eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: Al principio no tenía mucha fe en todo esto, pero, si seguimos por este camino, la investigación irá bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: I wasn't confident how things would go at first, but if we can keep this up, the investigation should go just fine.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: All'inizio non avevo molta fiducia in tutto questo, ma se continuiamo cosi', l'indagine andra' bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: Aunque apuesto a que sin tu alquimia estaríamos aquí mano sobre mano y no habríamos avanzado nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: Without your alchemy, we'd have just been sitting around twiddling our thumbs with no progress to speak of.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: Senza la tua alchimia, scommetto che saremmo rimasti qui con le mani in mano, senza fare alcun progresso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: Ya... Puede ser.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: ... Yeah, probably.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: Gia'... Puo' darsi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: ¿Qué pasa? ¿Te preocupa algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: Hm? Is something bothering you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: Che c'e'? Ti preoccupa qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: Nada, pensaba en lo mucho que te obsesiona el trabajo. Quiero decir que no te das un respiro como caballero.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: I was just thinking that you're pretty fixated on work—I mean, that you're a really dutiful knight.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: Niente, pensavo a quanto sei fissata col lavoro. Cioe', sei davvero un cavaliere ligio al dovere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: Mi posición en todo esto también tiene sus complicaciones...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: My position here does have its difficulties ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: Anche la mia posizione qui ha le sue difficolta'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: Ya... Tampoco yo lo tengo claro del todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: Hm ... Yes. That's a difficult issue for me as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: Gia'... E' una questione difficile anche per me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: Si te soy sincero, todavía tengo dudas sobre ti y la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: To be completely honest, I have my own share of doubts about you and the alchemy you use.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: A essere del tutto sincero, ho anch'io i miei dubbi su di te e sull'alchimia che usi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: Pero ahora mismo eres fundamental para nuestra misión. Gracias a ti hemos podido despejar algunas zonas de vínculo de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: But it's vital to our mission. Thanks to you, we've even managed to clear away some of the manabound areas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: Ma e' fondamentale per la nostra missione. Grazie a te siamo riusciti persino a liberare alcune zone avvolte dal mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: Lo que quiero decir es que, si tuviera que decir quién aporta más al equipo de investigación, no mencionaría a ninguno de los caballeros, sino a ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: In other words, the one who's contributing the most to the Research Team right now isn't us knights, it's you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: In altre parole, al momento sei tu a dare il contributo maggiore alla Squadra di Ricerca, non noi cavalieri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: No me perdonaría ignorar todo el empeño que has puesto sin más, es algo que no puedo hacer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: It wouldn't be right to dismiss all that effort without a second thought. At least, I couldn't.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: Non sarebbe giusto ignorare con leggerezza tutto l'impegno che ci hai messo. Almeno, io non ci riuscirei.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: Gracias... Me tranquiliza saberlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: ... Thank you. I'm glad to hear that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: Grazie... Mi fa piacere sentirlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: Te entiendo... Sí. Tampoco puedo negar que he sido algo desconsiderado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: Hmm ... Yes ... I suppose I should have told you this sooner.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: Ti capisco... Si'... Avrei dovuto dirtelo prima, immagino.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: A partir de ahora, intentaré aprender y basar mis opiniones en las cosas que haces y en cómo eres. Pero todavía no puedo darte una respuesta clara a tu pregunta...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: For now, I'm trying to watch and base my judgments on who you actually are. I don't have an answer yet, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: Per ora cerchero' di osservarti e di basare il mio giudizio su chi sei davvero. Anche se non ho ancora una risposta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: P-pero ¿te refieres a cómo soy yo como persona? Porque... tampoco tengo mucha fe en mí misma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: Y-you mean who I am as an individual? I'm not very confident in that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: I-intendi dire come sono come persona? Non ne sono molto sicura...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: ¡Ja, ja, ja! No le des más vueltas. Si te sirve de consuelo, no tengo una mala opinión sobre ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: Haha! There's nothing to worry about. At the very least, I don't see you as a bad person.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: Ahaha! Non pensarci troppo. Almeno, non ti considero una cattiva persona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: ¿Seguro que serás capaz de observarme tanto sin enamorarte de mí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: Are you sure you can handle watching me? You won't fall for me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: Sei sicura di riuscire a osservarmi cosi' a lungo senza innamorarti di me?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: ¡Ja, ja, ja! Conque sabes hacer bromas, ¿eh? Si te digo la verdad, jamás podría pensar mal de ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: Haha! So you can make that kind of joke. Honestly, I just can't see you as a bad person.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: Ahah! Quindi sai anche scherzare. A dire il vero, non riesco proprio a vederti come una cattiva persona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: Siempre eres sincera y es evidente que sientes una férrea determinación por cada cosa que haces, en especial cuando usas la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: You're always sincere, and there's a clear determination behind your actions. Especially when you're using alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: Sei sempre sincera e dietro ogni tua azione si vede una forte determinazione. Soprattutto quando usi l'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: Agradezco mucho toparme con personas así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: Personally, I love that kind of attitude.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: Mi fa davvero piacere incontrare persone cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: ¡Va-vaya! No tienes pelos en la lengua.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: W-wow, you're awfully straightforward.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: V-va-vah, sei davvero schietta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: ¿Eh? ¿Por qué lo dices?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: Hm? What makes you say that?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: Eh? Perche' lo dici?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: Ah, por nada, estaba pensando en voz alta. Creo que te estoy conociendo un poco mejor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: Oh, nothing. I just thought, "So that's the kind of person he is."
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: Ah, niente. Stavo solo pensando ad alta voce. Credo di conoscerti un po' meglio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: ¿Eh? ¿Y eso qué quiere decir?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: Huh? Wh-what's that supposed to mean?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: Eh? E cosa vorrebbe dire questo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..src: (Es una persona muy honesta...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..ref: ( ... He really is an honest guy.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_010..dst: (E' davvero una persona onesta...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_020..dst: Non puo' essere! Dimmi che non e' vero!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_020..ref: Wh-what are you shouting about, Viktor?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_020..src: Un miembro del equipo ha salido a investigar la parte inferior de la zona erosionada y ya debería haber regresado, pero no ha aparecido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_020..ref: A team member went to go investigate the lower layer of the erosion zone, but he hasn't come back when he should have.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_020..dst: Un membro della squadra e' andato a esplorare la parte inferiore della zona erosa e avrebbe dovuto gia' essere tornato, ma non si e' fatto vedere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_020..src: No habría dado la voz de alarma si hubieran pasado unas horas, pero sabiendo dónde está, que no haya vuelto en un día... me preocupa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_020..ref: If it were just half a day, it wouldn't be cause for much fuss, but given where he is, being gone for a whole day is worrying ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_020..dst: Non avremmo dato l'allarme se fossero passate solo poche ore, ma sapendo dov'e', il fatto che non sia tornato in un giorno... mi preoccupa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_020..src: Eso es lo que pasa. Lo siento...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_020..dst: E' questa la situazione. Mi dispiace...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_020..src: No pasa nada, lo entiendo. Iremos a buscarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_020..ref: It's fine, I understand. Let's go look for him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_020..dst: Non fa niente, ho capito. Andiamo a cercarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_030..src: Hemos dado con el compañero, pero ese monstruo no parece dispuesto a dialogar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_030..ref: We found the guy, but that sure is one nasty-looking monster.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_030..dst: Abbiamo trovato il compagno, ma quel mostro non sembra disposto a dialogare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_030..src: Y que lo digas. Voto por prepararnos antes de dar un paso adelante...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_030..ref: No kidding. I think it would be best if we take a moment to prepare first ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_030..dst: Lo dici bene. Direi di prepararci prima di fare un passo avanti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_030..ref: There's no time for that! I'm going in!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_030..dst: Non abbiamo tempo! Vado avanti io!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_030..src: Ya, supongo que es lo que toca. Venga, salgamos también.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_030..ref: Well, I guess that's that. We'd better jump in too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_030..dst: Beh, immagino sia quello che tocca fare. Dai, buttiamoci anche noi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_030..src: Ufff, ¿en serio? ¡Siempre hace lo que le viene en gana!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_030..ref: Ugh, I swear! He just does whatever he wants!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_030..dst: Uffa, sul serio! Fa sempre quello che vuole!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..src: ¡Muchas, muchas gracias! Si no fuera por vosotros, ya estarían redactando mi esquela.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..ref: Th-thank you so much! If it wasn't for you, I'd have been a goner!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..dst: Grazie, grazie infinite! Se non fosse stato per voi, ormai starebbero gia' scrivendo il mio necrologio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..src: Lo importante es que estás bien. ¿Podrás volver solo a la base?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..ref: All that matters is that you're safe. Do you think you'll be able to make it back to the base?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..dst: L'importante e' che tu stia bene. Riuscirai a tornare da solo alla base?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..src: Sí, creo que sí. ¡Os debo una! No lo pienso olvidar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..ref: Yeah, I'll be fine. Seriously, I owe you guys one!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..dst: Si', credo di si'. Vi devo un favore! Non me lo scordero'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..src: Fiu... Menos mal que hemos llegado a tiempo. Creo que es momento de...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..ref: Phew ... I'm glad we made it in time. Well, I guess we should get goin—
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..dst: Fiu'... Meno male che siamo arrivati in tempo. Direi che e' ora di...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..src: La próxima vez que vayas a jugarte el tipo, avísanos, ¿entendido?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..ref: At least let us know when you're going to go jumping out like that, would you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..dst: La prossima volta che rischi la pelle, avvisaci prima, capito?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..src: No eres el único que... Bueno, ¡que no podemos dar la cara así sin prepararnos antes!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..ref: You're not the only one who ... Look, we've got things to prepare first!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..dst: Non sei l'unico che... Vabbe', non possiamo buttarci cosi' senza prepararci prima!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..src: Un paso en falso y podríamos haber acabado heridos... o algo peor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..ref: One wrong move and we could have been seriously injured, or worse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..dst: Un passo falso e saremmo potuti rimanere gravemente feriti... o peggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..src: Lo siento. Cuando he visto que había alguien en apuros, he actuado por instinto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..ref: I'm sorry. When I saw that someone needed help, my body moved by instinct.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..dst: Mi dispiace. Quando ho visto che c'era qualcuno nei guai, ho agito d'istinto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..src: Aunque tampoco diría que me estuviera jugando nada, vi claramente que podía salir airoso y por eso me atreví.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..ref: That's not to say that I didn't give it some thought, though. I figured I could win, so I jumped in.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..dst: Pero' non direi che stessi rischiando qualcosa: ho visto chiaramente che potevo cavarmela, ed e' per questo che mi sono buttato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..src: Uf... En serio, ¿por qué eres así?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..ref: *Sigh* ... I swear, you're always like this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..dst: Uf... Sul serio, perche' sei fatto cosi'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..src: Te decides a actuar y sales pitando. Lo habrás sacado del jefe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..ref: As soon as you're convinced you should do something, you dash straight off. You probably get it from the chief.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..dst: Appena decidi che devi fare qualcosa, parti a razzo. L'avrai preso dal capo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..src: El día en que el jefe nos rescató... Si hubiera ido un paso por detrás, no estaría aquí para contarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..ref: The day the chief rescued us ... If he had been even one step behind, we might not be standing here today.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..dst: Il giorno in cui il capo ci ha salvati... Se fosse arrivato anche solo un attimo dopo, forse oggi non sarei qui a raccontarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..src: El día en que vi al jefe corriendo para salvarnos, decidí que siempre actuaría de ese modo, así que no pienso titubear.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..ref: So, I won't waver either. I decided that the moment I saw the chief rush in that day, and I'm sticking to it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..dst: Il giorno in cui ho visto il capo correre a salvarci, ho deciso che avrei fatto lo stesso, e non ho intenzione di tirarmi indietro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..src: Escucha, puedes hacerte el héroe siempre que quieras, pero ten presente dónde estás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..ref: Look, you can show off all you'd like, but pay more attention to your surroundings.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_040..dst: Puoi anche fare l'eroe quanto vuoi, ma fai piu' attenzione a cio' che ti circonda.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: ¿Estás pensando en Lili Borea?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: ... Thinking about Lili Borea?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Stai pensando a Lili Borea?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: ¿Tanto se me nota?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: Sorry, is it that obvious?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Si vede cosi' tanto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: Un poco sí, pero conociéndote un poco, ¿qué otra cosa podría ser?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: Well, yes, but also knowing you, I figured that you definitely would be.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Un po', si', ma conoscendoti, cos'altro potrebbe essere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: Ya. Me estoy devanando los sesos y sigo sin encontrarle ningún sentido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: Yeah. But, no matter how much I rack my brains over it, it's not making any more sense.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Gia'. Mi sto scervellando, ma continuo a non venirne a capo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: Yo tampoco me la quito de la cabeza y... cuando vi tu expresión, me vi reflejada en ella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: I've been thinking about the whole thing, so ... when I saw your expression, I thought you might be, too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Anch'io non riesco a togliermela dalla testa e... quando ho visto la tua espressione, mi ci sono rivista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: Ya, supongo que cualquiera estaría preocupado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: Right ... It really is something anyone would worry about.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Gia', immagino che chiunque sarebbe preoccupato...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: «A pesar de las circunstancias, no debemos dudar a la hora de luchar si lo que queremos es cumplir con la misión».
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: "Regardless of the circumstances, in order to achieve our mission, we must not hesitate to fight."
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: "Nonostante le circostanze, non dobbiamo esitare a combattere se vogliamo portare a termine la missione".

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: Ya le he dicho eso a los demás en otros momentos. Estaba convencido de que hicimos bien en luchar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: I told everyone that before. I truly believed that fighting was the right thing to do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: L'ho gia' detto agli altri in altre occasioni. Ero convinto che avessimo fatto bene a combattere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: Pero ahora... empiezo a plantearme si fue buena idea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: ... But now, I wonder if that was really the case.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Ma ora... comincio a chiedermi se sia stata la scelta giusta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: Si me pongo en su lugar... Después de haber sufrido esa transformación, no me sorprende que esté dispuesta a todo por volver a ser humana.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: Thinking about things from her perspective ... After being altered like that, it's not surprising that she'd have done anything to return to being a human.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Se mi metto nei suoi panni... Dopo aver subito quella trasformazione, non mi sorprende che sia disposta a tutto pur di tornare umana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: Del mismo modo que nosotros usamos la alquimia para avanzar en la investigación sobre el continente, aunque se considere un tabú...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: ... Just like how we're using alchemy to further our investigation of the continent, even though it's taboo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Allo stesso modo in cui noi usiamo l'alchimia per portare avanti le ricerche sul continente, anche se e' considerata un tabu'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: Exacto, nadie está exento de cometer errores.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: Exactly. We're not blameless, either.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Esatto, nessuno e' immune dagli errori.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: ¿Qué derecho tenemos a condenar sus actos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: So what right do we have to condemn what she did?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Che diritto abbiamo di condannare le sue azioni?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: ¿Habremos hecho bien? No lo puedo saber...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: Did we ... do the right thing? I honestly don't know.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Abbiamo fatto bene? Non posso saperlo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: ¿Qué piensas tú? Sé que no debería hacerte a ti esta pregunta, pero... ¿Qué opinas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: Maybe I shouldn't even be asking you this, but ... what do you think? Is what we're doing wrong?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Tu cosa ne pensi? So che non dovrei chiedertelo, ma... Che ne pensi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: No lo sé. Mejor dicho, no creo que haya una respuesta a estas cuestiones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Non lo so. Anzi, non credo che esista una risposta a queste domande.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: ¿Que no la hay...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: I'm not sure. ... No, wait. I don't think there actually is an answer to that question.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Che non esista...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: No. Todos tenemos parte de razón, incluida ella. No se puede tener la verdad absoluta en estas circunstancias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: There's ... not?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: No. Abbiamo tutti in parte ragione, lei compresa. In queste circostanze non si puo' avere la verita' assoluta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: Obsesionarnos hasta darle una conclusión personal tampoco es lo mejor, porque te lo cuestionarías todo hasta el infinito.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: Nope. We're both right and wrong, and so was she. There's no way to be absolutely correct in this scenario ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Ossessionarci fino ad arrivare a una conclusione personale non e' la soluzione, perche' finiremmo per mettere tutto in discussione all'infinito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: Por lo menos, así veo yo lo de ser alquimista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: So obsessing over it until you get your own answer might be wrong, too. All you can do is keep questioning it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Almeno, io vedo cosi' l'essere alchimisti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: ¿Estás diciendo... que viva mi vida sin saberlo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: At the very least, that's my take on it as an alchemist.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Stai dicendo... che dovrei vivere senza saperlo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: Sí. Porque incluso cuando creas que tienes la respuesta, siempre te esforzarías por encontrar otra que te guste más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: ... A lifetime of never knowing for sure, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Si'. Perche' anche quando credi di avere la risposta, continueresti sempre a cercarne un'altra che ti convinca di piu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: Yo tampoco dejo de preguntarme si la alquimia se puede usar para el bien o no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: Yes. Even when you think you've got the answer, you have to keep searching for an even better one.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Anch'io continuo a chiedermi se l'alchimia possa essere usata per il bene oppure no.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: Justo cuando doy con una solución, empiezo a dudar de mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: I'm also constantly searching for the answer to whether alchemy truly is a good thing or not.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Proprio quando trovo una soluzione, comincio a dubitare di me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: Entiendo... La primera respuesta es solo el detonante de más dudas y preocupaciones...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: You just have to find your first answer. Then, you start to doubt that too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Capisco... La prima risposta e' solo il punto di partenza per altri dubbi e preoccupazioni...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..src: No sé si alguna vez podría dar siquiera con una primera respuesta...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..ref: ... The first answer in a whole chain of more worrying ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_050..dst: Non so se riusciro' mai anche solo a trovare una prima risposta...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..ref: Are you feeling a little run down?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..src: No... En realidad, puede que sea eso, pero me siento liberado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..ref: No, I ... Actually, I might be. But sort of refreshed, too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..dst: No... In realta', potrebbe essere cosi', ma mi sento anche sollevato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..src: No he dejado de pensar en Lili Borea todo este tiempo y siento que, por fin, he llegado a una conclusión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..ref: I've been thinking about Lili Borea this whole time, and I feel like I've finally found my first answer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..dst: Per tutto questo tempo non ho fatto che pensare a Lili Borea e sento che finalmente sono arrivato a una conclusione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..ref: ... Would you mind telling me what it is?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..src: ¡Claro! No habría llegado a nada sin tus consejos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..ref: Of course not. I've been following your earlier advice, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..dst: Certo! Senza i tuoi consigli non avrei fatto nessun progresso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..src: Entiendo lo de Lili Borea, pero no podemos negar que era una gran amenaza para nosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..ref: I understand Lili Borea's situation, but there's no denying that she was a major threat to us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..dst: Capisco la situazione di Lili Borea, ma non possiamo negare che fosse una grande minaccia per noi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..src: Por eso no me arrepiento de luchar contra ella, a pesar de saber eso ahora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..ref: That's why I have no regrets about fighting her, despite that knowledge.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..dst: Per questo non mi pento di averla affrontata, pur sapendo quello che so ora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..ref: Then, isn't that the same as believing we did the right thing?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..dst: Allora stai affermando che abbiamo fatto la cosa giusta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..src: Dan igual los motivos que lo sustenten, un crimen es un crimen. Dejarla campar a sus anchas solo habría traído más desgracias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..ref: It doesn't matter what the reason is—a crime is still a crime. Letting her run rampant would have resulted in more harm.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..dst: Quali che siano i motivi, un crimine resta un crimine. Lasciarla agire liberamente avrebbe portato solo altre disgrazie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..src: Siguiendo esta lógica... usar la alquimia para lograr nuestro objetivo nos deja en una situación muy comprometida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..ref: But, going by that logic ... relying on alchemy to further our goals doesn't make us any better.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..dst: Seguendo questa logica... usare l'alchimia per raggiungere il nostro obiettivo ci lascia in una posizione molto scomoda.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..src: Los mutantes fueron creados mediante técnicas que se basaban en la alquimia. ¿Qué derecho tenemos a juzgarla?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..ref: Techniques rooted in alchemy are what created mutants. What right do we have to judge her?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..dst: I mutanti sono stati creati con tecniche basate sull'alchimia. Che diritto abbiamo di giudicarla?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..src: No puedo ignorar mis sentimientos, pero tampoco me he reconciliado con ninguna respuesta aceptable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..ref: I can't shake either of those feelings, so I haven't managed to settle on an acceptable answer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..dst: Non riesco a ignorare i miei sentimenti, eppure non ho ancora trovato una risposta accettabile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..src: Y en estas me encuentro. Tenías razón, en realidad, no hay una solución correcta a este problema.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..ref: Well, that's where I'm at. You were right, though—this isn't something that has a specific answer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..dst: E mi ritrovo in questa situazione. Avevi ragione: in realta' non esiste una soluzione giusta a questo problema.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..src: Es muy frustrante no poder dilucidar si algo está bien o mal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..ref: Not being able to figure out if something is right or not is nothing short of frustrating.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..dst: E' davvero frustrante non riuscire a capire se una cosa sia giusta o sbagliata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..src: No hace falta que lo jures. Aun así... estoy empezando a pensar que hay tantas respuestas correctas como perspectivas sobre los hechos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..ref: I'm with you there. Still ... I'm realizing that there are just as many potential answers as there are ways to think about things.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..dst: Ti capisco bene. Eppure... sto iniziando a pensare che ci siano tante risposte corrette quante prospettive sui fatti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..src: Y gracias a eso, creo que he madurado un poco, así que no ha sido en balde.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..ref: Thanks to that, I think I've grown a little more. So, I'd consider it time well spent.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..dst: E grazie a questo, credo di aver maturato un po' di esperienza, quindi ne e' valsa la pena.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_060..ref: You really are an honest guy.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: ¿Otra vez igual? ¡Ya te he dicho mil veces que lo entiendo! ¡No hace falta que repases cada detalle!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: How many times do I have to keep telling you that I get it?! You don't have to go over every single little thing!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: Di nuovo? Te l'ho gia' detto mille volte che ho capito! Non devi ripassare ogni singolo dettaglio!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: Es evidente que sí te hace falta, porque no lo estás haciendo bien. Esta es nuestra obligación y es tan importante como cualquier otra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: Obviously I do, since you're not doing it right. This is just as much a part of our duties as everything else.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: E' evidente che serve, perche' non lo stai facendo bene. E' un nostro dovere, importante quanto qualsiasi altro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: Em... ¿pasa algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: Um, what's all this about?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: Ehm... sta succedendo qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: Nada, mi hermanito el catedrático estaba con otra de sus turras. En serio, una lección más y me arranco las orejas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: My nitpicky brother's gone off on another one of his lectures. I swear, my ears are going to fall off!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: Niente, il mio fratellino professore era di nuovo nel giro delle sue prediche. Sul serio, un'altra lezione e mi stacco le orecchie!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: Se ha pedido al equipo de investigación que escriba un diario, pero Isla lleva semanas sin hacerlo a pesar de lo mucho que nos lo han repetido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: Members of the Research Team must write a daily journal, but Isla's skipped a week's worth of entries despite how important that task is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: E' stato chiesto alla Squadra di Ricerca di tenere un diario, ma Isla da settimane non lo scrive, nonostante quante volte ce l'abbiano ripetuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: ¿Has cumplido tú con la tarea, Yumia? Seguro que sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: You've kept up with yours, haven't you, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: Tu l'hai fatto, vero, Yumia? Sicuro che si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: ¿Eh? A ver, déjame ver.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: Hm? Here, lemme see.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: Eh? Vediamo un po', fammi vedere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: "No está mal", "ni fu ni fa", "ha ido bien". Oye, Yumia... ¿Este es tu registro?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: "Pretty decent," "so-so," "good enough" ... Uh, Yumia ... those are your logs?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: "Non e' male", "ne' buono ne' cattivo", "e' andata bene". Ehi, Yumia... Questo e' il tuo registro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: Pues sí. He descrito cómo me sentía en cada momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: Sure. I just wrote down what I was feeling at the time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: Beh, si'. Ho descritto cosa provavo in ogni momento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: Vaya dos... ¿Qué sentido tiene pedirnos un diario si no damos los detalles de nuestro día a día?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: You two ... There's not really a point to keeping a journal if you don't go into detail, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: Guardatevi un po'... Che senso ha scrivere un diario se non si entrano nei dettagli della giornata?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: ¿Y qué has escrito tú, Viktor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: Then, what do you write about, Viktor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: E allora, di cosa scrivi, Viktor?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: Soy muy celosa de mis recuerdos, por eso no he dado más detalles. ¿Qué hay de malo en eso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: I want to keep my memories to myself, so I don't want to write the details. Is there something wrong with that?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: Sono molto gelosa dei miei ricordi, per questo non ho dato altri dettagli. C'e' di male in questo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: Ya... Es un sentimiento muy noble para cuando viajas sola, pero estos registros ayudan a todo el equipo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: *Sigh* Save that sentiment for when you're traveling alone. These logs are for the good of the whole team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: Vabbe'... E' un sentimento nobile da tenere quando si viaggia da soli, ma questi registri servono a tutta la squadra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: ¿Y sobre qué escribes tú, si se puede saber?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: So? What do you write about then?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: E tu su che cosa scrivi, se si puo' sapere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: Lo que he hecho ese día, si he tenido alguna escaramuza, cosas que he percibido, cualquier escollo en el camino, los monstruos que nos han dado problemas... Ya sabes, esas cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: What I did that day, whether or not I ran into any trouble, things I noticed, anything concerning, any monsters I encountered, that sort of thing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: Cosa ho fatto quel giorno, se ho avuto qualche scaramuccia, cose che ho notato, eventuali ostacoli lungo il cammino, i mostri che ci hanno dato problemi... Insomma, roba del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: Pero ¡estaría todo el día escribiendo! Además, ni que me fuera a acordar de todos los detalles de un día cualquiera.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: There's no way I could write all that! I can't remember every little thing that happens!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: Ma passerei tutto il giorno a scrivere! E poi, come se mi dovessi ricordare ogni minimo dettaglio di una giornata qualsiasi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: Por eso te he aconsejado que lleves siempre una libreta encima.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: That's why I said to always carry around a notepad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: Per questo ti ho consigliato di portare sempre con te un taccuino.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: Mira, no hay NADIE en el equipo ni en el mundo que sea tan cuadriculado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: Absolutely NO ONE on the team is anywhere near that organized!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: Guarda, non c'e' NESSUNO in squadra, ne' al mondo, che sia cosi' metodico.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: Pues a mí me va bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: I'm managing just fine, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: A me invece va benissimo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: ¡Claro que sí! Tú no eres de este mundo. ¿Cómo puedes ser tan meticuloso para algunas cosas y luego se te da tan mal lo más simple?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: Okay, fine! You're the ONLY one! Ugh, how is it that you're so meticulous when you're awful with fiddly stuff?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: Ma certo! Tu non sei di questo mondo. Come puoi essere cosi' meticoloso in certe cose e poi essere cosi' scarso nelle cose piu' semplici?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: ¡Yo podría decirte lo mismo! Con lo detallista que eres para algunas cosas, no entiendo cómo has podido ser tan irresponsable con esto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: The same goes for you! For how much you pay attention to little things, it's unacceptable that you let yourself be sloppy for things like this!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: Potrei dirti lo stesso! Con quanto sei pignolo in certe cose, non capisco come tu abbia potuto essere cosi' irresponsabile con questa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: ¡No soy irresponsable, soy eficiente!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: It's not sloppy, it's efficient!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: Non sono irresponsabile, sono efficiente!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..src: No cabe duda de que son hermanos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..ref: Wow, you can really tell they're related.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_070..dst: Non c'e' dubbio che siano fratelli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_080..src: ¿Estás haciendo mejoras a tu arma, Viktor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_080..ref: Viktor, are you working on your weapon?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_080..dst: Stai facendo dei miglioramenti alla tua arma, Viktor?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_080..src: Sí, es una de repuesto que he recogido del almacén. Nunca se sabe qué puede ocurrir al salir a investigar, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_080..ref: Yeah. Well, this one's a spare from the storehouse. But, you never know what's going to happen while we're out investigating, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_080..dst: Si', e' una di scorta che ho preso dal magazzino. Non si sa mai cosa puo' succedere mentre siamo fuori a fare ricerche, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_080..src: He pensado que sería buena idea tener una de repuesto por si acaso. Y... yo diría que ya he terminado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_080..ref: I figured it would be good to have a backup ready to go, just in case. ... There, that should do it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_080..dst: Ho pensato che fosse una buona idea averne una di scorta, giusto in caso. Ecco... direi che ormai e' fatto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_080..src: Eh... Creo que ha salido volando una pieza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_080..ref: Um, I think a piece just came off, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_080..dst: Ehm... Mi sa che si e' staccato un pezzo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_080..src: Ay, no, otra vez no... Esta vez he ido con mucho más cuidado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_080..ref: Darn it, not again. I thought I was being careful ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_080..dst: Oh no, di nuovo no... Stavolta ho fatto ben piu' attenzione...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_080..src: Trae, anda, yo lo haré por ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_080..ref: It's fine, leave it. I'll finish it up for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_080..dst: Dai, va', lo finisco io per te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..src: ¡Hala! ¡Nunca dejas indiferente, Yumia! Está mucho mejor que antes, ¡lo has dejado irreconocible!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..ref: Whoa! Impressive as always, Yumia! It looks so much better than before that I barely even recognize it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..dst: Wow! Impressionante come sempre, Yumia! E' molto meglio di prima, e' quasi irriconoscibile!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..src: Ya que me puse manos a la obra, se me ocurrió reforzarlo para que lo pudieras usar cuanto antes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..ref: I figured it would be good to make it strong enough to use straight away since I was already working on it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..dst: Gia' che mi ero messo al lavoro, ho pensato di rinforzarlo cosi' che tu potessi usarlo al piu' presto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..src: Aunque... explícame una cosa: antes, cuando nos hemos encontrado, dijiste "otra vez no". ¿Por qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..ref: But, there's one thing that's been bothering me. When you were at it before, didn't you say, "Not again"?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..dst: Pero'... spiegami una cosa: prima, quando ci siamo incontrati, hai detto "non di nuovo". Perche'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..src: Ah, bueno... eso es que... No se me da muy bien trastear con estas cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..ref: Ah. Er, um ... To be honest, I'm not any good at that kind of finicky work.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..dst: Ah, beh... ecco... Sinceramente non sono molto bravo con questi lavoretti delicati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..src: Suelo recurrir a manos más delicadas, como a Isla o al responsable de mantenimiento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..ref: So, I usually ask someone else for help. Like Isla, or the maintenance manager.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..dst: Di solito ricorro a mani piu' esperte, come quelle di Isla o del responsabile della manutenzione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..src: Pero antes lo hacías todo por tu cuenta, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..ref: But you were doing it by yourself before, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..dst: Ma prima lo facevi tutto da solo, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..src: Porque este es el tipo de cosa que debería aprender a hacer por mí mismo, y no tener que pedir ayuda cada vez.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..ref: It just seems like the sort of thing I should be able to do without having to get help all the time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..dst: Perche' e' il tipo di cosa che dovrei imparare a fare da me, senza dover chiedere aiuto ogni volta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..src: También me lo podrías pedir a mí, si quieres. Ya sabes que soy capaz de forjar armas desde cero.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..ref: You could ask me too, you know. I do already make weapons from scratch, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..dst: Potresti chiedere anche a me, se vuoi. Sai che sono capace di forgiare armi da zero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..src: Ya lo sé, pero ¿y qué sería de mí si, llegado el momento, solo tengo mis habilidades para salir de un aprieto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..ref: I know, but I'd be in trouble if a time ever came where I only had my own skills to rely on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..dst: Lo so, ma che ne sarebbe di me se, arrivato il momento, avessi solo le mie capacita' per cavarmela?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..src: Por eso, de vez en cuando, vuelvo a probar suerte, fracaso estrepitosamente, me pregunto en qué me habré equivocado y acabo pidiendo ayuda. Y vuelta a empezar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..ref: So every now and again, I'll give it another shot, fail horribly, wonder where I went wrong, and ask someone for help. It's a never-ending cycle.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..dst: Per questo, ogni tanto, ci riprovo, fallisco clamorosamente, mi chiedo dove abbia sbagliato e finisco per chiedere aiuto. E poi si ricomincia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..src: No sé si soy muy descuidado o si me salto algún paso... O si, simplemente, es falta de talento... En cualquier caso, no me queda otra que seguir practicando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..ref: I'm not sure if I'm being careless or skipping a step ... It could also be a lack of talent, I guess ... Well, there's nothing to do but keep practicing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..dst: Non so se sono troppo sbadato o se mi salto qualche passaggio... O se e' semplicemente mancanza di talento... In ogni caso, non mi resta che continuare a esercitarmi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..src: Te pega tanto insistir en algo que no se te da bien, Viktor...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..ref: Keeping at something that keeps getting you down is so like you, Viktor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_090..dst: Insistere su qualcosa che non ti riesce proprio e' cosi' tipico tuo, Viktor...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..src: Confieso que no soy especialista en la materia, pero ¿es cierto que los Welleks superan a los humanos en fuerza?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..ref: I don't know much about these things, but is it true that Welleks have better physical abilities than humans?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..dst: Confesso che non me ne intendo molto, ma e' vero che i Wellek hanno capacita' fisiche superiori a quelle degli umani?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..src: Ah... Pues... Sí, ¿creo? Sí, eso he oído al menos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..ref: Oh, um? Ah ... Y-yes. At least, I think so ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..dst: Oh... Ehm... S-si'. O almeno, credo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..src: Ya veo. Me reconforta saber que contamos con una aliada competente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..ref: I see. It's reassuring to have another capable ally.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..dst: Capisco. E' rassicurante avere un'altra alleata cosi' capace.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..src: Viktor, deja de asustar a la pobre chica.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..ref: Viktor, stop terrifying the poor girl, okay?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..dst: Viktor, smettila di spaventare la povera ragazza, va'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..src: ¿Por qué no le das un respiro? La estás intimidando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..ref: Would you mind staying a little further back? I think someone's feeling a little shy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..dst: Perche' non le dai un po' di respiro? La stai mettendo a disagio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..src: Vale, tiempo muerto, ¿es que nadie ve lo asustada que está?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..ref: Okay, hold on. How is that reaction anything but her being scared?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..dst: Ok, tempo morto! Come fate a non vedere quanto e' spaventata?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..src: ¿Qué? ¿Es que... he hecho algo mal? No quería asustarla... Que alguien me lo explique.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..ref: Huh?! D-did I do something wrong? I didn't mean to scare her ... Isn't this strange?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..dst: Cosa? Ho... fatto qualcosa di sbagliato? Non volevo spaventarla... Qualcuno mi spieghi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..src: No-no me has asustado... Es que... bueno, yo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..ref: I-I'm not scared ... It's just, u-um ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..dst: N-non mi hai spaventata... E' che... ehm, io...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..src: No te preocupes, Leni, es que mi hermano no se da cuenta de lo enérgico que es a veces.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..ref: Don't you worry, Leni. I get it. My brother's an imposing kind of guy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..dst: Non ti preoccupare, Leni, e' che mio fratello a volte non si rende conto di quanto sia energico.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..src: ¿Enérgico yo? Ni siquiera era consciente de haber elevado la voz ni nada...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..ref: I-I am? I don't mean to yell or get angry, at least ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..dst: Energico, io? Non mi ero nemmeno accorto di aver alzato la voce, o giu' di li'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..src: Ni falta que te hace, eres alto y grandote. ¡Es normal que la pequeña Lenja se sintiera presionada teniéndote tan cerca!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..ref: Even if you don't, you're big and tall, and Lenja's tiny. Of course she'd feel pressured if you get close to her!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..dst: E invece si', sei alto e grosso. E' normale che la piccola Lenja si sentisse sotto pressione con te cosi' vicino!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..src: Y no solo es grandote, encima es ruidoso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..ref: And you're not just big, you're loud as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..dst: E non solo e' grosso, e' anche rumoroso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..src: ¿E-en serio? No... No sé si os sigo, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..ref: R-really? I'm ... not entirely sure I get it, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..dst: D-davvero? Non... Non so se vi seguo, ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..src: Mira, no le des más vueltas. Normalmente, solo se consigue que todo el mundo se sienta incómodo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..ref: Look, don't think about it too hard. Being too conscious about that sort of thing usually just makes it way more awkward.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..dst: Guarda, non pensarci troppo. Di solito basta solo a mettere tutti piu' a disagio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..src: No lo hace a propósito, de verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_100..ref: He really doesn't mean anything by it, okay?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..src: Oye, se ha dormido, ¿tan cansado está?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..ref: Goodness, he's fast asleep. Did he run himself down?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..dst: Oh, si e' addormentato. E' cosi' stanco?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..src: Qué va, no tenía nada que hacer, las siestas le pirran.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..ref: Nah, he just didn't have anything more important to do. Afternoon naps are one of his favorite things.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..dst: Ma no, non aveva niente da fare, i pisolini gli piacciono da morire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..src: Sí, de verdad. Cuando estaba estudiando, se metía en líos por quedarse dormido en medio de la clase.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..ref: Oh, absolutely. When he was a student, he'd always get in trouble for taking naps in the middle of class.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..dst: Si', davvero. Quando studiava, si metteva nei guai per essersi addormentato in mezzo alla lezione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..src: Sabía que no estaba bien, pero era superior a sus fuerzas, sobre todo, si hacía calorcito.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..ref: He knew he shouldn't, but he just couldn't help it. Especially if the weather was nice.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..dst: Sapeva che non andava fatto, ma non poteva farci niente, soprattutto quando faceva caldo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..src: No sé por qué, pero me cuesta imaginarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..ref: Hmm ... Something about that's kind of hard to imagine.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..dst: Non so perche', ma mi costa immaginarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..src: Ja, ja. Viktor es siempre tan diligente que es la forma que tiene su cuerpo de recargar las pilas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..ref: *Chuckle* Viktor's normally so diligent, so maybe his body couldn't keep up without a midday nap?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..dst: Ah, ah. Viktor e' sempre cosi' diligente che e' il modo che ha il suo corpo di ricaricarsi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..src: Además, soy de la opinión que es importante descansar cuando tienes la ocasión. Aunque tampoco creo que debas hacerlo en medio de una clase, claro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..ref: Besides, I do think that it's important to rest when you have the time. Not that I'm condoning dozing off during lessons, mind you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..dst: Inoltre, ritengo sia importante riposare quando ne hai l'occasione. Anche se non credo tu debba farlo in mezzo a una lezione, ovviamente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..src: Y eso también se nos puede aplicar a nosotras. A mí me encanta dormir la siesta, así que tal vez deberíamos seguir su ejemplo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..ref: And that's especially true for us now. I'm quite fond of naps myself, so perhaps I should follow his example.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..dst: E questo vale anche per noi. A me piace tantissimo fare il pisolino, quindi forse dovremmo seguire il suo esempio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..src: Increíble, se ha dormido en un segundo, ¿será un don que comparten?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..ref: Whoa, she fell asleep in an instant. Are all nap lovers like this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..dst: Incredibile, si e' addormentata in un secondo. Sara' un dono che condividono?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..src: Pues visto lo visto, yo diría que sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..ref: We're two for two now, so probably.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..dst: Be', visto come va, direi di si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..src: Mmmgh... ¿Qué pasa? ¿Qué hacéis ahí de pie?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..ref: Nnh ... What's the matter? Why are you two standing there?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..dst: Mmmh... Che succede? Perche' state li' in piedi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..src: ¡Anda, pero si ha venido Nina! ¿Cuánto tiempo lleva aquí? No la he oído llegar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..ref: Whoa! N-Nina's here, too? How long has she been there? I didn't even notice!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..dst: Oh, ma guarda, c'e' pure Nina! Da quanto tempo e' qui? Non l'ho sentita arrivare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..src: Hace un momento. Dijo que iba a echarse una siesta y ha tardado como dos segundos en caer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..ref: She just sat down. She said she was going to take a nap, so she did. Instantly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..dst: Poco fa. Ha detto che voleva fare un pisolino e in due secondi era gia' addormentata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..src: Ya veo, pero... Nina, aquí no puedes dormir, cogerías frío. Deberías ir a la cama.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..ref: Sure, but ... Nina, you can't fall asleep here. You'll catch a cold. You're better off napping in a proper bed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..dst: Capisco, ma... Nina, qui non puoi dormire, prenderesti freddo. Dovresti andare a dormire in un letto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..src: Anda que no. Hace un segundo estaba en el quinto sueño y mira ahora. A no ser... que no se haya dado cuenta de que se ha dormido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..ref: No kidding. He was totally out of it until a second ago. ... Wait, unless he didn't actually realize he was asleep?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_110..dst: Non e' mica vero. Un secondo fa dormiva come un sasso e guarda ora. A meno che... non si sia accorto di essersi addormentato?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..src: Lo estáis dando todo ahí fuera, ¿eh? No hay día que no me lleguen noticias vuestras.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..ref: You two are doing quite an impressive job out there, aren't you? There's a new rumor about you every day.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..dst: State dando tutto la' fuori, eh? Non passa giorno senza che mi arrivino notizie su di voi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..ref: Should we maybe tone it down a little?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..src: No, no lo decía en ese sentido. Sois libres de trabajar a vuestro modo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..ref: No, it doesn't bother me. Do whatever you'd like.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..dst: No, non lo intendevo in quel senso. Siete liberi di lavorare a modo vostro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..src: Esas noticias demuestran lo mucho que estáis contribuyendo a la investigación. Nos viene genial para subir los ánimos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..ref: It's proof that you're making steady progress on the investigation, which is perfect for raising morale.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..dst: Quelle notizie dimostrano quanto state contribuendo all'indagine. Ci fa molto bene per tirare su il morale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..src: Aunque confieso que siento remordimientos por haberos cargado con una responsabilidad que no os corresponde.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..ref: Though, I do feel like that's putting more on your shoulders than I should be doing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..dst: Anche se confesso di provare rimorsi per avervi caricato di una responsabilita' che non vi spetta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..src: Para nada, es nuestra obligación como parte del equipo de investigación de Aladiss. No te sientas culpable por eso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..ref: No, it's all part of our duties as members of the Aladiss Research Team. Please, don't let it bother you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..dst: Per niente, e' il nostro dovere in quanto membri della Squadra di Ricerca di Aladiss. Non sentirti in colpa per questo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..src: ¡Ja, ja, ja! Ya veo que sigues siendo tan impetuoso como siempre. No sé si se debe a lo jóvenes que sois o si es parte de vuestro encanto, pero ¡ay! ¡Qué envidia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..ref: Haaa. You're both as energetic as always, I see. Whether that's youth or your own personalities, I couldn't say, but ... I'll admit that I'm slightly jealous.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..dst: Ah, ah, ah! Vedo che sei sempre impetuoso come al solito. Non so se dipenda dalla giovane eta' o dal vostro fascino, ma... ah! Che invidia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..src: Pareces cansado, jefe. ¿Tenéis jaleo en el equipo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..ref: You seem a little tired, chief. Has something been going on with the team?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..dst: Sembri stanco, capo. C'e' qualche problema nella squadra?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..src: ¿No te has enterado? Cada vez hay más heridos y nos quedan cuatro vendas mal contadas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..ref: Hm? Well, there's been an increase in injuries, which is running our stores of bandages down at a worrying rate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..dst: Non l'hai saputo? Ci sono sempre piu' feriti e ci restano quattro bende mal contate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..src: Supongo que, cuanto más terreno abarcamos, más fuertes son los monstruos, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..ref: Because the monsters have been getting stronger the further in we get, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..dst: Immagino che, piu' territorio copriamo, piu' forti diventano i mostri, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..src: Exacto. Por mucho que eso signifique que nuestra labor de investigación va viento en popa, nadie tiene muchas ganas de celebrarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..ref: Pretty much. While that does mean that we're getting somewhere with our investigation, it's not a situation to be celebrating.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..dst: Esatto. Per quanto significhi che la nostra indagine procede a gonfie vele, nessuno ha molta voglia di festeggiare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..src: A fin de cuentas, estamos investigando un lugar desconocido. El cansancio es un factor a tener en cuenta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..ref: We've been investigating an unfamiliar place this entire time, after all. Fatigue makes injuries more likely.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..dst: In fondo, stiamo esplorando un luogo sconosciuto. La stanchezza e' un fattore da non sottovalutare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..src: Claro, a la dificultad de nuestra labor hay que sumarle la falta de mano de obra, era cuestión de tiempo que ocurriera una tragedia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..ref: Exactly. Given how understaffed we are and how harsh the work is, this was bound to happen eventually.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..dst: Certo, alla difficolta' del nostro lavoro va sommata la mancanza di personale; era solo questione di tempo che accadesse una disgrazia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..src: No podemos mirar para otro lado. Una herida mal curada puede ser letal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..ref: This is definitely not a situation we can be lax about. Leaving wounds untreated can be fatal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..dst: Non possiamo voltare le spalle alla situazione. Una ferita mal curata puo' essere fatale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..src: Yumia, ¿podríamos ayudar de alguna manera? Seguro que sí, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..ref: Yumia, is there anything we could do to help? There's got to be something, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..dst: Yumia, potremmo aiutare in qualche modo? Di sicuro c'e' qualcosa, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..src: Podría crear un lote enorme de vendas, que nunca están de más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..ref: I could make an extra-large batch of bandages. That's something you can never have too many of.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..dst: Potrei creare un lotto enorme di bende, non sono mai di troppo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..src: Desde luego que no. Y creedme, sé que sois los primeros que estáis al pie del cañón, pero agradezco cualquier cosa que podáis ofrecernos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..ref: No, never. I know that you don't have much in the way of free time yourselves, but I would appreciate whatever you can scrape together.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_120..dst: Certamente che no. E credetemi, so che anche voi avete poco tempo libero, ma vi saro' grata per qualsiasi cosa possiate offrirci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..src: ¡Dichosos sean los ojos! ¿En serio has hecho todas estas en tan poco tiempo? Gracias, no sabes la alegría que vas a dar a tus compañeros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..ref: Well now! You managed to make that many in such a short time? Thank you, the other members are going to be thrilled.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..dst: Ma guarda che meraviglia! Hai fatto davvero tutte queste in cosi' poco tempo? Grazie, non sai quanta gioia porterai ai tuoi compagni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..src: Si la cosa se vuelve a poner fea, no dudes en acudir a nosotros, haremos lo que podamos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..ref: If there's anything else, please don't hesitate to ask. We'll do whatever we can to help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..dst: Se la situazione si fara' di nuovo brutta, non esitare a rivolgerti a noi, faremo quel che potremo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..src: Agradezco vuestra oferta, de verdad que sí, pero ya os traéis bastante entre manos. No os desviéis de vuestras obligaciones para ayudarme.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..ref: As much as I appreciate the offer, you've got your own duties to focus on. Just help me out if it's on your way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..dst: Vi ringrazio dell'offerta, davvero, ma avete gia' abbastanza da fare. Non allontanatevi dai vostri doveri per aiutarmi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..src: ¡No pasa nada! Podemos ayudarte y dar lo mejor de nosotros para completar la misión al mismo tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..ref: It's no problem! We'll do our best to not only carry out our mission, but support you as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..dst: Nessun problema! Possiamo aiutarti e dare il massimo per completare la missione allo stesso tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..src: Confías mucho en el jefe, Viktor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..ref: You sure do have a lot of faith in the chief, Viktor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..dst: Ti fidi molto del capo, Viktor.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..src: Tengo buenos motivos. Estoy en deuda por lo que hizo en su momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..ref: That goes without saying. I'll never stop owing him for what he did.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..dst: Ho buone ragioni. Gli sono in debito per quello che ha fatto all'epoca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..src: Bueno, bueno, hice lo que haría cualquier caballero que se precie en mi lugar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..ref: Now, now. I only did what any knight worth their salt would have done, nothing more.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..dst: Beh, beh, ho fatto solo quello che avrebbe fatto qualsiasi cavaliere che si rispetti al mio posto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..src: Ya, pero ni Isla ni yo hubiéramos recuperado la sonrisa si no llega a ser por ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..ref: Still, I don't think Isla or I would be able to smile like we do now if it wasn't for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..dst: Gia', ma ne' Isla ne' io avremmo ritrovato il sorriso se non fosse stato per te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..src: Es igual que cuando nos invitaste a unirnos al equipo de investigación. Te enfadaste muchísimo con los que habían provocado ese desastre, pero, aun así, antepusisteis nuestros sentimientos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..ref: It's the same as when you allowed us to join the Research Team. You looked at us, full of rage towards the culprit of that disaster ... and you considered our feelings first.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..dst: E' come quando ci hai invitati a unirci alla Squadra di Ricerca. Ti sei arrabbiato tantissimo con chi aveva causato quel disastro, ma, nonostante cio', hai anteposto i nostri sentimenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..src: El tipo de persona que eres hace que Isla y yo confiemos plenamente en ti, jefe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..ref: Because you're that kind of person, Isla and I trust you wholeheartedly, Chief.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..dst: Il tipo di persona che sei fa si' che Isla e io ci fidiamo pienamente di te, capo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..src: Y todavía no sé si actué bien... Pero, en ese momento, fue lo único que se me ocurrió.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..ref: ... I can't say for certain that it was the right choice, though. It was just the only thing I could think of.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..dst: ... E ancora non so se ho agito bene... Ma in quel momento era l'unica cosa che mi e' venuta in mente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..src: Sea como sea, estamos muy agradecidos. Jamás nos cansaremos de darte las gracias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..ref: At the very least, we're still grateful for it. We always have been, and always will be.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_130..dst: In ogni caso, ti siamo molto grati. Non ci stancheremo mai di ringraziarti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Yumia, ¿te encuentras bien? Además de los recuerdos, ¿has notado algo más?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: Yumia, are you feeling all right? Aside from your memories, have there been any other effects?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Yumia, ti senti bene? Oltre ai ricordi, hai notato qualche altro effetto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Estoy bien, no te preocupes en exceso. Dejando a un lado los recuerdos de mi madre, no me pasa nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: I'm all right. You're worrying way too much. Apart from the memories of my mother, I'm completely fine.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Sto bene, non preoccuparti troppo. A parte i ricordi di mia madre, non mi succede niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Lo siento, Yumia, de veras. No sabes...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: ... I'm sorry, Yumia. I really mean it. I—
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Mi dispiace, Yumia, davvero. Non sai...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: ¡Oye, oye! ¿A qué viene eso? Vamos, déjalo ya.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: Whoa! What's gotten into you? Come on, don't do that!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Ehi, ehi! Ma cosa ti prende? Dai, smettila!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Debería protegerte y, en cambio, te dejé sufrir una situación tan dolorosa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: I'm supposed to be protecting you, but I let you suffer through such a dangerous situation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Dovrei proteggerti e invece ti ho lasciata affrontare una situazione cosi' dolorosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Y eso no es lo peor, encima ahora has perdido los valiosos recuerdos de alguien tan importante para ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: That's not even the worst of it. You even lost the memories you had left of a precious family member.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: E non e' nemmeno la cosa peggiore: ora hai anche perso i preziosi ricordi di una persona cosi' importante per te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Ni siquiera has querido sacar el tema. Mira, olvídalo, es imposible que llegue a resarcirme por todo esto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: And you haven't said one bad thing about it, never mind that there's no way I could even come close to making amends.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Non ne hai nemmeno voluto parlare. Insomma, lascia perdere, e' impossibile che io possa riscattarmi per tutto questo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: ¿Y si empiezas por mirarme a los ojos...? Me cuesta mantener una conversación si no puedo verte la cara.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: ... Could you at least look at me? It's hard to have a conversation when I can't see your face.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Che ne dici di iniziare a guardarmi negli occhi...? Fatico a conversare se non riesco a vederti il viso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Antes de nada, déjame decirte que no estoy afectada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: First of all, let me say this—none of that bothers me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Innanzitutto, lascia che ti dica una cosa: non ci resto male.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Y tampoco creo que tú seas el culpable. Los dos seguimos vivos y eso es todo lo que importa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: I don't think you're to blame for what happened either. We're both still alive, which is all that matters.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: E non credo nemmeno che tu sia il colpevole. Siamo entrambi ancora vivi, ed e' tutto cio' che conta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Tu obligación era vigilarme, no protegerme.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: Your job was just to keep an eye on me, not guard me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Il tuo compito era sorvegliarmi, non proteggermi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Tienes razón, tengo la responsabilidad de supervisaros, pero nadie me ordenó jugarme la vida para protegeros...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: True ... My duty is to observe you, but no one ordered me to put my life on the line to protect you ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Hai ragione, ho la responsabilita' di supervisionarvi, ma nessuno mi ha ordinato di rischiare la vita per proteggervi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Pero eres imprescindible para el equipo de investigación y la mejor amiga que tengo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: But your presence is integral to the Research Team's success, and you're also my most dependable friend.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Ma sei indispensabile per la Squadra di Ricerca, oltre che la migliore amica che ho.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Me arrepiento de no haberte protegido mejor por la amistad que nos une, no por mi trabajo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: I regret not doing a better job of protecting you because we're friends, not because of our roles.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Mi pento di non averti protetta meglio per l'amicizia che ci unisce, non per il mio compito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Esto va a sonar raro viniendo de mí, pero... ¿hablas en serio? ¿De verdad quieres mantener una amistad con una alquimista?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: This might sound a little weird coming from me, but ... are you sure about that? You really want to call an alchemist your friend?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Sara' strano sentirlo dire da me, ma... sei sicuro? Vuoi davvero essere amico di un'alchimista?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: La alquimia se prohibió porque gente despiadada la usó para hacer el mal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: ... Alchemy is taboo because people in the past were using it for wicked deeds.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: L'alchimia fu proibita perche' gente spietata la uso' per compiere il male.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Y eso se podría decir de cualquier herramienta. Las espadas, incluso nuestras propias manos, se podrían usar para hacer daño a los demás en lugar de para ayudarnos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: But, that's true of anything. Swords—even hands—can be used to hurt people just as easily as they can help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: E questo si potrebbe dire di qualunque strumento. Le spade, e perfino le nostre mani, potrebbero essere usate per ferire gli altri invece che per aiutarli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Tus motivos para usar la alquimia son los correctos, ni que decir tiene. Y no lo niegues, porque lo he visto de primera mano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: You're using alchemy for all the right reasons, though. That much is obvious. After all, I've seen it firsthand.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: I tuoi motivi per usare l'alchimia sono quelli giusti, questo e' innegabile. E non provare a negarlo, perche' l'ho visto con i miei occhi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Para, vas a hacer que me sonroje. Si sigues elogiándome, me volveré una engreída.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: ... Please, you're making me blush. If you keep complimenting me like that, it'll go to my head.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Basta, mi farai arrossire. Se continui a farmi i complimenti, diventero' presuntuosa.
