eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Gracias, Viktor. Me consuela saber que tienes tanta fe en mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: But, thank you. I'm really glad to hear that you have that much faith in me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Grazie, Viktor. Mi consola sapere che hai tanta fiducia in me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Pues claro. Por eso quiero que sea una confianza mutua.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: ... Yeah, I do. That's why I want you to trust me too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Ma certo. Per questo voglio che sia una fiducia reciproca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Te prometo que nunca dejaré que nadie te vuelva a arrebatar algo preciado para ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: I swear, I'll never let anyone steal anything precious from you again.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Ti prometto che non lasciero' mai piu' che nessuno ti rubi qualcosa di prezioso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Te protegeré hasta el fin de los días, como caballero y como amigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: I'll protect you to the very end, both as a knight, and as your friend.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Ti proteggero' fino alla fine dei giorni, come cavaliere e come amico.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Tú también eres un aliado para mí, Viktor, pero lo que más valoro de ti es tu amistad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: I think of you as an ally too, Viktor. But more importantly, as a friend.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Anche tu sei un alleato per me, Viktor, ma cio' a cui tengo di piu' e' la tua amicizia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Por eso no me perdonaría ver que te expones a un peligro por protegerme. No podría soportarlo, y menos siendo alguien a quien tengo tanto aprecio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: That's exactly why I don't want you to put yourself in danger to protect me. Seeing someone you care for do that is too much.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Per questo non mi perdonerei se ti esponessi a un pericolo per proteggermi. Non potrei sopportarlo, soprattutto da qualcuno a cui voglio tanto bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: Vale, si me lo pides así, te prometo que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: All right. If that's what you want, I promise I'll ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Va bene, se me lo chiedi cosi', ti prometto che...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: ... intentaré no pasarme de temerario.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: ... try harder to not do anything reckless.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: ... cerchero' di non fare nulla di imprudente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..src: ¡Ja, ja, ja! No hay forma de convencerte, ¿eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..ref: Haha! There really is no budging you, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm01_140..dst: Ah ah ah! Non c'e' verso di farti cambiare idea, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: ¡Viktor! ¿Qué le ha pasado a tu ropa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: Viktor! What happened to your clothes?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: Viktor! Che cosa e' successo ai tuoi vestiti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: ¿Por qué lo dices? Es la que siempre llevo, ¿qué le pasa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: What do you mean? They're the same ones I always wear. Is something wrong with them?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: Perche' lo dici? Sono quelli che indosso sempre, che c'e' che non va?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: Mírala, está en muy malas condiciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: Look closer. They're a little torn.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: Guarda bene, sono un po' strappati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: Ya, bueno, solo si te fijas mucho. Si no, no lo notarías.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: Oh, so they are. But no one will notice that unless they're really looking for it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: Vero, ma nessuno se ne accorge a meno che non ci faccia davvero caso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: No sé, que nuestro trabajo sea complicado no es motivo para descuidar nuestro aspecto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: Listen, just because we're on an investigation doesn't mean you've got an excuse to look sloppy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: Il fatto che siamo in missione d'indagine non e' una scusa per trascurare il nostro aspetto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: ¿A que tengo razón, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: You think so too, right, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: Non ho ragione, Yumia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: Toda la razón. Como miembros del equipo de investigación, deberíamos cuidar nuestra imagen.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: Isla's right. As members of the Research Team, we need to keep ourselves looking neat.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: Hai ragione. Come membri della Squadra di Ricerca, dovremmo curare la nostra immagine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: ¿Lo ves? No está bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: See? It's just not acceptable!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: Visto? Non e' affatto accettabile!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: ¿En serio? Creo que es una preocupación totalmente innecesaria para llevar a cabo una investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: Really? As the Research Team, I would think that appearances are the last thing we'd have to worry about.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: Davvero? Per fare una ricerca, direi che l'aspetto e' l'ultima cosa di cui preoccuparsi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: Mmm... Bueno, yo no le daría tanta importancia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: Hmm ... Something that small doesn't really bother me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: Mmm... Beh, io non gli darei cosi' tanta importanza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: Ya somos dos. ¿No ves que eres la única a la que preocupa algo así?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: There you have it. Aren't you the only one who would be bothered by something like this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: Vedi? Non ti accorgi che sei l'unica a cui importa una cosa del genere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: ¿Cómo? Ni hablar. Si te viera un caballero de alto rango, seguro que te echaría una bronca.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: What? No way! If a high-ranking knight spotted you, I'm sure they'd have something to say!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: Come? Nient'affatto! Se ti vedesse un cavaliere di alto rango, sicuramente avrebbe qualcosa da dirti!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: ¡Dámela! Te la arreglaré.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: Anyway, I'll fix it! Hand it over.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: Dammeli! Li sistemero' io.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: Como quieras, pero ¿no decías el otro día que apenas te quedaba tela?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: If you say so. But didn't you say we were running out of cloth the other day?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: Come vuoi, ma l'altro giorno non dicevi che ti restava pochissima stoffa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: ¡Es verdad...! Me había olvidado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: Oh, that's right! I completely forgot ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: E' vero...! Me n'ero completamente dimenticata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: ¿Necesitas que fabrique?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: Should I prepare some?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: Devo preparartene un po'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: ¿En serio harías eso? No te quiero dar mucho trabajo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: Huh? You mean you'll make some for us? Wouldn't that be a hassle?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: Davvero li faresti per noi? Non sarebbe troppo lavoro per te?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: Me encanta crear, sobre todo si se trata de algo que alguien necesita.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: I enjoy making things. Especially if someone needs them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: Adoro creare, soprattutto se si tratta di qualcosa di cui qualcuno ha bisogno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: A ti te pasa igual, Isla: cuando te pones a coser, te olvidas del resto del mundo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: Just like how you sometimes get so focused on your sewing that you forget to eat, Isla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: A te succede lo stesso, Isla: quando ti metti a cucire, ti dimentichi del resto del mondo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: Es que, cuando tengo la ocasión de dejarme llevar por la creatividad, no puedo parar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: Once I start bringing my ideas to life, I get so carried away that I just can't stop myself ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: E' che quando do vita alle mie idee, mi lascio trasportare e non riesco piu' a fermarmi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: Te entiendo perfectamente. Te concentras tanto que ¡puf! Todo lo demás se desvanece.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: I know exactly what you mean. You just start to focus and then poof! It's suddenly getting dark.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: Ti capisco perfettamente. Ti concentri cosi' tanto che puff! All'improvviso si fa buio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: Sí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: Exactly ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..src: Nos parecemos más de lo que creía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..ref: We might be more alike than I thought.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_010..dst: Ci somigliamo piu' di quanto pensassi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..src: Isla, te he traído la tela.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..ref: Isla, I brought the cloth we talked about.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..dst: Isla, ti ho portato il tessuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..src: Gracias, ahora podré arreglar la ropa de Viktor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..ref: Thanks! Now I can fix up Viktor's clothes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..dst: Grazie, ora potro' sistemare i vestiti di Viktor.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..src: ¡Vaya, es más de lo que esperaba!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..ref: Wow, it's bigger than I expected.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..dst: Wow, ne ho piu' di quanto mi aspettassi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..src: De hecho, podría usarla para que la ropa aguante un poco más. O quizás podría probar una nueva técnica...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..ref: With this much, I could layer the fabric to make it less likely to tear. That, or think up a different way to sew it ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..dst: In effetti, potrei usarla per far durare i vestiti un po' di piu'. O magari provare una nuova tecnica...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..src: Ja, sí que me veo un poco reflejada...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..ref: Hmm ... I guess there really is some similarity.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..dst: Ah, e' vero, mi vedo un po' riflessa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..src: ¿Reflejada? ¿Qué quieres decir?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..ref: Similarity? What do you mean?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..dst: Riflessa? Cosa vuoi dire?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..src: En la costura es muy importante el método que uses para dar vida a tus ideas. Bien: lo mismo que ocurre en la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..ref: Coming up with new materials and methods for making better stuff—it's the same for both sewing and alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..dst: Nella cucitura e' molto importante il metodo che usi per dare vita alle tue idee. Proprio come nell'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..src: ¿En la costura y en la alquimia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..ref: Sewing and alchemy?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..dst: Nella cucitura e nell'alchimia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..src: Sí, verte confeccionando tus prendas me llena de inspiración.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..ref: Yes. That's why, as a fellow creator of things, I'd love to see how you make clothes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..dst: Si', guardarti mentre confezioni i tuoi capi mi riempie di ispirazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..src: Bueno, no es que sea una artista... Me vas a sacar los colores.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..ref: Oh, it's not really anything impressive ... This is a little embarrassing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..dst: Beh, non e' che sia un'artista... Mi stai facendo arrossire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..src: ¡No te avergüences! Tenemos mucha creatividad, eso es todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..ref: No need to be embarrassed. We're fellow creators, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..dst: Non vergognarti! Abbiamo tanta creativita', ecco tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..src: Creatividad... sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..ref: Fellow creators ... Right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..dst: Creativita'... si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..src: Me encantaría tomarme la costura tan en serio como antes. ¡Hasta podría hacer un uniforme para los miembros del equipo de investigación!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..ref: Maybe I'll try making clothes seriously again, like I used to. Something adventurous that suits the Research Team!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..dst: Mi piacerebbe dedicarmi alla cucitura con la serieta' di una volta. Potrei persino fare un'uniforme per i membri della Squadra di Ricerca!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..src: Algo que nos siente bien a todos. Incluso podría diseñar algo personalizado para ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..ref: Oh, I should also think about what would look good on everyone. I could design something for you in particular.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..dst: Qualcosa che stia bene a tutti noi. Potrei persino disegnare qualcosa di personalizzato per te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..src: ¿Para mí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..ref: M-me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..dst: Per me?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..src: ¿Te gustaría? Sería muy divertido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..ref: Would you mind? Doesn't it sound fun?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..dst: Ti andrebbe? Sarebbe molto divertente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..src: No estaría mal...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..ref: I guess I don't mind ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..dst: Non sarebbe male...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..src: ¡Yupi! ¡Seguro que te encanta!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..ref: Yay! I'm sure you'll love it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..dst: Evviva! Sono sicura che ti piacera' tantissimo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..src: Primero diseñaré el patrón. ¡Ay! Pero no tengo maniquí. ¿Qué podría usar en su lugar?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..ref: First, I need to prepare the pattern. Oh, I don't have a mannequin. What could I use instead ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..dst: Per prima cosa disegnero' il modello. Oh! Pero' non ho un manichino. Cosa potrei usare al suo posto?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..src: (Sí que se queda absorta... Se nota que lo disfruta.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..ref: (She's really getting into this. I can see how much she loves it.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_020..dst: (E' davvero presa... Si vede quanto le piace.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: ¡Anda! ¿Estás cosiendo? Pero esa ropa no es tuya, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: Oh, you're sewing? But those aren't your clothes, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Oh! Stai cucendo? Ma quei vestiti non sono tuoi, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: No, es de Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: No, they're Rutger's.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: No, sono di Rutger.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Ese idiota es tan despreocupado que siempre lleva la ropa hecha un desastre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: That idiot is so careless with his clothes that they're always falling apart.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Quell'idiota e' cosi' spensierato che i suoi vestiti sono sempre ridotti malissimo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Oh, y me he quedado sin cuero: tendré que dejarlo para otro momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: Oh, I've run out of hide. Guess I'll have to continue this some other time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Ah, e sono rimasta senza cuoio: dovro' riprendere piu' avanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: ¿Quieres que vaya a buscar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: Do you want me to go gather some for you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Vuoi che vada a prenderlo io?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: ¿No te importaría? Es que este pellejo solo lo sueltan los monstruos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: Really? You'd do that? But this hide only comes from monsters.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Davvero? E' che questa pelle la lasciano solo i mostri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Me desviaré un poco durante mi paseo diario.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: It'd just be a slight detour on my usual walk.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Mi allunghero' un po' durante la mia passeggiata quotidiana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Pues... La verdad es que voy a aceptar tu oferta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: Hmm ... In that case, I'll take you up on that offer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Allora... In effetti accetto la tua offerta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Puf, preferiría mil veces estar diseñando tu ropa en lugar de arreglar la de Rutger...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: *Sigh* I'd much rather be thinking about your outfit instead of fixing Rutger's, though ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Uff, preferirei mille volte stare a disegnare i tuoi vestiti invece di sistemare quelli di Rutger...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Ja, ja, no hay prisa. Tengo muchas ganas de ver qué se te ocurre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: Haha, no rush. I'm looking forward to seeing what kind of clothes you'll come up with.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Ah ah, non c'e' fretta. Non vedo l'ora di vedere cosa creerai.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Pues he pensado mucho en qué tipo de prendas confeccionar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: I've actually been putting a lot of thought into what kind of clothes to make.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Beh, ho pensato molto su che tipo di capi confezionare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Había imaginado que, como alquimista, te sentaría bien algo con vuelo que te acompañe en tus movimientos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: Since you're an alchemist, I was thinking something that flows nicely when you dance would be good.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Avevo immaginato che, da alchimista, ti starebbe bene qualcosa di fluido che segua i tuoi movimenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Pero también debe de ser cómodo para que no te moleste al hacer tus danzas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: But I also know that it has to be easy to move in so that it won't get in the way when you're dancing ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Pero' deve anche essere comodo, per non darti fastidio mentre danzi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Sí, sería genial que no me molestara al hacer alquimia y ¿podría pedir que sirviera también para llevar muchos ingredientes?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: Yeah, something easy to move around in would be great. Also, maybe something that can hold lots of ingredients?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Si', sarebbe fantastico non essere intralciata mentre faccio alchimia, e chiedo anche che possa contenere molti ingredienti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Mmm... ¡Sí! entiendo lo que dices. Le añadiré bolsillos adorables, pero robustos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: Hmm, right, got it. In that case, maybe I should add some cute yet durable pockets.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Mmm... Si'! Ho capito cosa vuoi dire. Aggiungero' tasche adorabili, ma robuste.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Tienes mucho talento. ¿Hace mucho que coses?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: You seem quite skilled at sewing. Have you been doing it for a long time?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Hai davvero talento. Cuci da molto tempo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Sí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: ... Yeah.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Cuando era pequeña, jugaba con una amiga a que teníamos una tienda de ropa. Recuerdo que nos encantaba llevar materiales y compartir ideas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: When I was little, my friend and I would pretend we ran a clothing shop. I remember bringing materials and ideas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Quando ero piccola, con un'amica giocavamo ad avere un negozio di vestiti. Ricordo che adoravamo portare materiali e condividere idee.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Mi amiga era hija de un sastre de la casa Duerer. Se le daba muy bien coser.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: My friend was the child of a Duerer tailor. She was incredibly good at sewing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: La mia amica era figlia di un sarto della casata Duerer. Era bravissima a cucire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Era capaz de crear cosas fabulosas, como tú con la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: Just like you with alchemy, she could make pretty much anything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Era capace di creare cose stupende, come te con l'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Por aquel entonces yo era muy tímida y no entendía a los mayores.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: Back then, I was really shy, always tiptoeing around adults.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: All'epoca ero molto timida e non capivo gli adulti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Odiaba las normas de etiqueta y la formalidad de la nobleza, pero jamás se me habría ocurrido expresarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: I hated the strict rules and lifestyles of the nobility, but never had the courage to stand up for myself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Odiavo le regole del galateo e la formalita' della nobilta', ma non avrei mai avuto il coraggio di esprimerlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: ¿Tímida? ¿Tú? Nunca lo hubiera dicho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: Shy? You? I can hardly believe that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Timida? Tu? Non l'avrei mai detto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Ja, ja, ja, ¿verdad que no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: Haha, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Ah, ah, ah, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Un día, me escabullí de una fiesta y, mientras paseaba por la calle, me tropecé y me rasgué la ropa que llevaba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: Then one day, I snuck out of a party. While wandering the streets, I tripped and tore my clothes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Un giorno scappai da una festa e, mentre passeggiavo per strada, feci un passo falso e strappai i vestiti che indossavo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Y así fue como la conocí. Me dijo que era una pena lo que les había hecho a mis prendas y se ofreció a arreglarlas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: That's when I met her ... She told me it was a waste of such fine clothes, and that she would fix them for me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Fu cosi' che la conobbi. Mi disse che era un peccato rovinare dei capi cosi' belli e si offri' di sistemarli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Así empiezan las buenas amistades.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: Sounds like you made a great friend.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Cosi' nascono le belle amicizie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Lo era. Jugábamos y creábamos todo tipo de ropa. Antes de darme cuenta, se convirtió en mi mejor amiga.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: I really did. We started playing and making clothes together, and before I knew it we were best friends.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Davvero. Giocavamo e creavamo vestiti di ogni tipo. Prima che me ne accorgessi, era diventata la mia migliore amica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Incluso hicimos la promesa de que algún día abriríamos nuestra propia tienda. Juntas, todo era posible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: We even promised to open a store someday. We believed we could make any kind of clothes if we were together.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Facemmo persino la promessa di aprire un giorno un negozio nostro. Insieme, tutto era possibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Así que abrir una tienda con ella es tu sueño.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: So then opening a shop together with your friend is your dream.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Quindi aprire un negozio con lei e' il tuo sogno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Era mi sueño.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: Well, it was my dream.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Era il mio sogno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Ay, no... ¿Le pasó algo durante el desastre de maná?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: Oh no. Did something happen during the mana disaster?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Oh, no... Le e' successo qualcosa durante il disastro del mana?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Sí, después de eso, me parecía absurdo perseguir ese sueño.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: Yes. After that, it just didn't feel right for me to follow that dream anymore.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Si', dopo di allora mi e' sembrato assurdo continuare a inseguire quel sogno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Lo siento mucho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: I'm sorry.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Mi dispiace tanto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Bueno, ¡el pasado pasado está! No te preocupes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: It's all in the past now! Don't worry about it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Vabbe', il passato e' passato! Non ti preoccupare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Y me sigue encantando coser. Me alegro de haber recordado esta historia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: I still love making clothes, even now. I'm glad that I was able to remember that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: E ancora oggi adoro cucire. Sono contenta di aver ricordato questa storia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Tú me recuerdas mucho a ella, por eso me he ido por las ramas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: You really remind me of her, so I wound up saying too much.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Mi ricordi tantissimo lei, per questo mi sono lasciata andare a dirne troppo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: Bueno, ¡no te olvides de las pieles!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: Anyway, don't forget about those hides!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: Vabbe', non dimenticarti delle pelli!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..src: N-no, descuida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..ref: R-right. No problem!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_030..dst: N-no, tranquilla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..src: ¡Por fin te encuentro, Isla! Te he traído las pieles que me pediste.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..ref: Isla, there you are! I brought the hides you asked for.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..dst: Finalmente ti trovo, Isla! Ti ho portato le pelli che mi avevi chiesto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..src: ¡Gracias! Así podré seguir con las ropas de Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..ref: Thanks! Now I can get back to fixing Rutger's clothes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..dst: Grazie! Cosi' potro' continuare con i vestiti di Rutger.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..src: ¿Todavía andas con eso? Date prisa o no tendré nada que ponerme.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..ref: You still haven't fixed 'em? Hurry up, or I'm gonna run out of clothes to wear.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..dst: Ma sei ancora li' con quella storia? Sbrigati o non avro' niente da mettermi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..src: ¿En serio te vas a quejar? ¿Y por qué no te las coses tú, listillo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..ref: Seriously? If you're going to complain, then you should sew them yourself!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..dst: Davvero vuoi lamentarti? E perche' non le cuci tu, furbo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..src: Además, no es mi culpa. Me dijiste que te encargarías de ir a por los materiales.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..ref: ... And wait a minute, this all happened because you never gathered the materials in the first place!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..dst: E poi non e' colpa mia. Hai detto tu che saresti andato a prendere i materiali.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..src: ¿Qué? Me ofrecí a hacerlo, pero entonces hiciste hincapié en que preferías hacerlo tú.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..ref: Huh? I said I'd do it myself, but you were the one who insisted I leave it to you!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..dst: Cosa? Mi ero offerto io, ma poi hai insistito sul fatto che preferivi farlo tu.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..ref: Rememberin' only what's convenient for you, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..dst: Hai proprio la memoria selettiva, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..src: Venga, no te enfades, que era una broma. ¿A quién le importa quién dijo qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..dst: Dai, non arrabbiarti, era uno scherzo. Chissene importa di chi ha detto cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..src: ¡No, no cambies de tema! Crees que con una risita se arregla todo y...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..ref: Come on, don't be mad. We're friends, right? Let's just all have fun!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_040..dst: No, non cambiare argomento! Tu credi che con una risatina si risolva tutto e...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Uah... Qué sueño.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: *Yawn* ... So sleepy ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Uah... Che sonno...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Ah, Isla, escucha, hace un momento...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: Oh, Isla. Listen to this, a little bit ago—
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Ah, Isla, ascolta, un momento fa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: ¿Isla, estás bien?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: Isla? You okay?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Isla, stai bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: ¡Ah, Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: Whoa! Oh, Yumia ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Oh! Ah, Yumia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: ¿Todo bien? Pareces ida...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: You okay? You seem a bit out of it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Tutto bene? Sembri un po' assente...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: ¡Sí, genial!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: Yeah! I'm just fine!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Si', benissimo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Si tú lo dices... ¿Qué hacías?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: If you say so ... What are you doing here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Se dici tu... Che ci fai qui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Escribir mi diario de investigación. Llevo varios días de retraso en la tarea...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: I'm writing in my research journal. I've been slacking off a bit recently ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Scrivere il mio diario di ricerca. Ultimamente ho un po' trascurato...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: ¿Seguro que estás bien? Parecías algo distraída hace un segundo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: Are you sure you're okay? You looked really out of it a second ago.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Sicura di stare bene? Un attimo fa sembravi davvero distratta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Estaba en mi mundo, pensando qué escribir en este diario.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: I was just lost in thought. Wondering what to write in my research journal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Ero persa nei pensieri, a decidere cosa scrivere nel diario.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Ya... Yo tampoco he escrito hoy nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: Oh yeah, the research journal ... I haven't written mine for today either.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Gia', il diario di ricerca... Anch'io oggi non ho ancora scritto il mio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Es como hacer deberes. Además, no todos los días tengo algo que escribir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: Honestly, it's such a hassle. There's not even that much to write about every day.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Sinceramente e' una seccatura. E poi non tutti i giorni c'e' cosi' tanto da scrivere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Ay, no, ya me he equivocado otra vez.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: ... Ah, dang. Made another spelling mistake.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Ah, no, ho fatto di nuovo un errore di ortografia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Ah, aquí estás, Isla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: So this is where you were, Isla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Ah, ecco dove sei, Isla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: El jefe te está buscando. Quiere hablar contigo sobre el inventario del equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: The chief was looking for you. He wants to discuss something about the Research Team's equipment.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Il capo ti stava cercando. Vuole parlare dell'attrezzatura della Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Ah, es verdad, se me había olvidado. Gracias por avisarme, Viktor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: Oh, that's right. I forgot ... Thanks for the reminder, Viktor!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Ah, e' vero, me ne ero dimenticata. Grazie per l'avviso, Viktor.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Isla, ¿te encuentras bien?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: Isla, are you feeling all right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Isla, ti senti bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: ¿Eh? ¿Qué? Sí, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: Huh? Yeah, I'm fine.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Eh? Cosa? Si', si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: ¿De verdad? Pareces cansada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: Really? You look tired.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Davvero? Sembri stanca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Tengo un poco de sueño, sí. Ayer me quedé cosiendo hasta bien entrada la noche.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: Ah, I just didn't get enough sleep. I stayed up late last night sewing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Si', ho un po' di sonno. Ieri sono rimasta a cucire fino a tarda notte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Porque unos compañeros que tengo no dejan de darme tarea de tanto romperse la ropa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: Certain somebodies keep tearing their clothes, so I have a huge pile to fix up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Perche' certi miei compagni continuano a strapparsi i vestiti, e ora ho una montagna di cose da aggiustare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Pero ¡estoy bien! Un sueñecito y estaré como nueva.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: But I'm just fine! A little sleep and I'll be all better!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Ma sto benissimo! Un riposino e saro' come nuova.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Te noto un poco distraída. De verdad, me preocupas. ¿No podrías echarte un rato?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: But you've been zoning out. I'm worried about you. Maybe you should get some rest sooner rather than later?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Ti noto un po' distratta. Sul serio, mi preoccupo per te. Non potresti riposarti un po' prima?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Aunque no es fácil encontrar un sitio para descansar por aquí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: That said, it's not that easy to find a quiet place to nap around here ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Pero' non e' facile trovare un posto tranquillo dove riposare da queste parti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Sí, la base es un poco ruidosa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: Right. The base is pretty noisy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Gia', la base e' un po' rumorosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: ¿Y si construimos una sala de descanso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: Oh, how about we set up a rest area?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: E se costruiamo una sala di riposo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Buena idea. Te echaré una mano. Nos podría servir también para tratar a los heridos si se diera la ocasión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: That's a great idea. I'll help out as well. It might also be useful for treating the injured in the future.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Ottima idea. Ti daro' una mano anch'io. Potrebbe servirci anche per curare i feriti, in caso di necessita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Gracias, Viktor. Necesitaremos camas, sillas y...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: Thanks, Viktor. We'll need beds, chairs, and ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Grazie, Viktor. Ci serviranno letti, sedie e...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: ¿Queréis que os eche una mano?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: Sh-should I help too?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: D-dovrei dare una mano anch'io?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Ni hablar, ¡si hacemos esto es para que descanses!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: No way. If you haven't slept, you need to rest!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Neanche a parlarne, se lo facciamo e' proprio perche' tu ti riposi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Es verdad, Isla. No te exijas demasiado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: I agree, Isla. Don't push yourself too hard.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: E' vero, Isla. Non sforzarti troppo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Se lo comentaré al jefe antes. Necesitamos su permiso para construir una zona de descanso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: First, I'll report this to the chief. We'll need his permission to set up a rest area.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Prima lo riferiro' al capo. Ci serve il suo permesso per costruire una zona di riposo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Ah, claro, tienes razón. Gracias por tu ayuda, Viktor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: Oh right, good point. Thanks for taking care of that, Viktor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Ah, giusto, hai ragione. Grazie per occupartene, Viktor.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: Aguanta un poco, Isla, ¿podrás?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..ref: So, Isla, just hold on for a little bit, okay?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: Resisti ancora un po', Isla, ci riuscirai?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..src: <SEL_CM02_050_1_B><CR>¿Seguro?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_050..dst: <SEL_CM02_050_1_B><CR>Sicura?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: ¡Vaya, cómo mola! ¿De verdad puedo descansar aquí cuando quiera?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: Wow, this is amazing! Can I really use this anytime?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: Wow, che fantastico! Davvero posso riposarmi qui quando voglio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: Claro, úsala cuando te lo pida el cuerpo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: Absolutely. Come here whenever you need rest.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: Certo, usala tutte le volte che ne senti il bisogno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: Gracias. Te has tomado demasiadas molestias... Procuraré no trasnochar tanto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: Thank you. I've caused more than enough trouble though, so I'll make sure not to stay up too late anymore.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: Grazie. Pero' ti ho gia' dato non pochi fastidi... Cerchero' di non restare piu' sveglia cosi' tardi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: No me haría ninguna gracia quedarme dormida en medio de una investigación por falta de horas de sueño.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: Passing out in the middle of an investigation from lack of sleep wouldn't be a laughing matter.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: Non sarebbe per niente divertente addormentarsi in mezzo a un'indagine per mancanza di sonno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: Claro que no. Eres fundamental para el equipo y te echaríamos mucho de menos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: Exactly. You're a key member of our team and it'd be tough for all of us without you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: Esatto. Sei un membro fondamentale della squadra e senza di te sarebbe dura per tutti noi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: Descansa todo lo que necesites, ¿vale?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: So take it easy for a while. Okay?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: Riposati quanto ti serve, va bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: Vale, lo tengo en cuenta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: All right. I'll be careful ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: Va bene, ne terro' conto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: ¡Te digo lo mismo, Yumia! Eres la única alquimista que tenemos en el equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: Although, you should take it easy too, Yumia! You're the only alchemist on the Research Team, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: Lo stesso vale per te, Yumia! Sei l'unica alchimista della Squadra di Ricerca, dopotutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: Si no llegas a venir a ocuparte del maná, no habríamos avanzado nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: If you weren't here to use mana, we wouldn't be able to get any further.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: Se non fossi qui a occuparti del mana, non potremmo andare oltre.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: Y estaría más tranquila si nos dejaras a nosotros encargarnos de esos monstruos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: Honestly, I'd prefer if you stayed back and left the fighting to us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: E starei piu' tranquilla se lasciassi a noi l'incarico di occuparci di quei mostri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: Ja, ja, ja, no hace falta que te preocupes por mí. Sé arreglármelas en una pelea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: Haha, you're being overprotective. It's fine. I can handle myself in a fight.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: Ah, ah, ah, non c'e' bisogno che ti preoccupi per me. So cavarmela in un combattimento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: Sí, ya lo sé, pero de todas formas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: Um, yeah. I know that, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: Si', lo so, pero' comunque...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: ¿Isla?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: Isla?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: Isla?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: Lo siento, no he sido del todo sincera.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: Sorry. I wasn't being completely honest.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: Mi dispiace, non sono stata del tutto sincera.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: Lo que en realidad quería decirte es que me da miedo que te ocurra algo malo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: It's hard to put into words, but I guess I'm just scared of something happening to you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: Quello che volevo davvero dirti e' che ho paura che ti succeda qualcosa di brutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: Ya he perdido demasiadas amigas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: I've lost more than enough friends already.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: Ho gia' perso fin troppe amiche.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: (Es verdad. Isla perdió a su mejor amiga...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: (Oh, right. Isla lost a close friend before ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: E' vero. Isla ha perso la sua migliore amica...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: Isla, gracias por cuidar de mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: Thanks, Isla. I'm glad I have someone like you looking out for me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: Grazie, Isla, per prenderti cura di me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: Pero sabes que tengo mis motivos para correr algunos riesgos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: That said, I have my own reasons to push forward.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: Ma sai che ho le mie ragioni per correre dei rischi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: Yo soy quien soy. No puedo ocupar el lugar de otra persona ni es mi intención.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: I am who I am. I can't replace her, nor do I intend to.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: Io sono quello che sono. Non posso prendere il posto di qualcun altro, ne' voglio farlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: Ya, lo siento...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: Right. I'm sorry ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: Gia', mi dispiace...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: Es el cansancio quien habla por ti. Vamos, ¡seguro que descansar te levanta el ánimo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: You're just feeling down because you're exhausted. Come on, it's time for you to rest up!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: E' solo la stanchezza che parla. Dai, vedrai che un po' di riposo ti tirera' su il morale!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..src: ¡Claro, claro! ¡Os haré caso, te lo prometo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..ref: Aww, I know! I'll rest up, I promise!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_060..dst: Si', si'! Vi daro' ascolto, promesso!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..src: Oye, Isla. Estaba pensando en nuestra última conversación...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..ref: Hey, Isla. I've been thinking about the last time we talked, and ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..dst: Ehi, Isla. Stavo ripensando alla nostra ultima conversazione...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..ref: Whoa, stop! Let me say it first!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..dst: Aspetta, aspetta! Lascia parlare prima me!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..src: Ja, ja, vale, te escucho, Isla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..ref: Haha. All right, Isla, you first.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..dst: Ah, ah. Va bene, Isla, parla pure.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..src: Gracias. Lo siento mucho. No me había dado cuenta de que estaba proyectando mis problemas del pasado en ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..ref: Thanks. ... I'm sorry. I didn't realize it, but I was projecting my past onto you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..dst: Grazie. Mi dispiace tanto. Non mi ero resa conto che stavo proiettando su di te i miei problemi del passato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..src: Me has leído la mente. Yo también lo siento mucho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..ref: Looks like you beat me to it. ... I'm sorry too, Isla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..dst: Mi hai letto nel pensiero. Mi dispiace anche a me, Isla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..src: Di cosas por sentado sin tener en cuenta todo lo que habías pasado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..ref: I made a lot of assumptions without really knowing what you've been through.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..dst: Ho dato molte cose per scontate senza considerare tutto quello che avevi passato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..src: Yo también perdí a alguien importante... y debí entender tus sentimientos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..ref: I've also lost someone precious to me ... so I thought I might understand what you were feeling.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..dst: Anch'io ho perso una persona importante... e pensavo di poter capire quello che provavi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..src: Por eso vine a aclarar ese punto; no correré la misma suerte que tu amiga.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..ref: That's why I just wanted to make clear that I'm not the same as your friend.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..dst: Per questo volevo chiarire una cosa: non faro' la stessa fine della tua amica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..src: Pero debí expresarme mejor en aquel momento. Lo siento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..ref: But I should've been more careful about how I said it. I'm sorry.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..dst: Pero' avrei dovuto fare piu' attenzione a come mi sono espressa. Mi dispiace.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..src: ¡No, Yumia! No hiciste nada malo, fui yo. Estaba tan contenta de tener una persona con la que conectaba...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..ref: No, Yumia, you did nothing wrong! It's on me. I was just so happy to have a friend I felt a connection to again.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..dst: No, Yumia, non hai fatto nulla di male! E' colpa mia. Ero cosi' felice di aver ritrovato un'amica con cui sentivo di avere un legame...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..src: Y... creo que todavía no he superado su muerte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..ref: You know, I still don't think I've been able to come to terms with her passing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..dst: E... credo di non essere ancora riuscita ad accettare la sua morte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..src: Puede que nunca lo haga hasta que complete mi venganza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..ref: I may never be able to until I've avenged her.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..dst: Forse non ci riusciro' mai, finche' non l'avro' vendicata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..src: Pero tú no eres ella, Yumia, y no volveré a cometer el mismo error.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..ref: But, Yumia, you're not her. And I'll be sure that I don't forget that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..dst: Ma tu non sei lei, Yumia, e faro' in modo di non dimenticarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..src: De hecho, te quería pedir algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..ref: Actually, there's something I wanted your help with.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..dst: A dire il vero, volevo chiederti una cosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..src: Necesito más escamas para decorar las prendas que estoy confeccionando. ¿Te importaría ir a buscarme unas cuantas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..ref: I need more scales to decorate the clothes I'm working on. Would you mind going to gather some for me again?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..dst: Mi servono altre scaglie per decorare gli abiti che sto preparando. Ti dispiacerebbe andare a raccoglierne altre per me?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..src: Son escamas de monstruo, pero no te supondrá ningún problema, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..ref: The scales do come from a monster ... but that's no problem for you, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..dst: Sono scaglie di mostro, ma per te non sara' un problema, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..src: Por supuesto. Estoy aquí para ayudar, ya lo sabes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..ref: Of course. As always, I'm here to help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_070..dst: Certo. Sono qui per aiutarti, come sempre.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..src: ¡Siento la tardanza! Aquí traigo las escamas que me pediste, Isla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..ref: Sorry to keep you waiting, Isla! Here are the scales you asked for.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..dst: Scusa per il ritardo! Ecco le scaglie che mi avevi chiesto, Isla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..src: ¡Qué bien, gracias! Ya puedo darle a la ropa los últimos retoques.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..ref: Wow, thank you! Now I can get started on the finishing touches!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..dst: Grazie, che bello! Ora posso dare gli ultimi ritocchi ai vestiti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..src: No se merecen. A mí también me han servido para probar ingredientes nuevos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..ref: Don't mention it. It was a good chance for me to try some different ingredients too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..dst: Non c'e' di che. E' stata anche una buona occasione per provare ingredienti nuovi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..src: Oye, Yumia, mientras cosía, he estado pensando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..ref: Um, so, Yumia. While I was sewing, I did a lot of thinking.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..dst: Senti, Yumia, mentre cucivo, riflettevo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..src: Y la verdad es que eres muy especial. Tu estilo y tus gustos no tienen nada que ver con los de mi amiga.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..ref: I came to realize just how unique you are, Yumia. Your style and tastes are completely different from hers.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..dst: E a pensarci bene, sei davvero speciale. Il tuo stile e i tuoi gusti non hanno nulla a che vedere con quelli della mia amica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..src: ¡En fin! ¡Voy a confeccionar las mejores prendas de la historia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..ref: All right! I'm going to make the best outfit ever!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..dst: Insomma! Realizzero' i vestiti migliori della storia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..src: Isla... ¿No estarás obsesionándote demasiado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..ref: Isla ... Are you sure you're not pushing yourself too hard again?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..dst: Isla... Non starai diventando un po' troppo ossessionata?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..src: No, que va...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..dst: Ma no...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..src: Bueno, un poquito solo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..dst: Beh, solo un pochino.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..src: Como me recuerdas a mi amiga, supongo me abrí más contigo sin darme cuenta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..ref: I guess because I was projecting her onto you, I started getting close to you without really realizing it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..dst: Visto che mi ricordi la mia amica, immagino di essermi aperta con te senza accorgermene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..src: Ahora no tengo claro cómo portarme ni cuál es la relación que nos une.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..ref: Now I'm not really sure how I should act towards you—what our relationship should be.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..dst: Ora non so bene come comportarmi ne' che tipo di rapporto ci sia tra noi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..src: Nunca podré igualar lo que ella significaba para ti, del mismo modo que tú no puedes reemplazar a quien yo perdí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..ref: I can never be what she was to you, just like I know you can never replace the one I lost.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..dst: Non potro' mai essere all'altezza di cio' che lei significava per te, proprio come tu non puoi sostituire la persona che ho perso io.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..src: Pero sí que podemos forjar una nueva amistad, solo tú y yo, pasito a pasito.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..ref: But what we can do is build a new relationship, just between the two of us, slowly but surely.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..dst: Pero' possiamo stringere una nuova amicizia, solo tu e io, un passo alla volta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..src: Ya sabes... nuevas amigas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..dst: Insomma... nuove amiche.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..src: Sí, ¡las mejores!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..dst: Si', le migliori!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..src: Ja, ja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..ref: You know, I don't really understand fashion much.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..dst: Ah, ah.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..src: ¡Ja, ja, ja!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..ref: That's okay. You're you, and that's what matters! I don't know the first thing about alchemy!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..dst: Ah, ah, ah!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..src: Y, además, yo no entiendo nada de moda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..dst: E poi io non capisco niente di moda.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..src: No pasa nada. Tú eres tú y eso es lo que importa. ¡Yo no entiendo nada de alquimia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..dst: Non importa. Tu sei tu, ed e' questo che conta. Io non capisco niente di alchimia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..src: Pues vaya dos nos hemos juntado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_080..dst: Beh, che bella coppia che siamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..src: ¡Das más puntadas de las que puedo contar, altus! ¡Yo quiero!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..ref: You stitch-stitch so fast, Tall One! Mine too, please!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..dst: Fai piu' punti di quanti riesca a contarne, Alber! Ne voglio uno anch'io!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..src: ¡Y yo también! ¡Me encantaría tener un gorrito reluciente!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..ref: Mine too! A sparkly hat would be so nice!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..dst: Anch'io! Mi piacerebbe tanto avere un cappellino luccicante!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..src: ¡Qué monada! Digo... Vale, pero tendréis que esperar a que os toque. ¡Formad una fila!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..ref: Ahhh, they're so cute! ... Ahem. Please wait for your turn. Line up, everyone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..dst: Che carino! Cioe'... Va bene, ma dovrete aspettare il vostro turno. Mettetevi in fila!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..src: ¿Desde cuándo te llevas tan bien con los Alber?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..ref: Isla, when did you become so close with the Alber?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..dst: Da quando vai cosi' d'accordo con gli Alber?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..src: Pues todo empezó con este pequeñín de aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..ref: Oh, Yumia! Well, it all started with this little one here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..dst: E' cominciato tutto con questo piccoletto qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..src: ¡La altus me salvó la vida! Se le había salido un hilo y no sabía qué hacer ¡y ella lo salvó! ¡Mira, mira!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..ref: The Tall One saved my life! It was all tattered, and I didn't know what to do! But I was saved! Lookie, lookie!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..dst: L'Alber mi ha salvato la vita! Mi si era sfilato un filo e non sapevo cosa fare, ma lei mi ha salvato! Guarda, guarda!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..src: ¿Le salvaste la vida? ¿Estaba herido o algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..ref: You saved their life? Did you treat an injury or something?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..dst: Ti ha salvato la vita? Eri ferito o qualcosa del genere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..src: No, le arreglé el gorro hace un tiempo y después no se quería separar de mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..ref: Not exactly. I fixed this little one's hat a while back. After that, they became really attached to me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..dst: Non proprio. Tempo fa ho sistemato il cappellino di questo piccoletto. Da allora non mi si stacca piu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..src: Para el pueblo Alber, sus gorros son más importantes que su vida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..ref: Apparently to the Alber, their hats are more important than their lives.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..dst: A quanto pare, per gli Alber i loro cappelli sono piu' importanti della vita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..src: Ah, por eso dijo que le habías salvado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..ref: Ah, so that's why they said you saved their life ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..dst: Ah, ecco perche' diceva che gli avevi salvato la vita...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..src: Antes de que me diera cuenta, se habían puesto todos de acuerdo para pedirme que les arreglara los sombreros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..ref: But before I knew it, they all started gathering around and asking me to fix their hats.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..dst: Prima che me ne rendessi conto, si erano tutti messi d'accordo per chiedermi di aggiustare i loro cappelli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..src: Y ahora me dedico a «dar puntadas».
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..ref: I've been "stitch-stitching" nonstop for a while now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..dst: E adesso passo il tempo a "dare punti".

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..src: Ja, ja, ja, estás muy solicitada. ¿Puedo ayudarte con algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..ref: Haha, sounds like you've got your hands full. Anything I can do to help?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..dst: Ah, ah, ah, sei molto richiesta. Posso aiutarti in qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..src: ¡Ah! Pues ¿podrías traerme bayas de la luna? Van genial para teñir, pero se me han agotado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..ref: Oh, could you fetch some Moonlit Berries for me? They're great for dyeing, but I've run out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..dst: Ah! Potresti portarmi delle bacche lunari? Sono ottime per tingere, ma le ho finite.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..src: Espera, ¿también los tiñes?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..ref: Wait, you're dyeing them too?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..dst: Aspetta, li tingi anche?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..src: Sí, no me queda otra. ¡El color tiene que hacer justicia a lo adorables y suaves que son!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..ref: Yeah, I have to. Otherwise the color wouldn't match their adorable feel!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..dst: Si', non ho altra scelta. Il colore deve essere all'altezza della loro adorabilita' e morbidezza!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..src: ¡Toca, toca! ¡Las puntadas de la señorita altus son de calidad suprema!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..ref: Feel-feel? Miss human's stitch-stitch is different for everyone!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..dst: Tocca, tocca! I punti della signorina Alber sono di qualita' eccelsa!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..src: Normal que se haya formado una fila tan larga.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..ref: No wonder there's such a long line.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..dst: Non c'e' da stupirsi che si sia formata una fila cosi' lunga.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..src: Me voy a poner con la tarea, Yumia. ¿Podrías traerme los ingredientes?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..ref: I'm a bit tied up here. Can I get your help, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..dst: Mi metto al lavoro, Yumia. Potresti portarmi gli ingredienti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..src: Claro. No puedo negarme a traerte los mejores materiales con todas las molestias que te estás tomando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..ref: Of course. Since you're taking the trouble to make them, I'll gather some good materials for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_100..dst: Certo. Dopo tutto l'impegno che ci stai mettendo, non posso certo rifiutarmi di portarti i materiali migliori.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..src: ¡Vaaaaya! ¡Qué bonito, qué bonito! ¿Cómo me queda, eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..ref: Wowie! So pretty-pretty! How's it look? How's it look?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..dst: Wow! Che bello, che bello! Come mi sta, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..src: Como un guante, y ese color te favorece.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..ref: It looks great on you. That color was the right choice.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..dst: Ti sta a pennello, e quel colore ti dona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..src: Con los materiales que conseguiste, los gorros han quedado perfectos. ¡Gracias!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..ref: Thanks to the materials you gathered, the hats turned out perfectly! Thank you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..dst: Con i materiali che hai recuperato, i cappellini sono venuti perfetti. Grazie!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..src: Gracias, altus. ¡Mi gorrito es mi tesoro reluciente!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..ref: Thank you, Tall One. This sparkly hat is my treasure!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..dst: Grazie, altus. Il mio cappellino e' il mio tesoro scintillante!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..src: ¡Qué chachi! ¡La altus se ha ganado mi respeto!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..ref: Amazey-wazey! Respect for the Tall One!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..dst: Che figata! L'altus si e' guadagnata il mio rispetto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..src: Para nosotras puede ser un pequeño gesto, pero hay tesoros que tienen un valor que solo sus dueños comprenden.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..ref: To us, it might seem like they're overreacting, but some people have treasures that only they can understand.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..dst: Per noi puo' essere un piccolo gesto, ma certi tesori hanno un valore che solo i loro proprietari possono capire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..ref: Sparkly hat. I'll treasure it forever and ever!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..dst: Il mio cappellino scintillante! Me ne prendero' cura tantissimo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..src: Si se desgasta o deja de relampaguear, dímelo. Lo arreglaré las veces que necesites mientras esté cerca.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..ref: If it ever gets frayed or fades, let me know. As long as I'm here, I'll fix it as many times as needed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..dst: Se si consuma o non scintilla piu', dimmelo. Lo riparero' tutte le volte che serve, finche' saro' nei paraggi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..ref: Thankies! Miss human is so warm-warm!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..dst: Grazieee! La signorina e' un tesoro!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..src: ¡Se lo voy a enseñar a mis amiguitos! Cuando lo vean, se pondrán muy contentos, ¡mucho!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..ref: Gonna show-show everyone! When they see my hat, they'll clap-clap!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..dst: Lo faro' vedere ai miei amichetti! Quando lo vedranno, saranno felicissimi, tantissimo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..ref: Haha, go on and show it off to everyone! I'll see you again!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..dst: Ah, ah, vai pure! Ci vediamo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..src: Te has convertido en una diosa, Isla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..ref: I think you just became their goddess, Isla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..src: ¡No te rías! Solo trataba de ser amable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..ref: Oh, stop teasing me! I was just being nice.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..dst: Non ridere! Cercavo solo di essere gentile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..src: Nos viene bien tenerlos de nuestra parte por si acabamos en un aprieto, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..dst: Fa comodo averli dalla nostra parte, nel caso finissimo nei guai, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..src: Esa es mi Isla, siempre con un as en la manga.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..ref: Having a favor to call in might come in handy if we ever find ourselves in a bind, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_110..dst: Questa e' la mia Isla, sempre con un asso nella manica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Isla, Viktor, ¿qué hacéis?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: Oh, Isla and Viktor. What are you up to?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Isla, Viktor, cosa state facendo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: ¡Ah, Yumia! Acabamos de recibir raciones de alimentos. Las han enviado los caballeros de Eustella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: Oh, Yumia! We just received some food supplies. Apparently, they were sent by the knights in Eustella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Ah, Yumia! Abbiamo appena ricevuto delle razioni di cibo. Ce le hanno mandate i cavalieri di Eustella.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Estábamos haciendo recuento de inventario.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: We were just checking what and how much they sent us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Stavamo facendo l'inventario.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: ¡Y he visto que han incluido mi pan favorito! Llevo años sin comerlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: I even found my favorite bread! I haven't seen it in ages.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: E ho visto che ci hanno messo il mio pane preferito! E' da anni che non lo mangio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Antes, los ciudadanos compartían sus recursos con nosotros, pero aquí no nos cruzamos con nadie.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: In the past, the townspeople used to share supplies with us, but we never get to see them here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Prima, i cittadini condividevano le loro risorse con noi, ma qui non incontriamo nessuno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: ¡Es verdad! Cuando íbamos a una tienda o una granja, nos daban cosas ricas. Qué recuerdos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: Oh yes! Every time we visited a store or farm, they'd give us something nice. That brings back memories.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: E' vero! Quando andavamo in un negozio o in una fattoria, ci davano cose buone. Che ricordi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Una vez nos dieron a probar una fruta rara del sur, ¡estaba deliciosa!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: One of the things we got was that rare fruit from the south. It was so delicious!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Una volta ci fecero assaggiare una fruta rara del sud, era deliziosa!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: ¿Una fruta rara?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: Rare fruit?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Una fruta rara?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Era increíblemente dulce y jugosa, aunque costaba mucho pelarla y me pringué las manos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: A juicy and addictively sweet fruit. Though it is very tough to peel, which makes eating it quite the challenge.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Era incredibilmente dolce e succosa, anche se sbucciarla era un impresa e mi sono rovinate le mani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: ¡Sí! Eso te pasa por no dejar que los sirvientes lo hicieran por ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: Oh yes! Even though the servants offered to do it, you always insisted on peeling it yourself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Gia'! Te lo meriti per non aver lasciato che i servitori lo facessero per te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: (¿Una fruta rara? ¿Sirvientes?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: (Rare fruit? Servants?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: (Una fruta rara? Servitori?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: (Llevamos tanto tiempo juntos que había olvidado que pertenecían a la nobleza.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: (We've been together for so long now that I'd forgotten that both of them are nobility.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: (Stiamo insieme da cosi' tanto che avevo dimenticato che appartenevano alla nobilta'.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Viktor, Erhard pregunta por ti. Van a celebrar una reunión con los caballeros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: Viktor, the chief is calling for you. There's a gathering of the knights, apparently.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Viktor, Erhard ti cerca. Si terra' una riunione con i cavalieri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Vale, gracias por avisar. Hasta otra, chicas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: Ah, you have my thanks. Well then, Isla, Yumia, I'll see you later.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Va bene, grazie per l'informazione. Ci vediamo, ragazze.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: (¿Debería tomarme tanta familiaridad con ellos? Al fin y al cabo, ellos son nobles y yo no.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: (Huh? Is it really all right for me to speak so casually with them? They're nobility, and I'm just a commoner.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: (Dovrei davvero permettermi tanta confidenza con loro? In fondo, loro sono nobili e io no.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Me pregunto si podré seguir en contacto con vosotros cuando termine la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: I wonder if I'll still be able to talk to you and the others when this investigation is over.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Mi chiedo se potro' restare in contatto con voi quando finira' l'indagine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: ¿Eh? ¿Y eso a qué viene?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: H-huh?! What brought this on?
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Eh? Ma da dove ti viene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Me he dado cuenta de que, cuando acabe la misión, ya no te veré tanto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: I just realized that after this mission, it might not be so easy to see you anymore.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Mi sono accorta che, quando la missione finira', non ti vedro' piu' cosi' spesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Quiero decir, nuestra posición social es totalmente distinta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: I mean, we come from completely different social standings.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Voglio dire, la nostra posizione sociale e' completamente diversa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: ¡No digas eso!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: Don't talk like that!
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..dst: Non dire cosi'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..src: Me daría pena que nuestra amistad acabara por ese motivo ahora que nos conocemos tanto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_cm02_140..ref: It would be so sad for our friendship to end just like that, even though we've gotten to know each other so well.
