eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..src: Venga, Viktor, deja para otro momento las artes prohibidas y los pensamientos en voz alta, que no dejas a Yumia concentrarse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: Come on, Viktor. If you keep on talking about stuff being forbidden, it'll make it hard for Yumia to do her job, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Su, Viktor, lascia le arti proibite e i pensieri ad alta voce per dopo, che non fai concentrare Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..src: Solo estamos aquí para evitar que haga una locura.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: We're here to make sure that she doesn't do anything weird!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Siamo qui solo per impedirle di fare qualche pazzia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: Anything weird, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Una pazzia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..src: Muy bien. Esperad mientras ultimo unos detalles.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: All right. I'll get ready now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Perfetto. Aspettate mentre sistemo un paio di dettagli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: Hmm ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Come va, Yumia? Ti manca qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: How's it going, Yumia? Almost ready?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Eh... No, un attimino...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: U-umm ... Please wait a little longer ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Yumia...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: ... Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Ora questo... e poi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: Get that ready, and then ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Ehila'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: Hello?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Eh? Cosa? Arrivo, arrivo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: Huh? Y-yes!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: C'e' qualcosa che non va?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..src: Sí, claro... Es que tengo que preparar unas cosillas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: Is everything all right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Si', certo... E' che devo preparare delle cosine...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: O-of course ... After I prepare a few more things, I'll be ready to go! Yeah ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Hai bisogno di aiuto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..src: ¿Yo? Pero... Solo estáis aquí para supervisar, ¿no? No quiero causaros muchos problemas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: Umm ... Do you need help?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Io? Ma... Voi siete qui solo per supervisionare, no? Non vorrei crearvi troppi problemi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..src: Si es importante para nuestra investigación, te ayudaremos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: Huh? But you two are just here to observe me, so I couldn't possibly impose ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Se e' importante per la nostra ricerca, ti aiuteremo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: If it's vital to the investigation, we'll lend a hand.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Ah, grazie mille!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: Th-thank you!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: E... mi dispiace...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: ... And sorry.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Non ti preoccupare! Di cosa hai bisogno?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..ref: Don't worry about it! So, what do you need?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_020..dst: Ecco... Vediamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..dst: Che cos'e'? E' una specie di contenitore?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..src: Sí, los fabrico personalmente. Nos será útil de momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..ref: Yup, I can easily make something like this. It'll work for now, at least.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..dst: Si', li fabbrico io personalmente. Ci saranno utili per il momento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..src: Se necesitan muchas herramientas e ingredientes para hacer alquimia, por eso quiero que la base tenga de todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..ref: Alchemy requires a lot of tools and ingredients, so I need to make sure the base is set up properly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..dst: Per fare alchimia servono tanti strumenti e ingredienti, per questo voglio che la base abbia di tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..src: Aunque, ahora mismo, me faltan muchas cosas. Por ejemplo, ingredientes...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..ref: Although, I don't have enough things that I can make right now, or the ingredients to make them ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..dst: Anche se, al momento, mi mancano un sacco di cose. Per esempio, gli ingredienti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..src: Ya, pero cuando vayas de exploración recogerás todos los que necesites y estas cajas estarán a rebosar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..ref: Yeah, but as we continue with our work, you'll collect more ingredients and fill it up in no time!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..dst: Gia', ma quando andrai in esplorazione raccoglierai tutti quelli che ti servono e queste casse saranno piene zeppe.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..src: Veamos, aquí podríamos poner un sofá mono y...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..ref: Let's see, we could put a cute sofa here, and ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..dst: Vediamo, qui potremmo mettere un divano carino e...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..src: Isla, no hemos venido aquí para ser interioristas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..ref: Isla, we didn't come here to fool around.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..dst: Isla, non siamo venuti qui per fare gli arredatori.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..src: ¡Ya lo sé! Pero nuestra labor no está reñida con el buen gusto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..ref: I know that! But that doesn't mean we can't spruce the place up a little!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..dst: Lo so! Ma il nostro lavoro non esclude il buon gusto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..src: Supongo que a este lugar le vendría bien... La base debe ser un lugar agradable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..ref: ... I suppose you're right. Setting up the base is one of our duties.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..dst: Immagino che possa servire... La base deve essere un luogo piacevole.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..src: Podéis colocar lo que se os antoje siempre que sea útil. ¡Hagamos que este sitio sea nuestro hogar!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..ref: You can add anything you like as long as it's useful. Let's make this place nice!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_021..dst: Potete mettere cio' che vi pare, purche' sia utile. Facciamo di questo posto la nostra casa!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_022..src: Recolectar ingredientes va a ser más difícil de lo que pensaba con tantos acantilados...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_022..ref: There are so many cliffs around here. Gathering ingredients is gonna be a lot of work ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_022..dst: Raccogliere ingredienti sara' piu' difficile di quanto pensassi, con tutti questi dirupi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_022..ref: I've got just the thing for times like these.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_022..dst: Ho proprio quello che ci serve.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_022..ref: Huh? Are you gonna shoot it down?
I've got Regular Ammo and Burst Ammo ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_022..src: No sé si está bien que malgastes tus balas en algo como esto. ¿Y si te quedas sin munición en un momento crítico?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_022..ref: Is it okay to use your bullets for something like this? You might run out at a critical moment.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_022..dst: Non so se sia il caso di sprecare i tuoi proiettili per una cosa del genere. E se finissi le munizioni in un momento critico?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_022..ref: I can make more bullets anytime.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_022..src: Sí. Aunque fuera del atelier solo puedo crear cosas simples.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_022..ref: Yup, but I can only make simple stuff while I'm outside.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_022..dst: Si'. Anche se fuori dall'atelier posso creare solo cose semplici.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_022..src: A ver si lo he entendido. ¿Puedes fabricar cosas con los ingredientes que recolectas por ahí? Pues ¿a qué esperamos? ¡A explorar!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_022..ref: So you can collect the ingredients and make stuff right on the spot? Exploration should go quickly then!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_022..dst: Se ho capito bene, puoi creare cose con gli ingredienti che raccogli in giro? E allora cosa aspettiamo? Ad esplorare!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_022..ref: "It will be helpful to the Research Team," huh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_023..src: Los ingredientes tienen que estar listos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_023..ref: The ingredients should be ready now.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_023..src: Sí. Ahora solo tenemos que dividir todo esto entre cosas que se usan para la alquimia y cosas que no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_023..ref: Yes. Now all that's left is to divide it between the stuff used for alchemy and the stuff that isn't.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_023..dst: Si'. Ora non ci resta che dividere tutto questo tra le cose che servono per l'alchimia e quelle che non servono.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_023..src: La alquimia aprovecha el maná que contienen los ingredientes. Por eso, los que tienen poco maná son tan útiles.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_023..ref: Alchemy uses the mana contained within ingredients, so ingredients with low mana aren't all that useful.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_023..dst: L'alchimia sfrutta il mana contenuto negli ingredienti. Per questo quelli con poco mana non sono poi cosi' utili.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_023..src: Pero podemos usar los materiales restantes para otras cosas además de la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_023..ref: But we can still use those leftover materials for a bunch of other stuff besides alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_023..dst: Ma possiamo usare i materiali avanzati per molte altre cose oltre all'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_023..src: ¡Hala, eres la imagen de la supervivencia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_023..ref: Oh, wow. You're like a real survivalist!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_023..dst: Caspita, sei l'immagine stessa della sopravvivenza!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_023..src: Los recursos del equipo de investigación tienen sus limitaciones. Hay que aprovechar al máximo todo lo que tenemos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_023..ref: There are limits to the Research Team's resources. We need to make the most of everything we can.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_023..dst: Le risorse della Squadra di Ricerca hanno i loro limiti. Bisogna sfruttare al massimo tutto cio' che abbiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_023..src: Vamos a almacenar los ingredientes que hemos dividido. Ese será un buen punto de partida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_023..ref: First, let's store the separated ingredients. That should be a good starting point.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_023..dst: Immageremo gli ingredienti che abbiamo separato. Sara' un buon punto di partenza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_030..src: Bien, muchas gracias, en serio. Ya hemos terminado con los preparativos básicos, ahora...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_030..ref: Yeah, thanks a lot. I think we have the minimum amount of preparation done for now. So now ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_030..dst: Bene, grazie mille, davvero. I preparativi di base sono completati, adesso...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_030..ref: S-sorry Yumia, hold on a second.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_030..src: Flammi. Asistente autómata especializada en la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_030..dst: Flammi. Un'assistente automa specializzata nella ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_030..ref: It talks?! W-was this made with alchemy?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_030..dst: Ha parlato!? L'hai creata con l'alchimia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_030..src: Bueno, no lo he hecho yo desde cero, pero creo que nos ayudará en la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_030..dst: Beh, non l'ho creata da zero, ma credo che ci sara' utile nella ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_030..src: Así que has creado esto... ¿Tu siguiente invento también será parlanchín?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_030..ref: I didn't make it from scratch or anything, but I'm sure it will be helpful in our research.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_030..dst: Quindi hai creato proprio questo... Anche la tua prossima invenzione sara' cosi' chiacchierona?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_030..src: ¡No, nada de eso! Será algo sencillo. Lo he sintetizado mil veces. Bueno, como unas diez o doce en realidad...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_030..ref: To create something like this ... The thing you're making now isn't going to be chattering at us too, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_030..dst: No, niente di tutto questo! Sara' qualcosa di semplice. L'ho sintetizzato mille volte. Vabbe', una decina o una dozzina in realta'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_030..src: Haré algo que sea útil para todo el grupo. Confiad en mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_030..ref: Of course it won't talk! I'm just going to make something simple. I've done it dozens of times.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_030..dst: Faro' qualcosa di utile per tutto il gruppo. Confidate in me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_030..ref: I'm going to make something that's useful for everyone. Please, believe in me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Esto es...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: This is ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Questo e'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Ha sido... precioso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: So pretty ... Uh, I mean—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: E' stato... bellissimo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Nunca he tenido tanto público. ¿Qué os ha parecido?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: I've never had an audience for this before. What did you two think?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Non ho mai avuto cosi' tanto pubblico. Che ve ne e' sembrato?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Diferente a lo que me esperaba. No sabía que la alquimia funcionara así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: It was really different from what I imagined. I can't believe you can create something by doing that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Diverso da come me l'aspettavo. Non sapevo che l'alchimia funzionasse cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Esos movimientos... Me recordaban a un truco de magia o una coreografía. ¿Es así como se hace alquimia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: Those movements ... It was as if you were doing a magic trick or a performance. Is this really what alchemy is?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Quei movimenti... Mi ricordavano un trucco di magia o una coreografia. E' cosi' che si fa alchimia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Bueno, me resulta más fácil manipular el maná cuando me muevo así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: Well, it's easier for me to manipulate mana when I move my body like that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Beh, mi risulta piu' facile manipolare il mana quando mi muovo cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: ¿Manipularlo, dices?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: Manipulate?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Manipolarlo, dici?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Cuando la fuerza vital regresa a la tierra, los pensamientos y los recuerdos que alberga el alma se convierten en maná y se depositan en el terreno.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: When life force returns to the earth, the thoughts and memories engraved in the soul become mana, which is then stored in the land.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Quando la forza vitale ritorna alla terra, i pensieri e i ricordi custoditi nell'anima si trasformano in mana e si depositano nel terreno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Hay maná en todo lo que nos rodea, pero solo los alquimistas son capaces de interactuar con él y manipularlo directamente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: There's lots of mana all around us, but alchemists are able to manipulate it directly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: C'e' mana in tutto cio' che ci circonda, ma solo gli alchimisti riescono a interagire con esso e manipolarlo direttamente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Manipular maná, crear recetas de recuerdos intensos, transformar materiales en otros mediante ingredientes...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: Manipulating mana, creating recipes from engraved memories, reconstructing materials by offering ingredients ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Manipolare il mana, creare ricette da ricordi intensi, trasformare materiali in altri tramite ingredienti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Eso es la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: That's alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Questa e' l'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Para mí, el maná es algo que percibo a duras penas, es la primera vez que veo a alguien manipularlo de esta manera.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: I can only barely feel mana, so seeing it being manipulated directly like this is a first for me, I think.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Per me il mana e' qualcosa che percepisco a malapena: e' la prima volta che vedo qualcuno manipolarlo in questo modo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Se necesita un talento muy especial para hacerlo, yo solo estoy empezando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: Being capable of it is a very unique talent. Even I only recently learned about it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Ci vuole un talento davvero speciale per farlo. Anche io ho iniziato solo da poco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: En otras palabras, ni siquiera sabes el potencial que esconde este poder.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: In other words, you don't even know the full potential of this power yet.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: In altre parole, nemmeno tu conosci il potenziale che nasconde questo potere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Esto... Supongo que tienes razón, pero a medida que vaya aprendiendo, seguro que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: I, uh ... I guess you're right. But if I learn more about it, I'm sure that I'll—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Ehm... Suppongo che tu abbia ragione, ma man mano che imparero', sono sicura che...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: La naturaleza se ha adueñado de todas estas ruinas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: There are ruins overrun by nature all around here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: La natura si e' impossessata di tutte queste rovine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Dicen que el Imperio aladissiano fue destruido cuando se desató el poder de la alquimia sin control.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: They say that the Aladissian Empire was destroyed by the power of alchemy run rampant.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Si dice che l'Impero Aladissiano fu distrutto quando il potere dell'alchimia ando' fuori controllo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Aunque no sea tu intención, ¿no crees que existe el riesgo de que esto se te vaya de las manos a ti también?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: Even if you don't intend to, isn't there still a risk that your power could go out of control as well?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Anche se non e' tua intenzione, non credi che ci sia il rischio che anche a te sfugga di mano?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Eso es algo que no puedo desmentir, después de todo, sigo siendo una aprendiz del oficio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: ... Sorry, I can't deny that it's possible. I'm still inexperienced, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Non posso smentirlo, dopotutto sono ancora un'apprendista inesperta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Pero tampoco podemos quedarnos de brazos cruzados y esperar a que ocurra algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: But nothing will happen if we don't even try to learn.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Ma non possiamo restare con le mani in mano e aspettare che succeda qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: El objetivo del equipo de investigación es desentrañar los muchos misterios de este lugar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: The Research Team's goal is to unravel the many lingering mysteries of this land.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: L'obiettivo della Squadra di Ricerca e' svelare i tanti misteri di questo luogo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Como alquimista, deseo comprender qué ocurrió aquí y cuánto fue a causa de la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: As an alchemist myself, I want to understand what happened here, and what part alchemy played in it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Da alchimista, desidero capire cosa e' accaduto qui e quanto ne fu causa l'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Por eso he venido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: That is why I'm here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Per questo sono venuta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Ya veo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: ... I see.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: ... Capisco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Oye, Yumia, ¿y para qué podemos usar esto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: So, Yumia, what can we use this for?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Ehi, Yumia, e per cosa possiamo usare questa cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Es una herramienta para exterminar monstruos, aunque reconozco que no me ha quedado perfecta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: It's a tool for exterminating monsters. There's still room for improvement, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: E' uno strumento per sterminare i mostri, anche se ammetto che non e' venuto perfetto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: ¿En serio? ¿Puedo probarla?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: Ooh? Can I try it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Davvero? Posso provarla?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: ¡Isla!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: Hey, Isla!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Isla!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: ¿No la has oído? «No podemos quedarnos de brazos cruzados».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: "Nothing will happen if we don't try to learn." She had a point, you know?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Non l'hai sentita? "Non possiamo restare con le mani in mano".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Adelante, pruébala. He sintetizado un montón de esas, no debería darte ningún problema.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: Sure, give it a try. I've made them before a bunch of times, so there shouldn't be any problems.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Avanti, provala. Ne ho sintetizzate tante, non dovresti avere alcun problema.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Quédate donde podamos verte, ¿me oyes?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: Just stay where we can still see you, okay?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Resta dove possiamo vederti, mi senti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: ¡Sí, pesado! ¡Salgamos fuera!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: All right! Then it's time to head out!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Si', noioso! E' ora di uscire!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: ... to the ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: ¿Y esa voz?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: Huh?! What was that voice just now?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Eh? Che voce era quella?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: ...mperador... este...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: ... mperor ... this ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: ...mperatore... questo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: El... aná... duerm...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: The ... na ... slumbers ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Il... ana... dorme...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Flammi, ¿has notado algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: Flammi, did something just happen?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Flammi, hai notato qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Percibida una pequeña fluctuación de maná. No se ha obtenido más información.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: A small fluctuation of mana was detected, but no further information was obtainable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Rilevata una piccola fluttuazione di mana. Non sono state ottenute altre informazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: ... ¿Eso es todo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: ... That's all?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: ... Solo questo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Yumia ha calibrado las funciones de Flammi. Sus capacidades están limitadas por la destreza de la creadora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: Flammi's functions are calibrated by Yumia. Their upper limits are determined by Yumia's alchemical abilities.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Yumia ha calibrato le funzioni di Flammi. Le sue capacita' sono limitate dalla destrezza della creatrice.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..src: Oye, no recuerdo haber calibrado esa actitud...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..ref: ... I don't remember calibrating that attitude, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_040..dst: Ehi, non ricordo di aver calibrato quell'atteggiamento...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..ref: Let's try it out around here.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..src: Vaya... ¿Una herramienta puede hacer todo esto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..ref: Wow ... A tool can do all this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..dst: Caspita... Uno strumento puo' fare tutto questo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..src: Exacto. Con esto, podéis usar ese poder cuando queráis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..ref: Uh-huh. If you two have this, you should be able to use them right away.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..dst: Esatto. Con questo potete usare quel potere quando volete.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..src: Yo lo llamo Anillo de memoria.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..ref: I call it a Memoria Ring.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..dst: Io lo chiamo Anello della memoria.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..src: Recuerda el objeto que acabo de crear y os permite invocarlo en cualquier momento durante una batalla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..ref: It memorizes the item we just made, so you can summon it at a moment's notice during battle.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..dst: Ricorda l'oggetto che ho appena creato e vi permette di evocarlo in qualsiasi momento durante una battaglia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..src: Con el tiempo, seréis capaces de luchar usando vuestras armas y estas herramientas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..ref: With practice, you should be able to fight while utilizing both weapons and tools simultaneously.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..dst: Col tempo, sarete in grado di combattere usando le vostre armi e questi strumenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..src: Cuantas más herramientas fabrique, ¡más opciones tendremos en combate!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..ref: The more tools I make, the more options we'll have in battle!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..dst: Piu' strumenti fabbrichero', piu' opzioni avremo in combattimento!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..src: Aunque ahora no puedo hacer muchas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..ref: ... Not that I can make that many at this point, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_041..dst: Anche se, al momento, non posso prepararne molti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..src: ¡Ha sido alucinante! Si creas herramientas así en tan poco tiempo, nuestra investigación...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..ref: This thing is amazing! If you can make tools like this right away, the investigation will—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..dst: E' stato incredibile! Se crei strumenti cosi' in cosi' poco tempo, la nostra ricerca...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..ref: Oh ... Hmm, it's hard to say!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..dst: Eh... Non so proprio cosa dire!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..src: Ya, entiendo que no es fácil opinar solo con eso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..ref: Yeah, I guess it's hard to know from just that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..dst: Gia', capisco che non sia facile dare un giudizio solo con questo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..src: El jefe recalcó que tus poderes de alquimista son necesarios para la investigación sobre Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..ref: The chief said that your powers as an alchemist are necessary for the investigation of Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..dst: Il capo ha sottolineato che i tuoi poteri da alchimista sono necessari per l'indagine su Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..src: Pero «no podemos quedarnos de brazos cruzados»...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..ref: If "nothing will happen if we don't try to learn" ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..dst: Ma "non possiamo restare con le mani in mano"...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..src: Así que, como supervisor, me limitaré a vigilar que uses este poder para el bien de la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..ref: Then, as an observer, I will merely see to it that this power is properly used to aid the investigation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..dst: Quindi, in veste di supervisore, mi limitero' a vigilare che tu usi questo potere per il bene dell'indagine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..src: ¿Y si mientras vigilas también te relajas un poco?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..ref: How about a little less observation and a little more getting along?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..dst: E se mentre sorvegli ti rilassassi un po'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..src: Isla, no olvides cuál es nuestra misión aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..ref: Isla, don't forget that we are here on a mission.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..dst: Isla, non dimenticare qual e' la nostra missione qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..src: Entonces, según tú, ¿debemos ser hostiles entre nosotros hasta el fin de los días?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..ref: So you're saying we should just be hostile forever, then?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..dst: Quindi, secondo te, dovremmo restare ostili tra noi fino alla fine dei tempi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..src: ¡Por supuesto que no! Solo tenemos que ser más objet...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..ref: I didn't say that! We just need to look at things objec—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..dst: Ma certo che no! Dobbiamo solo guardare le cose in modo piu' oggett...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..src: Haré todo cuanto esté en mi mano para estar a la altura.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..ref: I'll do my best to prove myself to you two.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..dst: Faro' tutto cio' che e' in mio potere per essere all'altezza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..src: Si ya hemos terminado con los preparativos, regresemos con el jefe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..ref: If preparations are more or less complete, then let's go back and report to the chief.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..dst: Se abbiamo ormai finito i preparativi, torniamo dal capo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..src: Ya va siendo hora de que comience la verdadera misión, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..ref: Is it about time our real mission begins?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_050..dst: E' ormai l'ora che cominci la vera missione, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Eh, ella es de la que todo el mundo habla...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Oh, that's the rumored ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Eh, e' quella di cui parlano tutti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Sí, la alquimista. Por lo visto, el jefe la ha llamado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Yeah, it has to be. The alchemist! The one the chief called for.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Si', l'alchimista. A quanto pare il capo l'ha convocata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: ¡Es una chiquilla! Me esperaba a alguien más... imponente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: They say that her mother is an alchemist too. Can you believe it? Why alchemists, of all things?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Ma e' una ragazzina! Mi aspettavo qualcuno piu'... imponente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Dicen que su madre también es alquimista. ¿Te lo puedes creer? De todas las profesiones que existen, ¿por qué alguien elegiría la alquimia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: If you're so interested, why don't you go ask her yourself?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Dicono che anche sua madre sia un'alchimista. Ci puoi credere? Di tutti i mestieri che esistono, perche' mai qualcuno dovrebbe scegliere l'alchimia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: ¿Por qué no te acercas a preguntárselo tú misma?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Are you serious? She's a master of the forbidden arts. One wrong step and she might put a curse on me!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Perche' non ti avvicini a chiederglielo tu stessa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: ¿Estás de broma? Es experta en artes prohibidas. Un comentario fuera de lugar y podría echarme un mal de ojo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Good work. Now, onto the next report.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Stai scherzando? E' un'esperta di arti proibite. Basta un commento fuori posto e potrebbe lanciarmi un malocchio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Buen trabajo. Mantenedme informado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Hm? What's the commotion?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Buon lavoro. Tenetemi aggiornato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: ¿Hum? ¿A qué viene tanto ajetreo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Did something happen?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Hm? Ma perche' tutto questo trambusto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: ¿Ha pasado algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Ah, Viktor. The base was attacked by monsters.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: E' successo qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Ah, Viktor. Unos monstruos atacaron la base.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Ah, Viktor. Alcuni mostri hanno attaccato la base.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: ¿Qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Monsters ...! Was it serious?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: ¡Monstruos! ¿Estáis todos bien?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Some people were hurt, but we pulled through somehow.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Mostri! State tutti bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Hay unos cuantos heridos, pero no hay que lamentar mucho más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: In order to prevent further damage, the chief has instructed us to focus on wiping out monsters in the area.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Ci sono alcuni feriti, ma per fortuna non c'e' stato di peggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Para prevenir más sucesos como este, el jefe nos ha ordenado que nos encarguemos de los monstruos de los alrededores.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: I see ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Per prevenire altri episodi come questo, il capo ci ha ordinato di occuparci dei mostri dei dintorni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Queremos ayudar. ¿Podemos hacer algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: We can help too. Is there anything we can do?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Vogliamo aiutare. Possiamo fare qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Mucho, a decir verdad. Por ahora, las prioridades son erradicar esos monstruos y atender a los heridos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: There's a lot, actually. For now, the main priorities are defeating monsters and aiding the wounded.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Molto, a dire il vero. Per ora le priorita' sono eliminare quei mostri e curare i feriti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: A cada cual más importante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Both are important tasks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Ognuna piu' importante dell'altra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: No nos separaremos, dada nuestra situación. Si queremos ayudar, debemos elegir un cometido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: We can't be split up, given our current position. If we're going to help, we should choose one.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Non ci separeremo, vista la situazione. Se vogliamo aiutare, dobbiamo scegliere un compito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Vale, ¿qué... debemos hacer?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: In that case ... which should we do?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Allora, cosa... dobbiamo fare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Ayudar a los heridos.<CR>Derrotar a los monstruos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Aid the injured.<CR>Clear out monsters.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Aiutare i feriti.<CR>Sconfiggere i mostri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Ayudar a los heridos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Aid the injured.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Aiutare i feriti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Derrotar a los monstruos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Clear out monsters.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Sconfiggere i mostri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Para evitar más daños, ¿os parece que demos ahora el golpe de gracia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: In order to prevent any more harm, shouldn't we go out and strike now?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Per evitare altri danni, che ne dite di dare ora il colpo di grazia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Ayudar a los heridos es lo primero, ¿verdad? Reforzar el grupo y todo eso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Helping the injured should come first though, right? We need to regroup our forces.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Aiutare i feriti viene prima di tutto, vero? Rinforzare il gruppo e cosi' via.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Claro, ambas tareas son iguales de importantes. Haremos todo lo que esté en nuestra mano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Of course, both are very important. We should just do what we can for now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Certo, entrambi i compiti sono ugualmente importanti. Faremo tutto il possibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: ¿Qué opinas tú, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: What do you think, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Tu che ne pensi, Yumia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: ¿Yo? Pues...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Me? I think ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Io? Beh...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Creo que deberíamos proteger el perímetro y mermar sus fuerzas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: I think we should thin their numbers first, so that we can secure a safe area.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Penso che dovremmo proteggere il perimetro e indebolire le loro forze.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Creo que deberíamos ayudar a los heridos y recuperar fuerzas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: I think we should help the injured first, and get our forces back in shape.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Penso che dovremmo aiutare i feriti e riprendere le forze.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Eres la alquimista, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: You're that alchemist, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Sei l'alchimista, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: S-sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Listen here. All you need to do is carry out your duties exactly as you were told to.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: S-si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Escucha, limítate a cumplir con tus obligaciones y no te saltes las normas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Ascolta, limitati a fare i tuoi doveri e non trasgredire le regole.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: ¿Qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Don't think about or do anything else. Know your place and act within it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: No te sobrepases. Sé consciente de cuál es tu lugar y actúa en consecuencia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Viktor, please head over to help the injured.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Non esagerare. Sii consapevole del tuo posto e agisci di conseguenza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Viktor, por favor, ayúdanos con los heridos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Viktor, please focus on defeating those monsters.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Viktor, per favore, aiutaci con i feriti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Viktor, por favor, encárgate de esos monstruos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: And keep that girl in line.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Viktor, per favore, occupati di quei mostri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Y no la pierdas de vista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: Hey ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: E non perderla di vista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: A la orden.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: I have never approved of this arrangement. Relying on the taboo is a disgrace to the Eustellan Republic.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Ai vostri ordini.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Quiero que sepas que no veo con buenos ojos este acuerdo. Es una desgracia que la República de Eustella recurra a algo que se considera tabú.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: I'm leaving.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Voglio che tu sappia che non approvo questo accordo. E' una vergogna che la Repubblica di Eustella ricorra a qualcosa che e' considerato un tabu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Eso es todo, me marcho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..ref: I have to be useful ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: E' tutto. Me ne vado.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..src: Solo pretendo ayudar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_060..dst: Voglio solo dare una mano...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070a.src: Ah, Isla. Acaban de traernos más heridos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070a.ref: Oh, Isla. Some more of the injured were brought in just now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070a.dst: Ah, Isla. Ci hanno appena portato altri feriti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070a.src: Nada serio, menos mal, pero nos atacaron por sorpresa y no tuvieron tiempo para pertrecharse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070a.ref: Nothing life-threatening, thankfully, but it seems they were attacked out of the blue and taken by surprise.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070a.dst: Niente di grave, meno male, ma ci hanno attaccati di sorpresa e non hanno avuto tempo di prepararsi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070a.src: Todavía no tenemos todo lo necesario y vamos muy atrasados. Necesitamos casi un milagro, la verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070a.ref: We're still getting set up, and preparations are lagging behind. We need all the help we can get, honestly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070a.dst: Non abbiamo ancora tutto il necessario e siamo molto in ritardo. Ci serve quasi un miracolo, a dire il vero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070a.src: Nosotros hemos venido a echar una mano, ¿verdad, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070a.ref: We've come to help. Right, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070a.dst: Noi siamo venuti a dare una mano, vero, Yumia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070a.src: Sí, eh... Voy a preparar algunos medicamentos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070a.ref: Umm ... I'll start getting medicine ready right away.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070a.dst: Si', ecco... Vado a preparare qualche medicina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070a.src: Eh... Sí, claro, cuantas más, mejor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070a.ref: Err, yeah. I mean, the more the better.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070a.dst: Eh... Si', certo, piu' ce ne sono, meglio e'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070a.ref: In that case, Yumia, can you help us out?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.src: ¡Viktor, vienes en el mejor momento posible! ¿Eso es que...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.ref: Viktor, good timing! If you're here, then ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.dst: Viktor, arrivi proprio nel momento giusto! Quindi vuol dire che...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.src: Sí, vengo a cazar monstruos. ¿Cómo vais?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.ref: Yes, I'm here on monster-hunting duty. How are things going?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.dst: Si', vengo a dare la caccia ai mostri. Com'e' che andate?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.src: Está siendo difícil. Hay más monstruos de los que esperábamos. Agradeceríamos cualquier ayuda que nos podáis ofrecer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.ref: It's been tough. There are more monsters than we thought. Any help would be greatly appreciated.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.dst: E' dura. Ci sono piu' mostri di quanti pensassimo. Vi saremmo grati di qualsiasi aiuto possiate offrirci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.src: Yumia Liessfeldt. La alquimista de la que todo el mundo habla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.ref: Yumia Liessfeldt. The alchemist you've been hearing of.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.dst: Yumia Liessfeldt. L'alchimista di cui parlano tutti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.src: He venido a luchar también y vengo preparada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.ref: I'll fight too. I've been making preparations to that end.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.dst: Sono venuta anche a combattere, e mi sono preparata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.src: No causes más problemas de los que resuelvas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.dst: Non causare piu' problemi di quanti risolvi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.src: Entonces, ¿os dejo a vosotros los monstruos de por aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.ref: Can I leave the monsters in this area to you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.dst: Allora, vi lascio a voi i mostri di qui intorno?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.ref: ... It's my duty to protect you.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.src: Cuando te destinan a la vanguardia, un buen ataque es tu mejor defensa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.ref: But when going out on the front lines like this, your own strength is your last defense.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.dst: Quando vieni schierato in prima linea, un buon attacco e' la tua migliore difesa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.src: Vamos. No bajéis la guardia, aunque os parezcan enemigos insignificantes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.ref: Let's get started. Don't let your guard down, even against the small monsters.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_070b.dst: Andiamo. Non abbassate la guardia, anche se vi sembrano nemici insignificanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: ¿Eh? No siento dolor...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: Huh, all the pain just disappeared ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Eh? Non sento dolore...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: ¿Así de rápido?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: Huh? That quick?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Cosi' in fretta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: Nunca pensé que haría efecto tan rápido...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: To think it would have such a quick effect ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Non avrei mai pensato che facesse effetto cosi' in fretta...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: Nunca había visto una medicina como esta. No me digas que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: I've never seen this kind of medicine before. Wait, don't tell me this is—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Non avevo mai visto una medicina come questa. Non dirmi che...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: La... hice con alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: I ... made it with alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: L'ho... fatta con l'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: ¡¿Y por qué no lo has dicho antes?! ¿Hemos hecho bien en confiar...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: Why didn't you tell us beforehand?! Is it even all right to use this ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: E perche' non l'hai detto prima?! Abbiamo fatto bene a fidarci...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: No hay peligro, ¿a que no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: It's not anything dangerous, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Non c'e' nessun pericolo, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: ¡No! ¡Es totalmente seguro! La he probado en persona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: N-no! It's perfectly fine! I've used it myself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: No! E' totalmente sicura! L'ho provata di persona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: Nadie te ha pedido que hagas pócimas raras.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: We didn't ask for some strange concoction.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Nessuno ti ha chiesto di preparare pozioni strane.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: Pero el dolor desapareció por completo, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: But they said the pain went away completely, no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Ma il dolore e' completamente scomparso, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: Prefiero el dolor a deber mi vida a «medicinas» extrañas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: I'd rather deal with the pain than take some mystery "medicine."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Preferisco sopportare il dolore piuttosto che dover la vita a una "medicina" sconosciuta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: ¿A qué viene eso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: Wh-what's with that attitude?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: C-che ti prende?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: Déjalo estar, Isla. Vámonos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: It's okay, Isla. Let's go.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Lasciala stare, Isla. Andiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: ¿Primero nos piden ayuda y luego nos tratan así?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: They ask for help, and that's how they treat us?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Prima ci chiedono aiuto e poi ci trattano cosi'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: Es cierto que no es una medicina corriente... Debería haberlo mencionado antes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: ... It's true that it's unfamiliar medicine. It's my fault for not explaining properly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: E' vero che non e' una medicina normale... Avrei dovuto dirlo prima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: Aun así...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: But still ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Eppure...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: Confieso que la alquimia me da un poco de respeto...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: I'm not saying I don't find alchemy a little scary myself ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Devo ammettere che l'alchimia mi mette un po' di soggezione...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: Pero ¡eso no justifica que digan todo lo que se les pase por la cabeza!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: But that doesn't mean they can just go and say whatever they please!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Ma questo non giustifica che dicano tutto cio' che passa loro per la testa!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: Lo siento. ¡No vayas a echarme un mal de ojo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: Sorry, sorry. Are you actually going to put a curse on me now?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Mi dispiace. Non ti azzardare a gettarmi un malocchio!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: ¡No puedo maldecir a nadie!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: I can't curse people!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Non posso maledire nessuno!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: ¡Eso creía yo! Menos mal...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: That's what I thought. Thank goodness.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: E' quello che pensavo! Meno male...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: ¿Tenéis un momento? Uno de los heridos me ha informado de algo inquietante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: You two, can I have a moment? I heard a concerning report from some of the injured members.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Avete un momento? Uno dei feriti mi ha riferito qualcosa di inquietante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: ¿Inquietante?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: A concerning report?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Inquietante?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: Sí, y los aventureros más aguerridos lo han confirmado. No sé cómo pudieron pillarlos desprevenidos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: Yes. And the report came from seasoned adventurers too. To think that they could be caught unaware like that ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Si', e gli avventurieri piu' esperti lo hanno confermato. Non so come siano riusciti a prenderli di sorpresa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: Por lo visto, los monstruos estaban muy agitados en el momento del ataque.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: They said the monsters seemed to be quite riled up while they were engaging them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: A quanto pare, i mostri erano molto agitati al momento dell'attacco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: ¿Porque el equipo de investigación se adentró en su territorio?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: Is it because the Research Team went into their territory?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Perche' la Squadra di Ricerca e' entrata nel loro territorio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: Quizás, pero tanta saña por un asunto territorial...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: Perhaps. But for them all to incur such injuries from just that ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Forse, ma tanta ferocia per una questione territoriale...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: Han informado también al jefe, pero debemos encontrar el origen de todo esto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: This matter has been reported to the chief. But if there are any other causes, it's our job to find out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: L'hanno riferito anche al capo, ma dobbiamo trovare l'origine di tutto questo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: Ya veo. Puede que nos enteremos de los motivos en el trascurso de nuestra investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: I see. We might be able to figure out what's going on while we do our investigation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Capisco. Potremmo scoprirne i motivi nel corso della nostra indagine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: Eso es, nuestras pesquisas nos acercarán a la respuesta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: That's right, continuing our investigation may bring us closer to some answers.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Esatto, le nostre indagini ci avvicineranno alla risposta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: Algo no va bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: Things aren't going well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: C'e' qualcosa che non va.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: Tus talentos no son nada especiales, pero Flammi cree que les has ofrecido los resultados deseados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: Your abilities are nothing special, but Flammi believes that you produced the results that they desired.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: I tuoi talenti non sono granche', ma Flammi crede che tu abbia offerto loro i risultati desiderati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.src: Tú sí que sabes animar a una chica.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.ref: You always have a way with words.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080a.dst: Tu sei proprio brava a rincuorare una ragazza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: (Vale. Con ese debería bastar.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: (Okay. That should be the last one.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: (Okay. Con questo dovrebbe bastare.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: He venido a ver cómo os iba, ¿habéis acabado ya?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: I came to see how things were going, but it seems you're already done?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Sono venuto a vedere come andate, avete gia' finito?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Sí, todo bajo control.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: Yes, no problems here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Si', tutto sotto controllo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Esa herramienta tan rara que has usado en el combate, ¿la hiciste con alquimia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: The strange tool you used while fighting, was that made with alchemy?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Quello strumento cosi' strano che hai usato in combattimento, l'hai fatto con l'alchimia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Sí, creo que la hizo ella para ese fin, pero no sé cómo funciona del todo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: Yes. It's apparently a tool she made for combat, but I'm not sure exactly how it works ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Si', credo che l'abbia creato lei per questo scopo, ma non so esattamente come funziona...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Viktor, ¿en serio estás de acuerdo con esto? Nadie sabe qué podría pasar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: Viktor, is this really okay? Who knows what that thing could do ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Viktor, sei davvero d'accordo su questo? Nessuno sa cosa potrebbe succedere...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Por ahora, ha resultado útil...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: Well, it's been useful so far ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Beh, finora si e' rivelato utile...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Me preocupa tu seguridad y la de tu hermana. Creo que será mejor que no os fieis mucho de ella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: I'm worried about you and your sister's safety. It'd be best not to trust her too much.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Mi preoccupa la tua sicurezza e quella di tua sorella. Penso sia meglio che non vi fidiate troppo di lei.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Esto... sí, seremos precavidos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: That's ... Yes, I'll exercise more caution.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Eh... si', saremo prudenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Sigo un poco preocupado, pero... Bueno, da igual. Vámonos a la próxima ubicación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: I'm still anxious, but ... Whatever, it's fine. We'll head to the next location now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Resto un po' preoccupato, ma... Vabbe', non importa. Andiamo alla prossima posizione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Todos desconfían de tus creaciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: Everyone sure is suspicious of the things you make.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Tutti diffidano delle tue creazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Ya, lo he notado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: ... Yeah, I know.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Gia', me ne sono accorta...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: ¿Viktor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: Viktor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Viktor?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: ¿Dónde has aprendido a luchar con esas herramientas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: Your way of fighting with tools. How did you learn it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Dove hai imparato a combattere con quegli strumenti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Pues... soy autodidacta, a decir verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: Umm, well ... I kind of just studied by myself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Beh... a dire la verita', sono un'autodidatta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Desde que decidí unirme al equipo de investigación, hace tres años, estuve entrenando sola.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: In the three years since it was decided I would join the Research Team, I trained in my own way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Da quando ho deciso di unirmi alla Squadra di Ricerca, tre anni fa, mi sono allenata da sola.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Tres años...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: Three years ago ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Tre anni...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Me preparé para no ser un estorbo para los demás, aunque...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: I trained so that I wouldn't be a hindrance to everyone ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Mi sono allenata per non essere d'intralcio agli altri, pero'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Lo que más deseo es ayudar como alquimista, por eso debo esforzarme al máximo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: But even more so, I want to be helpful to everyone as an alchemist, so I thought I should do everything I can.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Cio' che desidero piu' di tutto e' aiutare come alchimista, per questo devo impegnarmi al massimo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Ese es el camino que he elegido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: That was the only path forward for me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: E' la strada che ho scelto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Y estás decidida a seguirlo, ¿eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: So that's your resolution, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: E sei decisa a seguirla, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Por cierto, Isla, ¿dónde te metiste después de enfrentarnos con los monstruos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: By the way, Isla. After taking care of the monsters, where did you go off to?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: A proposito, Isla, dove sei andata dopo lo scontro con i mostri?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: ¡Ah, es verdad! Casi se me olvida. Lo cierto es que escuché una conversación muy interesante...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: Oh that's right! I almost forgot what I meant to say. Truth is, I heard an interesting conversation ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Ah, e' vero! Stavo per dimenticarmene. A dire il vero ho sentito una conversazione molto interessante...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: ¿Sobre qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: What was it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Su cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Según oí, varias personas que se habían enfrentado a ellos decían que estaban demasiado nerviosos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: I heard this from some others who fought the monsters, but apparently they seemed strangely agitated.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Da quello che ho sentito, diverse persone che li avevano affrontati dicevano che erano troppo nervosi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: ¿Nerviosos en qué sentido?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: Strangely in what way?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Nervosi in che senso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Al principio pensé que su enfado se debía a que el equipo de investigación se metió de lleno en su territorio...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: At first I thought they were angry because of the Research Team trespassing on their territory ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: All'inizio pensavo che la loro rabbia fosse dovuta al fatto che la Squadra di Ricerca era entrata nel loro territorio...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Pero el resto de miembros tienen mucha experiencia en combate. Me extraña que haya tantos heridos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: But the other members are also seasoned adventurers. For there to be so many injuries ... It certainly is strange.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Ma gli altri membri hanno molta esperienza in combattimento. Mi stupisce che ci siano cosi' tanti feriti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: ¿Lo sabe el jefe?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: Does the chief know about this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Lo sa il capo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Dijo que algo había llegado a sus oídos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: He said he'd already heard.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Ha detto che qualcosa era arrivato alle sue orecchie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: En ese caso, espero que podamos averiguar el «modus operandi» de los monstruos por el camino.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: In that case, let's hope that we can learn more about how the monsters operate as we continue our investigation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: In tal caso, spero che lungo il cammino riusciremo a scoprire il "modus operandi" dei mostri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Eso es todo lo que podemos aportar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: That's all we really can do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: E' tutto quello che possiamo offrire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Algo no va bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: Things aren't going well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: C'e' qualcosa che non va.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Tus talentos no son nada especiales, pero Flammi cree que les has ofrecido los resultados deseados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: Your abilities are nothing special, but Flammi believes that you produced the results that they desired.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: I tuoi talenti non sono granche', ma Flammi crede che tu abbia offerto loro i risultati desiderati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.src: Tú sí que sabes animar a una chica.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.ref: You always have a way with words.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_080b.dst: Tu sei proprio brava a rincuorare una ragazza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: ¡Estamos de vuelta!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: We have returned.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Siamo tornati!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: Buen trabajo. Vuestros compañeros nos han informado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: Good work out there. I've heard the reports from the others who came in before you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Buon lavoro. I vostri compagni ci hanno informato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: Creía que te había quedado claro: recuerda cuál es tu lugar y nada de comportamientos extraños.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: ... I believe I made myself clear before. Remember your position, and no unnecessary behavior.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Credevo che ti fosse chiaro: ricorda qual e' il tuo posto e niente comportamenti strani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: Por lo que me han contado, has estado a tu aire.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: It sure sounds like you did as you pleased.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Da quello che mi hanno raccontato, hai fatto di testa tua.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: Es que... pensé que la alquimia aceleraría las cosas y...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: Uh ... I just thought that I could use alchemy to help out with things.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: E' che... pensavo che l'alchimia avrebbe accelerato le cose e...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: Lo siento mucho...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: ... I'm sorry.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Mi dispiace tanto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: Bah, de tal palo, tal astilla... Comparte los pecados de la madre...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: *Sigh* Like mother, like daughter. Both blind to their sins ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Bah, tale madre, tale figlia... Condivide i peccati della madre...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: La explosión fue culpa de una alquimista. ¿Sabes de lo que hablo? Esa... mujer en el taller de herramientas Liessfeldt.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: It seems that explosion was an alchemist's fault. You know, that woman from Liessfeldt's Tool Shop—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: L'esplosione e' colpa di un'alchimista. Sai di cosa parlo? Quella... donna dell'officina di attrezzi di Liessfeldt.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: Y pensar que vivíamos tan cerca de alguien así... ¿Qué estaban haciendo los caballeros?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: To think someone like that was lurking so close to us ... Just what are the knights doing?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: E pensare che vivevamo accanto a qualcuno del genere... Cosa stavano facendo i cavalieri?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: ¡Asume la responsabilidad! ¿Te das cuenta de cuánta gente ha perdido su hogar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: Take responsibility! Don't you realize how many people lost their homes?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Assumi le tue responsabilita'! Ti rendi conto di quanta gente ha perso la propria casa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: ¿Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Yumia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: ¿Sí? Oh... perdón, no es nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: Huh? Oh ... sorry. It's nothing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Si'? Oh... scusa, non e' niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: Eso es todo lo que tenía que decir. Ahora, id a hablar con el jefe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: In any case, that's that. As for what comes next, talk to the chief.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Questo e' tutto quello che dovevo dire. Ora andate a parlare con il capo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: Perdona. Nadie te conoce todavía y les cuesta un poco hacerse a la idea de tenerte por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: *Sigh* ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Perdonali. Nessuno ti conosce ancora e fa loro un po' fatica abituarsi all'idea di averti qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: Ya... Intento tomármelo con filosofía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: Sorry about that. Nobody knows what kind of a person you are yet, so they're still trying to figure you out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Gia'... Cerco di prenderla con filosofia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: Sé que te estás esforzando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: ... Yes, I'm trying to keep an open mind about it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: So che ti stai impegnando.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: ¿Sí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: ... I know you're trying hard.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Si'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: Y sé que no eres mala persona. El jefe no habría contado contigo si lo fueras.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: Huh ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: E so che non sei una cattiva persona. Il capo non avrebbe contato su di te se lo fossi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: No es mucho, pero quiero darte las gracias de parte de todos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: And I know you're not a bad person. Chief wouldn't have brought you in if you were.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Non e' molto, ma voglio ringraziarti a nome di tutti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: Muchas gracias por tu ayuda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: It isn't much, but I want to say thanks in everyone else's stead.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Grazie mille per il tuo aiuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: No ha sido nada...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: Thank you so much for your help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Non e' stato niente...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: Si de verdad piensas así, te pido que sigas esforzándote.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: I haven't really done anything ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Se la pensi davvero cosi', ti chiedo di continuare a impegnarti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: Vale. Gracias... Significa mucho para mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: If you really think that, then please keep trying hard.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Va bene. Grazie... Significa molto per me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: Eso pone fin a muchas cosas... Buen trabajo a los tres. Debéis de estar cansados después de una jornada tan larga.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: Okay. Thanks ... Thanks a lot.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Questo chiude molte questioni... Buon lavoro a tutti e tre. Dovete essere stanchi dopo una giornata cosi' lunga.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: ¡Gracias, pero tenemos cuerda para rato!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: That should finally wrap up a few things ... Good work, you three. You must be exhausted after such a day.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Grazie, ma di corda ne abbiamo per un bel po'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: ¿No me digas? Ja, ja, la juventud...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: Thanks, but we can keep going!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..dst: Davvero? Ah, ah, la giovinezza...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..src: Entonces, hablemos sobre vuestra siguiente tarea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_100..ref: Oh, really? It's good to be young.
