eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: A massive mana explosion took place in the Duerer domain of the Eustellan Republic ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Io e Isla siamo rimasti coinvolti in tutto quel caos.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Nunca lo olvidaré... De repente, escuché un rugido y el mundo se puso del revés.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: The sudden series of explosions took the lives of many.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Non lo dimentichero' mai... D'improvviso, ho sentito un ruggito e il mondo si e' ribaltato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Y, a través de las llamas, lo vimos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: Isla and I were caught up in the terror too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: E, attraverso le fiamme, lo abbiamo visto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Un monstruo alado de dos patas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: I'll never forget it. Suddenly, I thought I heard a roar, and then the next moment the world flipped upside down.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Un mostro alato con due zampe.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: ¿El que acabamos de...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: But then, past the flickering flames, we saw it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Quello che abbiamo appena...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Sí, sin duda. Lo recuerdo vívidamente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: ... A winged, two-legged monster.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Si', senza dubbio. Lo ricordo vividamente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Yo también lo vi. Hizo algo en el suelo y provocó una explosión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: You mean, the one we just ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Anche io l'ho visto. Ha fatto qualcosa sul terreno e ha provocato un'esplosione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Estáis diciendo que ese monstruo fue el responsable del desastre de maná...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: Yeah, without a doubt. I remember exactly how it looked.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: State dicendo che quel mostro e' stato il responsabile del disastro di mana...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Sí. Y por eso es nuestro objetivo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: And I saw it do it. It did something to the ground that caused the explosion.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Si'. Ed e' per questo che e' il nostro obiettivo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Destruyó toda la región y se cobró la vida de muchas personas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: You're saying that monster caused the mana disaster ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Ha distrutto l'intera regione e ha portato via la vita a molte persone.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Jamás lo olvidaré... Jamás. Acabaré con él con mis propias manos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: Yes. And that's why it's our enemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Non lo dimentichero' mai... Mai. Lo finiro' con le mie stesse mani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Si el jefe Erhard no nos hubiera rescatado, no estaríamos manteniendo esta conversación ahora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: It laid waste to the domain and stole the lives of so many people.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Se il capo Erhard non ci avesse salvati, ora non staremmo avendo questa conversazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Hemos consagrado nuestra vida a todas las personas a las que no pudimos proteger ese día... Tomamos esa decisión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: I'll never forgive it ... Never. I'll slay it with my own hands.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Abbiamo dedicato la nostra vita a tutte le persone che non abbiamo potuto proteggere quel giorno... Abbiamo preso quella decisione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Así que esa es vuestra historia... Me pregunto qué pudo causar una explosión tan devastadora...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: Isla ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Cosi' questa e' la vostra storia... Mi chiedo cosa possa aver causato un'esplosione cosi' devastante...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Ahora que lo pienso, ese monstruo llevaba... ¿un Núcleo de energía?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: If Chief Erhard hadn't rescued us, we probably wouldn't be alive right now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: A pensarci bene, quel mostro portava... un Nucleo di Energia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Creo que con la intención de recoger partículas de ese géiser de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: We've dedicated our lives for the sake of those we couldn't protect that day ... That was our decision.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Penso con l'intenzione di raccogliere le particelle di quel geyser di mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Cuando dices partículas, ¿te refieres a los brillitos de los que hablabas antes?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: So that's what happened ... But for something to be able to cause such an explosion ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Quando dici particelle, ti riferisci a quei brillantini di cui parlavi prima?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: El maná está formado por los recuerdos de los seres que han fallecido y regresado a la tierra. Las partículas son fragmentos de esos recuerdos que se dispersan por todo el mundo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: Wait, that thing it was holding ... It looked like an Energy Core.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Il mana e' formato dai ricordi degli esseri che sono morti e sono tornati alla terra. Le particelle sono frammenti di quei ricordi che si disperdono per tutto il mondo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Puedo recrear recetas de síntesis a partir de los recuerdos grabados en esas partículas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: And it seemed like it was trying to collect particles in front of that mana geyser.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Posso ricreare ricette di sintesi a partire dai ricordi incisi in quelle particelle...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: No sé cómo ni por qué, pero ese monstruo debía saber alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: By particles, you mean those things you were talking about before?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Non so come ne' perche', ma quel mostro doveva conoscere l'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Eso pensé yo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: Mana is the memories of living things that have died and returned to the earth. Particles are the remnants of memories that overflow from the earth.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: E' quello che pensavo anch'io...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: (Ahora que conozco todo esto, para ellos, yo soy...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: I make recipes for synthesis from the memories engraved in those particles ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: (Ora che so tutto questo, per loro, io sono...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Lo siento, deberíamos dejar a un lado nuestros sentimientos en las misiones. ¡Ya vale de tanta charla triste!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: I don't really know why or how, but that monster seems to know alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Mi dispiace, dovremmo lasciare da parte i nostri sentimenti nelle missioni. Basta con queste tristi chiacchiere!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Es verdad, el objetivo del equipo de investigación no es perseguir a ese monstruo. Nuestras metas personales deberían estar en segundo plano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: I had a feeling ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: E' vero, l'obiettivo della Squadra di Ricerca non e' dare la caccia a quel mostro. I nostri obiettivi personali dovrebbero restare in secondo piano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.src: Nos basta con saber que está aquí. Seguro que volveremos a toparnos con él algún día.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.ref: (Knowing that, to them, I'm ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220a.dst: Ci basta sapere che si trova qui. Prima o poi di sicuro lo incroceremo di nuovo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: Y bien, me pregunto qué habrá dentro...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: Well then, what's inside?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: Allora, mi chiedo cosa ci sara' dentro...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: Un Vial de recuerdos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: ... A Memory Vial.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: Una Fiala della Memoria...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: ¿Eso que nos enseñaste en el Atelier? A ver si me acuerdo... Dijiste que almacena todo tipo de ideas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: The thing you showed us at the atelier? If I remember correctly, you said it can record all kinds of things ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: Quella che ci hai mostrato in Atelier? Vediamo se ricordo... Hai detto che memorizza ogni sorta di idee...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: Eso es. Parece obra de una civilización pasada, así que quizá guarde algo de aquella época.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: That's right. It looks like it came from the past civilization, so there might be something recorded in it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: Esatto. Sembra opera di una civilta' passata, quindi forse custodisce qualcosa di quell'epoca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: Sé que es muy antiguo, Flammi, pero ¿puedes leerlo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: I know it's old, Flammi, but can you read anything from it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: So che e' molto antico, Flammi, ma riesci a leggerlo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: Gracias. Habéis logrado que la cosecha de este año sea abundante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: Yes, scanning now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: Grazie. Siete riusciti a rendere abbondante il raccolto di quest'anno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: Esa voz...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: ... Thanks. You all have ensured that this year was an abundant harvest.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: Quella voce...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: Es un recuerdo. Un recuerdo de gente que vivió en Aladiss hace mucho tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: This voice ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: E' un ricordo. Un ricordo di persone che vissero ad Aladiss molto tempo fa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: Aunque no sé qué ha pasado en el este, tened por seguro que estamos de vuestro lado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: It's a memory. A memory of people who lived in Aladiss long ago.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: Anche se non so cosa sia successo a est, siate certi che siamo dalla vostra parte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: Ahora registraré el proceso... ¿Se me escapa algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: Though I'm not sure what happened in the east, know that we are on your side.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: Ora annotero' il processo... Mi sfugge qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: Los alquimistas nunca dejan de sorprenderme. ¡Sois capaces de crear hasta nuevas especies!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: Now to record the process ... Um, am I doing this right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: Gli alchimisti non finiscono mai di sorprendermi. Riuscite persino a creare nuove specie!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: ¿No vais a decir cómo os llamáis? Bueno, si no queréis, tampoco os quiero obligar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: Alchemists sure are a wonder. With your skills, even making new varieties is possible!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: Non dite come vi chiamate? Vabbe', se non volete, non voglio certo obbligarvi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: Los alquimistas debemos ayudarnos entre nosotros. Da igual qué obstáculo se nos presente, seguro que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: So you won't tell me your names? ... Well, I suppose if you don't want to, that's all right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: Noi alchimisti dobbiamo aiutarci a vicenda. Non importa quale ostacolo si presenti, di sicuro...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: ¿Eran voces de personas que vivían aquí en el pasado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: Let's continue to help each other, alchemists. No matter what comes our way, I'm sure we can ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: Erano voci di persone che vivevano qui in passato?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: Sí que tenían aprecio a los alquimistas del este...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: Were those the voices of people who lived around here in the past?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: Avevano davvero a cuore gli alchimisti dell'est...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: Cosechas abundantes, nuevas especies... ¿Hablaban de agricultura? ¿Solía usarse la alquimia en los cultivos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: Everyone seemed to really like the alchemists from the east ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: Raccolti abbondanti, nuove specie... Parlavano di agricoltura? Un tempo si usava l'alchimia nelle coltivazioni?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: Sabiendo la opinión general de la gente sobre la alquimia en la actualidad, me parece impensable. Una época en la que todos convivían con la alquimia...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: Abundant harvest, new varieties ... Are they talking about agriculture? Was alchemy used for such things back then?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: Vista l'opinione generale delle persone sull'alchimia ai giorni nostri, mi sembra impensabile. Un'epoca in cui tutti convivevano con l'alchimia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: S-sí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: Given how alchemy is forbidden these days, it's almost unthinkable. An age where people lived together with alchemy ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: (Ese hombre dijo que «estaban de su lado»...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: Y-yeah ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: (Quell'uomo ha detto che "erano dalla loro parte"...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: (¿Quiere eso decir que había otros lugares donde eran hostiles?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: ( ... Those people told the alchemist that they were "on their side" ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: (Vuol dire che c'erano altri posti dove erano ostili?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: Miré dentro de la caja, pero no había nada que sirviera. Solo el Vial de recuerdos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: (Then that means ... other places were hostile to them?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: Ho guardato dentro della cassa, ma non c'era niente di utile. Solo la Fiala della Memoria...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: Bueno, el vial es más que suficiente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: I took a look inside that box, but other than the Memory Vial, I didn't find anything useful.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: Beh, la fiala e' piu' che sufficiente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: Cierto. La mayoría de los registros sobre Aladiss se perdieron en el tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: Well, the Memory Vial is more than enough.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: Vero. La maggior parte delle testimonianze su Aladiss si e' persa nel tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: Yo diría que nos vamos a cruzar con más viales de recuerdos mientras exploramos aquí y allá.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: True. Most historical records of Aladiss have been lost to time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: Direi che ci imbatteremo in altre Fiale della Memoria esplorando qui e la'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.src: Me pregunto si serían objetos corrientes en el pasado. Si encontramos más, debemos examinar qué contienen.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.ref: From the looks of it, we might come across even more Memory Vials here and there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_220b.dst: Mi chiedo se fossero oggetti comuni in passato. Se ne troviamo altre, dobbiamo esaminare cosa contengono.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: Gracias por informar. Sobre ese monstruo... ¿Seguro que estamos hablando del mismo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: Thank you for your report. However, about that monster ... Are you absolutely sure it was one and the same?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Grazie per la segnalazione. Riguardo a quel mostro... Sicuri che stiamo parlando dello stesso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: Jamás se me olvidará su aspecto. Ese monstruo fue el que asoló las tierras de mi familia hace tres años.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: I've never forgotten that figure. That monster is the one that laid waste to my family's domain three years ago.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Non dimentichero' mai il suo aspetto. Quel mostro e' quello che devasto' le terre della mia famiglia tre anni fa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: No podemos dejar que ande suelto. Morirá y seremos nosotros quienes nos encarguemos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: We can't leave it be. That thing is going down, by our own hands.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Non possiamo lasciarlo in giro. Morira', e saremo noi ad occuparcene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: Viktor, sé que me comprenderás si te digo que no te dejes llevar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: I'm sure you fully understand this, but don't get carried away, Viktor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Viktor, so che mi capirai se ti dico di non farti trascinare dai sentimenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: No sabemos qué es ni qué busca.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: We don't know what it is or what its goals are.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Non sappiamo ne' cosa sia ne' cosa cerchi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: Lo primero es investigar, también si queréis llevar a cabo vuestra venganza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: First comes a proper investigation. For the sake of your vengeance as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Prima di tutto bisogna indagare, anche se volete portare a termine la vostra vendetta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: Lo tendré presente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: I'll bear your words in mind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Ne terro' conto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: Bien, ahora... ¿Qué tal va la colaboración con Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: Good, now then ... Are you working well with Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Bene, ora... Come procede la collaborazione con Yumia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: Curioso, yo no lo llamaría así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: I wonder ... I don't feel like I am.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Curioso, io non la chiamerei cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: La alquimia... es tabú.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: ... Alchemy is taboo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: L'alchimia... e' un tabu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: Ella misma nos dijo que el monstruo que destruyó nuestro hogar estaba vinculado con esas artes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: She even told us that the monster that destroyed our domain was likely related to alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: E' stata proprio lei a dirci che il mostro che distrusse la nostra casa era legato a quelle arti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: No puedo aceptarlo sin más, aun así...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: I can't easily accept something like that. But ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Non riesco ad accettarlo cosi', eppure...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: ¿Aun así?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: But?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: E nonostante questo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: No nos ocultó la información, aunque la dejara en un mal lugar. Valoro su honestidad a la hora de afrontar los hechos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: She didn't hide information that was unfavorable for her. I appreciate her desire to face the situation head-on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Non ci ha nascosto l'informazione, anche se ci ha messi in una situazione difficile. Apprezzo la sua onesta' nel fronteggiare i fatti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: Veo que no me equivoqué al confiaros a Isla y a ti la tarea de observar a Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: It seems I was right to entrust you and Isla to observe Yumia after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Vedo che non mi sono sbagliato ad affidare a Isla e a te il compito di osservare Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: Los tres compartís un pasado y sois de edades parecidas, por eso consideré que os comprenderíais.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: You three are close in both age and circumstance. That's why I thought you would be able to understand each other's feelings.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Voi tre condividete un passato e avete eta' simili, per questo ho pensato che vi sareste capiti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: ¿Lo dices porque somos víctimas del mismo incidente?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: Because we were all victims of the same incident?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Lo dici perche' siamo vittime dello stesso incidente?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: Aparte... Creo que es mejor que sea ella quien les cuente los detalles.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: Not just that ... But I think the details are best left to be heard from the person in question.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: A parte questo... Penso che sia meglio che sia lei a raccontarvi i dettagli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: Si te soy sincero, prefiero que los jóvenes os sintáis rodeados de amigos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: But well, to put it plainly, I'd like for you young folks to become close friends.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: A dire il vero, preferisco che voi giovani vi sentiate circondati dagli amici.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: ¿En serio? Estás pidiendo demasiado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: Close ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Davvero? Pretendi troppo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: ¡Qué derroche de energía!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: Good grief, that's asking for a lot.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Che spreco di energia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: Van de un lado para otro para ser los primeros en conseguir un gran hallazgo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: Everyone sure is full of energy!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Vanno di qua e di la' per essere i primi a fare una grande scoperta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: Como las zonas de vínculo de maná se han disipado, hay muchos más sectores que investigar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: They all must be scrambling to be the first to make some big discovery.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Dato che le zone di legame del mana si sono dissipate, ci sono molti piu' settori da indagare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: Eh, vosotros tres, escuchad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: There are more places that can be investigated now that a swath of manabound areas has been cleared up, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Ehi, voi tre, ascoltate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: Esta mañana recibí los resultados de un estudio en el que hemos comparado los antiguos mapas con la distribución actual del terreno.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: Hey, listen to this, you three.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Stamattina ho ricevuto i risultati di uno studio in cui abbiamo confrontato le antiche mappe con l'attuale distribuzione del terreno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: Conseguimos identificar un lugar que los alquimistas usaban como base de sus indagaciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: This morning I received the results of a study that compared old maps to the current lay of the land ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Siamo riusciti a identificare un luogo che gli alchimisti usavano come base delle loro indagini.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: Conque alquimistas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: And one site was identified as the remains of a facility where alchemists conducted research.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Quindi alchimisti, eh...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: Sí. Quiero que vayáis a investigarlo, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: Alchemists ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Si'. Voglio che andiate a indagare in quel luogo, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: Puede que haya alguna pista importante en las ruinas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: Yes. So I'd like you to investigate further, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Potrebbe esserci qualche indizio importante nelle rovine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: ¡Sí, señor!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: There might be an important clue left behind in those ruins.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Si', signore!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..src: ¡Así me gusta! Viktor, Isla, ayudadla en todo lo que necesite.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..ref: Understood!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm01_230..dst: Cosi' mi piace! Viktor, Isla, aiutatela in tutto cio' di cui ha bisogno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..src: Así que estas son las ruinas...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..ref: ... Huh, wait a second. Who was that?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..src: Llevaba una cinta, así que yo diría que es del equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..ref: He was wearing a bandana, so he's probably part of the Research Team ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..dst: Portava una bandana, quindi direi che e' della Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..src: Sí, yo le he visto un par de veces. Creo que se llama Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..ref: I've seen him around a few times before. I think his name is Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..dst: Si', l'ho visto un paio di volte. Credo che si chiami Rutger.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..src: ¿Estaba solo? No veo a nadie más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..ref: Was he by himself? I don't see any others around.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..dst: Era da solo? Non vedo nessun altro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..src: Espero que no haya salido a investigar por su cuenta. ¿Estará el jefe al tanto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..ref: He'd better not be going out like this on his own. Does the chief know about this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..dst: Spero che non sia uscito a indagare per conto suo. Il capo ne e' al corrente?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..src: Parece que se nos ha adelantado, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..ref: So we've been beaten to the chase, then?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..src: El equipo de investigación no es una banda de cazarreliquias. No importa quién llegue primero a los sitios.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..ref: The Research Team isn't a group of relic hunters. It shouldn't matter whether we get here first or not.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..dst: La squadra di ricerca non e' un gruppo di cacciatori di reliquie. Non importa chi arrivi per primo sul posto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..src: Pero fue el jefe quien nos pidió que viniéramos, ¿no? ¿Se habrá confundido de misión?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..ref: We were told to come here by the chief himself, right? Was there some kind of mistake?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..dst: Ma e' stato il capo a chiederci di venire, no? Avra' sbagliato missione?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..src: Sea como sea, debemos cumplir con nuestras obligaciones ya que estamos aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..ref: Either way, we should conduct our own investigation while we're here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..dst: Comunque sia, dobbiamo svolgere i nostri compiti gia' che siamo qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_010..ref: <SEL_MM02_010_1_B><CR>So we've been beaten to the chase, then?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_020a.src: (Una estantería... Pero no hay nada interesante.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_020a.dst: (Una libreria... Ma non c'e' niente di interessante.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_020a.src: (No veo restos de polvo, lo que significa que ese chico se ha llevado algo...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_020a.ref: (There's no dust on the shelf, which means maybe that guy took something earlier ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_020a.dst: (Non vedo tracce di polvere, il che significa che quel ragazzo ha preso qualcosa...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_020b.src: (Vaya desastre, aunque era de esperar en un edificio tan antiguo.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_020b.ref: (What a mess ... But with such an old building, it's to be expected.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_020b.dst: (Che pasticcio, anche se era prevedibile in un edificio cosi' antico.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_020b.src: (No veo que haya nada particularmente destacable.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_020b.ref: (I don't see anything of note left behind.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_020b.dst: (Non vedo nulla di particolarmente degno di nota.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_020c.src: (¿Qué ha sido eso? Lo he visto por aquí...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_020c.ref: (What was that? It was somewhere around here ... )

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_020c.src: (Una simple moneda. Quizá la podamos vender, pero no creo que nos haga falta.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_020c.ref: (Just a coin. I'm sure we could sell it or something, but I don't really need it.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_020c.dst: (Una semplice moneta. Forse potremmo venderla, ma non credo ci serva.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..src: Buf... Así son las cosas a veces. Nada, regresemos a la base.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..ref: *Sigh* Well, that's just how it is. We should return to base for now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..dst: Uff... A volte va cosi'. Per ora, torniamo alla base.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..src: Yo me quedaré echando otro vistazo. Podéis descansar un rato por aquí cerca si os apetece.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..ref: I'm going to look around a little longer. You two can rest nearby.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..dst: Io restero' a dare un altro sguardo in giro. Potete riposare un po' qui vicino, se volete.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..ref: Hey, Yumia, can I ask you something?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..dst: Ehi, Yumia, posso farti una domanda?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..ref: Why did you decide to become an alchemist?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..src: Seguro que sabías que la alquimia era tabú, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..ref: I'm sure you were taught that alchemy is taboo as well, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..dst: Di certo sapevi che l'alchimia era tabu', vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..src: Y sé que tu madre era alquimista...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..ref: I know your mom was an alchemist ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..dst: E so che tua madre era un'alchimista...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..src: Pero ¿por qué decidiste seguir sus pasos? Te arriesgabas a profundizar en lo prohibido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..ref: But why did you choose to follow the same path as her, even though it meant venturing into the forbidden?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..dst: Ma perche' hai deciso di seguire le sue orme? Correvi il rischio di addentrarti nel proibito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..ref: The reason I chose to follow the same path ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..dst: Perche' ho deciso di seguire le sue orme...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..src: Bueno, vamos a estar un tiempo trabajando codo con codo y apenas te conocemos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..ref: We'll be working together for the foreseeable future, right? And yet, we don't know much about you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..dst: Insomma, lavoreremo gomito a gomito per un po' e ti conosciamo appena.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..src: Tenía pensado contároslo algún día, así que me alegro de que lo hayas preguntado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..ref: Well, I wanted to talk about it eventually ... so I appreciate you asking me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..dst: Avevo intenzione di raccontarvelo prima o poi, quindi sono contenta che tu l'abbia chiesto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..src: ¿Y si vamos a un lugar más tranquilo para conversar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..ref: ... But how about we go somewhere easier to chat first?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_030..dst: E se andassimo in un posto piu' tranquillo per chiacchierare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Me hice alquimista por mi madre... Quería conocer los motivos que la llevaron a actuar de esa manera.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: The reason I became an alchemist is because of my mother ... I wanted to know her true intentions ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Sono diventata un'alchimista per mia madre... Volevo conoscere i motivi che l'hanno spinta ad agire in quel modo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Vivíamos en un taller.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: Our house was a tool shop.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Vivevamo in una bottega.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Mi padre y yo llevábamos la tienda y mi madre fabricaba las herramientas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: Me and my father ran the store, and my mother made the tools.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Mio padre e io gestivamo il negozio e mia madre fabbricava gli attrezzi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Cuando mi padre murió, nos quedamos las dos solas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: But when my father died, it was just the two of us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Quando mio padre mori', rimanemmo sole noi due.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: A veces, las herramientas que creaba mi madre eran un poco raras, pero estaban en boca de todos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: The tools my mother made were sometimes a little weird, but usually very popular ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: A volte gli attrezzi che creava mia madre erano un po' strani, ma erano sulla bocca di tutti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: A mí me encantaban. Se pasaba el día regañándome por jugar con los productos de la tienda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: I loved them too. She always scolded me for playing with the merchandise.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: A me piacevano un mondo. Passava le giornate a sgridarmi perche' giocavo con i prodotti del negozio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Nunca la escuché hablar de alquimia, ni siquiera de pasada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: The word "alchemy" never came up, not even in passing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Non l'ho mai sentita parlare di alchimia, nemmeno di sfuggita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Al menos hasta el desastre de maná...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: ... Not until the mana disaster, that is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Almeno fino al disastro del mana...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: El de Duerer...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: The one in the Duerer domain ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Quello di Duerer...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Sí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: ... Yes.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Toda la ciudad quedó sepultada por el maná y la explosión destruyó el taller familiar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: The town was flooded with mana, and my family's shop was destroyed in the explosion.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Tutta la citta' rimase sepolta dal mana e l'esplosione distrusse la bottega di famiglia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Ahora que lo pienso, Aladiss pasó por lo mismo. El maná concentrado estaba llegando a todos los rincones del territorio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: Thinking back on it, it was the same situation as Aladiss, with highly concentrated mana spreading everywhere.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Pensandoci bene, anche Aladiss visse la stessa cosa. Il mana concentrato stava raggiungendo ogni angolo del territorio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Nos obligaron a evacuar. No sabía lo que pasaba y tenía miedo... Recuerdo que mi madre miró atrás con seriedad y dijo:
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: I was in shock and didn't know what was going on as we evacuated ... but then my mom looked at the situation and said,
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Ci obbligarono a evacuare. Non sapevo cosa stesse succedendo e avevo paura... Ricordo che mia madre guardo' indietro con serieta' e disse:

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: «Puedo salvarlos a todos».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: "I have the power to save everyone."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: "Posso salvarli tutti".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Me estrechó en sus brazos y la vi desaparecer en la zona de vínculo de maná...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: She hugged me tightly, and I watched as she disappeared into the manabound area ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Mi strinse tra le braccia e la vidi scomparire nella zona di legame del mana...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Esperé y esperé... pero nunca volvió.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: I waited and waited, but she never returned.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Aspettai e aspettai... ma non torno' mai.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Cuando el maná desapareció, lo único que quedaba de mi madre era Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: Even after the mana dissipated, the only thing I found was this little one my mother had brought with her.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Quando il mana scomparve, l'unica cosa rimasta di mia madre fu Flammi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Nuestra amiguita estaba muy dañada y no sabía cómo funcionaba, pero me las ingenié para repararla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: Flammi was damaged badly. I didn't know how it worked, but I managed to fix it up to its current state.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: La nostra amichetta era gravemente danneggiata e non sapevo come funzionasse, ma sono riuscita a ripararla lo stesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Y entonces, Flammi me lo contó...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: And then, Flammi told me ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Ed e' allora che Flammi me lo racconto'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Cuando nos separamos, mi madre disipó la zona de vínculo de maná. Flammi también me habló de la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: That after my mother had left me, she had dispelled the manabound area. Flammi also told me about alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Quando ci separammo, mia madre dissipo' la zona di legame del mana. Flammi mi parlo' anche dell'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Sentía un gran vacío en mi corazón... Me limité a hacer lo que me mandaban y a limpiar los desperfectos causados por el desastre...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: It felt like I was neither living nor dead ... I just did as I was told and cleaned up in the aftermath of the disaster ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Sentivo un grande vuoto nel cuore... Mi limitavo a fare quello che mi dicevano e a ripulire i danni causati dal disastro...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Fue entonces cuando conocí al jefe Erhard y él me habló de muchas más cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: It was then that Chief Erhard found me and told me more.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Fu allora che conobbi il capo Erhard e lui mi parlo' di molte altre cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: «Tu madre, Irene Liessfeldt, era alquimista».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: "Your mother, Irene Liessfeldt, was an alchemist."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: "Tua madre, Irene Liessfeldt, era un'alchimista".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: «Si compartes sus habilidades, podrás disipar las zonas de vínculo de maná que han bloqueado Aladiss».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: "If you hold the same qualities as your mother, you should be able to clear the manabound areas of Aladiss."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: "Se possiedi le sue capacita', potrai dissipare le zone di legame del mana che hanno bloccato Aladiss".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: «Necesitamos alguien con tu poder en el equipo de investigación». Más o menos, esa fue nuestra conversación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: "The Research Team is in need of your power." ... Well, it was something like that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: "Abbiamo bisogno di qualcuno con il tuo potere nella Squadra di Ricerca". Piu' o meno, fu questa la nostra conversazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Y así es como terminaste aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: And that's how you ended up here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Ed e' cosi' che sei finita qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Quiero conocer la verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: I want to know the truth.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Voglio conoscere la verita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: ¿Qué ocurrió en este continente? ¿Por qué prohibieron la alquimia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: What happened on this continent? Why was alchemy made forbidden?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Cosa e' successo in questo continente? Perche' hanno proibito l'alchimia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: ¿Desoyó mi madre... las leyes y continuó a pesar de todo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: ... And was my mother a bad person who broke that taboo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Mia madre... ignoro' le leggi e continuo' comunque?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Aquí hallaré todas las respuestas que necesito.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: The answers to those questions lie here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Qui trovero' tutte le risposte di cui ho bisogno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Tu madre...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: Your mother ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Tua madre...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Eso quiere decir que la persona que nos salvó...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: Then that might mean the one who saved us was—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Questo significa che la persona che ci ha salvato...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Ya veo. No teníamos ni idea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: I see. We didn't know anything about this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Capisco. Non ne avevamo la minima idea.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: ¿I-Isla?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: I-Isla?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: I-Isla?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Tu madre nos salvó la vida, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: I mean, that means your mother might have saved our lives, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Tua madre ci ha salvato la vita, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: No podemos mirar para otro lado sin más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: We can't take that lightly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Non possiamo voltare le spalle cosi' e basta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Yumia, tu madre era muy importante para ti, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: Isla ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Yumia, tua madre era molto importante per te, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Sí... No niego que me sorprendió saber que era alquimista, pero siempre he querido ser como ella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: Yumia, your mother is really important to you, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Si'... Non nego che mi ha sorpreso scoprire che era un'alchimista, ma ho sempre voluto essere come lei.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: No estuve presente para saber qué hizo tu madre ni puedo juzgar qué está bien y qué no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: ... Yeah. I was surprised when I found out she was an alchemist, but I've always wanted to be like her.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Non ero presente per sapere cosa ha fatto tua madre e non posso giudicare cosa sia giusto e cosa no.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Sí...
Pero tú lo has dicho antes: el objetivo del equipo es hallar la verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: It's not like I saw what your mother did firsthand. I still can't say for sure what is right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Ma l'hai detto tu prima: l'obiettivo della squadra e' trovare la verita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Conocer todo lo que ignoramos... ese es nuestro cometido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: ... Yeah.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Conoscere tutto cio' che ignoriamo... questo e' il nostro compito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Gracias, significa mucho oírte decir eso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: But like you said before, the Research Team's objective is to uncover the truth.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Grazie, significa molto sentirti dire questo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Oye, Yumia, pero ¡háblanos de ti! ¿Qué haces en tus ratos libres o... cuál es tu comida favorita?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: To find out the unknown—that's our purpose here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Ehi, Yumia, ma parlaci un po' di te! Cosa fai nel tempo libero o... qual e' il tuo cibo preferito?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: ¿Eh? ¿Así de repente?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: Thank you, it means a lot to hear you say that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Eh? Cosi' all'improvviso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Saber estas cosas es básico para conocer a otra persona. ¡Deberíamos haber empezado por ahí!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: Hey, Yumia, tell us more about yourself! Like your hobbies, or your favorite food!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Sapere queste cose e' fondamentale per conoscere una persona. Avremmo dovuto iniziare da li'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Jo, lo has preguntado tan de repente... Es que me da un poco de corte ahora. ¿Por qué no lo hablamos en otro momento?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: Huh? Why all of a sudden ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Uff, me l'hai chiesto cosi' di colpo... Mi mette un po' in imbarazzo adesso. Perche' non ne parliamo piu' tardi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Pero ¡si has dicho que querías hablarnos de ti!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: Knowing what someone likes helps you to get to know them, right? We should talk about stuff like that more!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Ma se hai detto che volevi parlarci di te!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Hace tiempo que no le veía esa expresión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: It's a little embarrassing being asked so suddenly ... Let's talk about it next time. Yeah, next time!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: E' da tempo che non le vedevo quell'espressione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: Debí de decir algo antes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: Aww, you were the one who wanted to tell us more about yourself, though!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Avrei dovuto dire qualcosa prima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..src: No te preocupes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..ref: Don't get to see her make that kind of face every day.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_035..dst: Non preoccuparti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..src: Rutger... No quiero volver a repetirlo: eres parte del equipo, compórtate como corresponde.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..ref: ... Rutger, don't make me say it again. You're part of the team, so act like it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..dst: Rutger... Non voglio ripeterlo di nuovo: fai parte della squadra, comportati come si deve.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..src: Prefiero ir por mi cuenta, saco más beneficios, ¿es para tanto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..ref: It's easier for me to act on my own. I'm gettin' plenty results, so what's the problem?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..dst: Preferisco andare per conto mio, mi conviene di piu', e' cosi' terribile?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..src: No se trata de los beneficios. Sé que estás acostumbrado a estar solo, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..ref: Results aren't the issue. I know you're accustomed to doing things on your own, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..dst: Non e' una questione di risultati. So che sei abituato a fare tutto da solo, ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..src: ¿Fuiste tú quién se llevó todas las reliquias?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..ref: Did you collect all of the relics from that place on your own?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..dst: Sei stato tu a portare via tutte le reliquie?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..src: Oye, oye, ¿me estás acusando de robarte toda la gloria? Deberías saber que somos parte del mismo equipo, no te lo tomes así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..ref: Whoa, whoa, are you sayin' that I snatched your glory? We're on the same team, so there's no such thing, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..dst: Ehi, ehi, mi stai accusando di rubarti tutta la gloria? Dovresti sapere che facciamo parte della stessa squadra, non prenderla cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..src: No he dicho eso. Ir solo por ahí es muy peligroso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..ref: That's not what I'm saying. Going out there solo is incredibly dangerous ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..dst: Non ho detto questo. Andare in giro da solo e' molto pericoloso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..src: Creo que no os he presentado. Este es Rutger, lleva un tiempo a mi cargo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..ref: Ahh, I don't believe I've introduced you yet. This is Rutger. I've been looking after him for a while.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..dst: Credo di non avervi presentato. Lui e' Rutger, e' con me da un po' di tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..src: Es un buen aventurero, pero, como habéis visto, es algo peculiar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..ref: He's quite an experienced adventurer, but ... Well, as you can tell, he can be a bit difficult.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..dst: E' un buon avventuriero, ma, come avete visto, e' un po' particolare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..src: Siento que hayáis perdido el tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..ref: I'm sorry that you ended up wasting your time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..dst: Mi dispiace che abbiate perso tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..src: No lo sientas. Menos mal que estamos todos a salvo, eso es lo más importante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..ref: Don't worry about it. Everything's fine as long as everyone's safe and sound. Let's leave it at that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..dst: Non te ne dispiacere. Meno male che siamo tutti salvi, e' la cosa piu' importante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..src: No, debí asegurarme de que comprendiera lo peligroso que es salir a explorar el continente sin compañía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..ref: No, I should have made sure he knew just how dangerous thoughtlessly traveling around this continent is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..dst: No, avrei dovuto assicurarmi che comprendesse quanto e' pericoloso esplorare il continente senza compagnia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..src: Sé que acabáis de llegar, pero había un Vial de recuerdos entre las reliquias que encontró Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..dst: So che siete appena arrivati, ma tra le reliquie che Rutger ha trovato c'era una Fiala della Memoria.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..ref: I know you've just gotten back, Yumia, but there was a Memory Vial among the relics Rutger found.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..dst: Ti dispiacerebbe controllarne il contenuto, Yumia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..ref: Could you check the contents for us?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..src: Se lo hemos dejado al responsable de las reliquias. Acompañadme. Tú también, Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..dst: L'abbiamo lasciata al responsabile delle reliquie. Seguitemi. Tu pure, Rutger.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_040..ref: The relics were left with the relic manager. Come with me. You too, Rutger.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: ¿Puedes enseñarme lo que trajo Rutger?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Can I see the thing that Rutger brought in earlier?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Puoi mostrarmi quello che Rutger ha portato?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Claro, jefe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Sure thing, Chief.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Certo, capo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Parece un Vial de recuerdos de una civilización pasada. Se nos adelantó por unos minutos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: This does seem like a Memory Vial from the past civilization. He really did beat us to the chase.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Sembra una Fiala della Memoria di una civilta' passata. Ci ha preceduto di pochi minuti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: ¿Qué es esa cosa? Supuse que tendría algún valor, pero no sabía a quién vendérsela.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: So what exactly is that thing? It looked like it might be worth somethin', but I had no clue what to do with it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Che cos'e' quella cosa? Pensavo avesse un certo valore, ma non sapevo a chi venderla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Sé cómo usarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: I know how to use it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: So come si usa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Es lógico que una persona corriente no sepa ver su valor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: It is natural that a normal person would not understand.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: E' normale che una persona comune non sappia vederne il valore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: ¿Qué has dicho?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: ... What?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Cosa hai detto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Vamos a ver qué información nos revela.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Now then, let's see what information is inside.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Vediamo quale informazione ci rivela.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Son los documentos de la investigación de los alquimistas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: It appears that it contains the alchemists' research documents.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Sono i documenti della ricerca degli alchimisti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: «Nos hemos asentado en esta tierra».<CR>«Sin embargo, la verdad sigue fuera de nuestro alcance».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: "We shall take root upon this land."<CR>"However, the truth we seek remains the same."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: "Ci siamo insediati in questa terra".<CR>"Tuttavia, la verita' rimane fuori dalla nostra portata".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: «Dejamos estos datos con la esperanza de que sirvan a los alquimistas del futuro». Y eso es todo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: "We leave this research for the sake of the alchemists of future generations." ... That is what is recorded.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: "Lasciamo questi dati nella speranza che servano agli alchimisti del futuro". E questo e' tutto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: ¿Qué contiene exactamente?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: So that's what's inside?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Cosa contiene esattamente?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Ya veo... Me gustaría estudiar con detalle los documentos, ¿puedo pedir prestado este Vial de recuerdos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: I see ... I'd like to take a closer look at these documents. Can I borrow this Memory Vial for a bit?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Capisco... Mi piacerebbe studiare i documenti nel dettaglio, posso chiedere in prestito questa Fiala della Memoria?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Por supuesto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Of course.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Certo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Los alquimistas usáis todo tipo de cachivaches.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Alchemists sure use a bunch of weird tools.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Voi alchimisti usate ogni tipo di aggeggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Flammi es una asistente autómata especializada en la investigación, no un «cachivache».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Flammi is a super-high-spec independent survey-assistance device, not a "weird tool."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Flammi e' un'assistente automa specializzata nella ricerca, non un "aggeggio".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Ja, ja, ja, ¿qué le pasa a esta cosa? Me cae bien. No deberías acapararla tú sola.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Haha, what's with this thing? I like it. Lend it to the rest of us as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Ah, ah, ah, che le viene a questa cosa? Mi cade simpatica. Non dovresti tenerla tutta per te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Olvídalo. Flammi es irreemplazable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: No can do. Flammi is irreplaceable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Non se ne parla. Flammi e' insostituibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Venga ya, somos compañeros, ¿no te acuerdas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Come on, we're all fellow Research Team members, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Dai, siamo compagni, non ti ricordi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: No insistas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Even so ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Non insistere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Lo lamento. A pesar de mi tecnología puntera, no cuento con la función de «duplicación».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Deepest apologies. Even perfect survey-assistance devices do not have a "duplication" function.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Mi dispiace. Nonostante la mia tecnologia all'avanguardia, non sono dotata della funzione "duplicazione".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Bueno, ¿y no sería mejor que colaborarais?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: In that case, wouldn't it be best if you worked together?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Insomma, non sarebbe meglio se collaboraste?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Podríais estudiar juntos los viales de recuerdo. Eso os facilitaría el trabajo, ¿qué me decís?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Then you could both investigate the Memory Vials. Quite efficient that way, don't you think?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Potreste studiare insieme le fiale della memoria. Vi semplificherebbe il lavoro, che ne dite?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Por si no me has oído antes: gracias, pero no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Like I said earlier, if that's what we're talkin' about, no thanks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Nel caso non avessi sentito prima: grazie, ma no.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: ¿Qué? Déjame trabajar a mi modo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: ... Listen here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Cosa? Lasciami lavorare a modo mio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Rutger, ven conmigo un momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: What? I just wanna do things my own—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Rutger, vieni con me un momento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: ¿Qué? ¡Ah! ¡Espera! ¡Suéltame! ¿Es que no me oyes?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Rutger, come with me a moment.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Cosa? Ah! Aspetta! Lasciami! Non mi senti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Por favor, cuidad de Rutger por mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Ah? What—Wait! Don't pull me! Are you even listenin' to me?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Per favore, prendetevi cura di Rutger per me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Ah... Bueno...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Please take good care of Rutger for me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Ah... Beh...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: No creo que yo sea la más indicada para hablar, pero... ¿seguro que es lo correcto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Ah ... Um, well ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Non credo di essere la persona piu' adatta per parlarne, ma... sei sicura che sia la cosa giusta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Es más que lo correcto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: It may be strange for me to say, but ... is this really all right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: E' piu' che giusto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Es más que lo correcto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Completely all right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: E' piu' che giusto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: En fin, si esas son tus órdenes... Procuraremos llevarnos bien, ¿vale, Rutger?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Completely all right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Insomma, se sono i tuoi ordini... Cercheremo di andare d'accordo, va bene, Rutger?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Lo dice por ti. Cuento con que nos eches una mano mientras trabajamos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: ... Well, if those are your orders. I hope we can work well together, Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Lo dice per te. Conto sul tuo aiuto mentre lavoriamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: No somos grandes aventureros, pero ¡estoy dispuesta a hacer más amigos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Same here. I'll be counting on your strength while we perform our duties.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Non siamo grandi avventurieri, ma sono disposta a fare piu' amici!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: No he venido a hacer amigos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: We aren't too used to being adventurers yet, so I hope we can get along well!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Non sono venuto a fare amicizia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: ¿Eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: I'm not here to make friends.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Rutger, otra vez no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: ... Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Rutger, non di nuovo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: ¡Ya, ya lo sé! ¡Quieres que cuide de estos críos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: ... Rutger, don't make me say it again.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Lo so, lo so! Vuoi che mi prenda cura di questi ragazzini!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: ¿Críos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: I know, I know! I'm babysittin', right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Ragazzini?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Isla, cálmate...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Babysitting?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Isla, calmati...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Pero ¿tú lo has oído?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Uh, Isla. Calm down ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Ma l'hai sentito anche tu?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Jefe, ¿seguro que...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Did you hear him?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Capo, sei sicuro che...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Llevo años repitiéndole que debe pensar antes de hablar, pero ya ves.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Chief, is this really ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Sono anni che gli ripeto che deve pensare prima di parlare, ma vedi un po'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Isla, vamos a llevarnos bien...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: I've scolded him for years, but he's never fixed that mouth of his.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Isla, cerchiamo di andare d'accordo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Imposible. ¡No puedo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Isla, let's get along ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Impossibile. Non posso!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..src: Rutger se ha unido al grupo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..ref: Nuh-uh. No way!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_050..dst: Rutger si e' unito al gruppo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_060..src: Me llamo Yumia. Al menos, podrías recordar mi nombre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_060..ref: You can call me Yumia. Please at least remember my name.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_060..dst: Mi chiamo Yumia. Potresti almeno ricordare il mio nome.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_060..src: Bueno, pero has respondido, ¿no? ¿Por qué no me enseñas de qué va eso de la alquimia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_060..ref: "Alchemist" works, no? Anyways, show me this alchemy stuff.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_060..dst: Va bene, ma hai risposto, no? Perche' non mi mostri com'e' quest'affare dell'alchimia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_060..src: ¿Es que no escuchas? Aunque supongo que no me importa que veas de qué se trata...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_060..ref: Are you even listening to me? Though, I don't mind showing you some alchemy ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_060..dst: Non ascolti proprio? Pero' suppongo che non mi dispiaccia mostrarti di cosa si tratta...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_060..src: Si vamos a ir juntos, debería saber al menos cuáles son tus puntos fuertes, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_060..ref: If we're gonna be workin' together, I should at least know what it looks like, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_060..dst: Se andremo insieme, dovrei sapere almeno quali sono i tuoi punti di forza, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_060..src: (Tiene sentido. Ha sonado como un verdadero aventurero.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_060..ref: (That does make sense. I guess he really is a seasoned adventurer.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_060..src: (¿Es que no le da miedo la alquimia? Este tipo es muy raro...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_060..ref: (Still ... he isn't afraid of alchemy? This guy's definitely a strange one ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_060..dst: (Non ha paura dell'alchimia? Questo tipo e' davvero strano...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_060..src: Entonces, debemos pasarnos por el Atelier. Allí podrás ver mi alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_060..ref: In that case, I'll lead you to the atelier. That's where I can show my alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_060..dst: Allora dobbiamo passare per l'Atelier. Li' potrai vedere la mia alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: Jum... Así que esto es un Atelier de alquimista, ¿eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: Hmm ... So this is what an alchemist's atelier looks like.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: Uhm... Quindi questo e' un Atelier da alchimista, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: Menudo vertedero.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: What a dump.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: Che discarica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: Me lo dicen mucho...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: That's what everyone keeps saying ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: Me lo dicono spesso...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: Voy a intentar hacerte un arma, a ver si así dejas de quejarte, ¿qué me dices?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: Well, I'm going to try making a weapon for you, so no complaints, okay?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: Cerchero' di farti un'arma, cosi' magari smetti di lamentarti, che ne dici?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: ¡Ah! Y, por favor, no rompas ninguna herramienta ni toquetees los ingredientes que veas por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: Oh, and please don't touch or break any of the tools and ingredients lying around.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: Ah! E per favore, non rompere nessun attrezzo e non toccare gli ingredienti che vedi in giro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: Ahora que lo dices, creo que estas herramientas alcanzarían un buen precio en las tiendas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: Now that you mention it, a lot of these tools look like they'd fetch a nice price.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: Ora che lo dici, credo che questi attrezzi si venderebbero a un buon prezzo nei negozi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: Si noto que me falta algo, iré a hablar directamente con el jefe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: The chief will be the first to hear if anything goes missing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: Se mi accorgo che manca qualcosa, andro' a parlare direttamente col capo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: ¿Eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: ¡Eh, alquimista! ¿Qué es esta habitación?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: Hey, Alchemist! What's this room here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: Ehi, alchimista! Che cos'e' questa stanza?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: Pues no sabría decirte. No he podido abrirla por mucho que lo he intentado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: Ah, I'm not too sure myself. I haven't been able to get it open ever since I first got here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: Non saprei dirti. Non sono mai riuscito ad aprirla, per quanto abbia provato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: Olvídate de tirar y empujar... Aquí no sirve de nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: Push it, pull it, nothing happens ... Honestly, I've given up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: Lascia perdere tirare e spingere... Qui non serve a niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: Es el Atelier de una alquimista. Puede que oculte algo ahí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: It's an alchemist's atelier. Maybe they sealed something away back there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: E' l'Atelier di un'alchimista. Potrebbe nascondere qualcosa li' dentro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: Me gustaría encontrar el modo de entrar, pero hasta ahora no ha habido suerte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: It'd be great if we could find another way in, but no luck so far.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: Sarebbe bello trovare un altro modo per entrare, ma finora niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: ¿Sois siempre tan obtusos? Las situaciones desesperadas requieren abrirse paso a patadas a la desesperada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: Are you all dense? At times like this, you just kick the dang thing in.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: Siete proprio degli ottusi? Le situazioni disperate richiedono di aprirsi la strada a calci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: ¡Apartaos, que voy!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: All right, here goes!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: Spostatevi, che vado!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: Me ha dolido hasta a mí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: That looked like it hurt.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: Mi ha fatto male persino a me...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: Vaya idiota.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: What an idiot.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: Che idiota.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: ¿Y seguimos sin saber qué oculta esta puerta?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: But just what could be behind this door?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: E si continua a non sapere cosa nasconda questa porta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: Yo ya solo espero que no haya nada peligroso al otro lado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: I really do hope there's nothing dangerous back there ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: Io ormai spero solo che dall'altra parte non ci sia nulla di pericoloso...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: Quizás sea algo que tuviera un gran valor para su antiguo dueño.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: Maybe it holds something that was really important to the old owner?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: Forse e' qualcosa che aveva un grande valore per il suo antico proprietario.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: ¡Como en casa! Siempre guardábamos las cosas de más valor en una caja fuerte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: Back home, all our precious valuables are locked up in a sturdy vault!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: Come a casa mia! Le cose piu' preziose le custodivamo sempre in una cassaforte robusta!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: Es verdad...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: ... That's true.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: E' vero...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: Sea lo que sea, no querían que nadie lo manoseara sin permiso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: Whatever it is, they definitely didn't want anyone getting to it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..dst: Qualsiasi cosa sia, non volevano che nessuno la toccasse senza permesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..src: Suficiente que tenemos acceso a este sitio; yo digo que dejemos esa puerta estar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm02_070..ref: We're lucky to have access to this place to begin with, so maybe we should just let this one room be.
