eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.dst: Me la cavo bene con le mani. Faro' del mio meglio per soddisfare le vostre aspettative.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.src: Lo intentaré y os enseñaré cómo han quedado. Si no os convencen, no tenéis por qué usarlas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.ref: I'll give it a try, so will you take a look at the result? If they're no good, you don't have to use them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.dst: Ci provero', poi darete un'occhiata al risultato? Se non vi piacciono, non siete obbligati a usarle.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.src: Trato hecho. Viviendo en un lugar como este, siempre nos falta mano de obra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.ref: We accept your offer. Living in a place like this, we're always short-handed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.dst: Accettiamo la tua offerta. In un posto come questo siamo sempre a corto di manodopera.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.src: Al equipo de investigación le pasa lo mismo. ¿Por qué no colaboramos siempre que podamos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.ref: The same goes for the Research Team. Let's work together wherever we can.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060b.dst: Vale anche per la Squadra di Ricerca. Collaboriamo ogni volta che possiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: Hola, ¿qué haces?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: Hello. What are you doing?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: Ciao, che fai?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: Vaya, vaya, pero ¡si es la comidilla de la aldea! ¡Tienes que escuchar esto!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: Well, well, if it isn't the talk of the town! Listen to this!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: Ma guarda un po', e' proprio la persona sulla bocca di tutti nel villaggio! Devi sentire questa!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: ¿Cómo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: Come?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: ¡La gente de la aldea recoge todos los trastos que encuentra y los tira aquí sin más!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: Everyone in the settlement gathers up all the junk they find and just dumps it here as they please!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: Gli abitanti del villaggio raccolgono ogni cianfrusaglia che trovano e la buttano qui e basta!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: Les he dicho que al menos los ordenen correctamente, pero nadie me escucha. ¿Acaso no les importa cómo me siento organizando todo esto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: I tell them to at least sort it properly, but nobody listens! Do they not care how I feel having to manage all of this?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: Ho detto loro di metterle almeno in ordine, ma nessuno mi ascolta. Non gli importa proprio di come mi sento mentre metto tutto in ordine?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: Ah, mmm...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: Uh, umm ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: Ah, ehm...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: Puf... Estoy hasta la coronilla. A saber cuándo voy a terminar de limpiar este desastre...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: *Sigh* I'm sick of it. Who knows when I'll finish cleaning up this mess ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: Uff... Ne ho fin sopra i capelli. Chissa' quando finiro' di ripulire questo disastro...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: Mmm... ¿Quieres que te ayudemos a limpiarlo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: Umm ... Would you like us to help you clean up?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: Mmm... Vuoi che ti aiutiamo a ripulire?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: ¡¿Lo dices en serio?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: You mean it?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: Dici sul serio?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: ¡S-sí! Es verdad que parece mucho trabajo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: Y-yes! It does seem like a lot of work ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: S-si'! In effetti sembra un bel po' di lavoro...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: ¿Cómo? ¿Por qué tenemos que ponernos a recoger basura?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: What? Why do we gotta pick up trash?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: Come? Perche' dovremmo metterci a raccogliere spazzatura?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: ¡Si es lo que queréis, haced lo que veáis, pero yo me piro!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: If that's what you wanna do, then go ahead, but I'm leavin'!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: Se e' quello che volete, fate pure come vi pare, ma io me ne vado!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: ¡Eh, espera, Rutger!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: Hey, wait! Rutger!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: Ehi, aspetta, Rutger!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: Los objetos que hay por aquí no se clasifican como «basura».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: The items here do not classify as "trash."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: Gli oggetti qui intorno non si possono classificare come "spazzatura".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: Una búsqueda preliminar determina que no solo hay materiales de la civilización pasada, sino también artículos y recursos de valor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: A preliminary search detects not only materials from the past civilization, but also valuable items and resources.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: Una ricerca preliminare indica che non ci sono solo materiali della civilta' passata, ma anche oggetti e risorse di valore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: A cambio de nuestra ayuda, ¿podemos quedarnos con las cosas que no necesites?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: In exchange for helping out, can we keep anything we find that you don't need?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: In cambio del nostro aiuto, possiamo tenere le cose che non ti servono?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: Sí, por supuesto. ¡Eso facilitaría mucho la limpieza!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: Yes, of course. If anything, that would just make cleaning up easier!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: Si', certo. Cosi' sara' molto piu' facile ripulire!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: ¡Haberlo dicho desde el principio!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: You should've said that from the start!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: Bastava dirlo fin dall'inizio!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: ¿Sabéis qué? A veces sí que sienta bien ayudar a la gente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: Rutger ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: Sapete una cosa? A volte dare una mano fa proprio bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: Sí que sabes cómo tratar con él.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: You know, it just feels good to help people sometimes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: Sai proprio come prenderlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: ¿A qué te refieres? Flammi solo ha proporcionado información que se consideraba de valor para todos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: You sure know how to handle him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: Che intendi? Flammi si e' limitato a fornire informazioni ritenute utili a tutti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: Ji, ji. Bueno, manos a la obra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: What are you talking about? Flammi simply provided information that was deemed to be of value to everyone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: Eh, eh. Bene, mettiamoci al lavoro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.src: ¡Oye, no os quedéis ahí plantados! ¡Vamos al lío!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.ref: *Chuckle* Let's go with that then.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_060c.dst: Ehi, non restate li' impalati! Diamoci da fare!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.src: Fiu, no sé cómo, pero lo hemos logrado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.dst: Uff, non so come, ma ce l'abbiamo fatta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.ref: Is everyone all right? What happened?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.dst: State tutti bene? Che e' successo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.src: Ya veo... Ha sido culpa mía, por perderos de vista. Lo siento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.ref: ... I see. It was my fault for not keeping an eye on you. I'm sorry.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.dst: Capisco... E' colpa mia, non vi ho tenuti d'occhio. Mi dispiace.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.src: Si no hubierais estado aquí, no habríamos salido con vida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.ref: If you all hadn't been here, we wouldn't have made it through safely.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.dst: Se non foste stati qui, non ce l'avremmo fatta a uscirne sani e salvi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.src: Estos valientes guerreros se han ganado mi respeto... Gracias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.ref: I have great respect for you courageous warriors ... Thank you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.dst: Questi valorosi guerrieri si sono guadagnati il mio rispetto... Grazie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.src: Me alegro de que todo el mundo esté sano y salvo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.dst: Sono solo felice che stiano tutti bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.src: Tenemos que recompensar vuestra cortesía. Así es el orgullo de los Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.ref: Courtesy must be repaid. Such is the pride of the Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.dst: La cortesia va ricambiata. E' l'orgoglio dei Wellek.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.src: Ah, eso es parte de vuestra cultura...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.ref: So that's part of your culture ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.dst: Quindi fa parte della vostra cultura...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.src: No sé nada sobre los Welleks. Si no os importa... ¿podríais enseñarme más?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.ref: I don't know anything about Welleks. If it's all right ... could you please teach me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.dst: Non so nulla dei Wellek. Se non vi dispiace... potreste parlarmene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.src: Ya que tenéis que recompensar nuestra cortesía, ¿puedo pediros un favor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.ref: If courtesy must be repaid, then could I ask you for a favor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.dst: Se dobbiamo ricambiare la vostra cortesia, posso chiedervi un favore?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.src: Como parte de nuestra investigación, me gustaría que nos enseñaseis más sobre los Welleks y vuestra cultura.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.ref: As part of our investigation, I want you to teach me more about the Welleks and your culture.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.dst: Come parte della nostra indagine, vorrei che mi parlaste dei Wellek e della vostra cultura.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.src: Si es lo que queréis... Este es el lugar perfecto para eso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.ref: ... If that's what you wish, then this is the perfect place.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.dst: Se e' cio' che desiderate... questo e' il posto perfetto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.src: Venid conmigo. Os enseñaré lo que queráis saber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.ref: Come with me. I will teach you what you wish to know.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.dst: Venite con me. Vi insegnero' cio' che desiderate sapere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.ref: Is it okay for us to go inside?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.src: Ya te lo he dicho. Tenemos que recompensar vuestra cortesía. Por mucho que seáis forasteros, las costumbres son las costumbres.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.ref: I told you. Courtesy must be repaid. Outsiders or not, this custom remains true.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070a.dst: Te l'ho gia' detto. Dobbiamo ripagare la vostra cortesia. Per quanto siate forestieri, le usanze sono le usanze.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.src: Ya están terminadas. Espero que sean de vuestro agrado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.ref: They're finished. I hope you like them ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.dst: Sono finite. Spero che siano di vostro gradimento...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.src: Siento haberos hecho esperar. Seguro que cumplen vuestras expectativas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.ref: Sorry to keep you waiting. I'm sure you'll find them satisfactory.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.dst: Scusate per l'attesa. Sicuramente soddisferanno le vostre aspettative.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.src: Pues están bien hechas... Parecen hasta más robustas que antes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.ref: It's well-made ... It seems even more sturdy than before.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.dst: Sono fatte bene... Sembrano addirittura piu' robuste di prima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.src: Sí y son más fáciles de sujetar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.ref: Yes, and they're easy to grasp too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.dst: Si', e sono piu' facili da impugnare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.src: Sí, es que pensé que debía centrarme en que fueran robustas y fáciles de usar. Como las últimas se rompieron...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.ref: Well, I figured I'd focus on ease of use and sturdiness, since the last ones broke ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.dst: Si', ho pensato di concentrarmi su robustezza e praticita'. Visto che le ultime si sono rotte...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.ref: How are they? Do you like them?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.src: Sí... Parece que os hemos subestimado. Os damos las gracias, humanos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.ref: ... Yes. It seems we underestimated your skills. You have our thanks, humans.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.dst: Si'... Sembra che vi abbiamo sottostimato. Vi ringraziamo, umani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.src: Me alegro de que os gusten.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.ref: ... Um, excuse me. Can I ask you something?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.dst: Uhm... Scusa, posso farvi una domanda?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.src: ¿Por qué tenéis problemas con las Neru? ¿Qué ha pasado entre vosotros?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.ref: Why are you fighting with the Neru? What happened between you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.dst: Perche' avete problemi con le Neru? Cosa e' successo tra voi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.src: Sí, nos gustaría saberlo, como parte de la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.ref: Yes, we would like to know, as part of our investigation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.dst: Si', vorremmo saperlo, come parte dell'indagine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.src: No conocemos todos los detalles, pero os contaremos lo que sabemos. Hablemos en otro lugar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.ref: We don't know all of the details, but we will tell you what we can. Let's talk elsewhere.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070b.dst: Non conosciamo tutti i dettagli, ma vi racconteremo quello che sappiamo. Parliamo altrove.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: Los tres anillos de antes y una copa de oro. Y aquí están las monedas de esa caja, con un collar y...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: The three rings from earlier and a gold cup. Then there's the coins from that box, along with the necklace and—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: I tre anelli di prima e una coppa d'oro. E qui ci sono le monete di quella scatola, con una collana e...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: Rutger, espero que no te creas que todo lo que hemos encontrado es para ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: Rutger, I hope you're not thinking that everything we found is yours alone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Rutger, spero che non pensi che tutto quello che abbiamo trovato sia solo per te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: Rutger tiene la costumbre de recoger artículos de valor sin informar a los demás durante las exploraciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: Rutger has a habit of collecting valuables without informing the others during explorations.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Rutger ha l'abitudine di raccogliere oggetti di valore senza avvisare gli altri durante le esplorazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: ¿Estás de broma? ¿En serio, Rutger?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: Are you kidding me? Seriously, Rutger ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Stai scherzando? Davvero, Rutger...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: Escucha, Rutger. Tienes que entregar las cosas al equipo de investigación antes de poder reclamarlas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: Listen here, Rutger. You have to submit things to the Research Team before you claim them for yourself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Sentiti, Rutger. Devi consegnare le cose alla Squadra di Ricerca prima di rivendicarle per te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: ¿Mmm? Me pregunto qué será esto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: Hm? I wonder what this is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Mh? Mi chiedo cosa sia questa cosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: (¿Será algún tipo de dispositivo? Parece que hay fragmentos rotos por todas partes...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: (Some kind of device, maybe? Seems like there are broken parts everywhere ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: (Sara' una specie di congegno? Sembra ci siano frammenti rotti dappertutto...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: Flammi, ¿sabes algo de esto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: Flammi, do you know anything about this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Flammi, ne sai qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: Nombre: Procella. No se ha encontrado más información.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: ... Name: Procella. No further information found.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Nome: Procella. Nessuna altra informazione trovata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: ¿Qué te pasa, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: What's wrong, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Che c'e', Yumia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: Anda, es...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: Oh, that's ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: ¿Lo habías visto alguna vez, Nina?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: Have you seen this before, Nina?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: L'avevi mai visto prima, Nina?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: No realmente... Pero me puedo hacer una idea de lo que es.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: ... No, I can't say that I have. But I can make a good guess at what it is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Non proprio... Ma riesco a farmi un'idea di cosa sia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: Por ejemplo... Mirad esto. Hay un fragmento que parece un asiento. Y una rueda grande...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: For example ... Look at this. There's a part that looks like a seat, and a big wheel ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Per esempio... Guardate questo. C'e' un frammento che sembra un sedile. E una ruota grande...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: ¿No os parece que se corresponde con algún tipo de dispositivo de transporte?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: Doesn't it look like it could be used as some kind of transportation device?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Non vi sembra che possa essere usato come una specie di mezzo di trasporto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: Parece algo... salido de un sueño.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: That sounds like, well ... something from a dream.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Sembra qualcosa... uscito da un sogno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: ¿Verdad? ¡Ver algo así en funcionamiento tiene que ser más alucinante que ver un carruaje!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: Right? Seeing something like that in motion would be more amazing than a carriage!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Vero? Vedere una cosa del genere in funzione dev'essere piu' incredibile di una carrozza!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: Ahora sí que sí. ¡Esto es el tipo de cosa que estaba esperando! Venga, arréglalo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: Now we're talkin'. Just the thing I was waitin' for! C'mon, fix it up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Adesso si' che si ragiona. E' proprio la roba che aspettavo! Dai, aggiustala.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: ¿Eh? No sé si puedo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: Huh? I don't know if I can ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Eh? Non so se ci riesco...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: Creo que la fuente de energía esta rota. Pero parece muy sofisticada, no sé si puedo hacer otra...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: The power source is broken, I think. But it looks so complicated, I'm not sure I can make another one ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Penso che la fonte di energia sia rotta. Ma sembra cosi' sofisticata che non so se riesco a farne un'altra...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: Mmm, ¿te parece bien que intente reparar esto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: Um, is it okay if I try to repair this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Uhm, ti va se provo a riparare questa cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: ¿Reparar ese trasto? Me da igual, pero ¿cómo pretendes hacerlo exactamente?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: Repair that junk? I don't really mind, but how exactly do you plan to pull that off?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Riparare quel rottame? Non mi importa, ma come pensi esattamente di riuscirci?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: Estaba pensando remplazar la pieza que alimenta el movimiento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: I was thinking I would try swapping out the part that powers the movement.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Pensavo di sostituire il pezzo che alimenta il movimento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: ¿Sabes de dónde viene? Me vendría bien encontrar piezas en alguna parte para sustituirla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: Do you know where this came from? If I could find replacement parts somewhere, that would be helpful.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Sai da dove viene? Mi farebbe comodo poter trovare pezzi di ricambio da qualche parte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: Creo que era de la Academia Hermética. No tengo ni idea de si queda algo por ahí, pero, si hay un sitio donde buscar, es ese.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: I think it was from Hermea Academy. No idea if there's anything left, but that's the place to search.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Penso fosse dell'Accademia Ermetica. Non ho idea se ne resti qualcosa, ma se c'e' un posto dove cercare, e' quello.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: Yo me ocupo de lo que queda aquí, podéis iros a buscarlo. ¡Gracias por vuestra ayuda!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: I can handle the rest of things here, so you're free to go look for it. Thanks for all the help!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Io mi occupo di cio' che resta qui, potete andare a cercarlo. Grazie per il vostro aiuto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.src: Gracias. Entonces nos vamos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.ref: Thank you. We'll be off then.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_070c.dst: Grazie. Allora andiamocene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: ¿Alguna vez has oído a hablar de la alquimia...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: ... Have you heard of "alchemy" before?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Hai mai sentito parlare di alchimia...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Mmm... Sí, he oído hablar del tema.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: Uh ... Yes. I've heard of it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Uhm... Si', ne ho sentito parlare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Como esperaba, os habéis informado bien antes de venir aquí. Pero seguro que no sabéis esto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: As expected, you haven't come to this land knowing nothing. However, you probably do not know this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Come immaginavo, vi siete informati bene prima di venire qui. Ma questo di sicuro non lo sapete.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: La alquimia es el poder prohibido que trajo la calamidad a esta tierra... La inventamos nosotros, los Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: "Alchemy," the forbidden power that brought calamity to this land ... It was originally invented by us, the Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: L'alchimia e' il potere proibito che ha portato la calamita' su questa terra... L'abbiamo inventata noi, i Welleks.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: ... Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: C-come...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: La alquimia que nosotros mismos creamos y desarrollamos se convirtió en una amenaza que sobrepasaba nuestra comprensión y asoló nuestro país.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: The alchemy we created and developed became a threat beyond our understanding and laid waste to the country.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: L'alchimia che noi stessi abbiamo creato e sviluppato e' diventata una minaccia oltre ogni nostra comprensione e ha devastato il nostro paese.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: La alquimia es un arte prohibido que retuerce la humanidad del que la practica. Cuanto más la utiliza, más se desvanece su humanidad...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: Alchemy is a forbidden art that contorts one's humanity. The more one uses it, the more their humanity fades ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: L'alchimia e' un'arte proibita che contorce l'umanita' di chi la pratica. Piu' la si utilizza, piu' la propria umanita' svanisce...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Su... humanidad...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: Their ... humanity ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: La loro... umanita'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Por eso, hemos rehuido de nuestra propia creación. Hemos eliminado los documentos, los hallazgos... Todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: That's why we've completely shunned our own creation. Documents, findings, everything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Per questo abbiamo rinnegato la nostra stessa creazione. Abbiamo eliminato documenti, scoperte... Tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Como muestra de arrepentimiento por nuestros pecados, rezamos y llevamos una vida honesta. Vivimos en base a ese código sagrado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: To repent for our sins, we offer up prayers and live an honest life. That is the ironclad code we abide by.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Come segno di pentimento per i nostri peccati, offriamo preghiere e conduciamo una vita onesta. Seguiamo fedelmente quel codice sacro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: A los Welleks también se nos conoce como «pueblo de la oración». Se dice que, hace mucho tiempo, mucha gente oraba en este mismo lugar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: We Welleks are also called a people of prayer. It is said that long ago many people once prayed here too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Noi Welleks siamo conosciuti anche come "popolo della preghiera". Si dice che, molto tempo fa, molte persone pregassero proprio in questo luogo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Ya veo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: I see ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: ... Capisco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Parece que estás aprendiendo mucho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: Seems like you're learning a lot.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Sembra che tu stia imparando molto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: ¡Cledia! ¿Has venido tú sola hasta aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: Cledia! You came all the way here by yourself?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Cledia! Sei venuta fin qui da sola?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Parece que los monstruos han desaparecido... ¿Ha ido todo bien?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: Looks like the monsters are gone ... Were there no issues?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Sembra che i mostri siano spariti... E' andato tutto bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: ¡Sí! Bueno, no... Hemos salido ligeramente heridos del combate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: Yes! Er, no ... We sustained some injuries during the fight.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Si'! Beh, no... Siamo usciti leggermente feriti dal combattimento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Volved a la aldea y tratad esas heridas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: Return to the settlement at once and get patched up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Tornate al villaggio e curate quelle ferite.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: ¡A la orden!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: Understood!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Ricevuto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Y bien...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: ... Now then.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: E allora...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: ¿Ahora qué? Nos hemos dejado la piel y hemos hecho lo que nos dijiste.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: What now? We're hard at work doing what you told us to do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: E ora? Ci siamo spezzati la schiena e abbiamo fatto quello che ci hai detto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Lo sé. Y, por ese motivo, creo que debo daros las gracias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: I know. Which is why I thought I should extend my thanks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Lo so. Ed e' proprio per questo che ho pensato di dovervi ringraziare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Ya te han hablado del código de los Welleks, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: You heard about the code of the Welleks just now, correct?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Hai gia' sentito parlare del codice dei Welleks, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: S-sí. Y pensar que fueron los Welleks los que crearon la alquimia...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: Y-yes. To think that Welleks were the ones who created alchemy ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: S-si'. E pensare che furono i Welleks a creare l'alchimia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Sin embargo, hay una cara de la historia que ni siquiera ellos conocen. He pensado que podría ofrecerte más detalles al respecto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: However, there's a part that even they do not know. I thought that I would provide you with a bit more detail.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Tuttavia, c'e' un lato della storia che nemmeno loro conoscono. Ho pensato di poterti offrire qualche dettaglio in piu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Te lo agradecería mucho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: That would be greatly appreciated.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Lo apprezzerei molto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: En la aldea Welleks, siempre hemos venerado el gran poder del maná, desde tiempos inmemoriales.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: In the Welleks settlement, we have worshiped the great power of mana since ancient times.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Nel villaggio dei Welleks veneriamo da sempre il grande potere del mana, da tempi immemorabili.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: En esta misma catedral, muchos devotos efectuaron sus rituales de rezos a la tierra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: At this very cathedral, many devout practitioners once performed prayer rituals unto the earth.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: In questa stessa cattedrale, molti devoti compivano i loro rituali di preghiera rivolti alla terra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Los miembros de esta aldea lo saben, pero solo unos pocos conocen la verdad oculta que voy a compartir con vosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: The people of the settlement know as much. But only a few know the truth I am about to share with you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Gli abitanti del villaggio lo sanno, ma solo in pochi conoscono la verita' nascosta che sto per condividere con voi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Solo unos pocos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: Only a few ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Solo in pochi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Si no comprendéis qué es lo correcto, podría ponerme en peligro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: If all of you do not understand what is right, it may prove a danger to me as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Se non capite cosa e' giusto, potrebbe rappresentare un pericolo anche per me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Hace tiempo, hubo un Welleks devoto capaz de utilizar un arte milagroso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: Once there was a devout Welleks who could use a miraculous art.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Molto tempo fa, visse un devoto Welleks capace di usare un'arte miracolosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: El poder que ostentaba excedía con creces la magia común, como la creación de fuego o viento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: The power they commanded far exceeded ordinary magic like creating fire or producing wind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Il potere che comandava superava di gran lunga la magia comune, come creare fuoco o generare vento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Su primera creación fue el «pequeño sol».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: The first thing they created was a "little sun."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: La loro prima creazione fu il "piccolo sole".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Era una luz amarilla y radiante que resistía incluso a la lluvia. La vida de nuestro pueblo cambió por completo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: A glowing yellow light that could withstand even rain. The lives of the people were changed completely.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Era una luce gialla e radiante che resisteva persino alla pioggia. La vita del nostro villaggio cambio' completamente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Ya fuera de día o de noche, la ciudad estaba iluminada por una luz brillante. En esa época, no existía la noche en Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: Day or night, the town was illuminated by a brilliant light. And so in those days, there was no night in Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Fosso giorno o notte, la citta' era illuminata da una luce brillante. In quell'epoca, ad Aladiss non esisteva la notte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Después de eso, se crearon más y más herramientas. Se corrió la voz fuera de la aldea a todo Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: After that, more and more new tools were created. Word spread outside of the settlement to all across Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: In seguito, furono creati sempre piu' strumenti. La notizia si diffuse oltre il villaggio, in tutto Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Entonces... el emperador de una pequeña nación de Aladiss empezó a creer que ese poder era su guía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: And then ... the emperor of the small nation of Aladiss came to believe that this power was his guiding light.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Allora... l'imperatore di una piccola nazione di Aladiss comincio' a credere che quel potere fosse la sua guida.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Poco a poco, el estudio de este poder pasó de las manos de los Welleks a todos los rincones del país.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: Gradually, the study of this power moved from the hands of the Welleks to all across the country.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Poco a poco, lo studio di questo potere passo' dalle mani dei Welleks a ogni angolo del paese.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Y, con el tiempo, ese «arte milagroso» se convirtió en lo que se conoce formalmente como «alquimia».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: Eventually, this "miraculous art" would be formally instituted and known as "alchemy."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: E, col tempo, quell'"arte miracolosa" divenne cio' che formalmente e' noto come "alchimia".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Los practicantes que poseían este poder especial también recibieron un nuevo nombre: «alquimistas».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: The practitioners who possessed the special power also donned a new name: alchemists.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Anche i praticanti che possedevano questo potere speciale ricevettero un nuovo nome: "alchimisti".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Ese fue el verdadero origen de la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: That is the true beginning of alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Quella fu la vera origine dell'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: No tenía ni idea de toda la historia que había detrás...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: I had no idea there was such a story behind it all ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Non avevo idea di tutta la storia che c'era dietro...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Se decidió que no se debía compartir la verdad con la gente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: It was decided that this truth would not be shared with the people.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Si decise che la verita' non doveva essere condivisa con la gente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Evitamos la alquimia, así que no pretendemos comprenderla. Y todo con el objetivo de prevenir otra calamidad. Esa es nuestra doctrina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: We avoid alchemy and do not attempt to understand it, all to prevent another calamity. That is our doctrine.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Evitiamo l'alchimia, quindi non cerchiamo di comprenderla. Tutto per prevenire un'altra calamita'. Questa e' la nostra dottrina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Gracias por compartir ese importante secreto con nosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: Thank you for sharing this important secret with us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Grazie per aver condiviso questo importante segreto con noi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Como ya os he dicho, es importante que comprendáis qué es lo correcto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: As I said before, it is best that you understand what is right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Come vi ho gia' detto, e' importante che comprendiate cosa sia giusto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Lo «correcto»... Siempre estoy pensando en lo que considero correcto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: What is "right" ... I'm also always thinking about what is right in my eyes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Il "giusto"... Sto sempre pensando a cio' che ritengo giusto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Eso es bueno... Así debe ser.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: ... That's good. As you should be.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: E' una cosa buona... Deve essere cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.src: Deberíamos volver pronto. Tengo trabajo por delante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.ref: We should head back soon. I have work I need to do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080a.dst: Dovremmo tornare presto. Ho del lavoro da fare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Hala, qué preciosidad...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: Wow, it's so beautiful ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Caspita, che meraviglia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Son Alstahlias, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: These are Alstahlia, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Sono Alstahlia, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Ah, ¿estáis familiarizados con ellas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: Oh, you're familiar with them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Oh, quindi le conoscete?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Sí, sabemos lo básico sobre ellas gracias a esta cosita de aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: Yes. I know some basic things about them thanks to this little one.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Si', conosciamo le basi su di loro grazie a questa cosetta qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Alstahlia. Una flor capaz de absorber maná de sus alrededores, autóctona de varias partes de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: Alstahlia. A flower capable of absorbing mana in its vicinity, native to various parts of Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Alstahlia. Un fiore in grado di assorbire mana dai dintorni, autoctono di varie parti di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: El maná que absorbe se convierte en un néctar que tiene un poder comparable al de la energía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: The mana it absorbs is converted into nectar which has power comparable to energy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Il mana che assorbe viene convertito in un nettare dal potere paragonabile a quello dell'energia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Para quienes vivimos aquí, el néctar de Alstahlia es el recurso más vital.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: To those who live here, Alstahlia nectar is the most vital resource of all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Per chi vive qui, il nettare di Alstahlia e' la risorsa piu' vitale di tutte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Por ejemplo, si nos lo rociamos por el cuerpo, podemos adentrarnos en las tierras prohibidas sin problemas durante un breve tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: For example, by sprinkling it on your body, you can safely walk inside of the forbidden lands for a short time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Per esempio, se ce lo spruzziamo sul corpo, possiamo addentrarci nelle terre proibite senza problemi per un breve tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Como absorben maná, también ralentizan la expansión de las tierras prohibidas. Pero eso ya no es necesario.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: By absorbing mana, they also slow the encroachment of the forbidden lands. Although, that is no longer needed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Poiche' assorbono mana, rallentano anche l'espansione delle terre proibite. Ma questo ormai non e' piu' necessario.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: El problema es que solo se puede recoger una cierta cantidad de néctar de las Alstahlias que crecen en la aldea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: The problem is, there's only so much nectar we can collect from the Alstahlia grown inside the settlement.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Il problema e' che dalle Alstahlias che crescono nel villaggio si puo' raccogliere solo una certa quantita' di nettare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Las Alstahlias silvestres crecen en las tierras prohibidas. Precisamente, luchamos contra las Neru por el acceso a su abundante néctar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: Wild Alstahlia flourish within the forbidden lands. We fight with the Neru over access to their abundant nectar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Le Alstahlias selvatiche prosperano nelle terre proibite. Ci scontriamo con le Neru per accedere al loro abbondante nettare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Las Neru mutaron repentinamente de monstruos, pero solo se asemejan en apariencia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: The Neru suddenly mutated from monsters, but they are alike only in appearance.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Le Neru sono mutate all'improvviso a partire dai mostri, ma si somigliano solo nell'aspetto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Tienen raciocinio, a diferencia de otros monstruos. Las tierras prohibidas tienen efectos negativos en la mente de seres como esos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: They have reason, unlike other monsters. The forbidden lands have negative effects on the minds of such beings.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Hanno capacita' di ragionare, a differenza degli altri mostri. Le terre proibite hanno effetti negativi sulla mente di esseri come loro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Ninguno de nosotros puede soportar el acceso a las tierras prohibidas sin néctar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: Neither of us can withstand entering the forbidden lands without nectar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Nessuno di noi puo' sopportare di entrare nelle terre proibite senza nettare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: En resumen, nuestro enfrentamiento radica en una lucha por recursos limitados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: So this confrontation boils down to a struggle over limited resources.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: In sostanza, il nostro scontro si riduce a una lotta per risorse limitate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: ¿Mutaron de forma repentina? ¿Y son las únicas a las que les ha pasado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: They suddenly mutated? Are they the only ones like that?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Sono mutate all'improvviso? E' successo solo a loro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: No sabría decirte... Sabemos muy poco sobre ellas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: I can't say ... We know little about them ourselves.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Non saprei... Anche noi sappiamo ben poco su di loro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Tiene sentido, teniendo en cuenta que sois enemigos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: Given that they are enemies, that makes sense.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Ha senso, considerando che siete nemici.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Tendremos que profundizar más en el asunto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: We'll have to look into the matter ourselves.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Dovremo indagare sulla questione di persona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Pues sí. Pero, basándonos en lo que sabemos por el momento, creo que todo esto guarda relación con ese tipo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: That's right. But judging from what we've learned so far, I feel this may be connected to that guy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Gia'. Ma da quello che abbiamo scoperto finora, credo che tutto questo sia collegato a quel tizio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Pero no dejo de preguntarme una cosa...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: There's one thing I'm still wondering about ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: C'e' una cosa che continuo a chiedermi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Si se despejasen todas las zonas de vínculo de maná, el problema se resolvería, ¿no? No habría motivos para luchar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: If all the manabound areas were cleared up, the problem would be solved, right? There would be no need to fight.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Se liberassimo tutte le zone sature di mana, risolveremmo il problema, no? Non ci sarebbe bisogno di combattere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: El néctar no solo sirve para explorar las tierras prohibidas. Es casi tan importante para nuestra vida diaria como el agua.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: The nectar isn't just for exploring the forbidden lands. It is almost as important to our everyday lives as water.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Il nettare non serve solo a esplorare le terre proibite. E' quasi importante per la nostra vita quotidiana quanto l'acqua.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Además... este conflicto ha sobrepasado lo razonable. Los sentimientos negativos que le profesamos al otro están muy arraigados y no van a desaparecer así sin más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: Besides ... this conflict has progressed beyond reason. Our deep-rooted feelings won't just go away.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Inoltre... questo conflitto e' ormai andato oltre ogni ragione. I sentimenti che nutriamo da tempo non spariranno cosi', da un momento all'altro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: La tristeza, el rencor, el odio... Se ha ido acumulando un sinfín de emociones y recuerdos oscuros a lo largo de los años.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: Sadness, resentment, hatred ... An endless pile of bitter memories and emotions has built up over the years.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Tristezza, risentimento, odio... Nel corso degli anni si sono accumulati infiniti ricordi amari ed emozioni dolorose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: No podríamos olvidarlo ni aunque quisiéramos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: We can never forget, not even if we wanted to.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Non potremmo mai dimenticare, nemmeno volendo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Mientras sobre nuestros hombros pesen los recuerdos del pasado, este conflicto no se resolverá.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: As long as we shoulder the heavy weight of these memories, this conflict will never be settled so easily.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Finche' porteremo sulle spalle il peso dei ricordi del passato, questo conflitto non si risolvera'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Lo más probable es que la lucha continúe hasta que solo quede un bando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: This fight will likely rage on until only one side remains.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: E' probabile che questa lotta continui finche' non restera' una sola fazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Esa es la pesada carga de los recuerdos, ¿eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: The heavy weight of memories, huh ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Il pesante fardello dei ricordi, eh...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: Un ser mutado... Me pregunto si Vésper también es algo así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: A mutated being ... I wonder if that's what Vesper is too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Un essere mutato... Mi chiedo se anche Ve'sper sia qualcosa del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.src: No tengo ni idea. Pero merece la pena investigarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.ref: I have no idea. But it seems to be worth looking into.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080b.dst: Non ne ho idea. Ma vale la pena indagare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.src: Yumia, ¿es esa la pieza que buscabas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.ref: Yumia, is that the part you were searching for?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.dst: Yumia, e' questo il pezzo che cercavi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.src: Pero no me sirve... No entiendo cómo funciona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.ref: ... But it's no good. I just don't understand how it works.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.dst: Ma non mi serve a niente... Non capisco come funziona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.src: Creo que nos va a costar instalarla correctamente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.ref: I think it'll be hard to install this properly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.dst: Credo che sara' difficile installarla correttamente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.ref: Hold on now. I'm not finished.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.src: Solo tengo que encontrar la manera de trabajar con esto. Estoy intentando hacer algunas modificaciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.ref: I just need to be able to work with this, so I'll try making some modifications.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.dst: Devo solo trovare il modo di lavorarci. Sto cercando di apportare qualche modifica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.src: Si podías hacerlo, haberlo dicho desde el principio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.ref: ... If you can do it, just say so from the start.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.dst: Se potevi farlo, potevi dirlo subito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.src: ¡Lo estaba intentando antes de que me interrumpieras!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.ref: I tried before you interrupted me!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.dst: Ci stavo provando prima che mi interrompessi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.src: Flammi, ¿tienes algún consejo? ¿Qué crees que puedo hacer con esto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.ref: Flammi, give me some advice. What do you think I should do with this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.dst: Flammi, hai qualche consiglio? Cosa pensi che possa farci?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.src: Los demás informes de Flammi no incluyen información sobre este tipo de dispositivo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.ref: Flammi's remaining records do not contain information on this type of device.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.dst: Gli altri rapporti di Flammi non contengono informazioni su questo tipo di dispositivo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.src: Sin embargo, si se usan herramientas con forma similar como referencia para compensar las zonas de dudosa construcción...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.ref: However, by using similarly-shaped tools as reference to compensate for areas of uncertain construction ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.dst: Tuttavia, se si usano come riferimento strumenti dalla forma simile per compensare le parti dalla struttura incerta...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.src: Después de todo, crear cosas es su especialidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.ref: Making things is her specialty, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_080c.dst: In fondo, creare cose e' la sua specialita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: Esto por aquí... ¿Se supone que esta cosa conecta con esa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.ref: Do this here ... Is this supposed to connect here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Da questa parte... Questa cosa dovrebbe collegarsi a quella?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: Yumia, has cometido el mismo error dos veces. Esa pieza va aquí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.ref: Yumia, you have made the same mistake twice now. That part goes here ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Yumia, hai commesso lo stesso errore due volte. Quel pezzo va qui...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: ¡Fiu! ¡Ya está listo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Fiu'! E' pronto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: ¡No puede ser! ¿Esto es el mismo montón de chatarra de antes?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.ref: No way! This is the same pile of junk from earlier ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Non ci credo! E' lo stesso rottame di prima?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: Está irreconocible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: E' irriconoscibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: ¿Este cacharro se mueve o qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Questo aggeggio si muove o cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: Bueno, necesita un toque final.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.ref: Well, it needs a finishing touch.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Beh, manca solo il tocco finale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: ¡Flammi, te toca!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Flammi, tocca a te!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: No entendía del todo cómo funcionaba la potencia, así que lo he modificado para que funcione con Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.ref: I didn't really understand how the power worked, so I modified it to run through Flammi instead.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Non avevo capito bene come funzionasse l'alimentazione, cosi' l'ho modificato perche' funzionasse con Flammi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: P-pero ¿eso va a funcionar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: M-ma funzionera' davvero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: No pasa nada, Isla. Flammi es una asistente autómata especializada en la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.ref: There is no problem, Isla. Flammi is a super-high-spec independent survey-assistance device.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Non preoccuparti, Isla. Flammi e' un'assistente automatizzata specializzata nella ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: No importa el trabajo que se me encomiende, lo ejecutaré a la perfección.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.ref: No matter the job, it will be executed perfectly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Qualunque compito mi venga affidato, lo eseguiro' alla perfezione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: Ji, ji, me parece una idea divertidísima.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Eheh, mi sembra un'idea divertentissima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: A ver... ¡Vamos a intentar mover esta cosa!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.ref: ... All right. Then let's try moving this thing!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Vediamo... Proviamo a far muovere questa cosa!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: ¡Arre!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Vai!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: Cuando quieras, Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Quando vuoi, Flammi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: A la orden. Activando el dispositivo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Ricevuto. Attivazione del dispositivo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: ¡Hala!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Accidenti!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: ¡Qué emoción!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.ref: Umm, now what was I supposed to do again?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Che emozione!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: Mmm, ¿qué se supone que tenía que hacer yo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Mmm, che cosa dovevo fare io?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: Ah, sí, coger esto y...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Ah, gia', prendere questo e...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: ¿Cómo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Come?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: ¿Eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: ¡AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: Allá va...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.ref: ... I'm glad I didn't ask to ride it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Eccola che va...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: Me alegro de no haberme montado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.ref: Isn't there a normal speed that's fit for people?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Meno male che non ci sono salita...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: ¡¿No tiene una velocidad normal apta para personas?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.ref: As a perfect assistance device, Flammi merely sought to perform the task to its ideal standard.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Non ha una velocita' normale adatta alle persone?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: Como dispositivo de asistencia perfecto, Flammi se ha limitado a cumplimentar la tarea de acuerdo con su estándar ideal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.ref: The problem lies with Yumia for being unable to maintain control over—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: In quanto dispositivo di assistenza perfetto, Flammi si e' limitata a svolgere il compito secondo il suo standard ideale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: El problema es que Yumia no es capaz de mantener el control de...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.ref: No it doesn't! There's no way anyone could control that thing, dummy!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Il problema e' che Yumia non riesce a mantenere il controllo di...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: ¡No es verdad! ¡No hay manera de controlar esa cosa, boba!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Non e' vero! Non c'e' modo di controllare quella cosa, stupida!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: ¿Sigues con vida?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Sei ancora viva?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: Por los pelos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.ref: I adjusted the speed. This time it should actually be rideable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Per un pelo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: He ajustado la velocidad. Esta vez debería ser manejable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.ref: This must be why alchemy is taboo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Ho regolato la velocita'. Stavolta dovrebbe essere gestibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: Seguro que por eso es tabú la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.ref: I can't really say you're wrong in this situation ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Sara' per questo che l'alchimia e' un tabu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: No puedo llevarte la contraria, la verdad...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: Non posso darti torto, a dire il vero...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.src: ¡AAAAAAAAH!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_090c.dst: AAAAAAH!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Cledia, ¿tienes algo que hacer por aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: Cledia. You have business here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Cledia, hai qualcosa da fare qui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Más o menos. Disculpa la intromisión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: Of sorts. Sorry for the intrusion.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Piu' o meno. Scusate l'intrusione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Después de haber dado luz verde a la investigación, lo correcto es venir a ver cómo es la base de operaciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: After giving permission for the investigation, it's only proper that I come see what the base of operations is like.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Dopo aver dato il via libera alle indagini, e' giusto che venga a vedere com'e' la base operativa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Dicho esto...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: That being said ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Detto questo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: La gente de la aldea está empezando a aceptaros, aunque puede que le cueste un tiempo confiar en vosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: The people at our settlement are beginning to at least accept you, although "trust" may still be a ways away.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: La gente del nostro insediamento sta cominciando almeno ad accettarvi, anche se forse ci vorra' ancora un po' prima che si fidi di voi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: He decidido que nos interesaría seguir cooperando con el equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: I have decided that it would be in our interest to continue cooperating with the Research Team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Ho deciso che sarebbe nel nostro interesse continuare a collaborare con la Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Solo hemos hecho lo que consideramos correcto, pero me alegro de que empiecen a aceptarnos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: We only did what felt right, but I'm glad that we're starting to be accepted.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Abbiamo solo fatto cio' che ci sembrava giusto, ma sono felice che stiano iniziando ad accettarci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Me imagino que os habéis ganado su favor con palabras como esas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: I imagine words like that are what caused everyone to welcome you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Immagino che vi siate guadagnati il loro favore con parole come quelle.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: A nosotros también nos gustaría mantener una relación beneficiosa para ambas partes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: We too would like to maintain a mutually beneficial relationship.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Anche noi vorremmo mantenere una relazione vantaggiosa per entrambe le parti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Ya, pienso lo mismo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: Yes, I feel the same.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Gia', la penso allo stesso modo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Aun así...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: Still ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Eppure...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Vosotros cinco formáis un grupo bastante extraño.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: You five are somewhat of a strange group.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Voi cinque formate un gruppo piuttosto strano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: ¿Extraño?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: Strange?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Strano?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Sí. No estoy familiarizada con vuestras costumbres, así que es más una cuestión de intuición, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: Yes. I can't say I'm familiar with your ways, so I can only speak from my own intuition, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Si'. Non ho dimestichezza con le vostre usanze, quindi e' piu' che altro una questione di intuizione, ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Yumia, Rutger y Nina me dais una impresión distinta que el resto del grupo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: Yumia, Rutger, Nina. The three of you in particular strike me as different from the other members.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Yumia, Rutger e Nina mi trasmettete un'impressione diversa dal resto del gruppo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: ¿Distinta? ¿En qué sentido?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: Different in what way?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Diversi? In che senso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: En el caso de Yumia, creo que se debe a su extraordinaria habilidad para manipular el maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: In Yumia's case, I'm sure this feeling comes from your extraordinary ability to manipulate mana.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Nel caso di Yumia, credo che dipenda dalla sua straordinaria abilita' nel manipolare il mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: ¿Y qué pasa con Nina y Rutger?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: ... What about Nina and Rutger then?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: E invece Nina e Rutger?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Sí, en vuestro caso...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: Yes, in your case ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Si', nel vostro caso...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: En vuestro caso, parece que hay algún problema relacionado con vuestra alma. Pero no tengo claro qué es...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: In your case, there seems to be a problem with your soul. Although I don't know the details ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Nel vostro caso, sembra che ci sia un problema legato alla vostra anima. Anche se non ne conosco i dettagli...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Tú...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: You ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Tu...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Los Welleks tenemos un sentido agudo para el maná. A veces incluso puedo intuir vuestras circunstancias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: Welleks have a keen sense for mana. It even allows me to somewhat sense your situation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Noi Welleks abbiamo un senso acuto per il mana. A volte mi permette persino di intuire le vostre circostanze.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Sin embargo, se diría que no os preocupa. ¿Quizá ya las habéis aceptado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: However, you don't seem troubled by it. Perhaps you've already accepted it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Tuttavia, non sembrate esserne turbati. Forse le avete gia' accettate?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Yo paso de esto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: I'm done here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Io ho finito qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: L-lo siento, pero ¿a qué te refieres con eso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: I-I'm sorry. What were you talking about just now?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: M-mi dispiace, ma a cosa ti riferisci?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Los seres vivientes almacenan infinidad de recuerdos en su paso por la vida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: Living things collect countless memories as they move through life.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Gli esseri viventi accumulano innumerevoli ricordi nel loro cammino attraverso la vita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Se acumulan como gotas en un vaso bajo la lluvia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: They accumulate like droplets in a cup held out in the rain.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Si accumulano come gocce in un bicchiere tenuto sotto la pioggia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Con el tiempo, esas gotas de recuerdos se acumulan como un mar en una vasija, que nutre y define la mente y el alma de una persona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: Soon the droplets of memory form a sea in the cup that nurtures and shapes a person's mind and soul.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Col tempo, quelle gocce di ricordi si accumulano come un mare in un vaso, che nutre e modella la mente e l'anima di una persona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Esa vasija es lo que llamamos «contenedor del alma».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: We call that cup a soul vessel.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Questo vaso e' cio' che chiamiamo "recipiente dell'anima".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Y... ¿cuál es el problema?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: So ... what's the problem?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: E quindi... qual e' il problema?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Es como contemplar un corazón herido. Quizá algo de su pasado interfirió en su alma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: It's like looking upon a wounded heart. Perhaps something in his past meddled with his soul.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: E' come contemplare un cuore ferito. Forse qualcosa del suo passato ha interferito con la sua anima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Pero no es algo en lo que debamos husmear.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: But that is not something for others to pry into.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Ma non e' qualcosa in cui dovremmo ficcare il naso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Nunca habla de sí mismo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: ... He never talks about himself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Non parla mai di se'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: A lo mejor significa que necesita lidiar con sus propios asuntos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: That might mean he has his own things to grapple with.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Forse significa che ha questioni sue da affrontare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: ¿Y qué hay de Nina?... ¿Quieres decir que su caso es el mismo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: ... And what about Nina? Are you saying she's the same?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: E Nina?... Vuoi dire che il suo caso e' lo stesso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: No. En todo caso, es lo contrario. Su maná fluye casi a la perfección.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: No, if anything it's the opposite. Her mana flows nearly perfectly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: No. Semmai, e' il contrario. Il suo mana scorre quasi alla perfezione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Parece que tienes control absoluto sobre tu mente. ¿Dominas algún tipo de artes marciales?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: You seem to have complete control over your mind. Are you a master of some martial art?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Sembra che tu abbia il controllo assoluto sulla tua mente. Padroneggi qualche arte marziale?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Hay muchos mercenarios que manejan mejor que yo la espada y las armas de fuego.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: There are plenty of mercenaries more skilled than me with both swords and guns.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Ci sono molti mercenari piu' abili di me sia con la spada che con le armi da fuoco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Entonces, ¿hay algo más?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: Then, is there something else ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Allora, c'e' qualcos'altro?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: A ver... ¡Soy capaz de quedarme dormida en cualquier parte en cinco segundos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: ...! I can fall asleep anywhere in five seconds flat!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Vabbe'... Riesco ad addormentarmi ovunque in cinque secondi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Pues yo lo hago en tres.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: I can do it in three.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: E io lo faccio in tre.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Esto no es una competición.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: It's not a competition.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Questa non e' una competizione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: Sí que sois un grupo peculiar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: You truly are a strange group.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: Siete davvero un gruppo singolare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..src: (¿Qué te pasó, Rutger? A lo mejor Erhard sabe algo.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..ref: (Rutger, what happened to you? Maybe Erhard knows something.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_100..dst: (Cosa ti e' successo, Rutger? Forse Erhard sa qualcosa.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: Mmm, perdona, Erhard. Me gustaría hacerte una pregunta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: Um, excuse me, Erhard? I have something I want to ask you about.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Ehm, scusa, Erhard. Vorrei farti una domanda.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: Ya veo... Quieres saber más sobre el pasado de Rutger, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: ... I see. And so now you want to know more about Rutger's past.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Capisco... Vuoi saperne di piu' sul passato di Rutger, vero?
