eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: Sí. Parece que no quiere hablar del tema, pero no puedo parar de darle vueltas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: Yes. He seems to not want to get into it, but it's really been bugging me ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Si'. Sembra che non voglia parlarne, ma non smetto di pensarci...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: Puede que tengas que saberlo, ya que eres alquimista y todo eso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: It's something you may need to know, being an alchemist and all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: E' una cosa che forse devi sapere, visto che sei un'alchimista e tutto quanto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: Rutger se crio en un orfanato en una zona muy pobre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: ... Rutger grew up as an orphan in an impoverished area.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Rutger e' cresciuto in un orfanotrofio in una zona molto povera.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: De pequeño, no tenía a nadie en quien confiar, así que necesitaba ganar dinero para sobrevivir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: Being a child without anyone else to rely on, he of course needed a way to earn money in order to survive.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Da bambino non aveva nessuno su cui contare, quindi ovviamente aveva bisogno di guadagnare soldi per sopravvivere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: Decidió vender sus recuerdos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: So, he decided to sell his memories.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Cosi' decise di vendere i suoi ricordi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: ¿Vender sus... recuerdos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: ... Sell his memories?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Vendere i suoi... ricordi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: Había un comerciante del mercado negro que usaba una técnica desconocida y «compraba» recuerdos poco comunes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: There was a black market broker who used an unknown technique. They would "buy" uncommon memories.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: C'era un commerciante del mercato nero che usava una tecnica sconosciuta e "comprava" ricordi poco comuni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: Una técnica desconocida...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: An unknown technique ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Una tecnica sconosciuta...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: La Orden de Eustella sigue buscando pistas para dar con ese comerciante, pero aún no hemos descubierto nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: Even now, the Order of Eustella is searching for clues leading to this broker. But we've yet to uncover anything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Ancora oggi, l'Ordine di Eustella cerca indizi per trovare quel commerciante, ma non abbiamo ancora scoperto nulla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: Al fin y al cabo, los recuerdos de toda la gente que trató con este comerciante se vieron afectados. Rutger es uno de ellos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: After all, anyone involved with this broker had their memories tampered with. Rutger is one such person.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Dopotutto, chiunque abbia trattato con quel commerciante ha avuto i ricordi manomessi. Rutger e' uno di questi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: Pensar que no tuvo más remedio que vender sus recuerdos... es horrible...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: To think he had to resort to selling his memories ... How horrible ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Pensare che non abbia avuto altra scelta che vendere i suoi ricordi... che orrore...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: Como te imaginarás, Rutger ha tenido su dosis de... adversidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: Well, as you might expect, Rutger had his share of ... hardships.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Come puoi immaginare, Rutger ha avuto la sua dose di... avversita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: Desde entonces, ha sufrido dolores de cabeza y alucinaciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: Since then, he's suffered from headaches and hallucinations.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Da allora, ha sofferto di mal di testa e allucinazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: ¿Crees que esa técnica desconocida de la que me has hablado... es alquimia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: That unknown technique you spoke of ... Do you think it was alchemy?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Pensi che quella tecnica sconosciuta di cui mi hai parlato... sia alchimia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: Pues... ¿quién sabe?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: ... Who's to say.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Mah... chi puo' dirlo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: Si quieres saber más, deberías preguntarle a Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: If you want to know any more, you should ask Rutger himself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Se vuoi saperne di piu', dovresti chiedere direttamente a Rutger.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: No sé yo si querrá hablar del tema...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: I wonder if he'd talk about it ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Non so se vorra' parlarne...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: Eso es decisión de Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: That's something only Rutger can decide.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Questa e' una decisione che spetta solo a Rutger.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: Lo que sí te digo es que, aunque tampoco lo llamaría huraño, le cuesta confiar en los demás desde hace mucho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: I will say, I don't know if I'd call him awkward exactly, but he's struggled with relying on others since long ago.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Posso dire che, anche se non lo chiamerei proprio scontroso, gli e' sempre costato fidarsi degli altri da molto tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: A lo mejor solo le hace falta un empujoncito.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: A little push may be just what he needs.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Forse gli serve solo una piccola spinta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: Perdona que te pida esto, pero ¿podrías estar pendiente de él?... Es como un hijo para mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: Sorry to ask you this, but please keep an eye on him ... He's like a son to me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Scusa se te lo chiedo, ma potresti tenerlo d'occhio?... E' come un figlio per me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: Por supuesto...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: ... Of course.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Certo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: ¿Qué puedo hacer?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: What can I do ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Cosa posso fare?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..src: Intentaré hablar con él.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..ref: I'll try to speak with him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_101..dst: Cerchero' di parlare con lui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Hola, Rutger...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: Hey, Rutger ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Ciao, Rutger...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Erhard me ha hablado un poco de ti. No me lo podía quitar de la cabeza. Perdona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: Erhard told me a little bit about you. I just couldn't get it off my mind. I'm sorry.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Erhard mi ha parlato un po' di te. Non riuscivo a togliermelo dalla testa. Scusa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Maldito viejo, no se puede callar la boca.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: That damn old man, runnin' his mouth.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Maledetto vecchio, non sa tenere la bocca chiusa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: ¿Podrías contarme qué paso exactamente? A lo mejor podría ayudarte de alguna...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: Could you tell me what happened exactly? Maybe I could help in some—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Potresti raccontarmi cosa e' successo esattamente? Magari potrei aiutarti in qualche...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: No, no puedes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: No, you can't.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: No, non puoi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Pero habría más probabilidades de solucionarlo que si lo gestionas tú solo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: I think there would be better odds than trying to solve it alone, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Ma ci sarebbero piu' probabilita' di risolverlo che se te la gestisci da solo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: No te rindes, ¿eh? Apenas nos conocemos. ¿Por qué tienes tantas ganas de entrometerte?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: You just don't give up. We're strangers, right? Why try so hard to get involved?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Non ti arrendi, eh? Ci conosciamo a malapena. Perche' hai cosi' voglia di immischiarti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Porque creo que es lo correcto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: I feel like it's the right thing to do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Perche' credo sia la cosa giusta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Ah, ya, «lo correcto».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: Hah. The "right thing," huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Ah, gia', "la cosa giusta".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Sé que mi madre no se habría quedado de brazos cruzados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: I know my mom wouldn't have just sat by idly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: So che mia madre non sarebbe rimasta con le mani in mano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Eso es lo que se conoce como meterse donde no te llaman.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: That's called unnecessary meddlin'.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Quello si chiama ficcare il naso negli affari degli altri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: ¿Y por qué dices que apenas nos conocemos? ¡Llevamos todo este tiempo trabajando juntos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: And you say we're strangers, but we've been working together all this time!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: E perche' dici che ci conosciamo a malapena? E' tutto questo tempo che lavoriamo insieme!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: No ha sido tanto tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: It hasn't actually been that long.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Non e' passato cosi' tanto tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Los Welleks nos han mirado con la boca abierta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: We were gawked at by the Welleks together.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: I Welleks ci hanno guardato a bocca aperta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Yo tampoco diría que eso fuera algo bueno...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: That was hardly a good thing ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Anch'io non direi che quella fosse una cosa buona...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Vale, lo pillo. Hablaré, pero solo para que te calles. Me estás dando dolor de cabeza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: Fine, I get it. I'll talk, so quit bein' so loud. You're givin' me a headache.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Va bene, ho capito. Parlo', ma solo per farti tacere. Mi stai dando mal di testa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Te ha contado que vendí mis recuerdos, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: He told you about how I sold my memories, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Ti ha raccontato che ho venduto i miei ricordi, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Sí... No tenía ni idea de que se podía hacer algo así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: ... Yeah. I had no idea that people could do that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Si'... Non avevo idea che si potesse fare una cosa del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Claro que no. Está terminantemente prohibido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: Of course you didn't. It's forbidden stuff.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Certo che no. E' severamente proibito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: A pesar de su nombre, el mercado negro no es más que un pasatiempo para los ricos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: Despite its name, the black market is really just a pastime of the rich.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Nonostante il nome, il mercato nero non e' che un passatempo per i ricchi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Si te pillan, se te acabó el chollo. Por eso se quitan de en medio a cualquier idiota que no les sirva para nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: Once you're caught, it's all over. That's why any unneeded idiots get discarded.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Se ti beccano, i giochi sono finiti. Per questo eliminano ogni idiota che non serve a niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Y, en aquel momento, ese idiota fui yo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: ... And I was the idiot back then.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: E in quel momento, quell'idiota ero io...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: El comprador tenía una joya. Solo tenía que cogerla y pensar en los recuerdos que quisiera vender.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: The buyer had a jewel. I'd take it and think of the memories I wanted to sell.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: L'acquirente aveva un gioiello. Bastava prenderlo e pensare ai ricordi da vendere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Al hacerlo, la joya empezaría a absorber mis pensamientos. Imagino que era una especie de Vial de recuerdos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: When I did, the jewel would begin to suck in my thoughts. It was like a Memory Vial, I guess.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Facendolo, il gioiello iniziava ad assorbire i miei pensieri. Immagino fosse una specie di Fiala della Memoria.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: ¿Y eso es posible?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: That kind of thing is possible?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: E questo e' possibile?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: A mí no me preguntes. Yo te estoy contando lo que me dijeron. Vendí recuerdos de experiencias peligrosas que no mucha gente suele compartir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: Don't ask me. I just did what I was told. I'd sell my memories of dangerous experiences that not many share.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Non chiedere a me. Ti sto raccontando quello che mi hanno detto. Vendetti ricordi di esperienze pericolose che non molti condividono.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Ese día, salí a vender mis recuerdos como siempre. Sin embargo... metí la pata y me siguieron.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: That day I went out to sell my memories like usual. However ... I screwed up and got followed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Quel giorno uscii a vendere i miei ricordi come al solito. Tuttavia... feci un pasticcio e mi seguirono.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: El comprador intentó deshacerse de mí. Al fin y al cabo, hay mucha gente con un sinfín de recuerdos miserables.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: The buyer tried to dispose of me. There are plenty of people full of crummy memories, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: L'acquirente provo' a sbarazzarsi di me. D'altronde, c'e' tanta gente con un'infinita' di ricordi miseri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Fui allí como siempre y cogí la joya. Pero, en cuanto lo hice, empezó a introducir algo en mi interior, en lugar de sacarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: I went there same as usual and took the jewel. As soon as I did, it started to pour somethin' into me instead.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Andai li' come al solito e presi il gioiello. Ma appena lo feci, inizio' a immettere qualcosa in me, invece di estrarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Fue demasiada información en un instante. Me sentía como si tuviera la mente frita. Apenas lo recuerdo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: So much information flowed in at once, it was like my mind was being fried. I barely remember it, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Fu troppa informazione in un istante. Mi sentivo con la mente friggerci. A malapena me lo ricordo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Debió de ser algún alquimista que vagaba por las sombras de la sociedad. Me quedé inconsciente y desapareció.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: They must've been an alchemist lurking in society's shadows. I was knocked out, and they disappeared.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Doveva essere qualche alchimista che vagava nell'ombra della societa'. Persi conoscenza e spari'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Entonces, ese viejales cotilla me encontró mientras la Orden de Eustella investigaba un caso...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: I was found by that nosy old man while the Order of Eustella was investigating a case ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Cosi' quel vecchiaccio pettegolo mi trovo' mentre l'Ordine di Eustella indagava su un caso...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Esa es mi historia. La de un idiota que actuó sin pensar y acabó saliendo perjudicado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: That's my story. An idiot who acted without thinkin' and got hurt.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Questa e' la mia storia. Quella di un idiota che ha agito senza pensare ed e' finito peggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: ¿Aún tienes dolores de cabeza y alucinaciones? ¿No tienes problemas para seguir con todo esto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: Rutger ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Hai ancora mal di testa e allucinazioni? Non hai problemi a stare dietro a tutto questo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Eso no es asunto tuyo. Se acabó la historia. Puedes darte con un canto en los dientes porque te haya contado algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: And you still have headaches and hallucinations? Is it okay for you to do all this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Non sono affari tuoi. La storia finisce qui. Puoi considerarti fortunata che ti abbia raccontato qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Espera, solo una cosa más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: That's none of your business. Story time's over. Be happy I told you anythin' at all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Aspetta, solo un'ultima cosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: ¿Odias a los alquimistas?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: Wait, just tell me one more thing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Odii gli alchimisti?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Fui yo quien decidió vender sus recuerdos. La culpa es mía, por no conocer los riesgos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: ... Do you hate alchemists?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Sono io che ho deciso di vendere i miei ricordi. La colpa e' mia, per non averne conosciuto i rischi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: ¿De qué me sirve odiarte a ti?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: I'm the one who decided to sell my memories. It was on me for not knowin' the risks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: A cosa mi servirebbe odiare te?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Si le hubiera echado la cruz a alguien, sería a la mercenaria esa. Tiene algo que me pone de los nervios.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: What good would hatin' you do me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Se avessi dovuto dare la colpa a qualcuno, sarebbe stata quella mercenaria. Ha qualcosa che mi fa innervosire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: ¿Cómo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: Well ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Come?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..src: Déjalo... Me las piro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..ref: If I were to have my eye on anyone, it'd be that mercenary girl. Somethin' about her puts me on edge.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_102..dst: Lascia perdere... Me la spiovento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..src: Yumia, menos mal, estaba a punto de llamarte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..ref: Yumia, perfect timing. I was about to call for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..dst: Yumia, meno male, stavo proprio per chiamarti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..ref: M-missing? Lenja?! But she was just ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..src: De repente, en mitad de la misión, perdimos todo el contacto con ella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..ref: She suddenly dropped all contact in the middle of her duties.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..dst: All'improvviso, in piena missione, abbiamo perso ogni contatto con lei.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..src: Lo habrá hecho por algún motivo. Dejémosla tranquila.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..ref: That's her responsibility then. Just let her be.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..dst: Avra' avuto i suoi motivi. Lasciamola tranquilla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..src: Rutger, no todo el mundo va por libre como tú.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..ref: Most people don't just go off on their own like you do, Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..dst: Rutger, non tutti vanno per conto proprio come te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..src: Exacto, no se puede comparar con tus salidas en solitario. Prometió ponerse en contacto con nosotros y no lo ha hecho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..ref: Yes, this isn't the same as when you were working on your own. She missed an agreed upon time to contact us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..dst: Esatto, non e' paragonabile alle tue uscite in solitaria. Aveva promesso di mettersi in contatto con noi e non l'ha fatto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..src: Debe de haberle sucedido algo. Me gustaría pediros que busquéis a Lenja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..ref: It's likely something has happened to Lenja. Please help us search for her.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..dst: Le sara' successo qualcosa. Vorrei chiedervi di cercare Lenja.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..src: Claro, haremos todo lo posible por encontrarla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..ref: G-got it. We'll see if we can find her.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..dst: Certo, faremo tutto il possibile per trovarla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..src: Propongo como primer destino la aldea Welleks. Será más fácil dar con ella si sabemos sus últimos movimientos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..ref: First, let's go talk to the Welleks at the settlement. If we know her last location, we might be able to track her.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_104..dst: Propongo come prima destinazione il villaggio dei Welleks. Sara' piu' facile trovarla se conosciamo i suoi ultimi movimenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: ¿Os importaría contarme por qué nos hemos reunido aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: ... Mind sharing why you've all gathered here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: Vi dispiacerebbe dirmi perche' ci siamo riuniti qui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: Verás, Cledia...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: Cledia. You see ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: Vedi, Cledia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: ¿Lenja ha desaparecido? ¿Quién la vio por última vez?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: Lenja's missing? Who saw her last?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: Lenja e' scomparsa? Chi l'ha vista l'ultima volta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: Creo que fui yo. Le puse al día sobre la situación de nuestra aldea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: Probably me. I had been explaining the situation of our settlement to her.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: Credo che fossi io. L'ho aggiornata sulla situazione del nostro villaggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: Debió de desaparecer poco después...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: She must've gone missing sometime after that ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: Deve essere scomparsa poco dopo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: ¿Notaste algo raro en ella?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: Did anything about her seem off to you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: Hai notato qualcosa di strano in lei?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: Bueno... es difícil de decir... Es nerviosa por naturaleza, aunque no tenga motivos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: Err, well ... She's pretty flustered even under normal circumstances, so it's hard to say ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: Beh... e' difficile a dirsi... E' nervosa di natura, anche senza motivo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: Ya, entiendo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: Ahh, you have a point.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: Gia', capisco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: ¿Esto es de Lenja?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: This is Lenja's, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: Questo e' di Lenja?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: Creo que sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: I think so ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: Credo di si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: Si estaba en la zona sur de la aldea, es que se dirigía en esa dirección.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: Since it was in the southern part of the settlement, it stands to reason that she had been heading south.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: Se si trovava nella zona sud del villaggio, significa che si dirigeva in quella direzione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: Menos es nada. Aunque preferiría tener un rastro...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: But it's not like we have a trail, only a direction ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: Meglio che niente. Pero' preferirei avere una traccia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: Un rastro, ¿eh? ¿Habrá alguna forma de seguir sus pasos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: A trail ... I wonder if we can follow her tracks or scent.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: Una traccia, eh? Ci sara' un modo per seguire le sue orme?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: ¡Ni que fuéramos perros de caza! Ninguno de nosotros sabe olfatear rastros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: We aren't huntin' dogs. We don't have those kinds of skills.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: Mica siamo cani da caccia! Nessuno di noi sa fiutare le tracce.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: Pero sí que sabemos hacer otras cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: That's why we'll rely on the skills we do have.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: Ma sappiamo fare anche altre cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: Voy a fabricar un rastreador. Flammi, ¿crees que sería posible?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: I'm going to make a tracking tool. Flammi, can it be done?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: Costruiro' un rilevatore. Flammi, credi che sarebbe possibile?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: Como dijo Cledia, el maná de cada persona es como su seña de identidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: As Cledia said, individuals contain identifiable mana signatures.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: Come ha detto Cledia, il mana di ogni persona e' come la sua firma identificativa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: Si pudiéramos detectarlo o identificarlo, sería posible dar con su paradero.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: If we can detect and identify those signatures, tracking her whereabouts should be possible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: Se riuscissimo a rilevarlo o identificarlo, sarebbe possibile scoprire dove si trova.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: ¿Os parece bien a los demás?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: Is that all right with everyone?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: A voi altri sembra giusto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: ¡Más que bien! No tenemos otras pistas que seguir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: Let's give it a try! We don't have any other clues to follow.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: Piu' che giusto! Non abbiamo altre piste da seguire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: Sí, tus habilidades suelen ser útiles. Avísanos si necesitas que te ayudemos con algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: Yes, your power certainly comes in handy. If there is anything we can do to help, let us know.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: Si', le tue capacita' tornano spesso utili. Avvisaci se hai bisogno che ti aiutiamo con qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..src: Vale, empecemos con los preparativos. ¡No hay tiempo que perder!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..ref: Okay, then let's get preparations underway. Time is of the essence.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_105..dst: Va bene, iniziamo con i preparativi. Non c'e' tempo da perdere!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_106..src: Se lo equipo a Flammi y...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_106..ref: Now I equip this to Flammi, and ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_106..src: Con suerte, nos servirá para detectar el rastro de Lenja...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_106..ref: This is how we'll pick up Lenja's trail. If all goes to plan, that is ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_106..dst: Con un po' di fortuna, ci servira' per rilevare le tracce di Lenja...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_106..ref: It looks like it continues that way ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_106..src: ¿No se va por ahí a la aldea Neru?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_106..ref: Isn't that the same direction as the Neru settlement?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_106..dst: Non e' la direzione del villaggio Neru?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: Así que esta es la aldea Neru...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: So this is the Neru settlement ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: Quindi questo e' il villaggio Neru...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: ¿Qué... queréis? Hoy hemos tenido... muchas visitas. Demasiadas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: ... What, what do you want? There have been. So many people. Today.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: Cosa... volete? Oggi abbiamo ricevuto... molte visite. Troppe.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: Oye, ¿Vésper y las Neru son de la misma especie?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: Do you think they're part of the same species as that guy?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: Ehi, Vesper e i Neru sono della stessa specie?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: No estoy seguro... No me parece que alberguen tanta maldad en su interior.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: I'm not sure about that ... They don't strike me as being nearly as wicked ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: Non sono sicuro... Non mi sembra che custodiscano tanta cattiveria al loro interno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: ¿Ha pasado una chica Welleks por aquí hace poco?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: Did a Welleks girl come through here recently?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: E' passata di qui di recente una ragazza Welleks?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: Sí, sí. Una... intentó entrar... por esta puerta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: Yes, yes. There was one. She tried to enter. Through this gate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: Si', si'. Una... ha provato a entrare... da questo cancello.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: ¡No nos equivocamos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: Just like we thought!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: Non ci sbagliavamo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: Dijo... «Las Neru y los Welleks pueden... llegar a un entendimiento». Qué absurdo. Muy absurdo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: She said. "Welleks, Neru, can understand each other." Absurd, absurd.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: Ha detto... "I Neru e i Welleks possono... arrivare a una comprensione". Che assurdo. Molto assurdo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: ¿Un entendimiento?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: Understand each other ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: Una comprensione?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: Es peligroso. Peligroso. Son nuestros enemigos... no podemos... permitirles el paso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: Dangerous, dangerous. Welleks are our enemy. They cannot be. Allowed to enter.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: E' pericoloso. Pericoloso. Sono nostri nemici... non possiamo... lasciarli entrare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: Ya, tiene sentido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: Well, that makes sense ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: Gia', ha senso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: Y ¿qué pasó luego?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: What happened after that?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: E poi che e' successo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: Insistió... No quería... marcharse. Me rendí. La dejé pasar... con una condición.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: She was persistent. And wouldn't leave. So I gave up. And issued her. An entry condition.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: Ha insistito... Non voleva... andarsene. Ho ceduto. L'ho lasciata passare... a una condizione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: Anda, eso no me lo esperaba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: Oh? That's not how I expected things to go.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: Oh, non me lo aspettavo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: Un momento. ¿Qué circunstancias son esas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: Wait. What was the condition?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: Un momento. Quali condizioni sono queste?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: Traer Alstahlias... tantas como pueda... llevar encima.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: Bring Alstahlia. Bring as much. As she can carry.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: Portare Alstahlia... quante ne puo'... portare addosso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: Entonces Lenja se fue sola a recolectar Alstahlia...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: So then Lenja must've gone out to gather Alstahlia on her own?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: Quindi Lenja e' andata da sola a raccogliere Alstahlia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: ¿Qué camino tomó?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: Which way did she go?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: Che strada ha preso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: Sois... tan molest...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: You are all. Annoy—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: Siete... cosi' fastidios...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: Dínoslo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: Tell us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: Diccelo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: Por ahí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: That way. Over there ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: Di la'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: Hacia la Academia Hermética...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: ... Towards Hermea Academy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: Verso l'Accademia Ermetica...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: Gracias. ¡Hasta pronto!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: Thank you. We'll be back!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: Grazie. A presto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..src: Flammi, vamos a seguir su rastro una vez más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..ref: Flammi, everyone. Let's try following her tracks one more time!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_110..dst: Flammi, proviamo a seguire di nuovo le sue tracce.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_130..ref: Perfect, I'm sure this'll be enough ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_130..dst: Cosa...? Come...? Perche'... siete tutti qui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_130..ref: We've been looking for you! You see ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_130..src: Lo siento... Solo quería aportar mi granito de arena...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_130..ref: ... I'm so sorry. I just wanted to bring back some good results ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_130..dst: Mi dispiace... Volevo solo dare una mano...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_130..src: No pasa nada, no te preocupes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_130..ref: It's okay, don't worry about it.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_130..src: Pero ¡no puedes decir que te pondrás en contacto a una hora y desaparecer por las buenas! Somos un equipo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_130..ref: But if you're supposed to make contact at a certain time, you can't just ignore it. We are an organization.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_130..dst: Ma non puoi dire che ti farai sentire a una certa ora e poi sparire cosi'! Siamo una squadra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_130..ref: Though that kinda stuff is a total pain.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_130..src: Lenja, ¿cómo se te ocurre recolectar Alstahlia tú sola?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_130..ref: Lenja, why did you try to get all of the Alstahlia by yourself?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_130..dst: Lenja, come ti e' venuto in mente di raccogliere l'Alstahlia da sola?
Che cosa sei venuto a fare?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..src: No la vi venir...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..ref: *Sigh* ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..dst: Non l'avevo vista arrivare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..src: ¿Qué ha pasado? Parecía odiar profundamente a los alquimistas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..ref: That came outta nowhere ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..dst: Che cosa e' successo? Sembrava odiare profondamente gli alchimisti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..src: El equipo está recabando más información, pero, por ahora, no sabemos nada en concreto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..ref: Just what was that? She seemed to seriously hate alchemists ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..dst: La squadra sta raccogliendo altre informazioni, ma per ora non sappiamo nulla di concreto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..src: Una cosa sí que es segura: hay seres muy peligrosos en esta región que nos la tienen jurada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..ref: ... The Research Team is looking for information, but as of now there's nothing concrete.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..dst: Una cosa e' certa: in questa regione ci sono esseri molto pericolosi che ce l'hanno giurata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..src: De ahora en adelante, deberíamos ir con más cuidado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..ref: Only one thing can be said for sure: there are dangers lurking on this continent that have their sights set on us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..dst: D'ora in poi dovremmo fare piu' attenzione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..src: Los que sigan con fuerza que vigilen los alrededores. Yumia, tú deberías descansar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..ref: We need to tread carefully from here on out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..dst: Chi e' ancora in forze tenga d'occhio i dintorni. Yumia, tu dovresti riposare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..src: Lo siento, ha sido mi culpa...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..ref: Those who have any strength left will watch our surroundings. Yumia, you get some rest.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..dst: Mi dispiace, e' stata colpa mia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..src: Yo os obligué a venir hasta aquí y os he causado muchos problemas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..ref: ... Okay.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..dst: Vi ho costretti a venire fin qui e vi ho causato un sacco di problemi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..src: Bah... Ha sido mala suerte que esa cosa rondara por aquí, tú no has tenido nada que ver.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..ref: I'm sorry. This is all my fault ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..dst: Ma va... E' stata solo sfortuna che quella cosa si aggirasse qui, non c'entri nulla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..src: ¿Por qué no le contaste a cualquier compañero adónde ibas o que querías recolectar flores?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..ref: I caused trouble for everyone by making you all come out here ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..dst: Perche' non hai detto a nessuno dei compagni dove andavi o che volevi raccogliere dei fiori?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..src: Me quería poner a prueba. Quería demostrar que servía para algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..ref: ... *Sigh* That monster just showed up by chance. It's not your fault.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..dst: Volevo mettermi alla prova. Volevo dimostrare di essere utile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..src: Me enteré de que los Welleks de la aldea y las Neru llevan mucho tiempo peleándose a causa de la Alstahlia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..ref: ... So, why didn't you tell anyone where you were goin'? You could've told other members about the flowers, too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..dst: Ho saputo che i Welleks del villaggio e le Neru litigano da molto tempo a causa dell'Alstahlia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..src: Como no nací en Aladiss, pensé que... Pensé que podría arreglar las cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..ref: Well ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..dst: Siccome non sono nata ad Aladiss, pensavo che... Pensavo di poter sistemare le cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..src: Pero no he sabido hacerlo. Por eso soy Lenja, la patética...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..ref: I wanted to prove myself. I wanted to show that I can be useful.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..dst: Ma non ci sono riuscita. Ecco perche' sono Lenja, la patetica...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..src: Sabemos cómo te sientes. Yo también creía que podríamos mejorar la situación, pero la gente de la aldea fue bien clara.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..ref: I heard the Welleks from the settlement have been fighting the Neru for a long time over Alstahlia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..dst: Sappiamo come ti senti. Anch'io credevo che avremmo potuto migliorare la situazione, ma gli abitanti del villaggio sono stati molto chiari.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..src: «Mientras sobre nuestros hombros pesen los recuerdos del pasado, este conflicto no se resolverá».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..ref: I wasn't born in Aladiss, so I thought I might be able to help solve their issues ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..dst: "Finche' il peso dei ricordi del passato grava sulle nostre spalle, questo conflitto non si risolvera'".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..src: Además... es imposible que las Neru supieran que tú eres de otro clan con solo mirarte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..ref: But it didn't work out at all. That's why I'm lousy Lenja ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..dst: Inoltre... e' impossibile che le Neru abbiano capito solo guardandoti che sei di un altro clan.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..src: Tenéis razón... Lo siento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..ref: I understand how you feel. I thought we could solve this too. But the people at the settlement told me something.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..dst: Avete ragione... Mi dispiace.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..src: Venga, no te lamentes tanto. Ya tendrás oportunidad de aportar tu granito de arena, ¿vale?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..ref: "As long as we shoulder the heavy weight of these memories, this conflict will never be settled so easily."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..dst: Su, non prendertela cosi'. Avrai ancora l'occasione di dare il tuo contributo, va bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..src: Deberíamos regresar a la base cuanto antes. Querrán saber que Lenja está a salvo y conocer los detalles sobre nuestro encuentro fortuito.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..ref: And also ... The Neru wouldn't know you're from another clan just by looking at you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_140..dst: Dovremmo tornare alla base il prima possibile. Vorranno sapere che Lenja e' al sicuro e conoscere i dettagli del nostro incontro fortuito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: ¡Estáis todos bien!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: You're all right!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Siete tutti sani e salvi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Sí, por los pelos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Yeah, somehow ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Si', per un pelo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: ¿Ha pasado algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Did something happen?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: E' successo qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Así que primero las Neru y luego un monstruo con cuernos, ¿eh? Y nada menos que uno que os recuerda a Vésper.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: The Neru and a monster with giant horns, huh? And you think that she was the same kind as Vesper.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Quindi prima le Neru e poi un mostro cornuto, eh? E per giunta uno che vi ricorda Ve'sper.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: No necesito saber más. Dispondré guardias alrededor de la base. Por ahora, id a descansar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Well, I understand the situation. I'll have the defenses around the base tightened. Get some rest for now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Non ho bisogno di sapere altro. Faro' mettere delle guardie intorno alla base. Per ora, andate a riposare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Oye, Lenja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Hey, Lenja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Ehi, Lenja.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: ¿S-sí? ¿Q-querías algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Y-yes? Wh-what is it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: S-si'? V-volevi qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: ¿Por qué te uniste al equipo de investigación? Eres la única Welleks del grupo, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Why did you decide to join the Research Team? You're the only Welleks who's joined, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Perche' ti sei unita alla Squadra di Ricerca? Sei l'unica Welleks del gruppo, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: En mi clan, el clan Flumme, existe la costumbre de embarcarse en lo que llamamos un viaje de redención cuando alcanzamos la edad adulta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Uh, um ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Nel mio clan, il clan Flumme, c'e' l'usanza di intraprendere quello che chiamiamo un viaggio di redenzione quando raggiungiamo la maggiore eta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Recorremos el mundo ayudando a la gente que nos necesite para redimir los pecados de nuestros antepasados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: In my clan, the Flumme clan, we have a custom that when you become an adult, you go on a journey of atonement.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Giriamo per il mondo aiutando chi ha bisogno di noi, per redimere i peccati dei nostri antenati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Yo fui una de tantos que decidió emprender este viaje... Siempre soñé con ayudar a los demás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: In order to atone for the sins of our ancestors, we travel across the land and help people.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Sono stata una delle tante a decidere di intraprendere questo viaggio... Ho sempre sognato di aiutare gli altri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Pero ¡no dejo de meter la pata! Dondequiera que vaya, solo escucho que soy una inútil y que vuelva a casa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: I left with a number of others ... I wanted to help lots of people.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Ma continuo a combinare guai! Ovunque vada, sento solo che sono un'incapace e che dovrei tornare a casa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: ¿Por eso dijiste que eras patética?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: But I kept messing up. No matter where I went, I was always told I was useless and to go home ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Per questo hai detto di essere patetica?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Sí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: ... So that's why you called yourself lousy?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Siempre me las ingenio para retrasar al grupo... Hasta mis amigos, los que partieron de viaje conmigo, sufrieron mis meteduras de pata.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: ... Yeah.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Riesco sempre a rallentare il gruppo... Persino i miei amici, quelli che sono partiti in viaggio con me, hanno sofferto per i miei pasticci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Y, a-aun así, me ayudaron. Estaban convencidos de que todos deberíamos unirnos al equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: All I do is hold others back. I even caused loads of trouble for my friends who went on the journey with me ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: E-eppure mi hanno aiutata. Erano convinti che dovessimo entrare tutti nella Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Era mi última oportunidad de ayudar a alguien, así que me presenté voluntaria con ellos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: B-but even then, they still helped me. They said that we should all join the Research Team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Era la mia ultima occasione per aiutare qualcuno, cosi' mi sono offerta volontaria insieme a loro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Pero la mañana que supuestamente nos alistaríamos al equipo, me desperté sola en la habitación. Se habían marchado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: I thought it might be my last opportunity to be of use to someone, so I volunteered with them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Ma la mattina in cui avremmo dovuto arruolarci nella Squadra di Ricerca, mi sono svegliata da sola in camera. Se n'erano andati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: ¿Cómo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: But on the morning we were supposed to join the team, I woke up to an empty room. They'd all left ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Come?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: El dueño de la posada me explicó que los demás se habían ido sin mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Il proprietario della locanda mi ha spiegato che gli altri erano partiti senza di me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Creí que estarían en el punto de reunión, así que me acerqué corriendo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: The inn's owner told me that the others had left ahead of me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Pensavo che fossero al punto d'incontro, cosi' sono corsa li'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Pero allí no había nadie...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: I thought maybe they went to the meeting place, so I hurried over ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Ma non c'era nessuno...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Qué mal...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: ... But they weren't there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Che tristezza...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: C-creo que les ocurrió algo que les i-impidió unirse al equipo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: How horrible ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: C-credo che sia successo qualcosa che gli ha i-impedito di unirsi alla Squadra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Por eso, debo esforzarme el doble en su honor ¡y regresar con pruebas de lo que soy capaz!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: I-I really think that something must've happened that kept them from joining!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Percio' devo impegnarmi il doppio in loro onore e tornare con la prova di cio' che so fare!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Después de todo, Aladiss es la tierra natal de los Welleks. Si consigo volver con algo que merezca la pena, se llevarán una gran alegría.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: So I want to work hard in their stead, and have the results to show for it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Dopotutto, Aladiss e' la terra natale dei Wellek. Se riusciro' a tornare con qualcosa di valido, ne saranno felicissimi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: O eso creía al menos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Aladiss is the Welleks's homeland, after all. If I can bring back something nice, I'm sure everyone will be overjoyed!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: O almeno cosi' credevo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Pero, cómo no, la he pifiado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: ... At least, I used to think that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Ma, ovviamente, ho combinato un disastro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Lenja, tus amigos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: But I screwed up again.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Lenja, i tuoi amici...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: La soledad es abrumadora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Lenja, your friends ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: La solitudine e' opprimente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Tsk, qué asco.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Being all alone truly is heartbreaking.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Tsk, che schifo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Vete de nuestro pueblo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: ... Tch, that's just sick.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Vattene dal nostro villaggio...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Es la hija de una bruja...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Get out of our town ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: E' la figlia di una strega...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Es horrible...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: And to think she's a witch's daughter ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: E' orribile...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: N-no lo entiendes. Ha sido por mi culpa...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: That's just too awful ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: N-non capisci. E' tutta colpa mia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: ¡Eso no es verdad!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Y-you don't understand. It was all my fault ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Non e' vero!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Lenja, ¡únete a nosotros!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: No, it wasn't!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Lenja, unisciti a noi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Hey, Lenja, come join us!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: C-come...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Creo que tienes una habilidad única.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: ... Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Credo che tu abbia un talento unico.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Cuando nos atacó el monstruo, fuiste la primera en notar su presencia, ¿te acuerdas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: I think you have a power that none of us have, Lenja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Quando ci ha attaccati il mostro, sei stata la prima ad accorgerti della sua presenza, ricordi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Sí, es verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: I mean, when we were attacked by that monster, you were the first one to sense it, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Si', e' vero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Tenerte a nuestro lado podría sernos muy útil, pero ¡útil de verdad!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Oh, that's right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Averti al nostro fianco potrebbe esserci molto utile, ma utile davvero!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Estoy de acuerdo. Compensas tu falta de confianza con talento. Que el jefe cuente contigo es prueba de ello.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: I think having you with us would be a huge help. A huge, HUGE help!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Sono d'accordo. Compensi la tua mancanza di fiducia con il talento. Il fatto che il capo conti su di te ne e' la prova.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Mi opinión ya la sabéis: que haga lo que quiera.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Agreed. While you seem to lack confidence, you have ability. The chief allowing you to join is proof of that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: La mia opinione la sapete gia': che faccia cio' che vuole.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: ¿Lo decís en serio?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: I told you before, do whatever you want.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: D-dici sul serio?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: ¿Queréis que os acompañe? ¿Yo? ¿La patética, torpe y patosa Lenja?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: ... Really?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Volete che venga con voi? Io? La patetica, imbranata e maldestra Lenja?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Oye, no te menosprecies así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: You really want me to join you? Clumsy, bumbling, lousy Lenja?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Ehi, non sminuirti cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Nos gustaría contar contigo precisamente por ser como eres.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Come on, don't say such bad things about yourself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Vogliamo averti con noi proprio perche' sei come sei.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Yo... Nunca nadie me había dicho algo así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: I want you to join us exactly as you are.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Io... Nessuno mi aveva mai detto una cosa simile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: ¡M-me esforzaré al máximo para demostrar que puedo ser de ayuda!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: It's just ... I've never been told something like that before.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: M-mi impegnero' al massimo per dimostrare che posso esservi utile!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Jefe, ¿nos has oído?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: If I can be of any help ... I'll try my very hardest!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Capo, hai sentito?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Bueno, es una idea excelente. Llevadla con vosotros, aquí nos las apañaremos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Chief! Did you hear that?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Be', e' un'ottima idea. Portatela con voi, qui ce la caveremo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Ya lo has escuchado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Hm? Yeah, I think that would be a good idea. Take her along with you. We'll figure out things on this end.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Hai sentito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: ¡Va-vale! ¡Os echaré una mano en cuanto tenga la ocasión!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: You heard him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: V-va bene! Vi daro' una mano appena ne avro' l'occasione!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: ¡Ah...! ¡Ya lo tengo! ¡Ya sé cómo ayudaros!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Okay! I-I'll work hard to be helpful to you as soon as possible!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Ah...! Ci sono! Ho capito come aiutarvi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: ¿Cómo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: ... Oh! There is one thing! I can be helpful right away!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Come?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: ¡Mirad!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: What?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Guardate!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Cuando los niños abrazan mi cola, sonríen con todas sus fuerzas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Look at this!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Quando i bambini abbracciano la mia coda, sorridono a pieni denti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: ¡Es una de mis especialidades! ¡Y está a vuestra disposición!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: If I let kids hug my tail real tight, they always get a big smile on their faces!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: E' una delle mie specialita'! Ed e' a vostra disposizione!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Interesante. Debo investigar este hecho concienzudamente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: This is a Lenja specialty, you can count on it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Interessante. Devo indagare a fondo su questo fatto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: ¿Nina?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Interesting. I suppose I'll have to investigate this matter thoroughly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Nina?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Está a nuestra disposición, eso has dicho, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Nina ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: E' a nostra disposizione, hai detto, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: ¿Eh? ¿Q-qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: It's okay, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Eh? C-che?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: ¿Puedo tocarla, verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Huh? U-uhhh ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Posso toccarla, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: ¡S-sí!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: It's okay to touch it, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: S-si'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Je, je, je, je, je, je... ¡Allá voy...!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Y-yes!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: He he he he he he... Eccomi...!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Qué suavecita... Je, je, je, je, je.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Hehe, hehehe ... Then don't mind if I do ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Che morbida... He he he he he.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Lenja se ha unido al grupo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: So soft ... Hehe, hehehe ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Lenja si e' unita al gruppo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Ji, ji, ji, mi teoría era correcta. Es tan suave y esponjosa como imaginaba...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Lenja joined your party.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Hi hi hi, la mia teoria era giusta. E' morbida e soffice come immaginavo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: ¿Podemos perder el tiempo en esto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Hehehe ... My hypothesis was correct. Aah, it's so fluffy no matter where I touch ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Possiamo perderci tempo con questa cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Depende de a quién le preguntes, claramente...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: Is now really the time for this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Dipende da chi lo chiedi, ovviamente...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Tiene la mirada perdida, como si tuviera la mente en blanco.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: To her, it might be the perfect time for this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Ha lo sguardo perso, come se avesse la mente in bianco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..src: Vamos, ya hemos descansado lo suficiente. Antes de nada, deberíamos preguntar a los Welleks sobre ese monstruo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..ref: I don't think there's a single thought inside that head of hers.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm03_150..dst: Dai, ci siamo riposati abbastanza. Prima di tutto, dovremmo chiedere ai Welleks di quel mostro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..src: Ah, así que eso fue lo que ha pasado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..ref: I see, so that's what happened ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..dst: Ah, quindi e' questo che e' successo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..src: Me alegro de que estéis a salvo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..dst: Mi fa piacere che siate al sicuro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..ref: I'm sorry for going out alone like that ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..dst: Mi dispiace per essere andata via senza avvisare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..src: No te preocupes. Al final, no hemos tenido que lamentar nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..ref: Everything turned out all right in the end, so don't worry too much.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..dst: Non ti preoccupare. Alla fine, non abbiamo dovuto rimpiangere nulla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..src: Sobre ese monstruo que visteis aparecer...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..ref: ... Now, about the monster you came across.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..dst: Riguardo a quel mostro che avete visto apparire...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..src: Por lo que habéis contado, entiendo que se trata de Lili Borea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..ref: From what you told me, that was likely Lili Borea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..dst: Per quello che avete raccontato, capisco che si tratti di Lili Borea.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..ref: Lili Borea ... Who exactly is she?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..src: Bueno, no sé mucho sobre ella...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..ref: I don't really know much about her myself ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..dst: Be', non ne so molto nemmeno io...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..src: He oído que hay gente de por aquí que la llegó a conocer hace mucho tiempo. Si queréis saber más, deberíais preguntarles a ellos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..ref: But there are some people who saw her a long time ago. If you want to know more, you should ask them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..dst: Ho sentito dire che qui da queste parti c'e' gente che l'ha conosciuta molto tempo fa. Se volete saperne di piu', dovreste chiedere a loro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..ref: We'll go and see what we can learn. Thank you, Cledia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_010..dst: Va bene, lo faremo. Grazie, Cledia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..src: Lili Borea... Ah, sí, esa mutante. La recuerdo bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..ref: Lili Borea ... That monster, right. I remember her well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..dst: Lili Borea... Ah, si', quella mutante. La ricordo bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..src: Hace tiempo, mucho tiempo, nos la cruzamos mientras explorábamos las tierras prohibidas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..ref: Some time ago—well, it was actually a long time ago—we were exploring the forbidden lands and came across her.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..dst: Tanto tempo fa, ma davvero tanto tempo fa, la incrociammo mentre esploravamo le terre proibite.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..ref: I see. Did you end up fighting her?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..src: No. Le grité «¿quién eres?» y, tras echarnos una mirada, nos dijo:
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..ref: No. I yelled out, "Who are you?" and after glaring at us, she spat out the words,
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..dst: No. Le gridai "chi sei?" e, dopo averci lanciato un'occhiata, ci disse:

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..src: «Soy Lili Borea. Si apreciáis vuestra vida, marchaos».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..ref: "I am Lili Borea. If you value your lives, leave now."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..dst: "Sono Lili Borea. Se tenete alla vostra vita, andatevene".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..src: Antes de que pudiéramos responder, ya había desaparecido de nuestra vista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..ref: Then she disappeared into the forbidden lands before we could even respond.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..dst: Prima che potessimo rispondere, era gia' sparita dalla nostra vista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..src: ¿En serio? A nosotros no nos trató así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..ref: What? Isn't that completely different from how she treated us?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..dst: Davvero? Con noi non si e' comportata cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..src: Tal vez su problema era otro...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..dst: Forse il suo problema era un altro...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..src: Si queréis saber más sobre Lili Borea, preguntadles a las Neru.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..ref: If you want to learn more about Lili Borea, you should be asking the Neru.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..dst: Se volete saperne di piu' su Lili Borea, dovreste chiedere alle Neru.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..src: Sí. No tienen un código como nuestro pueblo, ¿verdad? Y son capaces de recordar el pasado tal y como sucedió.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..ref: Yeah. They don't have a code like us, so wouldn't they pass down past events exactly as they happened?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..dst: Si'. Non hanno un codice come il nostro popolo, vero? E sono capaci di ricordare il passato cosi' come e' successo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..src: Nunca hemos recurrido a su ayuda, pero vosotros sí que podéis acercaros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..ref: We'd never ask the Neru for help, but you guys don't have to worry about that, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..dst: Non abbiamo mai chiesto il loro aiuto, ma voi potete tranquillamente avvicinarvi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..ref: That's certainly an option. What do you think, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..dst: E' un'opzione. Tu che ne pensi, Yumia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..src: Sí, claro. Vamos a hablar con las Neru.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..ref: We go, of course. Let's talk to the Neru.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..dst: Si', certo. Andiamo a parlare con le Neru.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..src: Ya me parecía. Venga, vamos a la aldea Neru.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..ref: Exactly as I thought. All right, let's head to the Neru settlement.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_020..dst: Come immaginavo. Forza, andiamo al villaggio di Neru.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..src: Extranjeros. Extranjeros de nuevo. ¿Por qué... habéis regresado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..ref: Outsiders, outsiders. Why are you. Here again?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..dst: Stranieri. Ancora stranieri. Perche'... siete tornati?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..src: ¿Te importaría que te hiciéramos unas preguntas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..ref: We have something else to ask you about. Is that okay?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..dst: Ti dispiacerebbe se ti facessimo qualche domanda?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..src: El monstruo... Queréis saber... quién es Lili Borea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..ref: Monster, monster ... You want to know? About Lili Borea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..dst: Il mostro... Volete sapere... chi e' Lili Borea.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..src: Así que las Neru sabéis algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..ref: So the Neru do know about her.
Could you please tell us about her?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..dst: Potreste raccontarci qualcosa su di lei?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..src: No. No podemos. Sois... extranjeros. No podemos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..ref: Cannot, cannot. Outsiders. Cannot be told.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..dst: No. Non possiamo. Siete... stranieri. Non possiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..src: ¡Por favor, dadnos una oportunidad! ¡Os lo compensaremos, si es lo que queréis!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..ref: Please, reconsider! We'll repay you however we can!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..dst: Vi preghiamo, dateci una possibilita'! Vi ricompenseremo, se e' quello che volete!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..src: Néctar. Lo más preciado... para las Neru... es el néctar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..ref: ... Nectar, nectar. The thing we Neru. Want the most.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..dst: Nettare. La cosa piu' preziosa... per le Neru... e' il nettare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..ref: If you have nectar, we will talk.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..src: Vale. ¿Nos ayudaréis entonces si traemos néctar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..dst: Va bene. Ci aiuterete allora se portiamo nettare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..src: Sí. Así es. Cooperaremos... si cumplís la condición.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..ref: Okay. If we bring you enough nectar to use freely, you all will help us?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..dst: Si'. Esatto. Collaboreremo... se soddisferete la condizione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..ref: Yes, yes. If you do, we will cooperate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..dst: Eh? E c-come faremo a ottenerlo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..ref: Huh? H-how are we going to do that?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..dst: Possiamo ottenere nettare senza le Alstahlia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..src: Les fabricaré un generador de energía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..ref: We know a way to make nectar without Alstahlia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_030..dst: Gli costruiro' un generatore di energia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..src: ¡Ya he terminado! Aquí tengo el generador de energía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..ref: It's finished! This is an Energy Generator!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..dst: Ho gia' finito! Ecco qui il generatore di energia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..src: Este generador es capaz de crear un néctar parecido al de la Alstahlia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..ref: With this, energy ... something similar to Alstahlia nectar can be made at any time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..dst: Questo generatore e' in grado di creare un nettare simile a quello dell'Alstahlia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..src: Sí, néctar. El néctar que pedimos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..ref: This, this is it. The nectar we wanted!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..dst: Si', nettare. Il nettare che avevamo chiesto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..src: Ja, ja. No es para tanto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..ref: Haha, it's not really that impressive ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..dst: Ah, ah. Non e' niente di che.
