eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..src: ¡Yumia, Yumia! ¡Deberíamos fabricar otro generador para la aldea Welleks!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..ref: Yumia, Yumia! We should make one of these for the Welleks settlement too!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..dst: Yumia, Yumia! Dovremmo costruire un altro generatore per il villaggio dei Welleks!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..src: Qué buena idea. Se la plantearé a Cledia más tarde.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..ref: That's a good idea. I'll talk to Cledia later.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..dst: Ottima idea. Ne parlero' con Cledia piu' tardi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..ref: Really, truly? It can make nectar. Forever?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..dst: Davvero? Non... state mentendo? Puo' generare... nettare? Sempre?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..src: Sí, igual que las Alstahlias. De hecho, puede que incluso más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..ref: Yes. It's just like Alstahlia ... Actually, it should be able to make even more than Alstahlia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..dst: Si', proprio come le Alstahlia. Anzi, forse anche di piu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..src: Entendido. Confiamos... en que actúas de buena voluntad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..ref: ... Understood. I will trust. That your deed. Is sincere.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..dst: Capito. Confidiamo... che tu agisca di buona fede.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..src: Venid. Venid conmigo. Conoceréis... a Laurie.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..ref: All of you. Come with me. ... To meet. Laurie.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..dst: Venite. Venite con me. Conoscerete... Laurie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..src: Disculpad. No permitimos... la entrada a los Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..ref: ... But, however. Welleks. You are. Not allowed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..dst: Scusate. Non permettiamo... l'ingresso ai Welleks.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..src: Son peligrosos. Son enemigos. No pueden... reunirse... con nuestra líder.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..ref: Welleks are dangerous. Our enemies. They cannot be. Allowed to meet. Our chief.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..dst: Sono pericolosi. Sono nemici. Non possono... incontrare... la nostra leader.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..src: Pero ¿qué dices? ¿Te parece que sea alguien que pueda hacerle daño a una mosca?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..ref: What the hell? Does she look like someone who can harm others to you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..dst: Ma che dici? Ti sembra una che farebbe male a una mosca?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..src: N-no pasa nada, señorito Rutger. No me molesta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..ref: D-don't worry, Mister Rutger. I'm okay.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..dst: N-non si preoccupi, signor Rutger. Non mi da' fastidio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..src: Os esperaré aquí. Vamos, id sin mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..ref: I'll wait here for you all to come back. So please, go on ahead.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..dst: Aspettero' qui che torniate tutti. Quindi, andate pure avanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..ref: Okay. Thank you, Lenja ... We'll be back soon.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_040..dst: Va bene. Grazie, Lenja... Torneremo subito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..src: Sí. Eso es. Laurie Nauie, líder de las Neru.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..ref: Indeed, indeed. Leader of the Neru, Laurie Nauie.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..dst: Si'. Esatto. Laurie Nauie, leader delle Neru.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..src: Entiendo... vuestra situación. Vuestro... objetivo. Comprendo... vuestro deseo de investigar Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..ref: I understand, comprehend. Your situation, goal. The investigation. Of Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..dst: Capisco... la vostra situazione. Il vostro... obiettivo. Comprendo... il vostro desiderio di indagare su Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..src: Sin embargo... sobre Lili Borea. No. No puedo contaros... mucho, puesto que no sé... demasiado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..ref: But Lili Borea? No, I am sorry. I have little knowledge. To share.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..dst: Tuttavia... riguardo a Lili Borea. No. Non posso dirvi... molto, poiche' non so... granche'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..src: Aunque... puedo daros... una pista. Una clave.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..ref: ... But, however. I have a clue. A key.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..dst: Pero'... posso darvi... un indizio. Una chiave.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..src: Documentos antiguos. Muy antiguos. Sobre las Neru... y los alquimistas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..dst: Documenti antichi. Molto antichi. Sulle Neru... e sugli alchimisti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..ref: Old, old documents. About us Neru. And alchemists.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..dst: Questo e'... una Fiala della Memoria!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..src: No... lo necesitamos. Lo guardaron... con esmero. Lleváoslo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..dst: Non... ci serve. Lo hanno custodito... con cura. Prendetelo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..ref: We have. No need for it. It was left in storage. Take it.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..src: ¿Un Vial de recuerdos? ¿Y contiene algo importante?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..ref: Thank you! This will help us out a lot!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..dst: Una Fiala della Memoria? E contiene qualcosa di importante?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..src: Puede que sí. Volvamos a la base para comprobarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..ref: A Memory Vial? It contains some kind of big clue?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..dst: Puo' darsi. Torniamo alla base per controllare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..ref: Probably. Let's head back to the base and check out its contents.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..src: Además, necesitaremos tu ayuda para ordenar los documentos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_041..dst: Inoltre, avremo bisogno del tuo aiuto per ordinare i documenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: ¿Estáis listos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: ... Is everybody ready?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: Siete pronti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: Detente... Acaba con esto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: Please begin.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: Fermati... Metti fine a tutto questo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: Ya has destruido nuestro país, ¿qué más nos quieres arrebatar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: ... Stop it already.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: Hai gia' distrutto il nostro paese, cos'altro vuoi strapparci?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: «Arrebatar» es una palabra demasiado fuerte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: First you destroy our country, what else do you wish to rob us of next?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: "Strappare" e' una parola troppo forte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: He de admitir que no esperaba encontrar a alguien tan competente entre los rehenes...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: "Rob" is such a slanderous way to put it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: Devo ammettere che non mi aspettavo di trovare qualcuno cosi' competente tra gli ostaggi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: ¿Cómo dices? ¿Competente?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: But regardless ... To think that there was someone with aptitude among the captives ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: Cosa hai detto? Competente?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: ¡Alégrate! Pronto renacerás por el bien y la grandeza del Imperio aladissiano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: What? Aptitude?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: Rallegrati! Presto rinascerai per il bene e la grandezza dell'Impero Aladissiano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: ¿Qué...? ¿De qué hablas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: Rejoice. You will soon be reborn for the sake of further developing the Aladissian Empire.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: Cosa...? Di cosa parli?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: Espero que te esmeres cuando estés a mi servicio como soldado. Eso sí, a los de tu calaña hay que... pulirlos antes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: Wha ... What do you mean ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: Spero che tu dia il massimo quando sarai al mio servizio come soldato. Detto questo, a quelli come te bisogna... rifinarli prima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: Déjate de historias. ¡Yo...! ¡No! ¡Déjame! Aléjate de mí... ¡No te acerques...!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: I look forward to your service as an outstanding soldier. Although, those like you must be given ... restraints.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: Basta con le storie. Io...! No! Lasciami! Vattene via... Non ti avvicinare...!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: Ag... ¡UAAAGGG!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: Don't mess with me ... I'll ...! No, stop! Get away ... Get away from me!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: Ag... UAAAGGG!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: Uf, uf... Me quema...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: Guh, guAAAAH!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: Uff, uff... Brucia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: Duele... duele mucho...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: *Huff* *Huff* It burns ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: Fa male... fa molto male...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: ...más os lo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: It hurts ... so much ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: ...mai ve lo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: ¡JAMÁS OS LO PERDONARÉ, ALQUIMISTAS!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: ... —give you ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: MAI VE LO PERDONERO', ALCHIMISTI!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: El experimento con la mutante ha sido un éxito. Fin de la grabación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: I'LL NEVER FORGIVE YOU, ALCHEMISTS!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: L'esperimento con la mutante e' stato un successo. Fine della registrazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: Maldición... Dan ganas de vomitar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: Mutant experiment is a success. Ending recording.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: Maledizione... Mette voglia di vomitare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: Una mutante... Y la voz que ha dicho «Jamás os lo perdonaré» era Lili Borea, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: ... Dammit. That's just sick.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: Una mutante... E la voce che ha detto "Mai ve lo perdonero'" era quella di Lili Borea, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: Los mutantes nacieron a raíz de los estudios de las Neru. En esos experimentos, crearon unos monstruos capaces de hablar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: Mutants ... Hey, the one that said, "I'll never forgive you." ... That was Lili Borea's voice, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: I mutanti nacquero dagli studi delle Neru. In quegli esperimenti, crearono dei mostri capaci di parlare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: En otras palabras, antes era una humana...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: Mutants were created as the result of research into the Neru, a race of monsters who understand language ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: In altre parole, prima era un'umana...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: ¡¿Convirtieron a una persona en eso?! ¿Cómo pudieron?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: In other words, she used to be human ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: Hanno trasformato una persona in quella cosa?! Come hanno potuto?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: Las Neru mutaron y ganaron inteligencia gracias al contacto con el maná y eso llamó la atención de los alquimistas de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: They made someone turn into that?! H-how could they ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: Le Neru hanno mutato e acquisito intelligenza grazie al contatto con il mana, e questo attiro' l'attenzione degli alchimisti di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: Aquí pone que crearon mutantes fusionando las capacidades físicas de los monstruos con una humana.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: The Neru mutated and gained reason due to mana. It seems that caught the attention of Aladiss's alchemists.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: Qui dice che crearono dei mutanti fondendo le capacita' fisiche dei mostri con un'umana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: A eso se refería con «competente», ya veo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: This says they created mutants by combining a monster's incredible physical capabilities with a normal human.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: A questo si riferiva dicendo "competente", ora capisco...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: ¿Por qué?... ¿Qué alquimista haría algo así?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: Usin' captives with "aptitude," huh ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: Perche'?... Che alchimista farebbe mai una cosa del genere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: Usar la alquimia para algo así no está bien...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: ... Why? Why would alchemists do something like that?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: Usare l'alchimia per una cosa del genere non va bene...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: Esto es... ¡Esto es...! ¡Es...!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: Yumia ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: Questo e'... Questo e'...! E'...!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..src: Yo me encargo del resto de los documentos. Tomaos un descanso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..ref: Using the power of alchemy this way is wrong ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_042..dst: Io mi occupo del resto dei documenti. Prendetevi una pausa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Jamás nos lo perdonará...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: "Never forgive" ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Non ci perdonera' mai...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Yo tampoco lo haría.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: ... I wouldn't forgive it either.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Nemmeno io lo farei.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: (¿Cómo sé qué es lo correcto, mamá?...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: (Just what is "right"? Mom ...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: (Come faccio a sapere cosa e' giusto, mamma?...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Mamá, se han vuelto a burlar de mí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: Mom, everyone made fun of me again ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Mamma, si sono di nuovo presi gioco di me...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: ¿Qué ha pasado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: What happened?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Cosa e' successo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: He dicho que veía centellitas en el aire y me han llamado rarita y mentirosa...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: I told them that a bunch of squiggles were flying around, and they said I was creepy and to stop lying ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Ho detto che vedevo piccole scintille nell'aria e mi hanno chiamata strana e bugiarda...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Pero yo las he visto, mamá, se mueven...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: But they really are flying everywhere ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Ma io le ho viste, mamma, si muovono...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Claro que sí. Y las sigues viendo, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: That's right. You can see them, can't you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Certo che si'. E le vedi ancora, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Que va.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: You can, but the other kids don't see them at all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Macche'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Eso es porque solo tú puedes verlas, pero tus compañeros no...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: Really?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: E' perche' solo tu puoi vederle, ma i tuoi compagni no...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: ¿De verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: Yes. Being able to see them is "right" for you, but not being able to see them is "right" for the other kids.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Davvero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Sí. Para ti lo «normal» es verlas, pero lo «normal» para ellos es no hacerlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: In this world, there isn't just one right thing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Si'. Per te e' "normale" vederle, ma per loro e' "normale" non farlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: En este mundo, no existe solo una verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: ... That's hard.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: In questo mondo non esiste una sola verita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Qué complicado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: Yes ... It really is hard. Even Mommy has trouble finding the answers ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Che complicato...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Sí, es muy complicado. Hasta a mamá le cuesta a veces saber qué es correcto y qué no...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: But it's important to keep thinking. That's what I do ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Si', e' molto complicato. A volte anche alla mamma costa capire cosa e' giusto e cosa no...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Lo importante es no dejar de reflexionar. O eso es lo que hago yo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: Good morning.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: L'importante e' non smettere di riflettere. O almeno, e' quello che faccio io.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Buenos días.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: ... Good morning, Isla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Buongiorno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Buenos días, Isla...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: Were you able to think about things?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Buongiorno, Isla...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: ¿Has podido aclararte un poco?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: To be honest, I'm not sure if it's really sunk in yet.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Sei riuscita a fare un po' di chiarezza?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: No sé si he conseguido sacar algo en claro, la verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: Is she ... Is Lili Borea truly the enemy? I don't know anymore.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: A dire la verita', non so se sono riuscita a capirci qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: ¿De verdad es Lili Borea nuestra enemiga? Estoy indecisa...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: Exactly. Just what are we supposed to do?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Lili Borea e' davvero la nostra nemica? Sono indecisa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Lo sé. ¿Qué se supone que debemos hacer ahora?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: I mean, she attacked us. In any other circumstance, she would clearly be an enemy, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Lo so. Cosa dovremmo fare ora?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Ella nos atacó... No dudaría en calificarla como mi enemiga en cualquier otra situación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: I think that regardless of the circumstances, in order to achieve our mission, we must not hesitate to fight.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Lei ci ha attaccato... Non esiterei a definirla una mia nemica in qualsiasi altra situazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Creo que, a pesar de las circunstancias, no debemos dudar a la hora de luchar si lo que queremos es cumplir con la misión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: Well, well. I actually agree with the noble boy on somethin'.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Penso che, nonostante le circostanze, non dobbiamo esitare a combattere se vogliamo portare a termine la missione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Vaya, vaya... Por una vez estoy de acuerdo con el soldadito.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: Will feelin' bad for her change anythin'? Are you gonna let her kill you without a fight if she attacks us again?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Mah, mah... Per una volta sono d'accordo col soldatino.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: ¿Cambia algo que sintamos lástima por ella? ¿Dejarías que te mate si vuelve a atacarnos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: Tossin' out that naive way of thinkin' as soon as possible is for your own good.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Cambia qualcosa se ci dispiace per lei? La lascieresti ucciderti se ci attaccasse di nuovo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Harías bien en dejar a un lado ese idealismo infantil si quieres seguir con vida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: I know! I know, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Faresti bene a mettere da parte quell'idealismo infantile se vuoi restare in vita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: ¡Ya lo sabemos! Pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: U-um ... Everyone, take a deep breath ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Lo sappiamo gia'! Pero'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Chicos... ¿Y si... respiramos hondo?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: ... Hey, Yumia. What do you think we should do?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Ragazzi... E se... facciamo un respiro profondo?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Y bien, Yumia, ¿qué crees que deberíamos hacer?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: You're the alchemist, so I'd like to know your opinion.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Allora, Yumia, cosa pensi che dovremmo fare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Tú eres la alquimista. Me interesa tu opinión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: ... Yes, of course. Think ... I need to think ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Tu sei l'alchimista. La tua opinione mi interessa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Entiendo... Solo... necesito pensar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: I think that ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Capisco... Devo solo... riflettere...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Mi opinión es que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: In order to achieve our goals, we can't avoid fighting. ... I feel like it's our only option.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Il mio parere e' che...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: No podemos dejarnos ganar. Tenemos una misión que cumplir... Es nuestra única opción.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: Thinking about it, I may have been a little naive to just how much power and influence alchemy has.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Non possiamo farci sopraffare. Abbiamo una missione da portare a termine... E' la nostra unica opzione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: A decir verdad, sí que he llegado a idealizar el poder y el alcance de la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: I'm sure that as long as I continue to use alchemy, Lili Borea's hatred towards me won't disappear.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: A dire la verita', e' vero che sono arrivata a idealizzare il potere e la portata dell'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Mientras siga usando este poder, Lili Borea no dejará de aborrecerme.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: Just like how the animosity between the Silva and Neru won't end easily. Painful memories can't just be erased.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Finche' continuero' a usare questo potere, Lili Borea non smettera' di detestarmi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Del mismo modo que la tensión entre los Silva y las Neru no desaparecerá por las buenas. Los recuerdos dolorosos dejan huella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: Which is why I won't hesitate. ... For the sake of reaching the truth as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Proprio come la tensione tra i Silva e le Neru non scomparira' di buon grado. I ricordi dolorosi lasciano il segno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Por eso, no puedo dudar... o nunca conoceré la verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: ... We're not from Aladiss. We have no reason to fight Lili Borea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Per questo non posso esitare... o non conoscero' mai la verita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: No somos de Aladiss. No tenemos motivos para enfrentarnos a Lili Borea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: Especially after learning of the suffering and anger that compel her actions from the recording.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Non siamo di Aladiss. Non abbiamo motivi per affrontare Lili Borea.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Sobre todo ahora que hemos visto en el vial lo mucho que ha sufrido y qué la impulsa a actuar así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: Fighting her would be the easiest way to solve this, but ending it like that would feel wrong.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Soprattutto ora che abbiamo visto nella fiala quanto abbia sofferto e cosa la spinge ad agire cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Luchar contra ella sería la vía rápida, pero nos dejaría un amargo sabor de boca.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: I'd like to find a way for us to come to an understanding, whether through talking to her or some other means.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Combatterla sarebbe la strada piu' rapida, ma ci lascerebbe un sapore amaro in bocca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Me gustaría razonar con ella. No sé si hablando o si habrá otro modo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: However naive that may be ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Vorrei farla ragionare. Non so se parlandole o se ci sia un altro modo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Por muy idealista que pueda sonar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: So that's what you believe to be right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Per quanto possa sembrare idealista...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: ¿Crees que eso es lo correcto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: ... Understood. If that's how you feel, we'll follow your lead.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Pensi che sia la cosa giusta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: Right, everyone?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Entiendo... Si eso es lo que piensas, te seguiremos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: What will we do now?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Capisco... Se e' quello che pensi, ti seguiremo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: ¿Verdad que sí, equipo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: In any case, we can't ignore Lili Borea. We have to go after her.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Vero, squadra?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Y ahora, ¿qué hacemos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: On a related note, there have been two separate reports from the other Research Team members.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: E ora, cosa facciamo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Pues, a pesar de todo, no podemos ignorar a Lili Borea. Hay que ir tras ella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: They've been looking into Lili Borea's whereabouts ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Beh, nonostante tutto, non possiamo ignorare Lili Borea. Dobbiamo andare alla sua ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Me gustaría añadir que el equipo de investigación ha presentado dos informes sobre ella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: According to both the Welleks and the Neru, Lili Borea has a stronghold atop the cliffs to the south.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Vorrei aggiungere che la Squadra di Ricerca ha presentato due rapporti su di lei.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Han salido en su busca.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: On top of a cliff? How are we supposed to get there?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Sono usciti alla sua ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: En uno de ellos, los Welleks y las Neru coincidían en que Lili Borea se refugia en las colinas del sur.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: There's a giant, old elevator in the Neru's territory. We should ask Laurie for permission to use it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: In uno dei due, i Welleks e le Neru concordavano sul fatto che Lili Borea si rifugia nelle colline a sud.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: ¿En las colinas? ¿Y cómo vamos a llegar allí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: And the other report was?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Nelle colline? E come arriveremo li'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: En el territorio de las Neru existe un enorme ascensor, aunque es muy antiguo. Deberíamos pedirle permiso a Laurie para usarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: We found a key in the documents you brought yesterday. It seems to be from the Faltona Observatory to the east.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Nel territorio delle Neru si trova un enorme ascensore, anche se e' molto antico. Dovremmo chiedere a Laurie il permesso di usarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: ¿Y qué decía el otro informe?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: It's believed that long ago, alchemists used it as a base of sorts.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: E cosa diceva l'altro rapporto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Entre los documentos que conseguimos ayer, había una llave. Parece pertenecer al Observatorio Fatum Astrorum del este.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: This key was kept in a separate location as it unlocks the room where they kept their highly classified information.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Tra i documenti che abbiamo ottenuto ieri c'era una chiave. Sembra appartenere all'Osservatorio Fatum Astrorum a est.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Se comenta que, hace mucho tiempo, los alquimistas tenían allí una base.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: Interesting. It might be good to investigate that before going after Lili Borea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Si dice che, molto tempo fa, gli alchimisti avessero li' una base.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Guardaron esta llave a buen recaudo, ya que abre la sala donde almacenaban toda la información clasificada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..ref: ... We've all had plenty of rest. Let's resume our investigation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Hanno custodito questa chiave con cura, poiche' apre la stanza in cui conservavano tutte le informazioni classificate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Qué interesante. Merece la pena investigar lo que dices antes de ir tras Lili Borea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Che interessante. Vale la pena indagare su quello che dici prima di andare alla ricerca di Lili Borea.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..src: Hemos tenido tiempo de descansar... Es hora de volver a las obligaciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_043..dst: Abbiamo avuto tempo di riposare... E' ora di tornare ai nostri doveri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_060..src: Así que esto es el Observatorio Fatum Astrorum. Ojalá obtengamos más información sobre los mutantes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_060..ref: So this is the Faltona Observatory. It would be great if we can find out more about mutants here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_060..dst: Quindi questo e' l'Osservatorio Fatum Astrorum. Magari riusciamo a saperne di piu' sui mutanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_060..ref: Where are we supposed to use this key?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_060..dst: E dove si usa questa chiave?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_060..src: Echaremos un vistazo y lo averiguaremos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_060..ref: All we can do is walk around and look for it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_060..dst: Non ci resta che girare e cercare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_061..src: Yo no veo ninguna puerta cerrada... ¿Se habrá roto o algo así?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_061..ref: ... Looks like there aren't any locked doors around here. Maybe the door was already broken?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_061..dst: Io non vedo nessuna porta chiusa... Sara' stata forzata o qualcosa del genere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_061..src: Aunque ninguna habitación parecía guardar documentos ultrasecretos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_061..ref: None of the rooms we saw looked like they'd hold secret documents, though ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_061..dst: Pero' nessuna stanza sembrava custodire documenti ultrasegreti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_062..src: La estructura del edificio es muy curiosa. No me imaginaba que existiera este tipo de arquitectura en Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_062..ref: This building's construction sure is strange. To think they made stuff like this in Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_062..dst: La struttura dell'edificio e' davvero curiosa. Non immaginavo che ad Aladiss esistesse questo tipo di architettura.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_062..src: Echemos un vistazo por fuera para asegurarnos de no haber pasado por alto ninguna cerradura.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_062..ref: Let's check to make sure there aren't any spots a key might fit on the outside ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_062..dst: Diamo un'occhiata fuori per assicurarci di non aver tralasciato alcuna serratura.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_063..src: No hay puertas cerradas con llave...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_063..ref: There aren't any locked rooms we can use the key on ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_063..dst: Non ci sono stanze chiuse a chiave...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_063..src: Alguien la habrá abierto a patadas, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_063..ref: So then someone must've already busted it down, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_063..dst: Qualcuno l'avra' aperta a calci, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_063..src: Hay algo que no me quito de la cabeza... Si guardaban algo con tanto celo bajo llave...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_063..ref: Something's bothering me, though ... If it's so important that a key like this is necessary, then ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_063..dst: C'e' una cosa che non riesco a togliermi dalla testa... Se tenevano qualcosa sotto chiave con tanto zelo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_063..ref: Everyone, can you come with me for a moment?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_063..src: Mirad aquí. ¿No os parece que el exterior del edificio no encaja con el interior de la habitación que acabamos de examinar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_063..ref: Say, over there ... Doesn't the outside of the building look different from the inside of the room we searched?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_063..dst: Guardate qui. Non vi sembra che l'esterno dell'edificio non corrisponda all'interno della stanza che abbiamo appena esaminato?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_063..src: Pues... ahora que lo dices, dentro se veía más estrecha. ¿Habrá algo más?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_063..ref: ...! Now that you mention it, that room wasn't this wide. Could it actually continue deeper in?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_063..dst: Mah... ora che lo dici, dentro sembrava piu' stretta. Chissa' se c'e' qualcos'altro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_070..ref: It should go on beyond here, right?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_070..dst: E'-e' quello! L-la chiave va qui!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_070..ref: All right. Let's take a good look inside.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..src: Los alquimistas que trabajaban en este observatorio dejaron unas cuantas notas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..ref: These are records left behind by the alchemists who conducted research at this observatory.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..dst: Gli alchimisti che lavoravano in questo osservatorio hanno lasciato qualche appunto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..src: «Las guerras han cambiado Aladiss». «Nuestra tierra sometida a un poder inmenso y donde cada día hay más anomalías».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..ref: "The repeated wars have changed Aladiss." "Seized by strength, abnormalities increase by the day."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..dst: "Le guerre hanno cambiato Aladiss". "La nostra terra sottomessa a un potere immenso, dove ogni giorno crescono le anomalie".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..src: «El país trata los recuerdos de su pueblo como un objeto. Desprecian los sentimientos que radican en ellos».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..ref: "The country treats the memories of its people as mere objects, disregarding the sentiments that reside in them."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..dst: "Il paese tratta i ricordi del proprio popolo come oggetti. Disprezzano i sentimenti che in essi risiedono".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..src: «Nosotros somos diferentes. Seguimos a Marina y juramos por nuestro honor averiguar la verdad».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..ref: "We are different. Under Doctor Marina's lead, we swear on our honor to seek out truth."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..dst: "Noi siamo diversi. Seguiamo Marina e giuriamo sul nostro onore di scoprire la verita'".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..src: «No importan el destino ni tampoco las circunstancias. Nuestra alma no flaqueará».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..ref: "No matter where we go. No matter the circumstances. Our souls shall never waver."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..dst: "Non contano il destino ne' le circostanze. La nostra anima non vacillera'".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..src: Este grupo de alquimistas no veía con buenos ojos cómo funcionaba el país.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..ref: It seems there was a group of alchemists who disagreed with how the country ran things.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..dst: Questo gruppo di alchimisti non vedeva di buon occhio il funzionamento del paese.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..src: No sé mucho sobre alquimia, pero ¿qué relación guarda con el observatorio?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..ref: I don't know anything about alchemy, but ... what's the relationship between it and the observatory?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..dst: Non so molto di alchimia, ma che rapporto ha con l'osservatorio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..src: Solo podría responder con vagas suposiciones...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..ref: I can only make vague guesses ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..dst: Potrei solo fare delle supposizioni vaghe...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..src: «No importa el destino... Nuestra alma no flaqueará». Es decir, que el lugar era irrelevante, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..ref: "No matter where we go, our souls shall not waver." That means the location is irrelevant, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..dst: "Non importa la destinazione... La nostra anima non vacillera'". Cioe' il luogo era irrilevante, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..ref: Ugh, they should just say what they mean.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..src: Bueno, es un mensaje de personas de otra época.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..ref: Well, it is a message left behind by people from a long time ago.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..dst: Beh, e' un messaggio lasciato da persone di un'altra epoca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..src: No estaban de acuerdo con el país... ¿Tendrá algo que ver con lo que vimos la otra vez?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..ref: And them disagreeing with their country ... Could that be related to what we saw before?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..dst: Non erano d'accordo con il paese... Avra' qualcosa a che fare con quello che abbiamo visto l'altra volta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..src: Ah, ¿te refieres a esos alquimistas que huyeron del este?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..ref: ... Ah, you mean that thing about the "alchemists who fled from the east"?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..dst: Ah, ti riferisci a quegli alchimisti che fuggirono dall'est?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..src: Unos disidentes que intentaron escapar hacia el oeste... Claro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..ref: A dissenting faction that ran to the west to escape ... I see.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_080..dst: Dei dissidenti che cercarono di fuggire verso ovest... Capisco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..src: Esto parece una recopilación de datos sobre los mutantes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..ref: This seems to be a collection of information related to mutants.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..dst: Sembra una raccolta di dati sui mutanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..src: «Las Neru han ganado inteligencia gracias a los efectos del maná». «El imperio necesita mano de obra como esta».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..ref: "The Neru suddenly gained intelligence through the effects of mana." "The empire desires laborers like them."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..dst: "Le Neru hanno acquisito intelligenza grazie agli effetti del mana". "L'impero desidera manodopera come questa".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..src: «Usando a las Neru como punto de partida, el país ha aceptado iniciar una investigación que modifique el cuerpo y el alma de...».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..ref: "Using the case of the Neru as a reference, the country has begun research on modifying the body and soul of—"
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..dst: "Usando le Neru come riferimento, il paese ha avviato una ricerca per modificare il corpo e l'anima di...".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..src: El registro está dañado a partir de aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..ref: ... The record can only be read up to this point.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..dst: Il registro e' danneggiato da qui in poi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..src: ¿Hablarán de Lili Borea cuando dicen eso de modificar el cuerpo y el alma?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..ref: When they talk about research modifying the body and soul, do they mean like what happened to Lili Borea?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..dst: Parleranno di Lili Borea quando dicono quella cosa di modificare il corpo e l'anima?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..src: Probablemente. Entonces, ¿las mutaciones surgieron a partir de los experimentos con las Neru?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..ref: That seems likely. So this means that the Neru are what gave them the idea to start researching mutation ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..dst: Probabilmente. Quindi le mutazioni sono nate dagli esperimenti sulle Neru?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..src: Jugar así con vidas humanas... Es terrible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..ref: Playing around with life and calling it research ... That's terrible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..dst: Giocare cosi' con le vite umane... E' terribile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..src: No era terrible en Aladiss por aquel entonces. Sus valores eran muy diferentes a los que tenemos ahora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..ref: Sounds like it was no big deal in Aladiss back then, though. Their values were too different from ours now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..dst: A quanto pare allora ad Aladiss non era un gran problema. I loro valori erano molto diversi dai nostri attuali.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..src: (Lili Borea y Vésper... No había límites en los sacrificios que se llevaron a cabo en nombre de la prosperidad del país.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..ref: (Lili Borea, and Vesper too ... No sacrifice was too great compared to their country's prosperity.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..dst: (Lili Borea e pure Vesper... Non c'erano sacrifici troppo grandi per la prosperita' del paese.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..src: (¿Pensarían que lo que estaban haciendo era lo correcto?... No llego a comprenderlo.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..ref: (I wonder if they believed what they were doing was "right." ... I just don't understand any of it.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_090..dst: (Pensavano che cio' che facevano fosse giusto?... Non riesco proprio a capirlo.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..src: Estos registros hablan sobre la densidad de maná en Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..ref: These are records pertaining to the density of mana in Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..dst: Questi registri parlano della densita' di mana ad Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..src: «El desarrollo en nuestro país de las artes relacionadas con el maná es sobresaliente, sobre todo, de la alquimia. Sin embargo, conlleva grandes peligros».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..ref: "Our country's development of mana arts, particularly alchemy, is remarkable, but it also brings great danger."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..dst: "Lo sviluppo delle arti legate al mana nel nostro paese e' notevole, soprattutto per quanto riguarda l'alchimia. Tuttavia comporta grandi pericoli".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..src: «En los últimos años, la densidad de maná en el aire ha crecido». «Creemos que se debe al uso generalizado de este recurso».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..ref: "In recent years, the density of mana in the air has risen." "The cause is believed to be the widespread use of mana."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..dst: "Negli ultimi anni, la densita' di mana nell'aria e' aumentata". "Crediamo che sia dovuta all'uso diffuso di questa risorsa".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..src: «El maná concentrado deteriora la psique humana. Los ciudadanos del imperio han comenzado a quejarse de algunos síntomas».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..ref: "The dense mana eats away at a person's psyche. The citizens of the empire began to complain of symptoms."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..dst: "Il mana concentrato logora la psiche umana. I cittadini dell'impero hanno iniziato a lamentare alcuni sintomi".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..src: «Al principio eran leves, como pesadillas o una fatiga persistente...».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..ref: "At first, most people complained of light symptoms, such as nightmares, and persistent fatigue ..."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..dst: "All'inizio erano lievi, come incubi o una stanchezza persistente...".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..src: «Pero, a medida que las zonas de maná fueron aumentando en densidad, también se intensificaron los síntomas más graves. Hay quien hasta sufrió alucinaciones».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..ref: "But as the mana density in areas increased, so too did complaints of serious symptoms, such as hallucinations."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..dst: "Ma, man mano che la densita' del mana nelle zone aumentava, si sono intensificati anche i sintomi piu' gravi. C'e' chi ha persino sofferto di allucinazioni".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..src: «Es de obligada necesidad controlar la densidad del maná. El país está considerando medidas desesperadas».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..ref: "Proper management of mana density is imperative. The country is already looking into taking drastic measures."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..dst: "E' imperativo controllare la densita' del mana. Il paese sta gia' valutando misure drastiche".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..src: «Por si fuera poco, los humanos no son los únicos afectados por estos efectos negativos...».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..ref: "In addition, it appears that humans are not the only ones impacted by the negative effects—"
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..dst: "Per di piu', sembra che gli umani non siano gli unici colpiti da questi effetti negativi...".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..src: El resto no se puede leer.
Un aumento de la densidad... Me pregunto si se referirán a las primeras fases de las zonas de vínculo de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..ref: Rising mana density ... I wonder if that was something like the initial stages of manabound areas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..dst: Un aumento della densita'... Saranno le fasi iniziali delle zone legate al mana?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..src: Hablaban de mantener el control... ¿Serían conscientes del problema?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..ref: There was mention of properly managing it and such ... Does that mean they were aware of the problem?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..dst: Parlavano di tenerlo sotto controllo... Voleva dire che erano al corrente del problema?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..src: S-si ese era el caso, ¿cómo acabó Aladiss en este estado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..ref: I-if they were, then why is Aladiss like this now?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..dst: S-se era cosi', perche' Aladiss e' finita in questo stato?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..src: O esas medidas fallaron o hubo algo que se les escapó. Con estos datos, cuesta adivinarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..ref: Either their countermeasures failed or somethin' else happened. Hard to say with what we have on hand.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..dst: O quelle contromisure fallirono o successe altro. Con questi dati, e' difficile dirlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..src: Me ha llamado la atención que dijeran que no solo los humanos se vieron afectados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..ref: Something else stuck out to me as well. "Humans are not the only ones impacted by the negative effects."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..dst: Mi ha colpito che dicessero che non sono stati colpiti solo gli umani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..src: Hablan de otras criaturas no humanas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..ref: Things that aren't human would mean ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_100..dst: Significa creature che non sono umane...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..ref: W-well, we investigated pretty much everything we could ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..dst: B-be', ormai abbiamo finito di fare ricerche...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..src: ¡Fiiiu! Regresemos con lo que podamos a la base y allí lo clasificaremos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..ref: Phew ... Let's take what we found back to the base and get it all sorted out properly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..dst: Fiuuu! Torniamo alla base con quello che possiamo e li' lo classifichiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..src: Hay alquimistas que huyeron de la capital para escapar del yugo del país...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..ref: Alchemists who fled the capital to escape the nation's control ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..dst: Ci sono alchimisti fuggiti dalla capitale per sfuggire al giogo del paese...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..src: E investigaron medios para crear mano de obra que beneficiara al país...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..ref: Research into creating laborers to benefit the country ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..dst: E studiarono dei mezzi per creare manodopera a beneficio del paese...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..src: El desarrollo de nuevas tecnologías provocó un aumento en la densidad del maná...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..ref: Rising mana density due to the development of new technologies ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..dst: Lo sviluppo di nuove tecnologie causo' un aumento nella densita' del mana...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..src: Por mucha información que hayamos conseguido, hay cosas que desconocemos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..ref: Even with this information, there are still a lot of things we don't understand ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..dst: Per quante informazioni abbiamo raccolto, ci sono ancora tante cose che non sappiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..src: Sin embargo, tengo la sensación de que estamos más cerca de saber qué tramaban los alquimistas de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..ref: But I feel like we've gotten a glimpse of what the alchemists in Aladiss were up to.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..dst: Tuttavia, ho la sensazione che siamo piu' vicini a scoprire cosa tramavano gli alchimisti di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..src: Jo... Pero cuantas más pistas encontramos, más turbio se vuelve todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..ref: But it's like ... the more we find, the darker things get ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..dst: Uffa... Ma piu' indizi troviamo, piu' tutto diventa torbido.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..src: En mi opinión, todos esos alquimistas que se dejaron manipular por los peces gordos por un supuesto interés nacional son personas horribles.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..ref: Alchemists manipulated by country leadership caught up in national interest. They're all awful if you ask me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..dst: Secondo me, tutti quegli alchimisti che si sono lasciati manipolare dai pezzi grossi per un presunto interesse nazionale sono persone orribili.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..src: (Me pregunto si al final me alegraré de haber averiguado todo esto...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..ref: (I wonder if I'll be glad I learned all this once everything is said and done ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_110..dst: (Mi chiedo se alla fine saro' contenta di aver scoperto tutto questo...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_120..src: Laurie, muchas gracias por todo. La información que nos has brindado es de vital importancia para nosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_120..ref: Laurie, thank you so much for your help earlier. You gave us an extremely important lead.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_120..dst: Laurie, grazie mille per tutto. L'informazione che ci hai fornito e' di vitale importanza per noi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_120..src: Gracias a ti... por el néctar. Ahora... podemos obtenerlo fácilmente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_120..ref: Thank you, thank you. Nectar. Is now. Easy to obtain.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_120..dst: Grazie a te... per il nettare. Ora... possiamo ottenerlo facilmente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_120..src: Siento tener que pedirte otro favor, ¿tendrías tiempo para escucharnos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_120..ref: I hate to ask another favor, but would you please hear us out?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_120..dst: Mi dispiace doverti chiedere un altro favore, avresti tempo per ascoltarci?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_120..src: Sí. Tenéis... permiso. Usad... el Gran Elevador.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_120..ref: Permission, permission. You are free to use. The Great Elevator.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_120..dst: Si'. Avete... il permesso. Usate... il Grande Ascensore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_120..src: Sin embargo. Sin embargo. Lili Borea... es despiadada. Enfrentarse a ella... es peligroso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_120..ref: However, however ... Lili Borea. Is vicious. Fighting her. Is dangerous.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_120..dst: Tuttavia. Tuttavia. Lili Borea... e' spietata. Affrontarla... e' pericoloso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_120..ref: We know. Especially in our case.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_120..src: Vayamos al Gran Elevador. No podemos dejar que Lili Borea se escape.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_120..ref: Let's head to the Great Elevator. We can't allow Lili Borea to run rampant.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_120..dst: Andiamo al Grande Ascensore. Non possiamo lasciare che Lili Borea fugga.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: Wh-what happened?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Cosa vi hanno detto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: Danger, danger. Go back. Quickly!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Pericolo. Pericolo. Indietro! Veloci!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: Hey, what's all the fuss about?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Eh? Ma perche' tutto questo trambusto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..src: Un monstruo... fuerte. Un enemigo. Regresad... a la aldea. Pedid... refuerzos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: A strong monster. An enemy. Appeared. Return to. The settlement. Call for. Reinforcements.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Un mostro... potente. Un nemico. Tornate... al villaggio. Chiamate... i rinforzi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: A strong monster? Could that be ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Un mostro? Sara'...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Yumia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: Lili Borea! You're here, aren't you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Lili Borea! Sei tu, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: I'm terribly sorry to disappoint you all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Mi dispiace deludervi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: Wha—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Cosa...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: A different monster?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Un altro mostro?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: It can speak! You're a mutant, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: E sa parlare! Sei un mutante, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..src: Vaya, hace tiempo que no me llamaban así...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: ... Now that is something I haven't been called in quite a while.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Oh, e' da parecchio tempo che non mi chiamavano cosi'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..src: Saludos, miembros del equipo de investigación de Aladiss. Me presento: soy Corleonis. Encantado de conoceros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: Greetings, members of the Aladiss Research Team. My name is Corleonis. It is a pleasure to meet you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Saluti, membri della Squadra di Ricerca di Aladiss. Mi presento: sono Corleonis. Piacere di conoscervi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: (This guy knows about us?!)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: (Sa chi siamo?!)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: ... Do you have business with us?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Cosa vuoi da noi?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..src: No os agitéis, hoy vengo en son de paz. Solo quería pasarme a saludaros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: Do not be alarmed, I have no intention to fight you. Today I simply came to say hello.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Non agitatevi, oggi vengo in son di pace. Volevo solo farvi un saluto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..src: ¿Y deberíamos creerte? No es la primera vez que noto tu presencia cerca.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: Or so you say, but I've sensed your presence before.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: E dovremmo crederti? Non e' la prima volta che sento la tua presenza nei paraggi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..src: Llevas siguiéndonos desde que entramos en la región de Syvashi, ¿me equivoco?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: You've been monitoring us ever since we entered the Sivash region, haven't you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Ci stai seguendo da quando siamo entrati nella regione di Syvashi, sbaglio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: M-monitoring us?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Se-seguendoci?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: Who could say?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Chissa'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..src: No obstante, me sorprende que hayáis aprendido tanto sobre los mutantes en el breve tiempo que lleváis en Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: ... However, to think that you've learned of mutants within such a short time of stepping foot into Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Ciononostante, mi sorprende che abbiate appreso cosi' tanto sui mutanti nel breve tempo in cui siete ad Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..src: Ese equipo de investigación debe de ser todo un portento. ¿O acaso es obra de la alquimia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: You must belong to quite the outstanding Research Team. Was this also the work of alchemy?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: La vostra Squadra di Ricerca dev'essere un portento. O forse e' opera dell'alchimia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: ... What is your goal? Why have you been monitoring us?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Cosa vuoi? Perche' ci stai seguendo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: I have but one goal ... To restore Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Cosa voglio? Beh... restaurare Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: Restore?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Restaurarla?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..src: No quiero retrasaros en vuestras pesquisas. Por favor, continuad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: I do not intend to block your path. Please, carry on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Non voglio intralciare le vostre ricerche. Per favore, continuate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..src: La persona que andáis buscando os lleva un poco de ventaja. Aunque me atrevería a decir que está sumida en una profunda rabia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: The person you seek is up ahead. Although, she has lost herself to rage.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: La persona che cercate vi ha un po' di vantaggio. Anche se oserei dire che e' in preda a una profonda rabbia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..src: ¡Habéis logrado animar el ambiente! Si lográis sobrevivir, puede que nos volvamos a ver.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: Things certainly have gotten interesting. If you survive, perhaps we shall meet again.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Avete saputo rendere le cose interessanti! Se sopravvivete, potrebbe darsi che ci rivedremo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: Just who was he ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Chi era quello?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..src: ¿Cómo sabemos que no vamos directos a una trampa? Podría estar compinchado con Lili Borea para tendernos una emboscada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: Are we sure this isn't a trap? Maybe he joined forces with Lili Borea to gang up on us?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Come facciamo a sapere che non andiamo dritti in una trappola? Potrebbe essersi alleato con Lili Borea per tenderci un'imboscata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..src: Nos lleva siguiendo un buen rato. Si quisiera atacarnos, ya lo habría hecho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: He's been on our tail the whole time. If he wanted to attack us, he would've done it already.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Ci segue da un bel po'. Se volesse attaccarci, l'avrebbe gia' fatto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..src: Es muy astuto... Ha sabido esquivar por completo la cuestión de por qué nos sigue.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: I wanted to ask why he's been tailing us, but he dodged the question ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: E' molto astuto... Ha saputo scansare completamente la questione del perche' ci segue.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: Safe? Are you all right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Siete al sicuro? State bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..src: Sí, no ha habido enfrentamiento. Tranquilas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: Yes, we didn't get into a fight. You all can rest easy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Si', non ci sono stati scontri. Tranquille.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: I see, I see ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Capisco... Capisco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..src: Debéis ser... cautelosos. Nunca habíamos visto... a ese monstruo... por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: You need to be. Cautious. Going forward. We have never seen. That monster before.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Dovete essere... prudenti. Non avevamo mai visto... quel mostro... da queste parti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..src: Entonces, es cierto que nos seguía a nosotros. Pero ¿por qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: Then he really has been following only us ... But why?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Allora e' vero, seguiva proprio noi. Ma perche'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..src: Vamos. Si nos quedamos aquí, nunca saldremos de dudas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: Let's go up. If we don't move forward, we'll never learn the answer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: Andiamo. Se restiamo qui, non avremo mai una risposta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..src: Es hora de enfrentarnos a Lili Borea...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..ref: ... It's time to face Lili Borea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_121..dst: E' ora di affrontare Lili Borea...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: ¡Lili Borea!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: Lili Borea!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: Lili Borea!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: ¿Habéis venido a matarme?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: You've come here to kill me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: Siete venuti ad uccidermi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: No nos echaremos atrás ahora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: We need to push forward.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: Non ci tireremo indietro adesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: Sabemos qué te ocurrió y por qué estás tan enfadada... Sabemos las barbaridades que te hicieron los alquimistas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: We know about your past, and your anger ... We know the crimes that alchemists committed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: Sappiamo cosa ti e' successo e perche' sei cosi' arrabbiata... Sappiamo delle atrocita' che ti hanno fatto gli alchimisti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: Sin embargo... Y por mucho que nos pese...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: However ... No, exactly because of that ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: Tuttavia... E per quanto ci dispiace...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: Necesitamos conocer la verdad. Si decides interponerte en nuestro camino, nos veremos obligados a abrirnos paso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: We need to learn the truth. If you insist on standing in our way, we will have to move you aside.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: Abbiamo bisogno di conoscere la verita'. Se decidi di metterti sul nostro cammino, saremo costretti ad aprirenci una strada.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: No hemos venido a luchar... Queremos hablar contigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: ... We didn't come here to fight. We came to talk to you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: Non siamo venuti a combattere... Vogliamo parlare con te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: Sabemos por qué odias la alquimia y lo que te ocurrió.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: We know that you hate alchemy, and we know about your past.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: Sappiamo perche' odi l'alchimia e cosa ti e' successo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: Pero ¡nosotros no somos así! ¡Yo no soy así! ¡Nunca usaría la alquimia para hacer el mal!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: But we're different! I'm different! I would never use alchemy like that!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: Ma noi non siamo cosi'! Io non sono cosi'! Non userei mai l'alchimia per fare del male!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: Ja, ja, ja... ¡JA, JA, JA, JA, JA! ¿Cómo te atreves a hablar como si lo supieras todo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: ... Heh.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: Ah, ah, ah... AH, AH, AH, AH, AH! Come osi parlare come se sapessi tutto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: Ja, ja, ja... ¡JA, JA, JA, JA, JA! ¿Queréis hablar? ¡No me hagas reír!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: Heh heh, aha ... AHAHAHA! How dare you talk as if you know everything!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: Ah, ah, ah... AH, AH, AH, AH, AH! Volete parlare? Non fatemi ridere!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: Sabéis las atrocidades que cometieron conmigo y, a pesar de eso, no os avergonzáis al mirarme a la cara...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: Heh heh, aha ... AHAHAHA! You've come to talk, you say? Hilarious!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: Sapete delle atrocita' che hanno commesso su di me e, nonostante cio', non vi vergognate a guardarmi in faccia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: ¡Tenéis agallas, lo reconozco!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: You know what they've done to me, yet you still shamelessly show your faces before me...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: Ne avete del fegato, lo ammetto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: ¡Escucha, Lili Borea! ¡No quiero luchar!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: You've got nerve, I'll give you that much!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: Ascolta, Lili Borea! Non voglio combattere!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: ¡CÁLLATE!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: Lili Borea! Listen, I don't want to fight you!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: STA' ZITTA!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: Vosotros los alquimistas NUNCA quisisteis escucharme.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: ... JUST SHUT UP!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: Voi alchimisti non avete MAI voluto ascoltarmi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: Por mucho que gritara, llorara y suplicara, ¡nunca hicisteis caso!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: You alchemists never ONCE listened to me!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: Per quanto gridassi, piangessi e implorassi, non mi avete mai dato ascolto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: ¿Y ahora queréis hablar? ¡Solo pensáis en vuestros intereses!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: No matter how I screamed and cried and pleaded, you never listened!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: E ora volete parlare? Pensate solo ai vostri interessi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: ¡Es lo que más odio de vosotros!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: And yet now you want to talk?! You selfish bastards!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: E' quello che odio di piu' di voi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: Yumia, déjalo. No tenemos otra opción.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: This is why I hate you alchemists!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: Yumia, lascia stare. Non abbiamo altra scelta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: Lo sé...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: Yumia, that's enough. We have no other choice.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: Lo so...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: (¿Es cierto que no hay ninguna alternativa? ¿Habré tomado las decisiones correctas?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: ... I know.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: (E' davvero vero che non c'e' alcuna alternativa? Avro' preso le decisioni giuste?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..src: (Ya es tarde para echarse atrás. ¡Debo actuar con resolución!)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..ref: (Is this really the only path forward? Were my choices and actions truly right?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_130..dst: (E' troppo tardi per ripensarci. Devo agire con determinazione!)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: ¡Ggg!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: Guh ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Ghh!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: Dime, Lili Borea...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: ... Tell me, Lili Borea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Dimmi, Lili Borea...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: ¿Cuál es tu objetivo? ¿Quién está detrás de todo esto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: What are all of you trying to achieve? Who is behind this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Qual e' il tuo obiettivo? Chi c'e' dietro a tutto questo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: ¿Acaso crees que tengo potestad para tramar algo?... Yo solo soy una marioneta usada por un alquimista interesado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: ... As if I was given the right to plot anything. I'm just a tool used by selfish alchemists.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Pensi forse che io abbia il potere di tramare qualcosa?... Sono solo una marionetta usata da un alchimista interessato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: Otro de tantos... El país se erigió sobre vuestro egoísmo y fue ese mismo egoísmo el que lo llevó a la ruina...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: Those alchemists ... The country was born of their selfishness and that same selfishness turned it to ashes ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Uno dei tanti... Questo paese sorse sul vostro egoismo, e fu proprio quell'egoismo a trascinarlo alla rovina...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: Y ahora, no contentos con todo el daño causado, ¡quieren volver a esos días aciagos! ¡A ese país pisoteado!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: And now in their selfishness they are trying to revive it, without so much as looking at what they have trampled!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: E ora, non contenti di tutto il danno causato, vogliono tornare a quei giorni funesti! A quel paese calpestato!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: ¿Quieren recuperar Aladiss?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: "To restore Aladiss" ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Vogliono recuperare Aladiss?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: Ja... Veo que ya conocéis a Corleonis. ¿O quizás a Basilius?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: ... Hah, so you met Corleonis. Or maybe it was Basilius?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Ah... Vedo che conoscete gia' Corleonis. O forse Basilius?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: ¿Basi... lius?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: Basi ... lius ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Basi... lius?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: ¿Ha dicho... Basilius?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: ... Did she just say Basilius?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Ha detto... Basilius?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: Así se llamaba el último emperador de Aladiss, el que murió en el Gran Desastre hace siglos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: That's the name of the last emperor of the Aladissian Empire, who died in the Great Disaster centuries ago ...
