eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Cosi' si chiamava l'ultimo imperatore di Aladiss, colui che mori' nel Grande Disastro secoli fa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: Je... Sí, el mismo. ¡Todavía no sabéis nada!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: ... Heh. Yes. Yes, that's right. You all came here knowing nothing!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Eh... Si', proprio lui. Non sapete ancora niente!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: En cierto modo os envidio. ¡Sois tan ingenuos que me dais ganas de vomitar! ¡Vivís felices en vuestra ignorancia e inocencia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: Aaah, I'm so jealous of you that I could vomit! Living completely carefree in utter ignorance and innocence!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: In un certo senso vi invidio. Siete cosi' ingenui da farmi venire voglia di vomitare! Vivete felici nella vostra ignoranza e innocenza!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: Un hecho que parece repetirse en quienes usan a los demás como marionetas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: Those who take from others are always like that ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Una cosa che sembra ripetersi in coloro che usano gli altri come marionette...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: ¡Tú! ¡Y Basilius también! Los alquimistas solo pensáis en vuestros intereses.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: You! And Basilius, too! Alchemists only ever think about themselves!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Tu! E anche Basilius! Voi alchimisti pensate solo ai vostri interessi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: ¡Abusáis de vuestro poder para satisfacer vuestros propios deseos y no os importa cuánto dolor provocáis a vuestro paso!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: Using your power to fulfill your desires, ignoring the pain you inflict!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Abusate del vostro potere per soddisfare i vostri desideri e non vi importa quanto dolore causate sul vostro cammino!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: ¡PUES SE ACABÓ!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: NO MORE!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: E ORA E' FINITA!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: ¡Mirad este espantoso cuerpo! ¡Esto es obra de la alquimia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: Look at this disgusting body! This, this is alchemy's scar!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Guardate questo corpo orrendo! E' opera dell'alchimia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: ¿Me miráis y veis a una humana? ¡Este cuerpo está marcado con las heridas que me habéis infligido!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: Do you look at me and see a person?! This mangled body that you've carved with wounds!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Mi guardate e vedete un'umana? Questo corpo e' segnato dalle ferite che mi avete inflitto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: That's—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Quella cosa...!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: Aun así... sigues siendo humana. Tu corazón siempre lo será.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: ... Even so, you are still a human. Your heart will always be.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Eppure... tu rimani un'umana. Il tuo cuore lo sara' sempre.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: Debe de existir un modo de ayudarte. Si recurrimos a la alquimia... ¡quizás algún día sea posible!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: There has to be a way to help you. With alchemy, someday ... It must be possible!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Deve esistere un modo per aiutarti. Se ricorriamo all'alchimia... forse un giorno sara' possibile!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: Suenas como él. Incluso tenéis la misma expresión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: You and him say the same things. Make the same face.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Sembri proprio lui. Avete perfino la stessa espressione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: ¿Él?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: Him?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Lui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: Ya veo... Te has quedado sin palabras.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: ... That's right. You can't say anything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Capisco... Sei rimasta senza parole.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: Cuando el plan llegue a su fin, mi cuerpo recuperará su forma original. Eso fue lo que me prometió Basilius.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: When the plan is complete, my body will also return to how it once was. Basilius promised me that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Quando il piano giungera' al termine, il mio corpo riacquistera' la sua forma originale. E' quello che mi ha promesso Basilius.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: Durante un tiempo, esa promesa fue mi única razón para vivir...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: ... That promise was my only reason to live.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Per un certo tempo, quella promessa e' stata la mia unica ragione per vivere...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: Aunque ha llovido tanto desde entonces que empiezo a quitarme la idea de la cabeza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: Though, so many nights have passed since that irresponsible promise that I can no longer count them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Ma da allora ne e' passata di acqua sotto i ponti, e comincio a togliermi quell'idea dalla testa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: Por favor... Devolvedme mi cuerpo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: ... Please. Give me back my body.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Per favore... Restituitemi il mio corpo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: ¿Ya habéis acabado con vuestra charla amistosa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: Is your pleasant chat finished?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Avete gia' finito la vostra amichevole chiacchierata?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: ¡Grrg! ¡Se acabó! ¡Estoy harta! Le pondré fin a esto ahora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: Heh ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Grrg! Basta! Ne ho abbastanza! Mettero' fine a tutto questo adesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: Eso sería un problema, querida. Por muy harta que estés, yo tengo la última palabra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: Grgh ... Stop! I'm done! Let it end here!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Sarebbe un problema, cara. Per quanto tu ne sia stufa, l'ultima parola spetta a me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: ¡Maldito seas...!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: Hm, that is quite troubling. Even if you are fine with it, I am not.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Maledetto...!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: Lamentándolo mucho, nos vamos, alquimista y compañía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: D-damn it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Con nostro grande dispiacere, ce ne andiamo, alchimista e compagnia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: ¡Espera!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: We'll be taking our leave now, alchemist and company.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Aspetta!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..src: Hasta la próxima.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..ref: Wait!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_140..dst: Alla prossima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_141..src: Yumia, tendremos que despejar la zona de vínculo de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_141..ref: Yumia, we need to clear the manabound area first.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_141..dst: Yumia, dovremo ripulire l'area legata al mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..src: ¿Qué debería haberle dicho a Lili Borea?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..ref: What should I have said to Lili Borea?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..dst: Cosa avrei dovuto dire a Lili Borea?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..src: Los alquimistas solo piensan en sus intereses y no les importa el dolor que generan a su paso...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..ref: "Alchemists only ever think about themselves," "ignoring the pain they inflict" ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..dst: Gli alchimisti pensano solo ai loro interessi e non importa loro il dolore che generano sul loro cammino...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..src: No puedo evitar pensar que tiene razón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..ref: I couldn't say that she was wrong ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..dst: Non posso fare a meno di pensare che abbia ragione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..src: Deseaba con todas mis fuerzas demostrar el potencial de la alquimia y ni siquiera la entiendo del todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..ref: I was so eager to prove alchemy's value without knowing anything about what it is ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..dst: Volevo con tutte le mie forze dimostrare il potenziale dell'alchimia, eppure non la capisco del tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..src: No pensé en todos los sacrificios que se hicieron. Creía ciegamente en la alquimia porque era como creer en mi madre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..ref: I didn't think about the people who were sacrificed, I just believed in alchemy because I believed in my mother.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..dst: Non ho pensato a tutti i sacrifici compiuti. Credevo ciecamente nell'alchimia perche' era come credere in mia madre.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..src: Nada de lo que ella ha dicho es tu culpa, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..ref: None of the things she talked about were your fault, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..dst: Nulla di cio' che ha detto e' colpa tua, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..src: Deberíamos poner al tanto al jefe Erhard sobre Lili Borea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..ref: For now, we should report to Chief Erhard about Lili Borea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..dst: Dovremmo informare il capo Erhard riguardo a Lili Borea.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..src: Es verdad. Vamos, Yumia, es hora de irse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_150..dst: E' vero. Andiamo, Yumia, e' ora di partire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: Mutantes, el emperador de Aladiss y el deseo de reinstaurar el imperio...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: ... Mutants, the name of the Aladissian emperor, and the desire to "restore Aladiss" ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: Mutanti, l'imperatore di Aladiss e il desiderio di restaurare l'impero...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: Ah... Estoy muy desconcertado. Es demasiado para asimilarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: *Sigh* ... I'm at a loss. So much has happened, I can't make sense of it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: Ah... Sono molto disorientato. E' troppo da assimilare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: Y, por vuestras caras, el sentimiento es mutuo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: Judging by your faces, the feeling is mutual.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: E, dalle vostre facce, vedo che il sentimento e' reciproco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: ¿Estás pensando en rendirte?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: Do you want to quit?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: Stai pensando di arrenderti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: Ni lo pienses; debéis seguir adelante. Nos queda mucho por descubrir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: That would be ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: Non ci pensare nemmeno; dovete andare avanti. Ci resta ancora molto da scoprire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: Todavía no sabemos nada de la alquimia ni de Aladiss... Ni siquiera sabemos ya qué está bien o qué está mal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: Regardless, you have to keep moving forward. We don't know anything yet.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: Non sappiamo ancora nulla dell'alchimia ne' di Aladiss... Non sappiamo nemmeno piu' cosa sia giusto o sbagliato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: Viniste aquí a conocer la verdad por mucho que te duela, ¿no dijiste eso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: We don't know about alchemy, or Aladiss ... What is wrong, or what is right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: Sei venuta qui per conoscere la verita', per quanto ti possa dolere, non l'hai detto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: Es fácil darle la espalda a la verdad, pero hay cosas que solo se aprenden cuando estamos dispuestos a enfrentarnos a ellas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: You came here to learn the truth, no matter how ugly it may be, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: E' facile voltare le spalle alla verita', ma ci sono cose che si imparano solo quando siamo disposti ad affrontarle.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: No cabe rendirse. Tampoco tú. Una vez me dijiste que no podíamos quedarnos de brazos cruzados y esperar a que las cosas sucedan sin más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: It's easy to look away from the truth. But there are some things that can only be gained by facing it head-on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: Non si puo' arrendersi. Nemmeno tu. Una volta mi hai detto che non potevamo restare con le mani in mano ad aspettare che le cose accadessero da se'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: («Juzga por ti misma qué es lo correcto...».)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: We can't stop here, and neither can you. "Nothing will happen if we don't even try to learn." You told me that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: ("Giudica da te stessa cosa sia giusto...".)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: No quiero rendirme. Quiero creer en la alquimia y en mi madre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: ("Learn how to judge what is right for yourself" ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: Non voglio arrendermi. Voglio credere nell'alchimia e in mia madre.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: Bien dicho, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: I think I want to move forward. To believe in alchemy, and in my mom.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: Ben detto, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: Estoy contigo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: Well said, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: Sono con te...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: Tuve mis dudas desde el principio... Pensaba que la alquimia era peligrosa y que no debíamos depender de ella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: ... I want to too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: Ho avuto dubbi fin dall'inizio... Pensavo che l'alchimia fosse pericolosa e che non dovessimo dipendere da essa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: Es cierto que algunos alquimistas la usaron para hacer el mal en el pasado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: I always had doubts from the very start ... I thought that alchemy was dangerous, and couldn't be trusted.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: E' vero che alcuni alchimisti la hanno usata per fare del male in passato...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: Pero la señorita Yumia es diferente. ¡Nos ha ayudado con su alquimia muchísimas veces!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: It's true that alchemists may have done bad things in the past ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: Ma la signorina Yumia e' diversa. Ci ha aiutato con la sua alchimia tantissime volte!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: Ja, ja, ja, ¡me lo has quitado de la boca! Yo iba a decir lo mismo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: But Miss Yumia is different. She's helped us with her alchemy so many times!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: Ah, ah, ah, mi hai tolto le parole di bocca! Stavo per dire la stessa cosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: Es evidente que la alquimia entraña riesgos, pero del mismo modo que un arma o la medicina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: ... Ahaha, looks like I was beaten to it! I wanted to say the same thing!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: E' evidente che l'alchimia comporta dei rischi, ma al pari di un'arma o della medicina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: Deja de rayarte tanto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: Sure, you could say that alchemy is dangerous, but in that sense it's just like weapons or medicine.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: Smettila di rimuginare cosi' tanto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: Cualquier chalado podría llevar armas, pero no todo el que lleva un arma es un chalado, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: You just gotta stop overthinkin' it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: Qualsiasi squilibrato potrebbe portare armi, ma non tutti quelli che portano un'arma sono squilibrati, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: Si estamos todos de acuerdo, no hay nada más que decir. Cada vez estamos más cerca de la capital de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: Bad guys can have weapons, but that doesn't make everyone with a sword evil, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: Se siamo tutti d'accordo, non c'e' altro da dire. Siamo sempre piu' vicini alla capitale di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: Sí, no hay tiempo que perder. Juntos descubriremos la verdad sobre el Imperio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: Everyone ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: Si', non c'e' tempo da perdere. Insieme scopriremo la verita' sull'Impero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: ¡De acuerdo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: Well, if that settles things, then let's get going. We're steadily getting closer to Aladiss's capital.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: D'accordo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..src: Entonces... Seguiremos adelante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..ref: Yeah, we have no time to sit around. We'll definitely reach the truth behind Aladiss together.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_160..dst: Allora... Andremo avanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_170..src: La región de Auruma queda al otro lado, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_170..ref: The Auruma region is beyond here, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_170..dst: La regione di Auruma e' al di la', vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_170..ref: Just how are we gonna get there, though?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_170..dst: E come faremo ad arrivare li'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_170..src: No recordarás alguna receta para, no sé, fabricar un barco o para que nos crezcan alas, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_170..ref: Can't you do somethin' with alchemy? Like makin' a boat, or flyin' us across.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_170..dst: Non ti ricorderai qualche ricetta per, non so, costruire una barca o farci crescere delle ali, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_170..ref: I don't know anything as convenient as that ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_170..src: Busquemos por los alrededores. Quizá haya algo aquí que nos ayude a cruzar el océano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_170..ref: Let's just look around for now. Maybe we can find something to help us cross the ocean.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_170..dst: Cerchiamo nei dintorni. Forse qui c'e' qualcosa che ci aiuti ad attraversare l'oceano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_180a.ref: What was this tower made for?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_180a.src: No parece un faro... ¿Quizás fuera una atalaya? Aunque tampoco veo que tenga puesto de vigilancia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_180a.ref: It doesn't seem like a lighthouse ... Maybe it's a watchtower? But I don't see a place for anyone to stand.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_180a.dst: Non sembra un faro... Forse era una torre di vedetta? Pero' non vedo nemmeno una postazione di guardia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_180a.src: O un campanario... o un monumento. Sea lo que sea, nunca he visto en Eustella nada que se le parezca.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_180a.ref: A bell tower ... No, maybe it's a monument? Whatever it is, I've never seen anything like it in Eustella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_180a.dst: O un campanile... o un monumento. Qualunque cosa sia, non ho mai visto niente di simile a Eustella.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_180a.src: Me cuesta creer que levantaran algo así sin motivo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_180a.ref: I find it hard to believe that something this big would be made with no particular purpose.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_180a.dst: Trovo difficile credere che abbiano eretto una cosa simile senza motivo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_180c.src: ¡Mirad, he encontrado una cosa increíble! Yumia, ¿sabes lo que es?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_180c.ref: Whoa, there's something incredible here! Yumia, do you know what it is?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_180c.dst: Guardate, ho trovato una cosa incredibile! Yumia, sai dirmi cos'e'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_180c.src: ¿Será una unidad de control? Parece que funciona con maná... Es un artilugio bastante grande.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_180c.ref: Some kind of control unit, maybe? It looks like it's powered by mana. It's pretty large-scale, too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_180c.dst: Sara' una specie di unita' di controllo? Sembra funzionare a mana... E' un marchingegno piuttosto grande.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_180c.ref: It looks like it's not working, though ... Is it broken?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_180c.src: No veo ninguna pieza desgastada ni oxidada...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_180c.ref: Just from looking at it, I don't see any broken or rusted-out parts.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_180c.dst: A guardarlo, non vedo pezzi usurati o arrugginiti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_190..src: (Primero esa torre tan extraña sobre el acantilado y ahora un dispositivo sin energía...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_190..ref: (A huge, strangely-shaped tower on the cliffs and a device that's out of power ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_190..dst: (Prima quella torre cosi' strana sulla scogliera e ora un dispositivo senza energia...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_190..src: Me da en la nariz que esta torre no es lo que parece ser... ¿Y si fuera un puente levadizo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_190..ref: This is just a hunch, but maybe this tower isn't just a tower ... Maybe it's a drawbridge?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_190..dst: Ho la sensazione che questa torre non sia quello che sembra... E se fosse un ponte levatoio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_190..src: ¡Claro! No se lo llevó la corriente, ¡es que está levantado!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_190..ref: Ooh, so the bridge wasn't swept away, it's just drawn right now!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_190..dst: Certo! Non se l'e' portata via la corrente, e' semplicemente alzato!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_190..ref: I see, I was starting to get the same idea!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_190..dst: Gia', pensavo proprio la stessa cosa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_190..src: Pero el mecanismo que baja el puente ha pasado a mejor vida...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_190..ref: The device that lowers the bridge isn't respondin' at all, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_190..dst: Pero' il meccanismo che abbassa il ponte ha tirato le cuia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_190..src: Aunque no creo que esté roto. Quizá, si le suministramos un poco de energía, vuelva a funcionar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_190..ref: But I don't think it's broken. If we can just power it for even a bit, it should work.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_190..dst: Pero' non credo che sia rotto. Forse, se gli forniamo un po' di energia, tornera' a funzionare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_190..src: Si replico el funcionamiento de un Núcleo de energía... Claro, eso debería servir. Vamos a probar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_190..ref: If I make use of how the Energy Core functions ... Yeah, that should work. I'll try it out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_190..dst: Se replico il funzionamento di un Nucleo di Energia... Certo, dovrebbe funzionare. Lo provo subito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_200..dst: Qualcosa non va! Allontanatevi dal dispositivo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_200..src: Bueno, por lo menos, ahora podemos cruzar a la otra orilla, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_200..ref: For now, we can get across to the other shore, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_200..dst: Beh, almeno ora possiamo attraversare fino all'altra riva, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_200..src: Sí, salvados otra vez por Yumia y su alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_200..ref: Yeah, Yumia's alchemy has come in handy once again.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_200..dst: Si', salvati ancora una volta da Yumia e dalla sua alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_200..src: Sí... Aunque casi nos alcanza la explosión...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_200..ref: Yeah ... But I almost got everyone caught up in an explosion ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_200..dst: Si'... Anche se per poco non ci prendeva l'esplosione...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_200..src: Bueno, pero el puente ha bajado y nadie está chamuscado. Eso es lo que yo llamo un éxito absoluto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_200..ref: The bridge worked, and we're all safe. That's a win in my book.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_200..dst: Beh, il ponte ha funzionato e nessuno e' andato in fumo. Questo per me e' un successo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_200..src: En cualquier caso, se nos abre un nuevo camino.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_200..ref: Well, at least the road has opened for us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_200..dst: In ogni caso, si apre davanti a noi un nuovo cammino.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_200..src: Sigamos adelante. Estamos un paso más cerca de conocer la verdad sobre la caída de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_200..ref: Let's keep going. We're another step closer to the truth behind Aladiss's collapse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm04_200..dst: Andiamo avanti. Siamo un passo piu' vicini alla verita' sulla caduta di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: ¡Ya hemos llegado! Si seguimos adelante, entraremos en la región de Auruma, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: We're here! Anything past here is the Auruma region, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Siamo arrivati! Se proseguiamo, entreremo nella regione di Auruma, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: Vaaaya... Esto no se parece en nada a Syvashi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: Wow ... Everything looks so different compared to Sivash.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Caspita... Non assomiglia per niente a Syvashi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: El jefe Erhard y el resto llegarán en cualquier momento. Busquemos un lugar para establecer la base para ellos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: Chief Erhard and the others will catch up with us soon. Let's find a place around here to set up base before then.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Il capo Erhard e gli altri arriveranno da un momento all'altro. Cerchiamo un posto in cui stabilire la base per loro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: ¡Por aquí!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: This way!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Da questa parte!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: ¡Fiu! Sí que pesa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: Phew, this one's heavy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Fiu'! Pesante davvero!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: ¡Esa va allí!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: That one goes over there!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Quella va li'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: ¡Qué horror de cuerpo! ¡Esta cicatriz es fruto de la alquimia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: Look at this disgusting body! This, this is alchemy's scar!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Che corpo orrendo! Questa cicatrice e' frutto dell'alchimia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: ¿Me miráis y veis a una humana? ¡Este cuerpo está marcado con las heridas que me habéis infligido!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: Do you look at me and see a person?! This mangled body that you've carved with wounds!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Mi guardate e vedete un'umana? Questo corpo e' segnato dalle ferite che mi avete inflitto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: Por favor... Devolvedme mi cuerpo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: ... Please. Give me back my body.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Per favore... Restituitemi il mio corpo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: Quizá debería haberme ofrecido a ayudar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: I wonder if I should have said I could help her ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Forse avrei dovuto offrirmi di aiutare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: ¿A qué viene esa cara tan larga?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: You're still sulkin'? Pathetic.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Perche' quella faccia cosi' lunga?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: ¡Aaah! ¡Rutger, eres tú!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: Waah! Oh, it's just you, Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Aaah! Rutger, sei tu!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: No tengo tiempo para tus bromas. Déjame sola.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: I'll deal with your harsh remarks some other time. Just leave me alone for now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Non ho tempo per le tue battute. Lasciami in pace.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: ¿No te cansas de estar siempre revolviendo el pasado? Déjame adivinar: estás pensando en lo que dijo esa homúnculo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: Don't you get tired of bein' mopey and broodin'? You're thinkin' about what that monster woman said, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Non ti stanchi di rimestare sempre nel passato? Fammi indovinare: stai pensando a quello che ha detto quell'omuncolo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: ¿Me estabas oyendo? Te digo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: Hey, were you even listening? I—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Mi stavi ascoltando? Ti dico...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: Escucha, alquimista: no puedes vivir atrapada en el pasado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: Listen, Alchemist. You can't stay trapped in the past forever.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Ascolta, alchimista: non puoi vivere intrappolata nel passato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: Eso de «devolvedme mi cuerpo», o lo que dijera, es absurdo. Es imposible razonar con ella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: This "give me back my body" or whatever it was? Absurd demands like that mean there was no reasonin' with her.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Quella storia di "restituitemi il mio corpo" o come l'ha messa, e' assurda. E' impossibile ragionare con lei.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: Da igual lo que hubieras respondido: ese monstruo se habría puesto hecho una furia de todos modos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: No matter what you said in the moment, that monster woulda just flown into a rage anyway.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Non importava cosa avessi risposto: quel mostro sarebbe andato su tutte le furie lo stesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: Te cuesta desprenderte de los recuerdos más dolorosos. ¿Eso ibas a decir?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: But ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Fai fatica a staccarti dai ricordi piu' dolorosi. E' questo che volevi dire?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: ¡Pues deja de removerlos! O al final vas a acabar enterrada en ellos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: It ain't easy to get rid of the scars etched into your memory. I know you know that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Allora smettila di rimestarci! O alla fine finirai sepolta sotto di quelli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: Ya... No es una imagen agradable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: So stop moping around! You're gonna start growing moss otherwise.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Gia... Non e' un'immagine piacevole.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: El jefe Erhard me ha avisado de que han acabado los preparativos de la primera exploración.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: ... Right. Wouldn't want that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Il capo Erhard mi ha avvisato che i preparativi della prima esplorazione sono finiti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: Como de costumbre, nos ha enviado el plan de exploración de la región. Revisadlo, ¿vale?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: I've received word from Chief Erhard that the preparations to begin pioneering are complete.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Come al solito, ci ha inviato il piano di esplorazione della regione. Dateci un'occhiata, va bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: Han pasado muchas cosas, pero la investigación sigue adelante. Nuestro primer objetivo es...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: As usual, we have received a pioneering plan for the region. Please be sure to look it over.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Sono successe molte cose, ma la ricerca va avanti. Il nostro primo obiettivo e'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: Creo que es un buen sitio para empezar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: A lot has happened, but the investigation must go on. Our first destination should be ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Penso sia un buon posto da cui iniziare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: Sí, es lo que más llama la atención.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: I think that would be a good place to start.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Si', e' quello che attira di piu' l'attenzione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: Tiene forma de árbol, p-pero no del todo... ¿Está hecho de... metal?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: It certainly does stand out the most.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Ha la forma di un albero, m-ma non del tutto... E' fatto di... metallo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: Se llama Turm Pérgrica. Tengo muchas ganas de explorarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: It's shaped like a tree, but it looks kind of strange ... Is it made from metal?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Si chiama Turm Pe'rgrica. Non vedo l'ora di esplorarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: Pérgri... ¿qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: That's Pergrica Turm. It's definitely a place worth investigating.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Pe'rgri... che cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: Qué nombre tan raro para un árbol.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: P-Per-a-what ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Che nome strano per un albero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: Ah, casi se me olvida. Fue el jefe quien le puso ese nombre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: That's a pretty weird name for a tree.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Ah, quasi dimenticavo. E' stato il capo a dargli quel nome.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: En los archivos llaman a esa zona «distrito Pérgrica». Es un nombre provisional.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: Ah, I forgot to mention it. The chief's the one who thought of the name.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Negli archivi chiamano quella zona "distretto Pe'rgrica". E' un nome provvisorio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: ¡Ah! Ya entiendo, el viejo le puso el nombre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: Historical records refer to that area as the Pergrica district. It's just a provisional name for now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Ah! Ho capito, il vecchio gli ha dato il nome.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: Las rutas de maná van más allá de Turm Pérgrica.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: Ah, so the old man named it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Le rotte del mana vanno oltre il Turm Pe'rgrica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: Empecemos por allí. Seguro que encontramos algo interesante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: The mana pathways seem to continue beyond Pergrica Turm.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: Iniziamo da li'. Di sicuro troveremo qualcosa di interessante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..src: (No quiero preocupar a los demás. Creo que debería centrarme en continuar con la misión.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..ref: Let's head there first. I'm sure we'll find something.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_010..dst: (Non voglio preoccupare gli altri. Penso di dovermi concentrare sul proseguire la missione.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: ¡Haaala!... Esta Turm Pergrinosequé es espectacular.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: Whoa ... This Pergri-thingamajig sure is a sight to see.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Ma guarda!... Questa Turm Pe'rgrica-checcosso e' spettacolare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Turm Pérgrica.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: Pergrica Turm.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Turm Pe'rgrica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Es aún más raro de cerca. Nunca he visto un á-árbol así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: It feels even stranger now that we're up close. It's definitely no ordinary tree ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: E' ancora piu' strano da vicino. Non ho mai visto un a'lbero cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: La flora autóctona de las distintas regiones ha variado por la influencia de las zonas de vínculo de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: The unique flora seen in each region are likely due to the influence of the manabound areas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: La flora autoctona delle varie regioni e' cambiata per via dell'influenza delle zone legate al mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Eso parece. Supongo que le habrá pasado lo mismo al árbol de Lignumbria y el bosque cubierto de esporas de Syvashi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: That does seem likely. Then it's the same for the massive tree in Ligneus and the spore-covered forest in Sivash?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Sembra proprio. Immagino che sia successo lo stesso all'albero di Lignumbria e alla foresta coperta di spore di Syvashi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Casi con toda probabilidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: It's highly probable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Molto probabilmente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Siempre con suposiciones y probabilidades. ¿Es que no hay nada de lo que podamos estar seguros?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: "Likely" and "probable." Why can't things just be certain for once?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Sempre supposizioni e probabilita'. Non c'e' niente di cui possiamo essere sicuri, una volta per tutte?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: ¿Humanos... sois?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: ... Humans, are you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Umani... siete?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: ¿Q-quién eres?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: Wh-who are you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: C-chi sei?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Puede hablar... ¿Será como las Neru? O tal vez...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: They can speak ... Could they be related to the Neru? Or maybe ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Sa parlare... Sara' come le Neru? O forse...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Eso no importa, no te distraigas. Podría atacar en cualquier momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: Doesn't matter what they are, stay alert. They could attack at any moment.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Non importa chi sia, non distrarti. Potrebbe attaccare da un momento all'altro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: ¡Sí! ¡Humanos! ¡Humanos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: It is! Humans! Humans, there are!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Si'! Umani! Umani!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: ¿Eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: ¿En serio? ¿Los humanos han aparecido?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: Really? Shown up, humans have?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Davvero? Sono apparsi gli umani?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Humanos verdaderos. Duda no cabe. ¡La primera vez que veo un humano es!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: Genuine humans they are. No doubt there is. My first time seeing humans, this is!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Umani veri. Dubito non c'e'. La prima volta che vedo un umano e'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: ¿Qué les pasa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: What's with these guys?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Che hanno?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Creo... que se alegran de vernos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: Uh ... I think they're happy to see us?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Credo... che siano contenti di vederci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: No parecen hostiles. De momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: They don't seem hostile, at the very least.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Non sembrano ostili. Per ora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: ¿Quiénes sois? ¿Vivís aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: Who are you? Do you live in this land?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Chi siete? Vivete qui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Geni somos. Durante mucho tiempo en Aladiss hemos vivido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: Geni, we are. Lived in Aladiss for a long time, we have.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Geni siamo. Per molto tempo ad Aladiss abbiamo vissuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Durante mucho tiempo... Sois como los Silva.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: For a long time ... Then you're like the Silva.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Per molto tempo... Siete come i Silva.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Otras razas no conocemos. Aquí siempre hemos estado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: Other races, we do not know. Always been here, we have.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Altre razze non conosciamo. Qui siamo sempre stati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Hace siglos nos crearon. Nuestro maestro vida nos dio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: Created hundreds of years ago, we were. By Master.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Secoli or sono ci hanno creati. Vita ci ha dato il nostro maestro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: ¿Creados? ¿Entonces...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: Created? Does that mean ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Creati? Quindi...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: ¿Son mutantes?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: They're mutants?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Sono mutanti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: ¡Bienvenidos sois, humanos! A nuestra aldea os invitamos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: Humans, welcome you are! To our village, we invite you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Benvenuti siete, umani! Al nostro villaggio vi invitiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: ¡Os encantará! Una celebración organizaremos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: Yes, be pleased you will. Our meeting, we must celebrate!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Vi piacera'! Una celebrazione organizzeremo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: No sé yo, son muy amistosos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: They're actin' a little too friendly now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Non so, sono un po' troppo amichevoli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Señorita Yumia, ¿q-qué hacemos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: Miss Yumia, wh-what should we do?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Signorina Yumia, c-cosa facciamo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Los seguiremos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: ... Yeah. Let's join them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Andiamo con loro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Son mutantes y saben hablar. Quizás nos den alguna pista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: If they really are mutants capable of speech, it might get us some leads.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Sono mutanti e sanno parlare. Potrebbero darci qualche indizio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Nada que objetar. ¿Qué decís los demás?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: No objections here. Right, everyone?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Niente da obiettare. Che ne dite voi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Me encantaría ir a su aldea, pero... ¿no estaría mal?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: As much as I'd like to go to their settlement ... Is it really okay for me to go?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Mi piacerebbe andare al loro villaggio, ma... non e' un problema?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Me preocupa hacer algo que les moleste...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: I'm worried I'll end up doing something that makes them angry ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Mi preoccupa fare qualcosa che li infastidisca...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Si eso sucede, ya nos ocuparemos. No lo pienses ahora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: We'll deal with that when it happens. No use worryin' about it now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Se succede, ci penseremo allora. Non pensarci ora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Tiene razón. Están muy contentos de vernos. No hay por qué ser pesimistas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: Agreed. They seem welcoming, so I don't think we need to be too pessimistic.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Ha ragione. Sono molto contenti di vederci. Non c'e' da essere pessimisti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Es verdad... Gracias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: ... You're right. Thank you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: E' vero... Grazie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: Por favor, guiadnos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: Please, lead the way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Per favore, guidateci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..src: ¡Excelente! ¡Por aquí, humanos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..ref: Excellent! Humans, this way!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_020..dst: Eccellente! Di qui, umani!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: Así que esta es la aldea Geni...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: So this is the Geni's settlement ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Quindi questo e' il villaggio dei Geni...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: ¡Huala! Es gigante. ¿Qué es eso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: Whoa, that's huge. What is that?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Whoa! E' gigante. Che cos'e' quello?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: Desprende una cantidad de maná enorme. ¿Será un géiser de maná? Me pregunto para qué lo usarán.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: It's letting off a huge amount of mana. Is it some kind of large mana geyser? I wonder what purpose it serves.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Emette una quantita' enorme di mana. Sara' una sorta di geyser di mana? Mi chiedo a cosa serva.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: Por aquí, humanos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: Humans, this way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Di qui, umani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: Keke Lou me llamo. Esta aldea gobierno.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: Keke Lou, I am. This village I govern.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Keke Lou mi chiamo. Questo villaggio governo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: Saludos, humanos. La bienvenida os damos los Geni.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: Greetings, humans. Welcome you, we Geni do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Salve, umani. Il benvenuto vi diamo noi Geni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: Hemos venido a...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: We're here to ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Siamo venuti per...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: Somos del equipo de investigación de Aladiss. Venimos de la República de Eustella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: We are the Aladiss Research Team, from the neighboring Eustellan Republic.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Siamo della Squadra di Ricerca di Aladiss. Veniamo dalla Repubblica di Eustella.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: Hemos despejado algunas zonas de vínculo de maná en nuestra exploración del territorio para conocer los misterios del desastre que aconteció hace tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: We have been clearing manabound areas on our journey to unravel the mysteries surrounding the past disaster.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Abbiamo bonificato diverse zone legate al mana durante il nostro viaggio per svelare i misteri del disastro avvenuto in passato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: ¿Purificado la tierra habéis?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: Purified the land, you have?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Purificata la terra avete?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: Sí. Nos gustaría limpiar las zonas de vínculo de maná que queden en la región de Auruma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: Yes. We plan to clear the manabound areas here in the Auruma region as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Si'. Vorremmo ripulire le zone legate al mana rimaste nella regione di Auruma.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: Si es cierto lo que dices, nuestras vidas cambiarías.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: If true that is ... Change our lives, it could.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Se vero e' cio' che dici... Cambiare le nostre vite, potrebbe.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: ¿Usáis t-también Alstahlia para cruzar el maná?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: Oh, do you also use Alstahlia to get around the mana?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Usate a-anche Alstahlia per attraversare il mana?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: No. Regalos usamos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: No. It is gifts we use.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: No. Regali usiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: ¿Regalos? ¿Qué quieres decir?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: Gifts? What do you mean?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Regali? Cosa vuoi dire?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: Vivir en las zonas ricas de maná nos permiten. Útiles para ese propósito son.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: Live inside of dense mana, they allow us to. Tools for that purpose, they are.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Vivere nelle zone ricche di mana ci permettono. Utili a tale scopo sono.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: Serán algo así como el Núcleo de energía de Yumia. ¿Quién os ha dado estos regalos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: I suppose they must be something like Yumia's Energy Core then. Who is giving you these gifts?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Saranno qualcosa come il Nucleo di Energia di Yumia. Chi vi ha donato questi regali?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: Nuestro maestro...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: Our master—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Il nostro maestro...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: El maestro Corleonis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: Master Corleonis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Il maestro Corleonis.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: Un momento... ¿Has dicho...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: Wait, isn't that—?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Un momento... Hai detto...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: ¿Ese rarito? ¿Por qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: That weirdo? Why would he—?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Quel tipo strambo? Perche' mai...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: Keke Lou. ¿Qué relación tenéis con ese maestro del que nos hablas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: Keke Lou. What sort of a relationship do you have with this master of yours?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Keke Lou. Che rapporto avete con questo vostro maestro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: Salvó a los Geni el maestro. Sin sus bendiciones, vivir aquí imposible sería para nosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: Saved the Geni, Master did. Without his blessing, unable to live here, we would be.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Il maestro ha salvato i Geni. Senza la sua benedizione, qui vivere non potremmo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: Tributos al maestro ofrecemos. A cambio, regalos nos deja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: Tributes to Master, we offer. In return, gives us gifts, Master does.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Offriamo tributi al maestro. In cambio, lui ci da' doni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: Los regalos nos protegen. La libertad y la vida nos brindan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: Protect us, the gifts do. Our lives. Our freedom.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: I doni ci proteggono. La nostra vita. La nostra liberta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: ¿Qué se propone ese bicho raro?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: What in the world is that weirdo doin' here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Che diavolo ci fa qui quel tipo strambo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: Ni idea. Pero si lo llaman «maestro», algo me dice que no lo hace por altruismo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: Not sure, but if they call him "Master," I can't imagine he's doing it out of the kindness of his heart.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Non saprei, ma se lo chiamano "maestro", dubito che lo faccia per pura bonta' d'animo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: ¿Y si se lo preguntamos? Después de todo, nos han dejado pasar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: Shall we hear the locals out a bit more? They've let us stay here, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: E se chiedessimo qualcosa agli abitanti? Dopo tutto, ci hanno permesso di restare qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..src: Sí. Nos dividiremos para preguntarles. Necesitamos toda la información posible para llegar a una conclusión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..ref: Yeah. Let's split up and ask around. We need more information to think on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_030..dst: Si'. Dividiamoci e chiediamo in giro. Ci servono piu' informazioni su cui riflettere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_040..ref: Oh? About Master, you wish to know?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_040..src: Nuestro creador el maestro fue. Una virtud que de generación en generación ha pasado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_040..ref: Our creator, Master is. Passed down through generations, it has been.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_040..dst: Nostro creatore, il maestro e'. Tramandato di generazione in generazione e' stato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_040..src: Los Geni eran simples monstruos hace tiempo. Gracias al maestro, renacimos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_040..ref: Mere monsters, the Geni once were. But through Master, reborn we were.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_040..dst: Semplici mostri, un tempo i Geni erano. Ma grazie al maestro, rinati siamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_040..src: Gobernaba sobre nuestros antepasados. Aquí en Auruma les ordenó asentarse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_040..ref: Commanded our ancestors, he did. Orders to settle here in Auruma, he gave.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_040..dst: Comandava i nostri antenati. Di stabilirsi qui ad Auruma, ordino' loro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_040..ref: Lived here we have, ever since.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_040..src: (Así que los Geni son mutantes. Pero, a diferencia de Lili Borea, no eran humanos.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_040..ref: (It sounds like the Geni are mutants, but unlike Lili Borea, they weren't originally human.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_040..dst: (A quanto pare i Geni sono mutanti, ma a differenza di Lili Borea, in origine non erano umani.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_040..src: (Además, se refieren a Corleonis como su maestro. Qué raro.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_040..ref: (On top of that, they refer to Corleonis as their creator?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_040..dst: (E in piu', si riferiscono a Corleonis chiamandolo loro maestro? Che strano.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_050..src: ¿El maestro? Lo siento, mucho no puedo decir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_050..ref: Master? Apologies, know much I don't.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_050..dst: Il maestro? Mi dispiace, non so molto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_050..src: A la aldea no viene. Raro es verlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_050..ref: To the village, he does not come. Rare to see him, it is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_050..dst: Non viene al villaggio. E' raro vederlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_050..src: Aunque regalos nos deja. Regalos que del maná nos protegen.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_050..ref: But provides us with gifts, he does. Protect us from the mana, the gifts do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_050..dst: Pero' ci lascia dei doni. Doni che ci proteggono dal mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_050..src: A cambio de los regalos, dejamos tributos. O eso me han contado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_050..ref: Tribute we give, so gifts we receive. So told, was I.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_050..dst: In cambio dei doni, offriamo tributi. O almeno, cosi' mi hanno detto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_050..src: (¿Se estará aprovechando Corleonis de los Geni?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_050..ref: (Is Corleonis using the Geni for some kind of goal?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_050..dst: (Corleonis si stara' servendo dei Geni per qualche suo scopo?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_060..src: Los tributos al maestro os enseñaré. Mirad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_060..ref: Show you what we tribute to Master, I will. Here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_060..dst: Vi mostrero' i tributi al maestro. Ecco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_060..ref: Particles! Why does Corleonis want those?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_060..dst: Sono particelle! A cosa le vorra' Corleonis?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_060..src: (Ahora que lo pienso, Vésper también estaba reuniendo partículas. ¿Estará relacionado?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_060..ref: (Come to think of it, Vesper was also collecting particles. Could there be some kind of connection?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_060..dst: (A pensarci bene, anche Vesper stava raccogliendo particelle. Potrebbe esserci un legame?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_060..src: No lo sabemos. Ni su uso ni su valor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_060..ref: Know, we do not. Neither the use, nor the value.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_060..dst: Non lo sappiamo. Ne' a cosa servano ne' quanto valgano.
Eppure, noi ci limitiamo a raccoglierle.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_060..src: Para recibir los regalos del maestro, recolectamos. Vivimos gracias a sus bendiciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_060..ref: To receive the gifts from Master, we gather. Live on through that blessing, we do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_060..dst: Raccogliamo per ricevere i doni del maestro. Viviamo grazie alle sue benedizioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_060..ref: All we need to think about, that is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_060..dst: E' tutto cio' a cui dobbiamo pensare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: La historia tiene bastante sentido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: Seems the information we gathered is pretty consistent.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: La storia fila piuttosto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: Corleonis creó a los Geni y les ordenó vivir aquí en la región de Auruma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: Corleonis is the Geni's creator, and he ordered them to live here in the Auruma region.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: Corleonis ha creato i Geni e ha ordinato loro di vivere qui, nella regione di Auruma.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: Los Geni recolectan las partículas y se las entregan en forma de tributo a cambio de unos regalos que les permiten entrar en las zonas de vínculo de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: The Geni collect particles, which they give as tribute to receive gifts that let them enter manabound areas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: I Geni raccolgono le particelle e gliele consegnano come tributo, in cambio di doni che permettono loro di entrare nelle zone di legame del mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: Oye, ¿no echáis de menos a alguien?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: Say, aren't we missin' someone?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: Ehi, non vi sembra che manchi qualcuno?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: Sí. ¿Dónde está Lenja?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: Oh yeah. Where is Lenja?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: Gia'. Dov'e' Lenja?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: ¡P-perdón! Llego t-tarde.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: S-sorry I'm late!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: S-scusate! Sono in r-ritardo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: No te preocupes, Lenja. ¿Has descubierto algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: No worries, Lenja. Did you find anything out?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: Non preoccuparti, Lenja. Hai scoperto qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: ¡S-sí! Eh...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: Y-yes! Um, uh ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: S-si'! Ehm...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: Lenja, tranquila. Respira hondo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: Lenja, relax. Take deep breaths!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: Lenja, calmati. Fai un bel respiro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: Vale, ya estoy más calmada... Os lo contaré t-todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: Sorry, I've calmed down ... Let me explain everything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: Va bene, ora mi sento piu' calma... Vi raccontero' t-tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: Por lo visto, el lugar donde los Geni reciben sus regalos se llama la Tierra de las bendiciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: So apparently, the place where the Geni go to receive their gifts is called the Blessed Land.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: A quanto pare, il luogo in cui i Geni ricevono i loro doni si chiama Terra delle Benedizioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: La Tierra de las bendiciones...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: The Blessed Land?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: Terra delle Benedizioni...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: Les he preguntado cómo llegar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: I asked around to try to find out where it is ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: Ho chiesto loro come arrivarci...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: Por lo que he entendido, creo que está cerca de un lugar que aparece en nuestros documentos como «Estación Ramus Radix».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: From what I could tell, I think it's around a place that's listed on our documents as the "Ramus Radix Station."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: Da quel che ho capito, credo sia vicino a un luogo chiamato nei nostri documenti "Stazione Ramus Radix".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: ¿Ramus Radix?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: Ramus Radix?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: Ramus Radix?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: Antes, esta zona estaba dividida en distritos, uno de ellos era Ramus y otro Pérgrica.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: This area once used to be separated into districts, such as the Ramus district and the Pergrica district.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: Un tempo, questa zona era divisa in distretti. Uno era Ramus e un altro Pe'rgrica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: Me parece que Lenja se refiere a la Estación Radix del distrito Ramus.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: Lenja seems to be referring to a spot called Radix Station in the Ramus district.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: Mi sa che Lenja si riferisce alla Stazione Radix del distretto di Ramus.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: ¡Aaah! Vale.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: Oh! I see ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: Ah! Va bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: ¿Es una especie de área de servicio o algo así?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: So it's some kinda rest stop? I dunno the details.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: E' una specie di area di servizio o qualcosa del genere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: Sea lo que sea, ya tenemos un destino. ¡Buen trabajo, Lenja!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: Either way, we now have a destination to look into. Excellent work, Lenja!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: Qualunque cosa sia, ora abbiamo una destinazione. Bel lavoro, Lenja!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: ¡Sí, eres una investigadora nata!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: Yeah, that was some good digging!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: Si', sei nata per fare la ricercatrice!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: ¡Je, je, je!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: If we head there, we might find some more leads on Corleonis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: Eheh!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: Allí podríamos encontrar más datos sobre Corleonis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: That guy definitely seems like he knows something. Maybe we can find out stuff about Vesper too ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: Li' potremmo trovare altre informazioni su Corleonis.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: Tiene pinta de que este tipo sabe algo. Y ¿quién sabe? Puede que también encontremos información sobre Vésper.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: Yeah. They're both mutants collecting particles. There has to be a connection.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: Questo tizio sembra sapere qualcosa. E chissa'? Magari troveremo anche informazioni su Ve'sper.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: Sí. Los dos son mutantes y buscan partículas. Es imposible que sea una coincidencia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..ref: It's settled then. Let's get goin'.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: Si'. Sono entrambi mutanti e cercano particelle. Non puo' essere una coincidenza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..src: ¡Decidido! En marcha.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_070..dst: Deciso! Andiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..src: Han ofrecido muchas partículas. ¿Es el altar que utilizan para los tributos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..ref: There are lots of particles being offered here. I guess that's the altar they use for tributes?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..dst: Qui hanno offerto un sacco di particelle. Dev'essere l'altare che usano per le offerte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..src: Es como si rezaran a Corleonis.
En un lugar sagrado estáis. Las voces debéis bajar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..ref: A sacred place this is. Your voices, quiet down.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..dst: Questo e' un luogo sacro. Abbassate la voce.
Che cosa vi porta da queste parti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..src: Lamentamos la intrusión. Solo queríamos hacerte unas preguntas sobre el maestro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..ref: I know this is sudden, but we were hoping you could answer some questions about your master.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..dst: Ci scusiamo per l'intrusione. Volevamo solo farti alcune domande sul maestro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..src: Jum... ¿Por qué le hacéis ofrendas aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..ref: Um ... Why do you make your offerings here?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..src: Una promesa a nuestro maestro hicimos. En este lugar, tributos le dejaríamos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..ref: A promise with our master, we made. That in this place, our tributes we would leave.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..dst: Una promessa al nostro maestro abbiamo fatto. In questo luogo, tributi gli lasceremmo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..ref: Any idea what he uses them for?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..src: Algo he oído... Para un bien mayor sirven.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..ref: Heard, I have ... that for the greater good, it is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..dst: Qualcosa ho sentito... Per un bene maggiore servono.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..src: «Un bien mayor»... Creo que no ha revelado nada a los Geni.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..ref: "For the greater good" ... I guess he hasn't given any details to the Geni.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..dst: "Un bene maggiore"... Pare non abbia rivelato nulla ai Geni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..ref: It seems we've hit a dead end.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..src: Sí. Seguimos sin saber cuáles son las intenciones de Corleonis ni dónde está.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..ref: Yeah. We still don't know Corleonis' intentions or whereabouts.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..dst: Si'. Continuiamo a non sapere quali siano le intenzioni di Corleonis ne' dove si trovi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..src: Nadie dijo que fuera fácil. A veces, se fracasa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..ref: Things can't always be easy. Sometimes you hit a wall.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..dst: Nessuno ha detto che sarebbe stato facile. A volte si fallisce.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..src: ¿Y q-qué hacemos? ¿S-seguimos buscando por la z-zona?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..ref: Wh-what should we do? Give everywhere a thorough search?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..dst: E c-cosa facciamo? C-continuiamo a cercare nella z-zona?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..src: Puede que en otro momento. Ahora debemos informar a la base. No perdemos nada por descansar un rato.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..ref: It may come to that, but let's go back and report first. Taking a rest won't set us back.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..dst: Potra' servire, ma piu' avanti. Ora dobbiamo riferire alla base. Non perdiamo nulla a riposare un po'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..src: Estoy de acuerdo. Regresemos a la base por ahora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..ref: Agreed. Let's head back to base for now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_080..dst: Sono d'accordo. Torniamo alla base per ora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_081..src: Entiendo. Habéis hecho bien en venir a descansar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_081..ref: I see. If that's the situation, please rest up for now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_081..dst: Capisco. Avete fatto bene a venire a riposarvi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_081..src: Lleváis mucho tiempo fuera investigando. Deberíais relajaros un poco y pasar el tiempo con vuestros compañeros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_081..ref: You've been out investigating for a long time now. You should slow down a bit and speak to your teammates.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_081..dst: Siete fuori a indagare da molto tempo. Dovreste rilassarvi un po' e passare del tempo con i vostri compagni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_081..src: Es verdad. No nos hemos tomado ni un solo minuto de descanso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_081..ref: You're right. We've been pushing forward nonstop.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_081..dst: E' vero. Non ci siamo presi nemmeno un minuto di pausa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_081..src: (Los demás estarán relajándose en la base. Voy a ver cómo les va.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_081..ref: (Everyone should be resting at the base. Let me go see how they're doing.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_081..dst: (Gli altri si staranno rilassando alla base. Vado a vedere come stanno.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: (Esos dos no dejaban de cuchichear a mis espaldas...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: (Those two were gossiping about me before ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: (Quei due non smettevano di bisbigliare alle mie spalle...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Jamás pensé que avanzaríamos tanto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: I really didn't think we'd get this far.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Non avrei mai pensato che saremmo arrivati cosi' lontano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Sí, yo también tenía mis dudas. Pero el jefe tenía razón en todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: Yeah. I was skeptical at first, but everything the chief said was right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Si', anch'io avevo i miei dubbi. Ma il capo aveva ragione su tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Y esa alquimista...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: And that alchemist ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: E poi quell'alchimista...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Nos equivocamos por completo con ella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: She turned out to be completely different from what we thought.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Ci sbagliavamo completamente su di lei.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Sí. Me daba miedo eso de que usara artes prohibidas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: Yeah. With all the talk of forbidden arts, I thought she'd be terrifying.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Si'. Mi spaventava quella storia delle arti proibite.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Pero tuve la ocasión de hablar con ella y era una chica muy normal. Hasta me decepcionó un poco que lo fuera.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: She was surprisingly normal when I tried talking to her. It was almost anticlimactic.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: Ma quando ho avuto modo di parlarle, era una ragazza normalissima. Anzi, mi ha quasi deluso il fatto che lo fosse.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: Y se toma muy en serio su trabajo... No es mala persona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..ref: She seems really serious about her work too ... She isn't a bad person by any means.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..dst: E prende molto sul serio il suo lavoro... Non e' una cattiva persona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm05_082..src: ¿En serio? ¿Esos dos que hablaban sobre las artes prohibidas y todo ese rollo?
