eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Voglio andare avanti con i nostri piani. In gran parte, perche' credo che i ricordi siano la base dell'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Si no he entendido mal, Yumia, dices que a pesar de los obstáculos que se te presenten en el camino, seguirás adelante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: I want to push forward. Push forward because I believe every memory is a part of alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Se ho capito bene, Yumia, dici che, a prescindere dagli ostacoli che incontrerai, continuerai ad andare avanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: So, no matter what walls block your path from here on out, you'll push forward. Is that your resolve, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: ¿Y vosotros estáis con ella?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: Are you all with her?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: E voi siete con lei?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: ¡Bien! Pues se reanuda la investigación. ¡A vuestros puestos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: Good. Then we resume the investigation immediately. Back to the front lines with you all!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Bene! Allora l'indagine riprende. Tutti ai vostri posti!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: ¡Sí, señor!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: Yes, sir!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Si', signore!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Ya era hora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: About time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Era ora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Esto es solo el principio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: This is just the start.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Questo e' solo l'inizio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: ¡Vamos a p-por todas!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: L-let's do our best!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: D-diamo il massimo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Nos queda mucho trabajo por delante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: There's still so much truth we have to uncover.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Ci resta ancora molto lavoro da fare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..src: Pero hay que seguir. ¡No hay tiempo que perder!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..ref: Let's go. There's no time to waste!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_060..dst: Ma dobbiamo andare avanti. Non c'e' tempo da perdere!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Ya estamos todos. Vamos a hablar de nuestra situación. Viktor, cuando quieras.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: I think that's everyone. Let's go over the current situation again. Viktor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Ora ci siamo tutti. Parliamo della situazione. Viktor, quando vuoi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Sí, señor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: Yes, sir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Si', signore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Hemos tenido varios encontronazos con unos seres peligrosos conocidos como «mutantes».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: We have encountered dangerous entities known as "mutants" several times now and engaged with them in some difficult battles.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Ci siamo scontrati diverse volte con esseri pericolosi noti come "mutanti".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Vésper.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: Lili Borea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Vesper.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Lili Borea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: And Corleonis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Lili Borea.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Y Corleonis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: In addition, during our battle with Corleonis we also encountered a tall, thin man.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: E Corleonis.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Además, en el combate contra Corleonis, conocimos a un hombre alto y delgado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: May I add something to that?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Inoltre, durante lo scontro con Corleonis, abbiamo incontrato un uomo alto e magro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: ¿Puedo acotar algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: I never actually saw him in person back in the day, but I believe that was Emperor Basilius himself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Posso aggiungere una cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: No es que lo conozca de nada, pero creo que era el emperador Basilius en persona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: The last emperor of Aladiss ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Non e' che lo conosca, ma credo che fosse proprio l'imperatore Basilius.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: El último emperador de Aladiss...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: But Aladiss was destroyed hundreds of years ago, right? H-how is he still alive?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: L'ultimo imperatore di Aladiss...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Pero Aladiss desapareció hace siglos, ¿no? ¿C-cómo sigue vivo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: It's been the same amount of time for me. We can only assume that alchemy could provide any number of ways.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Ma Aladiss e' scomparso secoli fa, no? C-come fa a essere ancora vivo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Yo también vivía en aquella época. Podemos suponer que la alquimia es una caja de sorpresas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: So, the emperor is commanding those three, trying to orchestrate something from behind the scenes?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Anch'io vivevo a quell'epoca. Possiamo dire che l'alchimia non smette mai di stupirci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Entonces, ¿es el emperador quien le da órdenes a esos tres? ¿Qué tramará con tanto secretismo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: So it seems. Or perhaps this is all part of the plan to "restore Aladiss."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Quindi e' l'imperatore a dare ordini a quei tre? Cosa stara' tramando in segreto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: No lo sabemos. Quizá todo sea parte del plan de «restaurar Aladiss».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: I wonder if the Recollection Cocoon project is related to that as well ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Non lo sappiamo. Forse fa tutto parte del piano per "restaurare Aladiss".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Me pregunto si tendrá relación con el proyecto Crisálida de recuerdos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: We don't know the full story yet, but it's clear they're up to something big, and they're trying to keep it hidden.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Mi chiedo se abbia a che fare con il Progetto Crisalide dei ricordi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Todavía nos faltan datos, pero es evidente que se trata de algo importante que prefieren mantener en secreto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: The mana disaster in Eustella, and the creation of mutants like Lili Borea ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Ci mancano ancora dei dati, ma e' evidente che si tratta di qualcosa di importante che preferiscono tenere segreto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: El desastre de maná en Eustella, la creación de los mutantes como Lili Borea...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: All these sins born of alchemy have to be related to the project.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Il disastro del mana a Eustella, la creazione dei mutanti come Lili Borea...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Y el resto de pecados cometidos con alquimia tienen que estar vinculados al proyecto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: I want to use alchemy in a way that benefits everyone and puts a smile on their face.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: E il resto dei peccati commessi con l'alchimia dev'essere legato al progetto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Yo quiero usar la alquimia para ayudar a los demás y aportar alegría a sus vidas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: However, the world has labeled alchemy as a taboo, instead of actually confronting what is right and wrong.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Io voglio usare l'alchimia per aiutare gli altri e portare gioia nelle loro vite.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Sin embargo, el mundo la considera un tabú en lugar de afrontar la realidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: That's why we first need to learn what's going on in this place.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Eppure, il mondo la considera un tabu' invece di affrontare la realta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Por eso, lo primero es averiguar qué está sucediendo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: If it turns out that their actions threaten the future of alchemy, then I want—no, I need—to stop them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Per questo, la prima cosa e' scoprire cosa sta succedendo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: No puedo permitir que sigan adelante si descubrimos que sus acciones ponen en jaque el futuro de la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: We can't allow them to repeat the same mistakes through alchemy again.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Non posso permettere che continuino, se scopriamo che le loro azioni mettono a repentaglio il futuro dell'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Debemos impedir que repitan los mismos errores haciendo uso de ella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: We don't know what exactly they are up to ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Dobbiamo impedire che commettano di nuovo gli stessi errori utilizzandola.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Y sé que no sabemos exactamente cuál es su plan...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: But if restoring Aladiss means repeating the same tragedies of the past ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: E so che non sappiamo esattamente qual e' il loro piano...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Pero si restaurar Aladiss significa revivir las tragedias del pasado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: Then as an alchemist, I must stop it. I need to prevent any further sins from being added to the name of alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Ma se restaurare Aladiss significa far rivivere le tragedie del passato...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Entonces, como alquimista, debo detenerlos. Es mi obligación evitar que se cometan más pecados en nombre de la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: It ain't in my nature to let things be after someone's led me by the nose. First off, we take the fight to Corleonis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Allora, come alchimista, devo fermarli. E' mio dovere impedire che vengano commessi altri peccati in nome dell'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: No entra en mis planes dejar que me tomen por tonto. Hay que pedirle la revancha a ese tal Corleonis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: B-but, if we're blocked by ice again ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Non e' nei miei piani farmi prendere per stupido. Dobbiamo chiedere la rivincita a quel tale Corleonis.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: ¿Y si e-ese hielo nos bloquea el paso otra v-vez?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: Indeed. The biggest issue last time we fought was that Yumia wound up being isolated.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: E se q-quello ghiaccio ci blocca il passaggio un'altra v-volta?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Tiene razón. La última vez que luchamos contra Corleonis, Yumia acabó separada del grupo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: As long as we can prevent that, we have a chance ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Ha ragione. L'ultima volta che abbiamo combattuto contro Corleonis, Yumia e' finita separata dal gruppo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Quizá tengamos alguna oportunidad de vencer si lo evitamos esta vez.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: B-but that ice wall didn't seem like something we could easily break ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Forse avremo qualche possibilita' di vincere se questa volta lo evitiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: P-pero ese muro de hielo no p-parecía f-fácil de romper...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: Maybe if we prepare a really big bomb or something?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: M-ma quel muro di ghiaccio non s-sembava f-facile da rompere...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Podríamos fabricar una bomba gigante o algo por el estilo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: If we set off a bomb up there, I don't think it's just the ice wall that'll be fallin' down.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Potremmo fabbricare una bomba gigante o qualcosa del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Imagina todo lo que caería del cielo si ponemos una bomba allí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: Hmm ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Immagina tutto cio' che cadrebbe dal cielo se mettessimo una bomba li'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: ¡Estirium! Podíamos usar estirium para crear una gran fuerza en una zona concentrada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: Stirium! We could use it to create a huge amount of force in a focused area.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Estirium! Potevamo usare l'estirium per creare una grande forza in una zona concentrata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: ¡Ah! ¡La piedra que usamos para reparar el horno de transposición de maná! Esa que altera el flujo de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: Oh, the stone we used to repair the Mana Transposing Furnace! The one that distorts the flow of mana.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Ah! La pietra che abbiamo usato per riparare il forno di trasposizione del mana! Quella che altera il flusso di mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Sí. Podemos usarlo para condensar el maná en un punto y lanzarlo contra el muro. ¡Ah! Y también podríamos fabricar balas que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: Yeah. We can use it to focus mana on a single point and smash it into the wall. Oh, if we process it into bullets—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Si'. Possiamo usarla per condensare il mana in un punto e scagliarlo contro il muro. Ah! E potremmo anche fabbricare proiettili che...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: P-perdona, pero ¿crees que habrá más? Pensaba que habíamos recogido t-todo lo que pudimos encontrar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: B-but, do you think there's any more left? I thought we collected everything we could find ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: S-scusa, ma credi che ce ne sia ancora? Pensavo che avessimo r-raccolto tutto cio' che si poteva trovare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Flammi dijo que era un metal peculiar, ¿no? Nos va a costar dar con una zona rica en este material.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: Flammi said it's a rare metal, right? Trying to find a place with more might be tough.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Flammi ha detto che era un metallo particolare, no? Ci costera' trovare una zona ricca di questo materiale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Habrá que volver a investigar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: I guess we have to go back and see what we can find ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Bisognera' indagare di nuovo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: ¿Qué? ¿Y eso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: ... Here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Cosa? E questo cos'e'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: ¿Estirium? ¿De dónde lo has sacado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: Ah! I-is that?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Estirium? Da dove l'hai preso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Dijiste que ya teníamos suficiente para el horno, así que recogí un poco más para uso propio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: Stirium?! When did you get this?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Hai detto che ne avevamo abbastanza per il forno, quindi ne ho raccolto un po' di piu' per uso personale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: ¡Tú y tu alijo!...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: We'd already found enough, right? So I just picked up some extra for myself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Tu e il tuo nascondiglio!...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: ¡Solo fue un poco! ¡Y no iba a usarlo para nada! Además, ¿no lo acabo de dar sin rechistar? Dame un respiro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: You and your money again!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: E' stato solo un po'! E non dovevo usarlo per niente! Inoltre, non l'ho appena dato senza lamentarmi? Lasciami respirare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: No importa. Esto nos da una ventaja. Yumia, ¿puedes procesarlo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: I just said it was extra! No one was using it! And anyway, I just gave it to you, so cut the complaints!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Non importa. Questo ci da' un vantaggio. Yumia, riesci a lavorarlo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Sí. Intentaré fabricar munición para mi pistola.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: Regardless, this gives us a way to break through. Yumia, can you process it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Si'. Provero' a fabbricare munizioni per la mia pistola.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..src: Cuando estén listas, nos enfrentaremos juntos a Corleonis. Je, je, ¡tiemblo de emoción solo de pensarlo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..ref: Yes. I'll try making it into bullets that my gun can shoot.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_070..dst: Quando saranno pronte, affronteremo insieme Corleonis. Eheh, tremo di emozione solo a pensarci!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_090..src: Este ascensor no está en buenas c-condiciones. ¿C-creéis que es seguro s-subirnos otra vez?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_090..ref: Th-the elevator isn't in great shape. Do you think it's safe to get into again?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_090..dst: Questo ascensore non e' in buone c-condizioni. C-credete che sia sicuro s-salirci un'altra volta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_090..src: No está roto del todo, aunque los desperfectos de nuestra última incursión han dañado el suelo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_090..ref: It doesn't seem to be completely broken, but the debris from last time definitely did some damage to the flooring.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_090..dst: Non e' del tutto rotto, anche se i danni della nostra ultima incursione hanno compromesso il pavimento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_090..src: Vamos a repararlo por si acaso. No quiero caerme otra vez.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_090..ref: Let's repair what we can just in case. I really don't want to fall again ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_090..dst: Ripariamolo per sicurezza. Non voglio cadere di nuovo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_100..ref: I guess everything is all ready then ...
Yeah. All that's left is to go up ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_100..dst: Si'. Non ci resta che salire...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_100..src: No bajéis la guardia, todavía podrían caer algunos cascotes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_100..ref: More debris could easily still fall from above, so don't let your guard down.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_100..dst: Non abbassate la guardia, potrebbero ancora cadere dei calcinacci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..src: Otra vez no...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..ref: Ngh ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..dst: Di nuovo no...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..src: ¡Corleonis!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..ref: Not again—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..dst: Corleonis!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..src: ¡Ja, ja! Como esperaba. Después de todo, ¡aquí estás! Vivita y coleando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..ref: Corleonis!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..dst: Ah, ah! Come immaginavo. Dopotutto, eccoti qui! Viva e vegeta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..src: Ay, y pensar que queda alguien con tanto talento en esta época.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..ref: Haha! Just as I expected! Even after all that, here you stand, alive and well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..dst: Ah, pensare che in quest'epoca rimanga ancora qualcuno cosi' talentuoso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..src: Eres diferente al resto. ¿Qué me dices? ¿Te unes a nuestra causa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..ref: My, my, to think such talent remains in this modern age.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..dst: Sei diversa dagli altri. Che ne dici? Ti unisci alla nostra causa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..src: ¡Ni en un millón de años! Sin embargo, te doy la oportunidad de que nos cuentes todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..ref: You are indeed so very different from the others. What do you say? Won't you join us?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..dst: Nemmeno in un milione di anni! Pero' ti do la possibilita' di raccontarci tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..src: ¿Dónde está? ¿Dónde está Basilius? ¿Cómo pretendéis restaurar Aladiss?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..ref: Not in a million years. Instead, I think it's about time you tell us everything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..dst: Dov'e'? Dov'e' Basilius? Come pensate di restaurare Aladiss?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..src: ¡Ay! Cuánto arrojo. ¿Dónde han quedado tus modales?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..ref: Where is he? Where is Basilius? How do you intend to restore Aladiss?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..dst: Oh! Quanta audacia. Dove sono finite le tue maniere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..src: Si hubieras aceptado unirte a nosotros, me habría pensado compartir contigo esas ideas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..ref: Oh my! Quite adamant, aren't we? Where are your manners?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..dst: Se avessi accettato di unirti a noi, avrei valutato di condividere con te quelle idee.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..src: Entonces no nos dejas más opción que vencerte y seguir investigando. Daremos con la verdad con nuestros propios medios.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..ref: If you had said you'd join us, perhaps I might have been inclined to tell you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..dst: Allora non ci lasci altra scelta che sconfiggerti e continuare a indagare. Troveremo la verita' con i nostri mezzi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..src: ¿Eso crees? Qué decepción...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..ref: Well, then we'll just have to defeat you and push forward. We'll grasp the truth with our own hands.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..dst: Credi davvero? Che delusione...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..src: Te doy una segunda oportunidad, ¿y así es como la usas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..ref: Hmm, is that so? What a disappointing turn of events.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..dst: Ti concedo una seconda possibilita', e tu la usi cosi'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..src: ¿Eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..ref: I gave you another chance and this is how you use it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..ref: Hm?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..dst: Hai...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..ref: Is that ...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..src: Ja, ja... ¡Ja, ja, ja! ¡No esperaba menos! Eres magnífica, Yumia Liessfeldt.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..ref: ... Hah.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..dst: Ah, ah... Ah, ah, ah! Non mi aspettavo meno! Sei magnifica, Yumia Liessfeldt.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..src: Al no aceptar mi petición, no me has dado alternativa. ¡Usaré tu cuerpo para llevar a cabo mis experimentos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..ref: Haha. Hahaha! Just as I suspected! You are truly magnificent, Yumia Liessfeldt!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..dst: Rifiutando la mia richiesta, non mi hai lasciato alternative. Usero' il tuo corpo per condurre i miei esperimenti!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..src: ¡¡Inténtalo!!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..ref: If you refuse to accept my invitation, then I have no other choice. I shall use your body for my experiments instead!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..dst: Prova pure!!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..src: ¡Me parece a mí que la alquimista moderna no es más que una ilusa!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..ref: Try it!!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..dst: A me pare che l'alchimista moderna non sia altro che una illusa!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_110..ref: It seems that modern alchemists are simply ... fools!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: Ja, ja... Ja, ja, ja... Increíble. Me has superado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: Haha ... Hahahaha ... To think that you have surpassed even me ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Ah, ah... Ah, ah, ah... Incredibile. Mi hai superata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: ¡Estupendo! Este es el poder de la alquimia...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: Magnificent. This is the power of alchemy ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Splendido! Questo e' il potere dell'alchimia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: He leído los documentos del proyecto Crisálida de recuerdos que dejaste en el horno de transposición de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: I read the Recollection Cocoon project documents you left at the Mana Transposing Furnace.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Ho letto i documenti del progetto Crisalide dei Ricordi che hai lasciato nel forno di trasposizione del mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: ¿Cuál es tu objetivo? ¿Qué estás buscando en este sitio?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: What is the purpose of that project? What are you trying to achieve here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Qual e' il tuo obiettivo? Cosa stai cercando in questo posto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: Ya os lo he dicho: restaurar Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: I told you. We will restore Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Ve l'ho gia' detto: restaurare Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: Es un plan sencillo: reviviremos... todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: It's simple. We will resurrect ... everything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: E' un piano semplice: riporteremo in vita... tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: Crearemos tantos cuerpos como nos parezca conveniente. Mientras los recuerdos permanezcan, la alquimia es capaz de crear vida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: We can make as many bodies as needed. As long as the memories remain ... alchemy can resurrect even life itself!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Creeremo quanti corpi vorremo. Finche' i ricordi permangono, l'alchimia e' capace di creare la vita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: ¡Eso es absurdo! Las cosas que se pierden jamás se recuperan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: That's absurd. The things we've lost can never be returned!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: E' assurdo! Le cose che si perdono non tornano mai piu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: ¡Solo estás acumulando pecados a tu nombre!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: All you are doing is adding more sins to the pile!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Stai solo accumulando peccati a tuo nome!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: ¿Pecados? No has entendido nada. La restauración de Aladiss será nuestra expiación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: More sins? You have it backwards. The restoration of Aladiss is our atonement!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Peccati? Non hai capito niente. La restaurazione di Aladiss sara' la nostra espiazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: Ja, ja... Por mucho que os esforcéis, nada detendrá a Su Majestad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: Haha ... No matter how much you all struggle forward, nothing shall stop His Majesty's march!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Ha, ha... Per quanto vi sforziate, nulla potra' fermare Sua Maesta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: Incluso si pierdo la vida por este motivo... ¡La alquimia hará que Aladiss vuelva a existir! Por nuestro rey...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: Even if my life is forfeit ... alchemy will resurrect Aladiss! By our lord's will!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Anche se perdessi la vita per questo... l'alchimia fara' si' che Aladiss torni a esistere! Per volonta' del nostro re...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: Mientras haya alquimia... Mientras la alquimia de mi señor siga funcionando, ¡nuestro plan saldrá adelante!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: So long as there is alchemy ... so long as we have our lord's alchemy, it will be done!!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Finche' esistera' l'alchimia... Finche' l'alchimia del mio signore continuera' a funzionare, il nostro piano andra' avanti!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: Ja, ja. ¡Ja, ja, ja! ¡JA, JA, JA, JA, JA! ¡Gloria a Aladiss! ¡Gloria al Imperio aladissiano!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: Haha. Ahaha! HAHAHAHA!! Glory to Aladiss—Glory to the Aladissian Empire!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Ha, ha. Ha, ha, ha! HA, HA, HA, HA, HA! Gloria ad Aladiss! Gloria all'Impero Aladissiano!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: Mientras haya alquimia...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: So long as there is alchemy, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Finche' esistera' l'alchimia, eh...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: Basilius fue el último emperador de Aladiss. ¿Estará intentando redimirse por la destrucción del imperio?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: Basilius is the last emperor of Aladiss ... Is he trying to atone for the destruction of his empire and his people?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Basilius fu l'ultimo imperatore di Aladiss. Stara' cercando di redimersi per la distruzione dell'impero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: ¡Menuda tontería! Cometer un pecado para subsanar otro es una locura. Eso no se puede considerar redención.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: Atoning for one sin by committing another is nonsense. That can never be considered atonement.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Ma che sciochezza! Commettere un peccato per ripararne un altro e' una follia. Non si puo' considerare redenzione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: Puede que n-no vea otra forma de hacerlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: Maybe he sees no other options?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Forse n-non vede un altro modo per farlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: Si me dieran la oportunidad de e-enmendar mis errores, creo que haría t-todo lo posible...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: If it was possible to erase my own mistakes, I think I would have clung to any possibility ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Se mi dessero la possibilita' di e-emendare i miei errori, credo che farei t-tutto il possibile...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: Tengo que llegar hasta el final. ¿Cuál es el objetivo de Basilius? ¿Por qué se destruyó Aladiss...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: Basilius's goal. The reason for Aladiss's collapse. ... I need to properly face it all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Devo andare fino in fondo. Qual e' l'obiettivo di Basilius? Perche' Aladiss e' stata distrutta...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: No llevarás esa carga sola. Todos juntos trazaremos un plan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: Don't overburden yourself. Let's think together about what the right path is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Non porterai quel peso da sola. Insieme traceremo un piano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: Siempre has dicho que estabas dispuesta a todo, ¿no? Pues sigue así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: You were ready for anythin' from the start, right? You just need to stick to it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Hai sempre detto che eri disposta a tutto, no? Allora continua cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: Sí, ya es tarde para echarse atrás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: Yeah. There's no turning back now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Si', ormai e' troppo tardi per tirarsi indietro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: Despejemos la zona de vínculo de maná y echemos un vistazo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: Let's clear away the manabound area and then take a look around.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Liberiamo l'area legata al mana e diamo un'occhiata in giro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..src: Buscad cualquier pista que haya podido dejar Corleonis. Y, lo más importante, debemos dar con el Vial de recuerdos de la doctora Marina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..ref: Look for any clues that Corleonis left. Most importantly, we need to find Doctor Marina's Memory Vial.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_130..dst: Cercate qualsiasi indizio che Corleonis abbia lasciato. E soprattutto, dobbiamo trovare la Fiala della Memoria della Dottoressa Marina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..src: (¿Serán estos los regalos de los Geni? ¿Qué será este recipiente?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..ref: (Could these be the gifts that the Geni use? And what's this bottle?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..dst: (Saranno questi i regali dei Geni? E questo recipiente, che sara'?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..ref: Is that a bottle for particles?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..dst: E' una bottiglia per le particelle?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..src: Eso creo. Corleonis obligaría a los Geni a recogerlas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..ref: I think so. Corleonis probably had the Geni collect them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..dst: Lo credo. Probabilmente Corleonis ha costretto i Geni a raccoglierle.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..src: Por eso Vésper estaba recogiendo las partículas en el Gran Árbol de Latere.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..ref: So the reason Vesper was collecting particles at the Great Tree of Latere ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..dst: Ecco perche' Vesper raccoglieva le particelle al Grande Albero di Latere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..src: Sí, para resucitar a los aladissianos. O, al menos, ese era su plan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..ref: Was to resurrect the Aladissian people. Or at least, it's a part of the plan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..dst: Si', per riportare in vita gli aladissiani. O almeno, quello era il loro piano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..src: Debemos dejarles las cosas claras a esos Geni.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..ref: ... But, I guess we need to be straight with the Geni.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..dst: Dobbiamo essere chiari con quei Geni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..src: Después de todo lo que ha pasado, no deberíamos ocultarles nada. La aldea Geni se merece conocer la verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..ref: After all that happened, we shouldn't hide anything. The Geni settlement deserves to know the truth.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..dst: Dopo tutto cio' che e' successo, non dovremmo nascondergli nulla. Il villaggio dei Geni merita di conoscere la verita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..src: Estoy de acuerdo. Los Geni me salvaron la vida cuando me sacaron del lago. No sería justo callarnos la verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..ref: Agreed. The Geni saved my life by pulling me out of the lake. It wouldn't be right to keep silent.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..dst: Sono d'accordo. I Geni mi hanno salvato la vita quando mi hanno tirata fuori dal lago. Non sarebbe giusto tacere la verita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..src: Encontraremos el momento adecuado para explicárselo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..ref: We'll find the right time to explain it to the settlement.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_140..dst: Troveremo il momento giusto per spiegarglielo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Alquimista, ¿necesitas ayuda?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: Alchemist, need something, do you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Alchimista, hai bisogno di qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Sí. Hemos venido a deciros una cosa. Dos, para ser exactos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: Yes. We have something we need to tell you. Two things, in fact.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Si'. Siamo venuti a dirvi una cosa. Due, per la precisione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Primero, quería daros las gracias. Me han contado que fuisteis vosotros quienes me sacaron del lago cuando me caí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: First, thank you. I heard that you pulled me out of the lake when I fell from the tree.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Prima di tutto, volevo ringraziarvi. Mi hanno detto che foste voi a tirarmi fuori dal lago quando sono caduta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Ah. Una sorpresa nos llevamos. La primera vez que una humana se caía del Árbol de metal fue.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: Ah. Surprised us, that did. The first time a human had fallen from the Steel Tree, that was.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Ah. Una sorpresa ci siamo presi. La prima volta che un'umana cadeva dall'Albero di metallo, quella fu.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: ¿Qué te pasó?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: Happened, what had?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Che cosa ti e' successo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Bueno, eso me lleva a la segunda cosa...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: Well, that links up to the second thing we need to tell you ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Beh, questo mi porta alla seconda cosa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Una cosa muy repentina para creerla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: ... Difficult to believe so suddenly, this is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Una cosa troppo improvvisa per crederci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Maestro ya no tenemos. ¿Hemos entendido bien?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: No more, our master is. What you're saying, that is?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Maestro piu' non abbiamo. Abbiamo capito bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Sí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: ... Yes.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Lo siento. Os lo debí contar hace mucho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: I'm sorry. I should have spoken to you all sooner.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Mi dispiace. Avrei dovuto dirvelo molto tempo fa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Lo entendemos. Opción no tenías.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: Understand, I do. No choice, you had.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Lo capiamo. Scelta non avevi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Ahora... nuestros próximos pasos necesitamos pensar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: But ... think, we must, about what now to do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Ora... i nostri prossimi passi dobbiamo pensare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Lo primero, protegernos. En la copa del Árbol de metal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: First, look for ourselves, we must. On top of the Steel Tree.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Per prima cosa, proteggerci. In cima all'Albero di metallo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Después, nuestro futuro decidiremos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: After that, decide our future we can.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Dopo, il nostro futuro decideremo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: ¿No nos culpáis por haber derrotado a vuestro maestro?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: You don't blame us for defeating your master?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Non ci incolrate per aver sconfitto il vostro maestro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: A nuestro maestro no nos devolverá culparte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: Bring our master back, blaming you will not.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Incolparvi non fara' tornare il nostro maestro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Esto... una gran oportunidad podría ser.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: ... Also, a good opportunity, this may provide us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Questo... una grande opportunita' potrebbe essere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: ¿Vuestro futuro?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: Your future?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Il vostro futuro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Acostumbrados a la vida sin el maestro no estamos. Cómo vivir debemos considerar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: Accustomed to life without Master, we are not. How to live from now on, we must consider.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Abituati alla vita senza il maestro non siamo. Come vivere dobbiamo considerare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Por eso, una gran oportunidad se presenta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: However, a good opportunity, this may provide us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Per questo, una grande opportunita' si presenta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: ¿Oportunidad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: Opportunity?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Opportunita'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Un tributo y fe depositamos en nuestro maestro. Y él nos protegió del denso maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: Tribute and faith we offered, and protected us from the dense mana, Master did.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Un tributo e fede abbiamo depositato nel nostro maestro. E lui ci ha protetto dal denso mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Así vivimos durante cientos de años.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: For hundreds of years, so we lived.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Cosi' abbiamo vissuto per centinaia di anni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Ahora, el maná de esta tierra borrado habéis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: But now, cleared the mana of this land, you have.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Ora, il mana di questa terra eliminato avete.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Tal vez el momento haya llegado. Vivir por nosotros mismos debemos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: Come, perhaps the time has. Time for us to step forward on our own, it may be.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Forse il momento e' arrivato. Vivere da noi stessi dobbiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Por vuestros medios...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: On your own ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Da voi stessi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Si hay algo que necesitéis del equipo de investigación, por favor, venid a verme. Es nuestra obligación ayudaros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: If there is anything the Research Team can do to assist, please let me know. I believe it is our duty to help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Se c'e' qualcosa di cui avete bisogno dalla Squadra di Ricerca, venitemi a dire, vi prego. E' nostro dovere aiutarvi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: La preocupación te agradezco.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: Appreciate the concern, I do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: La preoccupazione apprezzo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: Aunque, confundido sigo. Tiempo necesito. Tiempo para mí y los Geni.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: However, still confused, I am. Time, I need. Time for me, and the Geni.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: Pero', confuso resto. Tempo mi occorre. Tempo per me e i Geni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: (Venía preparada para esto. No me arrepentiré de mis decisiones.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: (I was prepared for this. I don't intend to regret my choices.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: (Venivo preparata per questo. Non rimpiangero' le mie decisioni.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: (Pero creo que no todo lo que hice estuvo bien. Sería un error pensar lo contrario.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: (But I don't think everything I did was right. I'm sure it would be wrong to think that it was.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: (Ma credo che non tutto cio' che ho fatto sia stato giusto. Sarebbe un errore pensare il contrario.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: (Supongo que esto es afrontar la verdad. Seguiré pensando en hacer lo correcto cueste lo que cueste.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: (I guess this is what it means to face what is right. To continue thinking about that all the time.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: (Immagino che sia questo affrontare la verita'. Continuero' a chiedermi come fare il giusto, costi quel che costi.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: (Me gustaría creer que esta decisión merecerá la pena.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..ref: (I want to believe there's some meaning in that.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: (Vorrei credere che questa decisione ne varra' la pena.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..src: <SEL_MM06_141_1_B><CR>¿Vuestro futuro?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_141..dst: <SEL_MM06_141_1_B><CR>Il vostro futuro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: ¿De qué tratan estos documentos? Flammi, ¿me echas una mano?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: What are these documents about? Flammi, can you read them?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: Di cosa parlano questi documenti? Flammi, mi dai una mano?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: Por supuesto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: Of course.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: Certo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: «Vial de recuerdos todopoderoso. Experimento de creación. Informe anual de la Era de la Fundación 1103».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: "Almighty Memory Vial - Manufacturing Experiment - Annual Report for Founding Era 1103"
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: "Fiala della Memoria onnipotente. Esperimento di creazione. Rapporto annuale dell'Era della Fondazione 1103".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: «Tercer informe de errores por parte del equipo personal del emperador».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: "Third failure report from the emperor's personal team."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: "Terzo rapporto di errori da parte della squadra personale dell'imperatore".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: «Aunque conseguimos aumentar notablemente el almacenamiento, descubrimos un defecto que provocaba una degradación de la información tras reproducirla».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: "While we succeeded in significantly increasing storage capacity, a defect causing degradation of information upon playback was discovered."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: "Anche se siamo riusciti ad aumentare notevolmente la capacita' di archiviazione, abbiamo scoperto un difetto che causava un deterioramento delle informazioni dopo la riproduzione".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: «Hemos clasificado este error como urgente».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: "Addressing this issue is deemed urgent."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: "Abbiamo classificato questo errore come urgente".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: ¿Un informe sobre unos experimentos que salieron mal?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: A report on some experiment? Seems like it didn't go well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: Un rapporto su degli esperimenti andati male?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: ¿Qué es eso de un Vial de recuerdos todopoderoso? Es la primera vez que escucho algo así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: Almighty Memory Vial? I've never heard of that before.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: Cosa sarebbe questa Fiala della Memoria onnipotente? E' la prima volta che ne sento parlare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: Hay fragmentos que describen en detalle los «objetivos de la investigación».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: Additional information about the "research goals" is also mentioned in fragments.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: Ci sono frammenti che descrivono in dettaglio gli "obiettivi della ricerca".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: «El objetivo de nuestra investigación es desarrollar un archivador de alta capacidad que pueda registrar toda Aladiss».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: "The goal of this research is to develop a high-capacity storage medium capable of recording all of Aladiss."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: "L'obiettivo della nostra ricerca e' sviluppare un supporto di archiviazione ad alta capacita' capace di registrare tutta Aladiss".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: «No solo registros sobre la alquimia. También sobre Arquitectura, Leyes, Humanidades, Ingeniería, Ciencia, Medicina...»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: "Not just records related to alchemy, but also architecture, law, humanities, engineering, science, medicine ... "
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: "Non solo documenti sull'alchimia. Anche su Architettura, Leggi, Umanistiche, Ingegneria, Scienza, Medicina..."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: «Todas las tecnologías y conocimientos que puedan ser recopilados para preservar la nación de Aladiss».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: "All technologies and knowledge are to be captured in order to preserve the nation of Aladiss itself."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: "Tutte le tecnologie e le conoscenze devono essere raccolte per preservare la nazione di Aladiss stessa".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: ¿Quiere decir... que con este Vial de recuerdos todopoderoso se puede sintetizar cualquier invento de Aladiss?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: Does that mean that if you had this Almighty Memory Vial, you could synthesize anything made in Aladiss?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: Vuoi dire... che con questa Fiala della Memoria onnipotente si puo' sintetizzare qualsiasi invenzione di Aladiss?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: ¿C-cualquier cosa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: Y-you could make anything?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: C-qualsiasi cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: Los viales de recuerdos son las recetas de la síntesis. Si contienen información sobre todas las cosas, entonces, en teoría...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: Memory Vials act as recipes for synthesis. If it really had information on everything, then theoretically ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: Le fiale della memoria sono le ricette della sintesi. Se contengono informazioni su ogni cosa, allora, in teoria...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: Se les podría sacar un gran provecho lo mires por donde lo mires.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: ... It could be abused in all sorts of ways.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: Se ne potrebbe trarre grande vantaggio, comunque la si guardi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: Correcto. Poseer un Vial de recuerdos semejante daría capacidad a un alquimista para conseguir un poder militar incomparable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: Affirmative. Possessing such a Memory Vial would allow an alchemist to wield unparalleled military power.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: Esatto. Possedere una simile Fiala della Memoria darebbe a un alchimista la capacita' di ottenere un potere militare incomparabile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: Me mareo solo de pensarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: I'm getting dizzy just thinking about it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: Mi gira la testa solo a pensarci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: En Aladiss se daba mucha importancia a la eternidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: In Aladiss, the view that everything should be eternal was given great importance.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: Ad Aladiss si dava molta importanza all'eternita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: Las cosas nunca se rompían. Y, si se desgastaban, se enviaban a reparar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: Things that would never break, or even if broken, could easily be remade.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: Le cose non si rompevano mai. E, se si usuravano, venivano mandate a riparare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: Con esa mentalidad, esta investigación cobra mucho sentido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: With that in mind, this research really does suit the Aladissian mindset.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: Con quella mentalita', questa ricerca assume un senso profondo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: Según los archivos históricos, la antigua Aladiss era una nación pequeña, pobre y deficiente en recursos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: According to historical records, ancient Aladiss was once a small, poor country which lacked resources.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: Secondo gli archivi storici, l'antica Aladiss era una nazione piccola, povera e carente di risorse.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: Intuyo que sus fuerzas militares estarían limitadas y otras naciones se aprovecharían de su inferioridad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: I imagine the size of its military must have been limited, so they were likely constantly exploited by other nations.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: Immagino che le sue forze militari fossero limitate e che altre nazioni approfittassero della sua inferiorita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..src: Tal vez por eso se obsesionaron con ser eternos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..ref: Perhaps that's why they were so fixated on being eternal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_150..dst: Forse e' per questo che erano ossessionati dall'idea di essere eterni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_160..src: ¡Aquí está! ¡Nina, he encontrado el Vial de recuerdos de la doctora Marina!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_160..ref: Ah, here it is! Nina, I found Doctor Marina's Memory Vial!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_160..dst: Ecco qua! Nina, ho trovato la Fiala della Memoria della Dottoressa Marina!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_160..src: ¡Gracias al cielo! Me preocupaba que hubiera llegado a destruirse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_160..ref: Thank goodness! I was so worried that it might have been destroyed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_160..dst: Meno male! Temevo che fosse andata distrutta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_160..src: A mí t-también. Es un vínculo muy importante entre tú y la doctora, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_160..ref: I was worried too. It's an important link between you and the doctor, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_160..dst: A-anche a me. E' un legame molto importante tra te e la dottoressa, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_160..src: Sí. Es un alivio haberlo recuperado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_160..ref: Yes. Having it back safe and sound is a huge relief.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_160..dst: Si'. Che sollievo averla recuperata sana e salva.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_160..src: Bueno, ya habíamos mirado por todas partes. Vamos a ver qué contiene.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_160..ref: Well, we've already checked everywhere else. Let's see what's on it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_160..dst: Beh, abbiamo gia' guardato dappertutto. Vediamo cosa contiene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_160..src: Sí. Pero antes, comprobemos que no haya nada merodeando por aquí antes de abrirlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_160..ref: Agreed. But let's make sure there's nothing else around here before we check its contents.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_160..dst: Si'. Ma prima, controlliamo che non ci sia nulla in agguato qui intorno prima di aprirla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_160..src: Mejor, así podré escucharlo con calma. Además, debo mentalizarme para este momento...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_160..ref: Right. I'd rather be able to relax and listen to it. Not to mention, I need to prepare myself mentally ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_160..dst: Meglio, cosi' potro' ascoltarla con calma. Inoltre, devo prepararmi mentalmente per questo momento...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: Por fin es nuestro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: We finally got it back.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: Finalmente e' nostra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: Sí. Todavía no sabemos qué información contiene, pero confío en que nos será de gran ayuda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: Yep. There's no telling what information it holds, but it's bound to give us a big new lead.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: Si'. Non sappiamo ancora quali informazioni contenga, ma confido che ci sara' di grande aiuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: Escaneo finalizado. El vial contiene una grabación de audio. ¿Queréis escucharla ahora?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: Scan complete. There is an audio recording stored in the vial. Would you like to hear it now?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: Scansione completata. La fiala contiene una registrazione audio. Volete ascoltarla ora?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: La voz de la doctora Marina... Sí, reproduce el audio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: Doctor Marina's voice ... Please play it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: La voce della Dottoressa Marina... Si', riproduci l'audio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: «Uf... Primero, me gustaría registrar nuestra situación actual.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: "*Huff* *huff* ... First, let me start by recording our current situation."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: "Uff... Innanzitutto, vorrei registrare la nostra situazione attuale."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: «Nos enfrentamos a un desastre de maná como nunca hemos vivido y que se extiende por toda Aladiss.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: "We're facing a mana disaster unlike anything we've ever seen before, all across Aladiss."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: "Stiamo affrontando un disastro di mana come non abbiamo mai vissuto, e si estende per tutta Aladiss."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: «La densidad del maná ha alcanzado cotas altísimas en todas las zonas. Nuestras contramedidas son inútiles.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: "Mana density is extremely high in all areas, rendering our usual defenses useless."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: "La densita' del mana ha raggiunto livelli altissimi in tutte le zone. Le nostre contromisure sono inutili."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: «Dada su extensión, no creo que podamos esperar a que se desvanezca. Podría tardar meses o incluso años.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: "Given how widespread it is, I don't think waiting it out will be an option. It could take months, even years."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: "Data la sua estensione, non credo che possiamo aspettare che svanisca. Potrebbe metterci mesi o persino anni."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: «Lignumbria será engullida por la zona de vínculo de maná que se aproxima desde el este.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: "Ligneus will be swallowed up by the manabound area as it spreads from the east."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: "Lignumbria verra' inghiottita dalla zona di legame di mana che si avvicina da est."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: «Ya hemos sido testigos de ciertas "anomalías" en los alrededores. No nos queda otra que abandonar el laboratorio.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: "We're already seeing abnormalities in the surrounding environment. We have no choice but to abandon the lab."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: "Abbiamo gia' assistito a certe "anomalie" nei dintorni. Non ci resta che abbandonare il laboratorio."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: «Si el maná lo envuelve todo, la verdadera historia de Aladiss quedará enterrada para siempre.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: "If mana engulfs everything, the real story of Aladiss's ruin will disappear into the shadows."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: "Se il mana avvolgera' ogni cosa, la vera storia di Aladiss rimarra' sepolta per sempre."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: «No permitiré que eso ocurra. Daré con el origen de todo esto.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: "But I will not let that happen. I'll find the truth behind it all."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: "Non permettero' che accada. Trovero' l'origine di tutto questo."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: «Nina me ha dado esperanzas. ¡No puedo dejar que haya sido para nada!»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: "Nina has given me hope. I cannot let that be for nothing!"
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: "Nina mi ha dato speranza. Non posso permettere che sia stato invano!"

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: «A todo aquel que oiga este mensaje en el futuro.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: Doctor ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: "A chiunque ascoltera' questo messaggio in futuro."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: «Voy a trasladar la base a un lugar seguro. Siempre que el tiempo lo permita, recogeré materiales de investigación y me dedicaré a estudiar qué ha provocado este desastre.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: "To those in the distant future hearing this message."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: "Trasferiro' la base in un luogo sicuro. Quando il tempo lo permettera', raccogliero' materiali di ricerca e mi dedichero' a studiare cosa ha causato questo disastro."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: «No podemos considerar este suceso como una simple tragedia. Debemos aprender de los errores. Y ese aprendizaje tiene que ser la base para construir el futuro.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: "I am moving the base to a safe location, and as long as time permits, I will collect research materials and devote myself to finding the truth of this disaster."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: "Non possiamo considerare questo evento come una semplice tragedia. Dobbiamo imparare dagli errori. E quell'apprendimento deve essere la base su cui costruire il futuro."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: «Rezo para que mi investigación sea útil en los días venideros. Rezo... para que podáis conocer la verdad.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: "We can't simply write this off as a tragedy. We have to learn from our mistakes and pave the way for the future."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: "Prego perche' la mia ricerca sia utile nei giorni a venire. Prego... perche' possiate conoscere la verita'."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: Fin de la grabación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: "I pray this research will help in the future. I pray that you will be able to uncover the truth."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: Fine della registrazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: ¡E-espera! Ha dicho que se había trasladado, pero ¿adónde?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: That is the end of the playable audio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: A-aspetta! Ha detto che si era trasferita, ma dove?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: Esa información no está en el audio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: H-hold on! She said she moved, but where?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: Quell'informazione non e' nell'audio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: Bah, ¿se ha dejado la mejor parte?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: That information was not stored within the playable audio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: Mah, ha tralasciato la parte migliore?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: Otro callejón sin salida...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: Bah, it's missin' the most important part?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: Un altro vicolo cieco...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: Todavía no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: Looks like we've hit another dead end ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: Non ancora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: La doctora Marina dijo que se había trasladado a un lugar seguro, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: Not quite.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: La Dottoressa Marina ha detto che si era trasferita in un luogo sicuro, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: Eso quiere decir que la base estaba fuera de las zonas de vínculo de maná presentes antes de que llegáramos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: Doctor Marina said she moved the research to a safe place, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: Il che significa che la base si trovava fuori dalle zone di legame di mana presenti prima del nostro arrivo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: Y seguro que protegió la investigación para que no se perdiera en el olvido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: That would mean that the base had to be somewhere unaffected by the manabound areas before we arrived.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: E sicuramente ha protetto la ricerca perche' non andasse perduta nell'oblio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: No puede haber tantos sitios que cumplan esos requisitos en Lignumbria.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: She also would have protected the research in some way to keep it from being lost, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: Non possono esserci molti posti che rispettano quei requisiti a Lignumbria.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: ¡Oh!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: There can't be many places that fit that definition in Ligneus.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: Oh!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: ¿Eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: Oh!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: ¡Tu pie!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: Hm?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: Il tuo piede!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: ¿Qué? ¿Qué te ha picado ahora?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: Your foot!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: Cosa? Cosa ti ha punto stavolta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: ¡Le diste una patada! ¡Es la habitación cerrada! ¡La puerta que nunca pudimos abrir en el Atelier!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: Huh? What the hell are you talkin' about?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: Le hai dato un calcio! E' la stanza chiusa! La porta che non siamo mai riusciti ad aprire nell'Atelier!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: You kicked it! The sealed chamber! The door that we could never get open! In the atelier!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: Podría ser. ¡No! ¡Seguro que es esa! Regresemos al Atelier para averiguarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: Potrebbe essere. No! Di sicuro e' quella! Torniamo all'Atelier per scoprirlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: Eh... ¿De qué están hablando?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: That could be it! No, that has to be it! Let's go back to the atelier and take a look!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: Eh... Di cosa state parlando?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..src: Da igual. Hay que volver al Atelier.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..ref: Um ... What are they talking about?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_170..dst: Non importa. Bisogna tornare all'Atelier.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: ¿Esta era la base de la doctora Marina?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: So, this was Doctor Marina's base ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: Questa era la base della Dottoressa Marina?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: Claro, por eso era tan perfecta para hacer alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: I see. So that's why it was so suitable for alchemy ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: Chiaro, ecco perche' era cosi' perfetta per fare alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: ¿No habéis podido abrirla de ningún modo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: So no matter what you did, you couldn't get the door to open?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: Non siete riusciti ad aprirla in alcun modo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: Supongo que la doctora pensaría en todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: I suppose Doctor Marina did whatever she could to keep it secure.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: Immagino che la dottoressa abbia pensato a tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: ¿Eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: ¡Haala!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: Whoa!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: Ohia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: ¿El Vial de recuerdos era la llave?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: The Memory Vial itself was the key?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: La Fiala della Memoria era la chiave?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: Echemos un vistazo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: Let's take a look inside.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: Diamo un'occhiata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: Sí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: ... Yes.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: ¡Cuántos documentos! Y pensar que estuvieron delante de nuestras narices todo este tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: All these documents! To think they were right under our noses all along.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: Quanti documenti! E pensare che erano sotto i nostri occhi per tutto questo tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: Están en buenas condiciones. Todavía se pueden leer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: They seem to be in good condition, too. These are all still readable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: Sono in buone condizioni. Si possono ancora leggere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: ¿Nina?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: Nina?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: Nina?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: La doctora Marina estuvo aquí. Justo donde estamos ahora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: ... Doctor Marina was right here. So close by our side.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: La Dottoressa Marina era qui. Proprio dove siamo adesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: ¡Chicos, mirad! ¡He encontrado otro Vial de recuerdos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: Everyone, look! I found a new Memory Vial!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: Ragazzi, guardate! Ho trovato un'altra Fiala della Memoria!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: ¡Vamos a oírlo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: Let's play it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: Ascoltiamola!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: Flammi se encarga. Reproduciendo grabación...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: Leave it to Flammi. Now playing the audio recording.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: Flammi ci pensa. Riproduzione della registrazione...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Día 382 tras el desastre de maná. Mi investigación de las regiones Lignumbria y Syvashi ha dado sus frutos...»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "Day 382 since the mana disaster. My investigation around the Ligneus and Sivash regions has yielded results—"
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Giorno 382 dopo il disastro del mana. Le mie ricerche nelle regioni di Lignumbria e Syvashi hanno dato i loro frutti..."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «He confirmado que existían fluctuaciones antinaturales de maná en los circuladores de cada región antes del desastre.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "I confirmed that there were unnatural mana fluctuations around the circulators in each area just before the disaster."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Ho confermato che prima del disastro c'erano fluttuazioni innaturali di mana nei circolatori di ogni regione."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «El origen de estas fluctuaciones es desconocido. Solo se me ocurre que alguien haya querido ocultar las pruebas».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "The origin of these fluctuations is completely unknown. I can only assume that someone covered up any evidence."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "L'origine di queste fluttuazioni e' sconosciuta. Mi viene in mente solo che qualcuno abbia voluto nascondere le prove".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Los circuladores estaban bajo el control del imperio. Sería extremadamente difícil que alguien se infiltrara para manipularlos.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "The circulators were under the empire's control. It would be exceedingly difficult for someone to infiltrate and tamper with them."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "I circolatori erano sotto il controllo dell'impero. Sarebbe stato estremamente difficile per qualcuno infiltrarsi per manometterli."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Además, debido al gran número de circuladores presentes en Aladiss, es casi imposible romperlos todos a la vez.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "In addition, due to the sheer number of circulators in Aladiss, it would be near impossible to tamper with them all simultaneously."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Inoltre, a causa del gran numero di circolatori presenti ad Aladiss, e' quasi impossibile manometterli tutti insieme."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «La conclusión más lógica sería que el imperio que supervisaba los circuladores quisiera ocultar las pruebas.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "This makes it likely that the empire which oversaw the circulators was the one that performed this cover-up."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "La conclusione piu' logica e' che l'impero che supervisionava i circolatori volesse nascondere le prove."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Pero ¿con qué finalidad? ¿Acaso querían contener alguna anomalía?»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "However, the purpose of this remains unclear. Was the empire trying to contain some kind of anomaly?"
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Ma con quale scopo? Volevano forse contenere qualche anomalia?"

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «¿O debemos pensar que buscaban el declive de su propia nación?»
