eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "Or are we to believe they were actively working to bring about the fall of their own nation?"
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "O dobbiamo pensare che cercassero il declino della loro stessa nazione?"

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «No importa. Es improbable que encuentre más pruebas investigando sola.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "Regardless, further investigation on my own is unlikely to yield any more results."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Non importa. E' improbabile che io trovi altre prove indagando da sola."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Por mucho que me duela, debo poner fin a mi investigación. He estado pensando en dejar el continente.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "While it pains me, I must end my investigation here. I'm considering leaving this continent."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Per quanto mi dolga, devo porre fine alla mia ricerca. Stavo pensando di lasciare il continente."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Que este mensaje sea tu señal, alquimista que vivirás en el futuro...»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "This message is my final wish to you, an alchemist living in the future—"
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Che questo messaggio sia il tuo segnale, alchimista che vivrai nel futuro..."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Espero que uses mis documentos para descubrir la verdad de una vez por todas.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "I truly hope that you can use these records to uncover the truth, once and for all."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Spero che tu usi i miei documenti per scoprire la verita' una volta per tutte."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: Incluso en plena desolación por el maná no dejó de buscar la causa de la destrucción del país.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: Even in the midst of the area being engulfed in mana, she desperately tried to find the cause of the destruction.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: Anche in piena desolazione causata dal mana non smise mai di cercare la causa della distruzione del paese.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: Debemos estar a la altura de la confianza que ha depositado en nosotros. Gracias, Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: We've got to live up to the trust she put in us. Thank you, Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: Dobbiamo stare all'altezza della fiducia che ha riposto in noi. Grazie, Flammi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: Espera, Yumia. Hay otro mensaje.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: Please wait, Yumia. There is still another recording.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: Aspetta, Yumia. C'e' un altro messaggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: ¿Eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Nina.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "Nina."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Nina."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: ¿Doctora?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: Doctor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: Dottoressa?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Sé que las probabilidades son ínfimas, pero si, por milagro del cielo, encuentras esto dentro de cien años...»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "I know the chances are slim, but if by some miracle you manage to find this hundreds of years in the future ... "
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "So che le probabilita' sono minime, ma se, per miracolo del cielo, trovi questo tra cento anni..."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: No puede ser...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: No way ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: Non puo' essere...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Quiero que sepas que lo siento. Te he exigido demasiado. Demasiado.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "I put you through a lot. Too much. I am truly, truly sorry."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Voglio che tu sappia che mi dispiace. Ti ho chiesto troppo. Troppo."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Te creé para recuperar a mi Nina. Para resucitar a mi hija y volver a tenerla en mi mundo.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "I created you to bring back my Nina. To resurrect my daughter back into this world."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Ti ho creata per riavere la mia Nina. Per resuscitare mia figlia e averla di nuovo nel mio mondo."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «La alegría que sentí cuando te vi nacer no puedo compararla con nada.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "The joy I felt when you were born was immeasurable."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "La gioia che provai quando ti vidi nascere non posso paragonarla a nulla."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Una niña que albergaba los recuerdos de mi propia hija y que se parecía tanto a ella... Por un momento creí que la había recuperado.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "A child who holds all of my daughter's memories and looks just like her. I felt like she had truly come back to me."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Una bambina che custodiva i ricordi di mia figlia e che le somigliava tanto... Per un momento ho creduto che fosse tornata davvero da me."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Pero... algo era distinto en ti. No eras mi hija Nina.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "But ... something was different. You weren't the same Nina as my daughter."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Pero'... in te c'era qualcosa di diverso. Non eri mia figlia Nina."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Sé que a ti también te resultaba confuso, pero nunca supe cómo abordar el tema.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "I knew you were confused yourself, but I was never sure how to approach you."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "So che anche tu ti sentivi confusa, ma non ho mai saputo come affrontare l'argomento."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Te di vida para tapar el vacío de mi corazón, pero me arrepentí.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "I created your life just to fill a void in my heart, and I regretted it."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Ti ho dato la vita per colmare il vuoto del mio cuore, ma mi sono pentita."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Sin embargo, tú... me transmitías tu cariño. Me protegías.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "Yet, you cherished me. You protected me."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Eppure tu... mi donavi il tuo affetto. Mi proteggevi."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Lamento haberte impuesto esta situación. Y siento muchísimo no haber estado a tu lado.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "I am so sorry for imposing my feelings on you. I'm so sorry that I could not be by your side."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Mi dispiace di averti imposto questa situazione. E mi dispiace tantissimo di non essere stata al tuo fianco."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Sé que ahora es muy tarde, pero...»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "I know that it may be too late to say this now, but ... "
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "So che ormai e' troppo tardi, ma..."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Tú eres tú. No eres ella. No intentes vivir la vida de Nina y vive la tuya propia.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "You are you. You're not her. Don't try to live Nina's life, and instead live your own."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Tu sei te stessa. Non sei lei. Non provare a vivere la vita di Nina: vivi la tua."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Seguro que te enfrentarás a muchos problemas por el camino, pero también encontrarás felicidad y alegría.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "I'm sure you will face many challenges on your journey, but you will also encounter joy and happiness."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Sicuramente affronterai molte difficolta' lungo il cammino, ma incontrerai anche felicita' e gioia."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Observa el mundo. Haz amigos.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "See the world. Make friends."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Osserva il mondo. Fatti degli amici."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Si te cruzas con alguien que te trate bien, permítete vivir el amor. Igual que lo hice yo en su día.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "If you happen to meet someone who cares for you, then fall in love. Just as I once did."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Se incontrerai qualcuno che ti tratta bene, permettiti di vivere l'amore. Proprio come feci io un tempo."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Ríe y llora como las personas que te rodean. Halla tu propia ilusión.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "Laugh and cry just like those around you. Find your happiness."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Ridi e piangi come le persone che ti circondano. Trova la tua felicita'."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Mira hacia el futuro. Seguro que te aguardan muchas esperanzas. Y elige siempre tu propio camino.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "Look ahead. The future is sure to be overflowing with hope. You are free to choose any path you want."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Guarda verso il futuro. Sicuramente ti aspettano molte speranze. E scegli sempre il tuo cammino."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Gracias, Nina, por venir a este mundo. Gracias por darme esperanza y por regalarme mi futuro.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "Thank you, Nina, for coming into this world. Thank you for giving me hope, and for giving me a future."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Grazie, Nina, per essere venuta in questo mondo. Grazie per avermi dato speranza e per avermi regalato un futuro."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: «Rezo para que vivas tu vida y la disfrutes.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: "I pray that your future is yours to live."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: "Prego perche' tu possa vivere la tua vita e assaporarla."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..src: Mamá...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..ref: Mom ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_180..dst: Mamma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: ¡Hola! Siento haberos hecho esperar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: Hello! Sorry for the wait.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Ciao! Mi dispiace di avervi fatto aspettare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Señorita Nina, ¿estás bien?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: Miss Nina, are you okay?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Signorina Nina, stai bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Sí. De hecho, estoy mejor que nunca. Por fin me he sacado la espinita que tenía clavada en el corazón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: Yes. Actually, I'm feeling better than ever. It feels like I've finally removed a thorn that had been stuck in my heart.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Si'. In effetti, sto meglio che mai. Ho finalmente tolto quella spina che avevo conficcata nel cuore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Me alegro de oír eso...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: ... Glad to hear it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Sono contenta di sentirlo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Bueno, ¿y de qué estabais hablando?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: So, what were you all talking about?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Allora, di cosa stavate parlando?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Estábamos debatiendo qué hacer con estos documentos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: We were trying to figure out what to do with all these documents.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Stavamo discutendo cosa fare di questi documenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: ¿Te importaría que se los estregásemos al equipo de investigación?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: Would you mind if we entrusted them to the Research Team?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Ti dispiacerebbe se li dessimo alla Squadra di Ricerca?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Seguro que significan mucho para ti. No queríamos decidirlo sin tu consentimiento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: I'm sure they mean a lot to you, so we felt it wasn't our place to decide.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Sicuramente significano molto per te. Non volevamo decidere senza il tuo consenso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Ja, ja, gracias por vuestra consideración, pero no os preocupéis por mí. Se los daremos al equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: Haha, thanks for thinking of me, but don't worry. Let's hand them over to the Research Team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Ah ah, grazie per la vostra premura, ma non vi preoccupate per me. Li daremo alla Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: ¿Estás segura? No va a ser fácil recuperarlos si te arrepientes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: You sure? It's not gonna be easy to get them back if you change your mind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Sei sicura? Non sara' facile riprenderseli se ti pentirai.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Segurísima. Ya he visto todo lo que necesitaba ver.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: It's fine. I've seen what I needed to see.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Assolutamente. Ho gia' visto tutto cio' che dovevo vedere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: «Espero que uses mis documentos para descubrir la verdad.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: "I hope that you can use these records to uncover the truth."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: "Spero che userai i miei documenti per scoprire la verita'."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Ese fue el deseo de la doc... de mi madre. Estos archivos se merecen estar en las manos adecuadas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: That was the doc—Mom's wish. These documents should be stored and investigated by the right hands.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Quello era il desiderio della dott... di mia madre. Questi documenti meritano di stare nelle mani giuste.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Las manos adecuadas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: Investigated by the right hands, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Le mani giuste...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: En ese caso, seguiremos investigando Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: In that case, we need to continue our investigation of Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: In tal caso, continueremo a indagare su Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Si Basilius quiere restaurar Aladiss...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: If Basilius really is trying to resurrect Aladiss ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Se Basilius vuole restaurare Aladiss...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Hay que pararle los pies.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: We need to stop him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Bisogna fermarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: ¡Vaya! Directa al grano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: Wow, so you can get straight to the point.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Caspita! Dritta al sodo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Después de oír a la doctora Marina, no he dejado de pensar en eso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: After hearing Doctor Marina's message, one thing really stood out to me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Dopo aver ascoltato la Dottoressa Marina, non ho smesso di pensarci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Nunca se puede volver a crear algo que se ha perdido exactamente igual al original.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: When you recreate something that's been lost, it will never quite be the same as the original.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Non e' possibile ricreare esattamente come l'originale qualcosa che e' andato perduto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Las cosas que se pierden jamás se recuperan. Eso incluye a las personas que han muerto y a mis recuerdos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: The things we've lost can never be returned. That includes people who have died, as well as my memories.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Le cose che si perdono non tornano mai piu'. Lo stesso vale per le persone che sono morte e per i miei ricordi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: El plan de Basilius solo traerá más desgracias, tanto para él como para los demás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: Basilius's plan will only bring more sorrow, both to him and everyone else.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Il piano di Basilius non portera' che altre disgrazie, sia a lui che agli altri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Es imposible recuperar Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: It's impossible to bring Aladiss back.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Recuperare Aladiss e' impossibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Quiero seguir adelante y aceptar lo que se ha quedado atrás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: Yumia ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Voglio andare avanti e accettare cio' che abbiamo lasciato alle spalle.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Deseo revelar toda la verdad sobre la alquimia y el motivo por el que se perdió Aladiss. ¡Quiero detener a Basilius!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: I want to move forward, accepting what has been lost.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Voglio rivelare tutta la verita' sull'alchimia e sul motivo per cui Aladiss e' scomparsa. Voglio fermare Basilius!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: No porque nadie me lo haya pedido ni porque sea nuestra misión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: I want to uncover the truth of alchemy and the reason behind Aladiss's collapse, and stop Basilius's plan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Non perche' qualcuno me l'abbia chiesto, ne' perche' sia la nostra missione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Sino porque creo que es lo correcto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: Not because someone told me to or just because it's our mission.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Ma perche' credo che sia la cosa giusta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Hemos llegado muy lejos, ¡hay que llegar hasta el final!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: But because I believe it's the right thing to do!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Siamo giunti fin qui, dobbiamo andare fino alla fine!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Será todo lo emperador que quiera, pero eso no significa que no se merezca un par de azotes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: After coming this far, we have to see this through!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Sara' pure imperatore quanto vuole, ma questo non significa che non si meriti un paio di frustate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Primera parada: la capital. Nuestro objetivo está al este, al otro lado de la región de Auruma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: He might be emperor or whatever, but that doesn't mean we can't punch him straight in the face!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Prima tappa: la capitale. Il nostro obiettivo e' a est, al di la' della regione di Auruma.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: Eso nos llevará a la última de las cuatro regiones de Aladiss. Al terreno de la capital...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: First we need to investigate the capital. Let's head further east beyond the Auruma region.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: Cosi' arriveremo all'ultima delle quattro regioni di Aladiss. Al territorio della capitale...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..src: La región de Lacuna.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..ref: That will lead us to the last of the four regions of Aladiss, where the capital lies ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm06_190..dst: La regione di Lacuna.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..ref: ... What the hell's goin' on here?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..src: Es un campo normal y corriente... ¿Seguro que Calumna está por aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..ref: Huh, it's just a regular field? Are we sure Calumna is supposed to be around here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..dst: E' un campo qualunque... Sei sicuro che Calumna sia da queste parti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..src: Según la topografía de este lugar, sí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..ref: Based on the topography, it should be here ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..dst: Secondo la topografia di questo luogo, si'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..src: ¿Será que el Gran Desastre acabaría con los edificios y la vegetación?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..ref: Do you think the Great Disaster wiped out all the buildings and vegetation here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..dst: Sara' che il Grande Disastro ha spazzato via edifici e vegetazione?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..src: No. Hemos visto estructuras en otras regiones... Me cuesta imaginar que todo haya desaparecido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..ref: No, the other regions all had something left in them, so for everything to be completely erased is hard to imagine.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..dst: No. Abbiamo visto strutture in altre regioni... Fatico a immaginare che tutto sia scomparso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..src: Eso implicaría que también se ha perdido la información sobre la capital...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..ref: If that's true, it would mean that any information related to the capital is lost too ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..dst: Significherebbe che anche le informazioni sulla capitale sono andate perdute...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..src: Sabemos que la capital se llevó la peor parte del daño y no lo pongo en duda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..dst: Sappiamo che la capitale ha subi'to i danni peggiori, e non lo metto in dubbio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..src: Pero, aun así, ¿de qué magnitud hablamos si ha desaparecido hasta el más mínimo rastro de su existencia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..ref: We've heard that the capital took the worst damage, and I'm pretty sure that is the case.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..dst: Pero', anche cosi', di quale entita' parliamo, se persino la piu' minuscola traccia della sua esistenza e' scomparsa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..src: ¿Y si miramos por los alrededores? Tal vez encontremos alguna pista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..ref: But even so, is it really possible for every trace of it to be completely gone?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_010..dst: Che ne dici di dare un'occhiata in giro? Forse troviamo qualche indizio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Oye, Lenja, ¿no notas algo extraño?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: ... Hey, Lenja, doesn't something feel kind of off?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Ehi, Lenja, non noti qualcosa di strano?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Sí, percibo algo cerca...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: Yes. It feels like there's something over here ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Si', avverto qualcosa qui vicino...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: ¿De qué se trata?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: You guys pickin' up on somethin'?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Di cosa si tratta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Hay un montón de maná arremolinándose en la zona. Es como si hubiera algo cerca, como dice Lenja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: There's a huge amount of mana swirling around here. Like Lenja said, it seems like there's something up ahead.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: C'e' una gran quantita' di mana che turbinia nella zona. Come dice Lenja, sembra che ci sia qualcosa da queste parti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: ¿En serio? Yo solo veo un campo enorme y vacío.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: Huh? No matter where you look, it's just a big open field.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Sul serio? Io vedo solo un campo enorme e vuoto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Si Lenja y Yumia lo han notado a la vez, algo habrá.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: If both Lenja and Yumia felt it at the same time, there's not much room for doubt.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Se Lenja e Yumia l'hanno avvertito allo stesso tempo, qualcosa ci sara' di sicuro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Venga, somos del equipo de investigación: si hay algo que no sabemos, le ponemos remedio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: We're the Research Team. If there's something we aren't sure about, we should look into it ourselves.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Dai, siamo la Squadra di Ricerca: se c'e' qualcosa che non sappiamo, lo scopriamo da noi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: ¡Eh! ¡Venid todos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: Everyone, over there!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Ehi! Venite tutti quanti!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: What the—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Ma che...?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Hay un muro invisible o algo así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: There's some kind of invisible wall here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: C'e' un muro invisibile o qualcosa del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: No puede ser... ¿Qué truco es este?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: No kidding ... What is this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Non e' possibile... Che scherzo e' questo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: La fisura llega hasta el otro lado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: This fissure goes through to the other side.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: La fessura arriva fino all'altro lato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Solo hay una forma de saber a dónde conduce.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: Only one way to find out where it leads.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: C'e' solo un modo per scoprire dove porta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Es increíble...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: Incredible ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: E' incredibile...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Así que esta es la verdadera capital de Aladiss... Esto es Calumna.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: So this is the real capital of Aladiss ... The real Calumna.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Quindi questa e' la vera capitale di Aladiss... Questa e' Calumna.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: ¿Y qué significa ese muro? ¿Se supone que sirve para ocultar la ciudad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: What the hell's with this wall? Is it supposed to make the city invisible?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Ma che significa quel muro? Dovrebbe servire a nascondere la citta'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Yo tampoco lo entiendo del todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: I can't even begin to imagine how it works.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Nemmeno io lo capisco del tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Oh... ¿Creéis que el muro se levantó para proteger a la ciudad del Gran Desastre?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: Oh ... Do you think the wall might have been made to keep the city safe from the Great Disaster?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Oh... Pensate che il muro sia stato eretto per proteggere la citta' dal Grande Disastro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: No lo creo. Hasta donde yo sé, no existía nada por el estilo en la vieja capital.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: No, I don't think that's it. To my knowledge, there wasn't anything like this in the old capital.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Non credo. Per quanto ne so, nella vecchia capitale non esisteva niente del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Acabaría destruida por el desastre como todo lo demás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: The capital should have been destroyed by the disaster just like everything else.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Sarebbe finita distrutta dal disastro come tutto il resto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Mmm... Entonces, ¿por qué está Calumna en tan buenas condiciones?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: Hmm ... But then why does Calumna look so well-preserved?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Mmm... Allora perche' Calumna e' in condizioni cosi' buone?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Estos materiales de construcción no son normales.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: These aren't your standard building materials ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Questi materiali da costruzione non sono normali.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Es solo una idea, pero se me ocurre que hayan reconstruido la ciudad después de su destrucción.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: This is just a thought, but this city might have been rebuilt after being destroyed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: E' solo un'idea, ma mi viene in mente che abbiano ricostruito la citta' dopo la sua distruzione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Venga, no estarás diciendo que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: Come on, are you really tellin' us—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Dai, non starai mica a dire che...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Es justo lo que estás diciendo, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: —you're bein' serious, aren't you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: E' proprio quello che stai dicendo, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Ya has oído a Nina. Aladiss fue destruida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: You heard Nina. Aladiss was definitely destroyed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Hai sentito Nina. Aladiss e' stata distrutta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: ¿Qué posibilidades hay de que la capital sobreviviera al desastre? Pero sí es posible que alguien que sepa de alquimia la haya recuperado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: It's unlikely that just the capital was left unscathed, but it's possible that someone later rebuilt it with alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: E' improbabile che solo la capitale sia rimasta illesa, ma e' possibile che qualcuno l'abbia poi ricostruita con l'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Y ese alguien sería...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: And that "someone" would be ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: E quel qualcuno sarebbe...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Basilius. El muro, la ciudad... Esto debe de ser obra suya, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: It has to be Basilius, right? That wall, the city—I think it was all him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Basilius. Il muro, la citta'... Deve essere opera sua, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Sí. Es la única explicación lógica.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: Indeed, that does seem to be the logical conclusion.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Si'. E' l'unica spiegazione logica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Formará parte de su plan de «restaurar Aladiss».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: This might be another part of their plan to "restore Aladiss."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Sara' parte del loro piano per "restaurare Aladiss".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: La grandeza de la alquimia no conoce límites...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: There really are no limits to what alchemy can do ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Le possibilita' dell'alchimia non conoscono limiti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Y ahora, ¿qué? ¿Investigamos como si nada?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: So now what? We just get right to investigatin'?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: E adesso, che facciamo? Ci mettiamo a indagare e basta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: La capital debe de ser esencial en los planes de Basilius. Deberíamos asegurarnos de contar con todo lo necesario antes de proceder.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: The capital is likely the crux of Basilius's plans. We should ensure that we're thoroughly prepared before proceeding.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: La capitale dev'essere essenziale nei piani di Basilius. Dovremmo assicurarci di avere tutto il necessario prima di procedere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Estoy de acuerdo. Lo primero es lo primero: hay que levantar una base.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: Agreed. Let's stick to the procedure and set up a base first.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Sono d'accordo. Prima di tutto: dobbiamo allestire una base.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: No sé cuál es la finalidad de ese muro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: I wonder how exactly that wall works.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Non so quale sia lo scopo di quel muro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Nosotros tampoco. Pero creo que Basilius está detrás de todo esto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: I also have no clue. But I think it was probably Basilius that set it up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Nemmeno noi. Ma credo che dietro a tutto questo ci sia Basilius.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: ¿Qué pasa, Nina? Llevas callada un buen rato.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: What's wrong, Nina? You've been lost in thought for a while.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Che c'e', Nina? Stai zitta da un bel po'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Lo siento. Es que... hay algo que me escama sobre la capital.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: Oh, I'm sorry. It's just, there's something that's been bothering me about the capital.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Mi dispiace. E' che... c'e' una cosa sulla capitale che non mi torna.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: ¿De qué se trata?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: Really? Please do share!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Di cosa si tratta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: A ver.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: Of course.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Allora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Es sobre su estado. Estaba distinta a como yo la recuerdo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: It's about the way the city looked. It just feels a little different from how I remember it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Riguarda il suo aspetto. La citta' era diversa da come la ricordo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Y no solo hablo del muro invisible. Todo lo demás era diferente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: It's not just the invisible wall ... The way everything looked was different too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: E non parlo solo del muro invisibile. Anche tutto il resto era diverso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: En otras palabras: no se han limitado a reconstruirla. Según tú, han rediseñado la ciudad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: In other words, it wasn't just rebuilt. The city itself was changed?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: In altre parole: non si sono limitati a ricostruirla. A quanto dici, hanno ridisegnato la citta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Sí, eso creo. Deberíamos mantenernos alerta mientras investigamos la zona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: Yes, perhaps. At the very least, we need to stay on our guard while investigating it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Si', e' cosi'. Dovremmo rimanere all'erta mentre indaghiamo sulla zona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Si Basilius está de verdad en la capital, puede que acabemos enfrentándonos a una horda de mutantes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: If Basilius really is in the capital, we might end up finding a swarm of mutants inside.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Se Basilius e' davvero nella capitale, potremmo ritrovarci faccia a faccia con un'orda di mutanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: E-espero que no...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: I-I really hope not ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: S-spero di no...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: No podemos descartarlo. No debemos bajar la guardia ni un instante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: It's certainly a possibility. We need to exercise more caution than ever before.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Non possiamo escluderlo. Non dobbiamo abbassare la guardia nemmeno un istante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Efectivamente. Esta fase de la investigación y la exploración os llevará a las zonas más recónditas de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: Please do. This phase of our investigation and pioneering will bring us in contact with the deepest parts of Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Infatti. Questa fase della ricerca e dell'esplorazione vi portera' nelle zone piu' remote di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Yo me aseguraré de que la base esté fortificada. Mientras tanto, continuad con vuestro cometido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: I'll be making sure this base is sufficiently fortified. In the meantime, please continue with the survey.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Io mi assicurero' che la base sia ben fortificata. Nel frattempo, continuate con il vostro compito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Eso haremos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: Will do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Sara' fatto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Veo que te has acostumbrado rápido a la acción, ¿eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: You've really gotten used to this, haven't you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Vedo che ti sei ormai abituato all'azione, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Bueno, es lo que se espera de mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: Well, when it's been this long.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Beh, e' quello che ci si aspetta da me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..src: Venga, vamos a atravesar ese muro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..ref: All right. Let's go back through the wall.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_020..dst: Dai, attraversiamo quel muro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_030..src: Yumia, estos son los planes de exploración de la región de Lacuna. Es la cuarta y última zona de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_030..ref: Yumia, these are the pioneering plans for the Lacuna region. This is the fourth and final region of Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_030..dst: Yumia, questi sono i piani di esplorazione della regione di Lacuna. E' la quarta e ultima zona di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_030..src: Teniendo en cuenta sus circunstancias especiales, es muy probable que las cosas se pongan serias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_030..ref: Considering the region's unique circumstances, it's likely that things will become even more difficult.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_030..dst: Considerate le sue circostanze particolari, e' molto probabile che le cose si facciano serie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_030..src: Pero habéis llegado muy lejos. Confío ciegamente en vuestras habilidades.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_030..ref: But you all have made it this far. I'm sure you'll do just fine.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_030..dst: Ma siete arrivati fin qui. Confido ciecamente nelle vostre abilita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_030..src: Claro que sí. ¡Déjalo en nuestras manos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_030..ref: Got it. Just leave it to us!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..src: Si lo que queremos es dar con Basilius y descubrir los misterios de Aladiss, hay dos opciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..ref: If we're going to track down Basilius and unravel the mysteries of Aladiss, there are two strong candidates.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..dst: Se vogliamo trovare Basilius e svelare i misteri di Aladiss, ci sono due opzioni valide.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..src: La primera es el Castillo de Lacuna, el castillo del emperador. La otra sería el Laboratorio imperial núm. 1... donde yo nací.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..ref: The first is Lacuna Castle, the emperor's castle. The other is the 1st Imperial Laboratory ... where I was born.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..dst: La prima e' il Castello di Lacuna, il castello dell'imperatore. L'altra sarebbe il Laboratorio imperiale n. 1... dove sono nata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..src: El castillo es enorme, debería ser fácil de divisar incluso desde la distancia. Pero ahora las cosas son muy distintas a mi época. No lo encuentro por ningún lado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..ref: The castle should be easy to spot even from a distance considering its grandeur, but things really are different now. I can't find it at all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..dst: Il castello e' enorme, dovrebbe essere facile scorgerlo anche dalla distanza. Ma ora le cose sono molto diverse dai miei tempi. Non lo trovo da nessuna parte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..src: Mmm... Así que ir directos al castillo no es viable. ¿Dónde queda el laboratorio?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..ref: Hmm, so investigating the castle right away might be difficult. Where is the laboratory?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..dst: Mh... Quindi andare direttamente al castillo non e' fattibile. Dov'e' il laboratorio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..src: Es ese edificio enorme en el centro de la ciudad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..ref: It's that huge building in the center of the city.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..dst: E' quell'enorme edificio al centro della citta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..ref: So that's where you were born ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..src: Era el epicentro de la investigación alquímica de Aladiss. Imaginad la de secretos que guarda en su interior.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..ref: That facility was the heart of Aladiss's alchemical research. It's bound to have some secrets buried within.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..dst: Era l'epicentro della ricerca alchemica di Aladiss. Immaginate quanti segreti custodisce al suo interno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..src: Pues parece que ya tenemos un destino.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..ref: Starting there sounds like a wise choice, then.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..dst: Beh, sembra che abbiamo gia' una destinazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..src: ¡Qué suerte tenemos de contar contigo, Nina! Que sepas todas estas cosas simplifica nuestro trabajo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..ref: We sure are lucky to have you with us, Nina! Knowing stuff in advance makes things so much easier!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..dst: Che fortuna averti con noi, Nina! Il fatto che tu sappia tutte queste cose semplifica il nostro lavoro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..src: Hago todo lo posible porque así sea, pero no siempre depende de mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..ref: Though, I can't guarantee how far it will continue to be useful.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..dst: Faccio del mio meglio perche' sia cosi', ma non dipende sempre da me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..src: De ahora en adelante no sabemos qué nos deparará el futuro. Mantened los ojos bien abiertos, ¿vale?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..ref: We have no idea what we might encounter from here on out. Let's proceed with caution, everyone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_040..dst: Da qui in poi non sappiamo cosa ci riservera' il futuro. Tenete gli occhi ben aperti, va bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..src: Este es el Laboratorio imperial número 1. Parece más grande de cerca.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..ref: The 1st Imperial Laboratory. It's even bigger up close.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..dst: Questo e' il Laboratorio imperiale numero 1. Sembra piu' grande da vicino.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..src: El maná fluye desde el otro lado de esta puerta. Es como si todo funcionara con ello.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..ref: There's even mana flowing through this door. It's like everything here uses mana.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..dst: Il mana scorre dall'altro lato di questa porta. E' come se tutto funzionasse con esso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..src: Eso tiene una explicación. Todo lo que investigaban aquí era un secreto de estado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..ref: That's because everything being researched here was considered a national secret.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..dst: C'e' una spiegazione. Tutto cio' che studiavano qui era un segreto di stato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..src: Sea lo que sea, no podemos entrar. No parece que esta puerta se abra de ningún modo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..ref: Either way, we can't get in here. This door doesn't look like it's going to open.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..dst: Qualsiasi cosa sia, non possiamo entrare. Non sembra che questa porta si apra in nessun modo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..src: Lenja, dices que el maná fluye hasta el laboratorio, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..ref: Lenja, the mana around here is all flowing toward the laboratory, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..dst: Lenja, dici che il mana scorre fino al laboratorio, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..src: Sí. Yo diría que procede de esa torre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..ref: Yes. What's more, it seems to be coming from that huge tower.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..dst: Si'. Direi che proviene da quella torre.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..src: Todo apunta a que el maná que alimenta el laboratorio viene de las tres torres que lo rodean.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..ref: It seems that the mana being used to power the laboratory is coming from the three surrounding towers.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..dst: Tutto induce a pensare che il mana che alimenta il laboratorio provenga dalle tre torri che lo circondano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..src: Calumna está dividida en tres distritos: el cementerio imperial, el distrito administrativo y el distrito comercial.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..ref: Calumna is divided into three main districts: the imperial graveyard, the administrative district, and the commercial district.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..dst: Calumna e' divisa in tre distretti: il cimitero imperiale, il distretto amministrativo e il distretto commerciale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..src: Cada uno posee una torre. Las llamaban «torres de control del maná».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..ref: Each of those districts has a tower. They're mana control towers.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..dst: Ognuno possiede una torre. Le chiamavano "torri di controllo del mana".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..src: Así que guiaban la afluencia de maná... Eso quiere decir...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..ref: So people were intentionally guiding the flow of mana ... Then ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..dst: Quindi guidavano l'afflusso di mana... Il che significa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..src: Que, si nos hacemos con el control del maná, podremos abrir la puerta. ¿No?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..ref: Oh. Does that mean that if we take control of the flow of mana, we might be able to open the door?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..dst: Che, se prendiamo il controllo del mana, potremo aprire la porta. No?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..src: Puede ser. Al controlar las tres fuentes de energía principales, podremos redirigir el maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..ref: It should. If we can secure all three power sources, we should be able to control the mana!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..dst: Puo' darsi. Controllando le tre fonti di energia principali, potremo reindirizzare il mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..src: Jamás hubiera dicho que una puerta cerrada con un mecanismo desconocido fuera tan fácil de sortear.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..ref: I never would've thought a door that can't be opened by normal means would have such a simple weakness.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..dst: Non avrei mai detto che una porta chiusa con un meccanismo sconosciuto fosse cosi' facile da aggirare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..src: Vale, investiguemos las torres para controlar la corriente de maná. Es lo mismo que hicimos con los pedestales.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..ref: All right, let's search the towers and take control of the flow of mana. Same thing as we did with the pedestals.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..dst: Va bene, indaghiamo le torri per controllare la corrente di mana. E' come abbiamo fatto con i piedistalli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..src: Puede que nos estén esperando para tendernos una emboscada. Os quiero atentos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..ref: It's possible we may be blocked or ambushed. Let's be on our guard.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_050..dst: Potrebbero star aspettando di tenderci un'imboscata. Voglio tutti ben attenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_060..src: ¡Un circulador de maná! Debe de ser parte del sistema de control.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_060..ref: Oh, a mana circulator! This must be a key part of the mana control system.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_060..dst: Un circolatore di mana! Dev'essere una parte fondamentale del sistema di controllo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_060..src: No veo que hayan colocado ninguna trampa. ¿Estás lista, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_060..ref: There don't seem to be any traps around it. Ready, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_060..dst: Non vedo che abbiano piazzato nessuna trappola. Sei pronta, Yumia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..src: ¿Mmm? Eso debería bastar para controlar la corriente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..ref: Huh? That should have controlled the flow of mana.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..dst: Mmm? Dovrebbe bastare per controllare la corrente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..src: Pues la zona de vínculo de maná sigue intacta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..ref: The manabound area hasn't changed either.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..dst: Pero' la zona di legame del mana e' ancora intatta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..src: O algo ha salido mal o nuestra hipótesis era incorrecta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..ref: So either something went wrong, or our theory was off.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..dst: O qualcosa e' andato storto, o la nostra ipotesi era sbagliata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..src: A lo mejor hay algo más que interfiera en el control del maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..dst: Forse c'e' qualcos'altro che interferisce con il controllo del mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..ref: Is it possible that somewhere else is controlling the mana?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..dst: Si', anche io ci avevo pensato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..src: Humm... El maná que fluye desde las torres se dirige a varios puntos, no solo al laboratorio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..ref: Yes, I was thinking the same thing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..dst: Hmm... Il mana che scorre dalle torri si dirige verso diversi punti, non solo verso il laboratorio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..ref: Um ... I feel like the mana flowing from the towers is going to multiple locations, not just the laboratory.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..src: La corriente que percibí... Creo que continúa en esta dirección.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..dst: La corrente che ho percepito... Credo che continui in questa direzione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..src: Echemos un vistazo. Tal vez encontremos una respuesta al final del camino.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..ref: The flow of mana I picked up ... I think it's going this way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_070..dst: Diamo un'occhiata. Forse troveremo una risposta alla fine del cammino.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_080..src: El maná fluye en paralelo a esta carretera.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_080..ref: The mana seems to be flowing parallel to this road.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_080..dst: Il mana scorre in parallelo a questa strada.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_080..ref: Whoa, where did these guys come from?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_080..src: ¿Una emboscada? Por fin se pone la cosa interesante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_080..ref: Hah, an ambush? Now things are gettin' interestin'!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_080..dst: Un'imboscata? Finalmente la cosa si fa interessante!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_080..src: Con calma, podemos acabar con ellos. ¡Vamos, equipo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_080..ref: If we just stay calm, we can handle this. Everyone, here we go!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_080..dst: Se stiamo calmi, possiamo farcela. Dai, squadra!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Ese era el último.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: That should be the end of it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Quello era l'ultimo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: No fui capaz de notar a los monstruos que nos rodeaban...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: I didn't even notice monsters were surrounding us ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Non ho potuto notare i mostri che ci circondavano...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Dudo mucho que lo hayan decidido en consenso. Es decir...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: I doubt that so many would just gather together naturally. In other words ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Dubito molto che l'abbiano deciso di comune accordo. Cioe'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: ¡Vésper!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: Vesper!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Vesper!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Ha llegado a mis oídos que habéis derrotado a Corleonis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: I hear you defeated Corleonis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Mi e' giunto alle orecchie che avete sconfitto Corleonis.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: ¿Y qué? ¿Vienes a vengarte?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: Yes, and? Do you intend to avenge him?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: E quindi? Vieni a vendicarti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Claro que no. Ambos comprendíamos que el sacrificio personal a veces es necesario para alcanzar un propósito mayor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: Nonsense. We both understand what it means to sacrifice our lives for a greater purpose.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Certamente che no. Entrambi comprendevamo che il sacrificio personale a volte e' necessario per raggiungere uno scopo piu' grande.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Entonces, ¿quieres detenernos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: Then are you here to stop us?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Allora, vuoi fermarci?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Sí, eso es lo que quiero.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: Indeed, I am.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Si', e' quello che voglio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Pero esta vez las cosas son diferentes. Todo ha cambiado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: But things are different this time. Everything is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Ma questa volta le cose sono diverse. E' cambiato tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Y no sabes cuánto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: Of course it is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: E non sai quanto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Sabemos lo que eres: un «mutante». Y hemos leído sobre algunos de los acontecimientos que tuvieron lugar en Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: We've learned that you're what's called a "mutant." And we've learned part of what occurred in Aladiss long ago.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Sappiamo cosa sei: un "mutante". E abbiamo letto su alcuni degli eventi avvenuti ad Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Ya no somos los críos ignorantes que viste por primera vez. Hemos crecido mucho durante esta investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: We've grown a lot from this investigation. We're no longer the ignorant people we once were.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Non siamo piu' i ragazzini ignoranti che hai visto la prima volta. Siamo cresciuti molto durante questa indagine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Y nos gustaría hacerte una pregunta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: There's something we need to ask you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: E vorremmo farti una domanda.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: ¿Por qué atacaste nuestro hogar? ¿Por qué luchas por Aladiss?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: Why did you attack our domain? Why are you fighting for Aladiss?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Perche' hai attaccato la nostra casa? Perche' combatti per Aladiss?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Sabemos que puedes hablar, ¡no te cortes!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: You can talk, so tell us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Sappiamo che puoi parlare, non esitare!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Incluso los recuerdos de personas insignificantes como vosotros son imprescindibles en nuestra misión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: ... Even the memories of lowly beings such as yourself are essential to our mission.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Anche i ricordi di persone insignificanti come voi sono indispensabili per la nostra missione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Resucitaremos a nuestros hermanos caídos que descansan en este lugar. Haremos realidad el mundo que Su Majestad imaginó.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: We will resurrect our fallen brethren who sleep here. This is all to make the world His Majesty envisioned a reality.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Resusciteremo i nostri fratelli caduti che riposano in questo luogo. Realizzeremo il mondo che Sua Maesta' aveva immaginato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Es mi obligación. Por mis cualidades de mutante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: As one who has obtained the power of a mutant, that is my duty.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: E' il mio dovere. Per le mie qualita' di mutante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: ¿Cualidades? Lo dices como si las obtuvieras voluntariamente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: You "obtained" it? Are you saying you wanted to take on that form?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Qualita'? Lo dici come se le avessi ottenute volontariamente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Nunca lo entenderíais...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: ... The likes of you could never understand.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Non lo capireste mai...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: No sabéis la impotencia que se siente al nacer en una familia de alquimistas famosos y no poseer ningún talento. Al escuchar una y otra vez que vuestra vida no tiene sentido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: The powerlessness of being born into a family famous for alchemy with no talent of your own—of having your life called worthless.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Non sapete quanta impotenza si prova a nascere in una famiglia di alchimisti famosi e non avere alcun talento. A sentire ancora e ancora che la propria vita e' priva di senso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Los experimentos me otorgaron este poder. Con él puedo demostrar mi valía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: But the mutant experiments granted me power. And with this power, I can demonstrate my worth.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Gli esperimenti mi hanno donato questo potere. Con esso posso dimostrare il mio valore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: La derrota y el fracaso no tienen cabida en nuestros planes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: Defeat, failure—these things are unacceptable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: La sconfitta e il fallimento non hanno posto nei nostri piani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Tienes razón... No te entiendo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: ... You're right. I don't understand.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Hai ragione... Non ti capisco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Tu momento pasó. Ahora nos toca a nosotros vivir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: Your era has ended. The present age is ours to live.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Il tuo tempo e' passato. Ora tocca a noi vivere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Los recuerdos de los siglos pasados deben ser enterrados con dignidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: The relics of bygone centuries should be laid to rest with dignity.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: I ricordi dei secoli passati vanno sepolti con dignita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Quizás... la lucha era inevitable desde el principio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: ... Perhaps battle was inevitable all along.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Forse... il conflitto era inevitabile fin dall'inizio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Muy bien. Concluiré mis preparativos y os aplastaré.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: Very well. I will perfect my preparations and crush you all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Molto bene. Concludero' i miei preparativi e vi annientero'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Se acerca la hora de la verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: The time of reckoning draws near.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: L'ora della verita' si avvicina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: Phew ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Uff!...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Qué tensión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: Isla ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Che tensione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: He dicho todo lo que tenía que decir. Y ya he obtenido la respuesta que necesitaba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: That was stressful.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Ho detto tutto quello che avevo da dire. E ho gia' ottenuto la risposta di cui avevo bisogno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Sí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: But I said what I needed to say, and we heard what we needed to hear.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: ¿Resucitar a sus hermanos caídos? Es un sueño imposible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: ... Yeah.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Resuscitare i loro fratelli caduti? E' un sogno impossibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Uno del que no quieren despertar. Creen que se hará realidad usando el poder de la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: But ... resurrecting their sleeping brethren? Yet another impossible dream.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Uno da cui non vogliono svegliarsi. Credono che si avverera' usando il potere dell'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Como alquimista, debo detenerlos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: Even so, they'll pursue it all the same. Because alchemy showed them that dream.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: In qualita' di alchimista, devo fermarli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Como alquimista, debo asegurarme de que mi sueño no nos conduce también a la ruina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: As a fellow alchemist, I have to stop them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: In qualita' di alchimista, devo assicurarmi che il mio sogno non porti anche noi alla rovina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: ¿Señorita Yumia?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: As a fellow alchemist, I need to make sure that I'm not also pursuing the wrong dream.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Signorina Yumia?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Perdonadme. ¿Os importaría que me quedara aquí un poco más antes de continuar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: Miss Yumia ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Perdonatemi. Vi dispiacerebbe se restassi qui ancora un po' prima di proseguire?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Creo que las personas que descansan aquí se merecen que me interese por sus historias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: Sorry, everyone. Would you mind if I looked around here a bit before we move on?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Penso che le persone che riposano qui meritino che mi interessi delle loro storie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..src: Por supuesto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..ref: I think I owe it to the people resting here to learn more about them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_090..dst: Certo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..src: Por aquel entonces, los conflictos eran más habituales de lo que estamos acostumbrados ahora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..ref: It seems that back then, conflicts used to occur far more frequently than we can imagine in this day and age.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..dst: In quell'epoca, i conflitti erano piu' comuni di quelli a cui siamo abituati adesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..src: Sí, así era. Cuando decidimos huir y escondernos, dejaron de llegar noticias del frente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..ref: Yes, they did. Since we had fled and were hiding, I don't know the details of the war front ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..dst: Si', era cosi'. Quando decidemmo di fuggire e nasconderci, smisero di arrivare notizie dal fronte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..src: Pero sabíamos desde el primer momento que crearon homúnculos y mutantes para usarlos como armas de guerra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..ref: But from the start, homunculi and mutants were created to be used in war.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..dst: Ma sapevamo fin dall'inizio che avevano creato omuncoli e mutanti per usarli come armi di guerra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..src: Aladiss siempre estaba en guerra, siempre había un frente abierto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..ref: It seemed Aladiss was always fighting someone, somewhere.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..dst: Aladiss era sempre in guerra, c'era sempre un fronte aperto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..src: La explicación que nos ha dado Vésper debe de ser su modo de justificarse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..ref: Vesper's answer earlier may have been his own form of justice.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..dst: La spiegazione che ci ha dato Vesper deve essere il suo modo di giustificarsi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..src: Del mismo modo que no se puede afirmar que la alquimia sea buena o mala, la justicia depende de las circunstancias y del punto de vista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..ref: Just like how alchemy isn't good or evil, justice changes depending on the circumstances and one's viewpoint.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..dst: Cosi' come non si puo' affermare che l'alchimia sia buona o cattiva, la giustizia dipende dalle circostanze e dal punto di vista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..src: En su época, la palabra justicia tenía otras implicaciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..ref: His era had its own justice.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..dst: Nella sua epoca, la parola giustizia aveva altre implicazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..src: Unas que no podemos aplicar en la actualidad. En mi opinión, todo se reduce a eso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..ref: That justice doesn't apply to the current age. That may be all there is to it, I think.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_100..dst: Implicazioni che non possiamo applicare al giorno d'oggi. Secondo me, tutto si riduce a questo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: ¡Aaaah! ¡Señorita Yumia!...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: Wah, Miss Yumia?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Aaaah! Signorina Yumia!...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: ¡Oh! ¿No me has notado llegar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: You only just noticed me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Oh! Non ti sei accorta che stavo arrivando?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: P-perdón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: I assumed you would be able to sense my presence. You must have been deep in concentration.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: S-scusa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: Di por hecho que notarías que venía hacia aquí. Debes de haber estado muy concentrada en tus cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: When I'm lost in thought, I completely lose track of my surroundings ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Davo per scontato che ti saresti accorta del mio arrivo. Devi essere stata molto concentrata nelle tue cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: Estaba pensando y perdí la noción del tiempo y del espacio...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: What were you thinking about?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Stavo pensando e ho perso la nozione del tempo e dello spazio...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: ¿En qué pensabas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: ... The Welleks. And our code. A lot of things, really.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: A cosa stavi pensando?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: En los Welleks... En nuestro código. En un montón de cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: It's true that alchemy is a potent power, and it may not have been something to take lightly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Ai Welleks... Al nostro codice. A un sacco di cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: Es cierto que la alquimia es poderosa y no deberíamos tomarla a la ligera.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: But to completely turn away from it, refusing to ever come in contact with it again ... was that the right thing to do?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: E' vero che l'alchimia e' potente e non dovremmo prenderla alla leggera.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: Pero darle la espalda y negarse a volver a usarla... Tampoco sé si es la decisión correcta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: Miss Yumia, you said at the Ligneus base that you had averted your eyes and tried to block out the truth about alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Ma voltarle le spalle e rifiutarsi di usarla di nuovo... Non so nemmeno io se sia la decisione giusta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: Señorita Yumia... En la base de Lignumbria dijiste que intentaste mirar hacia otro lado y rechazar la verdad sobre la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: I wonder if the same was true for us Welleks. We averted our eyes from what we didn't want to see.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Signorina Yumia... Alla base di Lignumbria hai detto che hai provato a distogliere lo sguardo e a rifiutare la verita' sull'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: Sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: We, more than anyone else, should never have turned our backs to alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: Me pregunto si es lo mismo que han decidido los Welleks: mirar hacia otro lado y obviar lo que no queríamos ver.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: And I shouldn't have either.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Mi chiedo se sia la stessa cosa che i Welleks hanno deciso di fare: distogliere lo sguardo e ignorare cio' che non volevamo vedere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: Nunca deberíamos haber dado la espalda a la alquimia. Nosotros menos que ninguna otra raza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: You?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Non avremmo mai dovuto voltare le spalle all'alchimia. Noi meno di qualsiasi altra razza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: Y yo tampoco debería.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: I don't like it when people are mad at me. When I do something wrong, I just want to hide it and run away.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: E nemmeno io dovrei.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: ¿Tú?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: But thinking that way won't change anything. If all I ever do is hide behind other people, I won't move forward.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Tu?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: No quiero que se enfaden conmigo. Cuando hago las cosas mal, algo se apodera de mí y solo pienso en esconder la cabeza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: I can't turn away from my shortcomings and mistakes. That's something I still need to work on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Non voglio che si arrabbino con me. Quando faccio le cose male, qualcosa si impadronisce di me e penso solo a nascondere la testa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: Pero ¿qué resuelvo así? Si lo único que sé es esconderme detrás de otras personas, nunca avanzaré.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: So that's why you tried so hard to help out at the tower.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Ma che cosa risolvo cosi'? Se l'unica cosa che so fare e' nascondermi dietro altre persone, non andro' mai avanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: No puedo seguir huyendo de mis errores y mis meteduras de pata. Debo esforzarme por mejorar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: O-oh, that was ... Ah ... P-please forget about that!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Non posso continuare a fuggire dai miei errori e dalle mie gaffe. Devo impegnarmi per migliorare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: Por eso te volcaste tanto en las torres.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: Come on, don't be shy! You were really helpful, you know.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Ecco perche' ti sei impegnata cosi' tanto con le torri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: A-ah... Eso... ¡Por favor, no me lo recuerdes!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: Miss Yumia ... Thank you. I've made up my mind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: A-ah... Quello... Ti prego, non me lo ricordare!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: ¡Venga, no seas tímida! Fuiste de gran ayuda, ya lo sabes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: I'm not going to spend forever admiring you and trying to be like you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Dai, non fare la timida! Sei stata di grande aiuto, e tu lo sai.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: Señorita Yumia... ¡Gracias! Ahora estoy convencida.
