eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: I'm going to become the me I want to be. I'll work hard to make sure that happens.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Signorina Yumia... Grazie! Ora sono convinta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: No pienso vivir un día más admirándote desde la distancia y deseando ser como tú.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: I see.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Non ho intenzione di passare nemmeno un altro giorno ad ammirarti da lontano, desiderando di essere come te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: Voy a ser la persona que quiero ser. Me esforzaré para que así sea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: That makes me a little sad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Saro' la persona che voglio essere. Mi impegnero' perche' cosi' sia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: Ya veo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Capisco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: Me da un poco de pena.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: I won't be able to turn around and find my cute Lenja nervously following me around anymore.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Mi da' un po' di tristezza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: ¿Eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..ref: That's right. She won't be there anymore.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: Ya no podré darme la vuelta y ver a mi adorable Lenja siguiéndome como siempre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: Non potro' piu' girarmi e vedere la mia adorabile Lenja seguirmi come sempre.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..src: No, esa Lenja nerviosa ya no existe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_110..dst: No, quella Lenja nervosa non esiste piu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_120..ref: Thank you all for giving me time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_120..dst: Grazie per avermi concesso questo tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_120..src: Nos ha servido para reflexionar sobre Vésper y Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_120..ref: It was a good opportunity for us to reflect on Vesper and Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_120..dst: Ci ha permesso di riflettere su Vesper e Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_120..src: Venga, retomemos la investigación. La corriente de maná sigue en esta dirección.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_120..ref: Well then, let's get back to the investigation. The flow of mana continues in this direction.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_120..dst: Dai, riprendiamo l'indagine. Il flusso di mana continua in questa direzione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_130..src: La corriente de maná continúa hacia el interior...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_130..ref: The flow of mana seems to continue inside ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_130..dst: Il flusso di mana prosegue verso l'interno...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_130..src: ¿Creéis que este lugar está conectado con las tumbas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_130..ref: Do you think this place is also connected to the graves somehow?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_130..dst: Pensate che questo posto sia collegato alle tombe?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_130..ref: Let's look inside and find out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_130..dst: Dai, la risposta la troverai dentro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: Aquí también hay lápidas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: There are tombstones here, too ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Anche qui ci sono lapidi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: Parece muy sólido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: This looks really well-built.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Sembra molto solido.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: Sí, estas tumbas deben de pertenecer a personas distinguidas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: Yes, the graves here must belong to people of considerable standing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Si', queste tombe devono appartenere a persone illustri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: Las tumbas sirven para recordar a las almas que han regresado a la tierra. Es una prueba de que existieron.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: Graves are meant to memorialize those whose souls have already returned to the earth, as proof that they existed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Le tombe servono a ricordare le anime tornate alla terra. Sono la prova che sono esistite.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: O eso me dijo mi abuela...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: ... That's what my grandma once told me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: O almeno cosi' mi disse mia nonna...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: El Imperio aladissiano prosperó gracias al maná. Seguro que valoraban estas tradiciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: The Aladissian Empire flourished due to mana. They likely valued this kind of custom as a result.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: L'Impero Aladissiano prospero' grazie al mana. Sicuramente tenevano in grande considerazione queste tradizioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: Yumia. En esta tumba está grabado el nombre de Basilius.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: Yumia. The inscription on this grave reads, "Basilius."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Yumia. Su questa tomba e' inciso il nome di Basilius.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: ¿Cómo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: ... Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Come?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: ¿¡Qué!? ¿Basilius? ¿Ese Basilius?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: What?! Basilius, as in that Basilius?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Cosa!? Basilius? Quel Basilius?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: Sí. El último emperador de Aladiss. Ese Basilius.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: Yes. Aladiss's final emperor. That Basilius.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Si'. L'ultimo imperatore di Aladiss. Quel Basilius.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: Eh, mercenaria. El tipo ese remilgado que vimos antes, ¿era Basilius de verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: Hey, Mercenary. Was that skinny guy we met before really Basilius?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Ehi, mercenaria. Quel tipo pomposo che abbiamo visto prima, era davvero Basilius?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: Por lo menos, se parecía a los retratos que he visto de él, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: He looked the same as the Basilius I've seen in portraits and the like ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Almeno, si', assomigliava ai ritratti che ho visto di lui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: Suponiendo que sea el mismo Basilius, me pregunto cómo ha logrado vivir tantos años.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: Supposing he is the same Basilius, that does raise the question of how he's lived until now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Ammesso che sia lo stesso Basilius, mi chiedo come sia riuscito a vivere cosi' tanti anni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: Puede que sea «algo» que se parece mucho a Basilius.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: It's possible that he's just something that looks like Basilius ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Potrebbe essere "qualcosa" che somiglia molto a Basilius.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: Sí. Tenemos su tumba justo aquí delante. Después de...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: Yeah. His grave is right in front of us, after a—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Si'. Abbiamo la sua tomba proprio qui davanti. Dopo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: ¿Rutger?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: ... Rutger?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Rutger?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: Espera. Aquí hay algo raro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: Hold on. There's somethin' off about this grave.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Aspetta. Qui c'e' qualcosa di strano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: Veo una hendidura...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: There's a thin gap here ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Vedo una fessura...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: ¡Viktor, échame una mano!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: Viktor, gimme a hand!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Viktor, dammi una mano!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: ¿Yo? Vale.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: Huh? Okay ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Io? Va bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: Sujétala por el otro lado. ¡Tira!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: You grab the other side. Now pull!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Tienila dall'altro lato. Tira!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: ¡Haala!... ¡Buen trabajo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: Whoa ... Nice catch!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Haala!... Buon lavoro!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: Eh, que estás hablando con un profesional.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: Thank my keen eye for that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Ehi, stai parlando con un professionista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: Pues se me han quitado las ganas de seguir hablando de repente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: Well, now I don't want to.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Eh, adesso mi e' passata la voglia di continuare a parlare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: Esconder cosas en un lugar como este es el truco más viejo del mundo. Ahora solo falta averiguar de qué se trata.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: Hidin' somethin' in a place like this is the oldest trick in the book. Now it's just a question of what that somethin' is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Nascondere cose in un posto come questo e' il trucco piu' vecchio del mondo. Ora non resta che scoprire di cosa si tratta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: Ya veo... La corriente de maná fluye hacia aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: I see ... The flow of mana seems to keep going this way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Capisco... Il flusso di mana scorre verso qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..src: Así que el maná se dirige hacia abajo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..ref: So the mana that was drawn here all ends up down there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_140..dst: Quindi il mana si dirige verso il basso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_150..ref: ... Hey, what the hell are those things?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_150..dst: Ehi, che diavolo sono quelle cose?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_150..src: Quien los haya colocado aquí nos estaba esperando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_150..ref: I suppose they were left here by whoever set this whole thing up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_150..dst: Chi li ha messi qui si aspettava il nostro arrivo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_150..src: Entiendo. Son sus guardianes, ¿no es así?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_150..ref: I see. The final gatekeepers, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_150..dst: Capisco. Sono i suoi guardiani, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_160..src: ¡Uf!... No creo que vuelvan a por otra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_160..ref: Phew ... We managed to beat them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_160..dst: Uff!... Non credo che torneranno per riprovarci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_160..ref: Were those monsters just waiting here all that time?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_160..dst: Saranno rimasti ad aspettare per molto tempo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_160..src: Quién sabe. Pero no se parecen en nada a los monstruos de fuera.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_160..ref: Who knows. They were pretty different from the monsters outside, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_160..dst: Chissa'. Pero' non assomigliano per niente ai mostri di fuori.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_160..src: En cualquier caso, ha llegado el momento...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_160..ref: In any case, now we can finally ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_160..dst: In ogni caso, e' arrivato il momento...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_160..src: Es increíble que hayamos encontrado otro circulador de maná en un lugar como este.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_160..ref: I never would've guessed that there was another mana circulator in a place like this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_160..dst: E' incredibile che abbiamo trovato un altro circolatore di mana in un posto come questo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_160..src: Espero que nos permita controlar la afluencia del maná en este distrito.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_160..ref: This should let us control the flow of mana in this district.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_160..dst: Spero che ci permetta di controllare il flusso di mana in questo distrito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..ref: All right, that should do the trick!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..src: ¡Hala! ¡La corriente de maná ha cambiado! Menos mal...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..ref: Whoa! The flow of mana really did change! Thank goodness ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..dst: Caspita! Il flusso di mana e' cambiato davvero! Meno male...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..src: Y, con este gesto, nuestra investigación del cementerio imperial llega a su fin.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..ref: And with that, our investigation of the imperial graveyard tower is complete.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..dst: E cosi', la nostra indagine sul cimitero imperiale giunge alla fine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..src: Ya era hora. ¿Para qué creéis que usarían esta sala?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..ref: That sure took a long time. What the hell was this room for though?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..dst: Era ora. A cosa serviva mai questa stanza, secondo voi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..src: Se tomaron muchas molestias para colocar un circulador adicional y atraer todo el maná hacia aquí, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..ref: They went out of their way to prepare an additional circulator to draw mana into this room, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..dst: Si sono presi molte brigue per installare un circolatore aggiuntivo e attirare qui tutto il mana, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..src: Ahora que lo dices... Quizá querían mantenerlo en secreto para usar el maná sin que nadie lo supiera.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..ref: In that case ... Maybe their goal was to keep it hidden, so they could use the mana without anyone noticing?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..dst: In quel caso... Forse il loro obiettivo era tenerlo nascosto, per usare il mana senza che nessuno se ne accorgesse?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..src: Sí, y lo escondieron detrás de una tumba con el nombre de Basilius.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..ref: Yeah, behind a grave with Basilius's name on it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..dst: Si', dietro una tomba con il nome di Basilius.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..ref: About that ... Does Basilius really exist?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..dst: E' vero! Ma Basilius esistera' davvero?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..src: Bueno, la persona que hemos visto podría haber sido un farsante haciéndose pasar por él.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..ref: Couldn't the person we saw just have been a fake who's imitating him?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..dst: Beh, la persona che abbiamo visto potrebbe essere un impostore che si spacciava per lui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..src: Al fin y al cabo, estamos en su tumba, ¿o no? ¿No significa eso que el verdadero Basilius falleció hace tiempo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..ref: I mean, we're literally at his grave, right? Doesn't that mean the real Basilius died a long time ago?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..dst: In fondo, siamo alla sua tomba, no? Non significa che il vero Basilius e' morto tanto tempo fa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..src: Ese Basilius sería un impostor. Usaba el nombre del emperador para hacer y deshacer a sus anchas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..ref: The person we saw before was a fake. They're just borrowing Basilius's name to do whatever they want! Or something!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..dst: Quel Basilius sarebbe un impostore. Usava il nome dell'imperatore per fare e disfare a suo piacimento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..src: Pues si tienes razón, es una pena que sus restos no estén por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..ref: If that's the case, he could have at least left some ashes behind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..dst: Se hai ragione, e' un peccato che i suoi resti non siano qui da queste parti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..src: Y no parece que haya otra sala oculta detrás de esta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..ref: There doesn't seem to be another hidden room beyond this one.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..dst: E non sembra che ci sia un'altra stanza nascosta oltre a questa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..src: Entonces, ¿aquí solo hay un circulador de maná?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..ref: Then the mana circulator is the only thing here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..dst: Quindi, qui c'e' solo un circolatore di mana?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..src: No podemos confirmar si Basilius usó la alquimia para prolongar su vida o si es otra persona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..ref: I guess that means we still can't determine whether Basilius is using alchemy to prolong his life, or if it's a different person altogether.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..dst: Non possiamo confermare se Basilius abbia usato l'alchimia per prolungare la propria vita o se si tratti di un'altra persona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..src: Oh... Y yo que creía que había dado en el clavo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..ref: Aw, I really thought I was on the right track ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..dst: Oh... E io che credevo di aver dato nel segno...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..src: Un Basilius falso... No podemos cerrarnos a esa posibilidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..ref: A fake Basilius ... I can't say it's entirely out of the realm of possibility.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_170..dst: Un falso Basilius... Non possiamo escludere del tutto questa possibilita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..ref: Tch ... Hey, are we outta energy or somethin'?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..dst: Tsk... Non ci rimane piu' energia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..src: El núcleo... no está roto. Entonces...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..ref: The Energy Core ... isn't broken. Then—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..dst: Il Nucleo di Energia... non e' rotto. Allora...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..src: ¡Señorita Yumia, el maná está demasiado concentrado en esta zona!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..ref: Miss Yumia, the mana density in this area is incredibly high!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..dst: Signorina Yumia, il mana e' troppo concentrato in questa zona!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..ref: C-come on, everyone! We need to get out of here!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..dst: F-fate in fretta! Dobbiamo uscire da qui!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..src: El dolor ha cesado. ¿Estáis todos bien?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..ref: ... My headache's finally subsided. Is everyone else okay?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..dst: Il dolore e' finalmente passato. State tutti bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..src: Sí. Sigo un poco mareada, pero nada más...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..ref: Yes. Still a little dizzy, but otherwise ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..dst: Si'. Sono ancora un po' stordita, ma nient'altro...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..ref: Hey, what the hell was that?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..dst: Cosa e' successo un attimo fa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..src: Ya has oído a Lenja. La densidad de maná ha aumentado de repente. Nunca he visto nada parecido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..ref: Just as Lenja said, the mana density there was unusually high. Higher than we've ever seen before.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..dst: Hai sentito Lenja. La densita' di mana e' aumentata di colpo. Non ho mai visto niente di simile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..src: O sea, que era como una zona de vínculo de maná extrema. Y la corriente nace desde aquí, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..ref: So it's like an extreme manabound area? This is where the mana is being supplied from, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..dst: Quindi era come una zona di legame del mana estrema. E la corrente nasce da qui, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..src: Sí. Me pregunto si el dispositivo estará defectuoso y por eso el maná fluye sin control en esta zona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..ref: Yeah. I wonder if there's something wrong with the mana controller inside that's making it overflow into its surroundings.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..dst: Si'. Mi chiedo se il dispositivo sia difettoso e per questo il mana fluisca senza controllo in questa zona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..src: Yo voto por no pensarlo más y entrar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..ref: Grittin' our teeth and runnin' in anyway—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..dst: Io voto per non pensarci piu' e entrare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..src: No lo secundo. No podemos permitirnos correr ese riesgo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..ref: Isn't an option. We can't risk that level of danger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..dst: Non la condivido. Non possiamo permetterci di correre un rischio simile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..ref: What're we supposed to do then?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..src: Si supiera cómo, podría mejorar el Núcleo de energía...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..ref: If only I were more skilled, I could maybe do something to improve the Energy Core ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..dst: Se sapessi come fare, potrei migliorare il Nucleo di Energia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..src: Eso no es algo que puedas cambiar de la noche a la mañana. Hay que buscar otro plan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..ref: That's not something that will change overnight. We'll have to come up with an alternative plan for now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..dst: Non e' qualcosa che puoi cambiare dal giorno alla notte. Dobbiamo trovare un altro piano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..src: Sí. Busquemos por la zona. Ojalá haya algo que nos sirva de ayuda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..ref: Yeah. Let's look around. Hopefully we'll find some kind of solution ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_180..dst: Si'. Cerchiamo nella zona. Speriamo che ci sia qualcosa che ci aiuti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_190..src: No nos acerquemos por el momento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_200..ref: I feel like I recognize this area.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_200..dst: Mi sembra di riconoscere questo posto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_200..src: ¡Sí! Aquí había un mercado. Entonces, a este lado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_200..ref: Yes, this should be where the market used to be. Which means that on the other side—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_200..dst: Si'! Qui c'era un mercato. Quindi, da questa parte...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_200..ref: Everyone, could we stop for a second?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_200..src: No estoy segura al cien por cien, pero... creo que la primera casa donde viví estaba por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_200..ref: I'm not one hundred percent certain, but ... I believe that the first house I ever lived in was near here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_200..dst: Non ne sono sicura al cento per cento, ma... credo che la prima casa in cui ho vissuto fosse qui vicino.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_200..src: Eso es. La casa donde viví junto a la doctora antes de huir del imperio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_200..ref: Yes. The house where the doctor and I lived together for a short while before being on the run from the empire.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_200..dst: Esatto. La casa in cui vivevo con la dottoressa prima di fuggire dall'impero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_200..src: ¡Vamos a buscarla! Igual encontramos algo que sirva para continuar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_200..ref: Let's go! Maybe we'll find something there!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_200..dst: Andiamo a cercarla! Chissa' che non troviamo qualcosa di utile per proseguire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..ref: Nina, this was your first house?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..dst: Nina, questa era la tua prima casa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..src: Hay algo raro. No la recordaba así...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..ref: Something's strange. It didn't look like this ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..dst: C'e' qualcosa di strano. Non la ricordavo cosi'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..src: Todas las casas de la zona son iguales.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..ref: All the houses around here are plain white like this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..dst: Tutte le case della zona sono uguali.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..src: Creía que Basilius había restaurado Aladiss, pero se dejó algunas cosas en el tintero... ¿Será que no ha terminado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..ref: I thought Basilius restored Aladiss, but it looks so half-done ... Do you think he's still working on it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..dst: Pensavo che Basilius avesse restaurato Aladiss, ma sembra abbia lasciato alcune cose in sospeso... Sara' che non ha ancora finito?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..src: No es tan sencillo. Fíjate en ese edificio de allí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..ref: I get the feeling that it's not that simple. Look at the building across the street.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..dst: Non e' cosi' semplice. Osserva quell'edificio laggiu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..src: Ese era el teatro que construyó el imperio para representar sus obras.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..ref: I think that's the theater the empire built for plays to be performed at.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..dst: Quello era il teatro che l'impero costrui' per rappresentare le proprie opere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..src: Estaba muy cerca de mi casa, pero no era tan grande.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..ref: It certainly was very close to my house back then, but it wasn't this large of a building.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..dst: Era molto vicino a casa mia, ma non era cosi' grande.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..src: Es decir, que aunque hayan restaurado el edificio, no es el mismo de entonces.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..ref: You mean to say that the restored building isn't the same as the one in the past?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..dst: Cioe', anche se hanno restaurato l'edificio, non e' lo stesso di allora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..src: Basilius tendrá sus motivos para haber restaurado las cosas a su modo. No estaría de más examinar el teatro por dentro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..ref: Basilius might have restored things this way for a reason. Searching the inside of the theater could be worthwhile.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..dst: Basilius avra' i suoi motivi se ha restaurato le cose a modo suo. Non sarebbe male esaminare il teatro dall'interno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..src: Pues manos a la obra. Merecerá la pena si encontramos algo que lo vincule a Basilius.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..ref: In that case, let's get to it. If we find anythin' connected to Basilius, it'll be worth it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..dst: Diamoci da fare, allora. Ne varra' la pena se troviamo qualcosa che lo colleghi a Basilius.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..src: Ya no está aquí... Me había hecho ilusiones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..ref: ... It's not here anymore. I'd gotten my hopes up a bit.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_210..dst: Non c'e' piu'... Mi ero fatta delle speranze.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_220..ref: This is a statue of him, right?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_220..src: ¿En serio mandó erigir algo así? Qué mal gusto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_220..ref: He had somethin' like this made? Gross.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_220..dst: Ha davvero fatto erigere una cosa simile? Che pessimo gusto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_220..src: No creo que el emperador tuviera gustos tan ostentosos como este.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_220..ref: No, I don't believe the emperor had any interest in ostentatious displays of power like this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_220..dst: Non credo che l'imperatore avesse gusti cosi' ostentati come questi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_220..src: Solo quería la prosperidad de la nación. Este tipo de cosas las construía el pueblo por decisión propia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_220..ref: The only thing he ever wanted was the prosperity of the nation. Things like this were usually made by the people of their own accord.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_220..dst: Voleva solo la prosperita' della nazione. Questo genere di cose il popolo le costruiva di propria iniziativa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_220..src: Era su forma de desear «larga vida al emperador», ¿no? Tampoco me gusta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_220..ref: Like a "long live His Majesty the Emperor" kinda thing? That's pretty gross too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_220..dst: Era il loro modo di augurare "lunga vita all'imperatore", vero? Non mi piace nemmeno questo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_230..src: ¿Un terremoto? Y parecía provenir de este edificio, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_230..ref: Some kind of tremor? Didn't it sound like it was coming from somewhere in this building?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_230..dst: Una scossa? E sembrava provenire da qualche punto di questo edificio, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_230..src: Sí, pero no sabría decir de qué lugar exactamente...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_230..ref: Yeah, although I couldn't tell where exactly ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_230..dst: Si', ma non saprei dire da quale punto esattamente...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_230..src: Ha s-sido demasiado fuerte para tratarse de simples monstruos. ¿Habrá alguien más aquí dentro?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_230..ref: I-it felt like too big of a tremor to just be monsters. Do you think there's something else here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_230..dst: E' stata t-troppo forte per essere semplici mostri. Secondo voi c'e' qualcun altro qui dentro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: ¡Es Lili Borea!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: Lili Borea!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: E' Lili Borea!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: No os veía capaces de llegar tan lejos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: I didn't expect you to make it this far.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Non vi vedevo capaci di arrivare cosi' lontano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: Así que os habéis propuesto pararle los pies.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: So you really intend to stop that man.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Quindi avete davvero deciso di mettergli i bastoni tra le ruote.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: No podemos dejar que alguien como él haga lo que se le antoje.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: We can't just let someone like him do as he pleases.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Non possiamo lasciare che uno come lui faccia cio' che gli pare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: Es mi deber detenerlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: I feel like it's my duty to stop him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: E' il mio dovere fermarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: ¿Eso piensas?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: ... Is that so?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: E' quello che pensi?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: Espera, ¡Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: Wait—Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Aspetta, Yumia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: No pasa nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: It's okay.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Non fa niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: Lili Borea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: Lili Borea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Lili Borea.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: ¿Sigues pensando que Basilius pretende ayudarte?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: Do you still believe Basilius is going to fix you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Pensi ancora che Basilius intenda aiutarti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: Claro que no... Solo le interesa la gloria de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: ... Of course not. The only thing he cares about is the glory of Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Certo che no... Gli interessa solo la gloria di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: No va a dedicar ni un segundo a mis asuntos. Lo conozco bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: He's not going to spare any time for my personal issues. That's just the kind of person he is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Non dedichera' nemmeno un secondo ai miei affari. Lo conosco bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: Pero sigues teniendo la esperanza, por muy pequeña que sea, de que pueda ayudarte. Por eso te ves obligada a seguirlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: But there's still a chance he'll fix you, no matter how small. That's why you have no choice but to follow him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Ma continui ad avere la speranza, per quanto piccola, che possa aiutarti. Per questo sei costretta a seguirlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: Ya lo dijiste, solo quieres recuperar tu cuerpo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: You said it before, "Give me back my body."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: L'hai gia' detto, vuoi solo recuperare il tuo corpo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: Lo siento. En aquel momento, no supe responder... Pero ahora puedo decirte que no tengo la habilidad suficiente para devolverte tu cuerpo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: I'm sorry. I couldn't find the words back then ... But right now, I don't have the ability to turn your body back.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Mi dispiace. In quell'occasione, non seppi rispondere... Ma ora posso dirti che non ho l'abilita' sufficiente per restituirti il tuo corpo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: Aun así...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: But still—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Eppure...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: Nos enfrentaremos a Basilius.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: We intend to fight Basilius.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Affronteremo Basilius.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: ¿Y qué quieres decirme con esto?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: ... What are you trying to say?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: E cosa vuoi dirmi con questo?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: Cuando nos enfrentamos, no quise reconocer tu situación ni los crímenes que Aladiss había cometido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: When we fought you, I had closed my eyes to you, and to the crimes Aladiss committed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Quando ci siamo scontrati, non ho voluto riconoscere la tua situazione ne' i crimini che Aladiss aveva commesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: Necesitaba pensar que la alquimia era algo bueno.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: I wanted to believe that alchemy is a good thing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Avevo bisogno di pensare che l'alchimia fosse una cosa buona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: Pero eso ha cambiado. No quiero dar la espalda a la verdad. Y eso también te incluye a ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: But I've changed. I'm not going to turn away from anything anymore. Of course, that includes you too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Ma questo e' cambiato. Non voglio voltare le spalle alla verita'. E questo ti include anche te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: He decidido seguir dedicándome a la alquimia. Y lo haré hasta mi último aliento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: I've decided I'm going to continue living as an alchemist. For the rest of my life.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Ho deciso di continuare a dedicarmi all'alchimia. E lo faro' fino al mio ultimo respiro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: Vaya, es un sentimiento precioso. Qué pena que no me importe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: Well, isn't that a lovely sentiment. However, I really don't care.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Vabbe', che sentimento adorabile. Peccato che non me ne importi nulla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: Da igual lo que digas o lo que hagas... Nunca perdonaré a los alquimistas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: No matter what you say, no matter what you do ... I will never forgive alchemists.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Non importa cio' che dici o cio' che fai... Non perdonero' mai gli alchimisti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: Solo nos queda luchar hasta que una de las dos caiga.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: The only thing we can do is fight until one of us falls.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Non ci resta che combattere finche' una delle due non cadra'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: Si pretendes seguir adelante a pesar de todo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: If you plan to continue on despite that—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Se intendi proseguire nonostante tutto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: Entonces, pongámosle fin aquí y ahora. Acaba conmigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: Then end it here, once and for all. End me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Allora, mettiamoci fine qui e ora. Finiscimi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: Como alquimista, aunque pertenezca a esta época...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: As an alchemist of the present era—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: In quanto alchimista, anche se appartengo a quest'epoca...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..src: Acepto que me odies, acepto tu ira.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..ref: Your anger, your hatred—I'll take it all on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_250..dst: Accetto che mi odii, accetto la tua ira.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..src: Quería destruir este lugar... La ciudad entera. Quería verla reducida a escombros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..ref: ... I wanted to destroy this place ... this city. I wanted to ruin it completely.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..dst: Volevo distruggere questo luogo... L'intera citta'. Volevo vederla ridotta in macerie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..src: Pero... no tengo la fuerza suficiente para conseguirlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..ref: But ... I did not possess the power to achieve even that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..dst: Ma... non ho la forza sufficiente per riuscirci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..src: Nunca olvides... los pecados cometidos con la alquimia. Las atrocidades que llegaron a hacer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..ref: Never forget ... the sins of alchemy. The atrocities committed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..dst: Non dimenticare mai... i peccati commessi con l'alchimia. Le atrocita' che hanno compiuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..src: Grábalas a fuego... en tus recuerdos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..dst: Imprimile a fuoco... nei tuoi ricordi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..src: Sí, algo así. Es como su versión de un Núcleo de energía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..ref: Yeah. I think this is like their version of an Energy Core.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..dst: Si', piu' o meno. E' come la loro versione di un Nucleo di Energia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..src: No sé cómo funciona, pero es evidente que es mejor que el mío.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..ref: I don't know how it works, but it's safe to say it's much better than the one I use.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..dst: Non so come funzioni, ma e' evidente che e' meglio del mio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..src: Quizá con esto podamos adentrarnos en la zona de vínculo de maná extrema.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..ref: If we use this, maybe we can handle the extreme manabound area.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..dst: Forse con questo potremo addentrarci nella zona di legame di mana estrema.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..src: Volvamos a la torre. Este Núcleo de energía podría ser la solución a todos nuestros problemas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..ref: Let's go back to the tower. This Energy Core might just be able to solve our problem.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_260..dst: Torniamo alla torre. Questo Nucleo di Energia potrebbe essere la soluzione a tutti i nostri problemi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..src: La energía de este núcleo es más eficiente que la que suelo usar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..ref: The energy in this core is much more efficient than the one I've been using.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..dst: L'energia di questo nucleo e' piu' efficiente di quella che uso di solito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..src: Sí. Aunque me temo que he usado toda la energía del núcleo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..ref: Yeah. But I used up all the energy in the core.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..dst: Si'. Ma temo di aver usato tutta l'energia del nucleo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..src: Su forma de generar energía es muy particular. No creo que podamos volver a usarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..ref: It seems like the way it generates energy is unique, so it doesn't seem like we'll be able to use this one anymore.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..dst: Il suo modo di generare energia e' molto particolare. Non credo che potremo riutilizzarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..src: Bueno, debemos alegrarnos de que tuviera la suficiente para atravesar este maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..ref: I'm just glad that we had enough to get through here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..dst: Beh, dobbiamo essere contenti che ne avesse abbastanza per attraversare questo mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..src: Al final, a pesar de haberle dicho a Lili Borea todo lo que quería... no pude salvarla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..ref: Lili Borea ... I said what needed to be said. But the fact remains that I couldn't save her.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..dst: Alla fine, nonostante avessi detto a Lili Borea tutto cio' che volevo... non sono riuscita a salvarla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..src: Y, aunque su destino fuera inevitable, cumplí con mi cometido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..ref: Yet, even though I couldn't save her ... I still did what I had to do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..dst: E, anche se il suo destino era inevitabile, ho adempiuto al mio compito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..src: Ser alquimista implica aceptar los errores del pasado. Por eso, su historia irá conmigo a dondequiera que vaya.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..ref: I need to carry her regrets with me as I move forward. As an alchemist, I can't avert my eyes from the mistakes of the past.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..dst: Essere un'alchimista significa accettare gli errori del passato. Per questo, la sua storia andra' con me ovunque andro'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..src: Y nuestra misión no ha terminado. Nos sigue faltando un objetivo: Basilius.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..ref: We're not finished yet. One big issue still remains—Basilius.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_270..dst: E la nostra missione non e' finita. Ci manca ancora un obiettivo: Basilius.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: ¿Qué le ha pasado a esta puerta?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: Is this door broken?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: Cosa e' successo a questa porta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: A saber. No estaría así si se hubiera roto sin más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: I wonder. If it was just broken, I don't think it would be like this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: Chissa'. Non sarebbe cosi' se si fosse semplicemente rotta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: Aunque no esté rota... muy entera tampoco parece.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: It's not broken ... it looks like it's incomplete.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: Anche se non e' rotta... non sembra nemmeno troppo integra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: El maná de la zona está fuera de control. Creo que alguien quiso arreglarla con alquimia, pero se rindió antes de conseguirlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: The mana here is a mess. It's like someone was trying to fix it with alchemy but stopped halfway through.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: Il mana della zona e' fuori controllo. Penso che qualcuno abbia cercato di ripararla con l'alchimia, ma si e' arreso prima di riuscirci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: ¿Podrías terminarla tú?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: Can't you finish it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: Potresti completarla tu?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: Ni siquiera sé si es posible. Quizá si no fuera tan grande... Pero no sé ni por dónde empezar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: Hmm ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: Non so nemmeno se sia possibile. Forse se non fosse cosi' grande... Ma non so da dove cominciare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: Sí, ¿qué necesitas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: I don't think this is going to work. Maybe if it were smaller, but I'm not sure how to tackle something of this s—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: Si', di cosa hai bisogno?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: ¿Puedes escanear esto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: ... Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: Puoi scansionare questa cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: Yumia, como bien has dicho, el maná está distorsionado. En este estado, un escáner no nos dará...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: Yes, what do you need?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: Yumia, come hai detto giustamente, il mana e' distorto. In questo stato, uno scanner non ci dara'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: Tú inténtalo. Haz lo que puedas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: Can you scan this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: Prova tu. Fai cio' che puoi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: Está bien...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: Yumia, as you said yourself, the mana here is in disarray. In this state, a scan would not yield—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: Va bene...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: Estos son los resultados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: Just give it a try. Do as best as you can.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: Ecco i risultati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: No he entendido nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: ... Understood.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: Non ho capito niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: Era una mezcla de voces y sonaban todas a la vez.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: Scan results are as follows.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: Era un misto di voci e suonavano tutte insieme.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: A diferencia de un Vial de recuerdos, donde la información se almacena en orden, estos recuerdos están superpuestos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: Couldn't catch a single word of that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: A differenza di una Fiala della Memoria, dove le informazioni vengono conservate in ordine, questi ricordi sono sovrapposti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: Eh, alquimista, ¿qué pretendías conseguir con todo esto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: It sounded like a bunch of people's voices all speaking at once.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: Ehi, alchimista, cosa intendevi ottenere con tutto questo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: El maná está superpuesto, pero no se ha disipado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: Unlike a Memory Vial that organizes and stores information, the memories here are all overlapping.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: Il mana e' sovrapposto, ma non si e' dissipato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: Si pudiéramos separarlo de algún modo, ¿podrías leer el maná y los recuerdos que contiene?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: Hey, Alchemist, was there somethin' you were tryin' to find out by doin' this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: Se potessimo separarlo in qualche modo, potresti leggere il mana e i ricordi che contiene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: Sería como desenredar una madeja de hilos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: The mana may be messed up, but it's still here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: Sarebbe come districare un gomitolo di fili.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: Si organizas y reestructuras el maná descontrolado del mismo modo que haces una síntesis... Sí, sería posible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: In that case, if we can fix the mess it's in, will you be able to read the mana—or in other words, the memories?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: Se organizzi e ristrutturi il mana fuori controllo allo stesso modo in cui fai una sintesi... Si', sarebbe possibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: ¿Y en nuestro idioma?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: Kind of like untangling a bunch of knotted up string.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: E in parole povere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: No es un Vial de recuerdos, pero, con unos cuantos retoques, podríamos oír los recuerdos que se han acumulado en este lugar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: If you organize and reconstruct the disarrayed mana in a process similar to regular synthesis, it may be possible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: Non e' una Fiala della Memoria, ma, con qualche ritocco, potremmo sentire i ricordi che si sono accumulati in questo luogo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..src: ¿Lo intentamos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..ref: I-in other words?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_280..dst: Ci proviamo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..src: Sin embargo, no veo que guarden relación con...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..ref: However, the majority of the memories here are irrelevant to—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..dst: Tuttavia, non vedo che abbiano attinenza con...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..src: He obtenido información para resolver esta situación. Reproduciendo los recuerdos descifrados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..ref: Information that is likely to help resolve the current situation found. Playing decoded memories now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..dst: Ho ottenuto informazioni utili a risolvere questa situazione. Riproduzione dei ricordi decifrati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..src: ¿Quién querría colarse en una torre que se utiliza para el papeleo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..ref: Who would try to sneak into a tower that's used for national administration?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..dst: Chi vorrebbe mai intrufolarsi in una torre usata per la burocrazia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..ref: How the hell did they even get in?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..dst: E come hanno fatto a entrare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..src: El culpable accedió al edificio del consejo por un pasadizo secreto...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..ref: The culprit used a secret passage from the council building—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..dst: Il colpevole e' entrato nell'edificio del consiglio attraverso un passaggio segreto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..src: ¿Utilizaban una torre para temas administrativos? ¿Se refieren a este lugar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..ref: A tower used for national administration? Are they talking about this place?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..dst: Usavano una torre per questioni amministrative? Parleranno di questo posto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..src: Ya veo. Y algún idiota se coló por un pasadizo secreto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..ref: I see ... So there were some idiots who used a secret passage to break in here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..dst: Capisco. E qualche idiota si e' intrufolato qui attraverso un passaggio segreto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..src: Entonces, ¿podríamos usar ese mismo pasadizo para evitar la corriente de maná distorsionado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..ref: Um, so if we use that secret passage, we can avoid the jumbled mana and enter the tower?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..dst: Allora, potremmo usare quello stesso passaggio per evitare la corrente di mana distorto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..ref: That's it! Lenja, Flammi, you're geniuses!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..src: No lo dudes: Flammi es una asistente autómata especializada en la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..ref: Flammi is a super-high-spec independent survey-assistance device, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..dst: Non ne dubitare: Flammi e' un'assistente automatizzata specializzata nella ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..src: Te has grabado esa frase a fuego, ¿eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..dst: Ti sei incisa quella frase a fuoco, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..src: En fin. Vamos al edificio del consejo y busquemos ese pasadizo escondido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..ref: Yeah, yeah. Anyways, let's head to the council building where the secret passage is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..dst: Insomma. Andiamo all'edificio del consiglio e cerchiamo quel passaggio segreto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..src: Creo recordar que era ese edificio. Rápido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..ref: I believe it's that building over there. Let's hurry over.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_290..dst: Mi ricordo che era quell'edificio. Sbrighiamoci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_300..src: Así que este es el consejo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_300..ref: So this is the council building ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_300..src: Según las voces del recuerdo, debe de haber un pasadizo secreto en alguna parte, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_300..ref: According to those memories we found, there should be a secret passage somewhere, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_300..dst: Secondo le voci del ricordo, da qualche parte deve esserci un passaggio segreto, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_300..src: Espero que no sea difícil de encontrar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_300..ref: I hope it's not a hassle to find.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_300..dst: Spero che non sia difficile da trovare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_300..src: Eso se soluciona pateándonos el edificio de arriba abajo. ¡Vamos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_300..ref: Let's search this building, top to bottom!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_300..dst: Quello si risolve setacciando l'edificio dall'alto in basso. Andiamo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_310..ref: I wonder what these statues are.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_310..src: Ay... Parece que se van a mover cuando dejemos de mirarlas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_310..ref: Ew, I hate how they look like they could start moving at any second.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_310..dst: Brr... Sembra che si muoveranno appena smettiamo di guardarle...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_310..ref: Huh? That's obviously not gonna happen.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_310..dst: Ma che dici? Smetti di immaginarti cose impossibili.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_310..src: ¿Y si las movemos nosotros? Puede que haya un camino secreto. Al fin y al cabo, ¿no es lo que suele pasar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_310..ref: But maybe moving them will reveal a secret path. That kind of thing is fairly common, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_310..dst: E se le muoviamo noi? Potrebbe esserci un passaggio segreto. Del resto, non e' quello che succede di solito?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_310..src: Nada. Por mucho que empuje o que tire, no ceden.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_310..ref: It's no use. Push or pull, they won't budge.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_310..dst: Niente. Per quanto spinga o tiri, non cedono.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_310..src: Puede que se nos escape algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_310..ref: Maybe we're on the wrong track.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_320..src: Parece que este sitio está muy concurrido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_320..ref: Looks like this place is already occupied.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_320..dst: Sembra che questo posto sia gia' molto affollato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_320..src: ¿Es que no hay un solo lugar sin monstruos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_320..ref: Tch. Is there anywhere that isn't infested with monsters?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_320..dst: Non c'e' proprio un solo posto senza mostri?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_320..ref: We'll just have to get rid of them.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_330..src: Eso parece. Al final no había nada aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_330..ref: Looks like it. Figures there's nothing here, huh ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_330..dst: Sembra di si'. Alla fine qui non c'era niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_330..src: Ya hemos terminado de examinar el otro lado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_330..ref: We finished checking the other side.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_330..dst: Abbiamo gia' finito di esaminare l'altro lato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_330..src: Tienen una estructura similar. No hemos visto nada especial.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_330..ref: Its structure is the same as this one. It doesn't look like there's anything there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_330..dst: Hanno una struttura simile. Non abbiamo visto niente di speciale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_340..ref: This must be the main hall.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_340..dst: Questo dovrebbe essere il salone principale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_340..src: Es la zona más llamativa hasta ahora. Echemos un vistazo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_340..ref: This is the most suspicious-looking area. Let's take a look ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_340..dst: E' la zona piu' sospetta finora. Diamoci un'occhiata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_340..src: Maldita sea. Nuestro gozo en un pozo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_340..ref: Dammit. We're not findin' anythin' at all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_340..dst: Maledizione. Le nostre speranze in fumo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_340..src: Sí. Me sorprende que no haya pistas en un sitio así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_340..ref: Yeah. I guess we're not going to pick up any leads here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_340..dst: Si'. Strano che non ci siano indizi in un posto cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_350..src: Nos vamos con las manos vacías...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_350..dst: Ce ne andiamo a mani vuote...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_350..src: ¿En serio? ¿Ni un mísero Vial de recuerdos? ¿Hemos buscado en todos los rincones para nada?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_350..ref: Seriously, there's not even a Memory Vial? We searched all around here without finding a single thing!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_350..dst: Sul serio? Nemmeno una misera Fiala della Memoria? Abbiamo cercato in ogni angolo per niente?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_350..src: A lo mejor los Viales de recuerdos se perdieron en el derrumbe. Tuvimos suerte de escuchar el recuerdo sobre ese pasadizo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_350..ref: Hmm, maybe any Memory Vials here were lost during the collapse? We were lucky to find information on the secret passage ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_350..dst: Forse le Fiale della Memoria si sono perse nel crollo. Siamo stati fortunati a sentire il ricordo su quel passaggio...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_350..src: Y ¿qué hacemos? Estamos en un callejón sin salida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_350..ref: What should we do? It seems we're at an impasse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_350..dst: E ora cosa facciamo? Siamo arrivati a un punto morto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_350..src: ¿Podríamos buscar otra corriente de maná distorsionado? Puede que contenga información valiosa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_350..ref: Could we look for more jumbled mana here, like before? Maybe we can get some information from that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_350..dst: Potremmo cercare un'altra corrente di mana distorto? Potrebbe contenere informazioni preziose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_350..ref: That's a good idea. Let's check around.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_350..dst: Buona idea. Andiamo a dare un'occhiata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_360..src: Tienes que ser un idiota redomado para cometer un crimen en Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_360..ref: You'd have to be a complete idiot to commit a crime in Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_360..dst: Devi essere un idiota finito per commettere un crimine ad Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_360..src: Si te pillan, te extraen los recuerdos y despídete de tu vida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_360..ref: You get caught once, they extract your memories, and it's over for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_360..dst: Se ti acchiappano, ti estraggono i ricordi e puoi dire addio alla tua vita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_360..src: Sí, los recuerdos hablan más alto que ninguna confesión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_360..ref: Yeah, firsthand memories are much more overwhelming evidence than a confession.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_360..dst: Si', i ricordi parlano piu' forte di qualsiasi confessione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_370..src: Tengo entendido que han detenido a unos alquimistas que trabajaban para el imperio. ¿Será cierto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_370..ref: I heard they detained alchemists working for the empire. Is that true?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_370..dst: Ho sentito dire che hanno arrestato alcuni alchimisti che lavoravano per l'impero. Sara' vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_370..src: Lo es. Querían evitar a toda costa las habladurías, pero hay quien afirma haber visto cómo los escoltaban a la oficina judicial.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_370..ref: It's true. It seems like they're trying to keep word from getting out, but there are people who saw them being brought into the judicial office.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_370..dst: E' vero. Volevano evitare a tutti i costi le voci, ma c'e' chi afferma di averli visti scortati all'ufficio giudiziario.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_370..src: Por lo visto, se negaron a seguir las órdenes del emperador. Últimamente, los ánimos están muy tensos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_370..ref: Apparently it's because they wouldn't follow the empire's orders. Tensions are really ramping up lately, huh.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_370..dst: A quanto pare, si sono rifiutati di seguire gli ordini dell'imperatore. Ultimamente gli animi sono molto tesi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..src: Mientras recopilaba información relevante, he hallado datos sobre los criminales.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..ref: While collecting relevant information, leads pertaining to past criminals were found.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..dst: Mentre raccoglievo informazioni rilevanti, ho trovato dati sui criminali.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..src: Parece que son recuerdos de los últimos días de Aladiss, pero no sé de qué tensiones hablan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..ref: They seem to be memories from the final days of Aladiss. I don't know much about the tensions they're referring to.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..dst: Sembra che siano ricordi degli ultimi giorni di Aladiss, ma non so bene a quali tensioni si riferiscano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..src: Esa parte sobre los alquimistas que se negaron a seguir órdenes me ha recordado a la doctora Marina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..ref: The part about alchemists who wouldn't follow their orders made me think of Doctor Marina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..dst: Quella parte sugli alchimisti che si rifiutarono di seguire ordini mi ha ricordato la Dottoressa Marina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..src: Y a mí. Puede que sus actos inspiraran a otros alquimistas a hacer lo mismo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..ref: Indeed. Perhaps her actions inspired other alchemists to rise up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..dst: Anche a me. Forse le sue azioni hanno ispirato altri alchimisti a fare lo stesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..src: Esto prueba que las cosas no iban del todo bien antes de la caída de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..ref: This seems like proof that things weren't normal in Aladiss during its final days.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..dst: Questo dimostra che le cose non andavano del tutto bene prima della caduta di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..src: Tienes razón. Es como si todo se viniera abajo, aunque yo no era consciente de la situación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..ref: I agree. Perhaps it had already begun to come apart at the seams without me realizing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..dst: Hai ragione. E' come se tutto stesse andando in pezzi, anche se io non ne ero consapevole.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..src: Me alegro de que no detuvieran a la doctora Marina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..ref: I'm really glad that Doctor Marina was never arrested.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..dst: Mi fa piacere che la Dottoressa Marina non sia stata arrestata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..src: Sí, fue una suerte. Yo no estaría aquí si no llega a ser por ella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..ref: Yes, I am truly grateful for that fact. I wouldn't be here right now if she had been.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..dst: Si', e' stata una fortuna. Io non sarei qui se non fosse stato per lei.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..src: Estos criminales usaron un pasadizo secreto, ¿no? Deberíamos buscar más información.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..ref: If criminals were using the secret passage, we might be able to find more clues by looking for information on them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..dst: Questi criminali hanno usato un passaggio segreto, no? Dovremmo cercare piu' informazioni al riguardo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..src: Me parece buena idea. Dijeron algo de una oficina judicial, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..ref: That's a good idea. The memories we found did mention a judicial office.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..dst: Mi sembra una buona idea. Nei ricordi veniva menzionato un ufficio giudiziario, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..src: Según la información obtenida, la oficina judicial se encuentra al suroeste de aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..ref: Based on the gathered information, the judicial office seems to be located southwest of here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..dst: In base alle informazioni raccolte, l'ufficio giudiziario sembra trovarsi a sud-ovest da qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..src: Gracias. Ya habéis oído, rumbo hacia el suroeste.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_380..ref: Thanks. Well then, let's head that way.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_390..src: Así que esta es la oficina judicial... ¿Cuántos criminales habrán recorrido estos pasillos de camino a un juicio?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_390..ref: So this is the judicial office. A great number of criminals were probably investigated and put on trial here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_390..dst: Quindi questo e' l'ufficio giudiziario... Quanti criminali avranno percorso questi corridoi diretti a un processo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_390..src: Me conformo con saber cómo lograron entrar en el edificio del consejo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_390..ref: If only we can find information here about the people who broke into the council building ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_390..dst: Mi basterebbe sapere come sono riusciti a entrare nell'edificio del consiglio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_400..src: Nos podría servir para averiguar un par de cosas, ¿no, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_400..ref: We might be able to get new information from this. Yumia, would you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_400..dst: Potrebbe servirci per scoprire un paio di cose, non credi, Yumia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..src: Sí... Había un mensaje cifrado en el viejo plano que sacamos del edificio del consejo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..ref: ... Yes. There was a secret message on the old blueprint we got of the council building.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..dst: Si'... C'era un messaggio cifrato sulla vecchia pianta dell'edificio del consiglio che abbiamo recuperato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..src: Decía: «Solo el sabio muestra el camino».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..ref: It said, "Only the sage shows the way."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..dst: Diceva: "Solo il saggio mostra la strada".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..src: Mmm... Y usasteis ese mensaje para entrar sin permiso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..ref: Hmm. And so you used that message to try to break in.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..dst: Mmm... E con quel messaggio avete cercato di entrarvi senza permesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..src: ¿De dónde sacasteis el plano? Necesitaríais un cómplice para obtener esa información.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..ref: But where did you obtain that blueprint from? You'd need an accomplice to get information like that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..dst: Dove avete preso la pianta? Vi servirebbe un complice per ottenere quel tipo di informazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..src: ¿No quieres vender a tus amigos? Muy admirable... Lástima que no vaya a servirte de nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..ref: Not interested in selling out your friends? That is admirable ... however, it is meaningless.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..dst: Non vuoi vendere i tuoi amici? Molto ammirevole... Peccato che non ti servira' a niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..src: Eres alquimista, ¿no? Deberías saber que tenemos varios métodos para acceder a tu mente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..ref: If you're an alchemist, you ought to understand. We have plenty of ways of looking into your head!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..dst: Sei un alchimista, vero? Dovresti sapere che abbiamo svariati metodi per accedere alla tua mente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..src: Fin de los datos obtenidos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..ref: End of acquired data.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..dst: Fine dei dati ottenuti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..src: Un plano del edificio del consejo, un mensaje cifrado, alquimistas... Seguro que estaban interrogando al tipo que se coló en el consejo, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..ref: A blueprint of the council building, a secret message, alchemists ... This is obviously the guy who snuck into the council building being questioned, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..dst: Una pianta dell'edificio del consiglio, un messaggio cifrato, alchimisti... Sicuramente stavano interrogando il tipo che si era intrufolato nel consiglio, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..src: Seguramente. Me pregunto qué sería de él...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..ref: Yes, probably. I wonder what happened to him afterwards ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..dst: Probabilmente. Mi chiedo che fine abbia fatto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..src: Espero que se contentaran con leerle los recuerdos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..ref: Hopefully it stopped with them just lookin' at his memories.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..dst: Spero che si siano accontentati di leggere i suoi ricordi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..src: No es la primera vez que vemos algo así, acordaos de Lili Borea. No sería descabellado asumir que corriera peor suerte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..ref: We've seen this before, with Lili Borea. A much more tragic fate than that is very possible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..dst: Non e' la prima volta che vediamo una cosa del genere, ricordate Lili Borea. Non e' da escludere che abbia incontrato una sorte ben piu' tragica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..src: Ojalá que no...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..ref: I hope not ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..dst: Spero di no...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..src: Seguro que tenía motivos de peso para traicionar al país. Al fin y al cabo, Aladiss no pasaba por su mejor momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..ref: But he surely had his reasons for defying his country. Aladiss was not in a good place, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..dst: Sicuramente aveva buoni motivi per sfidare il suo paese. Del resto, Aladiss non stava attraversando un buon periodo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..src: ¿Qué pretendía conseguir contraviniendo las leyes?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..ref: We don't know what he aimed to accomplish by committing that crime ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..dst: Cosa puntava a ottenere violando le leggi...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..src: Sabiendo que se negó a vender a sus compañeros, sus motivos debían de ser importantes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..ref: But considering he refused to sell out his accomplices, I get the sense that he had some kind of conviction.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..dst: Visto che si e' rifiutato di vendere i suoi compagni, i suoi motivi dovevano essere importanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..src: No quiso vender a sus compañeros... Luchaba por cumplir con su cometido, pero lo pillaron antes de lograrlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..ref: He wouldn't sell out his accomplices ... It sounds like he was trying to accomplish something until he got caught.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..dst: Non ha voluto vendere i suoi compagni... Cercava di portare a termine il suo compito, ma l'hanno preso prima che ci riuscisse.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..src: No sé si sus intenciones serían buenas o no, pero hemos sido nosotros quienes han dado con sus recuerdos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..ref: I don't know if his intentions were noble or not, but either way, we're the ones who found his memories.
