eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..dst: Non so se le sue intenzioni fossero buone o no, ma siamo stati noi a trovare i suoi ricordi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..src: Lo único que podemos hacer es asegurarnos de darles el uso que se merecen.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..ref: So I think it's up to us to make sure they're put to good use.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..dst: L'unica cosa che possiamo fare e' assicurarci di dar loro l'uso che meritano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..src: Estoy de acuerdo. Los recuerdos que nos ha legado nos servirán de guía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..ref: Agreed. The memories he left behind will be what guide us forward.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..dst: Sono d'accordo. I ricordi che ci ha lasciato ci serviranno da guida.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..src: Centrémonos en el edificio del consejo. ¡Esta vez daremos con ese pasadizo secreto!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..ref: Let's turn our focus back to the council building. We're definitely going to find that secret passage this time!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_410..dst: Concentriamoci sull'edificio del consiglio. Questa volta troveremo quel passaggio segreto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..src: Pues aquí estamos. Yumia, ¿ves algo que te llame la atención?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..ref: Well, here we are. Yumia, is anything catching your attention?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..dst: Ecco, siamo qui. Yumia, vedi qualcosa che ti colpisce?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..src: Bueno, cualquiera de estas estatuas podría representar a un sabio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..ref: Yeah. If we're looking for a sage, these statues seem to be strong candidates.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..dst: Beh, una qualsiasi di queste statue potrebbe rappresentare un saggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..src: «Solo el sabio muestra el camino». Las cuatro tienen atributos diferentes, pero solo una puede ser el «sabio».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..ref: "Only the sage shows the way." These four are all holding different things, so only one can be the "sage."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..dst: "Solo il saggio mostra la via". Le quattro hanno attributi diversi, ma solo una puo' essere il "saggio".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..src: Lo que quiere decir que el sabio es...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..ref: Which means the sage is probably ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..dst: Il che significa che il saggio e'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..ref: This statue is the sage? H-hmm, I wonder ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..src: No sigo tu razonamiento. ¿No ves otra estatua más sabia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..ref: I'm not sure that I follow your line of thinking. Don't you think there's a more sage-like statue here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..dst: Non seguo il tuo ragionamento. Non vedi una statua piu' saggia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..src: ¿Y esta? Lleva un bastón, eso es muy de sabios.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..ref: This one? He's holdin' a staff, so I guess he's pretty sage-like.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..dst: E questa? Regge un bastone, e' da saggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..src: Genial. Vamos a examinarla de cerca.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..ref: Great. Let's take a closer look around.
Um ... The wall feels kind of thin here.
Oh? This wall is actually a door.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..src: ¡A la de tres! ¡Una, dos y tres!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..ref: Here we go! One, two, three!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..dst: Al tre! Uno, due e tre!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..ref: Seems we hit the nail on the head.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..src: Echemos un vistazo. Si las pistas son ciertas, encontraremos la torre de control aquí dentro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..ref: Let's see what's back here. If the information we've collected is right, this should lead to the control tower!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_420..dst: Diamo un'occhiata. Se gli indizi sono giusti, troveremo la torre di controllo qui dentro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_430..src: ¡Ya está! ¡Hemos llegado a la torre de control de maná!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_430..ref: We did it! We made it to the mana control tower!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_430..dst: Ce l'abbiamo fatta! Siamo arrivati alla torre di controllo del mana!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_430..src: Ya era hora. Nos ha llevado nuestro tiempo, pero al fin hemos salido de ese pasadizo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_430..ref: That we did. It took a lot to get here, but we made it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_430..dst: Era ora. Ci ha richiesto tempo, ma finalmente siamo usciti da quel passaggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_430..src: El maná se debería poder controlar desde aquí. Vamos a buscar la manera de hacerlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_430..ref: The mana should be controlled from here. Let's look around.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_430..dst: Il mana dovrebbe essere controllabile da qui. Cerchiamo il modo per farlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..src: ¡Otra torre bajo control! Eso pone fin a nuestra investigación del distrito administrativo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..ref: And with that, this tower is under control. Our investigation of the administrative district is done.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..dst: Un'altra torre sotto controllo! Cosi' termina la nostra indagine del distretto amministrativo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..src: Aunque seguimos sin saber qué pasaría en los últimos días del Imperio aladissiano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..ref: Still, what exactly was going on at the end of the Aladissian Empire?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..dst: Pero' non sappiamo ancora cosa accadrebbe negli ultimi giorni dell'Impero Aladissiano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..src: Siento no poder daros más información para ayudar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..ref: I'm sorry that I can't provide you with any more definite information myself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..dst: Mi dispiace di non potervi dare altre informazioni per aiutarvi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..src: Aun así, nunca he escuchado que otros alquimistas se rebelaran antes de que la doctora Marina huyera conmigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..ref: But at the very least, I never heard any talk of alchemists rebelling until Doctor Marina and I defected.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..dst: Detto questo, non ho mai sentito parlare di altri alchimisti che si ribelassero prima che la Dottoressa Marina fuggisse con me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..src: La gente que vivía en la supuesta «utopía perdida» estaba tan frustrada que empezó a amotinarse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..ref: It seems even the so-called "Lost Utopia" reached a point where the dissatisfaction of its people began to mount.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..dst: La gente che viveva nella cosiddetta "utopia perdida" era cosi' frustrata che comincio' a ribellarsi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..src: Se enfrentaron a un problema que ni la alquimia podía solventar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..ref: There must have been some issue that even alchemy couldn't solve ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..dst: Si sono trovati davanti a un problema che nemmeno l'alchimia poteva risolvere...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..src: ¿Crees que ese problema estaba relacionado con la caída del imperio?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..ref: Do you think that issue was related to Aladiss's downfall?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..dst: Pensi che quel problema fosse legato alla caduta dell'impero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..src: Es difícil asegurar cuál fue la causa directa, pero seguro que estaban relacionados de una forma u otra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..ref: Hard to tell if it was the direct cause, but it seems pretty likely they were related in some way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..dst: E' difficile affermare quale sia stata la causa diretta, ma di sicuro erano collegati in un modo o nell'altro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..src: Ningún país próspero desaparece de la noche a la mañana sin mostrar signos de decadencia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..ref: There's no way such a prosperous country just suddenly collapsed without any warnin' signs.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..dst: Nessun paese prospero scompare dal giorno alla notte senza mostrare segni di decadenza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..src: Deberíamos reunir todas las piezas de este rompecabezas para hacernos a la idea de la situación general.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..ref: Maybe if we piece together all the clues we find, we'll eventually see the whole picture?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..dst: Forse mettendo insieme tutti gli indizi che troviamo, prima o poi vedremo il quadro completo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..src: Sí, opino lo mismo. Seguiremos adelante y daremos con una respuesta tarde o temprano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..ref: Yeah, that's exactly right. As long as we keep moving forward, we'll eventually reach our answers.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_440..dst: Si', penso esattamente lo stesso. Andando avanti, prima o poi troveremo le risposte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: ¡Hola! ¿Habéis conseguido avanzar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Hey. How are things progressing?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Ehi! Siete riusciti ad avanzare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Mucho. Hemos entrado al laboratorio del centro de la ciudad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Pretty good. We just gained access to the laboratory in the center of the city.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Molto. Siamo entrati nel laboratorio al centro della citta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Queríamos aprovechar para informarte y descansar un poco.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: We thought we'd come back to report to you and rest up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Volevamo approfittarne per informarti e riposare un po'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Lo entiendo. Ya me daréis los detalles. Descansad por ahora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Understood. You can tell me the details later. For now, get some rest.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Capisco. I dettagli me li darete dopo. Per ora riposatevi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Oye, Yumia...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Hey, Yumia ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Ehi, Yumia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: ¿Qué harás cuando termine la investigación?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: What are you going to do after the investigation is over?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Cosa farai quando finira' la ricerca?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: ¿A qué viene esa pregunta de repente?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Why the sudden question?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Da dove salta fuori questa domanda cosi' all'improvviso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Creo que es un buen momento para hablarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: It's not sudden at all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Penso sia un buon momento per parlarne.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Ya, supongo que sí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: ... I guess not.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Gia', immagino di si'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Mmm... Cuando acabe la investigación...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Hmm ... Once the investigation is over ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Mmm... Quando finira' la ricerca...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Primero iré a visitar la tumba de mi madre. Me gustaría verla y esa es la única forma que tengo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: First, I think I'd like to visit my mom's grave. Even if it's only her grave, I'd like to see her.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Prima andro' a visitare la tomba di mia madre. Mi piacerebbe vederla, ed e' l'unico modo che ho.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Luego, si me dejan, prestaré mis habilidades a quien las necesite.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: And ... if I'm allowed, I want to put my skills to good use.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Poi, se me lo permetteranno, prestero' le mie capacita' a chi ne avra' bisogno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Sé que no soy un portento ahora mismo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: I know there's not really much I can do right now ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: So che al momento non sono un portento...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Pero quiero hacer todo lo que esté en mi mano para ayudar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: But I want to do whatever is within my reach.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Ma voglio fare tutto cio' che e' in mio potere per aiutare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Me da un poco de vértigo pensar qué implicará ser una alquimista cuando todo esto acabe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Although, I don't know what it will mean to be an alchemist when all this is done.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Mi fa un po' girare la testa pensare a cosa significhera' essere un'alchimista quando tutto finira'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: ¡Suena estupendo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: I think that's great.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Sembra fantastico!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Y, cuando todo se calme, quiero hacerle unos retoques a Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: When things calm down, I'll need to tune Flammi up a bit too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: E, quando tutto si calmera', vorrei fare qualche ritocco a Flammi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Recuerdo vagamente que Flammi era capaz de hacer un montón de cosas más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: I vaguely remember Flammi having even more functions a long time ago.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Ricordo vagamente che Flammi era in grado di fare molte altre cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Me gustaría recalcar que, en las manos incorrectas, las valiosísimas funciones de Flammi se podrían deteriorar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Improper modification may result in all of Flammi's valuable memories being erased.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Vorrei sottolineare che, in mani sbagliate, le importantissime funzioni di Flammi potrebbero deteriorarsi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: No pasará nada. ¿No confías en mí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: It's fiiine. Are you that worried?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Non succedera' nulla. Non ti fidi di me?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: ¡Oye!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Hey!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Ehi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Los riesgos por confiar en alguien con tan poca experiencia como tú son notables.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: The risk associated with being entrusted to someone as inexperienced as yourself is extremely high.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: I rischi di fidarsi di qualcuno con cosi' poca esperienza come te sono notevoli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: No perdona una.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Cheeky as ever.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Non ne perdona una.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: En fin... ¿Y tú, Isla?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: *Sigh* ... How about you, Isla?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Insomma... E tu, Isla?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Depende de las órdenes del jefe. Soy caballera, después de todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: For me it depends on what the chief tells us to do. I'm a knight, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Dipende dagli ordini del capo. Sono una cavaliere, dopotutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Tú también, ¿verdad, Viktor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: You too, right, Viktor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Anche tu, vero, Viktor?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Sí. Pero tengo más cosas en mente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Yes. But that's not all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Si'. Ma ho altre cose in mente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Duerer sigue sufriendo los estragos del desastre. Nos queda un largo camino por delante hasta conseguir que todo vuelva a ser como antes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Duerer is still suffering from the effects of the disaster. There's a lot we need to do to restore things to normal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Duerer continua a subire le devastazioni del disastro. Ci rimane ancora una lunga strada da percorrere prima che tutto torni come prima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Sí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: ... Yeah.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: ¿Qué dices tú, Lenja? ¿Qué te gustaría hacer?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: What about you, Lenja? Is there anything you want to do?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: E tu che dici, Lenja? Cosa ti piacerebbe fare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Pues me gustaría hablar con el clan Flumme de Aladiss y de los Silva.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Um, I'd like to tell the rest of the Flumme clan about Aladiss and the Silva.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Beh, vorrei parlare con il clan Flumme di Aladiss e con i Silva.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: ¡Ojalá un día los dos clanes lleguen a conocerse!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: I really hope that one day, our clans can meet!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Mi auguro che un giorno i due clan arrivino a conoscersi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Si alguien puede lograrlo, esa eres tú, Lenja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Yeah. There's no one better to bring them together than you, Lenja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Se qualcuno puo' riuscirci, sei tu, Lenja.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: ¿Y vosotros? ¿Rutger? ¿Nina? Ya que hemos sacado el tema, quiero saber cuáles son vuestros planes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Rutger, Nina, how about you? Since we're on the subject, I want to hear everyone's plans.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: E voi? Rutger? Nina? Ora che ne abbiamo parlato, voglio sapere quali sono i vostri piani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: ¿Yo? Nada del otro mundo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Me? I won't be doin' anythin' different.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Io? Niente di speciale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Iré donde huela a dinero. Lo de siempre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: I'll just go wherever there's talk of profits. Same as always.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Iro' dove c'e' odore di denaro. La solita storia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Qué sorpresa. No has cambiado nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Figures. You haven't changed a bit from when we first met you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Che sorpresa. Non sei cambiato per niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Yo lo llamo ser perseverante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Just call me consistent.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Io la chiamo perseveranza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: ¿Y tú qué, Nina?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Nina, what about you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: E tu, Nina?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Yo... No sé qué decir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: For me ... It's hard to say.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Io... Non so cosa dire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Esperaré las instrucciones del jefe. Hay mucho de qué hablar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: I'll wait and see what the chief's instructions are. I imagine we still have a lot to talk about.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Aspettero' le istruzioni del capo. C'e' molto di cui parlare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Y después... supongo que retomaré mi trabajo de mercenaria.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: And after that ... Well, I suppose I'll return to mercenary work if I can.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: E poi... suppongo che riprendero' il mio lavoro di mercenaria.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Es reconfortante en cierto modo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: It's enjoyable work in its own way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: In un certo senso e' rincuorante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Todo apunta a que nuestros caminos se separarán.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: It sounds like we'll all be going our separate ways.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Tutto indica che i nostri camini si separeranno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: No estaremos juntos, pero no hay por qué apenarse. Estos días que hemos compartido no desaparecerán.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: It's a lonely thought, but there's no need to be sad. The days we've spent together won't disappear.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Non saremo insieme, ma non c'e' motivo di rattristarsi. I giorni che abbiamo condiviso non scompariranno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Bien dicho. Y todavía nos queda investigación por delante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Well put. And we still need to see this investigation through to the end.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Ben detto. E ci aspetta ancora della ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Pero no por mucho tiempo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: It won't be much longer ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Ma non per molto tempo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Vale. Vuestro siguiente destino es el corazón de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: All right. The next step is for you to enter the heart of Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Va bene. La vostra prossima destinazione e' il cuore di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Supongo que no he de recordaros que ultiméis los preparativos antes de salir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: I suppose I don't need to tell you all to prepare yourselves.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Suppongo che non serva ricordarvi di ultimare i preparativi prima di partire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Habéis crecido mucho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: You've all really grown.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Siete cresciuti molto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: ¿Qué bicho te ha picado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Ma che mosca ti ha morso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: ¿Sabéis una cosa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Did you guys know?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Sapete una cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Al principio, venía dando botes de alegría cuando le asignaba una misión. Y decía cosas como: «¡Quiero hacer el descubrimiento del siglo!».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: At first, she was so excited about making "huge discoveries" and "uncovering shocking truths."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: All'inizio, quando le assegnavo una missione, balzava di gioia. E diceva cose come: "Voglio fare la scoperta del secolo!".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: ¿¡Yo!? ¿Cuándo he dicho algo así?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Me?! When did I say that?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Io!? Quando avrei mai detto una cosa simile?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: ¡Ju, ju, ju!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: What's so funny?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Ah ah ah!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: ¿De qué te ríes?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: S-s-sorry, Yumia! It's just very sweet.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Di cosa ridi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: P-perdona, Yumia. Es que es una imagen adorable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Even Lenja laughed at me ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: S-scusa, Yumia. E' che e' un'immagine adorabile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Hasta Lenja se ha reído de mí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: I had no idea! I can't believe you said that!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Persino Lenja ha riso di me...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: ¡No tenía ni idea!... ¿En serio decías ese tipo de cosas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Back then I was just doing whatever I could!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Non ne avevo idea!... Davvero dicevi cose del genere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Me esforzaba mucho, ¿vale?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: I know, I know. That's right, everyone used to be pretty wary of you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Mi impegnavo tantissimo, eh!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Ya lo sé, lo sé. Intentabas ganarte la confianza de la gente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: There's no one who sees you that way anymore. Not me, and not anyone else on the Research Team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Lo so, lo so. Stavi cercando di conquistare la fiducia della gente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Pero ya nadie te mira con recelo. Todo el equipo confía en ti, yo el primero.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: I know.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Ma ormai nessuno ti guarda piu' con diffidenza. Tutta la squadra si fida di te, io per primo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: Lo sé.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: I don't think there's anything left for me to add. You guys get going. I'll be waiting for good news.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Lo so.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: No tengo más que añadir. Salid cuando estéis listos. Esperaré vuestro informe a la vuelta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..ref: Yes, sir!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Non ho altro da aggiungere. Partite quando siete pronti. Aspettero' il vostro rapporto al ritorno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..src: ¡Sí, señor!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm07_450..dst: Si', signore!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_010..ref: So much technology was born here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_010..dst: Quanta tecnologia sara' nata da qui...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_010..src: Sí, tantas innovaciones como ideas perversas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_010..dst: Si', tante innovazioni quante idee perverse.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_010..src: ¿Tú, Viktor? Pero si nunca pierdes la calma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_010..ref: Even you, Viktor? You never get nervous.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_010..dst: Tu, Viktor? Ma se non perdi mai la calma.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_010..src: Vésper amenazó con volvernos a ver. Seguro que aparece antes de que demos con Basilius.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_010..ref: Vesper said we'd fight again soon. I have no doubts he'll show himself before we come face to face with Basilius.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_010..dst: Vesper ha minacciato di rivederci. Di sicuro apparira' prima che troviamo Basilius.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_010..ref: He's here. I just know it.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_010..src: Estoy bien. Es solo que se me acumulan los recuerdos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_010..ref: I'm okay. I just find myself remembering many things.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_010..dst: Sto bene. E' solo che mi affollano i ricordi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_010..src: Estamos a punto de asomarnos al abismo de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_010..ref: We're about to peer into the abyss of Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_010..dst: Stiamo per affacciarci sull'abisso di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_020..src: Estar aquí me provoca nostalgia. El laboratorio es distinto, pero veo recuerdos de mi pasado por todas partes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_020..ref: It's so nostalgic being here. The laboratory looks different, but I can see remnants of the past here and there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_020..dst: Stare qui mi provoca nostalgia. Il laboratorio e' diverso, ma vedo ricordi del mio passato dappertutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_020..src: Según la afluencia de maná, diría que hay un circulador en la planta superior del edificio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_020..ref: Based on the flow of mana, it seems like there might be a circulator on the top of this building.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_020..dst: Secondo il flusso di mana, direi che c'e' un circolatore al piano superiore dell'edificio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_020..src: Si queremos subir, hay que usar el dispositivo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_020..ref: If you want to head up, we'll need to use this device.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_020..dst: Se vogliamo salire, dobbiamo usare il dispositivo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_020..src: Se necesita autorización para manipular el altar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_020..ref: Control authorization is required to operate this altar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_020..dst: E' necessaria un'autorizzazione per operare l'altare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_020..src: Lo explicaré para que lo entiendas: necesitas tres llaves.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_020..ref: To explain it in a way that you will understand, you need to collect three keys.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_020..dst: Te lo spiego in parole semplici: ti servono tre chiavi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_020..src: La primera parte sobraba, pero gracias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_020..ref: That first part wasn't necessary, but I see.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_020..dst: La prima parte era superflua, ma grazie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_020..ref: The keys are in this lab, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_020..dst: Le chiavi sono in questo laboratorio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_020..ref: Then let's start looking. Remain vigilant, everyone.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_030..src: ¡Uf! No tiene pinta de venir en son de paz.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_030..dst: Uff! Non ha proprio l'aria di venire in pace.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..ref: That was scary! It attacked so suddenly.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..src: ¿Qué hace un monstruo tan feroz en un laboratorio?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..ref: Why's such a vicious monster hangin' out in the middle of a research lab?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..dst: Che ci fa un mostro cosi' feroce in un laboratorio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..src: Quizá era un sujeto de estudio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..ref: Perhaps it was the subject of the research.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..dst: Forse era un soggetto di studio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..src: ¿Crees que usarían esta sala para experimentar con monstruos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..ref: You mean they used this room to research monsters?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..dst: Pensi che usassero questa stanza per sperimentare sui mostri?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..src: No, más bien investigaban a todo ser vivo existente. Yo también estuve en esta sala, o eso creo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..ref: It may be more accurate to say they were researching all living things. I think I've been in this room before, too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..dst: No, in realta' studiavano ogni forma di vita esistente. Anch'io sono stato in questa stanza, o almeno credo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..src: Otros homúnculos como yo y mutantes... Eso es lo que estudiaban aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..ref: Homunculi like myself, mutants ... They were likely all researched right here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..dst: Altri omuncoli come me e mutanti... E' questo che studiavano qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..ref: Sounds like we found what we were looking for.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..src: Pero no parece que haya muchas pistas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..ref: But it doesn't look like there are any other clues in here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..dst: Ma non sembra che ci siano altri indizi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..src: Sí, es como los otros sitios en los que hemos buscado: ni rastro de los datos de la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..ref: Yes, it's the same as all the other places we've been to. Not a single record of research data has been left behind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..dst: Si', e' come gli altri posti in cui abbiamo cercato: ne' ombra dei dati della ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..src: Hasta los documentos están en blanco. No han reparado en los detalles al restaurar la ciudad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..ref: Even when we find documents, they're empty. I guess that kind of stuff wasn't restored with the rest of the city.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..dst: Perfino i documenti sono in bianco. Non hanno curato i dettagli nel restaurare la citta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..src: Aquí no hay nada sobre los mutantes. Qué bajón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..ref: Nothin' on mutants either. Man, what a letdown.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..dst: Qui non c'e' nulla sui mutanti. Che delusione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..src: Los mutantes se creaban a partir de seres humanos, como Lili Borea, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..ref: Mutants were created by altering humans, just like what happened to Lili Borea, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..dst: I mutanti venivano creati partendo da esseri umani, come Lili Borea, giusto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..src: De ser así, aquí fue donde ocurrió todo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..ref: If this truly is where that took place ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_040..dst: Se e' cosi', e' qui che e' successo tutto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..src: ¿Qué es eso que flota? ¿Qué habitación es esta?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..ref: There's something floating up there. What kind of room is this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..dst: Che cos'e' quella cosa che fluttua? Che stanza e' questa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..src: Aquí se investigaría la creación de materia a través de la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..ref: This is probably a lab for researching the creation of matter through alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..dst: Qui si studiava probabilmente la creazione di materia attraverso l'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..src: Es decir, la producción en masa de armamento militar, la tecnología arquitectónica basada en la alquimia y ese tipo de cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..ref: Mass production of weapons and armor for military use, architectural technology rooted in alchemy ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..dst: Ossia la produzione in massa di armamenti militari, la tecnologia architettonica basata sull'alchimia e quel genere di cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..src: En Aladiss, todo se hacía con alquimia, desde los juguetes de los niños a las casas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..ref: In Aladiss, everything from children's toys to houses was made with alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..dst: Ad Aladiss tutto si faceva con l'alchimia, dai giocattoli dei bambini alle case.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..src: No me imagino cómo sería un mundo así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..ref: I can't even imagine what a world like that would look like.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..dst: Non riesco nemmeno a immaginare come sarebbe un mondo del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..src: Sí, es todo lo contrario a la actualidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..ref: Yes, it's the complete opposite nowadays.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..dst: Si', e' l'esatto contrario di oggi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..src: Flammi, ¿hay aquí alguna autorización que necesitemos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..ref: Flammi, are any of the control authorizations here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..dst: Flammi, qui c'e' qualche autorizzazione che ci serve?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..src: Parece que hay una almacenada en ese artilugio en forma de caja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..ref: There seems to be one stored inside of this box-shaped device.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_050..dst: Sembra che ce ne sia una conservata in quel marchingegno a forma di scatola.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_060..src: Si lo pienso, este lugar es muy artificial. Todo lo que contiene es estrictamente indispensable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_060..ref: You know ... this place really does have an artificial feeling. There's nothing here but the absolute necessities.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_060..dst: A pensarci bene, questo posto e' molto artificiale. Tutto quello che contiene e' strettamente indispensabile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_060..src: Quien lo haya restaurado solo se ha preocupado por las cosas que funcionaban con maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_060..ref: I think it might have been restored in a way that focused on only the mana-powered functionality.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_060..dst: Chi l'ha restaurata si e' preoccupato solo delle cose che funzionavano a mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_060..src: Humm... ¿Dices que no pudieron hacer nada mejor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_060..ref: Hmm ... So you mean they weren't able to do more than this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_060..dst: Hmm... Vuoi dire che non sono riusciti a fare di meglio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_060..src: Tiene sentido. De estar en su mano, habría creado un ejército enorme de mutantes con el que arrasarnos sin pensárselo dos veces.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_060..ref: Well yeah. If they coulda, they woulda made a huge army of mutants and wiped us all out in one go.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_060..dst: Ha senso. Se ne fossero stati capaci, avrebbero creato un enorme esercito di mutanti per spazzarci via in un colpo solo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_060..src: No hay mal que por bien no venga.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_060..ref: Let's hope there's some way to take advantage of that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_060..dst: Non tutto il male viene per nuocere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_070..src: Esta sala está en las últimas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_070..ref: This room is in pretty bad shape.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_070..dst: Questa sala e' in condizioni pessime.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_070..src: Sí, hay partes totalmente desgastadas. Ha visto tiempos mejores.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_070..ref: Yes, some parts are very run down. It's a far cry from what it used to look like.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_070..dst: Si', ci sono parti completamente deteriorate. Ha visto giorni migliori.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_070..src: Hay maná distorsionado... ¿Podríamos usar el mismo método para leer los recuerdos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_070..ref: This jumbled mana ... I wonder if we can use the same method as before to read the memories here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_070..dst: C'e' mana distorto... Potremmo usare lo stesso metodo per leggere i ricordi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Extracción finalizada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: Extraction successful.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Estrazione completata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Su Majestad, es un honor que haya decidido vis...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: Your Majesty. I'm honored that you would come here direc—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Vostra Maesta', e' un onore che abbia deciso di vis...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: No tengo tiempo para minucias. Ve al grano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: No need for pleasantries. Get to the point.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Non ho tempo per futilita'. Vai al punto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Por supuesto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: Of course.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Certo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: La tecnología para comprimir recuerdos está en fase de desarrollo, yo diría que hemos avanzado un noventa por ciento. Estamos preparando la fase dos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: The current phase of development for memory compression technology is approximately 90% complete. We're preparing to begin phase two.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: La tecnologia per comprimere i ricordi e' in fase di sviluppo, direi che abbiamo raggiunto il novanta percento. Stiamo preparando la fase due.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: La producción experimental del Vial de recuerdos todopoderoso dará comienzo al fin. Aunque se nos han presentado varios obstáculos que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: Experimental production of the Almighty Memory Vial will finally begin. Although, there are still many issues ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: La produzione sperimentale della Fiala della Memoria onnipotente avra' finalmente inizio. Anche se si sono presentati diversi ostacoli che...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: ¿Cuáles?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: Such as?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Quali?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Recopilar todo el conocimiento y las tecnologías de Aladiss. Parece una tarea sencilla, pero nos hemos topado con algunas dificultades.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: The collection of all Aladissian technology and knowledge. Though it's a simple task, we've encountered many difficulties.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Raccogliere tutte le conoscenze e le tecnologie di Aladiss. Sembra un compito semplice, ma ci siamo imbattuti in alcune difficolta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Hemos solicitado ayuda a los laboratorios de investigación de otras regiones, pero nos llevará un tiempo poder...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: We've requested assistance from research labs in other regions, but covering everything will take a considerable amount of ti—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Abbiamo chiesto aiuto ai laboratori di ricerca di altre regioni, ma ci vorra' tempo prima di poter...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Recuerdo oír la misma excusa hace seis meses.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: I seem to recall hearing the same thing half a year ago.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Ricordo di aver sentito la stessa scusa sei mesi fa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Si pudiéramos reducir la cantidad de datos, creo que el resultado sería positivo. Pero hasta ahora...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Se potessimo ridurre la quantita' di dati, credo che il risultato sarebbe positivo. Ma finora...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: No. No se hará tal cosa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: If, for instance, we were to reduce the scope of data collection, I believe it may change the outlook, but as things stand now ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: No. Una cosa del genere non si fara'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Os he ordenado almacenar todos los conocimientos de Aladiss. Sin excepción.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: No. There will be nothing of the sort.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Vi ho ordinato di memorizzare tutte le conoscenze di Aladiss. Senza eccezioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Si por algún casual no llenase el vial todopoderoso, mi crisálida de recuerdos estaría incompleta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: You are to record all of Aladiss's technology and knowledge.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Se per qualche motivo la fiala onnipotente non fosse riempita, la mia crisalide di ricordi resterebbe incompleta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: E-entiendo. Se hará con la mayor diligencia, Majestad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: If the Almighty Memory Vial is not full, I will not be able to complete my Recollection Cocoon.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: C-capisco. Lo faremo con la massima diligenza, Maesta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Después de almacenar los recuerdos de la gente en la crisálida, ¿usaréis a los homúnculos como cascarones vacíos para revivir a los muertos?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: I-I see. As diligent as ever, Your Majesty.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Dopo aver immagazzinato i ricordi delle persone nella crisalide, userete gli omuncoli come gusci vuoti per far rivivere i morti?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: ¿Acaso no he logrado en otras ocasiones lo que me he propuesto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: And after you've collected the people's memories within the Recollection Cocoon, you plan to use the homunculi as vessels to revive the dead ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Non ho forse realizzato in altre occasioni cio' che mi ero proposto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Discúlpeme, Su Majestad. Continuaremos investigando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: Have I ever spoken of unattainable ideals?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Mi perdoni, Vostra Maesta'. Continueremo le ricerche.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Fin de los recuerdos extraídos. Todo apunta a que era una conversación entre Basilius en persona y uno de los investigadores.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: My apologies, Your Majesty. We will continue with the research.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Fine dei ricordi estratti. Tutto indica che fosse una conversazione tra Basilius in persona e uno dei ricercatori.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: ¡Basilius!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: End of extracted memories. This memory appears to be of a conversation between Basilius himself and a researcher.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Basilius!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: «Todo el conocimiento y las tecnologías de Aladiss»... Qué hombre más codicioso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: Basilius himself!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: "Tutte le conoscenze e le tecnologie di Aladiss"... Che uomo avido.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: No quería renunciar a ningún dato. Era esa clase de persona que no se conforma con nada menos que la perfección.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: "All technology and knowledge," hm? He's quite the greedy man.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Non voleva rinunciare a nessun dato. Era il tipo di persona che non si accontentava di nulla se non della perfezione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Además, se ha obtenido una nueva autorización.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: He wasn't willing to give up even one bit of information. It seems he was the type of person who accepted nothing less than perfection.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Inoltre, e' stata ottenuta una nuova autorizzazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Genial. Gracias, Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: Additionally, control authorization has been successfully acquired.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Perfetto. Grazie, Flammi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Por lo que hemos oído en la conversación, esta sala estaba destinada al estudio del maná y los recuerdos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: Great. Thanks, Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Da quanto abbiamo sentito nella conversazione, questa sala era destinata allo studio del mana e dei ricordi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Me pregunto si todos estos recuerdos serán la causa de la distorsión del maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: Based on the conversation we just witnessed, this room must be related to the research of mana and memories.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Mi chiedo se tutti questi ricordi siano la causa della distorsione del mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Oye, y han mencionado una crisálida...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: Is the jumbled mana created by countless memories coming together?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Ehi, hanno anche menzionato una crisalide...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Sí. Ya leímos en Auruma unos documentos sobre el proyecto Crisálida de recuerdos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: Hey, about that Recollection Cocoon that they mentioned ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Si'. Ad Auruma abbiamo gia' letto dei documenti sul progetto Crisalide di Ricordi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: ¿Y para qué quería usar a los homúnculos? Ni yo conocía por aquel entonces el propósito general de los experimentos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: Yeah. It must be related to the Recollection Cocoon project documents we found in Auruma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: E per cosa voleva usare gli omuncoli? Nemmeno io conoscevo all'epoca lo scopo generale degli esperimenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Ya. Tengo la sensación de que todo va cobrando sentido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: What was he planning on using the homunculi for? Back then, I didn't understand the full scope of the project.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Gia'. Ho la sensazione che tutto stia acquisendo senso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Después de haber oído esta información, creo que empiezo a comprender la situación de Calumna.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: Yeah. I feel like things are a lot clearer after hearing that conversation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Dopo aver sentito queste informazioni, credo di iniziare a capire la situazione di Calumna.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: ¿El qué exactamente?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: I think I'm starting to understand things about this Calumna from the information we've gathered as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Cosa, esattamente?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Pues cómo acabó en este estado, por ejemplo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: Like what?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Be', per esempio, come e' finita in questo stato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Calumna se restauró a partir de los recuerdos de Basilius.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: Like how Calumna got to the state it's in right now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Calumna e' stata restaurata a partire dai ricordi di Basilius.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: ¿De sus recuerdos? ¿Y eso qué quiere decir?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: I think that the restoration of Calumna was based on Basilius's memories of it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Dai suoi ricordi? E cosa vorrebbe dire?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Hemos visitado muchos edificios en la ciudad: el teatro, la casa de Nina, este laboratorio...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: Based on his memories? What's that mean?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Abbiamo visitato molti edifici in citta': il teatro, la casa di Nina, questo laboratorio...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Y no hemos parado de preguntarnos por qué hay ciertas zonas más restauradas que otras.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: The theater, Nina's house, and this laboratory—we've seen a lot of the city.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: E non abbiamo smesso di chiederci perche' ci sono zone restaurate piu' di altre.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Pero esa conversación me ha dado la clave.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: And the whole time we've been wondering why some places have been restored more than others.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Ma quella conversazione mi ha dato la chiave.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: No se trata de la importancia de los edificios, lo que importa es si Basilius los recuerda o no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: But something came to me when we were listening to that conversation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Non si tratta dell'importanza degli edifici, cio' che conta e' se Basilius se li ricorda o no.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: El teatro era más grande de lo normal porque impresionó al emperador y así se le quedó grabado en la memoria.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: It doesn't matter how important a building might have been. What matters is whether or not Basilius remembers it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Il teatro era piu' grande del normale perche' impressiono' l'imperatore e cosi' gli rimase impresso nella memoria.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Sí, creo que sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: So then, the theater is bigger than it used to be because it made a strong impression on Basilius's memory?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Si', credo di si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Seguro que el emperador acudió a muchas representaciones. Tiene sentido que dejara una huella más profunda que las casas de los ciudadanos de a pie.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: Yeah, I think so.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Sicuramente l'imperatore assisteva a molte rappresentazioni. Ha senso che abbia lasciato un'impronta piu' profonda delle case dei cittadini comuni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Entonces... ¿¡Esa es «toda» su Aladiss!? ¡Vaya mentiroso!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: The emperor must have seen many plays there himself. Compared to a random citizen's home, it makes sense that it left a stronger impression on him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Allora... Quella e' "tutta" la loro Aladiss!? Che bugiardo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Solo ha restaurado lo que le apetecía. Es un egoísta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: But then ... But then, that's not "everything" at all!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Ha restaurato solo cio' che gli andava. E' un egoista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Es verdad. ¿En serio cree que esto es una «resurrección»?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: He's just bringing back whatever he wants! That's way too selfish!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: E' vero. Crede davvero che questo sia una "resurrezione"?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Mientras «su nación ideal» regrese, no le importa un pimiento lo que sientan sus ciudadanos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: You're right. Does he really think this can be called a "resurrection"?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Finche' ritorna "la sua nazione ideale", non gliene importa nulla di cio' che provano i suoi cittadini.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Sí. Nadie se conformaría con una Aladiss en estas condiciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: As long as his "ideal nation" comes to fruition, I guess he doesn't care about individual citizens.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Si'. Nessuno si accontenterebbe di un'Aladiss in queste condizioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Como bien dices, es una idea extremadamente egoísta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: Yeah. There's no way anyone would be happy with an Aladiss that was brought back like this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Come giustamente dici, e' un'idea estremamente egoista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..src: Motivo de más para pararle los pies.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..ref: Yeah. He really is unbelievably selfish.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_080..dst: Un motivo in piu' per fermarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_090..ref: Activation successful. Ready to begin operation.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_100..src: Ya era hora. Habéis tardado en acudir a nuestra cita.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_100..ref: So you've arrived. You novices certainly took your time getting here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_100..dst: Era ora. Avete tardato a presentervi al nostro appuntamento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_100..ref: It's time for us to end this, Vesper.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_100..src: No permitiremos que este plan salga adelante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_100..ref: We won't let your plan go any further.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_100..dst: Non permetteremo che questo piano vada avanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_100..src: Percibo determinación en vuestras miradas. No queda rastro de la ira.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_100..ref: I see not anger, but determination in your eyes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_100..dst: Percepisco determinazione nei vostri sguardi. Non resta traccia dell'ira.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_100..ref: In which case, there is nothing more for us to say.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_100..src: Nada puede interponerse en el camino de Su Majestad. ¡Os aplastaré con todas mis fuerzas!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_100..ref: I will not let you stand in the way of His Majesty's iron rule. I will crush you with everything I have!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_100..dst: Nulla puo' frapporsi sul cammino di Sua Maesta'. Vi schiaccero' con tutte le mie forze!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_110..src: No... Es imposible... Esto no puede acabar así...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_110..ref: I won't accept this ... This can't be how it ends ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_110..dst: No... E' impossibile... Non puo' finire cosi'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_110..src: No somos como tú, no vivimos anclados al pasado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_110..ref: We're different from the likes of you who cling to the past.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_110..dst: Non siamo come te, non viviamo ancorati al passato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_110..src: Miraremos hacia el futuro. Y te dejaremos atrás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_110..ref: We're going to keep moving forward. Leaving you behind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_110..dst: Guarderemo verso il futuro. E ti lasceremo alle spalle.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_110..src: Es el fin. Soy una sombra que pertenece al pasado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_110..ref: ... So this is how it ends. For relics that belong to the past ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_110..dst: E' la fine. Sono un'ombra che appartiene al passato...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_110..src: Su Majestad, lo lamento... No pude quedarme a su lado... hasta el final...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_110..ref: Your Majesty, I'm sorry ... I couldn't stay with you ... until the end ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_110..dst: Sua Maesta', mi dispiace... Non sono riuscito a restare al suo fianco... fino alla fine...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_110..src: No. Esto no ha hecho más que empezar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_110..ref: No, it's not. This is where it starts.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_110..src: Ese es el Castillo de Lacuna, hogar del emperador. Es imposible confundirlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_110..ref: There's no mistaking it. That's Lacuna Castle, the emperor's castle!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_110..dst: E' il Castello di Lacuna, la dimora dell'imperatore. E' impossibile confonderlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_120..src: Por eso no lo podía ver: ocultaron el castillo detrás de otro de esos muros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_120..ref: No wonder I couldn't see it. They hid the entire castle with another wall.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_120..dst: Per questo non riuscivo a vederlo: hanno nascosto il castello dietro un altro di quei muri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_120..src: No cabe duda de que es el castillo. Se han tomado muchas molestias para esconderlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_120..ref: But if they went to such lengths to hide it, then there's no doubt about it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_120..dst: Non c'e' alcun dubbio: e' il castello. Si sono presi molta briga per nasconderlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_120..src: Por fin damos con él. Por fin lo hemos arrinconado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_120..ref: We've finally found him. Or perhaps I should say we've finally cornered him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_120..dst: Finalmente gli siamo addosso. Finalmente lo abbiamo ridotto all'angolo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_120..src: Entremos. Hay que dejarle las cosas claras a Basilius.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_120..ref: Let's go in. It's time to settle things with Basilius.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_120..dst: Entriamo. Dobbiamo dirgli le cose chiare a Basilius.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..src: Así que este es el Castillo de Lacuna. Es un poco confuso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..ref: So this is Lacuna Castle. The construction is so intricate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..dst: Cosi' questo e' il Castello di Lacuna. E' un po' confuso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..ref: It really is. Almost too intricate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..src: Oí decir que hizo falta reunir la tecnología más avanzada de Aladiss para construir el castillo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..ref: I heard once long ago that they gathered all of Aladiss's most advanced technology to build this castle.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..dst: Ho sentito dire che per costruire quel castello servi' raccogliere la tecnologia piu' avanzata di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..src: Es decir, que solo querían presumir de lo poderoso que era el imperio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..ref: So basically, they were tryin' to show off just how strong the empire was.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..dst: Cioe', volevano solo vantarsi di quanto potente fosse l'impero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..src: Por muy bonito que sea, tiene algo tétrico.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..ref: But, you know ... while it's beautiful, it also feels foreboding.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..dst: Per quanto bello sia, ha qualcosa di tetro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..src: Opino igual. Aparte de la gran densidad de maná, percibo algo inusual... Algo que me pone los pelos de punta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..ref: I feel the same way. The mana isn't just dense, there's also some other kind of creepy feeling ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..dst: La penso uguale. Oltre all'alta densita' di mana, percepisco qualcosa di insolito... Qualcosa che mi fa drizzare i peli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..src: Sí, como un maná viscoso que recarga el ambiente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..ref: Yeah, it's like thick, sludgy mana is swirling around it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..dst: Si', come un mana viscoso che appesantisce l'atmosfera.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..src: En pocas palabras: no debemos dejarnos engañar por los sentidos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..ref: In other words, we shouldn't let appearances deceive us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..dst: In parole povere: non dobbiamo lasciarci ingannare dai sensi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..src: Exacto. Hay que andarse con mil ojos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..ref: Exactly. We need to be very careful here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_130..dst: Esatto. Bisogna stare con gli occhi ben aperti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_140..src: Hay maná flotando alrededor del castillo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_140..ref: It's like mana is flowing throughout the castle ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_140..dst: Il mana fluttua intorno al castello...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_140..src: Hasta nosotros podemos sentirlo. Es una sensación inquietante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_140..ref: Even we can feel it. It truly is an unsettling feeling.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_140..dst: Anche noi riusciamo a sentirlo. E' una sensazione inquietante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_140..src: No me sorprende, ahora estamos en su territorio. Pero no lo veo por ninguna parte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_140..ref: Makes sense, we're in the middle of his domain now. Still, he's not comin' out and attackin' us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_140..dst: Non mi sorprende, ora siamo nel suo territorio. Pero' non lo vedo da nessuna parte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_140..src: Ya... Aun así, yo no bajaría la guardia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_140..ref: Yeah, but still, we shouldn't let our guard down ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_140..dst: Gia'... Eppure io non abbasserei la guardia.
Ehi, goffa, non starai mica spaventata, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_140..src: ¡N-no estoy asustada! Pero un poco de miedo sí que da...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_140..ref: I-I'm not afraid! I'm just a little scared ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_140..dst: N-non sono spaventata! Pero' mette un po' di paura...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_140..ref: Is that supposed to mean somethin' different?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_140..src: Pues sí. Aunque me dé miedo, no pienso huir. He venido a luchar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_140..ref: I'm a little scared, but I'm going to fight anyway. I'm not going to run.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_140..dst: Beh, si'. Anche se avro' paura, non intendo fuggire. Sono venuta per combattere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: El aire está muy cargado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: The air in here feels so heavy ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: L'aria e' molto pesante...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Sí. ¿En qué clase de habitación estamos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: Yeah ... What kind of room is this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Si'. Che tipo di stanza e' questa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: ¿Qué es este dispositivo? ¿Servirá para fabricar Viales de recuerdos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: Um, what is this device? Is this for making Memory Vials?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Che cos'e' questo congegno? Servira' per creare Fiale della Memoria?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Nunca he visto nada igual, pero por la forma, yo diría que sí. Parece que le daban mucho uso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: I've never seen it before, but based on its shape, I would imagine so. There are also signs that it was used very recently.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Non ho mai visto niente di simile, ma dalla forma direi di si'. Sembra che lo usassero molto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Lo usaría ese gusano de Basilius, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: By that bastard Basilius, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Lo userebbe quel verme di Basilius, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Flammi, ¿siguen intactos los contenidos de los Viales de recuerdos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: Flammi, are the contents of the Memory Vials here intact?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Flammi, i contenuti delle Fiale della Memoria sono ancora intatti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Sí. Puedo acceder a ellos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: Yes. They can be accessed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Si'. Posso accedervi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Al menos, algo funciona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: So at least the ones in here work.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Almeno qualcosa funziona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Genial. A lo mejor averiguamos algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: All right. Maybe we'll find some new clues here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Fantastico. Magari scopriamo qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: ¿Qué es esto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: Checking now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Che cos'e' questo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Es un antiguo informe de guerra y va dirigido al emperador. Escaneando...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: What's this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: E' un antico rapporto di guerra indirizzato all'imperatore. Scansione in corso...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: «Título: Movimientos de las naciones extranjeras y futuras contramedidas.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: This appears to be a war report from the past, addressed to the emperor. Scanning now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: "Titolo: Movimenti delle nazioni straniere e future contromisure."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: «Los países vecinos han formado una alianza oficial. Se han declarado en guerra contra nuestra nación.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: "Report: Foreign Nations' Movements and Future Countermeasures."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: "Le nazioni vicine hanno formato un'alleanza ufficiale. Si sono dichiarate in guerra contro la nostra nazione."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: «El ejército de la alianza es diez veces mayor que el de Aladiss. No podemos hacerle frente con la milicia actual.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: "An alliance between neighboring countries has officially been formed. They have declared war against our nation."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: "L'esercito dell'alleanza e' dieci volte piu' grande di quello di Aladiss. Non possiamo affrontarlo con la milizia attuale."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: «Para resistir esta ofensiva, se necesita urgentemente evaluar los usos potenciales de la alquimia y del maná.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: "The alliance's forces appear to be approximately ten times the size of Aladiss's own, making it difficult to counter with our current forces."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: "Per resistere a questa offensiva, e' urgentemente necessario valutare gli usi potenziali dell'alchimia e del mana."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: «Proponemos proceder de forma inmediata con nuestros planes para fabricar el Vial de recuerdos todopoderoso.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: "To counter this offensive, a reevaluation of potential uses of alchemy and mana is urgently needed."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: "Proponiamo di procedere immediatamente con i nostri piani per creare la Fiala della Memoria onnipotente."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: «Los expertos señalan que podríamos usar los circuladores de maná para acelerar nuestro plan».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: "We propose that we proceed immediately with our plans to produce the Almighty Memory Vial."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: "Gli esperti indicano che potremmo usare i circolatori di mana per accelerare il nostro piano".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: «Llevaremos a cabo la extracción de los recuerdos de los ciudadanos de la nación con los circuladores que hemos instalado en cada región».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: "Experts have suggested that utilizing mana circulators may prove effective in accelerating the plan's progression."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: "Eseguiremo l'estrazione dei ricordi dei cittadini della nazione con i circolatori che abbiamo installato in ogni regione".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: «Todos los recuerdos recopilados se comprimirán posteriormente en el Vial de recuerdos todopoderoso. Así, la extracción que llevaba un tiempo en pausa se agilizará.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: "The extraction and collection of citizens' memories across the nation will take place via the circulators installed in each region."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: "Tutti i ricordi raccolti verranno successivamente compressi nella Fiala della Memoria onnipotente. In questo modo l'estrazione, rimasta a lungo in pausa, si accelerera'."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: «Creemos que, una vez que el Vial de recuerdos todopoderoso alcance su capacidad máxima, seremos testigos de un gran avance en la alquimia.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: "All collected memories will be subsequently compiled within the Almighty Memory Vial, allowing the previously halted collection to make considerable progress."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: "Riteniamo che, una volta che la Fiala della Memoria onnipotente avra' raggiunto la sua capacita' massima, assisteremo a un grande progresso dell'alchimia."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Fin de la información descifrada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: "Once the Almighty Memory Vial reaches maximum capacity, we anticipate seeing tremendous advancements from alchemists—"
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Fine delle informazioni decifrate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: ¿Recopilaban los recuerdos de los ciudadanos? Es lo mismo que dijeron Basilius y el investigador.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: End of decipherable information.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Raccoglievano i ricordi dei cittadini? E' la stessa cosa che hanno detto Basilius e il ricercatore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Sí, en la conversación que escuchamos en el laboratorio. ¿Cómo podrían los dirigentes del país hacer algo así?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: Collecting the citizens' memories? We heard Basilius and that researcher talk about that too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Si', nella conversazione che abbiamo sentito in laboratorio. Come avrebbero potuto i dirigenti del paese fare una cosa del genere?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Lo que me pregunto es si pudieron realmente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: Right, the conversation we listened to in the laboratory. But to think the country's leaders were doing such a thing ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Cio' che mi chiedo e' se ci siano davvero riusciti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Seguro que sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: Did they really though? I find it hard to believe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Sicuramente si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: ¿Cómo lo sabes?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: Yes, I'm sure they did.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Come fai a saperlo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Por los registros de la investigación que dejó la doctora Marina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: How do you know?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Dai documenti della ricerca lasciati dalla Dottoressa Marina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: «Día 382 tras el desastre de maná. Mi investigación de las regiones Lignumbria y Syvashi ha dado sus frutos...».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: The investigation records that Doctor Marina left behind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: "Giorno 382 dopo il disastro di mana. La mia ricerca sulle regioni di Lignumbria e Syvashi ha dato i suoi frutti...".
