eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: «He confirmado que existían fluctuaciones antinaturales de maná en los circuladores de cada región antes del desastre».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: "Day 382 since the mana disaster. My investigation around the Ligneus and Sivash regions has yielded results—"
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: "Ho confermato che esistevano fluttuazioni innaturali di mana nei circolatori di ogni regione prima del disastro".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: «El origen de estas fluctuaciones es desconocido. Solo se me ocurre que alguien haya querido ocultar las pruebas».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: "I confirmed that there were unnatural mana fluctuations around the circulators in each area just before the disaster."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: "L'origine di queste fluttuazioni e' sconosciuta. Mi viene in mente solo che qualcuno abbia voluto nascondere le prove".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: «Los circuladores estaban bajo el control del imperio. Sería extremadamente difícil que alguien se infiltrara para manipularlos».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: "The origin of these fluctuations is completely unknown. I can only assume that someone covered up any evidence."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: "I circolatori erano sotto il controllo dell'impero. Sarebbe estremamente difficile che qualcuno si fosse infiltrato per manipolarli".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: «Además, debido al gran número de circuladores presentes en Aladiss, es casi imposible romperlos todos a la vez».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: "The circulators were under the empire's control. It would be exceedingly difficult for someone to infiltrate and tamper with them."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: "Inoltre, a causa del gran numero di circolatori presenti ad Aladiss, e' quasi impossibile distruggerli tutti in una volta".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: «La conclusión más lógica sería que el imperio que supervisaba los circuladores quisiera ocultar las pruebas».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: "In addition, due to the sheer number of circulators in Aladiss, it would be near impossible to tamper with them all simultaneously."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: "La conclusione piu' logica sarebbe che l'impero che supervisionava i circolatori volesse nascondere le prove".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: ¿Aquellos sobre la «fluctuación de maná antinatural»? ¿Crees que la provocaron con todo esto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: "This makes it likely that the empire which oversaw the circulators was the one that performed this cover-up."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Quelle sulla "fluttuazione innaturale di mana"? Pensi che l'abbiano provocata con tutto questo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Sí, es lo más probable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: "Unnatural mana fluctuations"? That was them messin' with people's memories?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Si', e' la cosa piu' probabile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Y el Gran Desastre tuvo lugar poco después. Estas acciones debieron de ser la causa directa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: Yes, most likely.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: E il Grande Disastro avvenne poco dopo. Queste azioni debbero essere la causa diretta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Pondrían en marcha el plan antes de completar los preparativos y perdieron el control. Es la historia más plausible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: And if the mana disaster took place immediately afterward, their actions must have been the direct cause.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Misero in atto il piano prima di completare i preparativi e persero il controllo. E' la versione piu' plausibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: E-eso quiere decir... que Aladiss fue la única responsable de su desaparición.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: They went through with their plan before completing the necessary preparations and lost control. I believe that's the most likely story.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Q-quindi vuol dire... che Aladiss fu l'unico responsabile della sua scomparsa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: ¡Ja! Se lo merecen por dejarse cegar por la codicia. A mi modo de ver, tuvieron un final muy apropiado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: Th-then that means ... Aladiss caused its own downfall?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Ah! Se lo meritano per essersi lasciati accecare dall'avidita'. A mio parere, hanno avuto una fine molto appropriata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Es como dijo Corleonis: la restauración de Aladiss era su expiación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: Ha. They were basically askin' for it. They let their greed blind them. A fittin' end, really.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: E' come disse Corleonis: la restaurazione di Aladiss era la sua espiazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Muy loable llamarlo «expiación» cuando, en realidad, se comportan como niños que intentan ocultar un error.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: It's just like Corleonis said, "The restoration of Aladiss is our atonement."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Molto lodevole parlare di "espiazione", quando in realta' si comportano come bambini che cercano di nascondere un errore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Ya lo dijo Lenja: si te niegas a ver la verdad, nunca avanzarás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: Calling it atonement makes it sound good, but in reality, they're no different from children trying to hide their mistakes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Lo ha gia' detto Lenja: se rifiuti di vedere la verita', non andrai mai avanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Señorita Yumia...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: If you refuse to face the truth, you can never move forward. Just like Lenja said.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Signorina Yumia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Dicho así, nosotros también le dimos la espalda a lo que consideramos un tabú. No podemos ignorar la verdadera historia de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: Miss Yumia ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Detto questo, anche noi abbiamo voltato le spalle a cio' che consideriamo un tabu'. Non possiamo ignorare la vera storia di Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..src: Busquemos a Basilius. Nada cambiará hasta que no acabemos con él.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..ref: If you put it that way, we also turned our eyes from what is taboo. We need to face the history of Aladiss head-on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_150..dst: Cerchiamo Basilius. Nulla cambiera' finche' non lo avremo eliminato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..src: ¿Qué demonios...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..dst: Che diavolo...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..src: ¿Qué es ese árbol tan raro?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..dst: Che cos'e' quell'albero cosi' strano?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..src: ¡Ayyy!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..dst: Ayyy!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..src: ¿¡Lenja!?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..dst: Lenja!?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..src: ¿Qué te pasa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..dst: Cosa hai?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..src: Eso... Eso de ahí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..dst: Quella... Quella cosa li'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..src: ¿Basilius?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..dst: Basilius?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..src: Son muchos Basilius. Deben de ser homúnculos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..ref: They're all Basilius. They must be homunculi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..dst: Sono tanti Basilius. Devono essere omuncoli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..src: Usaría esos cuerpos para transferir sus recuerdos y prolongar así su vida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..ref: I guess he used these bodies as vessels and transferred his memories into them in order to prolong his life.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..dst: Userebbe quei corpi per trasferire i propri ricordi e prolungare cosi' la propria vita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..src: O sea, que esta habitación se ha construido para conservar todos estos cuerpos. ¿Y todo para seguir con vida?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..ref: So basically, this room is for preservin' all these bodies? He did all this to keep livin'?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..dst: Cioe', questa stanza e' stata costruita per conservare tutti questi corpi. E tutto solo per continuare a vivere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..src: No quería renunciar a nada. Ni siquiera estaba dispuesto a prescindir de su propia vida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..ref: He wanted everything. He wasn't even willing to let go of his own life.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..dst: Non voleva rinunciare a niente. Non era disposto nemmeno a fare a meno della propria vita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..src: Así que se transfería de cuerpo en cuerpo para mantener con vida sus recuerdos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..ref: So he transferred bodies over and over, keeping only his memories to stay alive until now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..dst: Cosi' si trasferiva di corpo in corpo per mantenere in vita i propri ricordi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..src: Y ¿cómo sabemos que sigue siendo el mismo Basilius?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..ref: Can we really even say he's still Basilius?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..dst: E come facciamo a sapere che sia ancora lo stesso Basilius?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..src: No lo sabemos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..dst: Non lo sappiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..src: Yo tampoco pude ser la hija de la doctora. Heredar los recuerdos de otra persona no te convierte en ella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..ref: Just as I could never be the doctor's daughter, simply inheriting someone's memories doesn't mean you're still the same person.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..dst: Nemmeno io sono riuscita a diventare la figlia della dottoressa. Ereditare i ricordi di un'altra persona non ti trasforma in lei.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..src: Entonces, Isla tampoco se equivocó al decir que era un impostor...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..ref: So Isla's theory about him being a "fake Basilius" wasn't exactly wrong ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..dst: Quindi Isla non si sbaglio' a dire che era un impostore...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..src: Ni siquiera eras consciente del error que cometías.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..ref: You never even realized the mistake you were making.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..dst: Non eri nemmeno consapevole dell'errore che stavi commettendo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..src: Su ambición era lo que le obligaba a continuar, como si estuviera poseído por una maldición que lo anclase a este mundo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..ref: His ambition must be his sole driving force, like a never-ending grudge or a ghost chained to this world.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..dst: Era la sua ambizione a costringerlo a continuare, come se fosse posseduto da una maledizione che lo teneva ancorato a questo mondo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..src: Hay que detenerlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..dst: Dobbiamo fermarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..src: Estoy contigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_160..dst: Sono con te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_170..src: Hay una enorme cantidad de maná más adelante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_170..ref: There's a tremendous amount of mana swirling up ahead.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_170..dst: C'e' un'enorme quantita' di mana piu' avanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_170..src: Refugiándose en la seguridad de su castillo. Le cuesta deshacerse de sus costumbres de emperador, ¿eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_170..ref: Lying in wait in the deepest depths of a castle. Once an emperor, always an emperor, I guess ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_170..dst: Rifugiato nella sicurezza del suo castello. Fatica a sbarazzarsi delle abitudini da imperatore, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_170..ref: It's not a trap, is it?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_170..src: Si quisiera tendernos una, ya lo habría hecho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_170..ref: If he was goin' to try to trip us up, he had plenty of opportunities.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_170..dst: Se volesse tendercene una, l'avrebbe gia' fatto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_170..src: Cierto. Está dispuesto a resolver este conflicto de una vez por todas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_170..ref: Indeed. It seems he's ready to settle this for real, here and now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_170..dst: Giusto. E' pronto a risolvere questo conflitto una volta per tutte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_170..ref: It's been a long time coming.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_170..src: Sí, hemos hecho todo lo posible. Vamos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_170..ref: We've done all we can. Let's go.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_170..dst: Si', abbiamo fatto tutto il possibile. Andiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_170..src: Todavía no. Me gustaría revisar un par de cosas. Nunca se sabe con qué nos sorprenderá esta vez.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_170..ref: Not quite. Let's make sure we're completely prepared. We don't know what he might have in store for us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_170..dst: Non ancora. Vorrei controllare un paio di cose. Non si sa mai con cosa ci sorprendera' questa volta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..src: (Perdí todos los recuerdos de mi madre.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..ref: (I lost all memories of my mom.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..dst: (Ho perso tutti i ricordi di mia madre.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..src: (Solo me quedó la alquimia.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..ref: (I was left with alchemy.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..dst: (Mi e' rimasta solo l'alchimia.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..src: Como sabrás, el uso de la alquimia está prohibido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..ref: I'm sure you already know this, but alchemy is a forbidden technique.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..dst: Come gia' saprai, l'uso dell'alchimia e' proibito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..src: Muchas gracias por tu ayuda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..ref: Thank you so much for your help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..dst: Grazie mille per il tuo aiuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..src: ¡Vengaremos a todos los fallecidos acabando contigo! ¡Hemos venido hasta aquí por ti!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..ref: We will avenge everyone we lost by striking you down! We've come this far just for this one purpose!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..dst: Vendicheremo tutti i nostri caduti abbattendoti! Siamo arrivati fin qui proprio per te!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..src: (Una cara oculta de la alquimia se escondía en Aladiss.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..ref: (A truth about alchemy that we could never have known lay dormant within Aladiss.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..dst: (Ad Aladiss si celava una verita' sconosciuta sull'alchimia.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..src: (No todos nuestros descubrimientos han sido motivo de celebración).
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..ref: (But not everything we learned was cause for celebration.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..dst: (Non tutte le nostre scoperte sono state motivo di celebrazione.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..src: (Vinimos aquí para enfrentarnos a nuestros fantasmas. Verdades que no queríamos afrontar.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..ref: (We came face to face with many things we didn't want to see—things we wanted to turn away from.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..dst: (Siamo venuti qui per confrontarci con i nostri fantasmi. Verita' che non volevamo affrontare.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..src: En estas tierras, no pueden saber que eres alquimista bajo ningún concepto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..ref: In these lands, you are under no circumstances to reveal yourself as an alchemist.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..dst: In queste terre, non devono in nessun caso scoprire che sei un'alchimista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..src: Mientras sobre nuestros hombros pesen los recuerdos del pasado, este conflicto no se resolverá.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..ref: As long as we shoulder the heavy weight of these memories, this conflict will never be settled so easily.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..dst: Finche' porteremo sulle spalle il peso dei ricordi del passato, questo conflitto non si risolvera'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..src: Por favor... Devolvedme mi cuerpo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..ref: ... Please. Give me back my body.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..dst: Per favore... Restituitemi il mio corpo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..src: (Y, a pesar de todo, la alquimia es mi vida.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..ref: (But despite all of that, I still love alchemy.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..dst: (E, nonostante tutto, l'alchimia e' la mia vita.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..src: (Por la alquimia soy capaz de enfrentarme a la realidad.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..ref: (I decided to face alchemy for all it is.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..dst: (Grazie all'alchimia sono capace di affrontare la realta'.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..src: Una vez dijiste «siempre podemos aprender nuevas cosas».
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..ref: "We can always learn new things." You're the one who said that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..dst: Una volta hai detto "possiamo sempre imparare cose nuove".

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..src: Sin embargo, espero que podamos ayudarte... siendo tus amigos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..ref: However, I do hope you will allow us to assist you ... as friends.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..dst: Tuttavia, spero che potremo aiutarti... in qualita' di amici.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..src: «Gracias, Nina, por venir a este mundo. Gracias por darme esperanza y por regalarme mi futuro.»
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..ref: "Thank you, Nina, for coming into this world. Thank you for giving me hope, and for giving me a future."
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..dst: "Grazie, Nina, per essere venuta in questo mondo. Grazie per avermi dato speranza e per avermi regalato un futuro."

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..src: No puedo seguir huyendo de mis errores y mis meteduras de pata. Debo esforzarme por mejorar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..ref: I can't turn away from my shortcomings and mistakes. That's something I still need to work on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..dst: Non posso continuare a fuggire dai miei errori e dalle mie gaffe. Devo impegnarmi per migliorare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..src: Quiero seguir adelante con nuestros planes. En gran medida, porque creo que los recuerdos son la base de la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..ref: I want to push forward. Push forward because I believe every memory is a part of alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..dst: Voglio andare avanti con i nostri piani. In gran parte, perche' credo che i ricordi siano la base dell'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..src: (Es un camino que nadie vino a mostrarme.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..ref: (This isn't a path that anyone showed me.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..dst: (E' un cammino che nessuno e' venuto a mostrarmi.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..src: (Es un camino que yo misma encontré y que decidí recorrer.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..ref: (This is the path that I found myself—the one I chose to walk.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..dst: (E' un cammino che ho trovato da sola e che ho deciso di percorrere.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..src: (Por eso...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..ref: (Which is why—)
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180..dst: (Per questo...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180a.ref: I'm sure you already know this, but alchemy is a forbidden technique.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180a.dst: Come gia' saprai, l'uso dell'alchimia e' proibito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_180b.dst: Grazie mille per il tuo aiuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: ¿Todavía sigues con vida? Vaya, eres una alquimista contemporánea bastante testaruda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: Still alive? Stubborn, aren't you, modern alchemist.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Sei ancora viva? Caspita, sei un'alchimista contemporanea piuttosto testarda.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: No hay nadie en este mundo más testarudo que tú.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: There's not a soul in the world who can be called more stubborn than you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Non c'e' nessuno al mondo piu' testardo di te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Ha pasado muchísimo tiempo y, sin embargo, sigues anclado al pasado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: Such an unbelieveable amount of time has passed, and yet you still cling to the past?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: E' trascorso tantissimo tempo e, tuttavia, continui ad aggrapparti al passato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: ¡Ya basta! Es hora de enfrentarte a la realidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: Enough. It's time to face reality!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Basta! E' ora di affrontare la realta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Ah, el vástago de Marina Friede.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: Ah, Marina Friede's legacy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Ah, la discendente di Marina Friede.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Vosotros sois los que os negáis a afrontar la realidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: You are the ones who need to face reality.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Siete voi che vi rifiutate di affrontare la realta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: ¿Acaso no lo veis? El potencial de la alquimia es ilimitado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: Don't you understand? Alchemy's potential is boundless.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Per caso non lo vedete? Il potenziale dell'alchimia e' illimitato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Ya es hora de que seáis conscientes de que el poder de la creación podría revolucionar el mundo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: It's time for you to realize the value that the power of creation has to revolutionize the world.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: E' ora che prendiate coscienza del fatto che il potere della creazione potrebbe rivoluzionare il mondo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Lo siento, pero eres el único que se cree esas tonterías.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: Sorry, but you're the only person left preachin' that stuff.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Mi dispiace, ma sei l'unico che crede a quelle sciocchezze.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Sé bueno y regresa a la tumba. Si quieres, hasta diremos unas palabras en tu honor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: Be good and scurry back to your grave. We'll even say a little prayer for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Fai il bravo e torna nella tua tomba. Se vuoi, diremo anche qualche parola in tuo onore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: ¿El único?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: The only person left?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: L'unico?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: El pueblo de Aladiss duerme dentro de esta crisálida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: The people of Aladiss sleep within this cocoon.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Il popolo di Aladiss dorme dentro questa crisalide.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Mientras exista la alquimia... mientras yo exista, el regreso de Aladiss es inevitable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: As long as alchemy exists ... As long as I exist, Aladiss's return is inevitable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Finche' esistera' l'alchimia... finche' io esistero', il ritorno di Aladiss e' inevitabile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Porque yo soy Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: Because I am Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Perche' io sono Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Nada se ha perdido: ni la tierra, ni los edificios, ni los ciudadanos. Yo restauraré nuestros ideales, nuestra historia y nuestra gloria.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: Nothing has been lost. No land, no buildings, no citizens. Our ideals, our history, our glory—I will restore it all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Nulla si e' perduto: ne' la terra, ne' gli edifici, ne' i cittadini. Io ripristinero' i nostri ideali, la nostra storia e la nostra gloria.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Es mi deber como emperador.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: As emperor, that is my duty.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: E' il mio dovere in quanto imperatore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: ¿Tu deber? ¡Nadie te ha pedido que hagas algo así!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: Your duty? No one asked you to do any of this!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Il tuo dovere? Nessuno ti ha chiesto di fare una cosa del genere!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: ¡Lo haces por ti mismo! ¿No ves todo el daño que has causado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: You're just claiming that yourself! Don't you realize how many problems you've caused?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Lo fai solo per te stesso! Non vedi tutto il danno che hai causato?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Isla tiene razón. Hablas de resucitar al pueblo, pero no te has parado a recapacitar sobre sus vidas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: She's right. You speak of resurrecting the people, but you can't even spare a thought for their lives.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Isla ha ragione. Parli di resuscitare il popolo, ma non ti sei mai soffermato a riflettere sulle loro vite.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Solo te importa recuperar una nación que tienes idealizada. Tus aspiraciones están basadas en tu propio egoísmo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: All you care about is bringing back your ideal nation. Everything you aspire to revolves around your selfishness.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Ti interessa soltanto recuperare una nazione che hai idealizzato. Le tue aspirazioni si basano sul tuo egoismo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Y ahora acabaremos con tus planes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: We're going to crush your plans, right here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: E adesso metteremo fine ai tuoi piani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: ¿De verdad os creéis capaces de tal cosa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: Do you truly think yourselves capable of doing so?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Credete davvero di essere capaci di una cosa del genere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: Please, stop adding more sins to the pile. You can't keep using alchemy to do whatever you want.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Por favor, deja de usar la alquimia para cometer más pecados. No puedes seguir aprovechándote de ella para tus caprichos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: As a Welleks ... I will stop you!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Per favore, smetti di usare l'alchimia per commettere altri peccati. Non puoi continuare a servirtene per i tuoi capricci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Yo... te detendré... ¡Por los Welleks!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: ... Insolent vermin.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Io... ti fermero'... Per i Welleks!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Qué bichito más insolente...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: Your incessant interference stops today.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Che verme insolente...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Hoy será la última vez que os interponéis en mi camino.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: I have no idea what is driving you to resurrect Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Oggi sara' l'ultima volta che vi mettete sul mio cammino.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: No sé por qué te empeñas en restaurar Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: But—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Non so perche' ti ostini a restaurare Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Hay cosas que se pierden y jamás se recuperan. Aunque seas capaz de usar la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: It doesn't matter if you have alchemy. The things we've lost can never be restored.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Ci sono cose che si perdono e che non si recuperano mai. Anche se sei capace di usare l'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Tu malograda Aladiss no es la misma que conocías.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: Your warped Aladiss is not the same as what it once was.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: La tua Aladiss deforme non e' la stessa di un tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: En el fondo lo sabes, ¿verdad? Por mucho que lo intentes, el pasado sigue estando en el pasado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: Deep down, you already know that, don't you? No matter what you do, the past will never be anything other than the past.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: In fondo lo sai, vero? Per quanto tu ci provi, il passato resta nel passato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Apenas has vivido un par de décadas y ya hablas como si lo supieras todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: You've lived for no more than twenty years, and yet you speak as though you know all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Hai vissuto appena un paio di decenni e gia' parli come se sapessi tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Si no lo comprendes, te lo mostraré...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: If you don't understand, then experience it firsthand—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Se non lo capisci, te lo mostrero'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: ¡Sé testigo del verdadero poder de la alquimia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: The true essence of alchemy!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Sii testimone del vero potere dell'alchimia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Alguien tan egoísta como tú no tiene derecho a usar la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: Someone as selfish as you has no right to use alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Qualcuno cosi' egoista come te non ha il diritto di usare l'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Por tu culpa, ahora está prohibida. Para que pueda sobrevivir en esta nueva era, no puedo permitir que sigas adelante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: Alchemy has been labeled taboo. In order for it to enter a new era, I can't let you keep doing whatever you want.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Per colpa tua, adesso e' proibita. Affinche' possa sopravvivere in questa nuova era, non posso permettere che tu vada avanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..src: Esto se acaba ahora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..ref: Let's end this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_190..dst: Ora finisce tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_200..src: Estaba dispuesto a llegar tan lejos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_200..ref: For him to create something like this ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_200..dst: Era disposto ad arrivare cosi' lontano...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_200..src: Ya no hay vuelta atrás para él.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_200..ref: He truly has passed the point of no return.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_200..dst: Per lui non c'e' piu' ritorno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_200..src: Sí. Este es un poder que jamás llegaréis a poseer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_200..ref: Yes. This is the power you all will never achieve.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_200..dst: Si'. Questo e' un potere che non arriverete mai a possedere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_200..src: El verdadero poder de la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_200..ref: Is the true power of alchemy.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_210..ref: My people! Lend me your strength!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_210..src: La crisálida donde selló los recuerdos de su pueblo. O eso ha dicho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_210..dst: La crisalide in cui ha sigillato i ricordi del suo popolo. O cosi' ha detto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_210..src: ¿Para qué va a usar los recuerdos?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_210..dst: Per cosa intende usare i ricordi?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_210..ref: The cocoon in which the people's memories were sealed. He said so himself.
He would even use their memories ...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_220..src: Las cosas que se pierden jamás se recuperan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_220..dst: Le cose che si perdono non si recuperano mai.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_220..src: Pero los sentimientos que han inundado nuestro corazón y nuestra alma...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_220..dst: Ma i sentimenti che hanno inondato il nostro cuore e la nostra anima...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_220..src: ¡No vivimos para quedarnos atrapados en el pasado y en los recuerdos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_220..dst: I ricordi che creiamo non servono a restare aggrappati al passato!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_220..src: ¡Los recuerdos nos sirven para avanzar hacia el futuro!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_220..ref: The things we've lost can never be restored.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_220..dst: Servono a guidarci verso il futuro!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_220..ref: But the feelings we've gained from them live on in our hearts—in our souls.
The memories we make aren't for clinging to the past!
They're for leading us into the future!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_230..src: ¿Podrás despertarte por la mañana sin la ayuda de Flammi?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_230..dst: Riuscirai a svegliarti al mattino senza l'aiuto di Flammi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_230..ref: Will you be able to wake up on your own without Flammi there?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_230..src: Juzga por ti misma qué es lo correcto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_230..ref: You won't lose your way anymore?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_230..dst: Giudica da te stessa cio' che e' giusto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_230..src: Tus acciones seguirán siendo parte de nuestra historia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_230..dst: Le tue azioni continueranno a far parte della nostra storia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_230..src: Lo bueno y lo malo. Lo grabaremos en nuestros corazones y seguiremos adelante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_230..ref: Learn how to judge what is right for yourself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_230..dst: Il buono e il cattivo. Li incideremo nei nostri cuori e andremo avanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_230..ref: Your actions will remain as history.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_230..dst: No... Non si perdera' mai... Io...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Después de informar sobre lo que le ocurrió a Basilius, nuestra investigación de la región de Lacuna llegó a su fin.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: With the submission of our report on what happened with Basilius, our investigation of the Lacuna region came to a close.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Dopo aver riferito cio' che e' accaduto a Basilius, la nostra ricerca sulla regione di Lacuna e' giunta alla fine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Al final, conseguimos limpiar todas las zonas de vínculo de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: We managed to finish cleaning up the manabound areas, too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Alla fine siamo riusciti a ripulire tutte le zone di legame del mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Y pusimos fin a los planes que se habían tramado desde las sombras en esta tierra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: Putting an end to the plans that had been secretly orchestrated in these lands.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: E abbiamo messo fine ai piani tramati nell'ombra in questa terra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Aunque Aladiss sigue plagada de misterios.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: Plenty of mysteries surrounding Aladiss remain, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Pero' Aladiss resta piena di misteri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Parece que algunos compañeros del equipo de investigación se quedarán por aquí para seguir trabajando...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: It sounds like some of the Research Team members are going to stay behind to continue the investigation ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Sembra che alcuni membri della squadra di ricerca restino qui per continuare a lavorare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Para nosotros, este capítulo de nuestra vida ha terminado. Hasta el jefe regresará a Eustella para entregar el último informe de la misión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: But for us, this chapter of our lives has come to an end. Even the chief is going back to Eustella to deliver his final investigation report.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Per noi, questo capitolo della nostra vita e' terminato. Perfino il capo tornera' a Eustella per consegnare l'ultimo rapporto della missione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Confío en que la alquimia empezará a verse con otros ojos. Confío en que se sepa la verdad sobre lo que sucedió en este país.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: I'm confident that a real understanding of alchemy will start to spread. And people will come to know what really happened in this country.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Spero che l'alchimia inizi a essere vista con altri occhi. Spero che si conosca la verita' su cio' che e' accaduto in questo paese.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Sin embargo, solo el tiempo dirá si cambiarán de opinión cuando llegue ese día.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: When that does happen, will people's feelings toward alchemy change? Only time will tell.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Tuttavia, solo il tempo dira' se cambieranno idea quando arrivera' quel giorno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Regreso a Duerer. Quiero asegurarme de que nuestros esfuerzos por recuperarnos del Desastre siguen su curso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: I'll be returning to Duerer. I need to make sure that disaster recovery efforts are progressing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Torno a Duerer. Voglio assicurarmi che i nostri sforzi per ripenderci dal Disastro continuino il loro corso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Lo entiendo... Un momento, ¿qué pasa con Isla?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: I see ... Wait, what about Isla?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Capisco... Un momento, e Isla?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Creo que me quedaré un poco más para documentar todo lo que hemos visto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: I think I'm gonna stay here for a little while and document things.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Penso che rimarro' ancora un po' per documentare tutto quello che abbiamo visto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Al fin y al cabo, debe quedarse alguien que haya sido testigo de todo lo que pasó con los mutantes y con Basilius.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: After the mutants and Basilius and everything else we saw, at least one person who witnessed it all firsthand needs to stay.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Dopotutto, deve restare qualcuno che sia stato testimone di tutto cio' che e' successo con i mutanti e con Basilius.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Sí. Siento que haya recaído en ti esa responsabilidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: Right. I'm sorry that fell to you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Si'. Mi dispiace che quella responsabilita' sia ricaduta su di te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: No pasa nada. Es mi trabajo. Además, me pega más que ir por ahí derrotando malvados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: It's completely fine. It's my job, after all. And anyway, I'm sure it'll suit me better than fighting did.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Non fa nulla. E' il mio lavoro. Inoltre, mi si addice piu' che andare in giro a sconfiggere i malvagi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Yumia, Nina. Venid conmigo un momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: I—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Yumia, Nina. Venite con me un momento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Tengo entendido que el Gobierno os mantendrá vigiladas, pero quiero que sepáis que habéis logrado muchas cosas. Es imposible que os juzguen con dureza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: Yumia, Nina. I want you to come with me for a while.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Ho capito che il Governo vi terra' d'occhio, ma voglio che sappiate che avete realizzato molte cose. E' impossibile che vi giudichino duramente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Sin embargo, antes de que os marchéis, quiero encargaros algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: You'll likely be placed under government observation, but you've achieved something incredible. I don't think they'll see you in a bad light.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Tuttavia, prima che partiate, voglio affidarvi qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: El Vial de recuerdos todopoderoso...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: However, before you leave here, I need you to take care of something.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: La Fiala della Memoria onnipotente...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Sí, es el Vial de recuerdos que dejó Basilius. Es un artículo valioso y no debe caer en las manos equivocadas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: The Almighty Memory Vial ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Si', e' la Fiala della Memoria che ha lasciato Basilius. E' un oggetto prezioso e non deve cadere nelle mani sbagliate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Yumia, como alquimista que ha participado en la investigación, quiero entregártelo a ti. ¿Qué te gustaría hacer con él?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: Yes, the all-powerful Memory Vial that Basilius left behind. A valuable item to be sure, but one that poses an immense threat.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Yumia, in quanto alchimista che ha partecipato alla ricerca, voglio consegnartelo a te. Cosa vorresti farne?

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Tienes razón, este Vial de recuerdos contiene testimonios sobre el pasado muy valiosos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: Yumia, as an alchemist who took part in the investigation of this land, I'm thinking of entrusting its fate to you. What do you want to do?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Hai ragione, questa Fiala della Memoria contiene testimonianze sul passato molto preziose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Pero no podemos negar que es demasiado peligroso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: It's true, this Memory Vial may contain some very valuable clues to the past.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Ma non possiamo negare che sia troppo pericoloso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Si lo conservamos tal cual, podrían repetirse los errores del pasado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: But more than that, it's far too dangerous.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Se lo conserviamo cosi' com'e', gli errori del passato potrebbero ripetersi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Por eso, creo que lo mejor es destruirlo. No es una herramienta a la que debamos tener acceso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: If left intact, it could lead to even more atrocities.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Per questo credo che la cosa migliore sia distruggerlo. Non e' uno strumento a cui dovremmo avere accesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Entendido. Respeto tu decisión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: Which is why I want to destroy it. This isn't a tool we should have access to.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Capito. Rispetto la tua decisione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: La alquimia puede convertirse en cualquier cosa. El resultado depende de quién la utilice.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: Understood. I'll respect your decision.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: L'alchimia puo' diventare qualsiasi cosa. Il risultato dipende da chi la utilizza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Habrá quien use la alquimia para correr riesgos innecesarios, como Basilius.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: Alchemy contains infinite possibilities. But how those possibilities are drawn out depends on the person.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Ci sara' chi usera' l'alchimia per correre rischi inutili, come Basilius.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Si queremos convertir la alquimia en un arte que mejore la vida de la gente, necesitamos garantizar que todo este poder se usa con responsabilidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: There are people who use alchemy to take dangerous risks, like Basilius.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Se vogliamo fare dell'alchimia un'arte che migliori la vita della gente, dobbiamo garantire che tutto questo potere venga usato in modo responsabile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: No obstante, no podemos controlar el Vial de recuerdos todopoderoso. Por eso he tomado esta decisión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: In order to turn alchemy into something that improves everyone's lives, we need to make sure that anything too powerful is properly managed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Tuttavia, non possiamo controllare la Fiala della Memoria onnipotente. Per questo ho preso questa decisione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: De conservarlo, sería cuestión de tiempo que se desate otro desastre. De eso no me cabe duda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: But the Almighty Memory Vial isn't a tool that we can manage, which is why I made the decision I did.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Se lo conservassimo, sarebbe solo questione di tempo prima che si scateni un altro disastro. Di questo non ho dubbi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Será complicado, pero me gustaría descifrar su contenido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: Letting it be would be inviting future disaster. I have no doubt about that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Sara' complicato, ma vorrei decifrarne il contenuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Los recuerdos que alberga podrían ayudarnos a resolver los misterios que no hemos logrado descifrar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: It'll be a challenge, but I want to try to decipher its contents.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: I ricordi che custodisce potrebbero aiutarci a risolvere i misteri che non siamo riusciti a decifrare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Y, si queremos que todo el mundo se beneficie de la alquimia, también debemos comprender qué riesgos entraña.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: The memories inside of it could end up being the key to uncovering mysteries we haven't even discovered yet.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: E, se vogliamo che tutti possano beneficiare dell'alchimia, dobbiamo anche capire quali rischi comporta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: ¿Hasta dónde llegó Aladiss? Si no lo sabemos, estamos condenados a correr el mismo destino.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: And if we want alchemy to really benefit everyone, we also need to understand exactly what kind of dangers accompany it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Fino a dove arrivo' Aladiss? Se non lo sappiamo, siamo condannati alla stessa sorte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Me encanta la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: Just how far did Aladiss go? Without knowing, we're doomed to end up on the same path they took.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Adoro l'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Tiene la capacidad de mejorar la vida de las personas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: I love alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Ha la capacita' di migliorare la vita delle persone.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Espero que un día todo el mundo pueda tratar con este poder sin correr riesgos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: Alchemy has the power to improve everyone's lives.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Spero che un giorno tutti possano gestire questo potere senza correre rischi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Yo estoy limitada por mis habilidades... Pero quiero hacer todo lo que esté en mi mano, por muy pequeño que sea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: I hope a day will come where everyone can safely interact with alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Io sono limitata dalle mie capacita'... Ma voglio fare tutto cio' che e' in mio potere, per quanto piccolo sia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: No te olvides de nada. No podemos responsabilizarnos de las cosas que dejes aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: There's only so much that I can do by myself ... But I want to do whatever I can, little by little.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Non dimenticare niente. Non possiamo occuparci delle cose che lasci qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: ¡Eh! Aparta tus manazas de eso. ¡Son mi recompensa!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: Make sure you take everything you need. We can't be responsible for anything you accidentally leave behind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Ehi! Giu' le zampe da quella cosa. E' la mia ricompensa!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: ¿Todo esto es tuyo? Espero que puedas cargar con todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: Hey, keep your hands away from that. Those are my spoils!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: E' tutto tuo? Spero che tu riesca a portare tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Eh... S-si quieres, puedo ayudarte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: You seriously collected this much stuff? Make sure to carry it all by yourself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Ehm... S-se vuoi, posso aiutarti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: ¡No lo mimes, Lenja!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: U-um ... Do you want me to help you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Non viziarlo, Lenja!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: Me voy adelantando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: Don't coddle him, Lenja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Vado avanti io.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: En fin, ¡una nueva aventura nos espera! Vamos, Flam...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: Doctor ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Beh, ci aspetta una nuova avventura! Andiamo, Flam...

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: He juzgado por mí misma y creo que es lo correcto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: I'll head out first.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Ho giudicato da me e credo che sia la cosa giusta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: ¡Venga, Yumia! ¡O nos iremos sin ti!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: All right, time to set out on our next adventure. Let's go, Flamm—
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Dai, Yumia! O andiamo senza di te!

eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..src: ¡Ya voooy!
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..ref: This is what I think is right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_mm08_240..dst: Arrivooo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..ref: Bring the boxes with weapons over here!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..dst: Portate le casse di armamento qui!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..src: ¡Las raciones de comida, por aquí! ¡Con cuidado!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..ref: Food supplies over here! No need to rush!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..dst: Le razioni di cibo, da queste parti! Con attenzione!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..src: ¡Vaya!... ¿Cómo han preparado todo esto en tan poco tiempo? ¡Creía que nos acababan de dar el visto bueno para construir la base!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..ref: Whoa ... How did things get set up so quickly?! Didn't we just get the OK to build a base?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..dst: Caspita!... Come avete preparato tutto questo in cosi' poco tempo? Credevo ci avessero appena dato il via libera per costruire la base!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..src: Tal vez empezaron con los preparativos antes de recibir el permiso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..ref: Maybe preparations were already underway even before we got permission?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..dst: Forse hanno iniziato i preparativi prima di ricevere il permesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..src: Ja, ja, ja, ¡correcto! El equipo de investigación tiene que adelantarse a los acontecimientos, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..ref: Hahaha, precisely. The Research Team needs to be prepared for anything, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..dst: Ha, ha, ha, esatto! La Squadra di Ricerca deve saper anticipare gli eventi, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..src: Controlaremos la exploración de la región de Syvashi desde aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..ref: We'll be running our exploration of the Sivash region from here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..dst: Gestiremo l'esplorazione della regione di Syvashi da qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..src: No lo habríamos conseguido sin la alquimia de Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..ref: Yumia's ability as an alchemist will be pivotal in achieving results here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..dst: Non ce l'avremmo fatta senza l'alchimia di Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..src: Pero todos sois igual de importantes para nuestro cometido. ¡Os deseo mucha suerte!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..ref: And the rest of you are just as important to our success. Best of luck.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_010..dst: Ma siete tutti importanti quanto lei per il nostro compito. Vi auguro tanta fortuna!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_020..src: El equipo de investigación lo llama Santuario del Rezo. Pero su finalidad es una incógnita.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_020..ref: The Research Team has been calling it a Shrine of Prayer, but we still don't know what its purpose is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_020..dst: La squadra di ricerca lo chiama Santuario della Preghiera. Ma il suo scopo e' un mistero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_030..src: Nunca he visto un material como este... ¿Servirá tal vez como herramienta?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_030..ref: I've never seen an ingredient like this before ... Or, wait, is this a tool?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_030..dst: Non ho mai visto un materiale del genere... Servira' forse come strumento?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_030..src: No sé cómo funciona, pero parece que el maná de su alrededor reacciona al activarse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_030..ref: I don't get how it works, but it seems to be activating the mana around it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_030..dst: Non so come funziona, ma sembra che il mana intorno ad esso reagisca quando si attiva.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_030..src: ¡Se me ocurren mil cosas que hacer con esto!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_030..ref: This might be useful for a bunch of different things!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_030..dst: Mi vengono in mente un sacco di cose da farci!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_030..src: Ajá. En ese caso, estudiaremos todos los santuarios que veamos en nuestros viajes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_030..ref: Huh. In that case, let's make sure to check any other shrines we come across!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_030..dst: Capisco. Allora studieremo tutti i santuari che incontreremo durante i nostri viaggi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_040..src: Pero esta puerta no quiere abrirse... ¿Se os ocurre el modo de entrar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_040..ref: But it doesn't seem like the door will open ... Can we get it open somehow?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_040..dst: Ma la porta non sembra volersi aprire... Come possiamo fare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_050..src: ¿Es un almacén de materiales de la civilización pasada?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_050..ref: Is this a materials storehouse from the past civilization or something?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_050..dst: E' un magazzino di materiali della civilta' passata?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_050..src: Es posible. Me siento un poco obligada a darles el uso que se merecen.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_050..ref: It's possible. Let's put the stuff that was left here to good use.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_050..dst: Puo' darsi. Mi sento in dovere di usare al meglio cio' che e' stato lasciato qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_060..src: Increíble, cuántos restos. ¡Debió de ser un edificio gigantesco!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_060..ref: These ruins must have been a pretty big building.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_060..dst: Incredibile, quanti resti! Dev'essere stato un edificio gigantesco!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_060..src: Tal vez contenga información sobre la civilización pasada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_060..ref: There may be some traces of the past civilization left here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_060..dst: Forse qui ci sono tracce della civilta' passata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_060..src: ¿Echamos un vistazo? ¡Podríamos hacer el descubrimiento del siglo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_060..ref: Let's look around. Hopefully we'll find something.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_060..dst: Che ne dite di dare un'occhiata? Potremmo fare la scoperta del secolo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_070..src: Si descubrimos ruinas similares en el futuro, no sería mala idea detenernos a estudiarlas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_070..ref: We're likely to encounter similar ruins in the future. Let's be sure to explore any that we find.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_070..dst: In futuro potremmo imbatterci in altre rovine simili. Assicuriamoci di esplorarle.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_070..src: ¡Hecho! Así nos haremos expertos en la civilización pasada. Apuesto a que muchas de estas cosas podrían sernos útiles.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_070..ref: Yeah. They give us good hints about the past civilization, and I bet we'll find useful things that were left behind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_070..dst: D'accordo! Cosi' diventeremo esperti della civilta' passata. Scommetto che molte delle cose che troveremo ci saranno utili.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_070..src: ¡Sí! Las expediciones a los restos arqueológicos son tan importantes para el equipo de investigación como el resto de las tareas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_070..ref: Yup! Investigating places like this is another part of the Research Team's job!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_070..dst: Si'! Le spedizioni nei siti archeologici sono importanti per la Squadra di Ricerca quanto tutte le altre attivita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_080..src: Estaba preguntando por el néctar de Alstahlia. Se me ha ocurrido que a lo mejor podemos usarlo de alguna manera durante la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_080..ref: I was asking about Alstahlia nectar. I thought maybe it could be used during our investigation somehow.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_080..dst: Stavo chiedendo del nettare di Alstahlia. Pensavo che magari potesse tornare utile in qualche modo durante le nostre indagini.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_080..src: He aprendido a hacer una botella para almacenarlo, pero no sirve para nada. No voy a conseguir ese valioso néctar en la vida...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_080..ref: I was able to learn how to make a bottle to store the stuff, but it's no good. There's no way I'll get my hands on that precious nectar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_080..dst: Ho imparato a fare una bottiglia per conservarlo, ma non serve a niente. Non riusciro' mai a mettere le mani su quel prezioso nettare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_080..src: ¿Ah, sí? ¿Podrías explicarme cómo se hace la botella?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_080..ref: Oh, really? Would you mind telling me how to make the bottle?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_080..dst: Ah, davvero? Ti dispiacerebbe spiegarmi come si fa la bottiglia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_080..src: (Ya veo, esto es lo que ha usado Lenja.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_080..ref: (I see, so Lenja was using this.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_080..dst: (Capisco, quindi e' questo che usava Lenja.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_080..src: Ah, es verdad. Puedes explorar el interior de las zonas de vínculo de maná. Hay bastantes probabilidades de conseguir néctar ahí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_080..ref: Oh, that's right. You explore inside of the manabound areas, which means there are plenty of chances for you to collect the nectar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_080..dst: Ah, gia'. Puoi esplorare l'interno delle zone permeate di mana, quindi hai parecchie occasioni di raccogliere il nettare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_080..src: Ya, si supiera hacer esas botellas, quizá podría usar el néctar como energía alternativa provisional.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_080..ref: Yes, if I knew how to make those bottles, I might be able to use the nectar as a temporary energy substitute.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_080..dst: Si', se sapessi come fare quelle bottiglie, forse potrei usare il nettare come sostituto temporaneo dell'energia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_090..src: ¡Lista! Si me topo con alguna Alstahlia durante la investigación, puedo usar esto para guardar un poco de néctar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_090..ref: It's finished! If I come across any Alstahlia during the investigation, I can use this and store some nectar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_090..dst: E' pronta! Se durante le indagini mi imbattero' in un'Alstahlia, potro' usarla per raccogliere un po' di nettare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_090..src: Qué bien. Me alegro de que la información haya servido para algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_090..ref: That's great to hear. I'm glad that information didn't go to waste.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_090..dst: Che bello! Sono felice che quelle informazioni siano state utili.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_090..src: Gracias por tu ayuda. Con esto, todo debería ser más sencillo. Aunque no ha resuelto el problema de conseguir el néctar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_090..ref: Thank you for your help. With this, things should go much smoother. Though, I didn't solve your problem of getting the nectar ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_090..dst: Grazie per l'aiuto. Con questo, dovrebbe andare tutto molto piu' liscio. Anche se non ho risolto il problema di procurarti il nettare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_090..src: Ah, bueno. Es que no queremos molestar a los Welleks con el tema de las Alstahlias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_090..ref: Oh well. We don't want to cause any trouble for the Welleks regarding Alstahlia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_090..dst: Pazienza. Non vogliamo creare problemi ai Wellek per via delle Alstahlia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_090..src: Puede que no sea posible ahora mismo, pero, a medida que recopilemos información, seguro que conseguimos avanzar en la investigación. Dejémoslo para más adelante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_090..ref: It might not be possible right now, but as we keep gathering information, I'm sure we'll be able to advance our research. We'll just leave it to the future for now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_090..dst: Forse per ora non e' possibile, ma continuando a raccogliere informazioni riusciremo di sicuro a portare avanti la ricerca. Per ora, ci penseremo piu' avanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_100..src: Percibo que hay un maná poderoso en este cristal...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_100..ref: I sense powerful mana in this crystal ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_100..dst: Avverto una potente presenza di mana in questo cristallo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_100..src: Parece que el maná que se encuentra en la tierra se ha condensado mucho y se ha cristalizado de esta forma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_100..ref: It appears that the mana stored within the earth has been tightly condensed and crystallized into this form.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_100..dst: Sembra che il mana presente nella terra si sia condensato e cristallizzato in questa forma.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_100..src: Esto significa que quizá podemos sacar algo útil de todo esto. Vamos a echar un vistazo más a fondo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_100..ref: Which means I might be able to gather something useful from it. Let's take a closer look.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_100..dst: Questo significa che forse possiamo ricavarne qualcosa di utile. Diamo un'occhiata piu' da vicino.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_110..src: ¡Vaya, ha vuelto el equipo de avanzada que despejó la zona de vínculo de maná!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_110..ref: Oh, seems like the advance team that cleared away the manabound area has returned!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_110..dst: Oh, sembra che la squadra d'avanguardia che ha liberato la zona satura di mana sia tornata!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_110..src: Hola, hola. ¿Vais a salir a investigar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_110..ref: Hello there. Are you heading out to investigate?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_110..src: Sí. Gracias a todos por expandir nuestra zona de operación, tenemos mucho que hacer. Estamos a punto de salir a investigar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_110..ref: Yes. Thanks to you all widening the area in which we can operate, we have a lot to do. We're about to go investigate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_110..dst: Si'. Grazie a voi, che avete ampliato l'area in cui possiamo operare, abbiamo un sacco da fare. Stiamo per andare a investigare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_110..src: Eso me recuerda que, de aquí en adelante, es posible que os encontréis a otros miembros del equipo mientras exploráis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_110..ref: That reminds me, from here on you might run in to other team members while out exploring.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_110..dst: A proposito, d'ora in poi potreste incontrare altri membri della squadra durante l'esplorazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_110..src: Si los veis preocupados o necesitan ayuda, no dudéis en echarles una mano. Estamos juntos en esto, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_110..ref: If they seem troubled or in need of assistance, please don't hesitate to lend a hand. We're all in this together, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_110..dst: Se sembrano preoccupati o hanno bisogno di aiuto, non esitate a dar loro una mano. Siamo tutti sulla stessa barca, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_110..src: Lo pillo. Haremos todo lo que podamos para ayudar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_110..ref: Understood. We'll do our best to help in any way we can.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_110..dst: Capito. Faremo del nostro meglio per aiutare in ogni modo possibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_120..src: Si quieres explorar, lo mejor sería que primero repusieras tu energía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_120..ref: If you wish to explore, it is highly recommended that you first replenish your energy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_120..dst: Se vuoi esplorare, ti consiglio vivamente di recuperare prima le energie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_120..ref: But ... just who made this thing?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_120..dst: Ma... chi ha costruito questa cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_120..src: Sirve para reponer la energía, pero creo que originalmente tenía otro uso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_120..ref: It is useful for energy replenishment, but the original use may have been different.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_120..dst: E' utile per recuperare le energie, ma forse in origine serviva a qualcos'altro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_120..src: Supongo que debería aprovechar cualquier cosa que sea de ayuda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_120..ref: Well, I guess I should take whatever help I can get.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_120..dst: Beh... credo che dovrei approfittare di qualsiasi aiuto riesca a trovare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: Hemos ido en dirección este, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: Well, we went east, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Beh, siamo andati a est, ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: Parece que hasta colocar una escalera nos llevaría su tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: It looks like even putting up a ladder would take some time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Sembra che ci vorra' un po' persino per montare una scala.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: Oye, Yumia, ¿en serio pretendes que escalemos este muro?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: Hey Yumia, are you seriously expectin' us to climb this wall?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Ehi, Yumia, ti aspetti davvero che scaliamo questo muro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: No, no os preocupéis por eso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: No, don't worry about that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: No, non preoccupatevi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: Este muro... Parece de piedra, pero tiene algo raro. Es como si fuera falso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: This wall ... It looks like rock, but something is off about it. Like it's fake.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Questo muro... Sembra di pietra, ma c'e' qualcosa che non va. Come se fosse finto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: ¡¿Falso?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: Fake?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Finto?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: ¿A q-qué te refieres?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: Wh-what do you mean?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: C-che vuoi dire?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: La afluencia de maná de la copa de Turm Pérgrica se ha desviado artificialmente para que atraviese el muro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: The flow of mana from the top of Pergrica Turm has been routed to pass through this wall.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Il Flusso di Mana dalla cima della Torre Pergrica e' stato deviato artificialmente per farlo passare attraverso questo muro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: ¿Para que lo atraviese? ¿Quieres decir que el camino continúa por dentro del muro de piedra?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: Pass through? Wait, are you saying that the path continues inside of this stone wall?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Farlo passare? Aspetta, vuoi dire che il percorso continua all'interno di questo muro di pietra?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: Seguramente se instaló para sellar el exterior sin bloquear la afluencia de maná que iba hacia la capital.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: It was probably installed as a means of sealing the outside while still allowing for mana to flow to the capital.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Probabilmente e' stato installato per sigillare l'esterno, permettendo comunque al mana di raggiungere la capitale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: Chist. Seguro que lo hizo esa maldita alimaña. Todo este esfuerzo para proteger un lugar al que casi nadie accedía...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: Tch. That shady beastman probably did this. All this work for a place hardly anyone ever steps foot in.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Tsk. Dev'essere stato quel maledetto uomo-bestia. Tutto questo lavoro per un posto dove quasi nessuno mette piede...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: Si se ha ocultado de forma artificial, a lo mejor hay alguna manera de desbloquearlo, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: If it's artificially hidden, maybe it can be unlocked somehow?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Se e' stato nascosto artificialmente, magari c'e' un modo per sbloccarlo, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: Buena idea. Vamos a echar un vistazo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: Good idea. Let's check around.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Buona idea. Diamo un'occhiata in giro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: No hay nada que parezca fuera de lugar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: There's nothing that stands out around here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Non c'e' niente che salti all'occhio qui intorno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: Tampoco me sorprende. No van a dejarlo a plena vista, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: Well, that's not too surprisin'. It wouldn't just be layin' out in the open.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Beh, non mi sorprende. Non l'avrebbero lasciato li' in bella vista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: Y pensar que Corleonis seguiría dando guerra hasta después de derrotarlo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: To think Corleonis would be giving us trouble even after we defeated him ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: E pensare che Corleonis continua a darci problemi anche dopo averlo sconfitto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: ¿Ahora qué hacemos? ¿Pedimos ayuda a los demás miembros del equipo para instalar una escalera?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: Wh-what now? Should we go ask the other Research Team members for help setting up a ladder?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: E-e adesso? Chiediamo aiuto agli altri membri della Squadra di Ricerca per montare una scala?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: Tendríamos que montar un andamio y todo... Tardaríamos un buen rato en avanzar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: Then we'd have to set up a scaffold and whatnot ... We'd be stopped in our tracks for a while.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Dovremmo montare un'impalcatura e tutto il resto... Ci fermeremmo per un bel po'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: Flammi, ¿puedes volar hasta arriba y tirarnos una cuerda o algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: Flammi, can't you fly up there and drop down a rope for us or somethin'?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Flammi, non puoi volare lassu' e calarci una corda o qualcosa del genere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: Flammi no está diseñada para transportar cargas que la superan en peso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: Flammi is not designed to haul loads that exceed Flammi's own weight.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Flammi non e' progettata per trasportare carichi che superano il peso di Flammi.
