eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: Ufff... Justo cuando más falta nos hacía...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: *Sigh* Right when it matters the most ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: *Sospira* Proprio quando ci serviva di piu'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: ¿A qué te refieres con «Justo cuando más falta nos hacía»? Solicito que se termine la oración.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: What do you mean by, "Right when it matters the most"? Requesting that you finish your sentence.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Cosa intendi con "Proprio quando ci serviva di piu'"? Richiedo che tu finisca la frase.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: Ah, ya... Hablando de buscar cosas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: ... Oh, right. If we're searching for something ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: ... Oh, giusto. A proposito di cercare qualcosa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: ¿Ese es el dispositivo de rastreo de maná que usamos cuando desapareció Lenja?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: Is that the mana tracking device we used when Lenja went missing?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: E' il dispositivo di tracciamento del mana che abbiamo usato quando e' scomparsa Lenja?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: Sí. Tengo el presentimiento de que esta función de camuflaje está alimentada por maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: Yup. I have a hunch this camouflage function runs on mana.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Si'. Ho il presentimento che questa funzione mimetica sia alimentata dal mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: Si seguimos el rastro, es probable que encontremos los controles.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: If we follow the trail, we should be able to find where the controls are.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Se seguiamo la traccia, probabilmente troveremo i comandi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: ¡Merece la pena intentarlo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: I think that's worth a try!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Vale la pena tentare!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: Humm, me gustaría volver a disculparme por lo de aquella vez...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: U-um, I'd like to apologize again about back then ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: E-ehm, vorrei scusarmi ancora per quella volta...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: No te preocupes, es cosa del pasado. ¡Además, parece que este cacharro va a ser de utilidad una vez más!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: Don't worry, that's all in the past. Besides, it looks like this will come in handy for us again!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Non preoccuparti, ormai e' acqua passata. E poi, a quanto pare, questo aggeggio ci tornera' utile ancora una volta!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: Muy bien, Flammi, contamos contigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: Okay Flammi, we're counting on you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Bene, Flammi, contiamo su di te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..src: Flammi se encarga.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..ref: Leave it to Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_130..dst: Lascia fare a Flammi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_140..src: Parece que este dispositivo está interfiriendo en la afluencia de maná... ¡Deben de ser los controles!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_140..ref: This device seems to be interfering with the flow of mana ... It must be the controls!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_140..dst: Sembra che questo dispositivo interferisca con il flusso di mana... Devono essere i comandi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_140..src: Todo gracias al poder de la asistente autómata superespecializada en la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_140..ref: This is the power of a super-high-spec independent survey-assistance device.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_140..dst: Tutto merito della capacita' di assistenza alle ricerche superavanzata dell'automa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_140..ref: I get it, I get it ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_140..src: El camuflaje debería haber desaparecido. Vamos a ver si podemos seguir avanzando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_140..ref: The camouflage should be gone now. Let's go back and see if we can continue through!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_140..dst: Il camuffamento dovrebbe essere sparito. Torniamo indietro e vediamo se possiamo proseguire!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_150..ref: Wow! There really is a path!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_150..src: Parece que el maná se suministra directamente a la capital de Calumna por esta ruta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_150..ref: Mana seems to be directly supplied to the capital city of Calumna via this pathway.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_150..dst: Sembra che il mana venga fornito direttamente alla capitale di Calumna attraverso questo passaggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_150..src: Me gustaría saber qué tipo de tecnología se usaría para crear un muro como ese...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_150..ref: I'm curious what sort of technology could have<CR>made a wall like that ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_150..dst: Mi piacerebbe sapere quale tecnologia serva per creare un muro del genere...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_150..src: Yo tampoco entiendo cómo funciona exactamente. Pero lo que sí sé es que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_150..ref: I don't really understand exactly how it works either. But I do know this ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_150..dst: Neanch'io capisco esattamente come funzioni. Ma so che...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_150..src: La persona que nos aguarda tiene la capacidad de controlar la tecnología de esa manera.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_150..ref: The one waiting ahead of us is someone who can control technology like that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_150..dst: La persona che ci aspetta piu' avanti e' in grado di controllare una tecnologia simile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_150..src: Tienes razón. Debemos estar en guardia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_150..ref: You're right. We need to be on guard.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_150..dst: Hai ragione. Dobbiamo stare in guardia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_150..src: Sigamos adelante. Por fin hemos llegado al esperado objetivo del equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_150..ref: Let's keep going. We've finally arrived at the Research Team's long-awaited goal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_150..dst: Andiamo avanti. Finalmente siamo arrivati all'obiettivo tanto atteso della Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_160..src: Las flores de Alstahlia del suelo han perdido la energía...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_160..ref: There are Alstahlia flowers with the energy taken out of them on the ground ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms01_160..dst: A terra ci sono dei fiori di Alstahlia a cui e' stata sottratta l'energia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_010..ref: Hmm ... I wonder what would suit her ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_010..src: ¿Te ayudo con algo, Isla? ¿Tengo algo en el pelo?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_010..ref: Can I help you, Isla? Is there something in my hair?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_010..dst: Posso aiutarti, Isla? Ho qualcosa tra i capelli?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_010..src: ¡Eso es! ¡Dos trenzas a los lados! ¡Y podrían terminar en unos rizos monos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_010..ref: Ooh, that's it! Braids on each side, set into wavy curls at the ends!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_010..dst: Ecco! Due trecce ai lati! E poi potrebbero finire con dei bei boccoli!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_010..ref: W-wavy curls? Is that some kind of spell?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_010..src: No, mejor no. ¿Y si probamos con un peinado más maduro? Quizás, con un recogido elegante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_010..ref: Wait, no. Maybe a more mature look with a neat bun would be better?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_010..dst: No, aspetta. Forse starebbe meglio un look piu' maturo, con uno chignon elegante?
Ehila'? Isla? ... Non c'e' niente da fare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_020..src: Oye, Yumia, ¿cómo llevas tus diarios de investigación?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_020..ref: Say, Yumia, have you been keeping up with your research journals?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_020..dst: Senti, Yumia, stai tenendo aggiornati i tuoi diari di ricerca?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_020..src: Eso no está bien. Escribir los diarios es parte de nuestro trabajo. Debemos recordar que... ¡Eh! ¿Me estás escuchando?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_020..ref: Kind of isn't good enough. Writing in your journal is part of the job. You must be diligent about—Hey! Are you even listening?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_020..dst: Piu' o meno non basta. Tenere un diario fa parte del lavoro. Devi essere diligente... Ehi! Mi stai ascoltando?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_020..src: ¿Sabes qué he estado pensando? Que cuando te pones así, pareces un padre, Viktor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_020..ref: You know, I've thought this for a while, but that part of you is pretty dad-like, Viktor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_020..dst: Sai, e' da un po' che ci penso, ma quando fai cosi' sembri proprio un papa', Viktor.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_020..src: Entonces, ¿podríamos decir que, con esa actitud, estás en tu fase rebelde?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_020..ref: ... Then, judging by your attitude, I guess I'm dealing with your rebellious phase?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_020..dst: ... Allora, dal tuo atteggiamento direi che sei nella fase ribelle?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_020..src: ¡Qué rápido te has metido en el papel!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_020..ref: Ah, so he's accepting the dad role ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_020..dst: Ah, quindi si e' preso il ruolo del papa'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_030..src: ¿Eh? Juraría haber visto algo detrás de ti, Rutger...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_030..ref: Huh? I swear I just saw something behind you, Rutger ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_030..dst: Eh? Giurerei di aver visto qualcosa dietro di te, Rutger...
C-che?! ... Ehi, qui non c'e' niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_030..ref: Oh, sorry. I guess I was seeing things.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_030..src: ¿A qué viene meterme ese susto en el cuerpo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_030..ref: What's your problem, surprisin' me like that?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_030..dst: Che ti prende? Mi hai fatto prendere un colpo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_040..src: Uf... Últimamente me noto muy cansada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_040..ref: Ugh ... I just can't seem to shake off my fatigue lately.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_040..dst: Uf... Ultimamente non riesco proprio a scrollarmi di dosso la stanchezza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_040..src: ¿Te preparo un té de hierbas? Mejora la circulación y te ayudará a recuperar las fuerzas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_040..ref: Would you like to try some herbal tea? It helps improve circulation and can make it easier to recover.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_040..dst: Vuoi provare un te' alle erbe? Aiuta la circolazione e puo' favorire il recupero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_040..src: ¡Oh, eso sería estupendo! A veces se me olvida lo mucho que entiendes de té, Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_040..ref: Oh, that would be great! I almost forgot that you're really passionate about tea, Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_040..dst: Oh, sarebbe fantastico! Mi ero quasi dimenticata che sei una vera appassionata di te', Nina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_040..src: ¡Es que me encantan! Llevo un tiempo obsesionada con las mezclas de hierbas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_040..ref: I am! I've been particularly focused on herbal blends lately.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_040..dst: E' che mi piacciono tantissimo! Ultimamente mi sono fissata con le miscele di erbe.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_040..src: Hay un té para todo: para mejorar la circulación, para aliviar el cansancio, para tener suerte en el amor...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_040..ref: From improving circulation and easing fatigue, to ensuring success in love and fortune—I have a tea for everything!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_040..dst: C'e' un te' per tutto: per migliorare la circolazione, alleviare la stanchezza, avere fortuna in amore...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_040..src: Vaya, no tenía ni... Espera, espera. No estarás preparando nada raro, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_040..ref: Wow, I had no—Wait. You're not mixing in anything weird, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_040..dst: Wow, non ne avevo idea... Aspetta, non ci metti dentro niente di strano, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_050..src: Lenja, a ti te gustaba hacer punto, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_050..ref: Lenja, you said your hobby was knitting, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_050..dst: Lenja, ti piaceva lavorare a maglia, giusto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_050..src: Bueno... sí. Me gusta ver cómo mis creaciones van tomando forma...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_050..ref: Um, well ... Yes. I just love seeing the way things take shape as I keep knitting away ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_050..dst: Beh... si'. Adoro vedere le cose prendere forma mentre lavoro a maglia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_050..src: Aunque la última vez que intenté hacerme un bolsito, me dejé llevar y acabé haciendo uno enorme.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_050..ref: But the last time I knitted a pouch back home, I got so carried away that I ended up making it far too big ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_050..dst: Pero' l'ultima volta che ho provato a fare una borsetta, mi sono lasciata prendere la mano e ne ho fatta una enorme.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_050..src: Ya, te entiendo... Si vuelves a hacer un bolso demasiado grande, podrías utilizarlo como mochila, por ejemplo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_050..ref: I see. But if you make a pouch a little big, you could probably repurpose it as a bag or something.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_050..dst: Capisco... Pero', se fai una borsetta un po' troppo grande, potresti riutilizzarla come borsa o qualcosa del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_050..src: Lo sé. Por eso uso mi «bolso» como saco de dormir...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_050..ref: Ah, yes. That's why I use it as a sleeping bag back at home now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_050..dst: Ah, si'. Ecco perche' adesso la uso come sacco a pelo, a casa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_050..src: C-creo que no me lo imaginaba tan grande...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_050..ref: ... That's way bigger than I imagined.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_050..dst: ...E' molto piu' grande di quanto immaginassi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_060..src: Por cierto, nos han escrito varias cartas desde casa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_060..ref: By the way, we received some letters from everyone back home.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_060..dst: A proposito, abbiamo ricevuto delle lettere da tutti quelli a casa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_060..ref: Oh, how gracious of them. What did they have to say?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_060..dst: Oh, che gentili. Che cosa dicevano?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_060..src: Pues algunas hablan del día a día, otras nos mandan ánimos, pero sobre todo quieren recordarte varias cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_060..ref: About twenty percent are updates, thirty percent are cheering us on, and the remaining half are lectures for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_060..dst: Circa il venti per cento parla di come vanno le cose, il trenta ci incoraggia e il restante cinquanta ti fa la predica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_060..src: «Come verduras». «No te eches muchas siestas». «No te pelees con Isla». ¿Quieres que siga?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_060..ref: "Be sure to eat all of your vegetables," "Don't take too many naps," "Don't fight with Isla." Want to hear more?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_060..dst: "Mangia tutte le verdure". "Non fare troppi pisolini". "Non litigare con Isla". Vuoi che continui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_060..src: No, ya las leeré en otro momento... A pesar de todo, debo decir que es reconfortante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_060..ref: No, I'll read them myself. I must say though, they all strike deep ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_060..dst: No, le leggero' io. Pero' devo ammettere che sono davvero confortanti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_060..src: ¡Lo dicen por tu bien! Deberías hacerles caso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_060..ref: That just goes to show how much you're loved! Make sure to take their words to heart!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_060..dst: Questo dimostra quanto ti vogliono bene! Mi raccomando, fai tesoro delle loro parole!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_070..src: ¡Rutger! No te habrás vuelto a comer mis aperitivos, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_070..ref: Rutger! You ate the snacks I was saving for later, didn't you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_070..dst: Rutger! Ti sei mangiato di nuovo gli spuntini che avevo messo da parte, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_070..src: Ah, ¿eran tuyos? No he visto que llevaran tu nombre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_070..ref: Oh, those were yours? Didn't see your name on 'em.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_070..dst: Ah, erano tuoi? Non c'era scritto il tuo nome.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_070..ref: Oh, so that's how it's gonna be, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_070..dst: Ah, e' cosi' che la metti, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_070..src: Pues pienso contarle a Yumia que tienes un montón de ingredientes guardados para que los use en su síntesis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_070..ref: Then I guess I'll tell Yumia about the loot you've been hiding away and have her use it as synthesis ingredients.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_070..dst: Allora diro' a Yumia che hai fatto scorta di un sacco di ingredienti, cosi' li usera' per le sue sintesi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_070..src: Es que no he visto que llevaran tu nombre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_070..ref: I mean, I didn't see your name on them!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_070..dst: Voglio dire, non c'era scritto il tuo nome!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_070..src: Ag... Contigo no se puede ganar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_070..ref: Dammit. She always gets the upper hand ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_070..dst: Dannazione. Riesci sempre ad avere la meglio...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_080..src: Todo lo que tienes es tan adorable, Isla... Por ejemplo, ¡mira qué monada de lazo llevas en el cinturón!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_080..ref: Everything you own is just so adorable, Isla. Especially the ribbon hanging from your belt.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_080..dst: Tutto quello che hai e' cosi' adorabile, Isla... Soprattutto il fiocco che porti appeso alla cintura.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_080..src: Ah, ¿te has fijado? Los lazos se llevan mucho esta temporada, ¡no pude resistirme a comprarlo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_080..ref: Oh, you noticed? Ribbons are in fashion this season, so I decided I had to have one!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_080..dst: Oh, te ne sei accorta? I fiocchi vanno di moda questa stagione, cosi' ho deciso che dovevo averne uno!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_080..src: ¿De verdad? Me temo que no sé nada sobre moda. Sin embargo, tú siempre estás a la última.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_080..ref: Oh, really? I'm afraid I don't really know much about fashion. You're certainly on top of the trends, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_080..dst: Davvero? Temo di non saperne molto di moda. Tu pero' sei sempre al passo con le ultime tendenze.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_080..src: Ja, ja, ja, ¡gracias por el cumplido!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_080..ref: Ehehe, I'm glad you think so!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_080..dst: Ehehe, sono contenta che tu la pensi cosi'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_080..src: Cuando regresemos a Eustella, ¿podrías ponerme al día sobre las tendencias del momento?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_080..ref: Once we get back to Eustella, do you think you could advise me on the latest trends?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_080..dst: Quando torneremo a Eustella, potresti aggiornarmi sulle ultime tendenze?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_080..src: ¡Claro que sí! Seremos las más modernas del mundo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_080..ref: Absolutely! We'll aim to be the forefront of fashion together!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_080..dst: Certo! Saremo all'avanguardia della moda, insieme!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_090..src: Isla, ¿por qué me llamas Leni a veces?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_090..ref: Isla, why do you sometimes call me Leni?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_090..dst: Isla, perche' a volte mi chiami Leni?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_090..ref: Oh, well, you know, I just feel like it suits you!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_090..dst: Oh, beh, sai... Mi sembra semplicemente che ti si addica!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_090..src: ¡Sí! Eres tan suave como un gatito y yo a los gatitos más monos siempre les pongo un apodo. ¿Entiendes?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_090..ref: Yeah! You remind me of a little kitten. It makes me want to give you a cute nickname. Does that make sense?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_090..dst: Si'! Mi ricordi un gattino. Mi viene voglia di darti un soprannome carino. Ha senso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_090..src: Ah... Pues... no, lo siento. Creo que no te sigo del todo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_090..ref: Oh ... I'm sorry. I think this might be a bit too difficult for me ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_090..dst: Oh... Mi dispiace. Credo che per me sia un po' troppo difficile...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_100..ref: What do you say, Rutger? Won't you join me for some train—
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_100..dst: Ehi, Rutger, ti va di allenar...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_100..src: No. ¿Cómo se te ocurre proponerme eso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_100..ref: No. Why would you even try to invite me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_100..dst: No. Perche' mai ti e' venuto in mente di invitarmi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_100..src: Bueno, te he visto luchar. Es evidente que tus habilidades como aventurero son dignas de admiración.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_100..ref: I've fought alongside you, and it's clear that you're a seasoned adventurer with impressive skills.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_100..dst: Ho combattuto al tuo fianco, ed e' chiaro che sei un avventuriero esperto e molto abile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_100..src: Por eso, me gustaría entrenar contigo y aprender un par de trucos nuevos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_100..ref: Therefore, I wish to train by your side and learn from your experience and skills.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_100..dst: Percio' vorrei allenarmi al tuo fianco e imparare dalla tua esperienza e dalle tue capacita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_110..src: Uf... Qué envidia me das. ¡Ojalá tuviera una hermana tan mona como Isla!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_110..ref: *Sigh* ... I really am quite jealous of you. I wish I had a cute little sister like Isla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_110..dst: Uff... Che invidia. Magari avessi una sorellina adorabile come Isla!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_110..src: Si tuviera una hermana pequeña, me gustaría ir vestida a juego con ella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_110..ref: If I had a sister, I'm sure we'd dress up together and go out in matching outfits every day.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_110..dst: Se avessi una sorellina, mi piacerebbe vestirmi uguale a lei.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_110..src: ¿Eso hacen las hermanas? No sé yo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_110..ref: Is that really what sisters do? I can hardly imagine it ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_110..dst: E' questo che fanno le sorelle? Non riesco proprio a immaginarlo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_110..src: Pero seguro que a Isla le encantaría tenerte de hermana mayor, Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_110..ref: But I'm sure Isla would also be glad to have a sister like you, Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_110..dst: Ma sono sicuro che anche a Isla farebbe piacere averti come sorella maggiore, Nina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_110..src: Ja, ja, ja. De vez en cuando, eres encantador sin darte cuenta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_110..ref: Haha. You really do say some amusing things from time to time without realizing it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_110..dst: Ahah. Ogni tanto dici cose davvero divertenti senza rendertene conto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_120..src: ¡Es fascinante cómo te manejas con un arma, Lenja! ¿Aprendiste esas técnicas de combate en tu tierra natal?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_120..ref: Your swordplay is fascinating, Lenja! Did you learn those techniques in your hometown?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_120..dst: E' affascinante vederti maneggiare la spada, Lenja! Hai imparato quelle tecniche nella tua terra natale?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_120..src: ¡Increíble! Me he entrenado en el manejo de la espada desde que era joven, pero tu habilidad es impresionante. ¿Me darías algún consejo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_120..ref: Fascinating! I've studied swordplay since I was a little kid, but yours is unlike any I've seen. Would you mentor me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_120..dst: Incredibile! Mi alleno con la spada fin da quando ero piccola, ma il tuo stile e' diverso da qualsiasi cosa abbia mai visto. Ti andrebbe di farmi da mentore?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_120..ref: M-m-mentor?! There's no way I can mentor anyone!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_120..dst: F-f-farti da mentore?! Non potrei mai fare da mentore a qualcuno!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_120..src: ¡Eso no es verdad! Si compartimos lo que sabemos, ¡seremos mucho más fuertes!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_120..ref: That's not true! If we share our techniques with one another, we're sure to become stronger!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_120..dst: Non e' vero! Se ci scambiamo le nostre tecniche, diventeremo sicuramente piu' forti!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_120..src: A-ah... Supongo... Pero solo si tú también me enseñas a mí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_120..ref: U-um ... Well ... If you're willing to teach me too ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_120..dst: E-ehm... Be'... Se anche tu sei disposta a insegnarmi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_130..src: Oye, he estado pensando... ¿No sería más práctico llevar una pistola y una guadaña por separado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_130..ref: I've been thinking, wouldn't it be more practical to carry a gun and a scythe separately?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_130..dst: Ehi, stavo pensando... Non sarebbe piu' pratico portare una pistola e una falce separate?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_130..ref: Practicality isn't the only thing that matters. Havin' a connection to the tools you use is what's important.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_130..src: No solo me interesa ser práctico. Para mí, lo importante es tener un vínculo con las armas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_130..ref: Practicality isn't the only thing that matters, huh? ... Yes, it's exactly as you say.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_130..dst: Non mi interessa solo la praticita'. Per me, l'importante e' avere un legame con le armi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_130..src: Ser práctico no es tu prioridad, ¿eh? Sí... Tienes toda la razón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_130..ref: Perhaps I should tinker with my dagger. Maybe coat it in glowing paint or make it play sounds when I swing it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_130..dst: La praticita' non e' la tua priorita', eh? Gia'... Hai proprio ragione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_130..src: Tal vez debería adornar mi daga. Quizás hacerle una funda de colores brillantes o incorporarle algún sonido al atacar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_130..dst: Forse dovrei decorare il mio pugnale. Magari fargli un fodero dai colori vivaci o aggiungere un suono quando attacco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_140..src: ¿Qué pasa, señorita Nina? No tienes buena cara...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_140..ref: What's the matter, Miss Nina? It seems like you aren't doing so well ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_140..dst: Che succede, Signorina Nina? Non hai una bella cera...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_140..ref: No, Lenja, stop. I'm begging you, don't come any closer ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_140..dst: No, Lenja, fermati. Ti prego, non avvicinarti...
M-mi dispiace. Non ci stavo pensando...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_140..src: No... No es culpa tuya... ¡Ag, contrólate, Nina! ¡Solo puedo acariciar a Lenja una hora al día! Una. Hora. ¡AL DÍA!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_140..ref: No ... No, it's not you ... Guh, control yourself, Nina! Petting time is one hour per day! One. Hour. Per. Day!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_140..dst: No... No, non e' colpa tua... Guh, controllati, Nina! Posso accarezzare Lenja solo un'ora al giorno! Un'ora. Al. Giorno!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_150..src: ¿Por qué eres tan tímida con los demás? Conmigo eres muy directa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_150..ref: Why're you all timid around the others, but pretty direct when talkin' to me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_150..dst: Perche' con gli altri sei cosi' timida, mentre con me sei molto diretta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_150..src: Bueno... Porque me recuerdas a alguien muy especial para mí. Es fácil hablar contigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_150..ref: W-well ... You remind me of someone very special to me. It makes talking to you easier.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_150..dst: B-be', perche' mi ricordi una persona molto speciale per me. Per me e' piu' facile parlare con te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_150..src: Por mucho que te empeñes en ser distante, se nota que tienes buen corazón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_150..ref: Even though you can be kind of blunt, I can tell you're really kind on the inside.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_150..dst: Anche se a volte sei un po' brusca, si capisce che in fondo hai un cuore d'oro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_150..ref: Oh? Someone special to you, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_150..dst: Ah si'? Ti ricordo una persona speciale?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_150..src: Oye... creo que te he oído mal. ¿No querías decir a tu «abuelito»?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_150..ref: ... If you're gonna say I remind you of someone, at least make it your grandfather, okay?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_150..dst: ... Se proprio devo ricordarti qualcuno, almeno che sia tuo nonno, va bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_160..src: Lo siento, Yumia. No pienso dar mi brazo a torcer, ni siquiera por ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_160..ref: I'm sorry, Yumia. This isn't something I'm going to back down from, not even for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_160..dst: Mi dispiace, Yumia. Non cambiero' idea, nemmeno per te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_160..src: ¡Lo mismo digo, Viktor! Pensaba que podía confiar en ti en estos temas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_160..ref: That's exactly how I feel! I really thought I could trust you, Viktor!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_160..dst: E' proprio quello che penso anch'io, Viktor! Credevo davvero di potermi fidare di te!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_160..src: ¡Hala! Se puede cortar la tensión con un cuchillo. ¿Qué os pasa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_160..ref: Whoa, you could cut the tension with a knife. What's the matter?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_160..dst: Ehi! Qui si taglia la tensione con un coltello. Che succede?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_160..src: ¡Isla, llegas en el mejor momento! Mañana los sándwiches serán de melocotón ambrosía, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_160..ref: Isla, perfect timing! The filling for tomorrow's fruit sandwiches is going to be Ambrosial Fruit, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_160..dst: Isla, sei arrivata proprio al momento giusto! Domani nei panini alla frutta ci mettiamo la pesca ambrosia, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_160..src: ¡Que no! ¡Yo los quiero de manzana almibarada! No querrás decepcionar a tu hermano, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_160..ref: No way, it has to be Honeyed Malum! You would never let me down, right?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_160..dst: Ma neanche per sogno! Ci voglio la mela al miele! Non vorrai deludere tuo fratello, vero?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_160..src: Vale, vale, ya lo entiendo. Prepararé de los dos tipos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_160..ref: Okay, okay. Let's just put both in.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_160..dst: Va bene, va bene. Mettiamoci entrambe.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_170..src: El equipo de investigación es genial, ¿verdad? Nos dan los recursos que necesitamos y sin preocuparnos por el dinero.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_170..ref: The Research Team is great, isn't it? We're supplied with all the resources we need and never have to worry about money.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_170..dst: La Squadra di Ricerca e' fantastica, vero? Ci fornisce tutte le risorse di cui abbiamo bisogno e non dobbiamo mai preoccuparci dei soldi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_170..src: Es un alivio, porque no se me dan nada bien las finanzas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_170..ref: It really is a blessing. Especially since I'm no good with numbers ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_170..dst: E' davvero una benedizione. Soprattutto perche' con i numeri non sono un granche'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_170..src: Pero ¿qué dices? ¡Eso significa que jamás haremos fortuna! Es un castigo, no un regalo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_170..ref: What're you sayin'? That means we can never make a profit, right? That's more like a curse than a blessin'!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_170..dst: Ma che dici? Cosi' non potremo mai fare un profitto! Altro che benedizione, e' una maledizione!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_170..src: Rutger, ¿has pensado en cambiar de profesión y hacerte comerciante? Así te hartarías de ganar dinero.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_170..ref: Rutger, maybe you should consider a career change to a merchant? You could count money until you're sick of it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_170..dst: Rutger, hai mai pensato di cambiare mestiere e fare il mercante? Potresti contare soldi fino a non poterne piu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_170..src: ¡Ja! Me gusta escuchar el tintineo de las monedas en el bolsillo, pero lo demás es un fastidio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_170..ref: Ha! I like cash and profits, but that doesn't mean I like accountin'.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_170..dst: Ah! Mi piacciono i soldi e i profitti, ma questo non vuol dire che mi piaccia tenere i conti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_170..src: Creo que al señorito Rutger se le daría muy bien ser contable, con lo metódico que es...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_170..ref: I actually think Mister Rutger would be quite good at it, since he's so methodical ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_170..dst: Secondo me il signorino Rutger sarebbe molto bravo a fare il contabile, visto quanto e' metodico...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_180..src: Lenja, eres un poco más joven que nosotros, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_180..ref: Lenja, you're a little younger than us, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_180..dst: Lenja, sei un po' piu' giovane di noi, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_180..src: Nunca he tenido amigos de mi edad. Haberos conocido me ha hecho muy feliz.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_180..ref: I never really had many friends close to my age, so making two of them all at once makes me kind of happy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_180..dst: Non ho mai avuto molti amici della mia eta', quindi averne conosciute due tutte in una volta mi rende felice.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_180..src: Amigos... Eh... ¿O-os importa que os llame «amigas»?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_180..ref: Friends ... Umm, is it ... Is it okay for me to call you my friends, too?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_180..dst: Amiche... Ehm, posso... posso chiamarvi mie amiche anch'io?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_180..src: Ja, ja, ja, ¡es un poco tarde para hacernos esa pregunta! Pues claro que no nos importa. ¡Me encanta ser tu amiga, Leni!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_180..ref: Haha, it's a bit late to be asking for permission! But of course you can! I'm happy to be your friend, Leni!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_180..dst: Ahah, ormai e' un po' tardi per chiedere il permesso! Ma certo che puoi! Sono felice di essere tua amica, Leni!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_190..src: A tu edad y tan quisquilloso con la comida... Eso solo pasa en las familias nobles.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_190..ref: I can't believe you're picky with your food at your age. I guess this is what it means to be born into nobility.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_190..dst: Non posso credere che tu sia cosi' schizzinoso col cibo alla tua eta'. Dev'essere questo che significa nascere nobili.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_190..src: No hay nada noble en ser quisquilloso... ¡Es que no puedo con las verduras! Sobre todo, si tienen hojas y tal...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_190..ref: I agree that it's not very dignified. But I just can't stomach vegetables, especially the leafy ones!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_190..dst: Capisco che non sia molto dignitoso. Ma proprio non riesco a mandare giu' le verdure, soprattutto quelle a foglia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_190..src: Imagina lo tristes que están ahora todas las verduras... ¡Y lo duro que habrán trabajado los granjeros...!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_190..ref: Oh, both the farmers and the vegetables themselves must be so very sad ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_190..dst: Oh, sia i contadini che le verdure stesse saranno molto tristi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_190..ref: Argh! Stop it! What is this unbearable feeling of guilt?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_190..dst: Ah! Smettila! Che senso di colpa insopportabile!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_190..src: ¿Qué... quieres decir con «lo tristes que están las verduras»?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_190..ref: What do you mean, "The vegetables themselves"?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_200..src: Oye, ¿cómo son los bailes de la nobleza? Yo me los imagino llenos de gente elegante y bailando... ¡Fascinantes!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_200..ref: Say, what's it like at a noble's ball? The idea of everyone dressing up and dancing together is so enchanting.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_200..dst: Dimmi, com'e' un ballo nobiliare? L'idea di tutti vestiti eleganti e a ballare insieme e' cosi' affascinante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_200..src: No son tan esplendorosos como crees. Lo único divertido es poder llevar vestidos monos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_200..ref: It's not as grand as you might think. Wearing cute dresses is fun, but that's about it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_200..dst: Non e' cosi' grandioso come pensi. Indossare bei vestiti e' divertente, ma finisce li'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_200..src: Todo gira en torno a demostrar quién es la casa más fuerte y a hacer contactos. Aunque a simple vista el ambiente sea agradable, es como vivir una guerra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_200..ref: It's about showing the power of your house and making connections. While there's a friendly atmosphere, in truth it's like a war.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_200..dst: Si tratta di mostrare il potere della propria casata e stringere conoscenze. Anche se l'atmosfera sembra amichevole, in realta' e' come una guerra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_200..src: Ya veo... En pocas palabras, los bailes son como una contienda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_200..ref: I see. ... So balls are also like brawls, in other words.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_200..dst: Capisco... In altre parole, i balli sono anche come delle risse.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_200..src: ¿Una contienda?... Eso tendría mucho más sentido. Cuando asuma la posición de mi padre, yo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_200..ref: Brawls ...? That might actually make things much more straightforward. Once I succeed father, perhaps I'll—
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_200..dst: Risse...? In effetti, cosi' sarebbe tutto molto piu' semplice. Quando succedero' a mio padre, forse...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_200..src: No. Ni acabes la frase. Quítate esa idea de la cabeza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms02_200..dst: No. Non finire nemmeno la frase. Toglitelo dalla testa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_030..src: Los escombros del edificio bloquean el camino...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_030..ref: The rubble from the buildings is blocking the path ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_030..dst: I detriti dell'edificio bloccano il passaggio...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_030..ref: Can't you use your power to clear it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_030..dst: Non puoi rimuoverli con i tuoi poteri?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_030..src: Es que me preocupa romper alguna parte de la estructura y que otros edificios se vengan abajo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_030..ref: Hmm ... I'm worried that if I blow it up or something, it will just cause more buildings to collapse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_030..dst: E' che temo che, se facessi saltare qualcosa, altri edifici potrebbero crollare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_030..src: Les pediremos a los compañeros que nos ayuden a retirar los escombros del camino.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_030..ref: We'll have to ask the other team members to help us remove the rubble from the road.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_030..dst: Chiederemo agli altri membri della squadra di aiutarci a rimuovere i detriti dalla strada.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_030..src: Pero antes debemos despejar la zona de vínculo de maná para que puedan venir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_030..ref: But we'll need to clear the manabound area first so everyone can come here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_030..dst: Ma prima dobbiamo liberare la zona dal vincolo di mana, cosi' potranno venire qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_040..src: Tenemos que esperar al resto del equipo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_040..ref: We need to wait for the rest of the team to get here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_040..dst: Dobbiamo aspettare che arrivi il resto della squadra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_050..src: ¡Oye, no puedes merodear por aquí cada vez que se te antoje!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_050..ref: Hey, you can't just wander around wherever you feel like!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_050..dst: Ehi, non puoi andartene in giro come ti pare!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_051..src: ¡Oye, no puedes merodear por aquí cada vez que se te antoje!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_051..ref: Hey, you can't just wander around wherever you feel like!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_051..dst: Ehi, non puoi andartene in giro come ti pare!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_060..ref: When did you get over there?! Get back here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_060..dst: Quand'e' che sei arrivato fin li'?! Torna qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_061..ref: When did you get over there?! Get back here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms03_061..dst: Quand'e' che sei arrivato fin li'?! Torna qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_010..src: ¿"Carta de desafío"? Viktor, ¿sabes algo de esto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_010..ref: "Letter of challenge"? Viktor, do you know anything about this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_010..dst: "Lettera di sfida"? Viktor, ne sai qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_010..src: Ve al lugar que menciona la carta, y no olvides ponerte la ropa proporcionada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_010..ref: Go to the place the letter mentions, and don't forget to wear the outfit provided.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_010..dst: Vai nel luogo indicato nella lettera e non dimenticare di indossare l'abito che ti hanno fornito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_010..src: Eso es todo lo que puedo decirte. Lo he prometido, así que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_010..ref: That's all that I can tell you. I made a promise, you see ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_010..dst: Questo e' tutto cio' che posso dirti. Ho fatto una promessa, vedi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_010..ref: What are you even talking about?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_010..src: No se puede explicar con palabras, se trata de pasión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_010..ref: This isn't something that can be explained—it's about passion.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_010..dst: Non si puo' spiegare a parole: e' una questione di passione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_010..src: No tengo ni idea de lo que está pasando, pero supongo que puedo acercarme a ver...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_010..ref: I have no idea what's going on, but I guess I can try going there for now ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_010..dst: Non ho idea di cosa stia succedendo, ma per ora potrei andare a dare un'occhiata...

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_020..src: (¿Qué es esta sensación? Es como si supiera lo que tengo que hacer al haberme puesto esta ropa...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_020..ref: (What's this feeling? It's like I understand what I have to do after putting this outfit on ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_020..dst: (Che sensazione e' questa? E' come se, dopo aver indossato quest'abito, sapessi cosa devo fare...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_040..src: Hola, Yumia. Tengo una tarea que encomendarte. ¿Es posible?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_040..ref: Hello, Yumia. I have a task I'd like to give you. Is that all right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_040..dst: Ciao, Yumia. Ho un incarico da affidarti. E' possibile?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_040..ref: Of course. What can I do for you?

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_040..src: Es un Libro de caza. En otras palabras, es una lista de monstruos peligrosos que el equipo de investigación ha identificado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_040..dst: E' un Libro di caccia. In altre parole, e' un elenco di mostri pericolosi individuati dalla Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_040..src: Si encontráis alguno durante vuestras investigaciones, me gustaría que le dierais caza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_040..ref: It's a Hunting Book. To put it simply, it's a list of high-risk monsters the Research Team has identified.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_040..dst: Se ne incontrate qualcuno durante le vostre ricerche, vorrei che lo catturaste.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_040..src: Tened en cuenta que el equipo de investigación ha determinado que ninguna de estas criaturas es fácil de tratar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_040..ref: If you come across one during your investigation, I'd like you to hunt it down.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_040..dst: Tenete presente che la Squadra di Ricerca ha stabilito che nessuna di queste creature e' facile da affrontare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_040..src: Se desconoce el hábitat de algunas de ellas. Lo primero será encontrarlas, así que estad atentos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_040..ref: Just know that the Research Team has determined that none of these monsters will be easy to deal with.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_040..dst: Non si conosce l'habitat di alcune di loro. Per prima cosa dovrete trovarle, quindi state all'erta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_040..src: Recibiréis una buena recompensa por derrotarlas. Digamos que es la forma que tiene el jefe de mantener arriba los ánimos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_040..ref: Some of them don't have confirmed habitats yet. You might have to start by finding them, so stay alert.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_040..dst: Riceverete una bella ricompensa per averle sconfitte. Diciamo che e' il modo del capo per tenere alto il morale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_040..ref: You'll get a proper reward for defeating them. Let's just say it's the chief's way of keeping morale high.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..src: ¡Anda, hola! Habéis venido en el momento perfecto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..ref: Oh, hey there! You've come at the perfect time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..dst: Oh, ciao! Siete arrivati proprio al momento giusto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..src: Pues ha llegado algo interesante. Imaginaba que querríais echarle un vistazo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..ref: Something interesting got brought in again, actually. I figured you might want to check it out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..dst: A dire il vero, e' arrivato qualcosa di interessante. Immaginavo che voleste dare un'occhiata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..src: (La última vez sacamos algo útil de todo esto...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..ref: (We did get something useful out of it last time ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..dst: (La volta scorsa ne abbiamo ricavato qualcosa di utile...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..src: En realidad, no. Son una especie de máquinas creadas hace mucho tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..ref: They're not, actually. They're some kind of machine built way back in the day.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..dst: In realta' no. Sono una specie di macchine costruite tanto tempo fa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..src: Como decía, no son criaturas vivientes. Parece que son máquinas diseñadas para el entrenamiento para el combate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..ref: Just as he said, these are not living creatures. They appear to be machines designed for combat training.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..dst: Come ha detto lui, non sono creature viventi. Sembrano macchine progettate per l'addestramento al combattimento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..src: ¡Vaya! Si sirven para entrenarse para el combate, podrían venir bien. Si queréis usarlas, no dudéis en llevároslas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..ref: Oh, huh! If they're for combat training, they could come in handy. If you want to use them, go ahead and take them with you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..dst: Oh, capisco! Se servono per l'addestramento al combattimento, potrebbero tornare utili. Se volete usarle, prendetele pure.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..src: Es cierto, podrían sernos de utilidad... Vale, ya que nos las ofreces, nos las llevaremos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..ref: True, we might get some use out of them ... All right then, if you're offering, we'll gladly take them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..dst: Gia', potrebbero tornarci utili... Va bene, se ce le offri, le accettiamo volentieri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..src: Me alegro de librarme de... Uy, quiero decir que si vais a ponerlas a prueba, hay una zona abierta que sería perfecta para eso...
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..ref: I'm glad to get rid of—uh, I mean ... If you're going to test them, there's an open spot over there that would be perfect!
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..dst: Sono felice di liberarmene-ehm, volevo dire... Se volete metterle alla prova, li' c'e' uno spazio aperto perfetto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..src: Gracias. Vamos a probarlas ahora mismo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_050..ref: Thank you. We'll try them out right away.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_060..src: Parece que sirven para entrenarse para el combate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_060..ref: It appears that these can be used to carry out combat training.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_060..dst: Sembra che si possano usare per l'addestramento al combattimento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_060..src: No puedo creer que sigan funcionando... Vamos a echar un vistazo, a ver qué pueden hacer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_060..ref: I can't believe they still work ... Let's take a look and see what they can do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_ms04_060..dst: Non riesco a credere che funzionino ancora... Diamo un'occhiata e vediamo cosa sanno fare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_010..src: Has hecho un buen trabajo. Dime, ¿cómo llevas estar en el equipo de investigación? ¿Te vas adaptando?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_010..ref: Good job out there. Are you getting used to being in the Research Team?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_010..dst: Hai fatto un buon lavoro. Dimmi, come ti trovi nella Squadra di Ricerca? Ti stai ambientando?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_010..src: Entiendo. La investigación de la región de Lignumbria es un asunto muy serio para todos. Por eso, me gustaría presentarte a alguien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_010..ref: I see. The investigation here in the Ligneus region is set to begin in earnest, but I'd like you to meet someone first.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_010..dst: Capisco. Le indagini nella regione di Lignumbria stanno per entrare nel vivo, ma prima vorrei presentarti qualcuno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_010..ref: Someone we'll be working with? Another member of the Research Team?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_010..dst: Qualcuno con cui lavoreremo? Un altro membro della Squadra di Ricerca?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_010..src: Exacto. Es una erudita. Se llama Wilma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_010..ref: That's right, a scholar. Her name is Wilma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_010..dst: Esatto, una studiosa. Si chiama Wilma.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_010..src: Por lo visto, necesita tus habilidades, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_010..ref: She is apparently in need of your abilities, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_010..dst: A quanto pare ha bisogno delle tue capacita', Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_010..src: ¡Vaya! Si puedo aportar mi granito de arena, será un placer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_010..ref: I'm surprised. But if I can be of help, I'll do it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_010..dst: Oh, non me l'aspettavo. Ma se posso essere d'aiuto, lo faro'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_010..src: Bien. ¿Por qué no vais a conocerla? Aunque creo que sigue hablando con los Alber...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_010..ref: Good. Why don't you go meet her first? Although, I believe she's still out talking to the Alber ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_010..dst: Bene. Perche' non vai a conoscerla? Anche se credo sia ancora fuori a parlare con gli Alber...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: Hola, soy Wilma Lutter. He oído hablar mucho de ti. Gracias por acudir tan rápido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: My name is Wilma Lutter. I've heard a lot about you. I'm glad that you came as soon as you did.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Mi chiamo Wilma Lutter. Ho sentito parlare molto di te. Sono contenta che tu sia arrivata cosi' in fretta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: El jefe nos ha dicho que necesitabas ayuda. Cuéntanos todos los detalles, ¿vale?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: We heard from the chief that you need our help. Let's get straight to the matter at hand, shall we?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Il capo ci ha detto che hai bisogno del nostro aiuto. Andiamo subito al dunque, d'accordo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: Claro. Estoy buscando un lugar que se conoce como «la aldea donde habitan los espíritus».
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: Of course. I'm currently looking into a place called the "Village That Lives with Spirits."
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Certo. Al momento sto cercando un luogo chiamato "Villaggio che vive con gli spiriti".

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: ¿Espíritus, dices?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: Spirits?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Spiriti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: Sí, eso es. Para que lo entendáis, primero necesito explicaros el concepto y la cultura en la que surge esta creencia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: Spirits, yes. To understand this concept, I first need to explain the culture around this belief.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Si', proprio cosi'. Per comprendere questo concetto, devo prima spiegarvi la cultura legata a questa credenza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: ¿Habéis oído hablar de la «deidad de la cosecha»?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: Do you know about the Harvest Deity?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Conoscete la Divinita' del Raccolto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: La deidad de la cosecha... Sí, creo que me suena de algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: The Harvest Deity ... I'm familiar with the name, at least.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: La Divinita' del Raccolto... Il nome mi e' familiare, almeno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: La religión que adora a la deidad de la cosecha se extendió por un grupo muy reducido de personas que vivían en Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: The religion of the Harvest Deity originally spread among a small number of people who lived in Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: La religione della Divinita' del Raccolto si diffuse inizialmente tra un piccolo gruppo di persone che vivevano ad Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: Se ha escrito mucho al respecto. En general, hace referencia a la adoración del maná y las bendiciones que aporta a la tierra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: It has many forms, but in a broad sense it refers to the worship of mana and its blessings on the earth.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Esistono molte forme di questa religione, ma in senso ampio si tratta dell'adorazione del mana e delle sue benedizioni sulla terra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: Los espíritus son una manifestación más de estas bendiciones. Se consideran los avatares de la deidad de la cosecha.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: Spirits are one of these forms, and are believed to be avatars of the Harvest Deity.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Gli spiriti sono una delle manifestazioni di queste benedizioni. Si crede che siano gli avatar della Divinita' del Raccolto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: Se cuenta que hay una aldea que convive con los avatares y, atentos: ¡estos colman a sus habitantes con bendiciones y prosperidad!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: They say that there is a village that lives together with these avatars, receiving their blessing and prospering!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Si dice che esista un villaggio in cui gli abitanti vivono insieme a questi avatar, ricevendone le benedizioni e prosperando!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: ¿Qué? ¿En serio?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: What? Really?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Cosa? Davvero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: Es fascinante, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: Quite fascinating, isn't it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Affascinante, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: S-sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: ... Excuse me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: S-si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: Mi familia procede del Imperio aladissiano. Algunas de estas creencias son muy importantes para nosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: My family descends from the Aladissian Empire. Some of the cultural aspects of these beliefs still run in my family.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: La mia famiglia discende dall'Impero Aladissiano. Alcuni aspetti culturali di queste credenze sono ancora presenti nella mia famiglia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: Ah, ¿por eso las investigas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: Oh, so that's why you're researching it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Ah, ecco perche' fai ricerche su questo argomento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: Sí. Y, como antropóloga cultural, mi trabajo es averiguar toda la verdad sobre Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: Yes, and as a cultural anthropologist, it's my job to uncover these things about Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Si', e in quanto antropologa culturale, il mio compito e' scoprire queste cose su Aladiss.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: Por suerte o por desgracia, este campo de estudio está conectado con el maná y la alquimia. Justo por eso necesitaba tu ayuda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: However, the field of study is inherently related to mana and alchemy, which is why I'd like to ask for your help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Tuttavia, questo campo di studi e' strettamente legato al mana e all'alchimia, percio' vorrei chiedervi aiuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: Ah, ya entiendo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: I see, so that's why.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Ah, capisco...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: Mi primer objetivo era hablar con los Alber, pero me temo que no he sacado nada en claro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: I started off by talking to the local Alber, but that hasn't lead to any concrete leads.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Ho iniziato parlando con gli Alber del posto, ma non sono riuscita a ottenere indizi concreti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: Así que esa es la situación. ¿Qué dices, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: So that's the situation. Yumia, what do you think?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Ecco la situazione. Tu che ne pensi, Yumia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: Vamos a ayudarla con la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: Let's help her investigate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Aiutiamola a indagare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: Con una alquimista en el equipo, ¡no habrá pista que se nos resista!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: With the power of alchemy on our side, I'm sure we'll find something!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Con l'alchimia dalla nostra parte, sono sicura che troveremo qualcosa!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: ¡Eso es! Empecemos por estudiar los alrededores.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: That's true. In that case, let's start by investigating the surrounding area.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Giusto. Allora, cominciamo a indagare nei dintorni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: Quizá deberíamos regresar para que el jefe nos dé algunas indicaciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: Maybe we should go back and ask the chief what he thinks?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Forse dovremmo tornare dal capo e chiedergli cosa ne pensa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: Bueno, creo que no hará falta. Él mismo nos envió aquí para ayudar a Wilma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: No, I don't think that's necessary. He did send us here to help Wilma in the first place.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: No, non credo sia necessario. E' stato lui a mandarci qui per aiutare Wilma, dopotutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: Tienes razón. Empecemos por estudiar los alrededores.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: That's true. In that case, let's start by examining the surrounding area.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Hai ragione. Allora, cominciamo a esaminare i dintorni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: ¡Gracias! Mientras tanto, seguiré preguntando sobre las historias locales.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..ref: Thank you! I'll continue to learn more about the local folklore in the meantime.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: Grazie! Nel frattempo, continuero' a raccogliere informazioni sulle leggende locali.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..src: <SEL_RM01_020_1_B><CR>Vamos a preguntarle al jefe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_020..dst: <SEL_RM01_020_1_B><CR>Chiediamo istruzioni al capo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_030..ref: Now then, where should we investigate first?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_030..dst: Allora, da dove cominciamo a indagare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_030..src: Pues supongo que podríamos dar una vuelta por aquí. Aunque nos costará abrirnos paso entre tanta vegetación...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_030..ref: I guess we're just going to have to wander around. With all this dense foliage, it's going to be tough ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_030..dst: Direi che non ci resta che girare un po' qui intorno. Con tutta questa vegetazione fitta, sara' dura...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_030..src: Oye, ¿no había unas ruinas con la entrada derrumbada cerca de donde estamos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_030..ref: Hmm ... Come to think of it, weren't there some ruins with broken entrances around here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_030..dst: A pensarci bene, non c'erano delle rovine con l'ingresso crollato qui nei dintorni?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_030..ref: Why don't we try looking there?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_030..dst: Perche' non proviamo a dare un'occhiata li'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_030..src: ¿Unas ruinas sin explorar? ¿Hablas de esa torre antigua en la orilla del río?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_030..ref: Unexplored ruins? How about that old tower by the riverside?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_030..dst: Rovine inesplorate? Intendi quella vecchia torre in riva al fiume?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_030..src: Quizás haya algo interesante dentro. Vamos a echar un vistazo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_030..ref: There might be something of interest inside. Let's go see.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_030..dst: Potrebbe esserci qualcosa di interessante. Andiamo a vedere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_040..src: No podía ser tan fácil. La puerta está bloqueada y no podemos pasar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_040..ref: This isn't going to work. We can't get in with this broken door in the way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_040..dst: Cosi' non funzionera'. Non possiamo entrare con questa porta rotta davanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_040..src: Ya... Y tampoco veo la forma de abrirnos paso a la fuerza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_040..ref: That's true. I don't think we can simply force our way in either.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_040..dst: Gia'. Non credo che riusciremmo nemmeno a farci strada con la forza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_040..src: Nos las apañaremos para arreglar y asegurar la entrada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_040..ref: We might be able to fix up and secure the entrance ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_040..dst: Potremmo riuscire a riparare l'ingresso e metterlo in sicurezza...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..src: Las he oído otra vez. Desde las profundidades del lago subterráneo emergen cientos de voces.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..ref: I heard it again, from the depths of the underground lake. The voices of a great number of people.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..dst: Le ho sentite di nuovo. Dalle profondita' del lago sotterraneo. Le voci di tantissime persone.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..src: Allí no debería haber nadie. ¿Seguro que no son imaginaciones tuyas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..ref: But there shouldn't be anything over there. Are you sure you aren't just imagining things?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..dst: Ma li' non dovrebbe esserci niente. Sei sicura che non te lo stia solo immaginando?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..src: ¡De verdad que no! No soy la única que las ha oído. No es mi imaginación. Allí hay... algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..ref: Believe me! I'm not the only one who's heard it. It's not my imagination. Something's definitely there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..dst: Credimi! Non sono l'unica ad averle sentite. Non e' frutto della mia immaginazione. La' c'e' sicuramente... qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..ref: Huh? Is this some kind of ghost story?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..dst: Eh? E' una specie di storia di fantasmi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..src: Aunque se llegó a investigar, nunca hallaron nada, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..ref: Even though it was finally investigated, nothing was found, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..dst: Anche se alla fine hanno indagato, non hanno trovato niente, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..src: Y, de algún modo, las voces siguen ahí. Nadie sabe cuál es el origen de todo esto y empiezo a hartarme...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..ref: And yet the voices are still there. No one knows what's causing them. I've had enough of this ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..dst: Eppure le voci sono ancora li'. Nessuno sa cosa le provochi. Non ne posso piu'...
E se le voci sugli spiriti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..ref: Did it just cut off when he said "spirits"?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..dst: Si e' interrotto proprio quando ha detto "spiriti"?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..src: Esa es toda la información que Flammi ha conseguido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..ref: That is all the information that was able to be retrieved.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..dst: Ecco tutte le informazioni che Flammi e' riuscita a recuperare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..src: A juzgar por esa conversación, yo diría que los espíritus están relacionados de algún modo con el lago subterráneo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..ref: Judging by that conversation, it seems very likely that spirits are somehow connected to the underground lake.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..dst: A giudicare da quella conversazione, direi che gli spiriti sono in qualche modo legati al lago sotterraneo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..src: ¡A lo mejor esta pista nos conduce a la aldea!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..ref: This could be a clue relating to the village!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_050..dst: Forse questo indizio ci portera' al villaggio!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_060..src: Como alguien responda, me muero de miedo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_060..ref: ... If someone actually does respond, I'm gonna be so scared.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_060..dst: Se qualcuno rispondesse, mi verrebbe un colpo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_060..src: Por mucho que lo intento, no oigo ni rastro de las voces.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_060..ref: I've been listening closely, but I haven't heard any voices.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_060..dst: Per quanto ascolti attentamente, non sento nemmeno una voce.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_060..src: Me temo que nos iremos con las manos vacías.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_060..ref: I guess we've come up empty-handed this time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_060..dst: Temo che stavolta ce ne andremo a mani vuote.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_060..src: Mmm... ¿De qué estarían hablando entonces en la grabación?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_060..ref: Hmm. I wonder what that recording at the tower was about ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_060..dst: Mmm... Chissa' di cosa parlavano nella registrazione alla torre...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_060..src: Tampoco he visto nada que podamos escanear. Me temo que estamos en un callejón sin salida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_060..ref: There doesn't seem to be anything we could scan here either. We might be at a dead end.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_060..dst: Non ho visto neanche niente che possiamo scansionare. Temo che siamo a un punto morto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_060..src: No te preocupes. No podíamos esperar resolver todo el misterio con solo venir aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_060..ref: No need to worry. It's not like we were going to solve everything just by coming here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_060..dst: Non preoccuparti. Non potevamo aspettarci di risolvere tutto il mistero solo venendo qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_060..src: Por ahora, regresemos a informar al jefe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_060..ref: Let's go back for now and report to the chief.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_060..dst: Per ora torniamo indietro e riferiamo al capo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: Ah, así que habéis descubierto un rumor sobre un lago subterráneo. No está mal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: So, you discovered a mysterious rumor about an underground lake. Good work.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: Ah, quindi avete scoperto una voce misteriosa su un lago sotterraneo. Niente male.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: Ni tampoco bien. En lugar de averiguar algo más sobre esa aldea, regresamos con una historia de fantasmas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: It doesn't feel like good work. Instead of finding out about the village, we just brought back a ghost story ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: Non direi che sia stato un buon lavoro. Invece di scoprire qualcosa sul villaggio, siamo tornati con una storia di fantasmi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: ¿Habéis dicho un lago subterráneo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: I see, the underground lake, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: Avete detto lago sotterraneo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: ¿Quién eres?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: Um, who is this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: Ehm, tu chi sei?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: ¡Ah, qué bien que hayas venido! Quería presentaros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: Ah, great timing. I've been wanting to introduce you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: Ah, tempismo perfetto. Volevo presentarvelo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: Este es Licht. Se dedica a documentar toda la información.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: This is Licht. He's an expert at gathering intel.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: Questo e' Licht. E' un esperto nel raccogliere informazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: A partir de ahora, trabajará con nosotros. Creo que su ayuda nos vendrá de perlas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: He'll be joining our research efforts for now. I think things will go well with him helping.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: D'ora in poi si unira' alle nostre ricerche. Credo che con il suo aiuto andra' tutto bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: Podéis llamarme Licht. Contad conmigo para lo que necesitéis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: I'm Licht. I'll do my best to be of use.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: Sono Licht. Faro' del mio meglio per rendermi utile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: Me he informado sobre la aldea donde habitan los espíritus que mencionó Wilma. Pero me intriga mucho más esa historia del lago subterráneo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: I heard about the Village That Lives with Spirits from Wilma, but this report about the underground lake is also quite intriguing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: Wilma mi ha parlato del Villaggio che vive con gli spiriti, ma anche questa storia del lago sotterraneo e' davvero intrigante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: Por lo que tengo entendido, la aldea está cerca de ese lago como bien habéis supuesto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: From what I've heard so far, it seems likely that the village is indeed near the underground lake.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: Da quanto ho capito, il villaggio si trova vicino a quel lago, proprio come avevate ipotizzato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: Gracias por los ánimos, pero no hallamos ninguna pista cuando fuimos a buscar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: You sound confident. We didn't find anything there when we went to look, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: Sei molto sicuro. Eppure, quando siamo andati a cercare, non abbiamo trovato nulla.
