eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: Yo diría que sí. Habéis descubierto que hay voces que proceden de las profundidades.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: But the fact remains that you obtained information about voices coming from within the lake.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: Ma resta il fatto che avete scoperto che dal lago provengono delle voci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: Sí, deberíamos investigar a profundidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: Yes, that does call for further investigation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: Si', dovremmo indagare piu' a fondo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: Pero de ahí a vincular las voces con la aldea hay un trecho...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: But I think it's a stretch to immediately link those voices to the location of the village ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: Ma collegare subito quelle voci al villaggio mi sembra un po' azzardato...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: ¡Qué bien! La cautela con la que abordas este asunto es justo lo que necesita el equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: Yes, very good. That kind of cautiousness is just what the Research Team needs.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: Benissimo! La cautela con cui affronti la questione e' proprio cio' di cui ha bisogno la Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: Ah... Gra-gracias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: Uh, thanks?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: Ehm, grazie?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: Como bien sabéis, en Aladiss aún quedan zonas sin explorar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: As you all well know, the land of Aladiss is still full of unexplored areas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: Come ben sapete, la terra di Aladiss e' ancora piena di zone inesplorate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: Incluso aquí, en la región de Lignumbria, hay mucho que desconocemos. ¿Entendéis por dónde voy?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: Even here in the Ligneus region, much has yet to be uncovered. You understand what I mean, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: Anche qui, nella regione di Ligneus, c'e' ancora molto da scoprire. Capite cosa intendo, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: Sí. Que no hayamos encontrado nada en el lago subterráneo no significa que podamos descartar esta pista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: Just because we didn't find anything in the underground lake doesn't mean we can rule it out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: Il fatto che non abbiamo trovato nulla nel lago sotterraneo non significa che possiamo escludere questa pista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: Exacto. La relación entre las voces que proceden del lago y los rumores sobre los espíritus son, cuanto menos, inquietantes...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: Yes. The connection between the voices coming from the lake and the rumors of spirits is quite interesting ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: Esatto. Il legame tra le voci provenienti dal lago e le voci sui fantasmi e' davvero interessante...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: Con suerte, si la aldea está cerca, puede que haya otra forma de dar con su ubicación que no sea el lago.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: If the village is close by, there might be a path to it from a direction other than the underground lake.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: Se il villaggio e' vicino, potrebbe esserci un sentiero per raggiungerlo da una direzione diversa dal lago sotterraneo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..src: En cualquier caso, habrá que investigar la región de Lignumbria a fondo para hacer algún avance.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..ref: In any case, I guess we'll have to investigate the Ligneus region further in order to make more progress.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_070..dst: In ogni caso, per fare progressi dovremo indagare piu' a fondo nella regione di Ligneus.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..dst: C'e' qualcosa che ti preoccupa, capo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..src: He estado hablando con Licht. Y, aunque la investigación y nuestros esfuerzos hayan dado sus frutos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..ref: I've been talking to Licht, and even though investigation and pioneering efforts have made good progress ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..dst: Ho parlato con Licht e, anche se le indagini e le nostre iniziative pionieristiche hanno fatto buoni progressi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..src: Todavía queda un área sin explorar entre el lago subterráneo y la región de Syvashi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..ref: It turns out there is an unexplored area between the underground lake and the Sivash region.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..dst: A quanto pare, c'e' una zona inesplorata tra il lago sotterraneo e la regione di Sivash.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..src: ¿Podría estar allí la aldea donde habitan los espíritus?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..ref: Could that be where the Village That Lives with Spirits is?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..dst: Potrebbe essere li' il villaggio in cui vivono gli spiriti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..src: Hasta donde sabemos, no podemos explorar esa región así como así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..ref: That area, as far as we can tell, is quite difficult to get around.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..dst: Per quanto ne sappiamo, e' piuttosto difficile spostarsi in quella zona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..src: Por si fuera poco, que perteneciera al Imperio aladissiano nos obliga a asumir que habrá peligros asociados con la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..ref: Not only that, but the fact that it's in the Aladissian Empire means there may be dangers created by alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..dst: E non solo: visto che si trova nell'Impero Aladissiano, potrebbero esserci pericoli causati dall'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..ref: That sounds like the perfect place for the team to explore!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..dst: Sembra il posto perfetto da esplorare per la squadra!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..src: Sería una tarea demasiado arriesgada para un miembro cualquiera. Pero es un trabajo hecho a la medida de una alquimista como tú.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..ref: While it might be too tall a task for our regular members, it could be the perfect job for an alchemist like yourself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..dst: Forse sarebbe un'impresa troppo ardua per i nostri membri comuni, ma potrebbe essere il lavoro perfetto per un'alchimista come te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..src: Si al final te ves superada, barajaremos otras opciones. ¿Qué me dices? ¿Aceptas este desafío?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..ref: If it's too difficult even for you, I'll look into other options, but what do you think? Up to the challenge?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..dst: Se fosse troppo difficile anche per te, valuterei altre opzioni. Che ne dici? Te la senti di affrontare la sfida?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..src: Claro que sí. Es mi deber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..ref: Of course. This is my duty, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..dst: Certo che si'. E' mio dovere, dopotutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..src: Entonces, lo dejo en tus manos. ¡Espero vuestro informe!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..ref: Then I'll leave that area to you. I'll be waiting for your report.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_080..dst: Allora lascio quella zona a te. Aspettero' il tuo rapporto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_090..src: No veo otro sendero por ningún lado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_090..ref: I don't see any other paths ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_090..src: ¿Mmm? Eh, venid aquí. Parece que la parte de arriba es transitable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_090..ref: Hm? Hey, look up there. It seems like it's level.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_090..dst: Uhm? Ehi, guardate lassu'. Sembra pianeggiante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_090..src: O sea, que si logramos subir con algún punto de apoyo, podríamos encontrar un camino.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_090..ref: Which means if we make a way to climb up, we might be able to keep going.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_090..dst: Quindi, se troviamo un modo per salire, forse possiamo proseguire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_100..ref: It was just a hunch, but it turned out to be right!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_100..dst: Era solo un presentimento, ma avevo ragione!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_100..src: ¿Quién habría dicho que esto nos estaba esperando en la cima? ¡Buen trabajo, Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_100..ref: Who would have thought the top of the cliff would be like this! Great idea, Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_100..dst: Chi l'avrebbe mai detto che in cima alla scogliera ci fosse tutto questo! Ottima idea, Yumia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_100..src: Oye, que la idea fue mía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_100..ref: I'm the one who noticed it, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_100..dst: Pero' sono stato io ad accorgermene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_100..src: Sí, sí. Lo que tú digas. ¡Sigamos adelante!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_100..dst: Si', si'. Come vuoi tu. Andiamo avanti!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_110..ref: This place was a settlement, I guess ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_110..dst: Questo posto un tempo era un insediamento, suppongo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_110..ref: So then this is the village we're looking for?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_110..dst: Quindi e' questo il villaggio che stiamo cercando?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_110..src: No lo sé. Pero encaja con lo que sabemos hasta ahora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_110..ref: We can't say for sure yet, but the location matches up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_110..dst: Non possiamo ancora esserne certi, ma la posizione corrisponde.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_110..src: Este Vial de recuerdos está en muy malas condiciones. Flammi, ¿se puede escanear?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_110..ref: This Memory Vial seems pretty damaged ... Flammi, can you scan it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_110..dst: Questa Fiala della Memoria sembra piuttosto danneggiata... Flammi, puoi scansionarla?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_110..src: Claro que sí, Yumia. Flammi está en ello.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_110..ref: Of course, Yumia. Leave it to Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_110..dst: Certo, Yumia. Lascia fare a Flammi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_110..src: Tantos peces... la gente de la aldea... feliz...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_110..ref: So many fish ... people at the village ... overjoyed ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_110..dst: Tanti pesci... Gli abitanti del villaggio... saranno felicissimi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_110..src: Así que esta era una aldea pesquera...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_110..ref: I see, so this was a fishing village.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_110..dst: Capisco, quindi era un villaggio di pescatori...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_110..src: Venga, vamos a echar un vistazo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_110..ref: Come on, let's take a peek around!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_120..src: Me da apuro entrar en casas ajenas, aunque estén en este estado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_120..ref: Even if they're ruins, entering other people's homes feels kind of wrong ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_120..dst: Mi sento a disagio a entrare in casa d'altri, anche se sono ridotte cosi'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_120..ref: This place is a scary place.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_120..dst: Si', questo posto mette i brividi.
E' pervaso da un enorme rancore!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_120..src: Si es así, están muy tranquilos...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..src: Ah, habéis encontrado las ruinas de una aldea pesquera. ¡Buen trabajo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..ref: I see. You found the remains of a fishing village. Nice work!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..dst: Capisco. Avete trovato i resti di un villaggio di pescatori. Bel lavoro!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..src: Los Alber mencionaron algo interesante. Pero decidimos regresar antes de seguir explorando las ruinas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..ref: The Alber said something interesting, so we decided to come back and report before exploring the ruins further.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..dst: Gli Alber hanno detto qualcosa di interessante, cosi' abbiamo deciso di tornare a fare rapporto prima di esplorare ancora le rovine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..ref: They spoke of spirits, which means ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..dst: Hanno parlato di spiriti, il che significa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..src: Ese asentamiento abandonado podría ser la aldea donde habitan los espíritus.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..ref: That abandoned village could very well be the Village That Lives with Spirits.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..dst: Quel villaggio abbandonato potrebbe proprio essere il Villaggio in cui vivono gli Spiriti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..src: Y no os olvidéis de la maldición y los resentimientos. Me da que pensar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..ref: At the same time, this talk of "curses" and "scary places" does give me some pause.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..dst: Allo stesso tempo, questo discorso di "maledizioni" e "luoghi spaventosi" mi lascia un po' perplesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..src: No recuerdo que se mencionara ninguna maldición en los escritos sobre la deidad de la cosecha.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..ref: I don't remember there being anything related to curses in the religion surrounding the Harvest Deity ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..dst: Non ricordo che nella religione legata alla Divinita' del Raccolto si parlasse di maledizioni...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..src: La conclusión más evidente es que la vida y las tradiciones de la aldea no tenían mucho que ver con lo que cuentan las leyendas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..ref: This leads me to believe that the life and traditions in the village might be quite different from the legends.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..dst: Questo mi fa pensare che la vita e le tradizioni del villaggio fossero molto diverse da quelle narrate nelle leggende.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..src: Todavía no hemos descubierto la verdad. Pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..ref: We still haven't uncovered the truth. Yet ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..dst: Non abbiamo ancora scoperto la verita'. Ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..src: Estos conceptos esotéricos deben de estar vinculados con la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..ref: Such supernatural concepts are surely tied to alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..dst: Questi concetti soprannaturali devono essere legati all'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..src: Después de todo, estamos en Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..ref: This is Aladiss we're talking about, after all.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..src: Por favor, Yumia, sigue investigando. Asegúrate de que la región sea segura antes de estudiar esa maldición.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..ref: Yumia, please continue looking into this for me. Ensure that the area is safe while you investigate the curse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..dst: Yumia, continua a indagare per me, per favore. Assicurati che la zona sia sicura mentre fai luce sulla maledizione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..src: En el mejor de los casos, podríamos usar la zona como base si no encontráis grandes peligros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..ref: At the very least, it could be used as a base if the area doesn't pose any danger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..dst: Almeno potremmo usare la zona come base, se non presenta grossi pericoli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..src: Todo lo que averigüemos en este caso podría ser de ayuda para otras investigaciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..ref: Research into the particulars of this case should help our other investigations as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..dst: Tutto cio' che scopriremo in questo caso potrebbe essere utile anche per le altre indagini.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..src: Aún tengo mucho trabajo por delante. Nos veremos más tarde.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..ref: I have a lot I want to investigate at the site. I'm looking forward to working with you all later.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..dst: Ci sono molte cose che voglio esaminare sul posto. Non vedo l'ora di lavorare con voi piu' tardi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..src: Tened cuidado en el camino, chicos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..ref: Be careful on your way over, everyone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_140..dst: Fate attenzione durante il tragitto, tutti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_150..ref: By the way, where did those Alber go?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_150..dst: A proposito, dove sono finiti gli Alber?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_150..src: ¿Tú has visto este sitio? Es un muermo. Se habrán aburrido de estar aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_150..ref: They probably got bored and wandered off.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_150..dst: Probabilmente si sono annoiati e si sono allontanati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_150..src: No sé. Me da la sensación de que intentaban advertirnos de algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_150..ref: They might have been trying to warn us about something earlier. In any case ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_150..dst: Forse prima cercavano di metterci in guardia da qualcosa. Comunque...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_150..src: Estos escombros están frenando nuestra investigación. Vamos a quitarlos de en medio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_150..ref: All the debris lying around will get in the way of our investigation. Let's clean it up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_150..dst: Queste macerie intralciano le nostre indagini. Togliamole di mezzo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_150..src: Vale, nos dividiremos para ir más rápido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_150..ref: Right. Let's divide the work and clear it up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_150..dst: Giusto. Dividiamoci il lavoro e facciamo pulizia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_160..ref: Yumia! There's a Memory Vial here!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_160..dst: Yumia! Qui c'e' una Fiala della Memoria!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_160..src: Ojalá no esté roto y contenga información sobre esa maldición. ¿Lo escaneamos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_160..ref: If we can scan this, maybe we can learn what this "curse" really is. I just hope it isn't broken.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_160..dst: Se riusciamo a scansionarla, forse scopriremo cos'e' davvero questa "maledizione". Speriamo solo che non sia rotta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_160..src: Sin problemas. Flammi es una asistente autómata especiali...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_160..ref: No problem. Flammi is a super-high-spec independent survey—
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_160..dst: Nessun problema. Flammi e' un'assistente automatica di altissimo livello...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_160..src: Otro año que nos bendicen los dioses. Como jefe de la aldea, no quepo en mí de gozo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_160..ref: We have been divinely blessed once again this year. As village chief, I couldn't be any more proud.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_160..dst: Anche quest'anno abbiamo ricevuto la benedizione divina. Come capo del villaggio, non potrei esserne piu' orgoglioso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_160..src: Es obligación de cada uno de vosotros el aprovechar esta bendición y no echar por tierra el entendimiento que hemos alcanzado entre todos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_160..ref: It is now our people's duty to make the most of these blessings, and strive to continue our good relations.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_160..dst: Ora spetta al nostro popolo sfruttare al meglio queste benedizioni e impegnarsi a mantenere buoni rapporti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_160..src: Parece una serie de mensajes del jefe del asentamiento para los vecinos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_160..ref: It seems to be a collection of brief messages from the head of the settlement to his people.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_160..dst: Sembra una raccolta di brevi messaggi del capo dell'insediamento rivolti ai suoi abitanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_160..src: Una bendición, ¿eh? No ha dicho nada de la maldición que mencionaron los Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_160..ref: "Divine blessing," huh? No mention of the curse that the Alber were talking about.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_160..dst: "Benedizione divina", eh? Non ha detto nulla della maledizione di cui parlavano gli Alber.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_180..src: No seas derrotista. Alguien tenía que quitar los escombros si queremos asentarnos aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_180..ref: Don't talk like that. If we're going to establish a base here, cleaning up was necessary labor either way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_180..dst: Non fare il disfattista. Se vogliamo stabilire una base qui, ripulire era comunque necessario.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_190..src: Sí, claro, menuda alegría: un montón de ruinas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_190..ref: Of course, just what we needed. More piles of debris.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_190..dst: Ma certo, proprio quello che ci serviva. Altre montagne di macerie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_190..ref: This place kind of feels like it was a library.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_190..dst: Questo posto sembra proprio una biblioteca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_190..src: Espero que haya algo de valor dentro. Vamos a despejar la zona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_190..ref: There might be something worthwhile then. Let's get to cleaning.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_190..dst: Spero che ci sia qualcosa di valore. Mettiamoci a fare pulizia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_190..src: He encontrado un Vial de recuerdos, pero está destrozado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_190..ref: Found a Memory Vial, but the thing's busted.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_190..dst: Ho trovato una Fiala della Memoria, ma e' distrutta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_190..src: Ya veo. Me pregunto qué habrían guardado dentro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_190..ref: Looks like it. I wonder what was in it.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_190..src: Ya no tiene remedio. Sigamos adelante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_190..ref: There's no point to sitting here thinking about it. Let's keep moving.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_190..dst: Non serve stare qui a pensarci. Andiamo avanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_191..src: Hemos avanzado mucho. Aunque todavía no sabemos nada sobre esa maldición...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_191..ref: We've made good progress, apart from actually finding anything out about this "curse" ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_191..dst: Abbiamo fatto un bel po' di progressi, anche se non abbiamo ancora scoperto nulla su questa "maledizione"...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_191..src: Ni sabemos de qué bendición hablaban.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_191..ref: We don't know the whole story to the "divine blessing" either.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_191..dst: E non sappiamo nemmeno tutta la storia della "benedizione divina".

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_191..src: Lo que sí sé es que estoy muy cansado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_191..ref: All I know is that I'm exhausted.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_191..src: Sí, apenas hemos tenido un respiro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_191..ref: There's nowhere to relax around here, that's for sure.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_191..dst: Di sicuro, qui intorno non c'e' un posto dove riposarsi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_191..src: Tenéis razón. Nos vendría bien descansar en una base y prepararnos para cuando llegue el resto del equipo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_191..ref: You're right. It'll be necessary when the other team members come here, so maybe we should prepare a base.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_191..dst: Hai ragione. Ci servira' quando arriveranno gli altri membri della Squadra di Ricerca, quindi potremmo preparare una base.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_191..src: Es verdad. ¿Qué os parece cerca de la playa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_191..ref: I agree. How about by the beach?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_191..dst: Sono d'accordo. Che ne dite della spiaggia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_200..src: ¡Es un lugar estupendo! ¿Y qué construimos primero?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_200..ref: This seems like a good spot! What should we make first?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_200..dst: Sembra un ottimo posto! Cosa costruiamo per prima cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_210..src: Ahora nuestros compañeros podrán venir sin correr riesgos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_210..ref: Now the others in the Research Team can come here without worry.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_210..dst: Ora gli altri membri della Squadra di Ricerca potranno venire qui senza preoccupazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_220..src: Hemos avanzado mucho con los preparativos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_220..ref: Hmm, preparations are moving along nicely, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_220..dst: Mmm, i preparativi procedono bene, pero'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_220..src: Sí. Pero todavía no tenemos pruebas de que esta sea la aldea donde habitan los espíritus.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_220..ref: Yeah. We still have no proof that this is the Village That Lives with Spirits ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_220..dst: Gia'. Non abbiamo ancora prove che questa sia il Villaggio in cui vivono gli spiriti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_220..src: Ya, esperaba encontrar una pista más concluyente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_220..ref: I was hoping we'd find some more conclusive evidence.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_220..dst: Speravo di trovare qualche prova piu' concreta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_220..src: Lo único que se me ocurre es no dejar piedra sin remover.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_220..ref: I guess the best thing we can do is keep looking in different places.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_220..dst: Mi sa che non ci resta che continuare a cercare in altri posti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_220..src: Vamos a contarles a los Alber todo lo que hemos averiguado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_220..ref: Let's take what we've found so far and talk to the Alber about it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_220..dst: Raccontiamo agli Alber tutto quello che abbiamo scoperto finora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_220..src: Deberíamos pedirle a Wilma una segunda opinión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_220..ref: We should ask Wilma for her opinion again.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_220..dst: Dovremmo chiedere di nuovo un parere a Wilma.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_220..src: Sí, es su investigación después de todo. Seguro que nos puede decir algo interesante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_220..ref: Agreed. This is her specialty after all, she might have good insight.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_220..dst: Sono d'accordo. E' il suo campo, dopotutto; potrebbe darci qualche dritta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_230..src: En este estante solo hay libros de pesca. ¿Has encontrado algo en tu lado, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_230..ref: Just books about fishing on this shelf. Yumia, did you find anything?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_230..dst: Su questo scaffale ci sono solo libri di pesca. Tu hai trovato qualcosa dalla tua parte, Yumia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_230..ref: Nope. I guess there's nothing here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_230..dst: No, mi arrendo. Qui non c'e' niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_230..src: Estas cosas pasan. Busquemos en otra parte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_230..ref: It happens. Let's look somewhere else.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_240..src: Aquí solo hay un barco antiguo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_240..dst: Qui c'e' solo una vecchia barca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_240..src: Parece que no hay registros sobre la aldea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_240..ref: There doesn't seem to be any information related to the village.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_240..dst: Sembra che non ci siano informazioni sul villaggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_240..src: Puf. Seguro que ese barco lleva algo en la bodega.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_240..ref: *Sigh* Is the boat itself hidin' anythin'?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_240..dst: Uff... E se fosse la barca stessa a nascondere qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_240..src: Ya he mirado, pero no hay nada. Miremos en otra parte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_240..ref: I looked, but it doesn't seem like it. Let's just search somewhere else.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_240..dst: Ho gia' controllato, ma non c'e' niente. Cerchiamo da un'altra parte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..src: No hay nada fuera de lo normal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..ref: Hmm, nothing out of the ordinary.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..src: Estaba convencida de que encontraríamos algo aquí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..ref: I really thought there would be something ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..dst: Ero proprio convinta che avremmo trovato qualcosa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..src: ¿Habéis mirado superbién y no habéis encontrado nada? ¡Qué rollo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..ref: You looked a lot, but couldn't find anything? That's so sad!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..dst: Avete cercato dappertutto, ma non avete trovato niente? Che peccato!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..src: G-gracias por preguntar. ¿Nos podrías contar algo de la aldea? Había una maldición, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..ref: Th-thanks for the offer. Could you tell us more about this village? There's some curse, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..dst: G-grazie per l'offerta. Potresti dirci qualcosa in piu' su questo villaggio? C'era una maledizione, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..src: ¿Una maldición? ¡Ni idea! Yo solo he escuchado hablar de las bendiciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..ref: Curse? I dunno about that. They say this village had lots of blessings!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..dst: Una maledizione? Non ne so niente! Io ho solo sentito parlare delle benedizioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..src: ¡Todos los problemitas se solucionaban con las bendiciones!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..ref: With the blessings, things always got solved right away!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..dst: Con le benedizioni, ogni problema si risolveva subito!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..src: Los monstruos no se acercaban... Los cultivos maduraban... ¡Y muchas cosas más!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..ref: Monsters stayed away, more veggies grew, and lots of other good stuff too!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..dst: I mostri stavano alla larga... I raccolti maturavano... E tante altre cose belle!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..src: Ya veo, primera noticia. ¡Gracias por tu ayuda!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..ref: I see, this is news to us. Thank you. You've been a big help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..dst: Capisco, non ne sapevamo nulla. Grazie per l'aiuto!
Mi fa piacere essere d'aiuto! Evviva!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..src: Al final hemos averiguado muchas cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..ref: We got our hands on some good information.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_250..dst: Alla fine abbiamo scoperto un sacco di cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_260..src: Pero ¿no decías que esta aldea estaba maldita y daba yuyu?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_260..ref: Uh, didn't you say this village was cursed and scary?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_260..dst: Ehm, non avevi detto che questo villaggio era maledetto e faceva paura?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_260..src: ¿Maldita? No, señorita. Pero hace muuucho tiempo, un amiguito me contó algo sobre la aldea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_260..ref: Cursed? I dunno about that, but I've heard some things about this village from a friend a long, looong time ago.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_260..dst: Maledetto? Non ne so niente, ma tanto, tantissimo tempo fa un amichetto mi ha raccontato qualcosa su questo villaggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_260..src: ¡No lo asustes! Perdón. Por favor, sigue. Te prometo que no volverá a darte ningún susto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_260..ref: Hey, you're scaring them! I'm sorry, please tell us. I promise we aren't scary.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_260..dst: Non spaventarlo! Scusa. Per favore, continua. Ti prometto che non ti spaventera' piu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_260..src: Vaaale. Pero me ha entrado hambre. ¿No tendréis comidita?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_260..ref: Hmmm. I'm hungry, though. Do you have any yummy food?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_260..dst: Va bene. Pero' mi e' venuta fame. Non avete qualcosa di buono da mangiare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_260..src: Ya veo. Te traeremos algo rico, ¡no te muevas de aquí!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_260..ref: Got it. We'll find you something good, so just wait here!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_260..dst: Capisco. Ti porteremo qualcosa di buono, non muoverti da qui!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_270..src: Pues sí. Esto me lo contaron hace mucho, mucho tiempo. Dicen que la aldea estaba colmada de bendiciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_270..ref: Oh yeah, I heard this a while ago, but they say this village had lots of blessings!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_270..dst: Gia'. Me l'hanno raccontato tanto, tanto tempo fa. Si dice che il villaggio fosse colmo di benedizioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_270..src: ¡Todos los problemitas se solucionaban con las bendiciones!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_270..ref: With the blessings, things always got solved right away!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_270..dst: Con le benedizioni, ogni problema si risolveva subito!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_270..src: Los monstruos no se acercaban... Los cultivos maduraban... ¡Y muchas cosas más!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_270..ref: Monsters stayed away, more veggies grew, and lots of other good stuff too!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_270..dst: I mostri stavano alla larga... I raccolti maturavano... E tante altre cose belle!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_270..src: Ya veo, primera noticia. ¡Gracias por tu ayuda!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_270..ref: I see, this is news to us. Thank you. You've been a big help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_270..dst: Capisco, non ne sapevamo nulla. Grazie per l'aiuto!
Mi fa piacere essere d'aiuto! Evviva!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_270..src: Al final hemos averiguado muchas cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_270..ref: We got our hands on some good information.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_270..dst: Alla fine abbiamo scoperto un sacco di cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_280..src: ¡Wilma, has venido! Me alegro de verte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_280..ref: Wilma, you made it! Glad you're here to help us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_280..dst: Wilma, sei arrivata! Sono felice di vederti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_280..src: Estaba deseando ver la aldea con mis propios ojos. Hay una biblioteca en buenas condiciones, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_280..ref: I've been looking forward to seeing this village in person. There's a library that's intact, correct?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_280..dst: Non vedevo l'ora di visitare di persona questo villaggio. C'e' una biblioteca in buone condizioni, giusto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_280..src: Sí. A lo mejor encuentras algo que se nos haya pasado al resto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_280..ref: Yes. We're hoping that you'll be able to notice something that the rest of us missed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_280..dst: Si'. Speriamo che tu riesca a notare qualcosa che e' sfuggito a tutti noi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_280..src: Hay libros que se remontan a la edad del Imperio aladissiano. Ojalá sigan intactos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_280..ref: Books dating back to the age of the Aladissian Empire. I hope there are still some in readable shape.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_280..dst: Libri risalenti all'epoca dell'Impero Aladissiano. Spero che ce ne siano ancora alcuni in condizioni leggibili.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_280..src: Aunque los alrededores de la aldea están plagados de guaridas de monstruos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_280..ref: However, the area around the village sure has a lot of monsters.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_280..dst: Pero' i dintorni del villaggio sono pieni di tane di mostri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_280..src: Eso pone en peligro la investigación. ¿Podéis espantarlos por mí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_280..ref: I think that poses a danger to the investigation. Could you clear some of them out for me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_280..dst: Questo mette a rischio l'indagine. Potreste scacciarne qualcuno per me?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..ref: Everyone! You won't believe what I've found out!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..dst: Ragazzi! Non crederete mai a quello che ho scoperto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..src: No tiene que ver con la maldición. Por lo visto, en la aldea sucedían «bendiciones».
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..ref: It may not have to do with the curse, but it seems this village experienced a phenomenon called "blessings."
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..dst: Non c'entra con la maledizione. A quanto pare, nel villaggio si verificavano le cosiddette "benedizioni".

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..src: ¿Bendiciones? ¿No es eso lo opuesto a una maldición?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..ref: Blessings? Isn't that the complete opposite of a curse?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..dst: Benedizioni? Non sono l'esatto opposto di una maledizione?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..src: Sí. Las bendiciones colmaban de bienes al pueblo. Todos sus problemas se resolvían.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..ref: Yes. The blessings were a boon for the village. All of their problems were solved one after the other.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..dst: Si'. Le benedizioni colmavano il villaggio di doni. Tutti i problemi si risolvevano uno dopo l'altro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..src: Mantenían a los monstruos a raya y los cultivos se multiplicaban. Y eso solo es el principio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..ref: Monsters were repelled, their crop yields increased ... And those are just some of the things I've uncovered.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..dst: Tenevano a bada i mostri e i raccolti aumentavano... E queste sono solo alcune delle cose che ho scoperto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..src: Suena interesante. Aunque es mucha información a tener en cuenta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..ref: I see, that does sound interesting. We need to sort out all of this new information.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..dst: Capisco, sembra davvero interessante. Dobbiamo fare ordine in tutte queste nuove informazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..src: Eso mismo he pensado. He avanzado en la investigación, pero necesito tiempo para organizar las ideas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..ref: Agreed. I found a lot of things, but I need some time to organize everything in my head.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..dst: Sono d'accordo. Ho scoperto molte cose, ma mi serve un po' di tempo per mettere ordine nei pensieri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..src: Sigamos con esta conversación en la base.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..ref: Let's continue this when we get back to the base.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_290..dst: Continuiamo a parlarne quando torniamo alla base.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..src: Así que la aldea pesquera es, sin duda alguna, donde habitaban los espíritus. ¿Tenéis más detalles?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..ref: So the fishing village you discovered is without a doubt the Village That Lived with Spirits? Any more details?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..dst: Quindi il villaggio di pescatori che avete scoperto e' senza dubbio il Villaggio che viveva con gli spiriti? Avete altri dettagli?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..src: Sí. En la aldea ocurrían unos fenómenos extraños que llamaban «bendiciones».
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..ref: Yes. It seems the village experienced many phenomenons they believed to be "blessings."
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..dst: Si'. Sembra che nel villaggio si verificassero strani fenomeni che consideravano "benedizioni".

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..src: Según cuentan las leyendas, en la aldea las plegarias a los dioses eran escuchadas. Por ejemplo, las cosechas eran más abundantes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..ref: According to stories, the village's needs were fulfilled when they prayed. The year had an abundant harvest ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..dst: Secondo le storie, quando pregavano i bisogni degli abitanti del villaggio venivano soddisfatti. I raccolti erano abbondanti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..src: Y, cuando el viento portaba rumores de algún infortunio, los problemas se solucionaban sin conflictos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..ref: And when the wind carried whispers of misfortune, the problems were solved without any fighting.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..dst: E quando il vento portava sussurri di sventura, i problemi si risolvevano senza combattere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..src: También hemos oído historias de espíritus. En una, contaban que nunca se sabía cuándo descenderían de los cielos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..ref: There were stories of spirits too. For example, the time of year that the spirits would visit wasn't set in stone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..dst: C'erano anche storie sugli spiriti. Per esempio, non si sapeva mai in quale periodo dell'anno sarebbero venuti a far visita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..src: Y el afortunado que bailara con los espíritus sería la persona más feliz de toda la aldea. Imagino que les iba la fiesta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..ref: And whoever danced with the spirits would be the happiest person in the village. I guess the spirits were a cheerful bunch?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..dst: E chiunque ballasse con gli spiriti sarebbe diventato la persona piu' felice del villaggio. Immagino che agli spiriti piacesse fare festa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..src: O eso o se llevaban muy bien con los aldeanos. Por eso se llamaba la aldea donde habitaban los espíritus.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..ref: It seems the spirits were fond of the villagers, which is why it was called the Village That Lives with Spirits.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..dst: Sembra che gli spiriti fossero affezionati agli abitanti, ecco perche' si chiamava Villaggio che viveva con gli spiriti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..src: Ya, pero no hemos averiguado nada sobre esa maldición de la que nos advirtieron los Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..ref: But we never got to the bottom of that "curse" those Alber told us about.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..dst: Pero' non siamo mai riusciti a scoprire nulla su quella "maledizione" di cui ci hanno parlato gli Alber.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..src: Y nos queda una incógnita por despejar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..ref: And there's one other thing I'm still curious about.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..dst: E c'e' un'altra cosa che continua a incuriosirmi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..src: Nada nos dice que los espíritus fueran el origen de las bendiciones ni qué clase de espíritus eran.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..ref: Nothing mentioned that the spirits were the ones who brought the divine blessings, or what the spirits were.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..dst: Non c'e' scritto che gli spiriti fossero all'origine delle benedizioni, ne' che tipo di spiriti fossero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..src: Por eso, me gustaría seguir investigando. ¿Te parece bien, jefe?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..ref: That's why I want to investigate a little further. Is that all right, Chief?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..dst: Per questo vorrei approfondire ancora un po'. Ti sta bene, capo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..src: Claro que sí. Despejar esa incógnita también es importante para nuestra seguridad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..ref: Yes, of course. Filling in those gaps of knowledge is a matter of our own safety as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..dst: Certo. Colmare quelle lacune e' importante anche per la nostra sicurezza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..src: Tú eres la experta, Wilma. Seguro que eres capaz de llegar al fondo de todo esto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..ref: You're our specialist, Wilma. I'm sure you'll get to the bottom of all this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..dst: Tu sei la nostra esperta, Wilma. Sono certo che riuscirai a venire a capo di tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..src: Haré lo posible para estar a la altura.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..ref: I'll do my best to meet your expectations.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..dst: Faro' del mio meglio per non deludervi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..src: Yumia y los demás prepararon el terreno para que no me topara con ningún inconveniente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..ref: Yumia and the others did a great job laying the groundwork for things to progress smoothly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..dst: Yumia e gli altri hanno preparato il terreno alla perfezione, cosi' ho potuto procedere senza intoppi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..src: ¡Estamos deseando saber qué descubres ahora, Wilma!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..ref: I'm looking forward to hearing what you find, Wilma!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_300..dst: Non vediamo l'ora di scoprire cosa scoprirai, Wilma!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Llegáis en el mejor momento. Quería hablar con vosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: Wow, fantastic timing! I was about to send for you all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Siete arrivati al momento giusto. Volevo parlarvi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: ¿Ha pasado algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: Did something happen?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: E' successo qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Ha habido un contratiempo. Le he pedido al jefe que convoque urgentemente a los compañeros pertinentes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: There's been a small problem. I just asked the chief to put out an urgent request to all the relevant members.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: C'e' stato un imprevisto. Ho chiesto al capo di convocare urgentemente i compagni interessati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: No hay más miembros que hayan participado en la investigación sobre la aldea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: This is everyone involved with the investigation of that village.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Non ci sono altri membri che abbiano partecipato alle indagini sul villaggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Adelante, Licht, Wilma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: Please begin, Licht, Wilma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Prego, Licht, Wilma.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Esto... sí. Hemos descubierto algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: R-right. We've made quite the discovery.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Ecco... si'. Abbiamo scoperto qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: ¿El qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: What happened?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Che cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Es sobre la caída del Imperio aladissiano. Creemos que guarda relación con la aldea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: The dark history surrounding the destruction of the Aladissian Empire ... Part of it lies within the village.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: La caduta dell'Impero Aladissiano. Crediamo che sia legata al villaggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Mientras estudiaba otros temas, descubrí una verdad a la que no podía dar crédito.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: While investigating other areas, I came to learn the truth behind that village.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Mentre studiavo altri argomenti, ho scoperto una verita' a cui non potevo credere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Todo era una farsa. Y no somos los únicos a los que han engañado, seguramente los habitantes de la zona no estaban al corriente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: We've been misled by false information. Likely in the same way the people who lived nearby once were.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Era tutta una farsa. E non hanno ingannato solo noi: probabilmente anche gli abitanti della zona ne erano all'oscuro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: No pinta bien. ¿De qué se trata?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: False information isn't good. What exactly was it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Non promette bene. Di che si tratta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Los habitantes de la aldea no eran personas normales y corrientes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: The people who lived in that fishing village weren't ordinary people.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Gli abitanti del villaggio non erano persone comuni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: La aldea fue erigida por alquimistas que fueron expulsados de centros de investigación aladissianos. En su mayoría, desertores que se escondieron en ese asentamiento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: The village was built by alchemists who were expelled from research institutions in the Aladissian Empire. They defected and went into hiding there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Il villaggio fu fondato da alchimisti espulsi dai centri di ricerca aladissiani. Perlopiu' erano disertori che si erano nascosti in quell'insediamento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: ¿Alquimistas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: Alchemists?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Alchimisti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: No tengo palabras.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: That's quite a shocking story.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Non so cosa dire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Entonces, esas «bendiciones divinas»...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: So the so-called "divine blessings" ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Quindi quelle "benedizioni divine"...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: ¿Eran en realidad alquimia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: Were actually all the things they were using alchemy to do?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Erano in realta' alchimia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Y eso no es todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: That's not all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: E non e' tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Vendieron los secretos del imperio a otras naciones a cambio de bienes y materiales.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: They sold the empire's secrets to other countries in exchange for goods and materials.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Vendevano i segreti dell'impero ad altre nazioni in cambio di beni e materiali.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Llamaban a los materiales «bendiciones divinas» y usaron la aldea pesquera para ocultar sus actividades.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: They called those foreign materials "divine blessings," and used the fishing village to conceal their actions.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Chiamavano quei materiali "benedizioni divine" e usavano il villaggio di pescatori per nascondere le loro attivita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Entonces, eso de «otro año que nos bendicen los dioses» era un eufemismo para decir que se habían llevado una buena tajada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: So, "We have been divinely blessed once again this year," just meant they got a good price for the secrets?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Quindi quel "un altro anno in cui gli de'i ci hanno benedetti" era un eufemismo per dire che si erano intascati un bel bottino.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Ni en mis peores pesadillas habría imaginado algo así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: I never would have dreamed that such a thing had occurred there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Neanche nei miei peggiori incubi avrei immaginato una cosa simile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Cuesta creer que los espíritus y las bendiciones que todo el mundo vinculaba a la deidad de la cosecha sean en realidad algo tan... perverso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: It's hard to believe that the spirits and blessings that are often associated with the Harvest Deity were just being exploited ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: E' difficile credere che gli spiriti e le benedizioni che tutti associavano alla Divinita' del Raccolto fossero in realta' qualcosa di cosi'... perverso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Y no habéis oído todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: ... And there are still even more shocking truths.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: E non avete ancora sentito tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Cierto. Como ya le he contado al jefe, todo esto guarda relación con la caída del imperio. En otras palabras...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: That's right. As I mentioned to the chief, this is indirectly related to the fall of the empire. To elaborate—
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Giusto. Come ho gia' detto al capo, tutto questo e' legato alla caduta dell'Impero Aladissiano. In altre parole...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Ya veo por dónde vas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: No need, I think we got the gist of it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Capisco dove vuoi arrivare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Esos secretos vendidos hicieron que el poder del enemigo creciera. Partían con ventaja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: Those secrets being divulged means that the enemy's power increased, giving them an edge.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Quei segreti venduti al nemico ne hanno accresciuto il potere. Aveva un vantaggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Cualquier esfuerzo es poco cuando se trata de hallar la verdad. A pesar de que todo sea una farsa y la historia haya acabado siendo menos... sobrenatural.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: It detracts from the story's magic, but if this contributed to the empire's downfall, then finding it was well worth it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Nessuno sforzo e' troppo grande quando si tratta di scoprire la verita'. Anche se era tutta una farsa e la storia si e' rivelata meno... soprannaturale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Eran alquimistas. Seguro que pudieron usar la aldea de tapadera para llevar a cabo sus planes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: Given that it was a group of alchemists, it's possible they succeeded using the whole town as a cover-up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Erano alchimisti. Di sicuro avranno potuto usare il villaggio come copertura per attuare i loro piani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: El motivo es lo de menos, vendieron su país por pura codicia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: Whatever the reason, they sold out their country and reaped the benefits.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Il motivo non conta, hanno venduto il loro paese per pura avidita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Imaginad qué podrían llegar a hacer aprovechándose de la alquimia...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: If they had that same attitude toward alchemy itself, then ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Immaginate cosa potrebbero arrivare a fare sfruttando l'alchimia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Entiendo que pienses así. Como soldado de este país, no puedo defender sus actos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: Your concern is natural. As a man sworn to his country, I also can't defend their actions.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Capisco che tu la pensi cosi'. Da soldato di questo paese, non posso difendere le loro azioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Pero lo único que sabemos es el origen de la aldea y su final. No podemos afirmar qué los motivó a cometer estas atrocidades.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: But all we know is the nature of the village and the final outcome. There's no way of knowing their inner motives.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Ma tutto cio' che sappiamo sono le origini del villaggio e la sua fine. Non possiamo affermare cosa li abbia spinti a commettere queste atrocita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Sabían que eran unos traidores a la patria. Por eso se escondieron.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: Viktor ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Sapevano di essere dei traditori della patria. Per questo si sono nascosti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Quizás esa era su «maldición». Los humanos son capaces de hechos inenarrables.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: They knew that their actions were treasonous, which is why they hid them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Forse quella era la loro "maledizione". Gli esseri umani sono capaci di atti indicibili.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..src: Ya no importa. Desde este momento, doy por concluida la exploración de la aldea. Que esta historia no salga de aquí, ¿entendido?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..ref: Perhaps the "curse" was referring to that. The ways of humankind can be a scary thing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_310..dst: Non importa piu'. Da questo momento, considero conclusa l'esplorazione del villaggio. Che questa storia non esca da qui, chiaro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..src: ¿Continuará el trabajo en la aldea pesquera?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..ref: Pioneering efforts at the fishing village are going to be resumed?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..dst: Il lavoro pionieristico nel villaggio di pescatori riprendera'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..src: Sí. Nuestras idas y venidas no eran precisamente clasificadas. Todo el equipo está al tanto de su existencia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..ref: Yes. The investigation and groundwork weren't exactly classified, so people are already aware of it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..dst: Si'. Le indagini e i lavori preparatori non erano proprio segreti, quindi ormai tutta la squadra ne e' al corrente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..src: A decir verdad, los aventureros y los cazarreliquias están muy interesados en ir de visita. Me está costando que no se acerquen.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..ref: To tell the truth, the adventurers and relic hunters are showing interest, making it hard to keep it under wraps.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..dst: A dire il vero, avventurieri e cacciatori di reliquie sono molto interessati a farci visita. Faccio fatica a tenerli alla larga.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..src: Pero tranquilos, la verdad sobre la aldea donde habitan los espíritus está a buen recaudo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..ref: Of course, the truth about the Village That Lives with Spirits hasn't gotten out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..dst: Ma state tranquilli, la verita' sul villaggio in cui vivono gli spiriti e' al sicuro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..src: A pesar de nuestras pesquisas, es un asentamiento valioso donde aprender sobre la civilización pasada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..ref: Regardless of the truth, it still remains a valuable site for research on the past civilization.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..dst: A prescindere dalle nostre indagini, resta un insediamento prezioso per saperne di piu' sulla civilta' del passato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..src: A mi entender, ya casi podemos avisar a los exploradores que han ido a la aldea de que su labor ha finalizado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..ref: With the investigation done so far, one could say that pioneering work in the fishing village is almost complete.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..dst: A mio parere, possiamo quasi avvisare gli esploratori che si sono recati al villaggio che il loro lavoro e' terminato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..src: Lo más prudente sería dar por concluidas las tareas antes de que otros miembros indaguen demasiado. Perderíamos el control.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..ref: So it might be prudent to get it finished up before the other members grow too restless.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..dst: Sarebbe piu' prudente portare a termine i lavori prima che gli altri membri indaghino troppo. Potremmo perdere il controllo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..src: Así lo haremos. Ayudad con las investigaciones en la aldea para construir allí una nueva base.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..ref: And there you have it. Please resume investigating and pioneering the village in order to turn it into a base.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_320..dst: Facciamo cosi'. Riprendete le indagini e contribuite a sviluppare il villaggio, cosi' da trasformarlo in una base.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..src: ¿Por qué no le pides ayuda a Flammi?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..ref: ... Hey, aren't you gonna ask Flammi for help?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..dst: Perche' non chiedi aiuto a Flammi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..src: No hace falta. Estos diagramas son muy útiles... Ya veo. Vale, entiendo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..ref: There are helpful diagrams, so I don't need to. ... I see, so that's the situation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..dst: Non serve. Questi schemi sono molto utili... Capisco. Ora e' tutto chiaro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..src: Hay un dispositivo en la aldea que suministra maná. Pero me temo que ha dejado de funcionar correctamente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..ref: It seems like this village has a device that supplies mana. But it's not functioning properly at the moment.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..dst: In questo villaggio c'e' un dispositivo che fornisce mana. Ma temo che al momento non funzioni correttamente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..src: No estaría mal restaurar la corriente para ayudar a los exploradores cuando este lugar sea la nueva base del equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..ref: If I could fix the supply, it would help pioneering efforts once this place becomes a base for the Research Team ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..dst: Se riuscissi a ripristinare l'erogazione, aiuterebbe le esplorazioni quando questo posto diventera' una base per la Squadra di Ricerca...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..ref: Is there some way to fix it?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..src: Si la corriente de maná es demasiado débil, podríamos amplificarla con un generador de energía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..ref: If the amount of mana being supplied is too low, placing an Energy Generator and using that could do the trick.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..dst: Se la quantita' di mana erogata e' troppo bassa, installare un generatore di energia e usarlo potrebbe risolvere il problema.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..src: Si localizamos el edificio que requiera más maná y logramos reducir su consumo, podríamos llegar a equilibrar el suministro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..ref: Finding a facility that's using up a lot of mana and lowering its consumption might balance out the supply.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..dst: Se troviamo una struttura che consuma molto mana e ne riduciamo il consumo, potremmo riequilibrare l'erogazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..src: Podría haber un corte de la corriente de maná en algún punto. Vayamos a echar un vistazo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..ref: There might be a disruption in the mana flow somewhere ... Let's go take a look!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..dst: Potrebbe esserci un'interruzione nel Flusso di Mana da qualche parte... Andiamo a dare un'occhiata!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_330..ref: <SEL_RM01_330_1_C><CR>Check the path of the mana flow.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_340..ref: Maybe putting it around here would be good?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_340..src: Creo que sí. Muy bien, vamos a fabricar un generador de energía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_340..ref: I think so too. All right, let's make an Energy Generator.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_340..dst: Lo penso anch'io. Bene, costruiamo un generatore di energia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_350..src: Está roto y hay una fuga. Por eso el maná no fluye en la aldea como debería.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_350..ref: It's broken and leaking. That might be why the mana isn't making it around the village properly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_350..dst: E' rotto e perde. Forse e' per questo che il mana non circola come dovrebbe nel villaggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_350..src: Si lo arreglamos, la corriente regresará a la normalidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_350..ref: If we can fix this, the mana flow should go back to normal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_350..dst: Se riusciamo a sistemarlo, il Flusso di Mana dovrebbe tornare alla normalita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_360..ref: Hey, why is there a pack of monsters here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_360..dst: Ehi, che ci fanno qui tutti questi mostri?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_360..ref: Maybe they're the reason the mana flow is so bad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_360..dst: Forse sono loro a causare problemi al Flusso di Mana?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_360..ref: All right! Let's clear them out!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_370..src: ¡Son gólems! ¿Los habremos despertado al poner en marcha los edificios de la aldea?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_370..ref: Golems! Did turnin' on the village's facilities wake 'em up?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_370..dst: Golem! Saranno stati svegliati dall'attivazione delle strutture del villaggio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_370..src: Es muy posible. No se me ocurre otra razón. Pero ¿qué los habrá atraído?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_370..ref: It's possible, I can't think of any other reason. But why are they here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_370..dst: Puo' darsi, non mi viene in mente un'altra spiegazione. Ma perche' sono qui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_370..src: Puede que los trajeran aquí para investigar. Después de todo, esos alquimistas trabajaban en un laboratorio, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_370..ref: Maybe they brought 'em from their old workplace? The alchemists here worked at a lab or somethin', right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_370..dst: Forse li hanno portati dal loro vecchio posto di lavoro? Gli alchimisti qui lavoravano in un laboratorio o qualcosa del genere, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_370..src: O será otra de esas «bendiciones divinas» de los espíritus.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_370..ref: Or maybe this is one of the "divine blessings" from the spirits.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_370..dst: O forse e' una delle "benedizioni divine" degli spiriti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_370..src: ¡Ya lo pensaremos luego! Hay que detenerlos antes de que causen estragos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_370..ref: We can think about it later! We have to stop them now before things get out of hand!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_370..dst: Ne parleremo dopo! Dobbiamo fermarli subito, prima che la situazione ci sfugga di mano!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_380..src: ¿Cómo esconderían algo así? Espero que no haya más sorpresas de este estilo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_380..ref: To think they had something like this hidden away. I hope that there are no other surprises.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_380..dst: Pensa che avessero nascosto una cosa del genere. Spero non ci siano altre sorprese.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_380..src: Lo encontré en el mismo sitio de donde salieron esos grandullones. ¿Habrá algún modo de leerlo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_380..ref: This was left where they started moving from. Maybe it has some kind of information in it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_380..dst: E' stato lasciato nel punto da cui si sono messi in movimento. Forse contiene qualche informazione?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_380..src: Contiene los planos de unos edificios de la civilización pasada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_380..ref: It seems to contain blueprints of facilities from the past civilization.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_380..dst: Sembra contenere i progetti delle strutture dell'antica civilta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_380..src: Ah, los que construyeron aquí me imagino. Quizás pueda replicarlos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_380..ref: Oh, ones that were used here, I imagine. I might be able to make some of these.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_380..dst: Ah, immagino siano quelle che venivano usate qui. Potrei riuscire a costruirne alcune.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_380..src: Con eso acaba nuestro trabajo aquí, ¿me equivoco?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_380..ref: So that marks the end of our investigation here for the most part, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_380..dst: Dunque, per ora la nostra indagine qui e' praticamente conclusa, giusto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_380..src: El resto se lo dejaremos a los compañeros. Aunque podríamos pasarnos en un futuro a ver cómo les va.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_380..ref: The rest will be left up to the other members. We should come check in again after a while.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_380..dst: Il resto lo lasciamo agli altri membri. Potremmo tornare a controllare tra un po'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..src: La mitad de los víveres van al almacén. ¡Vamos, equipo! ¡Con energía!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..ref: Half of the food here goes in the storeroom. All right people, let's move it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..dst: Meta' delle provviste qui va in magazzino. Forza, gente! Diamoci da fare!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..src: ¡Eh! ¡No me grites! Me duele la espalda...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..ref: Whaaat, give me a break! My poor aching back ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..dst: Ehi, datti una calmata! La mia povera schiena...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..src: Eso es porque levantas el peso con las lumbares. Mira, se hace así...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..ref: That's because you're lifting with your back. You have to pick up heavy things like this ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..dst: E' perche' sollevi i pesi usando la schiena. Le cose pesanti vanno sollevate cosi'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..src: Sí. En poco tiempo, será una buena base.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..ref: Indeed. I think it'll be a great base in no time.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..src: Así es imposible que nadie sospeche del pasado de la aldea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..ref: With this, no one will figure out this village's past.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..dst: Cosi' nessuno sospettera' del passato di questo villaggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..src: Me parece a mí que estás hablando demasiado rápido, Nina...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..ref: You're always quick to say stuff like that, Nina.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..dst: Sei sempre pronto a dire cose del genere, Nina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..src: Cuando la investigación haya finalizado y no quede nada por explorar, este será un buen sitio para vivir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..ref: When the investigation here finishes and development progresses, this will be a more lively and beautiful place.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..dst: Quando le indagini saranno concluse e non restera' piu' nulla da esplorare, questo sara' un bel posto in cui vivere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..src: Y todos hablarán de Yumia, la alquimista que hizo posible que existiera un lugar tan agradable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..ref: And then everyone will spread word that Yumia the alchemist made this place as nice as it is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..dst: E tutti parleranno di Yumia, l'alchimista che ha reso questo posto cosi' bello.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..src: ¡Y yo seré famosa por ser su amiga!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..ref: And I'll become famous by association!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..dst: E cosi' diventero' famosa per associazione!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..src: ¡Ah! Así que ese era tu gran plan, ¿eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..ref: So that's what you really wanted to say!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..src: Yo solo quiero que la gente se reconcilie con la alquimia y vea lo práctica que puede ser.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..ref: I just hope that more and more people will come to accept alchemy as something that can help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm01_390..dst: Spero solo che sempre piu' persone accettino l'alchimia e capiscano quanto possa essere utile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_010..src: Ya mismo dará comienzo la misión de exploración de la región de Syvashi. Siento pediros esto de forma tan repentina, pero necesito vuestra ayuda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_010..ref: The pioneering effort in the Sivash region is set to start soon. Sorry to ask so suddenly, but I have a request.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_010..dst: La Missione Pionieristica nella regione di Sivash iniziera' presto. Scusate se ve lo chiedo cosi' all'improvviso, ma avrei bisogno del vostro aiuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_010..src: Licht se ha adelantado para llevar a cabo una investigación preliminar en la aldea Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_010..ref: Licht has gone ahead to do some preliminary research in the Welleks settlement.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_010..dst: Licht e' gia' partito per svolgere alcune ricerche preliminari nell'insediamento di Welleks.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_010..src: Me gustaría que fuerais juntos a echarle una mano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_010..ref: I'd like for you all to go there and help him out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_010..dst: Vorrei che andaste li' ad aiutarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_010..ref: Is there something in particular that he's looking into?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_010..src: Según su informe, está siguiendo una pista relacionada con la alquimia de Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_010..ref: According to Licht's report, he's following a lead that relates to Aladissian alchemy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_010..dst: Stando al rapporto di Licht, sta seguendo una pista legata all'alchimia aladissiana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_010..src: ¡Vaya! En ese caso, no hay tiempo que perder.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_010..ref: Oh, wow. In that case, we'll head over quickly!
