eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_340..dst: Usano persino le loro creazioni per barattare. Se vi interessa, perche' non andare a dare un'occhiata?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_340..src: No me lo esperaba... ¡Y qué vergüenza! Ojalá eso signifique que el nuevo proyecto Cultivo será muy próspero.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_340..ref: That's surprising ... and a bit embarrassing. But I hope this means the new Harvest Project will go over well too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm02_340..dst: Non me lo aspettavo... Che imbarazzo! Spero che significhi che anche il nuovo Progetto del Raccolto andra' per il meglio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..ref: Have you grown accustomed to Auruma yet?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..dst: Ti sei gia' abituata a Auruma?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..src: Pues no sabría decirte... No se parece en nada a las regiones que habíamos visitado hasta ahora. Ahí hay mucha información.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..ref: It's hard to say ... It's pretty different from all the regions we've been to so far. There's a lot of information here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..dst: Beh, non saprei... Non assomiglia per niente alle regioni che abbiamo visitato finora. C'e' un sacco di informazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..src: Ya, es comprensible. Al fin y al cabo, en esta zona casi todo es artificial.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..ref: Well, that's understandable. Almost everything in this area is man-made, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..dst: Si', e' comprensibile. Dopotutto, in questa zona quasi tutto e' artificiale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..src: Si te digo la verdad, desde que empezamos a investigar Auruma todo el mundo tiene mucho trabajo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..ref: To tell you the truth, everyone's workload has been increasing ever since we started investigating Auruma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..dst: A dire il vero, da quando abbiamo iniziato a indagare su Auruma il carico di lavoro di tutti e' aumentato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..src: Si seguimos así, se caerán redondos de puro cansancio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..ref: We're starting to reach the point where people might collapse from fatigue.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..dst: Se continuiamo cosi', qualcuno potrebbe collassare dalla stanchezza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..src: Estarás dejando que se tomen descansos, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..ref: You are lettin' them take breaks, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..dst: Li stai lasciando fare delle pause, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..src: Hemos establecido un sistema de turnos, pero la gente sigue trabajando aunque no le toque.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..ref: We have a shift system in place, but people are continuing their work even when it's not their shift.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..dst: Abbiamo stabilito un sistema di turni, ma la gente continua a lavorare anche quando non tocca a lei.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..src: A lo mejor no pueden relajarse en los descansos porque no paran de pensar en todo el trabajo que hay que hacer, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..ref: Maybe they can't relax even while on break because they keep thinking about how much work there is to do?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..dst: Forse non riescono a rilassarsi durante le pause perche' continuano a pensare a tutto il lavoro da fare, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..src: Por si fuera poco, este no es el lugar ideal para descansar y relajarse. Creo que terminan todavía más cansados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..ref: To add to it, this place isn't ideal for resting. It's hard to relax here, and it might even make people feel more tired.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..dst: Per di piu', questo non e' il posto ideale per riposare e rilassarsi. Penso che alla fine si sentano ancora piu' stanchi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..src: La región de Lignumbria tenía una naturaleza exuberante, pero en Auruma solo hay ruinas. Sí que cuesta relajarse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..ref: The Ligneus region had lush nature, but the Auruma region is nothing but ruins. It does make it hard to relax.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..dst: La regione di Lignumbria aveva una natura rigogliosa, ma in Auruma non ci sono che rovine. Davvero non e' facile rilassarsi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..src: Habíamos pensado en crear una zona de descanso, pero aún no hemos hecho nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..ref: The idea of setting up a rest area did come up, but we haven't been able to make any progress on that yet.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..dst: Avevamo pensato di creare una zona di riposo, ma non abbiamo ancora fatto nulla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..src: ¡Anda, una zona de descanso! ¡A mí también me encantaría!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..ref: Oh, a rest area! I want that too!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..dst: Oh, una zona di riposo! Mi piacerebbe molto anche a me!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..src: ¿Y si usamos algún edificio que tengamos ya? Así no habría que hacer mucho esfuerzo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..ref: What if we used one of the existing buildings? Then it could maybe be set up without much work ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..dst: E se usassimo uno degli edifici che abbiamo gia'? Cosi' non ci vorrebbe troppo sforzo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..src: No es mala idea. ¿Podríais buscar un lugar adecuado para montar un centro de relajación?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..ref: That's not a bad idea. In that case, could you see if you can find a suitable location for a relaxation center?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..dst: Non e' una cattiva idea. Potreste cercare un posto adatto per allestire un centro relax?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..src: Nosotros nos encargamos. Con tanto edificio como hay aquí, no creo que nos cueste encontrar un buen sitio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..ref: Will do. Considering how many man-made structures there are here, we should be able to find someplace good.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_010..dst: Ce ne occupiamo noi. Con tutti gli edifici che ci sono qui, non penso che ci costi trovare un buon posto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..src: Más o menos. Estamos buscando un sitio por aquí cerca para montar un centro de relajación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..ref: Kind of. We're looking for somewhere nearby that we can turn into a relaxation center.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..dst: Piu' o meno. Stiamo cercando un posto qui vicino dove allestire un centro relax.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..src: El jefe está preocupado porque el equipo tiene mucho trabajo y nos ha pedido que busquemos un sitio para que descansen.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..ref: The chief is worried about the team being overworked and asked us to find a suitable location for people to recuperate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..dst: Il capo e' preoccupato perche' la squadra e' molto impegnata e ci ha chiesto di trovare un posto dove farla riposare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..src: Entiendo. En ese caso... Ah, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..ref: I see. In that case ... Ah, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..dst: Capisco. In tal caso... Ah, pero'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..ref: Licht, do you have a place in mind?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..dst: Hai qualche posto in mente, Licht?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..src: La verdad es que sí... Según mi información, había una instalación que servía para algo parecido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..ref: Well ... I actually came across some information about a facility that once served a similar purpose.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..dst: In effetti si'... A quanto mi risulta, esisteva una struttura che serviva a qualcosa di simile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..src: ¡Anda! Supongo que tampoco es de extrañar, teniendo en cuenta la cantidad de ruinas que hay por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..ref: So there was one! I guess that's not all that surprisin' considerin' how many ruins there are here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..dst: Oh! Beh, non e' poi cosi' strano, considerando quante rovine ci sono da queste parti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..src: Pero tendréis que disculparme: el ocio no está entre mis prioridades, así que no le seguí la pista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..ref: However, I must apologize. Recreation was quite low on my list of priorities, so I didn't follow the lead.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..dst: Ma dovete scusarmi: il tempo libero e' in fondo alle mie priorita', quindi non ho indagato oltre.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..src: Ya, lo lógico es que el equipo de investigación priorice el estudio de instalaciones de investigación y cosas así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..ref: Well, it only makes sense for the Research Team to prioritize examining research facilities and the like.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..dst: Gia', e' normale che la Squadra di Ricerca dia priorita' allo studio di strutture di ricerca e simili.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..src: Yo también tengo cosas que investigar, pero os avisaré si me entero de algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..ref: I have my own investigations to pursue, but if I happen to learn anything, I'll let you know.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_020..dst: Anch'io ho le mie indagini da portare avanti, ma vi faro' sapere se scopro qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_030..src: Humm... Me da a mí que este sitio no va a servir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_030..ref: Hmm ... This place isn't going to work, huh.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_030..dst: Hmm... A me pare che questo posto non vada bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_030..src: No es nada más que un parque. Aunque lo convirtiéramos en un lugar de descanso, no creo que pudiéramos llamarlo «centro de relajación» exactamente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_030..ref: It's just a plain park. Even if we turned it into a break spot, we couldn't exactly call it a relaxation center.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_030..dst: E' solo un parco qualsiasi. Anche se lo trasformassimo in un punto di riposo, non direi che si possa chiamare "centro relax".

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_040..src: Parece que hay todo tipo de instalaciones por aquí. A lo mejor alguna era un centro de reposo, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_040..ref: There appears to have been a variety of facilities here. Perhaps some of them were recuperation facilities?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_040..dst: Sembra che qui ci siano strutture di ogni tipo. Forse qualcuna era un centro di riposo, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_040..src: No sé... Aunque lo fuera, está todo bastante estropeado. Creo que no lo podríamos reparar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_040..ref: I don't know ... But even if there were some, they're all pretty run-down. I'm not sure we'd be able to fix them ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_040..dst: Non so... anche se lo fosse, e' tutto piuttosto deteriorato. Non credo che riusciremmo a ripararlo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_040..src: Ya, es verdad. Será mejor que sigamos buscando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_040..ref: Yeah, I agree. I think we should keep looking.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_040..dst: Gia', e' vero. Meglio continuare a cercare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_050..src: Pensaba que encontraríamos algo por aquí, pero no veo nada que merezca la pena.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_050..ref: I thought we might find somethin' here, but I'm not seein' anythin' useful.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_050..dst: Pensavo che avremmo trovato qualcosa qui, ma non vedo nulla che valga la pena.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_050..src: Estás tirando la toalla demasiado pronto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_050..ref: You're giving up way too early.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_050..dst: Stai gettando la spugna troppo presto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_050..src: Ahhh, ya estoy mucho mejor. La próxima vez, quiero tomarme unas buenas vacaciones y quedarme más tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_050..ref: Ahh, I feel so much better. Next time, I want to take a long vacation and stay here even longer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_050..dst: Ahhh, ora sto molto meglio. La prossima volta voglio prendermi una bella vacanza e restare piu' a lungo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_050..src: No me extraña que sea una atracción turística. Es como si hubiera ganado diez años de esperanza de vida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_050..ref: No wonder this place is such a highly rated tourist spot. I feel like coming here extended my lifespan by ten years.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_050..dst: Non mi meraviglia che sia una meta turistica. E' come se avessi guadagnato dieci anni di vita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_050..src: Las vistas son preciosas. ¡Me alegro mucho de haber venido! Tenemos que volver algún día.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_050..ref: The scenery here is gorgeous. I'm so glad I came! Let's all come back here again sometime.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_050..dst: Il paesaggio qui e' splendido. Sono davvero felice di essere venuti! Dobbiamo tornarci tutti insieme prima o poi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_050..src: Esto... Parece que sí que he tirado la toalla demasiado rápido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_050..ref: Huh. Guess I did give up too easily.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_050..dst: Ehm... Sembra proprio che abbia gettato la spugna troppo in fretta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_050..src: ¿Un lugar de interés turístico? Podría ser un buen centro de relajación. Vamos a investigar las zonas que conectan con la estación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_050..ref: A tourist spot? That might make a good relaxation center. Let's search the areas that are connected to the station.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_050..dst: Una meta turistica? Potrebbe essere un buon centro relax. Cerchiamo nelle zone collegate alla stazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..src: Anda, ¿tú también has venido a buscar el centro de relajación?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..ref: Oh, did you come here to look into the relaxation center as well?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..dst: Oh, sei venuto anche tu a cercare il centro relax?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..src: No, he llegado siguiendo unas huellas de Alber para preparar la exploración de esta zona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..ref: No, I was led here after following some Alber footprints as part of the preparations for pioneering the area.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..dst: No, sono arrivato seguendo delle impronte di Alber per preparare l'esplorazione di questa zona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..src: La cooperación con los lugareños que vivían aquí cuando no había humanos es crucial para nuestra exploración.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..ref: The cooperation of the locals who lived here while there were no humans is crucial to our pioneering efforts.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..dst: La cooperazione con gli abitanti del posto che vivevano qui quando non c'erano umani e' cruciale per la nostra esplorazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..src: Estamos aquí porque hemos encontrado una pista sobre una atracción turística en la zona. Podría servirnos de centro de relajación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..ref: We're here because we found a lead about a tourist spot in the area that might serve as a good relaxation center.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..dst: Siamo qui perche' abbiamo trovato una pista su una meta turistica della zona. Potrebbe servirci da centro relax.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..src: Ah, ¿en serio? En ese caso, parece que mis prioridades han cambiado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..ref: Oh, really? If that's the case, it seems I had my priorities out of order.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..dst: Oh, davvero? In tal caso, sembra che le mie priorita' siano cambiate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..src: He oído que esta zona estaba bajo dominio de los Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..ref: I've heard this area used to be under Alber management.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..dst: Ho sentito dire che questa zona era sotto la gestione degli Alber.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..src: ¿Bajo dominio de los Alber? Entonces, puede que encontremos alguna aldea Alber por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..ref: Management? We may be able to find an Alber settlement nearby, then.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..dst: Sotto la gestione degli Alber? Allora forse riusciremo a trovare un insediamento Alber da queste parti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..src: Podría ser. De hecho, estaba a punto de empezar a buscarla cuando habéis aparecido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..ref: It's likely. I was just about to start looking into that myself when you all showed up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..dst: Molto probabile. Anzi, stavo proprio per iniziare a cercarlo quando siete apparsi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..src: Genial. Si la encontramos, a lo mejor podemos preguntarles por esa atracción turística.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..ref: Great. If we find them, we might be able to ask them about the tourist spot.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..dst: Perfetto. Se lo troviamo, potremmo anche chiedere loro di quella meta turistica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..src: Parece que nuestros objetivos encajan: trabajemos juntos en la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..ref: It seems our goals are aligned. Let's work together on this investigation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..dst: Sembra che i nostri obiettivi coincidano: lavoriamo insieme a questa indagine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..src: Exacto. Vamos a dividirnos y a empezar a explorar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..ref: Indeed. Let's split up and start searching.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..dst: Esatto. Dividiamoci e iniziamo a esplorare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..src: Así que hay una aldea Alber por aquí cerca... Manos a la obra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..ref: So there's an Alber settlement nearby ... Let's get searching.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_060..dst: Quindi c'e' un insediamento Alber qui vicino... Mettiamoci al lavoro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_070..src: ¿Una corriente de aire...? Oíd, sale una corriente de aire de la grieta de este muro... ¡A lo mejor podemos pasar por aquí!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_070..ref: A draft? ... There's a draft coming from the crack in this wall ... I think there may be a way through here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_070..dst: Una corrente d'aria...? Sentite, esce una corrente d'aria dalla fessura di questo muro... Forse da qui si puo' passare!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_070..src: ¡¿En serio?! ¡Buen hallazgo, Lenja! Vamos a echar un vistazo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_070..ref: Really?! Nice find, Lenja! Let's take a look.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_070..dst: Davvero?! Bella scoperta, Lenja! Andiamo a dare un'occhiata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: ¡Oh, altus! ¡Hacía mucho que no veíamos uno!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: Oh, Tall Ones! It's been a long time since we've seen one of you!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: Oh, altus! Era da tanto che non ne vedevamo uno!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: ¡Hemos encontrado a los Alber!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: We found the Alber!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: Abbiamo trovato gli Alber!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: ¡Bieeen!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: Yay!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: Evviva!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: ¡Nos encantaría que os quedarais aquí a relajaros un poco!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: We'd love it if you stayed here and relaxed!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: Ci farebbe molto piacere che vi restaste qui a rilassarvi un po'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: No hay mucho espacio, pero ¡podéis descansar aquí!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: There's not a lot, but you can take it easy!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: Non c'e' molto spazio, ma qui potete riposarvi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: Gracias. De hecho, queríamos pediros una cosa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: Thanks. But there's actually something we want to ask you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: Grazie. In realta', volevamo chiedervi una cosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: Oh. ¿De qué se trata?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: Ooh? What is it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: Oh. Di cosa si tratta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: Al parecer, antes venían por aquí muchos turistas. ¿Es verdad que los Alber se encargan de este sitio?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: Apparently a place in this area used to draw in a lot of tourists. Is it true the Alber used to manage it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: A quanto pare, una volta qui venivano molti turisti. E' vero che gli Alber si occupavano di questo posto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: ¡Correcto! ¡Por lo visto, iban muchos humanos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: That's right! Apparently, lots of humans used to come visit it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: Esatto! A quanto pare venivano molti umani!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: ¿Os importaría que lo utilizáramos? Necesitamos un lugar para que nuestra gente descanse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: So, about that, would you mind if we used it? We're in need of a place for our people to rest.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: Vi dispiacerebbe se lo usassimo? Ci serve un posto dove far riposare la nostra gente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: ¿Y qué nos daréis a cambio?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: What will you give us in return?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: E cosa ci date in cambio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: ¿C-cómo? ¿A cambio?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: I-in return?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: C-come? In cambio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: ¡Siempre hemos oído que los altus nos recompensarían si venían a pedirnos algo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: We've always heard that the Tall Ones would give us something as thanks whenever they wanted something!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: Ci hanno sempre raccontato che gli altus ci avrebbero ricompensati se fossero venuti a chiederci qualcosa!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: E-eso es verdad... Si vamos a usar sus tierras, tendremos que hacer algo por ellos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: Th-that's true ... If we're going to use their land, we should do something for them too ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: E'-ve' vero... Se useremo le loro terre, dovremo fare qualcosa per loro...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: Tenéis toda la razón. En ese caso...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: You're absolutely right. In that case ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: Avete completamente ragione. In tal caso...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: ¿Y si nos libramos de los monstruos? Hay muchos en esta zona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: What if we get rid of monsters? There are a lot around here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: E se ci liberassimo dei mostri? Ce ne sono tanti in questa zona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: ¡Sí, sí! ¡Si os deshacéis de esos espeluznantes monstruos, nos ocuparemos de todas las gestiones!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: Yes, yes! If you get rid of lots of scary monsters, we'll talk to everyone for you!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: Si', si'! Se vi libererete di quei mostri paurosi, ci occupiamo noi di tutte le pratiche!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: ¡Gracias! Nos pondremos manos a la obra. ¡Esperad aquí!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: Thanks! We'll get right to it, so you just wait here!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: Grazie! Ci metteremo subito al lavoro. Voi aspettate qui!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: ¿Necesitáis algo? Puede ser cualquier cosa, siempre y cuando podamos conseguirla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: Is there anything you want? It can be anything, as long as it's something we're capable of getting.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: Vi serve qualcosa? Puo' essere qualsiasi cosa, purche' possiamo procurarla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: Humm... En un gran bosque muy lejos de aquí, hay un árbol inmenso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: Hmm, hmm ... There's a big forest really far away that has a big, big tree.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: Hmm... In un grande bosco, molto lontano da qui, c'e' un albero immenso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: Al parecer, ¡hay unas flores que parecen hermosos ropajes y otras con un néctar delicioso!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: Apparently there are flowers that look like pretty clothes, and also super yummy nectar from flowers!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: A quanto pare ci sono dei fiori che sembrano splendidi vestiti e altri con un nettare squisito!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: Flores que parecen ropa y flores de néctar delicioso... Vale, lo tengo. Iremos a buscarlo ahora mismo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: Flowers that look like clothes and yummy nectar ... Okay, got it. We'll go get them right away.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: Fiori che sembrano vestiti e fiori dal nettare delizioso... Ok, ho capito. Andiamo a prenderli subito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: ¡Bien! ¡Os estaremos esperando!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: Yay! We'll be waiting!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: Evviva! Vi aspetteremo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: Se me da bastante bien fabricar cosas. ¿Hay algo que queráis?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: I'm pretty good at making things. Is there anything you would want?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: Sono piuttosto bravo a fabbricare cose. C'e' qualcosa che vorreste?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: Humm... ¡Un peluche supermono!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: Umm, umm ... A super super cute stuffed animal!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: Hmm... Un peluche super carino!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: ¡Nos encantan los peluches! ¡Sería genial que nos hicieras alguno!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: We love stuffed animals! We would be so happy if you made us some!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: Adoriamo i peluche! Sarebbe fantastico se ce ne facessi qualcuno!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..src: ¿Peluches? Vale. Os haré algo muy adorable, solo tenéis que esperar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..ref: Plushies? All right. I'll make you something really cute, just you wait.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_080..dst: Peluche? Va bene. Vi faro' qualcosa di adorabile, aspettate e vedrete.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_090..src: ¡Hala, habéis derrotado a los espeluznantes monstruos! ¡Gracias! Ya podemos relajarnos un poquito.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_090..ref: Wow, you defeated all the scary monsters! Thanks! Now we can relax a little.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_090..dst: Wow, avete sconfitto tutti i mostri paurosi! Grazie! Ora possiamo rilassarci un pochino.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_090..src: Cuánto me alegro. Entonces, ¿os importa que montemos nuestro centro de relajación ahí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_090..ref: I'm glad to hear it. Then, is it okay if we set up a relaxation center here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_090..dst: Mi fa molto piacere. Allora, vi dispiace se allestiamo qui il nostro centro relax?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_090..src: ¡Para nada! Eso significa que vendrán muchos más altus por aquí, ¿no? ¡Qué ganas!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_090..ref: Yup! That means a lot more Tall Ones will be coming here, right? I can't wait!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_090..dst: Per niente! Cosi' verranno qui molti altri altus, vero? Non vedo l'ora!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_090..ref: It'll be great for us to relax, too!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_090..dst: A noi fara' benissimo rilassarci un po'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_090..src: Excelente. Vamos a informar al jefe de que hemos encontrado una buena ubicación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_090..ref: Excellent. Let's report to the chief that we found a good location.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_090..dst: Ottimo. Andiamo a riferire al capo che abbiamo trovato una buona ubicazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_100..src: ¡Hala, hala! ¡Gracias! ¡Se van a poner todos muy contentos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_100..ref: Wow, wow! Thank you! Everyone will be so happy!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_100..dst: Wow, wow! Grazie! Tutti saranno felicissimi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_100..dst: Ottimo. Andiamo a riferire al capo che abbiamo trovato una buona ubicazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_110..src: ¡Qué monada! ¡Gracias! ¡Se van a poner todos muy contentos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_110..ref: Wow, it's so cute! Thank you! Everyone will be so happy!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_110..dst: Ma che carino! Grazie! Tutti saranno felicissimi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_110..src: Cuánto me alegro. Entonces, ¿os importa que montemos nuestro centro de relajación ahí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_110..ref: I'm glad to hear it. Then, is it okay if we set up a relaxation center here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_110..dst: Mi fa molto piacere. Allora, vi dispiace se allestiamo qui il nostro centro relax?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_110..src: ¡Para nada! Eso significa que vendrán muchos más altus por aquí, ¿no? ¡Qué ganas!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_110..ref: It'll be great for us to relax, too!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_110..dst: A noi fara' benissimo rilassarci un po'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_110..dst: Ottimo. Andiamo a riferire al capo che abbiamo trovato una buona ubicazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_120..ref: Oh! You found a good place?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_120..dst: Ehi! Avete trovato un buon posto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_120..src: Pues sí. Era un lugar de interés turístico en la época del Imperio, así que las vistas y el clima serán perfectos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_120..ref: We did. It used to be a tourist attraction in the days of the empire, so I think the scenery and climate are suitable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_120..dst: Infatti. Ai tempi dell'Impero era un luogo di interesse turistico, quindi il panorama e il clima saranno perfetti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_120..src: La zona está bajo dominio Alber, pero nos han dado permiso para usarla como centro de relajación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_120..ref: The area is managed by the Alber, but we got their permission to use it as a relaxation center.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_120..dst: La zona e' sotto il dominio degli Alber, ma ci hanno dato il permesso di usarla come centro relax.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_120..src: Genial. Pues organizadlo todo. Mientras tanto, voy a ver quién necesita descansar primero.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_120..ref: Great. Please get things set up, then. In the meantime, I'll figure out which team members should rest first.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_120..dst: Perfetto. Allora organizzate tutto. Nel frattempo, vedro' chi ha bisogno di riposare per primo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_120..src: Cuando todo esté listo, mandaré al primer grupo por allí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_120..ref: Once everything is ready, I'll send the first group over.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_120..dst: Quando tutto sara' pronto, mandero' li' il primo gruppo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_130..src: Vale, construyamos aquí el centro de relajación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_130..ref: Okay, let's build the relaxation center here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_130..dst: Va bene, costruiamo qui il centro relax.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_130..src: Tengo ganas de ver cómo va a quedar. Je, je, estoy empezando a emocionarme.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_130..ref: I wonder how it will turn out. Hehe, I'm starting to get excited.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_130..dst: Non vedo l'ora di vedere come verra'. Eheh, mi sto emozionando.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_140..src: ¡Hala, así que este es nuestro centro de relajación!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_140..ref: Wow, so this is our relaxation center!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_140..dst: Ecco, quindi questo e' il nostro centro relax!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_140..src: No está nada mal. Creo que será un buen lugar para recuperar fuerzas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_140..ref: Not bad. This should be a good place for everyone to recuperate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_140..dst: Non e' affatto male. Sara' un ottimo posto per recuperare le forze.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_140..ref: Well then, let's try it out for ourse—

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_140..src: ¡Muy bien, ya está todo listo! ¡Hay que avisar al jefe!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_140..ref: All right, time to go tell the chief it's done!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_140..dst: Bene, e' tutto pronto! Ora andiamo ad avvisare il capo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_150..src: Jefe, el centro de relajación está listo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_150..ref: Chief, the relaxation center is ready.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_150..dst: Capo, il centro relax e' pronto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_150..src: Estupendo. El primer grupo está preparado. Casi no se tienen en pie.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_150..ref: Great, the first group is ready too. They all look just about ready to pass out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_150..dst: Ottimo, anche il primo gruppo e' pronto. Sembrano tutti sul punto di crollare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_150..src: Está claro que han trabajado muy duro. Vamos a llevarlos al centro lo antes posible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_150..ref: It's clear how hard they've been working. Let's get them to the center as soon as possible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_150..dst: E' evidente quanto abbiano lavorato sodo. Portiamoli al centro il prima possibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_150..src: Eso es. Yo me ocuparé del resto de los preparativos. Descansad vosotros también. Os habéis dejado la piel.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_150..ref: Indeed. I'll finish up the rest of the preparations. You all take a rest too. You worked hard.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_150..dst: Esatto. Mi occupero' io del resto dei preparativi. Riposatevi anche voi. Vi siete fatti in quattro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_160..src: Jefe, ¿el centro de relajación está sirviendo de algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_160..ref: Chief, are people using the relaxation center?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_160..dst: Capo, il centro relax viene usato?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_160..src: El equipo ya se ha acostumbrado a descansar entre turnos. Y ya no hay gente por ahí durmiendo en la base.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_160..ref: Resting at it in shifts seems to be an established practice now. You don't see people spacing out on base anymore.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_160..dst: Ormai sembra che si siano abituati a riposare a turno. Non si vede piu' nessuno che dorme in giro per la base.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_160..src: Humm... La gente ya no tiene pinta de estar a punto de desmayarse... Y el centro tiene buena fama, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_160..ref: Hmm ... Well, no one looks like they're on the verge of collapsing anymore. It has a good reputation too, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_160..dst: Hmm... ormai nessuno sembra sul punto di svenire. E il centro ha anche una buona reputazione, pero'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_160..src: Parece que el equipo sigue agotado mentalmente. No paro de oír suspiros, aunque esté aquí dentro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_160..ref: Everyone still seems mentally exhausted. I'm hearing a lot of deep sighs, even while I'm inside here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_160..dst: Sembra che il gruppo sia ancora mentalmente esausto. Continuo a sentire sospiri profondi, anche se sono qui dentro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_160..src: ¿Mentalmente? Eso significa que no están descansando de verdad, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_160..ref: Mentally? Does that mean they're not actually getting proper rest?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_160..dst: Mentalmente? Vuol dire che in realta' non stanno riposando come si deve, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_160..src: Eso pienso yo o no estarían suspirando todo el día. Vamos a comprobarlo con nuestros propios ojos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_160..ref: Probably. I doubt they would be sighing so much otherwise. Let's go see for ourselves.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_160..dst: Probabile. Altrimenti non sospirerebbero cosi' tanto. Andiamo a vedere con i nostri occhi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_170..src: Por mucho que descanse, no puedo dejar de pensar en el trabajo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_170..ref: Even while my body is resting, for some reason, I just can't stop thinking about work ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_170..dst: Anche se il mio corpo riposa, per qualche motivo non riesco a smettere di pensare al lavoro...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_180..src: Puedo hacer descansos, pero, en cuanto paro un poquito, me pongo de los nervios...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_180..ref: I can take breaks, but without anything to do, I get restless ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_180..dst: Posso fare delle pause, ma se non ho niente da fare, mi agito...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_180..src: Han dicho que nos lo tomemos con calma. Pero, si lo único que hay que hacer es mirar a la nada, igual me da estar aquí que seguir en la base.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_180..ref: I understand being told to take it easy. But if I'm just staring into space, then this is no different than the base.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_180..dst: Capisco che ci abbiano detto di prendercela comoda. Ma se devo solo fissare il vuoto, tanto vale restare alla base.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_190..src: Aquí hace buen tiempo y se respira tranquilidad. Quería relajarme un rato, pero sigo sin fuerzas... No sé por qué.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_190..ref: The weather's good and it's quiet, so I had planned to take it easy, but for some reason, I'm still tired.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_190..dst: Il tempo e' bello e qui e' tranquillo, quindi pensavo di rilassarmi un po', ma per qualche motivo ho ancora addosso la stanchezza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_190..src: Sé que venir a Aladiss es un lujo y que no debería quejarme, pero... Ayyyy...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_190..ref: I know that I'm asking for a lot after coming to Aladiss, but ...<CR>*Sigh*
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_190..dst: So che venire ad Aladiss e' un lusso e non dovrei lamentarmi, ma... Uff...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_200..src: Por mucho que descansen, les sigue faltando algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_200..ref: So even though everyone is getting the rest they need, they still feel like something's off.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_200..dst: Quindi, anche se tutti riescono a riposare quanto serve, hanno comunque la sensazione che manchi qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_200..src: ¿Y si no consiguen relajarse porque no pueden centrarse en el descanso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_200..ref: Is the reason they aren't able to relax while on break because they aren't able to focus on resting?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_200..dst: E' perche' non riescono a concentrarsi sul riposo che non si rilassano durante le pause?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_200..src: Tenemos que mejorar las zonas de descanso. Tienen que ser tan agradables que se relajen sin necesidad de intentarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_200..ref: We need to improve the lodgings here. They need to be so nice that you relax without even trying.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_200..dst: Bisogna migliorare gli alloggi qui. Devono essere cosi' accoglienti da far rilassare chiunque senza nemmeno provarci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_200..src: ¡Pues sí que te lo estás tomando en serio!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_200..dst: Te la stai prendendo proprio a cuore!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_200..src: ¿Sí? Cuando he trabajado en algo, no me gusta dejarlo con unos resultados tan pésimos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_200..ref: Am I? I just don't feel good about letting something I worked on end with such lackluster results.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_200..dst: E' cosi'? E' solo che non mi piace lasciare qualcosa su cui ho lavorato con risultati cosi' scadenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_210..src: Uf... ¡Yo diría que ahora está todo muy acogedor!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_210..ref: Phew ... I think we made things pretty comfortable around here!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_210..dst: Uf... Direi che ora qui e' tutto molto accogliente!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_210..src: Casi ni lo reconozco. Habéis hecho un trabajo estupendo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_210..ref: I almost don't recognize the place. You did a great job.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_210..dst: Quasi non lo riconosco. Avete fatto un ottimo lavoro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_210..src: Espero que ahora puedan relajarse... Deberíamos volver dentro de un tiempo para ver cómo van las cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_210..ref: I hope everyone will be able to relax here now ... We should come back later and see how things are going.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_210..dst: Spero che ora tutti riescano a rilassarsi... Dovremmo tornare piu' tardi per vedere come vanno le cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..src: Hum... Parece que estás agotado. ¿Va todo bien?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..ref: Hm? You look rather tired. Are you okay?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..dst: Hmm... Sembri piuttosto stanco. Va tutto bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..src: Ah, perdonad. Creo que con tanto oírlos suspirar se me está pegando el cansancio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..ref: Ah, apologies. It seems everyone's sighs are starting to get to me too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..dst: Ah, scusate. Credo che a forza di sentire tutti sospirare, la stanchezza stia contagiando anche me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..src: Si siguen suspirando así, ¿es que están igual de cansados?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..ref: If you're still hearing them, does that mean that people are still feeling tired?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..dst: Se continuano a sospirare, vuol dire che sono ancora stanchi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..src: Por desgracia, sí. Parece que vuelven en mejores condiciones, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..ref: Unfortunately, yes. They do seem to be returning in better condition than before, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..dst: Purtroppo si'. Sembra che tornino in condizioni migliori di prima, ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..src: Da la sensación de que están perdiendo la motivación. Por eso se cansan más fácilmente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..ref: It seems that people are losing their sense of motivation, which is making them get worn out more easily.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..dst: Sembra che stiano perdendo la motivazione, e cosi' si stancano piu' facilmente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..src: Es decir, que están agotados emocionalmente. Este asunto puede ser complicado, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..ref: So basically, they're emotionally worn out. This might be a pretty tough problem, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..dst: Quindi, in pratica, sono esausti emotivamente. Potrebbe essere un problema piuttosto difficile, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..src: Sí. Vamos a tener que esforzarnos un poco más para que se nos ocurra algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..ref: Yeah. It sounds like we should have put more effort into brainstorming ideas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..dst: Gia'. A quanto pare avremmo dovuto impegnarci di piu' per trovare delle idee.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..src: Si se os ocurre alguna solución, dadle una oportunidad. Las cosas no pueden seguir así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..ref: If you can come up with any solutions, please give them a shot. We can't let things go on like this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_220..dst: Se vi viene in mente qualche soluzione, provateci. Non possiamo lasciare che le cose continuino cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..src: ¡Hala, hay Alber por aquí! A lo mejor han visto lo animada que estaba la cosa y han venido a echar un ojo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..ref: Wow, there are Alber here! I wonder if they saw how lively things have become and came to take a look.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..dst: Wow, ci sono Alber da queste parti! Chissa' se hanno visto quanto e' diventato vivace il posto e sono venuti a dare un'occhiata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..src: Hola. Este sitio empieza a parecer la atracción turística que era en su época, ¿eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..ref: Hey. This place is startin' to look like the tourist spot from back in the day, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..dst: Ehi. Questo posto sta cominciando a sembrare l'attrazione turistica di una volta, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..src: ¿En su época? Por entonces había más altus. ¡Tenía que ser superdivertido!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..ref: Back in the day? Back then there were more Tall Ones. It sounds like it was really fun!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..dst: Di una volta? Allora c'erano piu' Alti. Doveva essere divertentissimo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..src: Todo el mundo se metía en una bañera enooorme, todos calentitos y felices.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..ref: Everyone would get in a huuuge bath, all toasty and happy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..dst: Tutti si infilavano in una vasca enooorme, belli al caldo e felici.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..src: ¿En serio? ¿Una bañera enorme? ¿Aquí había aguas termales?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..ref: Huh? Huge bath? Was this a hot spring before?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..dst: Eh? Una vasca enorme? Prima qui c'erano delle terme?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..ref: That's right! A hot spring! A really great one!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..src: Así que aguas termales, ¿eh? Un momento, eso significa que la fuente debería estar cerca, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..ref: A hot spring, huh? Wait, doesn't that mean its source should be around here somewhere?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..dst: Acque termali, eh? Aspetta, allora la sorgente dovrebbe essere qui nei dintorni, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..src: Sí. Si la encontramos y volvemos a poner esas aguas termales en funcionamiento, ¡podría ser aún más relajante!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..ref: Yeah. If we find that and make a hot spring, that would make this place more relaxing!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..dst: Gia'. Se la troviamo e rimettiamo in funzione quelle acque termali, questo posto diventera' ancora piu' rilassante!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..src: P-pero ¿dónde podría estar? Si el lugar quedó abandonado, seguro que la fuente está enterrada...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..ref: B-but where could it be? If it was abandoned, the source is probably buried now ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..dst: M-ma dove potrebbe essere? Se il posto e' stato abbandonato, probabilmente la sorgente e' sepolta ormai...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..src: Es posible. Tendremos que buscar la forma de dar con ella. Humm...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..ref: That's a possibility. We'll have to come up with a way to search for it. Hmm ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..dst: Potrebbe essere. Dovremo trovare un modo per cercarla. Mmh...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..src: ¡Pues claro! Podemos usar el dispositivo de rastreo de antes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..ref: I've got it! We can use the tracking device from before.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..dst: Trovato! Possiamo usare il dispositivo di tracciamento di prima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..src: Con un par de ajustes, debería hacerlo. Aunque no nos servirá de nada si no hay un manantial que encontrar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..ref: With a little tinkering, it should. It'll be pointless if there isn't actually any spring to find, though ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..dst: Con un paio di ritocchi, dovrebbe. Anche se non servirebbe a niente se non ci fosse davvero una sorgente da trovare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..src: Vamos a buscar a mano, como investigadores de verdad. A lo mejor encontramos algo interesante si buscamos sitios que nos parezcan sospechosos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..ref: Let's search on foot like proper investigators. We might find something if we search suspicious-looking spots.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..dst: Cerchiamo con le nostre mani, da veri investigatori. Potremmo trovare qualcosa di interessante se ispezioniamo i posti che ci sembrano sospetti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..src: Esperaba que pudiéramos resolver todo esto con alquimia. Está empezando a ser un incordio...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..ref: I was hopin' you could just solve this with alchemy. This is becomin' a huge pain ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..dst: Speravo che potessimo risolvere tutto con l'alchimia. Sta diventando una grande scocciatura...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..src: Me sabe mal porque están muy cansados, pero ¿y si les pedimos a los demás que nos echen una mano? Cuantos más seamos, mejor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..ref: I feel bad since they're so tired, but how about asking the other team members to help? There's power in numbers.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..dst: Mi dispiace perche' sono molto stanchi, ma e se chiedessimo agli altri membri di darci una mano? L'unione fa la forza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..src: Es verdad. Tampoco es justo que busquemos nosotros solos. Venga, vamos a reunir a todo el equipo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..ref: That's right. It wouldn't be fair if we were the only ones lookin'. Okay, let's go round everyone up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_230..dst: Hai ragione. Non sarebbe giusto cercare solo noi. Dai, andiamo a radunare tutti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_240..src: Sí, hemos detectado la fuente de las aguas termales.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_240..ref: Yes. The spring's source has been detected.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_240..dst: Si', abbiamo rilevato la sorgente delle acque termali.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_240..ref: All right! Let's check it out!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_241..src: Humm, creo que por aquí no hay nada. Vamos a mirar en otro sitio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_241..ref: Hmm, I don't think there's anything around here. Better look somewhere else.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_241..dst: Hmm, credo che qui in zona non ci sia niente. Meglio cercare in un altro posto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..src: Ya veo... Vale, voy a hablar con los demás y a pedirles que nos ayuden a buscar la fuente del manantial.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..ref: I see ... Okay. I'll explain what's going on to the other members and tell them to look for the spring's source.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..dst: Capisco... Va bene, parlero' con gli altri e chiedero' loro di aiutarci a cercare la sorgente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..ref: Thank you so much. Phew, that's a relief ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..src: Por supuesto. Pero... ya que vamos a ayudaros con esto, tenemos que pediros otro favor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..ref: Sure. But, well ... If we're going to be doing this, there's something I want to ask of you as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..dst: Certo. Ma... siccome vi daremo una mano con questa cosa, dobbiamo chiedervi un altro favore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..src: Si es posible, ¿podrías usar la alquimia para hacernos unas armaduras?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..ref: If it's possible, can you use alchemy to make us some armor?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..dst: Se possibile, potresti usare l'alchimia per crearci delle armature?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..src: Si eso es todo, por supuesto. Pero ¿para qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..ref: If that's all it is, then sure. But why?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..dst: Se e' solo questo, certo. Ma per che cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..src: Hay gente que se ha hecho daño luchando contra monstruos y todavía no se ha recuperado del todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..ref: Some people are here because they got hurt fighting monsters and their injuries haven't fully recovered yet.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..dst: C'e' chi si e' fatto male combattendo contro i mostri e non si e' ancora ripreso del tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..src: Por mucho que descansen, no se les van a curar las heridas de repente. Por eso, queremos que se pongan una buena armadura.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..ref: Getting rid of their fatigue won't fully cure their injuries. That's why I'd like to put them in some good armor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..dst: Per quanto riposino, le loro ferite non guariranno di colpo. Per questo vogliamo fargli indossare una buona armatura.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..src: Vale, ya entiendo. No puedo ofreceros armaduras para todos, pero puedo hacer cinco conjuntos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..ref: Okay, I hear what you're saying. I can't provide enough for everyone, but I can give you five sets.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..dst: Va bene, ho capito. Non posso fornire armature a tutti, ma posso realizzarvi cinque set.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..src: Sería de gran ayuda. Nosotros nos ocupamos de encontrar el manantial.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..ref: That would be a huge help. Leave finding the spring to us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_250..dst: Sarebbe un grande aiuto. Alla ricerca della sorgente pensiamo noi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_260..src: ¡Esto sí que es una armadura sólida! Va a ser de gran ayuda para proteger a los heridos. ¡Nos haces un gran apaño!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_260..ref: Now this is some solid armor! These should definitely keep our injured team members safe. You're a lifesaver!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_260..dst: Questa si' che e' un'armatura robusta! Servira' sicuramente a proteggere i feriti. Sei un salvatore!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_260..src: No ha sido nada. ¿Habéis hecho algún avance en la búsqueda del manantial?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_260..ref: It was nothing. So, has there been any progress made towards finding the spring?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_260..dst: Non e' stato niente. Avete fatto progressi nella ricerca della sorgente?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_260..src: Sí. Hemos encontrado un sitio donde podría ocultarse la fuente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_260..ref: Yes. We found a location that we suspect is hiding the source.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_260..dst: Si'. Abbiamo trovato un posto in cui potrebbe nascondersi la sorgente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_260..src: Pero no estamos seguros de que se pueda volver a usar como agua termal. ¿Podríais seguir vosotros a partir de aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_260..ref: But we aren't sure whether it can still be used as a hot spring. Can I ask you to take over from here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_260..dst: Ma non siamo sicuri che si possa ancora usare come acqua termale. Potreste occuparvene voi da qui in poi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_260..src: ¡Por supuesto! ¡Muchas gracias! Sabía que el equipo de investigación podría encontrar la fuente sin problemas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_260..ref: Of course! Thank you so much! I knew the Research Team would be able to find it no problem.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_260..dst: Certamente! Grazie mille! Sapevo che la Squadra di Ricerca l'avrebbe trovata senza problemi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..src: El suelo está húmedo por aquí... Esta zona parece prometedora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..ref: The soil here is moist ... This area certainly seems promising.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..dst: Il terreno e' umido da queste parti... Questa zona sembra promettente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..src: Pero ¿significa eso que el manantial está aquí...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..ref: But does that really mean the spring is here ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..dst: Ma questo vuol dire che la sorgente e' qui...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..ref: Rutger, lend me your scythe quick.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..dst: Rutger, prestami la tua falce, fai veloce.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..src: Oye, mi guadaña no es un pico, ¡¿te enteras?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..ref: Listen you, my scythe ain't a pickaxe, got it?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..dst: Ehi, la mia falce non e' un piccone, capito?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..src: Ya, pero la hice yo, así que me la puedes prestar un ratito, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..ref: Yeah, but I'm the one who made it. You can let me use it a little bit, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..dst: Gia', ma l'ho fatta io, quindi puoi prestarmela un attimino, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..ref: There's water welling up ... It's so warm!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..dst: Sta uscendo l'acqua... Che calda che e'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..src: Menos mal que no se ha secado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..ref: Thank goodness it hadn't dried up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..dst: Meno male che non si e' prosciugata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..src: Ya lo entiendo. Todo esto se usaba para las aguas termales.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..ref: I get it now. All the stuff around here was originally used for the hot spring.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..dst: Ora ho capito. Tutto questo veniva usato per le acque termali.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..src: Si conseguimos restaurarlas, podremos convertir este lugar en unos baños al aire libre para todo el mundo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..ref: If we can restore it, we can turn it into an open-air bath for everyone to use!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_270..dst: Se riusciamo a ripristinarle, potremo trasformare questo posto in bagni all'aperto per tutti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..src: ¡G-guau! ¡Ya tenemos unos baños al aire libre! ¡Qué pasada!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..ref: W-wow! We have an open-air bath now! Amazing!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..dst: W-wow! Finalmente abbiamo dei bagni all'aperto! Fantastico!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..src: Con esto, el centro debería ser mucho más relajante... Aunque eso mismo pensábamos la última vez.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..ref: This should make the center a lot more relaxing, but that's what we said last time, too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..dst: Con questo il centro dovrebbe diventare molto piu' rilassante... Anche se la volta scorsa pensavamo la stessa cosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..src: Ya. Habrá que probarlo para ver si consigue bajar el estrés...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..ref: Yeah. It needs to be tested to see if it will really melt stress away ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..dst: Gia'. Bisognera' provarli per vedere se riescono davvero a togliere lo stress...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..src: Pues... podríamos ser los primeros en probarlos, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..ref: ... So we can be the first ones to use it, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..dst: Allora... potremmo essere i primi a provarli, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..src: Bueno, supongo que no le hará daño a nadie que nos demos el gusto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..ref: Well, I suppose it wouldn't hurt to indulge ourselves a little.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..dst: Beh, suppongo che concedersi un piccolo lusso non faccia male a nessuno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..src: Puf... Qué a gustito se está en el agua. Noto cómo se me relajan los músculos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..ref: Phew ... The water feels great. I can feel my stiff muscles relaxing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..dst: Uff... Che piacere stare nell'acqua. Sento i muscoli irrigiditi rilassarsi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..src: Totalmente. Y las vistas desde los baños son preciosas. Le van a encantar a todo el mundo, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..ref: No kidding. And the view from the bath is gorgeous. Everyone is going to love it here, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..dst: Davvero. E la vista dai bagni e' splendida. Piaceranno a tutti, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..src: Je, je. Bueno, ya hemos fallado dos veces, a la tercera va la vencida. Con esto seguro que se relajan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..ref: Hehe. Well, we already missed the mark twice, so third time's the charm. This will definitely get people to relax.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..dst: Eheh. Beh, abbiamo gia' sbagliato due volte: la terza e' quella buona. Cosi' di sicuro si rilasseranno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..src: Nunca se sabe. A lo mejor sigue habiendo gente que no nota mejoría.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..ref: You never know, some people might still end up complainin' about not feelin' any different from before.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..dst: Non si sa mai. Puo' darsi che ci sia ancora gente che non nota alcun miglioramento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..ref: Hey, you're going to jinx us! Stop that, stop it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..dst: Ehi, non portare sfortuna! Taci, taci!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..ref: Bwah—?! What do you think you're doin'?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..dst: Aah...?! Ma che ti credi di fare?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..src: ¡Ay, no, n-no os peleéis, por favor!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_280..dst: Oh no, v-vi prego, non litigate!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_290..src: Me he enterado de lo de los baños al aire libre. ¿Cómo lo habéis hecho?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_290..ref: I heard about the open-air bath. How were you able to manage that?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_290..dst: Ho saputo dei bagni all'aperto. Come avete fatto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_290..src: Solo hemos restaurado el manantial que había antes. ¿Y bien? ¿Cómo está la gente?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_290..ref: All we did was restore the hot spring that used to be there. So, how are people feeling?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_290..dst: Abbiamo solo ripristinato la sorgente che c'era prima. E quindi? Come sta la gente?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_290..src: Solo he oído decir cosas buenas. Habéis hecho un gran trabajo, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_290..ref: I've heard nothing but good things. You did good work, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_290..dst: Ho sentito solo parli positivi. Avete fatto un ottimo lavoro, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_290..src: Si queréis, podéis ir a echar un vistazo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_290..ref: If you'd like, you can go take a look for yourself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_290..dst: Se volete, potete andare a dare un'occhiata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_290..src: Tienes razón. Después de todo lo que nos hemos esforzado, deberíamos ir a ver.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_290..ref: You're right. After all that work, we should.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_290..dst: Hai ragione. Dopo tutto lo sforzo che ci siamo fatti, dovremmo andare a vedere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..src: Anda, pero si es nuestra alquimista. El baño que habéis instalado es una maravilla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..ref: Oh hey, there's our alchemist. The bath you set up is great.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..dst: Oh, ecco la nostra alchimista. Il bagno che avete installato e' una meraviglia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..src: Pues sí, hacía mucho que no estiraba las piernas y me quedaba un buen rato en remojo. Gracias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..ref: Yeah, I haven't gotten to stretch my legs and soak in a bath in a long time. Thank you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..dst: Si', era da tanto che non stiravo le gambe e mi restavo un bel po' in ammollo. Grazie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..src: No hay de qué. ¿Estáis menos cansados que antes?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..ref: Oh, no problem. Are you feeling less fatigued now?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..dst: Non c'e' di che. Vi sentite meno stanchi di prima?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..src: Totalmente. Dentro de nada, estoy aquí otra vez.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..ref: Sure am. I'll be visiting again soon.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..dst: Assolutamente. Tra poco tornero' di nuovo qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..src: ¡Anda, hay Alber! ¿También habéis usado los baños?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..ref: Oh, Alber! Did you use the bath too?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..dst: Oh, c'e' Alber! Anche voi avete usato i bagni?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..src: ¡Sí! ¡Se estaba supercalentito!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..ref: Yes! It was so warm!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..dst: Si'! Era cosi' caldino!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..src: Qué bien. ¿Estaba a la altura de tus expectativas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..ref: That's great. Did it live up to your expectations?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..dst: Che bene. Era all'altezza delle tue aspettative?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..src: Humm... Bueno, antes había maná en el agua, pero ahora no se nota. Eso me ha dado un poco de pena.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..ref: Hmm ... Well, there used to be mana in the water. But you can't really feel it now, so that's a little sad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..dst: Hmm... Beh, prima nell'acqua c'era mana, ma adesso non si percepisce piu'. E' un po' un peccato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..src: Ajá. Es como que falta algo. Ahora son aguas termales normales y corrientes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..ref: Uh-huh. It feels kind of lonely, too. It's just regular old hot water now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..dst: Ah-ah. Si', come se mancasse qualcosa. Adesso sono acque termali normali e correnti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..src: ¿Antes el agua contenía maná? ¿Por eso eran tan populares estos baños?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..ref: So the spring's source used to be infused with mana? Was that why it was so popular?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..dst: Prima l'acqua conteneva mana? E' per questo che questi bagni erano cosi' popolari?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..src: ¡Exacto!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..ref: Exactly!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..dst: Esatto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..src: Maná en el agua... Falta algo... ¡Vale, en ese caso...!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..ref: Mana in the spring's water ... It feels lonely ... Okay, in that case—
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..dst: Mana nell'acqua... Manca qualcosa... Va bene, in tal caso...!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..src: ¡Solo tenemos que añadir un poco de maná al agua y los baños serán todavía mejores!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..ref: All we need to do is add some mana to the water and the bath will be even better!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..dst: Basta aggiungere un po' di mana all'acqua e i bagni saranno ancora migliori!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..src: ¿Flammi?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..ref: Flammi?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..dst: Flammi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..src: Yumia, Flammi ha llegado a una conclusión basándose en la anterior conversación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..ref: Yumia. Flammi has come to a conclusion based on the previous conversation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..dst: Yumia, Flammi e' giunta a una conclusione basandosi sulla conversazione precedente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..src: Parece que el maná se extraía del suelo y se aprovechaba con un dispositivo especial.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..ref: It appears that mana was extracted from the ground and utilized by means of a special device.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..dst: Sembra che il mana venisse estratto dal suolo e sfruttato tramite un dispositivo speciale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..src: Después de verificar la estructura, Flammi ha determinado que deberías poder recrearlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..ref: Its overall structure has been verified, so you should be able to recreate it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..dst: Dopo aver verificato la struttura, Flammi ha stabilito che dovresti riuscire a ricrearlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..src: ¡Hala! ¡Voy a intentar fabricarlo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..ref: Wow! Then I'll try making that!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..dst: Wow! Provero' a costruirlo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..src: A lo mejor podemos mejorar el paisaje todavía más. Solo tendría que preparar un par de cosas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..ref: And it should also be possible to improve the landscape even more. I just need to set up a few things ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..dst: Chissa', potremmo migliorare ulteriormente il paesaggio. Dovrei solo preparare un paio di cose...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..src: Cuando se le mete algo entre ceja y ceja, no hay quien la pare...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..ref: You really can't stop her once she sets her sights on making something ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..dst: Quando si mette qualcosa in testa, nessuno riesce a fermarla...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..src: Se nota que su padre tenía una tienda de herramientas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..ref: That's the daughter of a tool shop owner for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_300..dst: Si vede proprio che suo padre aveva un negozio di attrezzi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..src: ¡Vale! Ya tenemos unas aguas termales cargadas de maná. Las llamaré... ¡«Las mejores aguas termales de maná del mundo»!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..ref: Okay! This is now a mana-infused hot spring. And I'll name it ... "World's Best Mana Hot Springs"!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..dst: Perfetto! Ora abbiamo delle acque termali piene di mana. Le chiamero'... "Le migliori acque termali al mana del mondo"!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..src: Pero, si tienen maná, no serán una amenaza parecida a las zonas de vínculo de maná, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..ref: If it's infused with mana, it won't pose any threats similar to the manabound areas, will it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..dst: Ma, se contengono mana, non saranno una minaccia simile alle zone di legame del mana, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..src: N-no habrá ningún problema. La concentración de maná es baja y no hará ningún daño a los humanos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..ref: I-it'll be okay. The mana concentration isn't high enough to cause negative side effects in humans.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..dst: N-non ci sara' nessun problema. La concentrazione di mana e' bassa e non causera' alcun danno agli esseri umani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..src: Como el maná es nuestra fuente de vitalidad, ¡una concentración reducida es revitalizante!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..ref: Because mana is the source of our vitality, a small concentration actually has the power to invigorate you!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..dst: Poiche' il mana e' la nostra fonte di vitalita', una concentrazione ridotta e' rivitalizzante!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..src: Os garantizo que ahora va a ser todavía más relajante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..ref: I guarantee that it'll be even more relaxing than before.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..dst: Vi garantisco che adesso sara' ancora piu' rilassante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..src: ¡Sí! ¡Deberíamos probarlas para ver cuáles son sus efectos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..ref: Yeah! We'd better test it out to see what kind of effects it has!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..dst: Si'! Dovremmo provarle per vedere quali sono i loro effetti!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..ref: ... We need to test it out.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..src: Sí, solo para ver si funcionan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..ref: Yeah, in order to prove that it works.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..dst: Si', solo per vedere se funzionano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..src: Yu... Yumia... ¿Qué está pasando? Me está sentando genial... Ahhh... Pero ¿qué es esto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..ref: Yu ... Yumia ... What's going on? This feels amazing ... Ahh ... What is this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..dst: Yu... Yumia... Cosa sta succedendo? Mi sta facendo un benessere... Ahhh... Ma cos'e' questa cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..src: Es como si toda la tensión se desvaneciera de mi cuerpo... Peso tan poco como una pluma...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..ref: It's like all of the tension is leaving my body ... I feel so light ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..dst: E' come se tutta la tensione svanisse dal mio corpo... Peso come una piuma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..src: Ese es el efecto del maná... En la concentración adecuada, puede aliviar hasta los huesos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..ref: That's the effect of the mana ... With the right concentration, it soothes you all the way to your bones ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..dst: Questo e' l'effetto del mana... Alla concentrazione giusta, puo' rilassare fino alle ossa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..src: Mirad qué relajada está Lenja, está en su mundo. Parece que está notando los efectos más que nadie.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..ref: Lenja is so relaxed, she's totally out of it. Looks like she's feeling the effects more than any of us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..dst: Guardate come e' rilassata Lenja, e' nel suo mondo. Sembra che stia sentendo gli effetti piu' di tutti.
Fa niente se mi concedo un pisolino?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..src: Creo que yo también me voy a quedar en remojo un ratito... Pero esto significa que... hemos hecho un buen trabajo, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..ref: I might fall asleep like this. Is this all right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..dst: Penso che anch'io mi restero' in ammollo ancora un po'... Ma questo significa che... abbiamo fatto un buon lavoro, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..src: Yumia... Te puedo garantizar... que has hecho un trabajo estupendo. Nadie puede salir cansado de este sitio...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..ref: I also feel like I might end up taking a nice long bath ... But this means ... we did a good job, right?
