eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..dst: Yumia... Ti posso garantire... che hai fatto un lavoro magnifico. Nessuno puo' uscire stanco da questo posto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..src: Creo que ya va siendo hora de que salgamos... Todo el mundo arriba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..ref: Yumia ... I guarantee ... that you did a fantastic job. Not a single person will walk away from this feeling tired ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_310..dst: Penso che sia arrivata l'ora di uscire... Tutti su.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..src: ¡Qué buen trabajo! Habéis hecho un favor enorme a la comunidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..ref: You all did fantastic! You've made a huge contribution to our community.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..dst: Che ottimo lavoro! Avete fatto un enorme favore alla comunita'.
Wow! M-ma che cosa abbiamo fatto?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..src: Me refiero a los baños al aire libre. Lo que habéis hecho es alucinante. Todo el mundo que va los pone por las nubes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..ref: I'm talking about the open-air bath. You made something incredible. Everyone who's visited is giving it high praise.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..dst: Mi riferisco ai bagni all'aperto. Quello che avete fatto e' incredibile. Tutti quelli che li visitano ne parlano a meraviglia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..src: Sí. No solo se encuentran mejor físicamente, sino también a nivel mental. Están más motivados que nunca.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..ref: Yes. Not only are they feeling physically better, but mentally, too. Everyone is more motivated than ever.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..dst: Si'. Non solo si sentono meglio fisicamente, ma anche a livello mentale. Sono piu' motivati che mai.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..src: Estoy deseando ir yo también y dejar que el agotamiento se disuelva en el agua.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..ref: I'm looking forward to going and washing my fatigue away myself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..dst: Non vedo l'ora di andarci anch'io e lasciare che la stanchezza si dissolva nell'acqua.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..src: Qué bien. ¡Lo hemos conseguido, señorita Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..ref: That's great. We did it, Miss Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..dst: Che bene. Ce l'abbiamo fatta, Signorina Yumia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..src: Pues sí. Me alegro mucho de que hayamos podido ayudar al equipo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..ref: We did. I'm really glad we were able to do something good for everyone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..dst: Infatti. Sono davvero contenta che siamo riusciti a aiutare la squadra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..src: Lamento que haya sido tanto trabajo, pero gracias por el esfuerzo. Ahora todo el mundo está como nuevo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..ref: I'm sorry it turned into so much work. But thanks to your efforts, everyone is as good as new.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..dst: Mi dispiace che sia stato cosi' tanto lavoro, ma grazie per lo sforzo. Ora tutti sono come nuovi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..src: Os doy las gracias en nombre de todo el equipo. Muchas gracias por todo, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..ref: On behalf of the entire team, thank you so much. I really appreciate it, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..dst: Vi ringrazio a nome di tutta la squadra. Grazie mille per tutto, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..src: Le has levantado el ánimo a todo el mundo y has devuelto la vida a estas tierras. Deberías estar orgullosa, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..ref: You've lifted everyone's spirits and brought life back to the land. You should be proud, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..dst: Hai rialzato il morale a tutti e hai ridato vita a queste terre. Dovresti essere fiera, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..src: Gracias... Es que no esperaba que todo el mundo acabara tan contento con los baños...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..ref: Thank you ... I just wasn't expecting everyone to be so thrilled about it ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..dst: Grazie... E' che non mi aspettavo che tutti fossero cosi' felici dei bagni...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..src: Todo el esfuerzo ha merecido la pena. Muchas gracias por vuestra ayuda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..ref: All the hard work to see this through to the end was worth it. Thank you so much for your help, everyone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm03_320..dst: Tutto lo sforzo ne e' valso la pena. Grazie mille per il vostro aiuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..src: Por fin ha llegado la hora de empezar a trabajar en nuestro objetivo principal. Dan comienzo la investigación y la exploración de la capital.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..ref: It's finally time to begin working on our main goal. Our investigation and pioneering of the capital starts now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..dst: Finalmente e' arrivato il momento di lavorare al nostro obiettivo principale. Iniziano le indagini e l'esplorazione della capitale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..src: Como todos sabéis, esta ciudad era el corazón del Imperio aladissiano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..ref: As you all know, this city was once the heart of the Aladissian Empire.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..dst: Come tutti sapete, questa citta' era il cuore dell'Impero Aladissiano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..src: Podemos afirmar con bastante seguridad que aquí encontraremos más reliquias de la antigua civilización.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..ref: It's safe to say that this is where most of the relics of the former civilization will be concentrated.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..dst: Possiamo affermare con buona certezza che qui troveremo la maggior parte delle reliquie dell'antica civilta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..src: Sé que no es tarea fácil, pero quiero que os esforcéis al máximo para explorar hasta el último rincón de la ciudad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..ref: I know this is difficult work, but I want you to put your all into exploring every nook and cranny of the city.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..dst: So che non e' un compito facile, ma voglio che vi impegniate al massimo per esplorare ogni angolo della citta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..src: El corazón del Imperio... Seguro que hay todo tipo de cosas de gran valor histórico esperando a que las descubramos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..ref: The heart of the Empire ... I bet there are a lot of historically valuable discoveries just waiting to be found.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..dst: Il cuore dell'Impero... Di sicuro ci sono ogni sorta di cose di grande valore storico che aspettano solo di essere scoperte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..src: Pues sí. Quiero que descubramos todo lo que haya por descubrir. Ya he marcado algunas ubicaciones para investigar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..ref: Indeed. I'd like for us to learn everything there is to learn. I've already marked some locations for you to investigate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..dst: Esatto. Voglio che scopriamo tutto cio' che c'e' da scoprire. Ho gia' segnato alcune posizioni da investigare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..src: Según la información que nos ha proporcionado Nina, la capital está dividida en tres distritos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..ref: According to the information Nina provided us, the capital is divided into three districts.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..dst: Secondo le informazioni che ci ha fornito Nina, la capitale e' divisa in tre distretti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..src: El cementerio imperial, el distrito comercial y el distrito administrativo. Todos son importantes, pero primero vamos a centrarnos en el distrito administrativo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..ref: The imperial graveyard, the commercial district, and the administrative district. While each is important, let's start by turning our attention to the administrative district.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..dst: Il cimitero imperiale, il distretto commerciale e il distretto amministrativo. Tutti sono importanti, ma prima concentriamoci sul distretto amministrativo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..src: Creo que, si investigamos el lugar desde el que se gobernaba, entenderemos mejor cómo era Aladiss en conjunto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..ref: By investigating where the government was once run, we should gain an understanding of Aladiss as a whole.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..dst: Penso che, se investighiamo il luogo da cui si governava, capiremo meglio com'era Aladiss nel complesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..src: Eso sí, tened en cuenta que el distrito administrativo está lleno de puertas cerradas. Quiero que investiguéis las ruinas que haya tras ellas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..ref: I should note, the administrative district is filled with locked gates. I'd like you to search the ruins behind them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..dst: Detto questo, tenete presente che il distretto amministrativo e' pieno di porte chiuse. Voglio che investighiate le rovine che si trovano dietro di esse.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..src: Sería estupendo que trabajaseis en la investigación del distrito administrativo mientras le seguís la pista a Basilius.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..ref: I would appreciate it if you could work on investigating the administrative district while you track down Basilius.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..dst: Sarebbe stupendo se vi occupaste dell'investigazione del distretto amministrativo mentre seguite le tracce di Basilius.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..src: Entendido. Daremos prioridad a los dos objetivos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_010..dst: Capito. Daremo priorita' a entrambi gli obiettivi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_020..ref: What do you think this facility could be?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_020..dst: Secondo voi, cosa poteva essere questa struttura?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_020..src: Estuve poco tiempo en la capital, pero no recuerdo haber visto un edificio como este...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_020..ref: My time in the capital was rather short, but I don't think I recall seeing a building like this ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_020..dst: Il mio soggiorno nella capitale e' stato piuttosto breve, ma non ricordo di aver visto un edificio come questo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_020..src: Entonces seguro que merece la pena investigarlo bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_020..ref: It should be worth investigating then.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_020..dst: Allora di sicuro vale la pena investigarlo a fondo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..src: Bueno, ya sabemos qué es este sitio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..ref: Well, we know what this place is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..dst: Bene, ora sappiamo che cos'e' questo posto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..src: Exacto. Sin duda, aquí tenían a gente encerrada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..ref: Exactly. Without a doubt, people were held here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..dst: Esatto. Senza dubbio, qui tenevano le persone rinchiuse.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..src: Qué siniestro... ¿Para qué tendrían algo así en la capital?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..ref: That's scary ... Why would they have something like this in the capital?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..dst: Che inquietante... Perche' avrebbero avuto una cosa del genere nella capitale?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..src: Pues porque les haría falta, supongo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..ref: Because they needed it, I suppose.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..dst: Beh, perche' ne avrebbero avuto bisogno, suppongo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..src: ¿Les hacía falta encerrar a gente?... Pensaba que Aladiss había sido un lugar pacífico hasta la caída del Imperio...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..ref: They needed to lock people up? ... I thought Aladiss was supposed to be peaceful until its collapse ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..dst: Avevano bisogno di rinchiudere la gente?... Pensavo che Aladiss fosse stata un luogo pacifico fino alla caduta dell'Impero...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..src: Pues esto sugiere que no era así, al menos en sus últimos años.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..ref: This would indicate that wasn't actually the case during the empire's final years.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..dst: Ebbene, questo suggerisce che non era cosi', almeno nei suoi ultimi anni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..src: Parece que lo que provocó la caída del imperio fue lo suficientemente serio como para hacer que necesitaran una cárcel como esta...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..ref: So basically, whatever led to its downfall was bad enough to necessitate this jail ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..dst: Sembra che cio' che ha provocato la caduta dell'impero fosse abbastanza grave da rendere necessaria una prigione come questa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..src: Puede que Aladiss no fuera el paraíso que nos imaginamos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..ref: Aladiss may not have been the paradise we imagined it to be.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_030..dst: Potrebbe essere che Aladiss non fosse il paradiso che immaginavamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_040..src: Según este diseño, parece que era algún tipo de espacio para deliberar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_040..ref: Based on its layout, it seems to have been some sort of place for discussion.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_040..dst: In base alla sua disposizione, sembra che fosse una sorta di spazio per deliberare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_040..src: ¿Por qué tipo de delitos juzgarían a la gente?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_040..ref: What kind of crimes would they have been trying people for though?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_040..dst: Per quale tipo di crimini avrebbero giudicato la gente?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_040..src: El emperador de Aladiss tenía un poder absoluto. Oponerse a él de cualquier manera se consideraba directamente una traición.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_040..ref: Aladiss's emperor held absolute power. Doing anything to oppose him was immediately deemed to be treason.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_040..dst: L'imperatore di Aladiss aveva un potere assoluto. Opporsi a lui in qualsiasi modo veniva considerato direttamente un tradimento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_040..src: Si se celebraban juicios en este sitio, seguro que la mayoría era por casos de ese tipo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_040..ref: If trials were held here, the majority of them were probably for cases like that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_040..dst: Se si tenevano processi in questo posto, di sicuro la maggioranza riguardava casi di quel tipo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_040..src: ¿Traición? Creo que no me haría ninguna gracia vivir en un país con un gobierno como ese...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_040..ref: Treason? I don't think I would like living in a country ruled by someone like that ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_040..dst: Tradimento? Penso che non mi farebbe alcuna grazia vivere in un paese governato in quel modo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_040..src: Pero, a cambio, se prometía una vida próspera los ciudadanos. La cosa es que cada persona puede tener una idea distinta de prosperidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_040..ref: But in return, the citizens were promised affluent lives. Though, one's view of that differs from person to person.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_040..dst: Ma, in cambio, ai cittadini veniva promessa una vita prospera. Il punto e' che ognuno puo' avere un'idea diversa di prosperita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_050..src: Entonces, parece que esta instalación se usaba para juzgar delitos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_050..ref: So it seems like this facility was used to judge crimes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_050..dst: Quindi, sembra che questa struttura venisse usata per giudicare i crimini.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_050..src: Teniendo en cuenta que Aladiss se conoce como «la utopía perdida», pensaba que sería un lugar más alegre...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_050..ref: Considering it gets called the "Lost Utopia," I kind of thought Aladiss would be a happier place ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_050..dst: Considerando che Aladiss e' conosciuta come "l'utopia perduta", pensavo fosse un luogo piu' allegro...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_050..src: Ahora que conocemos mejor el pasado como miembros del equipo de investigación, la percepción que tenemos sobre Aladiss ha pegado un cambio radical.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_050..ref: Now that we've seen more of the past as members of the Research Team, our vague notions of Aladiss are being completely changed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_050..dst: Ora che conosciamo meglio il passato in qualita' di membri della Squadra di Ricerca, la nostra percezione di Aladiss e' cambiata radicalmente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_050..src: Puede que Aladiss no fuera el paraíso que nos imaginamos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_050..ref: Aladiss may not have been the paradise we imagined it to be.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_050..dst: Potrebbe essere che Aladiss non fosse il paradiso che immaginavamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_050..src: Ya que hemos terminado de investigar la zona, vamos a la base a informar de nuestros avances.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_050..ref: Now that we've finished looking around here, let's report back to base.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_050..dst: Ora che abbiamo finito di investigare la zona, torniamo alla base a riferire dei nostri progressi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..src: Gracias por el informe. Qué interesante... Por fin empezamos a hacernos una idea más clara de cómo eran las cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..ref: Thank you for the report. Very interesting ... We're starting to get a fuller picture of what things were like.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..dst: Grazie per il rapporto. Che interessante... Finalmente iniziamo a farci un'idea piu' chiara di come erano le cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..src: Parece que el Imperio estaba atravesando un periodo de conflicto en sus últimos momentos. Estos hallazgos determinarán la percepción que tenemos de su historia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..ref: It seems the empire experienced quite a bit of turmoil near the end of its lifespan. This will have a significant impact on our view of its history.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..dst: Sembra che l'Impero stesse attraversando un periodo di conflitto nei suoi ultimi momenti. Questi ritrovamenti avranno un impatto notevole sulla nostra percezione della sua storia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..src: Jefe, hemos descubierto algo interesante que... Vaya, ya estás reunido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..ref: Chief, we've discovered something interesting that—Oh, you're already in a meeting.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..dst: Capo, abbiamo scoperto qualcosa di interessante che... Cavolo, sei gia' in riunione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..src: No, acabamos de terminar nuestro informe. Ya podemos irnos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..ref: No, we just finished our report. We'll take our leave now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..dst: No, abbiamo appena finito il nostro rapporto. Possiamo andare via.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..src: Ya que estáis aquí, ¿por qué no os quedáis a escuchar lo que hemos descubierto? Creo que os resultaría útil.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..ref: Since you're already here, why don't you stay and listen to what we've discovered? It should be of use to you too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..dst: Dato che siete qui, perche' non restate ad ascoltare cio' che abbiamo scoperto? Penso vi risulterebbe utile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..src: Bueno, ¿qué es eso tan interesante que tenéis que compartir?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..ref: So, what's this interesting update of yours?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..dst: Allora, che cosa c'e' di cosi' interessante che dovete condividere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..src: Seré breve. Hemos descubierto que la religión que adora a la deidad de la cosecha no se originó en Aladiss, sino que provino de otra nación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..ref: I'll make it brief. We've discovered that the religion of the Harvest Deity, was in fact not of Aladissian origin, but rather brought in from another nation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..dst: Saro' breve. Abbiamo scoperto che la religione che adora la Divinita' del Raccolto non ha origini in Aladiss, ma proviene da un'altra nazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..src: ¿De otra nación? Siempre habíamos pensado que se originó en Aladiss...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..ref: Another nation? And all this time we thought it was from Aladiss ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..dst: Di un'altra nazione? E per tutto questo tempo abbiamo pensato provenisse da Aladiss...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..src: Exacto. Parece que, hace mucho tiempo, los humanos de una nación amiga la trajeron aquí cuando pasaban por los territorios del Imperio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..ref: Exactly. It seems that a very long time ago, the humans of a friendly nation brought it with them as they came and went from the empire's territories.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..dst: Esatto. Sembra che, molto tempo fa, gli umani di una nazione alleata l'abbiano portata qui quando passavano per i territori dell'Impero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..src: Ya era una tierra rica en maná y era el hogar de los Welleks...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..ref: It was already a land rich with mana, and was also the home of the Welleks ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..dst: Era gia' una terra ricca di mana ed era la casa dei Welleks...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..src: Parece que la religión acabó calando en este lugar por varios motivos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..ref: It seems there were a number of reasons that led to the religion taking hold here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..dst: Sembra che la religione abbia attecchito in questo luogo per vari motivi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..src: ¿Eso significa que, por mucho que investiguemos Aladiss, no descubriremos cuál es el origen de esta religión?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..ref: Then this means that no matter how much we investigate Aladiss, we won't learn the religion's origin?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..dst: Questo significa che, per quanto investighiamo Aladiss, non scopriremo qual e' l'origine di questa religione?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..src: Eso parece... Sin embargo, saber que no se originó en Aladiss también es un descubrimiento importante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..ref: It appears that way ... However, even just the discovery that it didn't originate in Aladiss is significant.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..dst: Sembra di si'... Tuttavia, sapere che non ha avuto origine ad Aladiss e' gia' una scoperta importante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..src: Cuando termine la investigación de Aladiss, me gustaría investigar esa nación amiga.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..ref: When the investigation of Aladiss is done, I'm planning on looking into that friendly nation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..dst: Quando finira' l'indagine su Aladiss, vorrei indagare su quella nazione alleata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..src: ¿Vas a continuar con la investigación? Increíble.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..ref: You're going to continue the investigation? That's incredible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..dst: Continuerai con l'indagine? Incredibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..src: Je, je, en eso consiste ser erudita.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..ref: Hehe. That's what it means to be a scholar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..dst: Eheh, e' questo che significa essere una studiosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..src: Hemos aprendido mucho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..ref: We've learned a lot.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..dst: Abbiamo imparato molto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..src: Yumia, seguid investigando las ruinas, pero avisad si encontráis alguna pista relacionada con esa nación amiga.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..ref: Yumia. Please continue investigating the ruins, but do report if you find any clues related to the friendly nation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..dst: Yumia, continuate a investigare le rovine, ma fateci sapere se trovate indizi relativi a quella nazione alleata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..src: Voy a compartir con vosotros la siguiente ubicación de investigación. Echadle un vistazo y poneos manos a la obra cuanto antes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..ref: I'll share the next location to investigate with you. Take a look and start working as soon as you can.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..dst: Condividero' con voi la prossima sede da investigare. Dateci un'occhiata e mettetevi al lavoro quanto prima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..src: Entendido. Yo también tengo curiosidad, así que te avisaré si descubrimos algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..ref: Understood. I'm curious too, so we'll definitely let you know if we find anything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_060..dst: Capito. Anche io sono curiosa, quindi ti faremo sapere sicuramente se scopriamo qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_070..src: ¿Este es nuestro siguiente destino? ¿Otro edificio ostentoso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_070..ref: Is this our next destination? Another flashy buildin', huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_070..dst: Questa e' la nostra prossima destinazione? Un altro edificio vistoso, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_070..src: Es un poco tarde para hacer esta pregunta, pero ¿qué vamos a hacer si nos encontramos algún arma chunga hecha con alquimia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_070..ref: It's a bit late to be askin' this, but what're we gonna do if we find some kinda nasty weapon made with alchemy?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_070..dst: E' un po' tardi per fare questa domanda, ma cosa facciamo se ci imbattiamo in qualche arma losca fatta con l'alchimia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_070..src: Pues dependerá de si puede ofrecernos información importante o si puede ser un peligro. En este último caso, tendremos que deshacernos de ella, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_070..ref: If it gives us valuable information, that's one thing, but if it's really dangerous, we'd have to dispose of it, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_070..dst: Dipendera' se ci puo' offrire informazioni importanti o se puo' essere un pericolo. In quest'ultimo caso, dovremo liberarcene, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_070..src: Me da miedo pensar que cada vez es más probable que encontremos algo así...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_070..ref: It's scary to think that we're more likely to encounter something like that here than ever before ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_070..dst: Mi spaventa pensare che sia sempre piu' probabile che troviamo qualcosa del genere...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_070..src: Tenemos que estar en guardia... Hemos venido a investigar precisamente ese tipo de cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_070..ref: ... Let's be on our guards. That's exactly the sort of thing we're here to investigate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_070..dst: Dobbiamo stare in guardia... Siamo venuti proprio per investigare quel tipo di cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_080..src: Mmm... Había monstruos pero, aparte de eso, no parece que quede nada importante...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_080..ref: Hmm ... There were monsters, but otherwise, it doesn't seem like there's anything significant left behind ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_080..dst: Mmh... C'erano mostri ma, a parte questo, non sembra che sia rimasto nulla di importante...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_080..src: A lo mejor se deshicieron de todo cuando llegó el fin, para evitar que otras naciones se lo llevaran y lo usaran.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_080..ref: Perhaps they disposed of everything at the very end to prevent other nations from taking and using it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_080..dst: Forse si sono sbarazzati di tutto alla fine, per impedire ad altre nazioni di portarlo via e usarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_080..src: Si tenemos en cuenta que no se transmitió ninguna información sobre la alquimia o la tecnología de maná, es más que posible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_080..ref: Considering that no knowledge of alchemy or mana technology ever got out, that is certainly plausible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_080..dst: Considerando che non si e' mai diffusa alcuna informazione sull'alchimia o sulla tecnologia del mana, e' piu' che plausibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_080..src: Pero tiene que quedar algo. A lo mejor nos vendría bien mirar debajo de los escombros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_080..ref: But there has to be something left. Maybe we'll find something if we look under the rubble.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_080..dst: Ma qualcosa dev'essere rimasto. Forse troveremmo qualcosa guardando sotto le macerie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_090..src: Este edificio... El diseño es completamente distinto, pero la atmósfera recuerda a la del centro de mando de la Orden.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_090..ref: This building ... The design is completely different, but the atmosphere here resembles the Order's headquarters.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_090..dst: Questo edificio... Il design e' completamente diverso, ma l'atmosfera ricorda quella del quartier generale dell'Ordine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_090..src: Sí, entiendo lo que quieres decir. A lo mejor es por lo imponente que es, pero sí que tienen una atmósfera similar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_090..ref: I think I get what you mean. Maybe it has to do with how imposing it is, but something about it does feel similar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_090..dst: Si', capisco cosa vuoi dire. Forse e' per quanto e' imponente, ma hanno davvero un'atmosfera simile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_090..src: A lo mejor albergaba una organización que mantenía el orden público.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_090..ref: Then perhaps this building was once used by an organization that maintained public order.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_090..dst: Forse un tempo ospitava un'organizzazione che manteneva l'ordine pubblico.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_100..src: Me da la sensación de que ya he visto esto antes... Esto es equipo para la investigación de homúnculos, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_100..ref: I get the feeling I've seen this before somewhere ... This is equipment for homunculus research, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_100..dst: Ho la sensazione di aver gia' visto questo prima... Questo e' equipaggiamento per la ricerca sugli omuncoli, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_100..src: Sí, sí que lo es... No me puedo creer que hayamos encontrado equipo como este aquí también.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_100..ref: Yes, it certainly is ... I can't believe we found equipment like this here too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_100..dst: Si', lo e' di certo... Non ci credo che abbiamo trovato equipaggiamento del genere anche qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_100..src: ¿La creación de homúnculos estaba tan extendida como parece?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_100..ref: Was the creation of homunculi really this widespread?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_100..dst: La creazione di omuncoli era davvero cosi' diffusa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_100..src: Yo diría que no. Puede que el país fuera el precursor de su producción, pero seguía siendo una investigación clasificada...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_100..ref: I don't believe it was. It may have been spearheaded by the country itself, but it was still classified research ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_100..dst: Direi di no. Puo' darsi che fosse il paese a guidarne la produzione, ma restava comunque una ricerca classificata...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_100..src: Entonces, es probable que este lugar encierre todavía más secretos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_100..ref: Then it's safe to say this place could be hiding some other secrets.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_100..dst: Allora e' probabile che questo luogo nasconda ancora altri segreti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..src: Los otros miembros llevarán a cabo una investigación más minuciosa más adelante, así que solo tenemos que echar un vistazo rápido...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..ref: The other members will be conducting a more thorough investigation later, so we only gave it a cursory look ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..dst: Gli altri membri condurranno in seguito un'indagine piu' approfondita, quindi dobbiamo solo dare un'occhiata veloce...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..src: Pero tampoco hemos encontrado información especialmente práctica, como un Vial de recuerdos por ahí tirado o algo así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..ref: But there really wasn't any conveniently collected information like a Memory Vial lying around.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..dst: Ma non abbiamo trovato nemmeno informazioni particolarmente comode, come una Fiala della Memoria in giro o qualcosa del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..src: A lo mejor se esforzaron por que no quedara nada, para que nadie pudiera usarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..ref: It's possible that they purposely made sure nothing was left behind. That way no one else could use it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..dst: Forse si sono assicurati apposta che non rimanesse nulla, cosi' nessun altro poteva usarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..src: En cualquier caso, lo único que podemos hacer es intentar deducir la verdad a partir de las pistas que hemos encontrado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..ref: At any rate, all we can do is attempt to deduce the truth from the clues we've acquired.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..dst: In ogni caso, l'unica cosa che possiamo fare e' cercare di dedurre la verita' dagli indizi che abbiamo trovato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..src: Esto es lo que hemos encontrado hasta ahora...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..ref: So what we've gathered this far is ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..dst: Quindi questo e' quello che abbiamo scoperto finora...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..src: Lo más probable es que este edificio fuera la sede de una organización que mantenía el orden público.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..ref: This was likely once a building used by an organization dedicated to maintaining public order.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..dst: Molto probabilmente questo edificio era la sede di un'organizzazione che manteneva l'ordine pubblico.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..src: Y parece que estaban usándolo para investigar a los homúnculos o hacer algo relacionado con ellos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..ref: And they were secretly researching or using something related to homunculi here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..dst: E sembra che lo stessero usando per investigare sugli omuncoli o fare qualcosa legato a loro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..src: ¿Qué tienen que ver los homúnculos con mantener el orden público?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..ref: What do homunculi have to do with maintaining public order?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..dst: Che c'entrano gli omuncoli con il mantenere l'ordine pubblico?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..src: No lo sé... Por ahora, vamos a informar de lo que hemos encontrado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..ref: ... Anyway, for now, let's report back with what we learned.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_110..dst: Non lo so... Per ora, riferiamo quello che abbiamo scoperto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Anda, Licht se nos ha adelantado esta vez.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: Oh, Licht beat us here this time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Oh, Licht ci ha preceduto questa volta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Sí, volvemos a encontrarnos. ¿Venís a informar al jefe?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: Yes, we meet again. Reporting to the chief?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Si', ci rincontriamo di nuovo. Venite a riferire al capo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Sí. Hemos terminado de investigar las ruinas que nos encargó.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: Yup. We just finished our investigation of the ruins he told us to look at.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Si'. Abbiamo finito di indagare sulle rovine che ci ha affidato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Ya veo. No habéis encontrado información de utilidad ni armas, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: I see. So there were no weapons or pieces of information left behind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Capisco. Non avete trovato ne' informazioni utili ne' armi, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Por fin hemos llegado a la capital y ahora parece que vamos a tardar más de lo que esperábamos en desvelar la verdad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: We've finally arrived in the capital, and yet it seems it will still be some time before we unravel the truth.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Finalmente siamo arrivati alla capitale, eppure sembra che scoprire la verita' richiedera' piu' tempo del previsto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Ya, eso es lo único que hemos encontrado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: Yeah. That's about all we were able to find ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Lo so, e' tutto quello che siamo riusciti a trovare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Por cierto, Licht, ¿qué estabas haciendo antes de que llegáramos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: By the way, Licht, what were you doing before we got here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: A proposito, Licht, cosa stavi facendo prima che arrivassimo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Ah, pues estaba dando mi informe, igual que vosotros. Creo que os convendría escucharlo otra vez.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: Oh, I was also reporting in. As usual, I think it would be best if you heard this as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Ah, stavo anch'io presentando il mio rapporto, come voi. Penso che vi converrebbe ascoltarlo di nuovo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: ¿Os acordáis de lo que descubrimos sobre el proyecto de creación de homúnculos a gran escala, el proyecto Cultivo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: Do you recall what we learned regarding the large-scale homunculus project, the Harvest Project?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Vi ricordate quello che abbiamo scoperto sul progetto di creazione di omuncoli su larga scala, il Progetto del Raccolto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Claro, ¿cómo olvidarlo? ¿Qué pasa con él?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: There's no way I could forget. What about it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Certo, come dimenticarlo? Cosa c'e' a riguardo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: No sabíamos por qué se creó el proyecto ni para qué se iban a usar los homúnculos exactamente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: Why exactly was the Harvest Project formulated, and what were they going to use the homunculi for?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Non sapevamo perche' fosse stato creato il progetto ne' per cosa esattamente sarebbero stati usati gli omuncoli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Pues resulta que la intención era producir homúnculos en masa para usarlos como soldados desechables.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: The answer to that is, the project was meant to mass produce homunculi to be used as disposable soldiers.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Ebbene, l'intenzione era produrre omuncoli in massa per usarli come soldati monouso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: ¿Desechables...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: Disposable ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Monouso...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: ¿Para usarlos como soldados...? Qué horror...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: Using homunculi as soldiers ...? That's horrible ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Per usarli come soldati...? Che orrore...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Licht, explícate, por favor... Dinos qué más habéis descubierto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: ... Licht, please explain. Tell us what your investigation turned up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Licht, spiegati, ti prego... Dicci cos'altro avete scoperto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Por supuesto. Los homúnculos que pretendían emplear utilizaban recuerdos extraídos de las Alstahlias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: Of course. The homunculi they were attempting to make utilized memories extracted from Alstahlia flowers.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Certo. Gli omuncoli che intendevano creare utilizzavano ricordi estratti dalle Alstahlia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Como es lógico, eran recuerdos aleatorios de un montón de humanos, así que los homúnculos resultantes no tenían identidades concretas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: Naturally, those memories would be random memories from countless humans. The resulting homunculi would have no particular identities.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Naturalmente, erano ricordi casuali di moltissimi esseri umani, quindi gli omuncoli risultanti non avevano identita' precise.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: No tengo toda la información, pero los recuerdos recopilados conformarían un alma. Pero un alma sin sentido de la identidad, evidentemente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: I don't know the details, but the gathered memories would form a soul. A soul with no sense of self, of course.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Non ho tutti i dettagli, ma i ricordi raccolti andrebbero a formare un'anima. Pero' un'anima priva di senso dell'identita', ovviamente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Al no tener auténtica voluntad, debían de ser marionetas que hacían lo que se les ordenaba. Podían usarlos a su antojo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: With no real will, they would be dolls that did whatever they were told, making them completely controllable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Non avendo una vera volonta', sarebbero state marionette che facevano cio' che veniva ordinato. Potevano usarle a loro piacimento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Un proyecto para convertir a los homúnculos en soldados desechables... Conque esa es la verdad detrás del proyecto Cultivo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: A project to make homunculi into disposable soldiers ... So that is the truth behind the Harvest Project.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Un progetto per trasformare gli omuncoli in soldati monouso... Quindi questa e' la verita' dietro al Progetto del Raccolto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Pero ¿qué estaba haciendo Aladiss? ¿Esta gente no tenía ningún tipo de ética o qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: What was Aladiss doing? Were they completely devoid of morals?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Ma cosa stava facendo Aladiss? Questa gente non aveva proprio alcuna etica o cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Los homúnculos son el resultado de los experimentos de la investigación alquímica más extraordinaria de Aladiss...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: ... Homunculi are the result of trial and error from the best alchemical research imaginable in Aladiss.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Gli omuncoli sono il risultato degli esperimenti della ricerca alchemica piu' straordinaria di Aladiss...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Dudo mucho que se pueda borrar algo así. Tiene que estar a buen recaudo en algún lugar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: I don't believe something like that would be completely erased. It should still be securely stored somewhere.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Dubito fortemente che una cosa simile possa essere stata cancellata. Deve essere custodita in un luogo sicuro, da qualche parte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: (Se está poniendo especialmente serio con todo este asunto... Pero bueno, será su afán por que la investigación progrese.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: (He sounds unusually intense about this ... But maybe he just wants the investigation to make progress?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: (Si sta dimostrando insolitamente acceso con questa faccenda... Mah, sara' lo zelo nel far progredire l'indagine.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Como ha informado el grupo de Yumia, el tema de los homúnculos se tiene que investigar más a fondo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: As Yumia's party reported, the homunculus matter is something we'll have to investigate further.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Come ha riferito il gruppo di Yumia, la questione degli omuncoli andra' indagata piu' a fondo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Yumia, ¿por qué no vais a investigar otro distrito? A lo mejor encontráis algo más si lo abordáis desde otro ángulo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: Yumia, how about you search another district? You might find something by approaching this from another angle.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Yumia, perche' non andate a indagare un altro distretto? Forse troverete qualcosa affrontandola da un'altra angolazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: ¿Otro distrito? A ver...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: Another district? Let's see ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Un altro distretto? Vediamo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Podemos ir al cementerio imperial. No parece que esté relacionado, pero igual nos viene bien echar un vistazo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: Let's go to the imperial graveyard next. It doesn't sound like it would be related, but we might as well take a look.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Possiamo andare al cimitero imperiale. Non sembra correlato, ma in fondo vale la pena dargli un'occhiata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: ¿Que os parece el distrito comercial? Era una zona muy poblada, así que podría quedar más información.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: How about the commercial district? It was a populated area, so there might be some information left behind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Che ve ne pare del distretto commerciale? Era una zona molto popolata, quindi potrebbe esserci ancora qualche informazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Por el momento, no tenemos pistas. Creo que vendrá bien que investiguéis cualquier sitio que se os ocurra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: As it stands, we don't have any leads. I believe it would be good to take a look around anywhere that comes to mind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Per il momento, non abbiamo indizi. Credo che sara' utile indagare in qualsiasi luogo vi venga in mente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..src: Genial. Si habéis tomado una decisión, podéis poneros manos a la obra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..ref: Very well. If you've decided, please go ahead and get started.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_120..dst: Perfetto. Se avete preso una decisione, potete mettervi all'opera.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_140..src: Si no nos deshacemos de los monstruos primero, la investigación podría ponerse peligrosa...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_140..ref: If we don't clear out the monsters first, it will be dangerous to look around ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_140..dst: Se prima non eliminiamo i mostri, l'indagine potrebbe diventare pericolosa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_140..src: Lo mejor será que eliminemos cualquier posible fuente de preocupación. Tendremos que esforzarnos un poco, pero juntos podremos con ellos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_140..ref: It's best to eliminate any cause for concern. It will be a little work, but let's take them down together.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_140..dst: Meglio eliminare ogni possibile fonte di preoccupazione. Sara' un po' faticoso, ma insieme ce la faremo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..src: Fiu... Con eso debería bastar por ahora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..ref: Phew ... It should be okay for a while now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..dst: Fiu... Con questo dovrebbe bastare per ora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..src: ¿Cómo?... Un momento...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..ref: Huh ...? Hold on a second.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..dst: Eh...? Un momento...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..src: Los documentos almacenados en el centro de pruebas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..ref: The documents stored at the test site—
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..dst: I documenti conservati nel centro di prova...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..src: ...antes de que llegue el día en que triunfe...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..ref: Before the day comes that they do succeed—
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..dst: ...prima che arrivi il giorno in cui avra' successo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..src: ¡Una voz!...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..ref: A voice ...!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..dst: Una voce...!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..src: ¡¿Q-qué ha sido eso?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..ref: Wh-what was that?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..dst: C-cosa era quello?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..src: (Una voz... ¡A lo mejor encontramos algo útil si seguimos la corriente de maná!)
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..ref: (A voice ... If we follow the stream of mana, we might find something useful!)
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..dst: (Una voce... Forse troviamo qualcosa di utile se seguiamo il flusso di mana!)

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..src: Si Aladiss denomina «cultivo» a este tipo de barbaridades y sigue trabajando en ellas tan alegremente, le esperará un futuro muy oscuro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..ref: If Aladiss calls such atrocities harvest and works towards them with joy, there is no future left for it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..dst: Se Aladiss definisce "raccolto" questo tipo di atrocita' e continua a lavorarci con allegria, non le resta alcun futuro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..src: Teniendo en cuenta la situación actual de la tecnología de Aladiss, lo más probable es que el plan fracase.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..ref: As Aladiss's technology currently stands, this plan is unlikely to succeed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..dst: Considerando lo stato attuale della tecnologia di Aladiss, e' improbabile che il piano abbia successo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..src: Pero, antes de que llegue el día en que triunfe, rezo por que las instalaciones y los materiales de investigación se desechen.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..ref: But before the day comes that they do succeed, I pray that the facilities and research materials are disposed of.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..dst: Ma, prima che arrivi il giorno in cui avra' successo, prego affinche' le strutture e i materiali di ricerca vengano eliminati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..src: Los documentos almacenados en el centro de pruebas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..ref: The documents stored at the test site ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..dst: I documenti conservati nel centro di prova...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..src: ¡S-señorita Yumia! Tú también escuchas esa voz, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..ref: M-Miss Yumia! You heard that voice, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..dst: S-signorina Yumia! Anche tu hai sentito quella voce, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..src: ¿De qué estás hablando?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..ref: What're you talkin' about?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..dst: Di cosa stai parlando?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..src: Acabamos de oír una voz que provenía de los restos de los recuerdos de alguien en el maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..ref: ... We just heard a voice from the remnants of someone's memories in the mana.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..dst: Abbiamo appena sentito una voce proveniente dai resti dei ricordi di qualcuno nel mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..src: ¿Una voz de los restos de recuerdos? ¿Eso es posible?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..ref: A voice from some memory remnants? Is that possible?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..dst: Una voce dai resti di ricordi? E' possibile?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..src: Sí. De hecho, antes pasó algo parecido...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..ref: Yeah. Actually, something like this happened before too ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..dst: Si'. A dire il vero, e' gia' successa una cosa simile...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..src: Ahora que lo pienso, puede que la voz que escuché en el Atelier fuera de la doctora Marina...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..ref: Now that I think about it, the voice I heard in the atelier might have been Doctor Marina's ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..dst: Ora che ci penso, la voce che ho sentito nell'Atelier potrebbe essere stata della Dottoressa Marina...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..src: En ese momento no lo sabíamos, pero los registros que dejó habían estado en la habitación de al lado todo el tiempo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..ref: We didn't know at the time, but the records she left behind had been in the next room over the whole time ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..dst: All'epoca non lo sapevamo, ma i documenti che ha lasciato si trovavano nella stanza accanto tutto il tempo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..src: Bueno, deberíamos apuntar todo esto antes de que se nos olvide para informar de ello. Lenja, ¿me echas una mano?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..ref: Anyway, we should write this down and report it before we forget. Lenja, could you help me out?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..dst: Dai, dovremmo annotare tutto prima che ci dimentichiamo, per poterlo riferire. Lenja, mi dai una mano?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..src: ¡Por supuesto! Al menos, puedo decirte todo lo que he oído.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..ref: Of course! At least, I'll help with as much as I heard!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_150..dst: Certo! Almeno posso dirti tutto quello che ho sentito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_170..src: Esto de aquí... Si no me falla la memoria, esto era un banco.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_170..ref: This is ... If my memory serves me, this was a bank.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_170..dst: Questo qui... Se non ricordo male, questo era una banca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_170..src: Aunque ponernos a buscar dinero antiguo suena divertido, no podemos entrar. Y, aunque pudiéramos, parece que podría derrumbarse en cualquier momento, así que paso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_170..ref: As much fun as lookin' for old money sounds, we can't get in. And even if we could, it looks like it'll collapse at any moment, so I think I'm good.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_170..dst: Per quanto divertente suoni cercare denaro antico, non possiamo entrare. E anche se potessimo, sembra che possa crollare da un momento all'altro, quindi passo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_170..src: ¿Qué le pasa a esto? Parece que está sin terminar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_170..ref: What's with it? It looks like it's unfinished.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_170..dst: Cosa c'e' che non va qui? Sembra incompiuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_170..src: Yumia, parece que hay un Vial de recuerdos por esta zona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_170..ref: Yumia, there seems to be a Memory Vial nearby.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_170..dst: Yumia, sembra che ci sia una Fiala della Memoria da queste parti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_170..src: ¡¿Cómo?! Si ni siquiera encontramos ninguno en Calumna...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_170..ref: Huh?! We didn't even find any inside Calumna ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_170..dst: Come?! Se a Calumna non ne abbiamo trovata nemmeno una...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..ref: I found it! Flammi, could you?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..src: Hemos venido al banco a solicitar financiación para ponerlo todo en marcha, pero, evidentemente, las cosas no son tan sencillas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..ref: We came to the bank to ask for funding to get things started, but of course, nothing's ever that easy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..dst: Siamo venuti in banca a chiedere un finanziamento per far partire tutto, ma ovviamente le cose non sono mai cosi' semplici.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..src: Si hubiera sabido que todo acabaría así, habría ahorrado dinero... Pero ya es tarde para lamentarse.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..ref: Had I known things would end up like this, I would have saved my money. I regret it, but it's too late now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..dst: Se avessi saputo che sarebbe andata cosi', avrei messo da parte dei soldi... Ma ormai e' troppo tardi per rimpianti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..src: A lo mejor debería hipotecar el depósito de agua... Así conseguiría algo de dinero, pero ese sitio es todo un polvorín...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..ref: Maybe I should mortgage the water storage facility ... It'd get me money, but that place is a veritable powder keg—
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..dst: Forse dovrei ipotecare il serbatoio dell'acqua... Mi frutterebbe un po' di soldi, ma quel posto e' una vera polveriera...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..src: Fin de los datos accesibles. Es bastante antiguo. Parece que pertenece a una persona que acudió al banco para solicitar financiación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..ref: End of recoverable data. This is quite old, and seems to belong to someone who came to the bank for financing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..dst: Fine dei dati recuperabili. E' piuttosto antico. Sembra appartenere a una persona che si e' rivolta alla banca per chiedere un finanziamento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..src: ¿El depósito de agua? ¿Será el mismo que investigamos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..ref: The water storage facility? Could it be the one we investigated before?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..dst: Il serbatoio dell'acqua? Sara' quello che abbiamo indagato noi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..src: No sé si se referirá al mismo... Pero ha dicho que era todo un polvorín, así que es bastante probable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..ref: I don't know if it's referring to the same one ... but given that he called it a powder keg, it's very possible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..dst: Non so se si riferisca allo stesso... Ma visto che l'ha definito una vera polveriera, e' molto probabile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..src: Eso significa que conocían los riesgos y continuaron con la investigación de todos modos. ¿Tan codiciosa era esta gente?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..ref: So this means they knew the risks and went on with the research anyway. Just how greedy were these guys?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..dst: Questo significa che conoscevano i rischi e hanno comunque continuato la ricerca. Quanto erano avidi questi individui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..src: En cualquier caso, el Vial de recuerdos ha sido un buen hallazgo. No he encontrado nada por aquí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..ref: Anyway, the Memory Vial was a good find. I couldn't find anything around here ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..dst: In ogni caso, la Fiala della Memoria e' stata un bel ritrovamento. Non ho trovato niente da queste parti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..src: El núcleo de la ciudad está lleno de calles que Basilius restauró.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..ref: The inner city is filled with streets that Basilius restored.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..dst: Il centro della citta' e' pieno di strade che Basilius ha restaurato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..src: Pero no creo que su labor de restauración afectase a los viales de recuerdos de aquella época.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..ref: But I don't think his restoration extends to the Memory Vials of the time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..dst: Ma non credo che il suo lavoro di restauro riguardasse le Fiale della Memoria di quell'epoca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..src: Como mucho, abarcó lugares a medio restaurar como este, donde puede que todo haya quedado como estaba hace mucho tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..ref: If anything, it's half-restored places like this where stuff might actually be left as it was long ago.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..dst: Al massimo, si estese a luoghi rimasti a meta' del restauro come questo, dove tutto puo' essere rimasto com'era tanto tempo fa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..src: La verdad es que la imprecisión de la grabación no inspira mucha esperanza en lo que a encontrar pistas más grandes se refiere...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..ref: Though the vagueness of the recording doesn't inspire much hope as far as finding any big leads goes ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..dst: A dire la verita', l'imprecisione della registrazione non lascia molte speranze in fatto di indizi importanti...
Eppure, abbiamo trovato qualcosa di fantastico!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..src: Pues sí. Vamos a volver y a informar de ello.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..ref: We did. Let's head straight back to report it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_190..dst: E' vero. Torniamo subito a riferirlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: Jefe, venimos a informar de nuevo. Un momento, ¿por qué estáis tan serios los dos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: Chief, we're here with another report. Wait, why do you two look so serious?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Capo, siamo qui per un altro rapporto. Un attimo, perche' siete cosi' seri tutti e due?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: Ah, Yumia. Ahora te pongo al día. Pero, primero, informadme de los avances.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: Ah, Yumia. I'll catch you up, but first, let me hear your report.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Ah, Yumia. Ti mettero' al corrente. Ma prima, datemi un rapporto sui progressi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: Entiendo, habéis encontrado una nueva pista relacionada con el proyecto Cultivo. A lo mejor sacamos algo en claro si la combinamos con nuestra información.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: I see, so you found a new clue related to the Harvest Project. Perhaps combining it with our information will bring something to light.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Capito, avete trovato un nuovo indizio legato al Progetto del Raccolto. Magari combinandolo con le nostre informazioni veniamo a capo di qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: Entonces, ¿vosotros también habéis encontrado algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: Does that mean you guys found something too?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Quindi, anche voi avete trovato qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: Pues sí, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: We did. But ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Si', in effetti, ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: Licht me ha informado de un nuevo lugar al que expandir mi investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: Licht informed me of a new place to expand my investigation into.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Licht mi ha segnalato un nuovo luogo in cui estendere la mia indagine.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: Hala, qué buena noticia, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: Whoa, that's great, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Wow, che bella notizia, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: Sí. También he hecho avances en mi investigación actual. Pero, al final, solo he podido hacer deducciones...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: Yes. I had also made progress investigating, but in the end, all I could do was draw inferences ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Si'. Ho fatto progressi anche nella mia attuale indagine. Ma alla fine ho potuto solo fare deduzioni...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: Como no tenía más opciones, pensé que solo podía ir a la ubicación a la que apuntaban mis deducciones y ver si eso me llevaba a alguna parte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: With no other options, I thought I would have to just go to the location I had inferred and hope for the best.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Non avendo altre opzioni, pensavo di dover andare nel luogo indicato dalle mie deduzioni e sperare che portasse a qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: Pero la información de Licht era muy específica e incluía el país y la región que yo había deducido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: And yet Licht's information was very specific, and included the country and region that I had inferred.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Eppure le informazioni di Licht erano molto specifiche e includevano il Paese e la regione che avevo dedotto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: Hala, lo de Licht es impresionante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: Wow, Licht is really impressive.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Wow, Licht e' davvero impressionante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: Ya, pero ¿no os parece demasiado impresionante?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: But isn't he a little too impressive?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Si', ma non vi sembra troppo impressionante?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: ¿Cómo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Come?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: La verdad es que nunca le ha puesto trabas al equipo y siempre ha sido extremadamente colaborador.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: Certainly, he's never been an impediment to the team, and he's been extremely cooperative.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: E' vero, non ha mai ostacolato la squadra ed e' sempre stato estremamente collaborativo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: Pero... no puedo pasar por alto ninguna sospecha, sobre todo ahora que la investigación se acerca a su fin.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: But ... I cannot ignore any cause for suspicion. Especially now that our investigation is approaching its conclusion.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Pero'... non posso ignorare alcun motivo di sospetto, soprattutto adesso che l'indagine si avvicina alla conclusione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: A lo mejor resulta que también es un homúnculo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: Maybe he'll turn out to be a homunculus too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Chissa', magari anche lui e' un homunculus.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: Sería alucinante que hubiera alguien más como yo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: It would be incredible if there were someone else like me here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Sarebbe incredibile se ci fosse qui qualcun altro come me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: Las sospechas no van a llevarnos a ninguna parte. Por eso, quiero que os ocupéis de investigarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: Just harboring suspicions isn't going to get us anywhere. To that end, I'd like you to investigate him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Le suspensioni non ci porteranno da nessuna parte. Per questo, voglio che vi occupiate di indagare su di lui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: Tengo la esperanza de que lleguemos a la conclusión de que simplemente tiene mucho talento como investigador.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: Personally, I'm hoping we come to the conclusion that he is simply a talented researcher.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Spero che arriviamo alla conclusione che sia semplicemente un ricercatore di grande talento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: Hala, ¿ahora tenemos que investigar a una persona?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: Whoa, now we're investigating a person?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Oh, quindi ora dobbiamo indagare su una persona?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: Pero Licht suele trabajar solo, ¿no? ¿Cómo podemos abordar la situación?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: But doesn't Licht usually work alone? How should we go about this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Ma Licht di solito lavora da solo, no? Come possiamo affrontare la situazione?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: Hay muchos aventureros que lo admiran. Deben de estar explorando la región ahora mismo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: There are plenty of adventurers who look up to him. They should be out exploring the region right now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Ci sono molti avventurieri che lo ammirano. Dovrebbero essere proprio ora la' fuori a esplorare la regione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: He oído que han hablado con Licht, así que a lo mejor saben algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: I've heard they've spoken to Licht, so they might know something.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Ho sentito che hanno parlato con Licht, quindi magari sanno qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..src: Vale... Bueno, a ver si conseguimos localizarlos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..ref: I see ... All right. We'll see if we can find them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_200..dst: Capito... Va bene, vediamo se riusciamo a trovarli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..src: Perdonad, nos gustaría haceros una pregunta...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..ref: Excuse me, there's something we'd like to ask you ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..src: Ya... Es verdad que se me vienen muchas cosas misteriosas a la cabeza cuando pienso en Licht.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..ref: Yeah ... It's true that a lot of mysterious things come to mind when it comes to Licht.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..dst: Gia'... E' vero che mi vengono in mente tante cose misteriose quando penso a Licht.
Ad esempio? Potresti essere piu' specifico?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..src: Claro, pero me gustaría pedirte una cosa a ti también. Eres Yumia, la alquimista, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..ref: Sure, but there's something I'd like to ask you too. You're Yumia, the alchemist, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..dst: Certo, ma anch'io vorrei chiederti una cosa. Sei Yumia, l'alchimista, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..src: A cambio de hablarte de Licht, sería genial que nos ayudaras con un asunto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..ref: In exchange for telling you about Licht, it'd be great if you could help us out with something.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..dst: In cambio di parlarti di Licht, sarebbe fantastico se ci aiutassi con una faccenda.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..src: ¿Como un intercambio? ¿Qué es lo que necesitáis?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..ref: A trade? What did you have in mind?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..dst: Tipo uno scambio? Di cosa avete bisogno?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..src: Nos han pedido que entreguemos una cosa, pero no la encontramos por ninguna parte. No sabemos qué hacer. ¿Podrías ayudarnos a buscarla?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..ref: We were asked to deliver something, but we can't find it anywhere. We're stumped. Could you find it for us?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..dst: Ci hanno chiesto di consegnare una cosa, ma non la troviamo da nessuna parte. Non sappiamo cosa fare. Potresti aiutarci a cercarla?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..src: Pero, ya que le pedimos un favor a una alquimista, ¿no sería mejor pedir un arma superfuerte o algo así?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..ref: Wait, if we're getting a favor from an alchemist, wouldn't it be better to ask for a really strong weapon?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..dst: Pero', visto che chiediamo un favore a un'alchimista, non sarebbe meglio chiedere un'arma superforte o qualcosa del genere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..src: Pero ¿qué decís? Deberíamos pedirle algo que podamos usar para establecer una base sencilla por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..ref: What are you saying? We should ask for something that we could use to set up a simple base around here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..dst: Ma cosa dite? Dovremmo chiederle qualcosa che possiamo usare per allestire una base semplice da queste parti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..src: ¿El objeto que necesitáis se encuentra por aquí? Si es así, podemos ocuparnos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..ref: Is the item you need something we can collect around here? If so, we'll do it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..dst: L'oggetto di cui avete bisogno si trova da queste parti? Se e' cosi', possiamo occuparcene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..src: Sí, lo malo es que los monstruos de por aquí son bastante fuertes y acabamos de los nervios cuando intentamos buscarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..ref: Yeah, it's just that the monsters around here are strong, so we get so anxious looking around for it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..dst: Si', il problema e' che i mostri qui intorno sono piuttosto forti e veniamo presi dai nervi quando proviamo a cercarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..src: Disculpad las molestias, pero os lo agradeceríamos muchísimo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..ref: We're sorry to trouble you, but we really appreciate it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..dst: Scusate il disturbo, ma ve ne saremmo davvero molto grati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..src: ¿Un arma potente? Podría crear algo muy especial para vosotros, ¿os parece bien?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..ref: A strong weapon? I'll make you something really special in that case, so does that sound good?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..dst: Un'arma potente? In tal caso potrei crearvi qualcosa di davvero speciale, vi sembra buono?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..src: ¿Un arma que una alquimista considera especial? Eso sí que es crear expectación. ¡Estoy deseando verla!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..ref: Something that an alchemist calls really special? Sounds like something to look forward to. I can't wait!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..dst: Un'arma che un'alchimista considera speciale? Questo si' che crea aspettative. Non vedo l'ora di vederla!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..src: Va a ser muy difícil construir una base en este sitio. ¿Podría crear otra cosa que podáis usar en lugar de una base?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..ref: It'd be pretty difficult to build a base here. Could I build you something you can use in place of a base?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..dst: Sara' parecchio difficile costruire una base in questo posto. Potrei costruire per voi qualcosa da usare al posto di una base?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..src: Solo necesitamos un sitio para acampar mientras investigamos. No tiene que ser nada del otro mundo. Gracias de antemano.
