eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..ref: We just need a place to camp while we're investigating. It doesn't need to be anything special. Thanks in advance.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_210..dst: Ci serve solo un posto dove accamparci mentre indaghiamo. Non dev'essere niente di speciale. Grazie in anticipo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..src: ¡Hala! ¡Sabía que era buena idea pedirle algo así a una alquimista! Ahora podremos realizar la entrega.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..ref: Wow! I knew asking an alchemist was the right choice! Now we'll be able to fulfill our delivery.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..dst: Caspita! Sapevo che chiedere una cosa cosi' a un'alchimista fosse la scelta giusta! Ora potremo effettuare la consegna.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..src: Me alegro de que estéis satisfechos. Y bien, ¿podéis hablarme más de Licht?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..ref: I'm just glad you're happy with it. Now, could you tell me more about Licht?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..dst: Mi fa piacere che siate soddisfatti. E allora, potete parlarmi ancora di Licht?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..src: Claro. No tengo pruebas, pero tengo la corazonada de que está relacionado de alguna manera con la realeza, la nobleza o algo así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..ref: Right. I don't have any proof, but I have a hunch that he has some connection to royalty or nobility or something.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..dst: Certo. Non ho prove, ma ho la sensazione che sia in qualche modo legato alla regalita', alla nobilta' o qualcosa del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..src: Ha leído varios libros sobre la era aladissiana. No se encuentra ese tipo de cosas en las bibliotecas de Eustella, ¿no creéis?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..ref: He's read some books from the Aladissian Era. You can't find that kind of stuff in a Eustellan library, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..dst: Ha letto diversi libri sull'era aladissiana. Non si trovano certe cose nelle biblioteche di Eustella, non trovate?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..src: Además, lo he visto manejar dispositivos que utilizan tecnología de maná y eliminar trampas con facilidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..ref: I've seen him operate devices that use mana technology and remove traps with ease, which is another reason.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..dst: Inoltre, l'ho visto manovrare dispositivi che utilizzano la tecnologia del mana e rimuovere trappole con facilita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..src: La información sobre la tecnología de maná se encuentra restringida y bloqueada. Solo algunas personas pueden acceder a ella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..ref: Information on mana technology is restricted and locked up so only certain people can look at it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..dst: Le informazioni sulla tecnologia del mana sono limitate e bloccate. Solo alcune persone possono accedervi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..src: Por otro lado, siempre evita las preguntas sobre su lugar de nacimiento. Nunca dice en qué zona nació ni habla de lugares que le gusten.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..ref: He also dodges questions about his birthplace. He won't say what territory or talk about places he likes either.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..dst: Inoltre, evita sempre le domande sul suo luogo di nascita. Non dice mai in quale zona e' nato e non parla dei posti che gli piacciono.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..src: Por eso, se me ha ocurrido que a lo mejor es alguien importante y no conoce lo que hay fuera de su patrimonio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..ref: So my assumption was that maybe he's so important, he doesn't know about stuff outside of his estate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..dst: Per questo ho pensato che magari e' una persona importante e non conosce cio' che c'e' fuori dalla sua tenuta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..src: Pero ¿una persona así querría convertirse en aventurero en Aladiss? En cualquier caso, es un tipo misterioso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..ref: Could someone like that really become an adventurer in Aladiss? But either way, he's a mysterious guy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..dst: Ma una persona del genere vorrebbe davvero diventare un avventuriero ad Aladiss? In ogni caso, e' un tipo misterioso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..src: Sabe más de lo que debería y no habla de su lugar de procedencia... Lo pillo. Gracias por la información.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..ref: So he knows more than he should, and he won't talk about where he's from ... Got it. Thank you for sharing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_220..dst: Sa piu' di quanto dovrebbe e non parla del suo luogo di provenienza... Capito. Grazie per l'informazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_230..src: ¡Hala! ¡Qué pasada de arma! Parece que alberga un inmenso poder de algún tipo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_230..ref: Whoa! This weapon is incredible! It's like it's hiding some kind of tremendous power ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_230..dst: Caspita! Che arma incredibile! Sembra nascondere una sorta di potere immenso...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_230..src: Ahora que tenemos esto, seguro que podemos explorar zonas más peligrosas. ¡Muchas gracias!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_230..ref: Now that we have this, we should be able to explore more dangerous areas. Thank you so much!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_230..dst: Ora che abbiamo questo, dovremmo riuscire a esplorare zone piu' pericolose. Grazie mille!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_230..src: Pero ¿una persona así querría convertirse en aventurero en Aladiss? En cualquier caso, es un tipo misterioso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_230..ref: Could someone like that really become an adventurer in Aladiss? But either way, he's a mysterious guy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_230..dst: Ma una persona del genere vorrebbe davvero diventare un avventuriero ad Aladiss? In ogni caso, e' un tipo misterioso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_240..src: ¡Hala, qué pasada! Ya podemos acampar y hacer todavía más avances en la exploración de la capital.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_240..ref: Wow, this is great! Now we can set up camp and make some real progress on surveying the capital!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_240..dst: Wow, che fantastico! Ora possiamo accamparci e fare ancora piu' progressi nell'esplorazione della capitale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..src: Vale, ya hemos vuelto. Vayamos a informar al jefe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..ref: Okay, we're back. Let's go straight to the chief.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..dst: Va bene, siamo tornati. Andiamo a riferire al capo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..src: Habéis vuelto justo a tiempo. Parece que Licht se nos ha adelantado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..ref: You all came back just in time. It seems that Licht has beaten us to the chase.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..dst: Siete tornati proprio in tempo. Sembra che Licht ci abbia anticipato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..src: Al parecer, según la información que hemos obtenido, se dirige a la región septentrional de Auruma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..ref: Based on the information we've gathered, it appears that he's moving toward the northern Auruma region.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..dst: A quanto pare, in base alle informazioni che abbiamo raccolto, si dirige verso la regione settentrionale di Auruma.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..ref: What?! How could he act so quickly?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..dst: Cosa?! Come ha fatto ad agire cosi' in fretta?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..src: Parece que su objetivo era obtener información sobre la alquimia, el proyecto Cultivo y los homúnculos desde el principio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..ref: Sounds like his goal was gettin' info on alchemy, the Harvest Project, and homunculi from day one.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..dst: Sembra che il suo obiettivo fosse ottenere informazioni sull'alchimia, sul Progetto del Raccolto e sugli omuncoli fin dall'inizio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..src: Ya había rumores de que sabía más de lo que debía. Por eso ha estado actuando tan rápido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..ref: There were those rumors that he already knew more than he should've. That's why he's been able to act so quickly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..dst: Circolavano gia' voci secondo cui sapeva piu' di quanto dovesse. Ecco perche' sta agendo cosi' in fretta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..src: Teniendo en cuenta todo lo que sabemos..., a lo mejor se dirige al depósito de agua.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..ref: ... All that considered, perhaps he's headed to the water storage facility.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..dst: Considerato tutto cio' che sappiamo..., magari si dirige verso il serbatoio dell'acqua.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..src: Ahora que lo pienso, fue él el que nos habló del proyecto Cultivo y la ubicación del centro de pruebas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..ref: Thinkin' about it, he was the one who told us about the Harvest Project and the test site's location.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..dst: Ora che ci penso, e' stato lui a parlaci del Progetto del Raccolto e dell'ubicazione del sito di prova.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..src: ¿Insinúas que ya lo sabía todo desde el principio, hasta la existencia del centro de pruebas de los homúnculos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..ref: Are you saying you think he knew everything the whole time? Even the existence of the homunculus test site?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..dst: Stai suggerendo che lo sapesse tutto fin dall'inizio, persino l'esistenza del sito di prova degli omuncoli?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..src: En ese caso, mandarnos a investigar la zona pudo ser su forma de hacer que destapásemos esa información.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..ref: So sending us out to investigate was his way of getting us to uncover that information?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..dst: In tal caso, mandarci a indagare nella zona poteva essere il suo modo di farci scoprire quell'informazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..src: Basta ya de conjeturas: que nos cuente la verdad él mismo. Localizadlo lo antes posible, por favor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..ref: That's enough conjecture. Let's hear the truth from the man himself. Please track him down as soon as you can.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_250..dst: Basta con le congetture: la verita' ce la dica lui di persona. Localizzatelo il prima possibile, per favore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_260..src: Noto el suelo extraño por aquí...
Hala. Hay algún tipo de dispositivo en esta parte del suelo... Puede que pase algo si lo pisamos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_260..ref: Whoa. There's some sort of device in this part of the floor. Something might happen if we step on it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_260..dst: Wow. C'e' una specie di dispositivo in questa parte del suolo... Potrebbe succedere qualcosa se lo calpestiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_260..src: Pues parece que no ha pasado nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_260..dst: Beh, sembra che non sia successo niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_260..src: Porque está roto. Y da la sensación... de que lo han roto hace poco.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_260..ref: That's because it's broken. And with the way it feels ... it was broken recently.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_260..dst: Perche' e' rotto. E ho l'impressione... che sia stato rotto di recente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_260..src: Es probable. Si arreglamos el mecanismo, a lo mejor conseguimos que vuelva a funcionar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_260..ref: Probably. If we fix the mechanism, we might be able to make it work again.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_260..dst: Probabilmente. Se ripariamo il meccanismo, magari riusciamo a farlo funzionare di nuovo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..src: Aquí no hay nada. ¿Habrá estado siempre vacío o...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..ref: There's nothing here. Was it always empty? Or ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..dst: Qui non c'e' niente. Sara' sempre stato vuoto, o...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..src: Esta es la única zona que no está cubierta de polvo. Tenía que haber algo aquí hasta hace muy poco.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..ref: This is the only area that is not coated in dust. Something must have been here until very recently.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..dst: Questa e' l'unica zona non coperta di polvere. Qui doveva esserci qualcosa fino a pochissimo tempo fa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..src: Pues parece que, fuera lo que fuera, se lo han llevado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..ref: It's safe to assume then that whatever was here has been taken.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..dst: Sembra proprio che, qualunque cosa fosse, se la siano portata via.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..src: Si era algo que Licht estaba buscando, lo más probable es que esté relacionado con el proyecto Cultivo o con los homúnculos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..ref: If it's something Licht was after, then it probably has something to do with the Harvest Project or homunculi ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..dst: Se era qualcosa che Licht stava cercando, molto probabilmente e' collegato al Progetto del Raccolto o agli omuncoli...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..src: Pretendía ganar tiempo obstaculizándonos la entrada...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..ref: ... So he was buying himself time when he made it harder for us to get in here.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..src: Sabía que, si rompía el mecanismo, pararíamos a repararlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..ref: He must have realized that we would stop and fix the mechanism if he broke it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..dst: Sapeva che, se avesse rotto il meccanismo, ci saremmo fermati a ripararlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..src: No es momento de dejarse impresionar, pero está más avispado que nunca. Lo bueno es que no hemos tardado tanto en arreglarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..ref: This isn't the time to be impressed, but he's as sharp as ever. In any case, it didn't actually take that long to fix it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..dst: Non e' il momento di lasciarsi impressionare, ma e' piu' sveglio che mai. La cosa buona e' che non abbiamo impiegato molto ad aggiustarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..src: A lo mejor sigue cerca. Vamos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..ref: Then he might still be nearby. Let's go.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_270..dst: Puo' darsi che sia ancora nei paraggi. Andiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: ¡Licht!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: Licht!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Licht!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: Sabía que vendríais a por mí, pero habéis avanzado más rápido de lo que esperaba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: ... I knew you all would chase after me, but you moved faster than I anticipated.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Sapevo che saresti venuti a prendermi, ma avete fatto piu' in fretta del previsto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: Licht, se acabó.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: Licht, stand down.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Licht, e' finita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: Eso es un Vial de recuerdos con información sobre la investigación de los homúnculos, ¿verdad? ¿Podrías entregárnoslo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: That's a Memory Vial with information on homunculus research, right? Could you hand it over to us?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Quella e' una Fiala della Memoria con le informazioni sulla ricerca sugli omuncoli, vero? Potresti consegnarcela?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: Esa investigación es el resultado de experimentos absolutamente inhumanos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: That research is the result of inhumane experiments.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Quella ricerca e' il risultato di esperimenti assolutamente disumani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: Sabes perfectamente que no es algo que deba usarse en beneficio propio. ¿Qué pretendes hacer con eso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: You know very well that it isn't something to be used for personal gain. What do you plan to do with it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Sai benissimo che non e' una cosa che debba essere usata per proprio tornaconto. Cosa intendi farci?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: Si pensáis que pretendo usarlo con el mismo fin que ellos, estáis sumamente equivocados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: If you think I plan to use it for the same ends as they did, you're sorely mistaken.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Se pensate che io intenda usarlo per lo stesso scopo di loro, vi sbagliate di grosso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: Necesito... Bueno, hay gente en mi país que necesita desesperadamente la tecnología de los homúnculos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: I need ... No, there are people in my country who desperately need homunculus technology.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Ne ho bisogno... Cioe', nel mio paese c'e' gente che ha disperatamente bisogno della tecnologia degli omuncoli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: Tengo que hacer todo lo que esté en mi mano para llevarles esto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: I need to do whatever it takes to bring this back to them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Devo fare tutto cio' che e' in mio potere per portargliela.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: ¿Tu país? ¿Eres un espía de otro país?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: Your country? So you're a spy for another country.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Il tuo paese? Sei una spia di un altro paese?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: No soy un espía. Estoy trabajando en esto por motivos personales. Y eso incluye conseguir esto de aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: I'm not a spy. I'm doing this for my own reasons. That goes for wanting to obtain this too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Non sono una spia. Sto lavorando a questa faccenda per motivi personali. E questo include ottenere cio' che si trova qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: ¿Y cuáles son esos motivos? Si es una estupidez, pienso pararte los pies.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: And what reasons are those? If it's somethin' stupid, I'll cut you down.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: E quali sarebbero questi motivi? Se e' una stupidaggine, intendo fermarti sul serio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: En el lugar del que provengo, muchas personas están sufriendo una enfermedad inusual que hace que sean incapaces de recobrar la conciencia después de nacer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: Where I'm from, there are countless individuals suffering from an unusual disease that renders them unable to gain consciousness after birth.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Nel luogo da cui provengo, molte persone soffrono di una malattia insolita che le rende incapaci di riacquistare coscienza dopo la nascita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: ¿Quieres decir que nacen muertas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: You mean stillbirths?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Vuoi dire che nascono morte?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: No, están vivas, pero su alma permanece inactiva.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: No. These people remain alive. However, their souls lie dormant.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: No, sono vive, ma la loro anima rimane inattiva.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: Y, mientras su alma está inactiva, no adquieren conciencia, pero su cuerpo crece y envejece.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: They never gain consciousness as long as their souls remain dormant, but physically, they grow and age.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: E finche' la loro anima e' inattiva, non acquisiscono coscienza, ma il loro corpo cresce e invecchia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: Empecé a darle vueltas a la cabeza. ¿Podrían vivir una vida normal si creásemos homúnculos para usarlos como contenedores a los que transferir sus almas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: I began thinking. Would they be able to live normal lives if we were to create homunculi to use as vessels and transfer their souls to them?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Ho iniziato a pensarci su. Potrebbero vivere una vita normale se creassimo degli omuncoli da usare come contenitori a cui trasferire le loro anime?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: ¿Una enfermedad que hace que el alma permanezca inactiva? Nunca había oído algo así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: A disease that causes the soul to remain dormant? I've never heard of such a thing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Una malattia che fa rimanere l'anima inattiva? Non avevo mai sentito una cosa del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: Pues existe. Por eso estoy aquí. Estoy buscando una manera de combatir la enfermedad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: Nevertheless, it exists. That's why I'm here. I'm looking for a way to combat that disease.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: E invece esiste. Per questo sono qui. Sto cercando un modo per combattere la malattia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: ¡Y por fin he encontrado la técnica para crear esos contenedores! ¡Con esto, puedo ayudar a todo el mundo a despertar!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: And I've finally obtained the technique for creating the vessels! With this, I can help everyone wake up!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: E ho finalmente trovato la tecnica per creare quei contenitori! Cosi' potro' aiutare tutti a risvegliarsi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: Tengo que llevarme esto a casa. Por eso me uní al equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: I'm bringing this back to my home. This is what I joined the Research Team for.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Devo portare questa cosa nel mio paese. Per questo mi sono unito alla Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: Pero... ¿de verdad ayudará a la gente a vivir una vida normal?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: Will that ... really help them live normal lives?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Pero'... aiutera' davvero la gente a vivere una vita normale?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: ... What?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Cosa?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: Si se transfiere su alma..., aunque pudieras hacerlo, ¿no se convertirían en personas distintas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: Transferring their souls ... Even if you were able to do that, wouldn't they become different people?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Se si trasferisce la loro anima..., anche se tu fossi capace di farlo, non diventerebbero persone diverse?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: ¿Pretendes convencerme de que lo deje todo diciéndome que mis métodos son erróneos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: Are you trying to convince me to stop by telling me that my methods are wrong?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Pensi di convincermi a lasciare tutto dicendomi che i miei metodi sono sbagliati?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: ¿Tú? ¿La que utiliza el arte prohibido de la alquimia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: You, who is just as guilty of using the forbidden art of alchemy?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Tu? Tu che usi l'arte proibita dell'alchimia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: Solo me han permitido usarla por el bien de la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: That's ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Mi hanno permesso di usarla solo per il bene della ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: Si quieres usar la información y las técnicas que has obtenido aquí, tienes que seguir los procedimientos adecuados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: I've only been permitted to use it for the sake of the survey.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Se vuoi usare le informazioni e le tecniche che hai ottenuto qui, devi seguire le procedure adeguate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: Así que déjalo, Licht, por favor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: If you want to use the information and techniques you've acquired here, you have to follow the proper procedures.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Quindi lascia perdere, Licht, ti prego.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..src: Yumia Liessfeldt... La alquimia no es un privilegio reservado exclusivamente para ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..ref: So ... Licht, please, let it go.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_280..dst: Yumia Liessfeldt... L'alchimia non e' un privilegio riservato esclusivamente a te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..src: Entiendo... Fuera sincero o no, parece que el objetivo definitivo de Licht era ayudar a la gente de su país...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..ref: I see ... Setting aside whether or not it's true, Licht's goal was ultimately to help the people of his country ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..dst: Capisco... Che fosse sincero o no, sembra che l'obiettivo finale di Licht fosse aiutare la gente del suo paese...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..src: Lo sentimos mucho, jefe. No hemos conseguido capturar a Licht ni recuperar los materiales que se llevó.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..ref: We're truly sorry, Chief. We failed to capture Licht or recover the materials he took.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..dst: Ci dispiace tanto, capo. Non siamo riusciti a catturare Licht ne' a recuperare i materiali che si e' portato via.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..src: Ha sido culpa mía. Podría haberlo detenido, pero no sabía cómo responderle y me bloqueé...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..ref: It's my fault. I could have stopped him, but I didn't know how to answer him, and I froze ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..dst: La colpa e' mia. Avrei potuto fermarlo, ma non sapevo cosa rispondergli e mi sono bloccata...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..src: No pasa nada, no os preocupéis. No teníamos forma de saber lo que estaba ocurriendo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..ref: It's all right, don't worry about it. We had no way of knowing what was going on.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..dst: Non fa niente, non preoccupatevi. Non avevamo modo di sapere cosa stesse succedendo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..src: ¿Para qué objetivos debería usarse el poder? No es una cuestión que se limite a la alquimia ni que se pueda responder con facilidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..dst: Per quali scopi dovrebbe essere usato il potere? Non e' una questione che riguardi solo l'alchimia, ne' a cui si possa rispondere con facilita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..src: Si tenemos en cuenta nuestros propios sentimientos o las decisiones que toma una nación entera, la respuesta puede cambiar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..ref: To what ends should power be used for? That's not a question that's limited to alchemy, nor is it something that can be answered so easily.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..dst: Se teniamo in considerazione i nostri stessi sentimenti o le decisioni che prende un'intera nazione, la risposta puo' cambiare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..ref: And when you take into account personal feelings, or the decisions made by a nation, that answer changes.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..src: Incluso en la época de la civilización pasada, el asunto de la creación de homúnculos no era tan sencillo como parece. Me imagino que Licht es bastante consciente de ello.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..dst: Persino ai tempi della civilta' passata, la questione della creazione degli omuncoli non era cosi' semplice come sembra. Immagino che Licht ne sia ben consapevole.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..src: Creo que la situación tenía que ser muy crítica para que se agarrara a un clavo ardiendo de esta forma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..ref: Even in the days of the past civilization, the issue of creating homunculi was not so simple. I imagine Licht knows that as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..dst: Penso che la situazione dovesse essere davvero critica perche' si aggrappasse a un'ultima speranza in questo modo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..ref: I feel like the surrounding situation must have been desperate for him to cling to such a thin thread of hope.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..src: Pero, aunque tuviera acceso a la tecnología de creación de homúnculos, jamás se me pasaría por la cabeza hacerlos de la misma forma que los hacían en aquella época.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..dst: Pero', anche se avessi accesso alla tecnologia di creazione degli omuncoli, non mi passerebbe mai per la testa di crearli nello stesso modo di allora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..src: Claro, no digo que tengamos que dejar que se lleve lo que quiera y haga lo que le dé la gana, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..ref: Even if I were to get my hands on the technique to make homunculi, the idea of making them the same way they did back then is unthinkable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..dst: Certo, non dico che dobbiamo lasciare che si porti via quello che vuole e faccia cio' che gli pare, pero'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..src: Para bien o para mal, todo el tema de los homúnculos sigue siendo objeto de nuestra investigación, lo que significa que se encuentra bajo mi supervisión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..ref: Of course, I'm not saying that we should just let him take and do whatever he wants with it, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..dst: Per bene o per male, tutta la questione degli omuncoli resta oggetto della nostra ricerca, il che significa che rientra sotto la mia supervisione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..ref: For better or worse, the homunculus issue is still under investigation, which means it's under my supervision.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..src: Yumia es alquimista y Nina, un homúnculo... Creo que vosotras debéis decidir cómo abordar la situación de Licht.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..dst: Yumia e' un'alchimista e Nina e' un omuncolo... Penso che siate voi a dover decidere come affrontare la situazione di Licht.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..src: No puedo asumir la responsabilidad de lo que ocurra, sobre todo si acabas arrepintiéndote...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..ref: In other words, Yumia and Nina, you are an alchemist and a homunculus ... How the situation with Licht will be handled is up to you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..dst: Non posso assumermi la responsabilita' di quello che accadra', soprattutto se poi te ne pentirai...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..src: Asumir la responsabilidad es cosa mía. No tienes por qué preocuparte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..ref: ... I can't take responsibility for what happens, even if you end up regretting this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..dst: Assumermi le responsabilita' e' affare mio. Tu non hai bisogno di preoccuparti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..src: Volvamos a lo importante: si pretende huir de la nación, lo más probable es que lo encontréis en la costa que hay más allá de la colina Scurra. Cuento con vosotras.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..ref: Taking responsibility is my job. You don't need to worry.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_290..dst: Torniamo a cio' che e' importante: se intende fuggire dalla nazione, molto probabilmente lo troverete sulla costa oltre la collina Scurra. Conto su di voi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..src: No me gustaría tener que hacer así las cosas, pero estoy preparado para luchar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..ref: It's not the way I'd prefer to do things, but I'm prepared to battle.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..dst: Non e' che mi piaccia fare le cose in questo modo, ma sono pronto a combattere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..src: Si queréis detener a alguien que está dispuesto a dejarse la vida en ello, tenéis que estar preparadas para quitar una vida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..ref: If you want to stop someone who is prepared to put their life on the line, you must be prepared to take a life.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..dst: Se volete fermare chi e' disposto a rischiare la vita, dovete essere pronte a togliere una vita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..src: Licht... Como homúnculo, hay algo que me gustaría decirte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..ref: Licht ... As a homunculus myself, there's something I want to say to you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..dst: Licht... In quanto omuncolo, c'e' una cosa che vorrei dirti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..src: La producción de homúnculos en masa fue un proceso muy duro para las personas de aquella época.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..ref: For the people living back then, the mass production of homunculi was grueling.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..dst: La produzione di omuncoli in massa e' stato un processo molto duro per le persone di quell'epoca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..src: El camino que te espera por delante es largo y peligroso. Pero, si lo que te mueve es la esperanza de salvar a la gente que te importa...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..ref: The path you walk is long and treacherous. But if you're acting in the hope of saving the people you care about ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..dst: Il cammino che hai davanti e' lungo e pieno di pericoli. Ma se quello che ti spinge e' la speranza di salvare le persone che ti stanno a cuore...
Grazie... Perche' non ho intenzione di arrendermi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..src: Licht, espero que tu plan salga bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..ref: Licht, I pray that you will succeed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..dst: Licht, spero che il tuo piano abbia successo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..src: Aunque esos materiales no te resulten útiles, espero que te ayuden a encontrar la manera de salvar a tu gente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..ref: Even if those materials aren't useful as is, I hope that they will help you find some way to save your people.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..dst: Anche se quei materiali non ti risultassero utili, spero che ti aiutino a trovare il modo di salvare la tua gente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..src: Y espero que puedas usar esas técnicas de una forma que te parezca correcta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..ref: And I hope that you are able to use those techniques in a way that feels right to you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..dst: E spero che tu possa usare quelle tecniche nel modo che ritieni giusto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..src: Nunca olvidaré vuestras palabras. Yo también rezo por el éxito de vuestra investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..ref: I will never forget your words. I, too, pray for the success of your investigation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..dst: Non dimentichero' mai le vostre parole. Anch'io prego per il successo della vostra ricerca.
Pensi che abbiamo fatto la cosa giusta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..src: Si te digo la verdad, lo dudo. Pero es la respuesta que hemos elegido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..ref: Broadly speaking, I doubt it. But this is the answer we chose.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_300..dst: A dire la verita', lo dubito. Ma e' la risposta che abbiamo scelto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..src: Entiendo... Habéis hecho un buen trabajo, chicos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..ref: I see ... A job well done, everyone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..dst: Capisco... Avete fatto un buon lavoro, ragazzi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..src: Aunque no hubiera ocurrido nada de esto, decidir qué hacer con la producción de homúnculos en masa habría sido muy difícil.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..ref: Even if this hadn't happened, deciding what to do with the mass production of homunculi would have been extremely difficult.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..dst: Anche se nulla di tutto cio' fosse accaduto, decidere cosa fare con la produzione in massa di omuncoli sarebbe stato molto difficile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..src: No solo porque la alquimia sea tabú, sino porque tendría un efecto tremendo en lo que consideramos aceptable y ético.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..ref: And not just because alchemy is taboo. It would have a huge impact on what we consider acceptable and ethical.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..dst: Non solo perche' l'alchimia sia un tabu', ma perche' avrebbe un effetto enorme su cio' che consideriamo accettabile ed etico.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..src: Os he puesto en una posición muy complicada a las dos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..ref: I put you two in quite a difficult position.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..dst: Vi ho messe entrambe in una posizione molto complicata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..src: Después de todo lo que ha ocurrido durante la investigación, siento que he logrado entender una cosa...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..ref: Through everything that's happened during our investigation, I feel like I've truly come to understand ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..dst: Dopo tutto cio' che e' accaduto durante la ricerca, sento di essere riuscita a capire una cosa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..src: La gran responsabilidad que conlleva tener un gran poder.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..ref: Just how much responsibility comes with having great power.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..dst: La grande responsabilita' che comporta avere un grande potere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..src: Estás usando la alquimia para convertir este continente en un lugar donde la gente pueda vivir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..ref: You're using alchemy to once again make this continent into a home for people to live in.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..dst: Stai usando l'alchimia per trasformare questo continente in un luogo dove la gente possa vivere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..src: Con una herramienta como esa, lo más importante es la forma en que se utiliza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..ref: As with any tool, the important thing is how you use it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..dst: Con uno strumento come quello, la cosa piu' importante e' il modo in cui viene usato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..src: Pues yo creo que tu alquimia es de lo más acogedora, señorita Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..ref: I think your alchemy is warm, Miss Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..dst: Beh, io trovo la tua alchimia davvero accogliente, signorina Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..src: ¡Pienso lo mismo! ¡Me encanta tu alquimia, Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..ref: Me too! I like your alchemy, Yumia!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..dst: Penso anch'io! Adoro la tua alchimia, Yumia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..src: Estoy de acuerdo. Al principio tenía mis dudas, pero, después de ver cómo la usas, he aprendido a apreciarla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..ref: Agreed. I had my doubts at the start, but seeing the way you use it, over time I've come to appreciate it as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..dst: Sono d'accordo. All'inizio avevo dei dubbi, ma dopo aver visto come la usi, ho imparato ad apprezzarla.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..src: Quiero usar un tipo de alquimia que ayude a la gente a mantener la esperanza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..ref: I want to use the kind of alchemy that helps people hold onto hope.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..dst: Voglio usare un tipo di alchimia che aiuti le persone a mantenere la speranza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..src: Así que... seguiré dando lo mejor de mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..ref: So ... I'll keep doing my best!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm04_310..dst: Quindi... continuero' a dare il massimo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: ¡Hola, altus!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: Um, hey! Tall One!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Ehi, altus!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: ¿Eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: Hm?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Tengo que pedirte un favorcito, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: There's a tiny favor I'd like to ask, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Dovrei chiederti un piccolo favore, pero'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Claro, ¿qué necesitas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: Sure, what's it about?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Certo, di cosa hai bisogno?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Necesito ayuda para encontrar a una amiga.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: I need some help finding my friend.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Ho bisogno di aiuto per trovare un'amica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: ¿En serio? ¿Te crees que nos sobra el tiempo o qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: Seriously? Do you think we're made of free time or somethin'?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Sul serio? Credi che abbiamo tempo libero da sprecare o cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Venga ya. Déjale hablar por lo menos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: Aw, come on. Let's at least hear them out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Dai, su. Lasciala parlare almeno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: ¿Tienes alguna pista sobre dónde puede estar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: Do you have any clues about where your friend could be?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Hai qualche indizio su dove possa essere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Sip, ¡claro!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: Yep, sure do!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Yep, certo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: ¡Mi amiga dejó esto!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: My pal left this behind!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: La mia amica ha lasciato questo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: ¿Un vial de recuerdos?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: A Memory Vial ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Una Fiala della Memoria...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: ¿Cómo? ¿Tu amiga no es Alber?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: Huh? Your friend isn't an Alber?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Come? La tua amica non e' un'Alber?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Nop, ¡es una altus!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: Nope, she's a Tall One!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Nope, e' un'altus!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: No me puedo creer que alguien llegase aquí antes que el equipo de investigación...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: It's hard to imagine that someone made it here before the Research Team did ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Non riesco a credere che qualcuno sia arrivato qui prima della Squadra di Ricerca...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Seguramente eso signifique que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: So, that probably means...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Molto probabilmente questo significa che...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Es una muy vieja amiga, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: This is one very old friend, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: E' un'amica di tantissimo tempo, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: ¡Sip! Vino hace muuucho tiempo y nos dijo que nos enseñaría algo increíble, pero ¡nunca volvió!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: Yep! She came here a reeeally long time ago and said that she'd show us something great, but then she didn't come back!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Yep! E' venuta muuolto tempo fa e ci ha detto che ci avrebbe mostrato una cosa incredibile, ma non e' mai tornata!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Para empezar, podríamos ver qué hay almacenado en el vial de recuerdos. Flammi, ¿harías los honores?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: Well, we can start by checking what's stored in this Memory Vial. Flammi, would you do the honors?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Per iniziare, potremmo vedere cosa c'e' memorizzato nella Fiala della Memoria. Flammi, vuoi fare gli onori?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Por supuesto. A escanear.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: Of course. Scanning now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Certo. Inizio la scansione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Parecen registros de investigación creados por una persona llamada Enrika.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: These appear to be research logs made by a person called "Enrika."
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Sembrano registri di ricerca creati da una persona di nome Enrika.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Era alquimista en el jardín botánico Arbor. La mayoría de los datos están centrados en sus expediciones por el entorno local.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: She was an alchemist at the Arbor Botanical Garden. The majority of the data is centered around her surveys of the local environment.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Era un'alchimista del giardino botanico Arbor. La maggior parte dei dati riguarda le sue esplorazioni dell'ambiente locale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Durante sus expediciones, tuvo encuentros con los Alber y se han conservado registros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: Records of her exchanges with the Alber remain as part of those surveys.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Durante le sue esplorazioni ebbe contatti con gli Alber, e di cio' restano dei registri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: El jardín botánico Arbor... Pues sí que vino hace tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: The Arbor Botanical Garden ... Then she really is from way long ago.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Il giardino botanico Arbor... Allora e' venuta davvero tanto tempo fa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Pobre Alber, ¿cuánto tiempo llevará esperando?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: Just how long has that Alber been waitin' for?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Povero Alber, da quanto tempo stara' aspettando?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Parece que experimentan el tiempo de forma diferente a los humanos. Pero bueno, ¿qué vamos a hacer al respecto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: It seems they experience time on a different scale than humans. That said, what are we going to do about this?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Sembra che percepiscano il tempo in modo diverso dagli umani. Comunque, cosa facciamo a riguardo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Me parece muy cruel decirles la verdad tal cual sin rodeos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: It seems pretty heartless to just tell them the truth outright.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Mi sembra molto crudele dirgli la verita' cosi', senza mezzi termini.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Como mínimo, deberíamos investigar lo que le sucedió a Enrika en la medida de lo posible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: At the very least, we should investigate what happened to Enrika as much as we can.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Come minimo dovremmo indagare su cosa e' successo a Enrika il piu' possibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: ¿Deberíamos? ¿Y qué ganamos con eso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: We should? What's in it for us?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Dovremmo? E cosa ci guadagnamo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Son habitantes muy importantes de la zona. Si así conseguimos que accedan a ayudarnos en la investigación, también sacaremos provecho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: They're important local residents. If this gets them to agree to help with the investigation, it would be advantageous for us as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Sono abitanti molto importanti della zona. Se cosi' riusciamo a convincerli ad aiutarci nella ricerca, ne trarremo vantaggio anche noi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Así que lo hacemos para que nos devuelvan el favor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: So we do it to get a favor outta them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Quindi lo facciamo per farci rendere il favore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Tu amiga es una humana llamada Enrika, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: Your friend is a human called Enrika, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: La tua amica e' un'umana di nome Enrika, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: ¡Sí! ¡Así es!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: Yep! That's right!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Si'! Esatto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Vamos a ver qué conseguimos averiguar sobre ella. ¿Te importaría prestarnos el vial de recuerdos un ratito?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: We're going to go see what we can find out about her. Do you mind if we borrow this Memory Vial for a while?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Vediamo cosa riusciamo a scoprire su di lei. Ti dispiacerebbe prestarci la Fiala della Memoria per un po'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: ¡Sin problema! ¡Gracias, altus!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: That's fine! Thank you, Tall Ones!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Nessun problema! Grazie, altus!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Si encontramos más pistas en algún sitio, lo más probable es que sea en el jardín botánico Arbor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: The Arbor Botanical Gardens would be the most likely location to provide more clues.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Se c'e' un posto dove trovare altri indizi, molto probabilmente e' il giardino botanico Arbor.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..src: Sí, empecemos por ahí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..ref: Yeah, let's start there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_010..dst: Si', iniziamo da li'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..src: Flammi, ¿había alguna pista más en el vial de recuerdos para saber en qué dirección seguir?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..ref: Flammi, was there anything else in that Memory Vial that could help steer us in the right direction?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..dst: Flammi, c'era qualche altro indizio nella Fiala della Memoria per capire in che direzione proseguire?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..src: Sí. Solo había un fragmento, pero indicaba dónde se habían almacenado documentos en aquella época.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..ref: Yes. While it was only a fragment, there was an account of where documents were stored at the time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..dst: Si'. C'era solo un frammento, ma indicava dove erano conservati dei documenti all'epoca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..src: ¡Vale, pues vamos a dividirnos para buscarlos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..ref: Okay! Let's split up and look for it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..dst: Va bene, allora dividiamoci per cercarli!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..src: Hemos encontrado un buen número de documentos que parecen estar relacionados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..ref: We managed to find a fair number of seemingly related documents.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..dst: Siamo riusciti a trovare parecchi documenti che sembrano collegati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..src: Enrika era alquimista y su investigación se centraba en la relación entre el maná y la naturaleza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..ref: Enrika was an alchemist whose research focused on the relationship between mana and the natural world.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..dst: Enrika era un'alchimista che studiava il rapporto tra il mana e il mondo naturale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..src: En sus estudios de campo, entabló una relación de amistad con gentes Alber, que la ayudaron en sus expediciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..ref: Through her field studies, she established a friendly relationship with the Alber, who then assisted with her surveys.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..dst: Durante le sue ricerche sul campo, strinse amicizia con gli Alber, che la aiutarono nelle sue ricognizioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..src: Por mucho que fuera otra época, las similitudes son sorprendentes. No difiere mucho de lo que hacemos nosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..ref: The era might be different, but the similarities really are striking. That's not far off from what we're doing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..dst: L'epoca era diversa, ma le somiglianze sono davvero impressionanti. Non e' poi cosi' diverso da quello che facciamo noi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..src: Pero, en su caso, era un asunto más urgente. Sucedió durante una época de hostilidad entre distintos países.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..ref: In her case, however, there was a distinct sense of urgency. This occurred during a period of unrest between various countries.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..dst: Nel suo caso, pero', c'era un'urgenza ben precisa. Accadde in un periodo di tensioni tra vari paesi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..src: Le preocupaba que Aladiss se viera inmerso en una guerra y que el pueblo Alber también acabara arrastrado al conflicto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..ref: She was concerned that if Aladiss was about to become embroiled in war, then the Alber would be dragged into the conflict as well.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..dst: Temeva che, se Aladiss fosse stato coinvolto in una guerra, anche gli Alber sarebbero stati trascinati nel conflitto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..src: En varios de los documentos se plantea la intención de crear espacios seguros para que residieran.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..ref: A number of these documents outline plans intended to create safe spaces for them to reside in.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..dst: In diversi documenti si descrivono piani per creare luoghi sicuri in cui potessero vivere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..src: Vale, pero ¿hay algo que nos ayude a seguirle la pista?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..ref: Okay, but was there anythin' that'd let us track her down?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..dst: Va bene, ma c'e' qualcosa che ci aiuti a rintracciarla?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..src: Aparece el nombre de la zona que solía visitar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..ref: The documents contained the name of the area which she frequently visited.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..dst: Nei documenti c'era il nome della zona che era solita visitare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..src: La Arbolada de Falbra. Es una zona boscosa que se encuentra al norte de aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..ref: The Falbra Thicket. It is a wooded area located to the north of here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..dst: La Selva di Falbra. E' una zona boschiva a nord di qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..src: Quería que fuera el nuevo refugio Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..ref: She intended for it to be the site of a new safe haven for the Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..dst: Voleva che diventasse un nuovo rifugio per gli Alber.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..src: Entiendo. En ese caso, vamos para allá.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..ref: I see. In that case, let's go there next.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..dst: Capisco. In tal caso, andiamo li'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..src: Pues sí. Nuestra única opción es seguir sus pasos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..ref: Agreed. Our only option is to follow her step by step.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_020..dst: Gia'. Non ci resta che seguire le sue orme.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_030..src: Tenemos la Arboleda de Falbra justo en frente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_030..ref: The Falbra Thicket lies just ahead.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_030..dst: La Selva di Falbra e' proprio piu' avanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_040..src: Así que esta es la Arboleda de Falbra... Vaya, sí que es densa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_040..ref: So this is the Falbra Thicket ... It certainly is dense.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_040..dst: Quindi questa e' la Selva di Falbra... E' proprio fitta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_040..src: Si seguimos por este camino, deberíamos llegar a la base que usaban Enrika y sus compañeros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_040..ref: Continuing along this path should bring you to the base that Enrika and her coworkers used.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_040..dst: Seguendo questo sentiero dovremmo arrivare alla base usata da Enrika e dai suoi colleghi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_040..src: Parece un buen lugar para comenzar. Si es que encontramos algo ahí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_040..ref: Which sounds like a good place to start. Here's hoping we actually find something there ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_040..dst: Sembra un buon punto di partenza. Sempre che li' si trovi qualcosa...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_050..src: Este espacio vacío... ¿Será donde iban a construir las casas para el pueblo Alber?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_050..ref: This empty space ... Is this where the houses for the Alber were supposed to go?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_050..dst: Questo spazio vuoto... E' qui che dovevano sorgere le case per gli Alber?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_050..src: Consiguieron proteger una zona bastante amplia. Hicieron todo lo que pudieron por ellos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_050..ref: They managed to secure a fairly large area. They really were trying to go the distance for them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_050..dst: Sono riusciti a ritagliarsi un'area piuttosto vasta. Si sono davvero impegnati per loro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_050..src: Esta debía de ser la base de Enrika.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_050..ref: And this must have been Enrika's base.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_050..dst: E questa dev'essere stata la base di Enrika.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_050..src: Si queda algo de información, debe de estar aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_050..ref: If there's any information left, it'll be here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_050..dst: Se e' rimasta qualche informazione, dev'essere qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_050..src: Sí, vamos a echar un vistazo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_050..ref: Right, let's take a look around.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_060..ref: Sorry, but you can't stay here!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_060..dst: Mi dispiace, ma non potete restare qui!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_070..src: ¡Puf! Ya podemos echar un vistazo sin problemas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_070..ref: Phew! Now we can go back to looking around in peace.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_070..dst: Uff! Ora possiamo tornare a guardare in giro in pace.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_070..src: Creo que son los registros de las exploraciones de la Arboleda de Falbra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_070..ref: These appear to be the survey logs for the Falbra Thicket.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_070..dst: Sembrano i registri delle ricognizioni nella Selva di Falbra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_070..src: «A simple vista, aquí solo hay árboles. Y está a bastante distancia de la aldea humana más cercana».
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_070..ref: "There's nothing but trees as far as the eye can see, and it's a good distance away from even the nearest human settlement."
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_070..dst: "A perdita d'occhio non si vedono che alberi, e il posto e' parecchio lontano persino dall'insediamento umano piu' vicino".

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_070..src: «Hay agua y alimento de sobra y la zona es tranquila y agradable».
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_070..ref: "There's plenty of food and water, and the surroundings are nice and peaceful."
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_070..dst: "C'e' cibo e acqua in abbondanza, e i dintorni sono tranquilli e piacevoli".

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_070..src: «Para humanos sería un poco pequeño, pero es perfecto para que vivan Alber»... Fin de la entrada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_070..ref: "Things would be a bit cramped here for a human, but it's just perfect for the Alber." ... End entry.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_070..dst: "Per gli umani sarebbe un po' angusto, ma per l'Alber e' perfetto"... Fine della voce.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_070..src: Pues sí que se preocupaba por las gentes Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_070..ref: So, she really was looking out for the Alber.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_070..src: Jamás habría imaginado que alguien de Aladiss pudiera pensar así. Voy a tener que replantearme la opinión que tengo de ellos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_070..ref: I wouldn't have expected someone from Aladiss to think like that. I might have to revise my opinion of them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_070..dst: Non avrei mai immaginato che qualcuno di Aladiss potesse pensarla cosi'. Forse dovro' ricredermi su di loro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_080..src: Humm... No se mueve ni un poco. Yumia, ¿puedes arreglarlo como hiciste en el faro?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_080..ref: Hm... This isn't budging at all. Yumia, can you fix it? Like you did at the lighthouse?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_080..dst: Uhm... Non si muove proprio. Yumia, puoi aggiustarlo? Come hai fatto al faro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_080..ref: Yep, just leave it to me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..src: Imagino que esto sería el almacén, ¿no? Diría que aquí guardaban sus cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..ref: I guess this was their storehouse? It seems like this is where they kept their things.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..dst: Immagino fosse il loro magazzino. Sembra che tenessero qui le loro cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..src: ¡Hay otro vial de recuerdos! ¿Habrá algo registrado en él?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..ref: There's another Memory Vial! I wonder if there's anything recorded on this one.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..dst: C'e' un'altra Fiala della Memoria! Chissa' se c'e' qualcosa registrato qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..src: Este vial de recuerdos tiene información sobre los planes de construcción cancelados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..ref: This Memory Vial contains information pertaining to canceled construction plans.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..dst: Questa Fiala della Memoria contiene informazioni sui progetti di costruzione annullati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..src: Parece que Enrika actuaba por su cuenta, sin informar a su país sobre sus planes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..ref: It would seem that Enrika was acting of her own accord, without informing her country of her plans.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..dst: Sembra che Enrika agisse di sua iniziativa, senza informare il suo paese dei suoi piani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..src: La convocaron en la capital y no le dio tiempo a llevar a cabo sus planes. Todo está detallado aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..ref: She was called back to the capital too soon to accomplish anything of note, which is all detailed here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..dst: La richiamarono nella capitale prima che potesse fare qualcosa di significativo. Qui e' tutto descritto nei dettagli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..src: Lo que más lamentaba era no haber podido mantener la promesa que hizo al pueblo Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..ref: All in all, she most regretted not being able to keep her promise to the Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..dst: In definitiva, cio' che piu' rimpiangeva era di non aver potuto mantenere la promessa fatta all'Alber.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..src: Ah, así que eso fue lo que ocurrió...
Las consecuencias de no seguir tu misión y salirte de lo establecido, ¿eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..ref: Carry out the mission you were assigned and don't act out of line, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..dst: Portare a termine la missione assegnata senza uscire dai ranghi, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..src: ¡Ja! Vaya país más tiránico. Yo me habría pirado del tirón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..ref: Ha! Talk about an oppressive country. I'd have left right away.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_090..dst: Ah! Che paese oppressivo. Io me ne sarei andato subito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..src: Parecen los registros del trabajo de Enrika. Pero solo se puede leer una parte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..ref: This appears to be the work logs that Enrika left behind. However, only one section is legible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..dst: Sembrano i registri di lavoro lasciati da Enrika. Tuttavia, si riesce a leggere solo una parte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..src: Casi todo son quejas sobre su trabajo de laboratorio. Escribió exactamente cómo se sentía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..ref: By and large, it was idle complaints about her laboratory work. She wrote exactly what she felt.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..dst: Perlopiu' si lamentava del lavoro in laboratorio. Ha scritto esattamente cio' che provava.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..src: «Últimamente, en lugar de la investigación del entorno que me gustaría estar haciendo, todas nuestras tareas han sido militares. No hay más que venenos y bestias para la batalla».
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..ref: "Lately, instead of the environmental research I'd rather be doing, all of our tasks have been military-focused. It's nothing but poisons and battle-ready beasts."
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..dst: "Ultimamente, invece delle ricerche sull'ambiente che vorrei fare, i nostri compiti sono stati tutti di natura militare. Nient'altro che veleni e bestie da battaglia".

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..src: «Me hice investigadora para estudiar la naturaleza, pero tengo la sensación de que estoy contribuyendo a su destrucción».
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..ref: "I became a researcher so that I could study the natural world! This feels more like I'm facilitating its destruction."
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..dst: "Sono diventata una ricercatrice per studiare la natura, ma ho la sensazione di stare contribuendo alla sua distruzione".

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..src: Todo es así. Estas entradas denotan que había roces entre Enrika y los que la rodeaban. Estaba cada vez más descontenta. Pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..ref: And so on. These entries make it clear that there was friction between Enrika and those around her, and that she was becoming increasingly dissatisfied. However ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..dst: E cosi' via. Queste annotazioni mostrano che c'erano attriti tra Enrika e chi la circondava. Era sempre piu' scontenta. Pero'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..src: A pesar de las obligaciones que le imponía el trabajo, su trato con gentes Alber era su único sostén emocional.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..ref: Despite the work-related obligations that she was bound to, her interactions with the Alber proved to be a source of emotional support.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..dst: Nonostante gli obblighi imposti dal lavoro, il suo rapporto con gli Alber era il suo unico sostegno emotivo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..src: Conque «obligaciones», ¿eh? La obligaban a hacer un trabajo que aborrecía y a arruinar la naturaleza que tanto adoraba...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..ref: "Obligations," huh. Being forced to do work that you hate, while ruining the natural world that you love so much ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..dst: Quindi "obblighi", eh? La costringevano a fare un lavoro che detestava e a rovinare la natura che amava tanto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..src: ¡Yo habría dimitido sin pensarlo! Pero... imagino que las cosas no funcionaban así por entonces.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..ref: I'd have quit right away! But ... I guess that's not how things worked back then.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..dst: Io avrei dato le dimissioni senza pensarci due volte! Pero'... immagino che all'epoca le cose non funzionassero cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..src: En cualquier caso, entiendo que estar con los Alber le diera tanta paz. ¡Son una monada!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..ref: Either way, I totally get how soothing the Alber are! They're just so cute!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..dst: In ogni caso, capisco che stare con gli Alber la tranquillizzasse cosi' tanto. Sono una favola!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..src: Son como criaturillas antiestrés. No sabría decir por qué, pero en su compañía te olvidas de todos tus problemas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..ref: Yeah, they're tiny walkin' stress-relievers. I don't really get it, but you sure don't need to think much when you're talkin' to 'em.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_100..dst: Sono come creaturine anti-stress. Non saprei dire perche', ma in loro compagnia ti dimentichi tutti i problemi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: Yo diría que nos hemos hecho una buena idea del trabajo de Enrika y de por qué tuvo que distanciarse del pueblo Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: It feels like we've gotten a decent idea about what Enrika was working on, and why she had to distance herself from the Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Direi che ci siamo fatti un'idea abbastanza chiara del lavoro di Enrika e del perche' abbia dovuto tenersi a distanza dal popolo Alber.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: Sí, pero no me puedo creer que se fuera sin decirles nada...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: Yeah. But I can't believe she left without saying anything to them ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Si', ma non riesco a credere che se ne sia andata senza dir loro niente...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: ¡Oye, necesito ayuda para cargar esto!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: Hey! I need a hand carryin' somethin'!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Ehi, mi serve una mano per portare questa roba!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: Humm... ¿Qué será?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: ... Huh. I wonder what.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Hmm... Che cosa sara'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: ¿Todo listo? Uno, dos... ¡y tres!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: Ready? One, two ... three!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Pronti? Uno, due... e tre!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: ¿Qué es esto?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: What is this ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Che cos'e'...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: Es inmenso, pero es un tipo de vial de recuerdos. Comenzando escaneo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: It is massive in scale, but this is a type of Memory Vial. Commencing scan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: E' immenso, ma e' un tipo di Fiala della Memoria. Avvio della scansione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: Encantada de conocerte, querida alquimista. ¿Me oyes bien?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: Nice to meet you, fellow alchemist. Can you hear me all right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Piacere di conoscerti, cara alchimista. Mi senti bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: Un momento, ¿es una grabación que dejó Enrika?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: Hang on, this is a recording left by Enrika?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Un attimo, e' una registrazione lasciata da Enrika?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: Sí, eso es.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: Yes, that's right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Si', e' cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: ¡Hala!... ¿Acaba de...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: Wh-whoa! Did she just ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: M-mamma mia!... Non ha appena...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: ¡¿Respondernos?! Sí, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: Reply to us?! She did, right?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Risposto a noi?! Si', vero?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: ¿Eres... Enrika?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: Are you ... Enrika?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Sei... Enrika?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: Me llamo Enrika. Trabajé en el borrador de un plan de vivienda para los Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: My name is Enrika. I drafted a set of housing plans for the Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Mi chiamo Enrika. Ho lavorato alla stesura di un piano di abitazioni per gli Alber.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: No hay una persona real, así que tiene que ser una grabación, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: I know that there's not a real person in there, so does that mean this was all pre-recorded?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Non c'e' una persona vera, quindi sara' una registrazione, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: Hala. Has hecho un hallazgo alucinante, Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: Wow, you managed to find something pretty incredible, Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Dai. Hai fatto un ritrovamento incredibile, Rutger.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: No subestimes mis habilidades de cazador de tesoros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: Don't underestimate my treasure huntin' skills.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Non sottovalutare le mie abilita' da cacciatore di tesori.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: Oye, eres alquimista de Aladiss, ¿verdad? Eso significa que sabes lo que llevamos preguntándonos todo este tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: Hey, you're an Aladissian alchemist, right? That means you know the thing that we've been wonderin' about this whole time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Ehi, sei un'alchimista di Aladiss, vero? Il che significa che sai quella cosa che ci chiediamo da tutto questo tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: Voy a ir al grano..., ¿cómo y por qué se destruyó Aladiss?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: So, I'm gonna get straight to the point—how and why was Aladiss destroyed?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Vado al sodo... come e perche' Aladiss e' stata distrutta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: Lo siento, no puedo responder a preguntas inesperadas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: I'm sorry. I cannot answer unexpected questions.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Mi dispiace. Non posso rispondere a domande inaspettate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: ¿Cómo, cómo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: ... Come again?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Come, come?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: En este momento, estoy eligiendo las respuestas más adecuadas a la situación a partir de una lista de preguntas y respuestas previsibles.
