eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: Currently, I am selecting the responses which best fit the situation from a list of anticipated questions and answers.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Al momento sto selezionando le risposte piu' adatte alla situazione da un elenco di domande e risposte previste.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: He intentado hacerlo lo mejor posible y grabar una respuesta para cada situación. ¡Lo siento!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: I tried to record a response for every situation as best as I could, but ... I'm sorry.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Ho cercato di registrare una risposta per ogni situazione al meglio delle mie possibilita'. Mi dispiace!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: ¡Tch! Debería haberme imaginado que no sería tan sencillo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: Tch! Should've known it wouldn't be that easy ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Tch! Avrei dovuto immaginare che non sarebbe stato cosi' semplice...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: Aun así, es una pasada... Casi parece una conversación normal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: S-still, that's amazing ... This basically feels like a normal conversation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Ciononostante e' incredibile... Sembra quasi una conversazione normale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: Flammi es capaz de pensar de forma autónoma y responder a cualquier pregunta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: Flammi possesses autonomous thought, and is capable of answering any question.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Flammi e' in grado di pensare in modo autonomo e di rispondere a qualsiasi domanda.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: Por lo tanto, esta tecnología es inferior a Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: Therefore, this technology is inferior to Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Pertanto questa tecnologia e' inferiore a Flammi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: Lo pillo, lo pillo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: I get it, I get it ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Ho capito, ho capito...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: ¿Qué os trae por aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: So, what brings you all here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Cosa vi porta da queste parti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: Ah, es verdad, una Alber nos ha pedido que te buscáramos. Quería saber dónde estaba su amiga.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: Oh, that's right, an Alber asked us to find you. They've been wondering where their friend is.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Ah, e' vero, una Alber ci ha chiesto di cercarti. Voleva sapere dove si trovasse la sua amica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: ¿Podríais traer aquí a las gentes Alber? Yo soy la amiga que buscan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: Would it be possible for you to bring the Alber here? They are my friends.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Potreste portare qui gli Alber? Io sono l'amica che cercano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: («Soy la amiga que buscan»... Debió de pensar que le harían esa pregunta.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: (... "They are my friends," huh? Maybe this was one of the questions she thought might come up.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: (... "Io sono l'amica che cercano"... Avra' pensato che le avremmo fatto questa domanda.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: Nos encantaría.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: We'd be happy to.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Volentieri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..src: Tenemos muchas preguntas más, pero antes deberíamos ir a buscar al pueblo Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..ref: There's still a lot that I'd like to ask, but we should go see the Alber first.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_110..dst: Avremmo ancora tante domande, ma prima dovremmo andare a cercare il popolo Alber.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: ¡Altus! ¿Habéis encontrado algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: Tall One! Did you find anything?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Altus! Avete trovato qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: Sí. De hecho, nos gustaría llevaros a un sitio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: Yep. Actually, there's somewhere we'd like to take you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Si'. In effetti, vorremmo portarvi in un posto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: ¿Qué es este sitio?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: What is this place?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Che posto e'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: Es el hogar que Enrika os construyó.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: It's something that Enrika was making for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: E' la casa che Enrika ha costruito per voi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: Pero... será mejor que le preguntes a ella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: But, well ... you should probably just ask her yourselves.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Pero'... sara' meglio che lo chiedi a lei.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: ¡Anda, es la voz de Enrika!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: Everyone ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Dai, e' la voce di Enrika!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: Ohhh, pero ¡si son mis pequeñines! ¡Os he echado muchíííísimo de menos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: Oh! That's Enrika's voice!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Ohhh, ma se sono i miei piccolini! Mi siete mancati taaaantissimo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: ¿Cómo?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: Ooooooh, my pwecious widdle darliiings! I've missed each and every one of you sooooooooo much!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Come?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: ¡Cómo me gustaría daros un abrazo! ¿Por qué tuvieron que separarnos?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: ... Huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Come vorrei potervi abbracciare! Perche' ci hanno dovuto separare?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: ¡Oh, Enrika! ¡No has cambiado nada!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: I wish I could give you all the biggest hug! Oh, why did the world have to tear us apart?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Oh, Enrika! Non sei cambiata per niente!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: ¡Hace tanto tiempo que te fuiste!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: Aw, Enrika! You haven't changed a bit!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: E' passato cosi' tanto tempo da quando te ne sei andata!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: Humm... ¿Eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: You've been gone for ages and ages!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Hmm... Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: ¡Mis amorcitos! ¿Cómo estáis? ¿Estáis comiendo bien?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: Uh ... huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Amori miei! Come state? State mangiando bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: ¡Estamos bien!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: My little lovelies! How have you been? Are you all eating well?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Stiamo bene!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: *Snif*... ¿Estáis durmiendo suficiente? ¿Os abrigáis bien por las noches?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: We're doing fine!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: *Snif*... Dormite abbastanza? Vi coprite bene la notte?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: ¡Claro que sí!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: *Sniffle* ... You're getting enough sleep? You're making sure to stay bundled under the covers?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Certo che si'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: ¿Soy la única que piensa que se está portando como una madre?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: Sure are!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Sono l'unica a pensare che si stia comportando come una mamma?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: Con vuestra ayuda, he podido decirles todo lo que quería.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: Anyone else think she's acting like their mom?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Grazie al vostro aiuto, sono riuscita a dir loro tutto quello che volevo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: Humm... ¿De eso iba todo esto?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: Thanks to you all, I managed to say everything I still had left to tell them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Hmm... Era per questo tutto questo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: No sé por qué, siempre me emociono un poquito cuando hablo con los Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: Hey, um ... What was all that about, back there?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Non so perche', ma quando parlo con gli Alber mi commuovo sempre un pochino.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: ¿Cómo que «un poquito»?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: There's just something about talking to the Alber that gets me a little worked up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Come sarebbe a dire "un pochino"?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: Bueno, lo importante es que has podido despedirte... aunque las formas hayan sido estas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: That's "a little" ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Beh, l'importante e' che tu abbia potuto salutarlo... anche se le circostanze sono state queste.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: Bueno, prosigamos... Quería pediros otro favor. En realidad, creo que sería más preciso llamarlo «negociación».
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: Well, what matters most is that you were able to get your parting words across, regardless of the, er, delivery.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Beh, proseguiamo... Volevo chiedervi un altro favore. In realta', credo sarebbe piu' preciso chiamarla "negoziazione".

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: ¿De qué se trata?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: Now, continuing on ... There's one other favor I'd like to ask. Ah, no. Calling it a "negotiation" would be more accurate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Di cosa si tratta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: Me encantaría que retomaseis el proyecto de vivienda Alber donde lo dejé.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: Which is?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Mi piacerebbe molto che riprendeste il progetto abitativo Alber da dove l'ho lasciato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: Evidentemente, no se me ocurriría pedíroslo sin ofreceros algo a cambio. Os cederé todos mis materiales y notas de la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: I'd really love for you to pick up where I left off on the Alber settlement plans.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Ovviamente, non mi sognerei di chiedervelo senza offrirvi qualcosa in cambio. Vi lascero' tutti i miei materiali e gli appunti della ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: Ah, por eso dejaste aquí tus registros. Esperabas que alguien te tomara el relevo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: Of course, I wouldn't ask you to do it for free. I'd bequeath you all of my materials and research notes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Ah, ecco perche' hai lasciato qui i tuoi registri. Speravi che qualcuno raccogliesse il testimone.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: ¿Qué? ¿Nos apuntamos o no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: Ah, so that's why you left your memories here. You were hoping that someone would eventually take over.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Cosa? Ci stiamo o no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: Recuperar las notas de la investigación de una alquimista tan prodigiosa le vendría genial al equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: So, are we in or out?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Recuperare gli appunti di ricerca di un'alchimista tanto prodigiosa sarebbe una manna per la Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: Sí, vamos a tener que investigar de todas formas. Si encima nos llevamos algo a cambio, mejor que mejor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: Recovering the research notes of this talented of an alchemist would be beneficial to the Research Team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Si', tanto dovremo fare ricerche comunque. Se in piu' ci guadagniamo qualcosa, tanto meglio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: ¡Venga, vamos a intentarlo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: Yeah, and we're gonna end up goin' around investigatin' anyway. If we can get a reward, might as well take it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Forza, proviamoci!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: Enrika, llevaremos a cabo tus planes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: Okay! Let's give it a shot!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Enrika, porteremo a termine i tuoi piani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: Gracias, futura alquimista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: ... Right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Grazie, futura alchimista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: Si no os importa, ¿podríais satisfacer sus peticiones también?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: Enrika, we'll see your plans through.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Se non vi dispiace, potreste esaudire anche le loro richieste?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: Cread un lugar donde puedan vivir sin preocupaciones y a salvo, por favor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: Thank you, future alchemist.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Per favore, create un posto dove possano vivere al sicuro e senza preoccupazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..src: ¡Cuenta con nosotros!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..ref: If you don't mind, could you also handle their requests as well?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_120..dst: Contaci!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: Acabáis de empezar, pero parece que la cosa ya está progresando sin problemas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: You've only just started, but things seem to be progressing smoothly.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Avete appena cominciato, ma sembra che le cose stiano gia' procedendo senza intoppi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: Sí, así es. Más Alber se han enterado de lo de la nueva aldea y han empezado a presentarse aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: Yeah, they are. Other Alber have already started showing up after hearing rumors about the new settlement.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Si', e' cosi'. Altri Alber hanno saputo del nuovo villaggio e hanno iniziato a presentarsi qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: Ya, les encanta cualquier novedad emocionante. No me extraña que les haya llamado la atención una nueva aldea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: Well, they do love anything exciting. And news of new housing is guaranteed to pique their interest.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Gia', adorano tutte le novita' emozionanti. Non mi stupisce che un nuovo villaggio abbia attirato la loro attenzione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: Cuanto más desarrolléis la zona, más Alber vendrán por pura curiosidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: The more you develop this area, the more Alber will show up out of curiosity.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Piu' svilupperete la zona, piu' Alber arriveranno per pura curiosita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: Ooooooh... Cómo me gustaría ver qué monadas habrán llegado... Ojalá pudiera verlas en persona...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: Ooooooh ... I wonder what kind of cuties have arrived ... I wish I could see them in person ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Ooooooh... Chissa' quali adorabili creaturine saranno arrivate... Magari potessi vederle di persona...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: Ja, ja... Sería increíble que se convirtiera en el nuevo punto de interés Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: Ahaha ... It would be nice if this became the new Alber hot spot.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Ah, ah... Sarebbe fantastico se diventasse il nuovo punto d'interesse Alber.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: ¡Disculpad!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: Excuse me!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Scusate!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: ¿Q-qué pasa?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: Wh-what's the matter?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: C-che succede?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: ¡Me he enterado de que este va a ser nuestro nuevo hogar, así que aquí estoy!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: I've come here because I heard this is going to be our new home!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Ho saputo che questa sara' la nostra nuova casa, cosi' eccomi qui!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: S-sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: If we're going to live here, we need a sym-bol to show it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: S-si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: ¡Si vamos a vivir aquí, necesitamos un sím-bolo que exhibir!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: Er, sym ... sorry?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Se vivremo qui, ci serve un sim-bolo da esibire!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: ¿Un sím...? ¿Perdona?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: Sym! Bol!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Un sim...? Scusa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: ¡Sím! ¡Bolo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: O-okay, and ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Sim! Bolo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: Ah, vale... Entonces...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: Lend me a hand.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Ah, va bene... Allora...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: Échame una mano.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: Ummm ... You want me to help you build something?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Dammi una mano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: Humm... ¿Quieres que te ayude a construir algo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: No, I will be the one who builds it. I need you to gather the materials for me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Ehm... Vuoi che ti aiuti a costruire qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: No, yo lo construyo. Necesito que me consigas los materiales.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: Yeesh, who does this Alber even think they are?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: No, costruisco io. Mi serve che tu mi procuri i materiali.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: Uf, pero qué humos gastan algunas gentes Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: How should I know? I guess this means that there are all sorts of Alber out there ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Uff, che arie si da' certa gente Alber.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: Yo qué sé. Supongo que esto significa que hay todo tipo de Alber por ahí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: And? Why do we gotta help you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Che ne so. Immagino significhi che la' fuori ci sono Alber di ogni tipo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: Y... ¿Por qué deberíamos ayudarte?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: I heard that it's your job.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: E... perche' dovremmo aiutarti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: Me han dicho que es vuestro trabajo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: I wouldn't really call it our job ... But, well, I guess you aren't far off ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Mi hanno detto che e' il vostro lavoro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: Yo tampoco diría eso... Pero bueno, supongo que no vas desencaminado del todo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: There are all sorts of Alber. Sorry, but would you mind giving this one a hand?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Non lo direi nemmeno io... Ma va beh, immagino che non sia del tutto fuori strada...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: Hay todo tipo de Alber. ¿Os importaría echar una mano a esta de aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: Umm ... you just need some materials, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Ci sono Alber di ogni tipo. Vi dispiacerebbe dare una mano a questa qui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: Humm... Solo necesitas materiales, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: Exactly!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Uhm... Ti servono solo dei materiali, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: ¡Exacto!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..ref: Well, that shouldn't be too hard.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Esatto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..src: Bueno, no debe de ser muy complicado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_130..dst: Beh, non dovrebbe essere troppo complicato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_140..ref: Yes! I'll get to work on it right away!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_140..dst: Si'! Mi metto subito al lavoro!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_140..src: ¡Uf! Aún queda mucho trabajo, pero ¡no hemos empezado con mal pie!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_140..ref: Phew! Still a ways to go, but that's not a bad start!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_140..dst: Uff! C'e' ancora parecchio da fare, ma non e' un cattivo inizio!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_140..src: Hala. Menuda hazaña para un constructor tan pequeño.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_140..ref: Whoa. That's an impressive job for such a small crafter.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_140..dst: Accidenti. Un lavoro notevole per un costruttore cosi' piccolo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_140..src: Más increíble que las de una alquimista que conocemos, ¿eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_140..ref: Better than some alchemists we could name, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_140..dst: Meglio di certi alchimisti che conosciamo, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_140..src: ¡Oye! No estoy en desacuerdo, pero ¡un respeto!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_140..ref: Hey! I don't disagree with that, but still!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_140..dst: Ehi! Non e' che non sia d'accordo, ma comunque!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_140..src: ¡Volved a pasaros luego! ¡Será el mejor sím-bolo que hayáis visto jamás!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_140..ref: Stop by again later! It'll be the finest sym-bol you've ever seen!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_140..dst: Tornate a trovarmi piu' tardi! Sara' il sim-bolo piu' bello che abbiate mai visto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_140..src: Podemos volver por aquí cuando los planes de Enrika hayan progresado un poco más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_140..ref: I guess we should check in again once Enrika's plans have made a little more progress.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_140..dst: Direi di ripassare quando i piani di Enrika saranno un po' piu' avanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..src: Parece que han llegado más Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..ref: It seems as though more Alber have arrived.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..dst: Sembra che siano arrivati altri Alber.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..src: Sí, esto se está animando mucho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..ref: Yeah, it's gotten pretty lively around here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..dst: Gia', qui c'e' un bel po' di movimento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..src: Ah, por cierto, Enrika, me gustaría preguntarte una cosa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..ref: Oh, right. Enrika, there was something that I've been meaning to ask.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..dst: Ah, gia'. Enrika, volevo chiederti una cosa da un po'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..src: Haré todo lo que pueda para responder a vuestras preguntas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..ref: I'll do my best to answer whatever questions you might have.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..dst: Faro' del mio meglio per rispondere a qualsiasi domanda abbiate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..src: ¿Cómo te convertiste en alquimista? En mi época, no hay ninguno.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..ref: Why did you become an alchemist? In my era, we don't have any.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..dst: Perche' sei diventata alchimista? Nella mia epoca non ce ne sono.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..src: Me gustaría aprovechar esta oportunidad para preguntarte sobre el tema. ¿Cómo eran los alquimistas de Aladiss?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..ref: So, I'd like to take this opportunity to ask you. What were Aladissian alchemists like?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..dst: Allora vorrei approfittare di questa occasione per chiedertelo: com'erano gli alchimisti dell'Impero Aladissiano?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..src: Sospechaba que alguien tendría preguntas sobre mí. Me da un poco de vergüenza, pero puedo hablarte un poco de ello.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..ref: I suspected that someone might have questions about myself. It's somewhat embarrassing, but I can explain a little.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..dst: Immaginavo che qualcuno potesse avere delle domande su di me. Mi mette un po' in imbarazzo, ma posso raccontarti qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..src: Cuando era más joven, no se me daba bien relacionarme con los demás. Prefería quedarme en casa y leer manuales.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..ref: When I was younger, I wasn't very good at relating to others. I preferred to stay at home and read reference books.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..dst: Da piccola non ero brava a relazionarmi con gli altri. Preferivo restare a casa a leggere libri di consultazione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..src: Se me daba bien estudiar, pero socializar no tanto. Siempre me decían que era una rarita.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..ref: I was good at studying, but less so at socializing. I was often told that I was weird, or creepy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..dst: Ero brava a studiare, ma meno a socializzare. Mi dicevano spesso che ero una tipa strana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..src: No hay mucha gente capaz de ver el maná con claridad, así que se reían de mí por eso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..ref: There aren't many people these days who can see mana clearly, so I got made fun of for it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..dst: Al giorno d'oggi sono in pochi a vedere chiaramente il mana, percio' mi prendevano in giro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..src: No imaginaba que los alquimistas de Aladiss serían tan parecidos a mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..ref: I might have assumed that Aladissian alchemists were more different from me than they actually were.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..dst: Non immaginavo che gli alchimisti aladissiani fossero cosi' simili a me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..src: Nos han tratado de forma parecida en el pasado y en el presente. Parece que esa parte no ha cambiado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..ref: We've been treated similarly, in both the past and the present. Maybe that part hasn't changed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..dst: Sia in passato che oggi ci hanno trattati in modo simile. Forse questo non e' cambiato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..src: Lo siento, no puedo responder a preguntas inesperadas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..ref: I'm sorry. I cannot answer unexpected questions.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..dst: Mi dispiace. Non posso rispondere a domande inaspettate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..src: ¡Ja, ja! Me imaginaba que dirías eso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..ref: Haha! Yeah, I thought you might say that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..dst: Ahah! Si', immaginavo che avresti detto cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..src: Muchas gracias, Enrika. Me has dado mucho en lo que pensar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..ref: Thank you very much, Enrika. You've given me more to think about.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..dst: Grazie mille, Enrika. Mi hai dato molto su cui riflettere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..ref: I'm just glad that I could help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..dst: Sono solo contenta di averti potuto aiutare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..src: ¡Y tanto! Si no te importa, tengo más cosas que preguntarte más tarde.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..ref: You did! And if you don't mind, I might have some more questions for you later.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_150..dst: E' vero! E, se non ti dispiace, piu' tardi potrei farti altre domande.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: Parece que estamos llegando a la última mitad del proyecto. Me alegro muchísimo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: We seem to be reaching the latter half of the plan, which is a wonderful feeling.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: Sembra che stiamo arrivando alla seconda meta' del piano. E' una sensazione meravigliosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: Todo está creciendo y mejorando. Además, han venido más Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: Everything's getting bigger and better, too. Plus, there are so many more Alber here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: Sta diventando tutto piu' grande e migliore. E poi, qui ci sono molti piu' Alber.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: Si las cosas siguen a este ritmo, podremos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: Provided that things continue on at this pace, we—
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: Se le cose continuano cosi', noi-

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: ¡Aaaaal! ¡Tuuuus!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: Taaaaaall Oooooone!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: Altoneeeee!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: Pero ¿qué...? ¿Qué les ha pasado a vuestros gorros?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: What's wr—Huh? What happened to your hats?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: Che succ-Eh? Che fine hanno fatto i vostri cappelli?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: ¡Pues es gracioso!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: Funny story!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: E' una storia buffa!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: ¡¿Os los han robado?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: Th-they were stolen?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: V-ve li hanno rubati?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: ¡Sí! Últimamente hemos hecho un montón de nuevos amigos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: Yeah! We've made oodles of new friends lately ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: Gia'! Ultimamente abbiamo fatto un sacco di nuovi amici...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: Pero ¡aparecieron unos pájaros monstruosos gigantes y se llevaron nuestros gorros!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: But these super big bird monsters swooped down and took all of our hats!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: Ma sono piombati giu' dei mostri uccello giganteschi e ci hanno rubato tutti i cappelli!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: ¡No tuvieron en cuenta lo importantes que son para nosotros!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: Even though they're super important to us!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: Eppure per noi sono importantissimi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: ¡Esto es una emergencia! ¡Es una crisis sin precedentes para el pueblo Alber!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: Emergency! Emergency! The Alber are experiencing an unprecedented crisis!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: Emergenza! Emergenza! Gli Alber stanno affrontando una crisi senza precedenti!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: Humm, ¿Enrika?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: Um, Enrika ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: Ehm, Enrika...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: ¡Tenéis que dejar todo lo que estéis haciendo y ocuparos de esta amenaza!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: You must drop everything and go handle this threat to their existence!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: Dovete lasciare tutto e occuparvi di questa minaccia alla loro stessa esistenza!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: Parece que el vial de recuerdos tiene un subsistema que se activa en situaciones críticas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: It would appear that this Memory Vial has a subsystem that activates in critical situations.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: Sembra che questa Fiala della Memoria abbia un sottosistema che si attiva nelle situazioni critiche.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: Hala, pues sí que pensó en todo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: Wow, she really did think of everything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: Accidenti, ha pensato proprio a tutto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: Me pregunto si la aparición repentina de tal cantidad de Alber está causando el caos en el bosque...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: I wonder if the sudden appearance of all these Alber is throwing the forest into disarray ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: Mi chiedo se l'improvvisa comparsa di tutti questi Alber stia gettando nel caos la foresta...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: ¿Sabes en qué dirección fueron esos monstruos? Vamos a intentar encontrar vuestros gorros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: Do you know which way those monsters went? We'll go track down your hats.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: Sai da che parte sono andati quei mostri? Cercheremo di ritrovare i vostri cappelli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: ¡¿Lo dices en serio?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: You really mean it?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: Dici sul serio?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: ¡Están en lo alto del árbol! ¡El árbol suuuuperalto!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: They're up in the tree! The suuuuuuper tall one!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: Sono lassu' sull'albero! Quello altissimoooo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: En lo alto del árbol...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: Up in the tree ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: Lassu' sull'albero...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: Conque están ahí arriba, ¿eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: ... All the way up there, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: ... Fin lassu', eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: Entendido. A ver qué podemos hacer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: Got it. We'll see what we can do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: Capito. Vedremo cosa possiamo fare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..src: ¡Muchas gracias, altus!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..ref: Thanks a bunch, Tall Ones!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_160..dst: Grazie mille, Altus!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_170..src: Parece que los monstruos pájaro de los que hablaron las gentes Alber han anidado ahí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_170..ref: It looks like the bird monsters those Alber told us about have made their nest here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_170..dst: Sembra che i mostri uccello di cui ci hanno parlato gli Alber abbiano fatto il nido qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_170..src: ¡Han usado los gorros como acolchamiento extra! ¡Ya entiendo para qué los querían!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_170..ref: And they've used the hats as extra padding! Now I see why they took them!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_170..dst: E hanno usato i cappelli come imbottitura! Ora capisco perche' li hanno presi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_170..src: ¿Cómo? ¿Nos estáis diciendo que no nos acerquemos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_170..ref: What, you're tellin' us to stay back?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_170..dst: Cosa? Ci state dicendo di restare indietro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_170..src: Lo siento, pero esos gorros son nuestros. ¡Y los recuperaremos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_170..ref: Sorry, but those hats are ours. We'll be taking them back!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_170..dst: Mi dispiace, ma quei cappelli sono nostri. Li riprenderemo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_180..ref: And that takes care of that.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_180..src: Sí, no creo que tengan ganas de vérselas de nuevo con los Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_180..ref: Yes, I don't think they'll feel like messing with the Alber ever again.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_180..dst: Si', non credo che avranno piu' voglia di dare fastidio agli Alber.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_180..src: Bueno, vamos a coger los gorros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_180..ref: Well then, let's go grab the hats.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_180..dst: Allora, andiamo a prendere i cappelli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_180..src: Los monstruos los han hecho trizas... Menudo marrón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_180..ref: Those monsters tore them to shreds ... This is quite the predicament.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_180..dst: Quei mostri li hanno fatti a pezzi... Che bel pasticcio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_180..src: Humm... Supongo que lo mejor que podemos hacer por ahora es volver y darles la noticia a esas Alber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_180..ref: Hmm ... I guess the best thing we can do for now is go back and give those Alber the news.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_180..dst: Uhm... Per ora, credo che la cosa migliore sia tornare indietro e dare la notizia agli Alber.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_190..ref: Tall Ones! Did you get our hats back?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_190..dst: Altoni! Avete recuperato i nostri cappelli?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_190..src: Lo siento. Los hemos recuperado, pero los pájaros los han usado para hacer sus nidos, así que están hechos trizas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_190..ref: Sorry. We did, but the birds used them as nesting material, so they're all ripped and torn.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_190..dst: Mi dispiace. Li abbiamo recuperati, ma gli uccelli li hanno usati per fare il nido, quindi sono tutti strappati e ridotti a brandelli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_190..src: Humm, podría hacerles algún apaño, pero creo que va a ser más rápido volver a hacerlos de cero... Aunque también tardaría una eternidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_190..ref: Hmm, I could patch them up, but remaking them would probably be faster ... and even that'd take ages.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_190..dst: Uhm, potrei rattopparli, ma probabilmente ci metterei meno a rifarli da zero... e anche cosi' ci vorrebbe un'eternita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_190..src: Pues parece que ha llegado mi momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_190..ref: Looks like it's my time to shine.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_190..dst: Sembra proprio che sia arrivato il mio momento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_190..src: ¿Os importaría prestármelos? Me gustaría usarlos de referencia para hacer unos nuevos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_190..ref: Would you mind if I borrowed these? I'd like to use them as a reference for making new ones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_190..dst: Vi dispiacerebbe prestarmeli? Vorrei usarli come modello per farne di nuovi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_190..ref: You can make hats, Tall One?!
All right, just leave it to me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_200..src: Me alegro de que os gusten.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_200..ref: I'm just glad you're happy with them.
We sure are! Thank you, Tall One!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_200..src: Verlos siempre me alegra el corazoncito.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_200..ref: Watching them makes me feel all warm and fuzzy inside.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_200..src: ¡A mí también! ¡Me chifla estar con los Alber, son una monada!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_200..ref: I feel the same way! The Alber are just so, so cute!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_200..dst: Anch'io! Gli Alber sono cosi', cosi' carini!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_200..src: ¿Cómo sabía que tendría que añadir eso a la lista de respuestas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_200..ref: Did she really go out of her way to add that to her list of responses?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_200..dst: Ma ha davvero aggiunto apposta questa risposta alla sua lista?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: Hemos llegado muy lejos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: We've come so far ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Ne abbiamo fatta di strada...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: Gracias. Esto nunca se habría hecho realidad sin vuestra ayuda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: Thank you. This wouldn't have happened without your help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Grazie. Questo non sarebbe successo senza il vostro aiuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: Bueno, solo hemos seguido tus planes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: Well, we've just been following your plans.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Beh, abbiamo solo seguito i tuoi piani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: Me alegro de que me encontraseis vosotros. Lo digo de corazón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: I'm so glad you were the ones to find me. I mean that from the bottom of my heart.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Mi fa tanto piacere che siate stati voi a trovarmi. Lo dico con tutto il cuore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: Ojalá hubiera podido estar ahí para sentir esa alegría con vosotros. Es una lástima.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: I only wish that I could have been there to experience their joy myself. But, alas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Vorrei solo aver potuto essere li' e provare di persona la loro gioia. Ma, ahime'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: ¡Altus! ¡Venid a jugar con nosotros!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: Tall Ones! Come and play with us!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Alti! Venite a giocare con noi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: ¡Hay diversión por todas partes!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: Everywhere looks so fun!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Qui sembra tutto cosi' divertente!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: ¡Hala! ¡Oye, no pegues tirones!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: Whoa! Hey, don't pull!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Ehi! Non tirare!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: ¡Oye, yo no he dicho que quisiera...!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: Hey! I didn't say anythin' about goin' with—
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Ehi! Non ho detto che sarei venuto con voi-

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: Venga ya, ¿qué tiene de malo? ¿Por qué no vamos a pasar un buen rato?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: Easy there, there's no harm in it. Why don't we tag along for now?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Calma, non c'e' niente di male. Perche' non li accompagniamo per ora?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: Por favor, vivid esta experiencia por mí. No dejéis que esas sonrisitas se desvanezcan...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: Please, go make memories in my stead. Don't let those little smiles fade ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Per favore, create dei ricordi anche per me. Non lasciate svanire quei loro sorrisini...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: Ahora que lo pienso, ¿qué te gusta tanto de esas gentes?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: Come to think of it, what is it about the Alber that you love so much?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: A pensarci bene, che cosa ti piace tanto degli Alber?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: ¡¿No es evidente?! ¡Son las criaturas más monas del mundo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: Isn't it obvious?! They're just too cute for words!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Non e' ovvio?! Sono le creature piu' carine del mondo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: Bueno, bromas aparte...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: ... Setting that joke aside.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: A parte gli scherzi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: Ya hemos hablado de que no me llevo muy bien con otras personas, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: Have we already talked about how I don't really get along well with other people?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Abbiamo gia' parlato del fatto che non vado molto d'accordo con le altre persone, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: Los compromisos sociales y el aburrimiento de las relaciones personales no son lo mío, así que me centraba en mí misma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: I don't do well with social obligations. I hated dealing with bothersome personal relationships, so I just kept to myself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Gli obblighi sociali non fanno per me. Detestavo dover gestire complicati rapporti personali, cosi' me ne stavo per conto mio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: Sin embargo, un día me topé con unos Alber mientras hacía una exploración de campo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: However, one day I encountered some Alber while I was out on a field survey ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Tuttavia, un giorno mi sono imbattuta in alcuni Alber mentre facevo un'esplorazione sul campo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: La pureza de sus corazones me conmovió. No tienen ninguna mala intención. Sus almas son puras e inmaculadas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: And I was moved by their hearts that were so completely free of ill will. Their pure, unblemished souls ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Mi ha commossa la purezza dei loro cuori. Non hanno alcuna malizia. Le loro anime sono pure e immacolate...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: Fue como si me hubieran hecho una limpieza de corazón. Cuando pasé tiempo con ellos, dejé de sentirme sola por primera vez.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: They made my own heart feel like it was being cleansed. The time I spent with them was the only time I didn't feel alone.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: E' stato come se mi avessero purificato il cuore. Quando passavo del tempo con loro, per la prima volta non mi sentivo sola.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: ¿Por eso hiciste todo esto para que fueran felices?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: And that's why you did all this for them?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: E per questo hai fatto tutto questo per renderli felici?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: Quería devolverles una parte de la felicidad que me habían dado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: I wanted to return some of the happiness they'd given me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Volevo restituire loro un po' della felicita' che mi avevano dato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: Me llevo mucho más tiempo del que esperaba, pero... al final lo hemos conseguido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: It took much, much longer than I'd thought, but ... we got there in the end.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Ci ho messo molto, molto piu' del previsto, ma... alla fine ce l'abbiamo fatta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: Podría decirse que cientos de años después, tus sentimientos siguen siendo los mismos, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: I guess you could say that even after hundreds of years, your feelings never changed, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Si potrebbe dire che, anche dopo centinaia di anni, i tuoi sentimenti non sono mai cambiati, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: Lo siento, no puedo responder a preguntas inesperadas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: I'm sorry. I cannot answer unexpected questions.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Mi dispiace. Non posso rispondere a domande inaspettate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: Lo dices porque te da vergüenza, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: You're just using that to cover up your embarrassment, aren't you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Lo dici solo per nascondere l'imbarazzo, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: Lo siento, no puedo responder a preguntas inesperadas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: I'm sorry. I cannot answer unexpected questions.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Mi dispiace. Non posso rispondere a domande inaspettate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: ¿En serio?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: Honestly ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Davvero?...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: Gracias de nuevo, futura alquimista. Me has ayudado a resolver el mayor de mis remordimientos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: Thank you again, future alchemist. You've cleared the last of my lingering regrets.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Grazie ancora, futura alchimista. Mi hai aiutata a liberarmi dell'ultimo dei miei rimpianti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..src: Peeeero... ¡ojalá pudiera haber visto a esas monaditas tan adorables con mis propios ojooos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..ref: Buuuuuut! I really, really wish I could've seen those adorable widdle cutie-pies off in persoooooon!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm05_210..dst: Pero'o'o'o'! Avrei tanto, tanto voluto vedere di persona quei tenerissimi piccolini!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_010..src: Han venido a verme de la aldea para contarme un problema...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_010..ref: The settlement's residents came to me about a problem they've been having ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_010..dst: Sono venuti a cercarmi dal villaggio per parlarmi di un problema...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_010..src: Ha sido muy amable por tu parte haber escuchado. ¿Qué problema?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_010..ref: You really are kind to hear them out. What kind of problem is it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_010..dst: E' stato molto gentile da parte tua ascoltarli. Che problema c'e'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_010..src: S-sí... Dicen que apareció una figura vagamente humana.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_010..dst: S-si'... Dicono che sia apparsa una figura vagamente umana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_010..src: Al parecer, la vieron cerca de aquí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_010..ref: Y-yeah ... They said a hazy humanlike figure appeared.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_010..dst: A quanto pare, l'hanno vista qui vicino...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_010..src: Pues sí que es interesante... Vamos a reunirnos con los demás para investigar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_010..ref: And apparently, it was spotted close to here ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_010..dst: E' proprio interessante... Andiamo a riunirci con gli altri per indagare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_010..ref: ... That's definitely interesting. Let's gather the others and investigate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..ref: So, this is where the ghost was sighted?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..dst: E' qui che hanno avvistato il fantasma?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..src: Dijo: «Menudo muermo. Haced lo que os dé la gana».
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..ref: He said, "Sounds borin'. You all do whatever you want."
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..dst: Ha detto: "Che noia. Fate come vi pare".

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..ref: By the way, what exactly is this ghost?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..dst: A proposito, com'e' fatto esattamente questo fantasma?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..src: Dicen que tenía una forma vagamente humanoide.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..ref: The witnesses said it was a hazy humanlike figure.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..dst: I testimoni hanno detto che era una figura indistinta dalle sembianze umane.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..src: Cuando vieron al fantasma, atravesó el muro y desapareció...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..ref: According to the resident who saw the ghost, it appeared to phase into the wall and disappear ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..dst: Stando all'abitante che ha visto il fantasma, sembrava attraversare il muro e sparire...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..src: Es muy tenue, pero parece que hay un residuo de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..ref: It's faint, but I see something that looks like the remnants of mana.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..dst: E' molto tenue, ma vedo qualcosa che sembra un residuo di mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..ref: Ah! Now that you mention it ...!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..dst: Ah! Ora che me lo fai notare...!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..src: Esto significa que hay una posibilidad considerable de que el «fantasma» sea un fenómeno de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..ref: That means there's a strong possibility that this "ghost" is a mana-related phenomenon.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..dst: Questo significa che e' molto probabile che il "fantasma" sia un fenomeno legato al mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..src: El sonido ha cambiado... Ahí hay una cueva.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..ref: The sound changed ... There's a cave here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..dst: Il suono e' cambiato... Qui c'e' una grotta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..src: ¡Hay algo detrás del muro! Entonces ¿de ahí vino el fantasma?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..ref: So there's something behind this wall! Then that's where the ghost came from?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..dst: C'e' qualcosa dietro il muro! E' da li' che e' venuto il fantasma?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..src: Humm... Ese sonido sugiere que si seguimos cavando llegaremos a una cueva.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..ref: Hmm ... that sound suggests we'll reach a cave if we do a little digging.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..dst: Mmh... Quel suono suggerisce che, scavando un po', raggiungeremo una grotta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..src: Sí, pero no deberíamos hacerlo sin permiso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..ref: Yes, but it's not our place to do so without permission.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..dst: Si', ma non dovremmo farlo senza permesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..src: Vamos a intentar hablar con Cledia.
Es solo un presentimiento, pero creo que deberíamos investigar más a fondo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..ref: This is just a hunch, but I think we should do a thorough investigation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_020..dst: E' solo un presentimento, ma credo che dovremmo indagare a fondo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Cledia, ¿tienes un momento para hablar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Cledia, do you have a moment to talk?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Cledia, hai un momento per parlare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: ¿De qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Oh? What about?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Di cosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Verás... Estamos investigando el problema del fantasma que se ha convertido en la comidilla de la aldea...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: You see, we're looking into the ghost issue that's become the talk of the settlement ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Vedi... Stiamo indagando sul fantasma, che e' diventato il pettegolezzo del villaggio...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: ¿Sabes algo del fantasma o la cueva que hemos encontrado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Do you know anything about the ghost or the cave we found?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Sai qualcosa del fantasma o della grotta che abbiamo trovato?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Veamos. Es probable que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Let's see. It's likely ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Vediamo. E' probabile che...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Será mejor que hablemos en otro sitio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Let's discuss this elsewhere.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: E' meglio parlarne altrove.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Si no me equivoco, la cueva debería dirigir a una gruta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: If my history is correct, that cave should lead into a cavern.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Se la mia memoria storica non mi inganna, quella grotta dovrebbe condurre a una caverna.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Después de subir una pendiente traicionera, deberíais<CR>llegar al Campo de entrenamiento de Idus.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Then, after climbing a treacherous slope, you should<CR>reach a place called the "Idus Training Grounds."
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Dopo aver superato una ripida salita impervia, dovreste<CR>raggiungere un luogo chiamato "Campo di addestramento di Idus".

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Es el lugar al que los alquimistas Welleks viajaban para cultivar su mente y su cuerpo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: It's a place where Welleks alchemists once journeyed to hone their minds and bodies.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: E' il luogo dove un tempo gli alchimisti Welleks si recavano per allenare la mente e il corpo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Almas valerosas de todo el territorio se reunían para competir y mejorar sus habilidades para mejorar aún más como alquimistas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Fearless souls from across the land gathered to compete and improve their skills so they could become greater alchemists.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Anime impavide da ogni angolo del territorio si riunivano per competere e affinare le proprie capacita', cosi' da diventare alchimisti migliori.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Mejorar como alquimistas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Greater alchemists ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Alchimisti migliori...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: ¿Cómo? Pero los alquimistas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Huh? But alchemists are ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Eh? Ma gli alchimisti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Sí. Cuando se produjo el Gran Desastre de Aladiss, se responsabilizó a la alquimia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Yes. The Great Disaster of Aladiss occurred, and alchemy was held responsible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Si'. Quando si verifico' il Grande Disastro di Aladiss, la colpa fu attribuita all'alchimia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Después de eso, los Welleks juraron que la evitarían. Renunciaron a ella y no la volvieron a practicar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Afterwards, Welleks swore to avoid alchemy. It was renounced and hasn't been practiced since.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: In seguito, i Welleks giurarono di starne alla larga. Vi rinunciarono e da allora non la praticarono piu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Evidentemente, eso significa que Idus ya no es un campo de entrenamiento para alquimistas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Of course, this means that Idus no longer serves as a training ground for alchemists.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Certo, questo significa che Idus non e' piu' un campo di addestramento per alchimisti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Entonces, ¿significa eso que se ha sellado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Then does that mean that it's been sealed away?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Quindi significa che e' stata sigillata?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Sí. En la aldea hasta se han olvidado de su existencia. No es más que una reliquia del pasado...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Yes. The people of the settlement have forgotten it even exists. It's purely a relic of the past ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Si'. Gli abitanti dell'insediamento si sono persino dimenticati che esista. Non e' altro che una reliquia del passato...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Ah, pero podría tener valor para el equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Ah, but it might hold some value for your Research Team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Ah, ma potrebbe avere un certo valore per la Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Nos interesa mucho echarle un vistazo, pero ¿sería apropiado que echáramos abajo el muro?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: We really want to check it out, but is it all right to break the wall?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Vorremmo proprio dare un'occhiata, ma va bene abbattere il muro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Mientras no se dañe nada más, no hay problema. Pero no es fácil llegar a Idus.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: As long as nothing else is damaged, it won't be a problem. But one cannot reach Idus that easily.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Purche' non si danneggi altro, non ci saranno problemi. Ma raggiungere Idus non e' cosi' semplice.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Según lo que se indica en la guía Flumme, debería estar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: According to the words left behind by the Flumme guide, it should be ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Stando a quanto scritto dalla guida Flumme, dovrebbe trovarsi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: ¿Cómo? ¿Flumme?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Huh? The Flumme?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Eh? I Flumme?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Ah. ¿Eres del clan Flumme?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Oh. Are you from the Flumme clan?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Ah. Tu fai parte del clan Flumme?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: ¡S-sí! ¡Soy de una aldea del clan Flumme!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: I-I am! I'm from a Flumme clan settlement!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: S-si'! Vengo da un insediamento del clan Flumme!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Vaya, menuda casualidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: I see. This is quite a coincidence.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Capisco. Che coincidenza!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Una conexión con el pueblo de Lenja... Suponía que encontraríamos algo así algún día.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: A connection to Lenja's people? Well, I thought we'd find something like that one day, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Un legame con il popolo di Lenja? Beh, pensavo che prima o poi avremmo trovato qualcosa del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Nunca había oído hablar del campo de entrenamiento, ni siquiera en la aldea. Si pudiera recuperar algún documento o reliquia...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Even in the settlement, I never heard about a training ground. If I could bring back some documents or relics ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Non avevo mai sentito parlare del campo d'addestramento, nemmeno nell'insediamento. Se riuscissi a recuperare qualche documento o reliquia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Ji, ji. Otro motivo más para investigar el asunto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: *Chuckle* Yet another reason to look into this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Eh eh. Un altro motivo per indagare sulla faccenda.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: ¡Sí!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Yes!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Si'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Se dice que el camino a Idus tiene una prueba inicial para medir el poder de un alquimista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: It's said that the path to Idus has an "Initial Trial" designed to measure an alchemist's power.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Si dice che lungo la strada per Idus ci sia una "Prova Iniziale" ideata per misurare il potere di un alchimista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: No sé qué significará eso. A lo mejor tiene algo que ver con el supuesto fantasma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: I don't know what that entails. Perhaps it's related to that so-called ghost.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Non so cosa comporti. Forse ha a che fare con quel presunto fantasma.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Esa es toda la información que puedo darte...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: ... That is all the information I can give you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: ...Queste sono tutte le informazioni che posso darvi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: No va a ser fácil llegar ahí, ¿eh? Un campo de pruebas... Suena interesante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: So gettin' there won't be easy? A trial ground ... now that sounds interestin'.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Quindi arrivarci non sara' facile, eh? Un campo di prova... Questo si' che sembra interessante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: ¿No estabas muerto de miedo hace un momento?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Weren't you terrified a minute ago?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Ma non eri terrorizzato un momento fa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Lo pillo... Lo investigaremos más a fondo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: ... Understood. We'll look into this further.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: ...Capito. Approfondiremo le indagini.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Por cierto, me gustaría pediros que no enseñéis nada de lo que encontréis en Idus ni habléis del tema con nadie de la aldea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: And as an additional note, I ask that you do not show or discuss anything you find at Idus within the settlement.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: E gia' che ci siamo, vi chiedo di non mostrare ne' discutere con nessuno dell'insediamento cio' che troverete a Idus.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Vale, tendremos cuidado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: All right. We'll be careful.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Va bene. Faremo attenzione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Ni siquiera nosotros sabemos cómo será ese lugar a día de hoy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Even we don't know what's become of that place.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Nemmeno noi sappiamo come sara' quel posto ormai.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..src: Avanzad con cautela. Os deseo un viaje seguro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..ref: Proceed with caution. Well then, have a safe journey.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_030..dst: Procedete con cautela. Vi auguro un viaggio sicuro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_040..src: Será mejor que vayamos poco a poco si queremos no alterar el entorno.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_040..ref: If we need to minimize any impact on the surroundings, a simpler method might be the way to go.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_040..dst: Se vogliamo ridurre al minimo l'impatto sull'ambiente, forse e' meglio procedere con un metodo piu' semplice.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_040..src: Es tu momento, Rutger. A perforar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_040..ref: It's your time to mine, Rutger.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_040..dst: E' il tuo momento di scavare, Rutger.
Da quando mi metto a scavare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_040..ref: You've got a pickaxe, don't you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_040..dst: Ma ce l'hai un piccone, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_040..src: ¡No es un pico, es una guadaña!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_040..ref: It's not a pickaxe, it's a scythe!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_040..dst: Non e' un piccone, e' una falce!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_040..src: Chist, me estás tocando las narices...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_040..ref: Tch, you've got some nerve, pushin' me around ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_040..dst: Tsk, hai proprio un bel coraggio a darmi ordini...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_040..src: Hora de investigar. Por lo que ha dicho Cledia, no va a ser un camino fácil...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_040..ref: Let's start the investigation. According to Cledia, the path ahead won't be an easy one ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_040..dst: Cominciamo a indagare. Da quello che ha detto Cledia, la strada davanti a noi non sara' facile...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: Un momento...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: ... Wait.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: ...Aspetta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: ¿Qué pasa, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: What's wrong, Yumia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Che c'e', Yumia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: Aquí hay algo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: Something's here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Qui c'e' qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: ¡E-es una barrera! ¡El camino está bloqueado!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: I-it's a barrier! A barrier is blocking the way forward!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: E'-e' una barriera! Ci blocca la strada!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: ¿Alguno de los dos ve algo? Para mí, parece que el camino continúa por aquí...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: Do you two see something? To me, it just looks like the path continues on from here ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Voi due vedete qualcosa? A me sembra solo che il sentiero continui da qui...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: No tengo claro cuál será su origen, pero parece que aquí hay una materia única que contiene una gran cantidad de maná.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: The principle behind it is unclear, but there seems to be a unique material containing large amounts of mana here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Non e' chiaro come funzioni, ma qui sembra esserci un materiale unico che contiene una grande quantita' di mana.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: ¿P-podría ser esa prueba inicial que mencionó Cledia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: C-could this be the "Initial Trial" that Cledia mentioned?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: P-potrebbe essere la "Prova iniziale" di cui parlava Cledia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: ¿Qué es eso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: What's that?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Che cos'e'?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: ¿U-una persona?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: A-a person?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: E'... una persona?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: ¡¿Flammi?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: Flammi?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Flammi?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: O-oye, ¿qué es...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: H-hey, what's—?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Ehi, ma che...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: Oh, alquimistas, da comienzo vuestra prueba...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: O alchemists, challengers of this trial ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: O alchimisti, sfidanti di questa prova...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: ¿Flammi?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: Flammi ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Flammi...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: Ved más allá de la puerta invisible, vislumbrad la senda oculta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: See beyond the invisible gate before you. Discern the hidden path.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Guardate oltre il varco invisibile che vi sta davanti. Scoprite il sentiero nascosto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: El camino a Idus solo se abrirá a aquellos que ansíen de corazón aprender, medrar y entrenar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: The path to Idus shall only open to those who show a will to learn, grow, and train in earnest.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Il cammino per Idus si aprira' solo a chi dimostrera' di voler imparare, crescere e allenarsi con impegno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: Conciencia recuperada... Regreso confirmado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: ... Senses restored. Confirming return.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: ... Sensi ripristinati. Confermo il ritorno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: ¡¿Flammi?! ¿Estás bien?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: F-Flammi?! Are you okay?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: F-Flammi?! Stai bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: Factores externos han provocado una posesión temporal del alma de Flammi.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: External factors caused Flammi's soul to be temporarily possessed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Fattori esterni hanno causato una temporanea possessione dell'anima di Flammi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: Wha—?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Cosa...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: ¡Un momento, esto no me suena nada bien!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: Hang on, that doesn't sound okay to me!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Aspetta un attimo, non mi sembra affatto una cosa da niente!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: Todas las funciones han vuelto a la normalidad. Flammi no detecta problemas en este momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: Presently, functions have all returned to normal. Flammi does not detect any issues at this time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Tutte le funzioni sono tornate alla normalita'. Al momento Flammi non rileva alcun problema.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: Me alegro si es verdad, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: That's good if it's true, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Se e' vero, mi fa piacere, ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: ¿A qué ha venido eso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: What was that just now?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Cos'e' successo poco fa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: Lo más probable es que el fantasma haya usado el cuerpo de Flammi para enseñarte cómo pasar la prueba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: It is likely that the phantom used Flammi's body to tell you how to clear the trial.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Probabilmente il fantasma ha usato il corpo di Flammi per dirvi come superare la prova.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: Ha dicho que el camino se abriría a aquellos que mostraran un interés sincero en entrenarse. Pero... ¿qué significará eso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: It said the path would open to those who show a will to train in earnest. But ... what's that mean?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..dst: Ha detto che il cammino si sarebbe aperto a chi avesse dimostrato di voler fare sul serio con l'allenamento. Ma... che significa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..src: Oye, Flammi, ¿con eso se referirá a...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm06_050..ref: Hey, Flammi. Would showing a will to learn mean ...
