eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..src: Ya sabes cómo va el tema. Al principio también les costó aceptarte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..ref: You know how it is. It wasn't easy for them to accept you at first either.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..dst: Sai com'e'. All'inizio e' stato difficile anche per loro accettarti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..src: Vaya, restableció a un espécimen con siglos de antigüedad... Cuesta creerlo, pero Nina demuestra que no es imposible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..ref: Restoring a centuries-old specimen, huh? It's hard to believe, but Nina proves it's not impossible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..dst: Hai riportato in vita un esemplare vecchio di secoli, eh? E' difficile da credere, ma Nina dimostra che non e' impossibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..src: Parece que has recuperado parte de la memoria. ¿Te importaría contarnos en qué piensas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..ref: It seems like parts of your memory have returned. Mind sharing what you're thinking?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..dst: Sembra che ti siano tornati alcuni ricordi. Ti va di dirci cosa ne pensi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..src: Pienso en el propósito de mi existencia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..ref: I've been thinking about the purpose of my existence.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..dst: Penso allo scopo della mia esistenza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..src: Este presente... no tiene nada que ver con la época que veo en los pequeños fragmentos de recuerdos que tengo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..ref: The present day ... it's completely different from the time that exists in the fragments of my memory.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..dst: Il presente... e' completamente diverso dall'epoca che esiste nei frammenti dei miei ricordi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..src: Tampoco sé los motivos por los que acabé siendo un mutante. No soy más que un artefacto olvidado, fuera de lugar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..ref: The reasons I became a mutant are long gone as well. I'm just a leftover artifact, out of place in this era.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..dst: Anche le ragioni per cui sono diventato un mutante sono ormai svanite. Sono solo un reperto dimenticato, fuori posto in quest'epoca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..src: Pero saber de la existencia de otros mutantes me lleva a preguntarme si podría tener alguna función.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..ref: But hearing about the other mutants made me wonder if there's some role only I can fill.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..dst: Ma sapere che esistono altri mutanti mi ha fatto chiedere se ci sia un ruolo che solo io posso ricoprire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..src: Tal vez mi misión sea ayudar al equipo de investigación de Aladiss en lo que pueda. Quizá por eso he despertado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..ref: Maybe that role is helping the Aladiss Research Team in whatever way I can. Perhaps that's why I awoke.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..dst: Forse il mio ruolo e' aiutare la Squadra di Ricerca di Aladiss come posso. Magari e' per questo che mi sono risvegliato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..src: Una cosa tengo clara: no me convertiré en lo que Corleonis quería.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..ref: If nothing else, I won't let myself turn into what Corleonis wanted.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..dst: Una cosa e' certa: non diventero' cio' che Corleonis voleva.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..src: Por eso quería saber más sobre vosotros y vuestra historia. Si me lo permitís, claro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..ref: That's why I want to hear your stories—to learn more about you. If you'll allow me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..dst: Per questo voglio ascoltare le vostre storie e conoscervi meglio. Se me lo permettete, s'intende.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..src: Ya veo. Ahora entiendo cómo te sientes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..ref: I see. I understand where you're coming from now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..dst: Capisco. Ora comprendo come ti senti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..src: Por suerte, tenemos tiempo de sobra y me gustaría que todos pudiesen hablar. ¿Qué os parece comentar cómo os sentís?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..ref: Luckily, we've got time, and I won't stop anyone from speaking. How about you all discuss what you're feeling?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_190..dst: Per fortuna abbiamo tutto il tempo che vogliamo, e non impediro' a nessuno di parlare. Che ne dite di raccontarci come vi sentite?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: Elnath, ¿podemos hablar? Hay algo importante que me gustaría decirte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: Elnath, can we talk? There's something important I need to share with you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: Elnath, possiamo parlare? Devo dirti una cosa importante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: Por supuesto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: Of course.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: Certo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: No me andaré con rodeos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: To get straight to the point—
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: Vado dritto al punto...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: Soy un homúnculo, y me crearon en la misma época en la que tú viviste.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: I'm a homunculus, created in the same era as you lived.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: Sono un omuncolo, creato nella stessa epoca in cui vivevi tu.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: Debido a lo que pasó en aquel entonces, se me encerró en un féretro y he vivido hasta ahora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: Because of what happened back then, I was sealed inside a casket and lived to this era.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: A causa di cio' che accadde allora, fui sigillato in un sarcofago e sono sopravvissuto fino a quest'epoca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: Por cómo has hablado, pensaba que podríamos tener un pasado similar... Y veo que tenía razón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: From the way you spoke, I sensed we might share a similar past ... I see now I was right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: Da come parlavi, avevo intuito che potessimo avere un passato simile... Ora vedo che avevo ragione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: Ahora viene lo más importante: ¿te suena el nombre de Marina Friede?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: Now comes the crucial part. Does the name "Marina Friede" ring any bells?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: Ora viene il punto cruciale. Il nome "Marina Friede" ti dice qualcosa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: La doctora Marina... La fugitiva que se escapó del laboratorio. Seguro que fue a ella a quien ayudé.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: Doctor Marina ... the fugitive who escaped from the lab. I'm fairly certain she's the one I helped get away.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: La Dottoressa Marina... La fuggitiva che e' scappata dal laboratorio. Sono quasi certo che sia proprio lei ad avermi aiutato a fuggire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: ¡¿Qué...?! Espera, eso significa que... ¡¿Cómo...?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: Wha—?! Wait, does that mean ... Wha?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: Co...?! Aspetta, vuol dire che... Co...?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: ¿Os conocisteis hace siglos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: You two were acquainted centuries ago?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: Vi conosceste secoli fa?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: El recuerdo está un poco difuso, pero... sí. Recuerdo que no estaba sola cuando escapó.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: The memory's faint ... But yes, I do recall that she wasn't alone when she escaped.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: Il ricordo e' un po' sbiadito, ma... si'. Ricordo che non era sola quando e' fuggita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: Entonces... ¿Eras tú?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: ... That was you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: Allora... eri tu?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: Tal y como pensaba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: As I thought.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: Proprio come pensavo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: Nunca pensé que encontraría a alguien a quien conociera en esta época..., aunque tu aspecto sea distinto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: I never imagined I'd run into someone I knew in this era ...  Even if your appearance has changed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: Non avrei mai immaginato di incontrare qualcuno che conoscevo in quest'epoca... anche se il tuo aspetto e' cambiato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: Lo mismo digo. Si no recuerdo mal, por aquel entonces parecías mucho más joven...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: The same goes for me. If I recall, you looked much younger at the time ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: Lo stesso vale per me. Se ricordo bene, all'epoca sembravi molto piu' giovane...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: Gracias. De no ser por tu ayuda entonces, no estaría aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: Thank you. If it weren't for your help that day, I wouldn't be standing here now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: Grazie. Se non mi avessi aiutata quel giorno, ora non sarei qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: Fui yo quien decidió ayudarte, así que no estás en deuda conmigo. Además, fue hace siglos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: I chose to help you, it's not something you owe me for. Besides, it was centuries ago.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: Sono stata io a scegliere di aiutarti, non mi devi nulla. E poi, e' successo secoli fa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: Pero te detuvieron por eso...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: But it's what led to your arrest ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: Ma e' per questo che ti hanno arrestato...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: No fue solo por eso. Fue mi culpa por aferrarme a unos ideales demasiado adelantados a mi época.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: It wasn't just that. It was my own fault for clinging to ideals that didn't belong in that era.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: Non e' stato solo per questo. E' colpa mia, per essermi aggrappato a ideali troppo avanti per la mia epoca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: No has cambiado nada. Sigues tan amable como entonces.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: ... You haven't changed. You're still as kind as ever.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: Non sei cambiato per niente. Sei ancora gentile come allora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: Ojalá alguien lo hubiera visto así por entonces...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: If only someone had seen it that way back then ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: Se solo qualcuno l'avesse visto cosi', all'epoca...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: La historia parece casi sacada de un cuento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: It's almost like something out of a fairy tale.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: La storia sembra quasi uscita da una fiaba.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..src: Sí, cuesta creer que sea verdad...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..ref: Yeah. It's hard to believe that it's actually true...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_200..dst: Si', e' difficile credere che sia davvero successo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..ref: Elnath, do you have a moment?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..src: En nuestro hogar, mi hermana y yo sobrevivimos a un enorme desastre de maná, obra de un mutante como tú: Vésper.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..ref: Back where we're from, my sister and I survived a huge mana disaster. It was caused by Vesper, a mutant like you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..dst: Nella nostra terra, io e mia sorella siamo sopravvissuti a un'enorme catastrofe di mana, opera di un mutante come te: Vesper.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..src: Así que tenía mis dudas: ¿de verdad podía confiar en un mutante o eran todos enemigos a derrotar?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..ref: So I had doubts. Could I really trust a mutant? Or were they simply enemies to be defeated?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..dst: Cosi' avevo dei dubbi: potevo davvero fidarmi di un mutante o erano tutti nemici da sconfiggere?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..src: Si te digo la verdad, aún estoy resentida. Lo que Vésper nos arrebató... dejó huella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..ref: To be honest, I'm still torn. What Vesper took from us ... it left too deep a wound.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..dst: A dire la verita', sono ancora risentita. Quello che Vesper ci ha strappato via... ha lasciato il segno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..src: Sin embargo, pienso en lo que le dijiste a Yumia: que fue tu culpa y de nadie más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..ref: But then I think of what you said to Yumia. "This is my burden to bear, not yours."
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..dst: Pero' penso a quello che hai detto a Yumia: che era colpa tua e di nessun altro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..src: Dijiste que estaba mal culpar a Yumia solo por ser alquimista.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..ref: In other words, you were saying it's wrong to blame Yumia just because she's an alchemist.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..dst: Hai detto che era sbagliato incolpare Yumia solo perche' e' un'alchimista.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..src: Y, cuando te oí decir eso, me di cuenta de que tenías razón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..ref: When I heard that, I realized you were right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..dst: E quando ti ho sentito dire quello, ho capito che avevi ragione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..src: Siguiendo esa lógica, tampoco tendría sentido guardarte rencor por ser mutante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..ref: By that logic, it doesn't make sense for us to hold you being a mutant against you either.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..dst: Seguendo quella logica, non avrebbe senso nemmeno risentirti per essere un mutante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..src: El enemigo real es Vésper y quien lo controla, Basilius. No debo olvidarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..ref: The real enemy is Vesper, and the one behind him, Basilius. I reminded myself not to lose sight of that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..dst: Il vero nemico e' Vesper e chi lo controlla, Basilius. Non devo dimenticarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..src: Así que, si has decidido ayudar al equipo de investigación, no tenemos motivos para negarnos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..ref: So if you've decided to support the Research Team, then we have no reason to say no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..dst: Quindi, se hai deciso di aiutare la Squadra di Ricerca, non abbiamo motivo di rifiutare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..src: La confianza no se gana así como así, y lo mismo ocurrió con Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..ref: Trust doesn't come instantly. The same was true for Yumia at first.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..dst: La fiducia non si guadagna cosi' facilmente, e lo stesso e' accaduto con Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..src: Me alegra que no me guardes rencor pero, en parte, siento que también es culpa mía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..ref: I'm grateful you're not holding it against me, but I still feel that I'm not entirely blameless.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..dst: Mi fa piacere che tu non me ne voglia, ma in parte sento che e' colpa anche mia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..src: A juzgar por tus actos, diría que a ti también te ocurre, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..ref: Judging by how you've acted, I'd say you share that sentiment, Lady Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..dst: A giudicare dai tuoi atti, direi che anche a te succede lo stesso, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..src: Pues sí. Como alquimista de la era moderna, creo que mi responsabilidad es aprender y hacer todo lo que pueda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..ref: I do. I feel it's my responsibility as a modern alchemist to learn what must be learned and do what must be done.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..dst: Beh, si'. In quanto alchimista dell'era moderna, credo che sia mia responsabilita' imparare e fare tutto il possibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..src: Atesoro esas palabras y, como Yumia, llevaré a cabo mi labor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..ref: So I'll keep those words close to heart, and, like Yumia, fulfill the duty that is mine to bear.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..dst: Faro' tesoro di quelle parole e, come Yumia, portero' a termine il compito che mi spetta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..src: Bien. Me alegra que esa sea tu respuesta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..ref: Good. I'm glad that's your answer.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_210..dst: Bene. Mi fa piacere che tu abbia risposto cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: Que quede claro que no tengo nada que decirte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: Just so we're clear, I've got nothin' to say to you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: Ti dico subito che non ho nulla da dirti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: Muy bien, respeto tu decisión.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: Fair enough. I respect that decision.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: Molto bene, rispetto la tua decisione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: Sin embargo, parece que la que te acompaña no piensa igual.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: But the one stickin' close to you doesn't look like she feels the same.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: Pero' sembra che quella che ti accompagna non la pensi come te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: ¿Y-yo? Em...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: M-me? Um ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: I-io? Ehm...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: Tienes razón. Supongo que me gustaría comentar algunas cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: You're right. I guess there are some things I wanted to talk about.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: Hai ragione. Suppongo che ci siano alcune cose che vorrei dirti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: Si así lo quieres, estaré encantado de oírlas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: If you're willing, I'd like to hear them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: Se ti va, le ascoltero' volentieri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: Como ha dicho el jefe, la gente te mira igual que me miraban a mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: Like the chief said earlier, the way everyone looks at you reminds me of how they used to look at me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: Come ha detto il capo, la gente ti guarda come guardava me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: Hoy en día, la alquimia es un arte prohibido, por eso la gente me miraba con desconfianza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: Nowadays, alchemy is a forbidden art. That's why people often looked at me like I couldn't be trusted.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: Oggigiorno l'alchimia e' un'arte proibita, per questo la gente mi guardava con diffidenza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: No podía verlo como si no fuera conmigo. A lo mejor es interesado decir que sentía compasión por ti, pero así era.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: I just couldn't see it as someone else's problem. Maybe it's self-serving to say I felt sympathy, but I did.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: Non riuscivo a vederla come una questione che non mi riguardava. Forse e' da egoisti dire che provavo compassione per te, ma era cosi'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: Yo también he pasado por ahí. Por eso quiero verte por quién eres y no por la etiqueta que se te ha impuesto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: I've been there too. That's why I want to see you for who you are, not the label you've been given.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: Anch'io ci sono passata. Per questo voglio vederti per quello che sei e non per l'etichetta che ti e' stata imposta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: ¿A ti qué clase de persona te parezco?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: What kind of person do I seem like from your perspective?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: Che tipo di persona ti sembro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: Mmm... Me recuerdas a Viktor. Una persona de ideales firmes y que sigue adelante pase lo que pase.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: Hmm ... you remind me of Viktor. A person who sticks to their beliefs and pushes forward, no matter what.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: Hmm... Mi ricordi Viktor. Una persona dai saldi ideali, che va avanti qualsiasi cosa succeda.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: En el fondo, sabes qué es lo justo. Y lo admiro. Me encantaría poder ser así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: You know what is right, deep down. I admire that. I hope I can be like that, too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: In fondo sai cosa e' giusto. E questo lo ammiro. Mi piacerebbe poter essere cosi' anch'io.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: Por eso creo que se puede confiar en ti para que te unas al equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: That's why I feel you can be trusted as a fellow member of the Research Team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: Per questo credo che tu possa unirti alla Squadra di Ricerca come membro degno di fiducia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: Aunque Rutger no esté a favor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: Even though Rutger seems against the idea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: Anche se a Rutger non piace l'idea.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: Es que no creo en la amistad, sea con un mutante o no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: I don't trust things like "friends" to begin with, mutant or not.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: E' che non credo nell'amicizia, si tratti di un mutante o no.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: Ajá.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: What?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: Aha.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: ¿Qué?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: I don't believe you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: Eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: No me lo creo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: Listen, I'm only workin' with you because I figured it'll pay off for me down the line.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: Non ci credo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: Mira, yo solo trabajo con vosotros porque pensé que me acabaría beneficiando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: I get rid of things that aren't worth anythin' to me without hesitation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: Guarda, io lavoro con voi solo perche' pensavo che prima o poi ne avrei guadagnato qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: Me deshago de todo lo que no me aporta nada sin dudarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: Makes sense. It's a simple, logical stance.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: Mi sbarazzo di tutto cio' che non mi serve, senza esitare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: Tiene sentido. Es una postura lógica y sencilla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: In other words, if I demonstrate that I bring value to the team and to you, there won't be a problem, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: Ha senso. E' una posizione logica e semplice.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: En otras palabras, si demuestro ser útil para el equipo y para ti, no habrá problema, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: ... Hmph.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: In altre parole, se dimostro di portare vantaggio alla squadra e a te, non ci saranno problemi, giusto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: Rutger nunca se abre con sinceridad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: Rutger's never honest with his feelings.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: Rutger non si apre mai con sincerita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: Es más que obvio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: That much is obvious.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: E' piu' che ovvio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..src: Vosotros dos, ya basta...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..ref: That's enough from you two ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_220..dst: Voi due, basta cosi'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_230..src: ¿Ya habéis dicho todo lo que queríais decir?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_230..ref: Have you all said what you wanted to say?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_230..dst: Avete gia' detto tutto quello che volevate dire?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_230..src: Sí, al menos por ahora, pero creo que lo importante viene ahora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_230..ref: Yeah, for now. But I think what really matters is what comes next.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_230..dst: Si', almeno per ora, ma credo che adesso venga la parte importante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_230..src: Creo que has dado en el clavo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_230..ref: I'd say you hit the nail on the head.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_230..dst: Penso che tu abbia colpito nel segno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_230..src: Como ha dicho Yumia, seguirás formando parte del equipo por ahora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_230..ref: As Yumia said, you'll remain with her team for the time being.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_230..dst: Come ha detto Yumia, per ora continuerai a far parte della squadra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_230..src: Tenemos que seguir investigando Aladissia, a ver si encontramos algo que te devuelva la memoria.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_230..ref: There's still investigation to be done in Aladissia. See if anything else jogs your memory.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_230..dst: Dobbiamo continuare a indagare su Aladissia, per vedere se troviamo qualcosa che ti faccia recuperare la memoria.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_230..ref: Apologize for the long wait I do, Yumia. Opened, the path to the reservoir has been. Go to the bridge.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_230..src: Por la espera lo siento mucho, Yumia. El camino a la reserva se ha abierto, sí. Puedes ir al puente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_230..dst: Mi dispiace molto per l'attesa, Yumia. La strada per la riserva si e' aperta, si'. Puoi andare al ponte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_230..ref: All right everyone, let's get back to it.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_230..src: Muy bien, ¡volvamos a ponernos manos a la obra!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..src: No cabe duda, aquí hay muchísima energía. ¿Para qué necesitaría tantísimo maná?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..ref: No doubt about it, this is all energy. What could he possibly have needed this much mana for?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..dst: Non c'e' alcun dubbio, qui c'e' tantissima energia. Per cosa avrebbe mai bisogno di cosi' tanto mana?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..src: Eso sí, no veo nada que parezca un laboratorio...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..ref: I don't see anything that looks like a lab, though ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..dst: Pero' non vedo niente che sembri un laboratorio...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..src: Sabiendo lo meticuloso que era Corleonis, seguro que el laboratorio está oculto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..ref: Knowing how meticulous Corleonis was, the lab itself might be hidden.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..dst: Conoscendo la meticolosita' di Corleonis, il laboratorio potrebbe essere nascosto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..src: Si hay algo aquí que tuviese que estar oculto, seguro que estaría debajo del agua.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..ref: If there's anywhere around here to hide something, it'd have to be underwater.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..dst: Se c'e' un posto qui intorno dove nascondere qualcosa, dev'essere sott'acqua.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..ref: Do you know anything about it, Kuku?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..src: Al laboratorio entrar no podemos, no. Su ubicación yo no sé, no.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..ref: Enter the lab, we cannot. Thus, its location, I do not know.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..dst: Entrare nel laboratorio, non possiamo, no. La sua posizione, non la conosco, no.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..ref: That's fine, we'll take anything we can get!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..dst: Va benissimo, ci va bene qualsiasi indizio!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..src: Primero, consumiendo el maná líquido para la investigación estaba el maestro Corleonis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..ref: First, said that he was "consuming" the liquefied mana for research, Master Corleonis did.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..dst: Per prima cosa, il maestro Corleonis ha detto che "consumava" mana liquefatto per le sue ricerche.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..src: Y el laboratorio cerca de la reserva está, seguro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..ref: And certain that the lab lies near the reservoir, I am.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..dst: E sono certo che il laboratorio si trovi vicino al serbatoio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..src: Así que, en esta zona, algún mecanismo que consuma maná líquido debe haber.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..ref: Thus, within this area, some mechanism that consumes liquefied mana, there should be.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..dst: Quindi, in questa zona deve esserci un qualche meccanismo che consuma mana liquefatto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..src: Sí, claramente no parece que este lugar se construyese para controlar inundaciones o suministrar agua.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..ref: Yes, it certainly doesn't seem like this place was built to manage floods or supply water.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..dst: Si', chiaramente non sembra che questo posto sia stato costruito per controllare le inondazioni o fornire acqua.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..src: Entonces, ¡solo hay que encontrar el mecanismo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..ref: Then all we've gotta do is find that mechanism!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..dst: Allora non ci resta che trovare quel meccanismo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..src: Vale, ¡hora de buscar! Prestad atención a todo lo que pueda ser el mecanismo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..ref: Okay. Time to search around! Keep an eye out for anything that might be it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_240..dst: Va bene. Mettiamoci a cercare! Fate attenzione a tutto cio' che potrebbe essere il meccanismo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_250..src: ¿Qué demonios? ¡Corleonis ha dejado un guardia y todo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_250..ref: What the hell? So Corleonis even left a gatekeeper behind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_250..dst: Che diavolo? Corleonis ha persino lasciato un guardiano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_250..src: Por lo que, seguramente, lo que custodia sea importante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_250..ref: Which also means whatever lies beyond is probably something important.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_250..dst: Quindi, cio' che si trova oltre dev'essere qualcosa di importante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_250..src: Vamos a acabar con él y descubramos qué es lo que protege.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_250..ref: Let's take it down and see what it's guarding.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_250..dst: Abbattiamolo e scopriamo cosa sta proteggendo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_251..src: Vaya, así es cómo se consumía la energía...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_251..ref: So this is how they were consuming the energy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_251..dst: Ah, ecco come veniva consumata l'energia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_251..src: Sí, no parece que se esté drenando. Pero, si se está consumiendo, ¿dónde se está utilizando?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_251..ref: Yeah, it doesn't seem like it's being drained. But if it's being consumed, where is it actually being used?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_251..dst: Gia', non sembra che venga prosciugata. Ma se viene consumata, dove viene usata?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_251..src: Para descubrirlo, seguramente tendremos que continuar avanzando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_251..ref: We'll probably find out as we go deeper.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_260..dst: C-c'e' qualcosa che non va in lui!

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_280..src: Quién sabe... Tal vez... este fuese mi destino...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_280..dst: Chissa'... Forse... questo era il mio destino...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_280..src: No es justo... No debería ser así...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_280..ref: This isn't fair ... It shouldn't be like this ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_280..dst: Non e' giusto... Non dovrebbe andare cosi'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_280..src: De esto son capaces Corleonis y todos los demás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_280..ref: This is the kind of thing that Corleonis and the others are capable of committing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_280..dst: E' questo che sono capaci di fare Corleonis e tutti gli altri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_280..src: Lo siento, no he podido evitarlo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_280..dst: Mi dispiace, non sono riuscito a impedirlo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_280..src: Pero... no seguiré más sus órdenes...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_280..dst: Ma... non seguiro' piu' i suoi ordini...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_280..ref: But I won't do as he desires ... Not anymore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_280..src: Quiero que pongas fin a esto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_280..dst: Voglio che tu ponga fine a tutto questo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_280..ref: I want you to finish this.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_280..src: Decidir mi final es todo un regalo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_280..ref: I was living on borrowed time ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_280..dst: Decidere la mia fine e' un vero dono...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_280..ref: Deciding how it ends is a rare mercy.
You've done what had to be done.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Ya estoy al tanto de lo ocurrido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: I've been briefed on what transpired.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: So gia' cos'e' successo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Lo siento, no pude evitarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: I'm sorry. There was nothing I could do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Mi dispiace, non sono riuscita a evitarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: No has hecho nada malo..., aunque no sea de consuelo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: You did nothing wrong ... though hearing that may not help much.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Non hai fatto nulla di male..., anche se so che non ti consola.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Debería haber sido más cauta. No vi venir el ataque y no supe cómo zafarme de las ataduras.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: I should've been more cautious. I didn't see the attack coming, and I didn't know how to get rid of the restraints.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Avrei dovuto essere piu' cauta. Non ho previsto l'attacco e non sono riuscita a liberarmi dai legacci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Todo ha sido culpa mía.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: It's all my fault.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: E' tutta colpa mia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: No todo puede salir a pedir de boca, y mucho menos contra alguien como Corleonis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: You can't expect everything to go your way. Especially not against someone like Corleonis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Non puo' andare sempre tutto per il meglio, soprattutto contro uno come Corleonis.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Según los registros, el objetivo de estas instalaciones era crear una pseudopersona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: The records left behind show that the goal of that facility was to generate a "pseudo-persona."
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Secondo i registri, lo scopo di queste strutture era creare una pseudopersona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Un alma artificial, nacida a partir de una gran cantidad de maná. Una vez completada...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: An artificial soul, born from an immense injection of mana. Once completed ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Un'anima artificiale, nata da una grande quantita' di mana. Una volta completata...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Esta pseudopersona sería capaz de generar maná sin límites. Parece que ese era su objetivo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: The pseudo-persona would be able to produce mana endlessly. That seems to have been his goal.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Questa pseudopersona sarebbe stata in grado di generare mana senza limiti. A quanto pare, era questo il suo obiettivo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Generar maná sin límites...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: Endless mana ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Generare mana senza limiti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Además, es muy probable que quisiera usar a Elnath como peón para su plan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: Further, it's highly likely they intended to use Elnath as a pawn to restart the plan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Inoltre, e' molto probabile che volesse usare Elnath come pedina per il suo piano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Porque, visto lo visto, esa pseudopersona pensaba igual que Corleonis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: Because from what it seems, that pseudo-persona shared Corleonis's way of thinking.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Perche', a giudicare da quello che e' successo, quella pseudopersona la pensava come Corleonis.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Conociéndolo, tampoco me extraña.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: Knowing him, I can believe it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Conoscendolo, non mi sorprende.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: En cierta forma, Elnath lo dio todo para poner fin al intento desesperado de Corleonis por recuperar el control.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: In a way, Elnath gave everything to put an end to Corleonis's desperate grasp for control.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: In un certo senso, Elnath ha dato tutto se' stesso per porre fine al disperato tentativo di Corleonis di riprendere il controllo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Lo sé. Él mismo dijo que no seguiría más sus órdenes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: I know. He said himself, "I won't do as he desires anymore."
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Lo so. Ha detto lui stesso che non avrebbe piu' seguito i suoi ordini.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Se negó a que tomase el control de su vida y decidió su propio camino. Ha sido una gran muestra de voluntad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: He refused to let his life be controlled and chose his own path. That was a true display of his resolve.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Ha rifiutato di lasciargli prendere il controllo della sua vita e ha scelto la propria strada. Ha dimostrato una grande forza di volonta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Lo que más me duele es que pensábamos que podría tener una vida..., un nuevo comienzo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: What stings the most is that we believed in a future with him. That something new could begin.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Quello che mi fa piu' male e' che pensavamo che potesse avere una vita..., un nuovo inizio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Pasamos juntos muy poco tiempo, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: Our time with him was so brief ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Siamo stati insieme per pochissimo tempo, ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Creo que jamás lo olvidaremos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: ... but I don't think we'll ever forget him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Credo che non lo dimenticheremo mai.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Sin él, es posible que los planes oscuros de Corleonis hayan quedado frustrados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: Without him, Corleonis's dark plans might have come to pass.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Senza di lui, e' possibile che i piani oscuri di Corleonis siano stati sventati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Ahora debemos cargar con todo por lo que luchaba y seguir adelante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: It's on us to shoulder everything he stood for, and keep going.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Ora dobbiamo farci carico di tutto cio' per cui ha lottato e andare avanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Esa es mi labor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: That is my duty.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: E' il mio compito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Te has vuelto más fuerte, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: You've grown stronger, Yumia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Sei diventata piu' forte, Yumia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Es todo fachada. De ser así, las cosas habrían acabado de otra forma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: It's all an act. If I had real strength, things wouldn't have ended up like this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: E' tutta apparenza. Se fosse davvero cosi', le cose sarebbero finite diversamente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: No te preocupes. Llegará el momento en el que esa fachada se convertirá en una fortaleza real.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: Don't worry. Eventually, that front you're putting up will turn into the real thing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Non preoccuparti. Verra' il momento in cui quell'apparenza diventera' una vera fortezza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Me voy con los demás. Tengo que ayudarles con la investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: ... Right.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Vado dagli altri. Devo aiutarli con le ricerche.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..src: Buena suerte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..ref: I'm going to join the others. I need to help with the investigation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_290..dst: Buona fortuna.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..src: ¿N-no habríamos podido ayudarle a liberarse de alguna forma?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..ref: W-wasn't there some way we could've helped free him?
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..dst: N-non avremmo potuto aiutarla a liberarsi in qualche modo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..src: De haber sido posible, ahora Lili Borea sería libre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..ref: If something like that were possible, Lili Borea would be free right now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..dst: Se fosse stato possibile, Lili Borea sarebbe libera adesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..src: Tenía el mismo control sobre Lili Borea. Seguramente prive a los mutantes de su libertad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..ref: Lili Borea was bound the same way. It's probably meant to rob mutants of their freedom.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..dst: Aveva lo stesso controllo su Lili Borea. Probabilmente priva i mutanti della loro liberta'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..src: Un equipo para silenciar a los rebeldes... Los métodos de Aladiss me enferman.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..ref: Equipment made to silence dissent ... Aladiss's methods make me sick.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..dst: Una squadra per mettere a tacere i ribelli... I metodi di Aladiss mi fanno star male.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..ref: I'm still sorting things out, and I have regrets, but standing still isn't an option.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..src: Estoy intentando asimilarlo, y me arrepiento de muchas cosas, pero no puedo quedarme de brazos cruzados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..dst: Sto cercando di farcela entrare in testa, e mi pento di tante cose, ma non posso restare a braccia conserte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..ref: I refuse to let this kind of injustice happen ever again.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..src: Me niego a dejar que este tipo de injusticias sigan ocurriendo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..ref: I won't accept a world that demands the lives of people like him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..dst: Rifiuto di lasciare che questo tipo di ingiustizie continuino a verificarsi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..src: No aceptaré un mundo que arrebata la vida a la gente como él.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..ref: I want this to be about more than just what we lost.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..dst: Non accettero' un mondo che strappa la vita alla gente, come ha fatto con lui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..src: No quiero que luchemos solo por lo que hemos perdido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..ref: So that one day, his name shines where all can see—honored as a hero of the Research Team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..dst: Non voglio che lottiamo solo per cio' che abbiamo perso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..src: Algún día, su nombre brillará con fuerza, como héroe del equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..ref: The truth must be brought to light, and it's the Research Team's duty to reveal it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..dst: Un giorno, il suo nome brillera' forte, come eroe della Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..src: Alguien tiene que sacar la verdad a la luz. ¡Esa es labor del equipo de investigación!
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..ref: So let's press on for his sake—together.
eventmessagedata/event_message_rm07_300..dst: Qualcuno deve portare la verita' alla luce. E' il compito della Squadra di Ricerca!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_010..src: Humm, estoy en una encrucijada. ¿Qué debería hacer?...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_010..ref: Hm, this is definitely an issue. What should I do ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_010..dst: Uhm, sono a un bivio. Cosa dovrei fare...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_010..src: Es que no sé cómo llevar estos suministros a algunos miembros del equipo que han ido lejos a investigar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_010..ref: Oh, I'm just not sure how I'm going to get these supplies to some team members who are investigating far away.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_010..dst: E' che non so come portare questi rifornimenti ad alcuni membri della squadra che sono andati lontano a indagare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_010..src: Estoy inundado de trabajo y no tengo un hueco libre para entregárselos, pero los necesitan sí o sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_010..ref: I'm swamped with work. I can't seem to find the time to deliver them myself, but they absolutely have to go out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_010..dst: Sono sommerso di lavoro e non trovo il tempo per consegnarli, ma ne hanno assolutamente bisogno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_010..src: Bueno... Si son tan importantes, podríamos encargarnos nosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_010..ref: Well ... If it's that important, then we could do it for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_010..dst: Beh... Se sono cosi' importanti, potremmo occuparcene noi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_010..src: ¿Lo dices en serio? ¡Gracias! ¡Menudo peso me quitas de encima! Están muy lejos y los caminos están llenos de peligros, ¡tened mucho cuidado!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_010..ref: Y-you really mean it?! Thanks, that would be such a big help! They really are far away, so take care while you're out on the road.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_010..dst: Lo dici sul serio? Grazie! Che peso mi togli dalle spalle! Sono molto lontani e le strade sono piene di pericoli, state molto attenti!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_020..src: ¡Ay, las estábamos esperando! ¿Cómo os ha ido el viaje? No se os habrá hecho demasiado largo, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_020..ref: Oh! We've been waiting for those! How was the trip? Way too far, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_020..dst: Oh, le aspettavamo! Com'e' andato il viaggio? Non sara' stato troppo lungo, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_020..src: En realidad, no ha sido para tanto. Bueno, pues eso era todo, así que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_020..ref: Honestly, it wasn't that bad. Well, that's all we came here for, so ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_020..dst: In realta', non e' stato cosi' male. Beh, era tutto, quindi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_020..src: Espera un momento. No os podéis marchar con las manos vacías. No después de haber reunido todo esto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_020..ref: Wait, hang on. I can't let you go without taking this back. We went through a lot of trouble to gather it, you know.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_020..dst: Aspetta un attimo. Non potete andarvene a mani vuote. Non dopo aver raccolto tutto questo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_020..ref: You mean there's more to this?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_020..src: Se supone que íbamos a hacer un trueque, ¿no te avisaron?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_020..ref: Yeah, this was supposed to be an exchange. Didn't anyone tell you that?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_020..dst: Dovevamo fare uno scambio, non te l'hanno detto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_020..src: No, pero no me importa llevar algo de vuelta, tenía que volver a informar de todos modos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_020..ref: No, but I'll have to go back and report this anyway, so dropping something extra off should be fine.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_020..dst: No, ma non mi dispiace riportare qualcosa, dovevo tornare a riferire comunque.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_020..src: Ya veo... Siento cargaros con esta tarea inesperada, estoy en deuda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_020..ref: Uh ... huh. Um, I'm sorry to spring this on you, but I'd really appreciate it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_020..dst: Capisco... Scusate per l'incarico inaspettato, vi sono in debito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_030..src: ¡Perdón, perdón! ¡Se me olvidó comentaros lo del intercambio de provisiones!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_030..ref: I-I'm so sorry! I completely forgot to mention the exchange!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_030..dst: Scusate, scusate! Mi ero dimenticato di parlarvi dello scambio di provviste!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_030..src: No pasa nada, teníamos que volver a informar de la entrega de todos modos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_030..ref: It's fine, we had to come back to report the delivery anyway.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_030..dst: Non fa niente, dovevamo tornare a riferire della consegna comunque.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_030..src: Ya y, aunque no lo hice con maldad, ha sido muy descortés. Llevaos esto como recompensa, espero que este detalle os sirva como disculpa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_030..ref: No, it was still rude, even if it wasn't intentional. Here, take this—it's your reward, plus a little extra as an apology.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_030..dst: Si' si', anche se non l'ho fatto apposta, e' stato molto scortese. Prendete questo come ricompensa, spero che questo pensiero vi serva come scusa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_030..src: ¡Vaya! Agradezco la sinceridad y nunca nos viene mal una ayuda extra. Si necesitas algo más, ¡avísanos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_030..ref: You sure are sincere, huh? But, I won't say no to a bonus. If you ever need help with anything else, just say the word!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_030..dst: Caspita! Apprezzo la sincerita' e un aiuto in piu' non ci fa mai male. Se hai bisogno di altro, avvisaci!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_040..src: Ayayay... Esto de las provisiones y los envíos se nos está yendo de las manos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_040..ref: Good grief, even just managing these supplies has gotten out of hand.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_040..dst: Ayayay... Questa storia di provviste e consegne ci sta sfuggendo di mano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_040..ref: Is there anything I can help you with?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_040..src: ¡Anda! ¡Eres tú! Pues necesito enviar otro paquete, tengo tanto lío ahora que...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_040..ref: Oh! It's you again! Well, I need to make another delivery, but there's too much to do here, so ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_040..dst: Oh! Sei tu! Ecco, devo spedire un altro pacco, ma adesso ho cosi' tanto da fare che...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_040..src: Pedir ayuda y confiar en los demás es de sabios. ¡Nosotros podemos encargarnos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_040..ref: You know there's no shame in relying on other people, right? We'll take care of that for you!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_040..dst: Chiedere aiuto e fidarsi degli altri e' da saggi. Possiamo occuparcene noi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_040..src: Gracias, me volvéis a salvar la vida. Están en otro lugar remoto, pero cuento con vosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_040..ref: Thank you, that's a huge weight off my shoulders. It's in another<CR>out-of-the-way location, but I'll be counting on you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_040..dst: Grazie, ci salvate di nuovo la vita. Sono in un altro posto remoto, ma conto su di voi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_050..src: Eh... Hemos venido a entregar unas provisiones, pero... ¿qué ha pasado aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_050..ref: Uh ... We've come to deliver some supplies, but ... What even happened here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_050..dst: Ehm... Siamo venuti a consegnare delle provviste, ma... che e' successo qui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_050..src: Ah, ya, es que acabo de llegar y me habéis pillado desempacando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_050..ref: Oh, that. I only just got here myself, so I'm still in the middle of unpacking everything.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_050..dst: Ah, si', e' che sono appena arrivato e mi avete colto mentre disimballavo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_050..src: O en eso estaba cuando nos atacaron unos monstruos y pusieron todo patas arriba. Increíble, ¿verdad? Menudo desastre.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_050..ref: Or, I was, until a bunch of monsters attacked and made a mess of it all. Yeesh, this is a real disaster, huh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_050..dst: O meglio, ci stavo facendo quando dei mostri ci hanno attaccato e messo tutto sottosopra. Incredibile, vero? Che disastro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_050..src: Bueeeno... Pues... Dejaremos esto aquí y...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_050..ref: W-well, um ... I'm just going to leave this here, so ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_050..dst: Be'eeeno... Allora... Lasceremo qui questo e...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_050..src: Huy, pero eso sería dejar otro trasto más en medio. Ya está todo muy desordenado como para añadirle otro paquete.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_050..ref: C'mon, it's just going to get in the way. Things are bad enough already without that extra stuff.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_050..dst: Uffi, ma cosi' mettereste ancora un altro ingombro in mezzo. E' gia' tutto abbastanza disordinato senza aggiungere un altro pacco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_050..src: Dejadme un momento que me organice, ¿vale? Y luego os quito esas provisiones de las manos. A ver... ¿Por dónde empiezo...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_050..ref: Give me a bit to get more of this sorted, okay? Then I'll take those supplies from you. ... But, where do I start ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_050..dst: Datemi un attimo per mettere un po' d'ordine, va bene? Poi vi tolgo quelle provviste dalle mani. Vediamo... Da dove comincio...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_050..src: (Si esperamos a que termine, nos quedaremos aquí para siempre. Quizá podríamos tirar estos trastos...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_050..ref: ( ... If we wait for him to finish, then we'll never leave. Maybe we could at least get rid of some of this trash?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_050..dst: (Se aspettiamo che finisca, non andremo mai via. Forse potremmo almeno buttar via questa spazzatura...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_060..src: No puedo agradeceros lo suficiente vuestra ayudita. Ahora ya puedo aceptar esa entrega.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_060..ref: Guys, I can't thank you enough for lending a hand. I'll take those supplies off you now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_060..dst: Non posso ringraziarvi abbastanza per il vostro aiuto. Ora posso accettare quella consegna.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_060..src: No dejes que se pierdan entre tanto lío, ¿vale? No ha sido fácil llegar hasta aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_060..ref: Please don't let them get lost in the shuffle, okay? We went out of our way for this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_060..dst: Non lasciare che si perdano in tutto quel caos, va bene? Non e' stato facile arrivare fin qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_060..src: Ya, ya, lo entiendo. Gracias de nuevo y tened cuidado en el viaje de vuelta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_060..ref: All right, I get it. Thanks again, and have a safe trip back.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_060..dst: Si', si', ho capito. Grazie di nuovo e fate attenzione al viaggio di ritorno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_060..src: (Uf... Vaya día. Bueno, ya podemos volver a informar).
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_060..ref: (Yeesh, that was something else. ... Well, time to go report this.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_060..dst: (Uff... Che giornata. Beh, ora possiamo andare a riferire).

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_070..ref: Welcome back! I take it the delivery went well?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_070..dst: Ciao di nuovo! E' andato tutto bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_070..src: Más o menos. Nos han interceptado para hacer limpieza general.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_070..ref: More or less. We got roped into some tidying up, so ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_070..dst: Piu' o meno. Ci hanno trascinati in una pulizia generale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_070..src: En realidad, no era tanto limpiar como ordenar un desastre... No importa, no ha sido nada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_070..ref: Actually, it was more like trying to undo a disaster ... Never mind, don't let it bother you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_070..dst: In realta', piu' che pulire era rimediare a un disastro... Non importa, non e' stato niente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_070..src: Eh... vale, si tú lo dices... Aunque me ha sonado a contratiempo inesperado. De todas formas, os estoy muy agradecido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_070..ref: Er ... If you say so. It sounds like a lot happened, but I really do appreciate your help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_070..dst: Ehm... va bene, se lo dici tu... Anche se mi e' sembrato un contrattempo inaspettato. In ogni caso, vi sono molto grato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..src: ¡Oye, tú! ¡Sí, tú! ¿Eso que llevas es una reliquia?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..ref: Hey, you! ... Yes, you there! Would that happen to be a relic in your possession?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..dst: Ehi, tu! Si', proprio tu! Quella cosa che porti e' una reliquia?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..src: Ah, ya me parecía a mí. Un objeto así no se ve todos los días.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..ref: Oooh, I thought it might be. That isn't the kind of object someone stumbles onto every day.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..dst: Ah, me lo figuravo. Un oggetto cosi' non si vede tutti i giorni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..src: Verás, es que colecciono esos cachivaches, tanto me apasionan que me uní al equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..ref: I happen to love collecting that sort of thing. So much so that I joined the Research Team.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..dst: Sai, colleziono proprio quel genere di cianfrusaglie, mi appassionano cosi' tanto che mi sono unito alla Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..src: Lo encontraste en algún lugar de este continente, ¿verdad? ¿Conoces alguna región que sea rica en reliquias?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..ref: You found that somewhere on this continent, right? Would you happen to know of any regions rich in relics?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..dst: L'hai trovato da qualche parte in questo continente, vero? Conosci qualche regione ricca di reliquie?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..src: No sé si hallarás algo que te deje sin aliento, pero se me ocurren un par de sitios con restos interesantes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..ref: I don't know if you'll find anything impressive, but I can think of a few places where you'd probably find some.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..dst: Non so se troverai qualcosa di impressionante, ma mi vengono in mente un paio di posti dove probabilmente ne troveresti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..src: Entiendo, entiendo. ¿Te importaría traerme algo que te llame la atención cuando salgas de aventuras?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..ref: I see, I see. Could I possibly trouble you to pick me up anything that catches your eye while you're out and about?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..dst: Capisco, capisco. Ti dispiacerebbe portarmi qualcosa che attiri la tua attenzione quando esci per le tue avventure?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..src: Te compensaría por tus esfuerzos, claro. ¿Qué me dices?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..ref: You'd be appropriately compensated for your findings, of course. What do you say?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..dst: Ti compenserei per quello che trovi, naturalmente. Che ne dici?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..src: Humm... Vale, ¿por qué no? No me supone ningún problema y no nos vendría nada mal un dinerito extra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..ref: Hmm ... Sure, why not? That's not too much trouble, and we could use some extra spending money.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..dst: Hmm... Va bene, perche' no? Non e' troppa fatica, e un po' di soldi extra non ci farebbero affatto male.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..src: ¡Estupendo! Me alegro de haber llegado a un acuerdo. ¿Y si empezamos con unas... tres reliquias?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..ref: Great! I'm glad we could come to an agreement. Why don't you start by bringing me three relics?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..dst: Fantastico! Sono contento che siamo riusciti a metterci d'accordo. Perche' non inizi con... tre reliquie?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..src: ¿Solo tres? ¡Está hecho! Te las traeré antes de que digas "coleccionar".
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..ref: That's it? No problem! I'll have those for you in no time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_080..dst: Solo tre? Fatto! Te le portero' in men che non si dica.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_090..src: ¡Vaya, son perfectas! ¡He soñado con que me traías reliquias maravillosas como estas!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_090..ref: Well now, these are just perfect! I was hoping for wonderful relics like these!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_090..dst: Oh, ma sono perfette! Speravo proprio in reliquie meravigliose come queste!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_090..src: ¿En serio...? ¿Son para tanto? Yo no les veo nada de especial, pero si tú lo dices...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_090..ref: You ... were? They're that great? I didn't think these were anything special, but if you say so.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_090..dst: Davvero...? Sono cosi' belle? Non le trovavo per niente speciali, ma se lo dici tu...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_090..src: Cada una de ellas cuentan un pedacito de historia. ¿Cómo quieres que no me sienta insignificante frente a ellas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_090..ref: Each and every one is a precious piece of history. How could I possibly treat them with any less reverence?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_090..dst: Ognuna di loro racconta un piccolo pezzo di storia. Come potrei mai trattarle con meno riverenza?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_090..src: Tu recompensa, como te prometí. Si encuentras más como estas, ya sabes a quién acudir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_090..ref: Your reward, as promised. If you find any others, you know who to come to.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_090..dst: La tua ricompensa, come promesso. Se ne trovi altre, sai gia' a chi rivolgerti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_100..ref: What to do, what to do ...?
What seems to be the problem?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_100..src: Pues a que estoy a cargo de estos campos y estos últimos días nos están asaltando unos castores con muy mala baba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_100..ref: Well, I'm the one managing these fields, and these past few days we've been bothered by beavers.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_100..dst: Ebbene, sono io a occuparmi di questi campi, e negli ultimi giorni ci tormentano dei castori proprio dispettosi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_100..src: No han dejado ni un cultivo al que hincarle el diente. Como sigan a este ritmo, nos dejarán sin alimentos para el equipo de investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_100..ref: They've gone and spoiled a good portion of the crops. There's not going to be much food to go around to the research folks if they ruin any more.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_100..dst: Hanno rovinato un bel po' di raccolti. Se continuano cosi', non rimarra' molto cibo per la Squadra di Ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_100..src: Ya veo, no tiene buena pinta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_100..ref: Yeah, that's no fun at all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_100..dst: Capisco, non e' per niente una bella cosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_100..src: Y que lo digas. Me da la sensación de que cada vez son más... ¡Y de que a cada día que pasa están más rollizos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_100..ref: You can say that again. I get the feeling there's more of them each time—and that they're only getting rounder.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_100..dst: E' vero! Ho l'impressione che ogni volta siano di piu'... E che di giorno in giorno diventino sempre piu' paffuti!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_100..src: Humm... No miraremos para otro lado. Les dejaremos bien clarito que esas fechorías no son bien recibidas por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_100..ref: Hmm ... We really shouldn't let this one go. We'll go let them know that their mischief isn't welcome here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_100..dst: Hmm... Non possiamo lasciar correre. Andremo a fargli capire chiaramente che le loro birbonate non sono le benvenute qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_110..src: ¡Ya nos hemos ocupado de todos los castores!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_110..ref: The beavers have all been dealt with!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_110..dst: Ci siamo occupati di tutti i castori!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_110..src: ¡Gracias! Ojalá les den un poco de respiro a estos campos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_110..ref: Thank you! Maybe that'll make them give these fields a wide berth.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_110..dst: Grazie! Speriamo che ora diano un po' di tregua a questi campi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_110..src: Eso espero... Eran muchos, la verdad, más de los que me esperaba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_110..ref: I hope so ... There really were a lot of them. More than I was expecting, for sure.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_110..dst: Lo spero... Erano davvero tanti, piu' di quanto mi aspettassi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_110..src: Pues os estoy más que agradecido. Llevaos esto por los problemas ocasionados, ¿vale?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_110..ref: Well, I appreciate the help. Take this for your trouble, okay?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_110..dst: Beh, vi sono piu' che grato. Prendete questo per il disturbo, va bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_120..src: Ah, sois vosotros otra vez. Lo siento, habéis llegado en un mal momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_120..ref: Oh, it's you again. Sorry, you've come at a troubling time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_120..dst: Ah, siete di nuovo voi. Mi dispiace, siete arrivati in un brutto momento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_120..src: ¿Os acordáis de esos castores a los que disteis una lección? Pues su jefe vino a hacernos una visita poco después...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_120..ref: You remember those beavers you smacked around? Well, their boss came to call not long after.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_120..dst: Vi ricordate quei castori a cui avete dato una lezione? Ebbene, poco dopo il loro capo ci ha reso visita...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_120..src: Estaba preparándome para levantar una valla y mantenerlos alejados de mis cultivos, pero el grandote se presentó aquí antes de que clavara el primer tablón... Qué mala suerte tengo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_120..ref: I'd been thinking about putting up a fence to keep the little guys out, but then the big one showed up before I could. Ugh, just my luck ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_120..dst: Stavo pensando di costruire una recinzione per tenerli lontani dai miei raccolti, ma quello grande si e' fatto vivo prima che piantassi il primo palo... Che sfortuna la mia...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_120..src: (Una valla es una buena idea, la verdad).
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_120..ref: ( ... A fence does sound like it would've been a sensible solution, actually.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_120..dst: (Una recinzione sarebbe stata una soluzione sensata, a dire il vero.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_120..src: Vale, pues vamos a encargarnos del jefe y luego pensamos en esa valla.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_120..ref: All right, we'll go take care of the leader, then fence off the field right after.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_120..dst: Va bene, allora ci occupiamo del capo e poi pensiamo a quella recinzione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_120..src: Eso sería lo mejor. Siento cargaros con esta responsabilidad y estoy muy agradecido por toda vuestra ayuda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_120..ref: That'd be for the best. I'm sorry to put this all on your shoulders, but thank you for your continued help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_120..dst: Sarebbe la cosa migliore. Mi dispiace caricarvi con questa responsabilita', ma vi ringrazio per tutto il vostro aiuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_130..src: ¡Nos hemos deshecho de ese jefe castor y ya tenemos el espacio cercado!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_130..ref: We took out the boss beaver and built a fence!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_130..dst: Abbiamo eliminato quel capo castoro e ora il campo e' recintato!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_130..src: Gracias. Ahora puedo volver a dedicarme a mi granja.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_130..ref: Thank you. Now I can focus my attention back on farming.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_130..dst: Grazie. Ora posso tornare a occuparmi della mia fattoria.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_130..src: No es una recompensa muy grande después de todo lo que habéis sufrido, pero podéis coger lo que os pueda servir de aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_130..ref: It's not really much of a reward for what you've done, but feel free to help yourselves to anything here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_130..dst: Non e' una grande ricompensa dopo tutto quello che avete fatto, ma prendete pure tutto cio' che vi puo' servire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_130..src: Por raro que os suene, este clima va muy bien para los cultivos. ¡Vamos, no os cortéis! Servíos vosotros mismos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_130..ref: Oddly enough, this climate is incredibly well-suited to growing crops. Go on! Don't be shy, grab whatever you'd like.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_130..dst: Per strano che possa sembrare, questo clima e' perfetto per i raccolti. Dai, non fatevi pregare! Servitevi pure.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..dst: Noooooo! La mia Mallon, la mia piccolina!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..src: (Lo mejor será fingir que no he escuchado nada. No tiene sentido meternos en un problema).
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..ref: ( ... Nope. I'm just going to pretend I didn't see that. It sounds way too much like trouble.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..dst: (Meglio fingere di non aver sentito niente. Sembra troppo un guaio in cui ficcarcisi.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..src: ¡Holi! ¡Hola! ¡Holita! ¿Habéis visto a mi Mallon corretear por aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..ref: Hey! You there! Do you know where my little Mallon ran off to?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..dst: Ehi! Voi li'! Avete visto la mia piccola Mallon scorrazzare da queste parti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..src: Es una perrita muy mona, mi Mallon. La encontré cuando salí a investigar la zona y me derretí de lo adorable que era. Desde entonces, no nos hemos separado ni un segundo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..ref: A dog. Mallon's a dog. I found her while I was out investigating and she was so adorable. We've been together ever since.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..dst: E' una cagnolina molto carina, la mia Mallon. L'ho trovata mentre indagavo in zona e mi sono sciolto per la sua dolcezza. Da allora non ci siamo piu' separati nemmeno un secondo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..src: A veces le gusta salir a pasear sola, porque es muy independiente mi chiquitina, pero siempre vuelve, por eso, no le di mayor importancia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..ref: She likes to go off on walks on her own, but she always comes back, so I wasn't too concerned.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..dst: A volte le piace uscire a passeggiare da sola, perche' la mia piccolina e' molto indipendente, ma ritorna sempre, cosi' non ci ho fatto troppo caso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..src: Pero es que hoy ¡no ha vuelto! ¿Y si le ha atacado un monstruo? Ay, no sé qué voy a hacer, ¡sin ella no sé qué va a ser de mí!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..ref: Except that today, she hasn't! What if she got attacked by a monster?! I can't stop crying, I'm so worried about her!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..dst: Ma oggi non e' tornata! E se l'ha attaccato un mostro? Oh, non so cosa fare, cosa sara' di me senza di lei!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..src: Esto... ¿Tiene Mallon algún lugar favorito? Podríamos ir a echar un vistazo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..ref: ... Um, does Mallon have any favorite places? We can go take a look.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..dst: Ehm... Mallon ha qualche posto preferito? Potremmo andare a dare un'occhiata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..src: Humm... pues... le ha dado por ir al bosque, ¿se habrá perdido mi Malloncinita?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..ref: Hm ... She's really taken a liking to the forest lately. Maybe she got lost in it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..dst: Hmm... beh... le e' venuta la mania di andare nel bosco, si sara' persa la mia Malloncina?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..src: Empecemos por ahí. No te preocupes, espéranos. Encontraremos a tu perrita.
