eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..ref: Well, having somewhere to start helps. Don't worry, we'll find your dog, so please wait.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_140..dst: Cominciamo da li'. Non preoccuparti, aspettaci. Troveremo la tua cagnolina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_150..src: Esta debe de ser la perrita que estamos buscando. Vamos a dejarle olisquear algo de su dueña y...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_150..ref: This must be the dog we've been looking for. We'll let her get a good whiff of her owner's scent, and ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_150..dst: Questa dev'essere la cagnolina che stiamo cercando. Facciamole annusare qualcosa della sua padrona e...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_150..ref: There! Do you remember the way back now?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_150..dst: Ecco! Ti ricordi la strada del ritorno?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_150..src: Está volviendo a la base. Supongo que sí que andaba perdida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_150..ref: She's heading back towards the research base. I guess she really was just lost.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_150..dst: Sta tornando alla base. A quanto pare si era davvero persa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_150..src: Deberíamos ir a ver a su dueña.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_150..ref: We should go meet up with that woman, too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_150..dst: Dovremmo andare a trovare la sua padrona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_160..ref: Mallon, you came baaack! Thank you so, sooo much!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_160..dst: Mallon! Sei tornaaaaata! Grazie, grazie, grazie mille!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_160..src: Je, je, je. Me alegro de que todo haya salido bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_160..ref: Ahaha ... I'm glad it all worked out.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_160..dst: Eheh. Mi fa piacere che sia andato tutto bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_160..src: ¡Oh, mirad! Tenemos un nuevo miembro de la familia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_160..ref: Oh, and look! We have a brand-new member of the family!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_160..dst: Oh, guardate! Abbiamo un nuovo membro della famiglia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_160..src: (Algo me dice que estas no van a ser sus únicas mascotas...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_160..ref: ( ... I get the feeling that these won't be the last of her pets ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_160..dst: (Qualcosa mi dice che queste non saranno le sue uniche mascotte...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..dst: Nooooooo! La mia Lulu, la mia Lululinaaaaa!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..ref: Huh? What's the matter this time?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..src: ¡Mi Lulu se ha escapado! ¡Y Momo y Roro también!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..ref: My darling cat Lulu ran off! So did my precious Momo and Roro!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..dst: La mia Lulu e' scappata! E anche Momo e Roro!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..src: Espera, espera, ¿has perdido a TRES animales?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..ref: Wait, hold up. You lost THREE animals this time?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..dst: Aspetta, aspetta. Hai perso TRE animali stavolta?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..src: ¿Verdad que es el peor día de mi vida? Y estoy desconsolada, solo de imaginarlos ahí tan solitos y perdidos... ¡Ay, ay, ay, no puedo dejar de llorar!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..ref: Isn't it awful?! I'm so worried about them, all scared and alone out there. I can't stop bawling my eyes out!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..dst: E' il giorno peggiore della mia vita, vero? E sono disperata, solo a immaginarli li' cosi' soli e smarriti... Ahi, ahi, ahi, non riesco a smettere di piangere!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..src: Vale, vale, mantén la calma. Iremos a buscarlos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..ref: Okay, I get it ... We'll go track them down for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..dst: Va bene, va bene, mantieni la calma. Andremo a cercarli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..src: ¡Muchísimas graciaaaas! Esto... debería avisarte de que mis gatitos están un pelín malcriados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..ref: Thank you sooo much! But, my cats are just a tiiiny bit spoiled.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..dst: Grazie miieee! Ehm... devo avvisarti che i miei gattini sono un po' viziati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..src: No hacen caso a nadie ni a nada, a no ser que lleves Escamohoso en los bolsillos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..ref: They won't listen to a word anyone says, unless you have some Mossclad for them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..dst: Non danno ascolto a nessuno e a niente, a meno che tu non abbia dello Scamosciato in tasca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..src: Os daría de mi pesca, pero se me ha acabado todo. Encontraréis un montón si pescáis por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..ref: I'd give you some, but I'm all out, sorry. You should find plenty if you go fishing, though!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..dst: Ve ne darei della mia pesca, ma l'ho finita tutta. Ne troverete un sacco se pescate da queste parti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..src: ¿Si pescamos? Vale, eso será lo primero y después a buscar a los gatetes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..ref: Fishing, huh? Right. First that, then cat-fetching.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_170..dst: Pescare, eh? Va bene, prima quello e poi via a cercare i micioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_180..ref: I'll just toss this to the cat, and ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_190..ref: I'll just toss this to the cat, and ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_200..ref: I'll just toss this to the cat, and ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_210..src: ¡Todos mis mininos han vueeelto! ¡Millones de gracias! Qué digo millones, ¡mil millones!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_210..ref: My kitties all came back! Thanks a million for finding them!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_210..dst: Tutti i miei micini sono tornaaaaati! Grazie milioni! Anzi, che dico, un milione di milioni!
Non e' stato niente di speciale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_210..ref: What made them run away though?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_210..dst: Cosa li ha fatti scappare via impauriti?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_210..src: Es que no podía soportar verlos hacinados en una caseta ¡y me niego en rotundo a meterlos en una jaula!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_210..ref: Well, I just couldn't bear to see them all cooped up in a cage or a pen, so I refused to stuff them in one.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_210..dst: E' che non sopportavo vederli stipati in una cuccia, e mi rifiuto categoricamente di chiuderli in una gabbia!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_210..src: Siempre regresaban de sus excursioncillas como buenos aventureros que son.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_210..ref: They'd always come back from their short excursions like the good little adventurers they are.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_210..dst: Tornavano sempre dalle loro scampagnatine, da bravi avventurieri che sono.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_210..src: Pero... de vez en cuando, volvían ya tarde. Y esta vez, ¡no aparecían por ningún lado!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_210..ref: But, um ... Lately they've been coming back late. Then this time, not at all!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_210..dst: Ma... ogni tanto tornavano in ritardo. E stavolta, non si vedevano da nessuna parte!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_210..src: (Volvían cuando las zonas de exploración estaban fuera de su alcance por la contaminación de maná, pero ahora que tienen el camino abierto...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_210..ref: (So, they came back pretty regularly when mana pollution was restricting the areas they could explore. But, with more places to go now ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_210..dst: (Tornavano quando l'inquinamento di mana limitava le zone che potevano esplorare, ma ora che hanno la strada aperta...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..ref: Tiaraaa! Tiara, my treasure, where are yoooooou?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..dst: Tiaaaara! Tiara, tesoro mio, dove seiii?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..src: No me lo digas... ¿Has perdido una oveja? ¿O esta vez es un conejo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..ref: ... Wait, don't tell me. A sheep or a rabbit got away from you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..dst: Non mi dire... Ti e' scappata una pecora? O stavolta e' un coniglio?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..src: ¡No, qué va! Tiara es una cuerva preciosa de la que estoy cuidando.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..ref: No, no! Tiara is an absolutely gorgeous crow I've been keeping!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..dst: No, ma dai! Tiara e' una splendida cornacchia di cui mi sto prendendo cura.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..src: No se suele alejar cuando sale a estirar las alas y siempre acude a mi llamada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..ref: She never flies too far off, and she always comes back when I call!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..dst: Di solito non si allontana quando esce a stendere le ali e accorre sempre al mio richiamo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..src: Pero a mi chiquitina le encantan las cosas brillantes, tal vez haya visto algo de su agrado y se haya despistado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..ref: But, she does love sparkly things. Maybe she went further away to go find some?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..dst: Ma alla mia piccina piacciono tantissimo le cose luccicanti, forse ha visto qualcosa che le piaceva e si e' distratta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..src: ¿Un cuervo de mascota? ¿Y qué será lo próximo? Bueno, un animal volador no debe de ser fácil de encontrar. De hecho, yo diría que es casi imposible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..ref: Crows as pets, huh? What next? ... Anyway, finding something that can fly isn't going to be easy. Like, at all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..dst: Una cornacchia come animale domestico? E cosa verra' dopo? Vabbe', un animale volante non sara' facile da trovare. Anzi, direi quasi impossibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..src: ¡No digas eso! ¡Hasta ahora has logrado encontrar a mis animalitos descarriados!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..ref: Please don't say that! You've found all my other babies so far!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..dst: Non dire cosi'! Finora sei riuscita a trovare tutti i miei animaletti smarriti!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..src: Solo te lo puedo pedir a ti, ¿por fa? ¿Por fa, porfita?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..ref: You're the only one I can ask! Please? Pretty pleeease?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..dst: Posso chiederlo solo a te, per favore? Per favore, per favina?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..src: Buff... Va-vale, aceptamos. Cómo vamos a negarnos ante una emergencia como esta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..ref: Ngh ... F-fine, we'll do it. It's hard to turn down someone in a crisis, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..dst: Uff... V-va bene, accettiamo. Come potremmo rifiutarci davanti a un'emergenza del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..src: Empezaremos echando un vistazo por la zona, supongo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..ref: We'll start by taking a look around the area, I guess.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_220..dst: Inizieremo dando un'occhiata in zona, suppongo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_230..src: ¿Eh? ¿Eso es un gorjeo de canario...? ¿Qué estará haciendo aquí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_230..ref: Huh? Isn't this ... a Canary's Warble? What's it doing here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_230..dst: Eh? Quello e'... un gorgheggio di canarino? Cosa ci fa qui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_230..src: Ah, claro, la chica nos dijo que a Tiara le gustan las cosas brillantes, quizá lo haya traído ella aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_230..ref: Wait, she did say that Tiara likes shiny things, so ... maybe the crow brought it here?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_230..dst: Ah, giusto, la ragazza ci ha detto che a Tiara piacciono le cose luccicanti, forse e' stata lei a portarlo qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_230..src: En ese caso, puede que encontremos más pistas si vamos a donde se recolectan los gorjeos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_230..ref: In that case, we might find more clues if we go to where this can be gathered.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_230..dst: In tal caso, potremmo trovare altri indizi se andiamo dove si raccoglie il gorgheggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_230..src: Un gorjeo de canario... yo diría que a las llanuras, ¿no? ¡En marcha!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_230..ref: Hm, Canary's Warble would be ... out on the plains, probably. Let's go take a look!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_230..dst: Un gorgheggio di canarino... direi che si trova sulle pianure, no? Si parte!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_240..src: ¿Hum? Esto es... ¿una piedra ígnea? Qué extraño, no son típicas de aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_240..ref: Hm? This looks like ... an Igneo Stone? Which definitely isn't from this area.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_240..dst: Hmm? Questo e'... una pietra ignea? Che strano, non e' tipica di questa zona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_240..src: Lo que quiere decir que Tiara ha hecho de las suyas. Esta mena es muy brillante también.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_240..ref: Which probably means that Tiara strikes again. Ore is nice and sparkly, after all.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_240..dst: Il che significa che Tiara ha fatto di nuovo i suoi scherzi. Anche questo minerale e' molto luccicante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_240..src: Si no recuerdo mal, se recogen cerca del lago subterráneo. No pasará nada por ir a comprobarlo...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_240..ref: I'm pretty sure you can find this near the underground lake. Well, it wouldn't hurt to go take a look ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_240..dst: Se non ricordo male, si raccolgono vicino al lago sotterraneo. Non guasta andare a controllare...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_250..src: Humm... Tiara tampoco está aquí. Sí que le gusta darse paseos largos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_250..ref: Hm ... Tiara's not here either. She sure does seem to be flying all over the place.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_250..dst: Humm... Tiara nemmeno e' qui. Le piace proprio girare in lungo e in largo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_250..src: Anda, esta vez se trata de una rama alterada. Proceden del Matorral Rhizoma.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_250..ref: There's a Forest Feeling here this time, though. Um, that's ... from around the Rhizoma Thicket.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_250..dst: Oh, questa volta si tratta di un ramo alterato. Provengono dal Boschetto Rhizoma.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_250..src: Si no la atrapo allí, me rindo. Es demasiado esfuerzo por un cuervo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_250..ref: If I don't catch her there, that's it. I'm giving up. This is way too much effort for one crow.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_250..dst: Se non la catturo li', mi arrendo. E' troppa fatica per un corvo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_250..ref: ... I really hope that's where she ends up being.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_260..src: ¡Esa podría ser Tiara! Primero debemos ocuparnos de esos monstruos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_260..ref: Oh, that's probably Tiara. I've got to do something about those monsters first, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_260..dst: Quella potrebbe essere Tiara! Ma prima dobbiamo occuparci di quei mostri.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_270..src: No estás herida, ¿a que no? De verdad que... en menuda búsqueda nos has metido, chica.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_270..ref: You're not hurt, are you? ... Seriously though, you sent us on one heck of a wild crow chase.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_270..dst: Non sei ferita, vero? Davvero pero'... che inseguimento del corvo ci hai fatto fare, ragazza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_270..src: Me alegro de que estés de una pieza. Vamos, vuelve con tu dueña.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_270..ref: Well, it's good that you're safe. Go on, hurry up and head back to your owner.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_270..dst: Mi fa piacere che tu sia illesa. Dai, torna subito dalla tua padrona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_270..src: Vamos a contarle las buenas noticias a la mayor amante de los animales de la zona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_270..ref: Okay, let's go give that animal lover the good news.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_270..dst: Andiamo a dare la buona notizia alla piu' grande amante degli animali della zona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_280..src: ¡Tiara regresó hace unos instantes! ¿Adónde te habías escapado, pillina?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_280..ref: Tiara got back just a few moments ago! Just where did you fly off to, you silly thing?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_280..dst: Tiara e' tornata pochi istanti fa! Dove ti eri cacciata, birichina?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_280..src: Se retrasó por culpa de unos monstruos que estaban acechando por el bosque.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_280..ref: She got held up by some monsters in the forest, which is why she was taking so long.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_280..dst: Si e' trattenuta per colpa di alcuni mostri che appostavano nel bosco.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_280..src: ¡Mo-monstruos! ¡Ay, mi cuervita! ¡Menos mal que has vuelto sana y salva!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_280..ref: M-monsters?! Aw, you poor thing! I'm so glad you made it back safe and sound!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_280..dst: Mo-mostri! Oh, la mia cornacchia! Meno male che sei tornata sana e salva!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_280..src: Hoy te prepararé tu cena favorita, ¡y podrás repetir y tripitir!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_280..ref: I'll make all your favorites for dinner tonight, so you can eat as much as you'd like!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_280..dst: Stasera ti preparero' la tua cena preferita, e potrai fare il bis e il tris!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_280..src: ¡Oh! Pero lo primero es dar las gracias a nuestros amigos. Os debo la vida por encontrar a mi princesita.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_280..ref: Oh! But, I have to thank these nice folks first. I owe you so much for finding my dearest princess!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_280..dst: Oh! Ma prima devo ringraziare i nostri amici. Vi devo tantissimo per aver trovato la mia principessina.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_280..src: Señorita... Debería adiestrar a sus mascotas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_280..ref: ... Miss, you really ought to train your pets better.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_280..dst: Signorina... Dovrebbe addestrare meglio i suoi animali...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..ref: Shoot, they're going to be here soon ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..dst: Accipicchia... Arriveranno da un momento all'altro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..src: Bueno, con tantas las labores de investigación, solicitamos personal de apoyo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..ref: Well, we've got our hands full with investigation-related duties here, so we made a request for additional personnel.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..dst: Beh, con tutte queste mansioni di ricerca, abbiamo richiesto personale di supporto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..src: Aceptaron y, por lo visto, nos van a enviar a unos cuantos novatos. ¡Y no me quejo, de verdad que no! Pero no estamos preparados para su llegada.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..ref: They're sending us nothing but fresh recruits—which is fine, but we're not quite ready for their arrival.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..dst: Hanno accettato e, a quanto pare, ci manderanno parecchi novizi. E non mi lamento, davvero! Ma non siamo pronti per il loro arrivo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..src: Para empezar, no tenemos camas suficientes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..ref: We don't have enough beds for them to use, for one.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..dst: Per cominciare, non abbiamo abbastanza letti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..src: Hummm... ¿Si consiguiera las que faltan, ya estaría todo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..ref: Hmm ... So, if you could get some, you'd be set for now?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..dst: Hmm... Quindi, se riuscissi a procurartene, per ora saresti a posto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..src: Pues... sí o, bueno, no, pero nos solucionaría un poco la papeleta. ¿Conoces a alguien que nos pueda proveer de camas o literas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..ref: W-well, it would solve a few problems. Do you know someone who could supply us with any?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..dst: Beh... si', o meglio, no, ma ci risolverebbe in parte il problema. Conosci qualcuno che possa fornirci letti o brande?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..src: La verdad es que no. Pero se me ha ocurrido que podría hacerlas yo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..ref: Not exactly. I was just thinking that I could probably make them myself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..dst: A dire il vero no. Ma mi e' venuto in mente che potrei costruirle io.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..src: ¡No me digas! Eso sería increíble, ¡mejor que increíble! Sería magnífico.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..ref: You don't say! If you could, that would be nothing short of incredible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..dst: Non mi dire! Sarebbe incredibile, piu' che incredibile! Sarebbe magnifico.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..src: Con cuatro camas más nos conformamos, ¡por favor y gracias!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..ref: Four extra beds would do the trick, please and thank you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_290..dst: Con quattro letti in piu' ci accontentiamo, per favore e grazie!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_300..src: ¡Muchísimas gracias! Así los recién llegados no tendrán que dormir en el suelo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_300..ref: Thank you very much! Now none of the newcomers will have to sleep on the floor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_300..dst: Grazie mille! Cosi' i nuovi arrivati non dovranno dormire per terra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_300..src: Menudo alivio, pero ¿para qué os hace falta la nueva mano de obra?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_300..ref: I'm sure they'll be grateful for that. But what has you so short-staffed?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_300..dst: Sicuramente ve ne saranno grati. Ma perche' vi manca cosi' tanto personale?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_300..src: Bueno, este sitio no es el mejor para vivir. Entre la amenaza de los monstruos y los demás peligros, muchos dimiten o piden el traslado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_300..ref: Well, this isn't the easiest environment to live in. Plus, there's always the threat of monsters and other dangers. Turnover's quite high.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_300..dst: Beh, questo posto non e' dei migliori per vivere. Tra la minaccia dei mostri e gli altri pericoli, molti si dimettono o chiedono il trasferimento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_300..src: Siempre tenemos puestos vacantes... Pero eso también implica que los reclutas más jóvenes están aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_300..ref: So, we usually have some positions that need filling. ... We also tend to have more young recruits than not.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_300..dst: Di solito abbiamo sempre posti vacanti... Ma questo implica anche che qui ci siano tanti reclute giovani.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_300..src: Por lo menos ahora solo nos queda esperar a que lleguen. ¡Gracias otra vez!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_300..ref: At least we're ready to welcome them now. Thanks again!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_300..dst: Almeno ora non ci resta che aspettare il loro arrivo. Grazie di nuovo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..src: ¡Hola de nuevo! Los novatos se están adaptando mejor que nunca y todo gracias a vosotros.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..ref: Hello again! Those newcomers are settling in nicely, thanks to you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..dst: Ciao di nuovo! I novizi si stanno ambientando a meraviglia, tutto grazie a voi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..src: Me alegro de oír eso, ¿entonces? ¿Por qué esa cara tan larga?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..ref: I'm glad to hear it. But why the long face?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..dst: Mi fa piacere sentirlo. Ma perche' quella faccia cosi' lunga?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..src: ¿No es evidente? A ver... cómo explico yo esto...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..ref: Is it that obvious? Well ... I suppose I could explain.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..dst: Si nota cosi' tanto? Allora... provo a spiegare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..src: Llegaron los nuevos fichajes y lo único que pudimos entregarles son esas camas tuyas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..ref: So, we got all those new recruits, but all they really have to their names are those beds.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..dst: Sono arrivati i nuovi reclute e l'unica cosa che abbiamo potuto consegnare loro sono quei tuoi letti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..src: Si van a quedarse, necesitarán algo más para entretenerse y pasar el poco rato libre que tengan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..ref: If they're going to be here for a while, they're going to need something to keep themselves entertained.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..dst: Se resteranno qui, avranno bisogno di altro per distrarsi e trascorrere il poco tempo libero che avranno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..src: Tienes razón. Sin un modo de relajarse, renunciarán y se marcharán a Eustella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..ref: Good point. Without some way to relax, they might give up and go straight back to Eustella.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..dst: Hai ragione. Senza un modo per rilassarsi, si arrenderanno e torneranno a Eustella.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..src: ¿Tú también lo piensas...? ¡Es un problemón! ¡No pueden dimitir! Si acaban de llegar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..ref: R-right? This is a major problem! We can't let them quit! Not when they only just got here!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..dst: Pensi anche tu...? E' un problema enorme! Non possono dimettersi! Sono appena arrivati...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..src: ¿Te importaría preguntarles cuáles son sus actividades de ocio favoritas? Y si te piden algo que esté en tu mano construir, ¿lo harías por ellos y por mí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..ref: I don't suppose you could ask around and find out what their preferred leisure activities are? And if it's something else you can build, would you mind?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..dst: Ti dispiacerebbe chiedere loro quali sono le loro attivita' preferite nel tempo libero? E se ti chiedessero qualcosa che puoi costruire, lo faresti per loro e per me?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..src: Les doblo la edad y no estoy al día de lo que se lleva o se deja de llevar... Creo que responderán con más naturalidad si les preguntas tú.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..ref: I'm twice their age, and I barely follow what's popular these days, so ... Well, I think they'd respond better to you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..dst: Ho il doppio della loro eta' e non sono al passo con cio' che va di moda... Credo che risponderebbero piu' spontaneamente se lo chiedessi tu.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..src: Claro, cuenta con ello. Iré a hablar con los nuevos reclutas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..ref: Sure, I can do that. I'll start by talking to the new recruits.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_310..dst: Certo, puoi contare su di me. Andro' a parlare con i nuovi reclute.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_320..src: ¿Cómo? ¿Quieres saber cómo me gusta pasar el tiempo? Pues...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_320..ref: Hm? You want to know what I usually do to pass the time? Well ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_320..dst: Come? Vuoi sapere come mi piace passare il tempo? Beh...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_320..src: ¡Cocino y cocino hasta desfallecer! Me encantaría preparar algunos platos, aunque sean los más sencillos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_320..ref: I cook up a storm! It'd be nice if I could make even some simple dishes out here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_320..dst: Cucino e ricucino fino allo sfinimento! Mi piacerebbe preparare qualche piatto, anche solo i piu' semplici.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_330..src: ¿Que cómo paso el tiempo libre? ¿Acaso no es evidente?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_330..ref: Huh? What I like doing in my free time? Isn't it obvious?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_330..dst: Come passo il tempo libero? Non e' forse evidente?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_330..src: ¡Ejercito los músculos! ¡Soy pura fuerza, pura fibra! Podría levantar pesas y tal, pero para eso necesitaría algo más de equipo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_330..ref: I do strength training! Work my muscles, you know? Sure, you can do basic bodyweight exercises, but it does help to have some extra equipment.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_330..dst: Mi alleno! Sono puro muscolo, pura forza! Potrei sollevare pesi e simili, ma per quello mi servirebbe un po' di attrezzatura in piu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_340..src: Ay, pues hay una cosa sin la que no podría vivir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_340..ref: Oooh, there's one thing I just can't live without!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_340..dst: Ah, beh, c'e' una cosa senza la quale non potrei proprio vivere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_340..src: ¡Los libros! Una buena pila de libros entre los que perderme sería magnífico.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_340..ref: Books! A whole pile of them to get lost in would be great!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_340..dst: I libri! Una bella pila di libri in cui perdermi sarebbe magnifico.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_350..src: ¡Me salvas la vida! Todo el equipo estará más animado ahora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_350..ref: You're a real lifesaver! Now we'll be able to keep the team's morale up!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_350..dst: Mi salvi la vita! Ora tutta la squadra sara' piu' animata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_350..src: No es para tanto. No pudieron traer nada con ellos, eso es muy triste.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_350..ref: No problem. They really didn't bring anything with them, which is, well, sad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_350..dst: Non e' niente. Non hanno potuto portare nulla con se', ed e' davvero triste.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_350..src: Pero... No sé, ¿no habría sido mejor que hubieras ido tú a hablar con tu equipo en persona?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_350..ref: But, you know ... Wouldn't it have been better if you'd taken the initiative to talk to the troops yourself?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_350..dst: Pero'... non so, non sarebbe stato meglio che andassi tu a parlare con la tua squadra di persona?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_350..src: ¡Ah! No, no sé, la verdad, es que no puedo quitarte la razón... Ja, ja, ja. Lo haré la próxima vez.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_350..ref: Oh! No, I can't really argue with that ... Hahaha ... I'll do better next time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_350..dst: Ah! No, insomma, in verita' non posso darti torto... Ah, ah, ah. La prossima volta lo faro'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_350..src: (Una cosa es ser demasiado duro con tus subordinados, pero este líder se pasa de blando...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_350..ref: (Being too harsh on your subordinates is one thing, but this leader is a bit too hands-off ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_350..dst: (Una cosa e' essere troppo duri con i subordinati, ma questo leader e' troppo accomodante...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_360..src: ¡Ya basta de lloriqueos! ¿Qué esperabas? Cuando se lucha con monstruos, se acaba con arañazos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_360..ref: Pull it together, you wimp! Fighting monsters means that you're going to get a little scratched up!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_360..dst: Datti una regolata, fifone! Se combatti i mostri, e' normale farsi qualche graffio!
Eh... Ma cos'e' tutto questo chiasso?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_360..src: Ah, eh... Uno de los novatos se tropezó con un monstruo. No tiene nada grave, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_360..ref: Oh, um ... One of the new fellows ran afoul of a monster. He's not that badly injured, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_360..dst: Ah, ehm... Uno dei nuovi si e' imbattuto in un mostro. Non e' nulla di grave, pero'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_360..src: ¡No me mires así! ¡Me duele taaanto que veo estreeeeellas!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_360..ref: Don't give me that look! I can't help that I'm in paaaaaain!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_360..dst: Non guardarmi cosi'! Mi fa taaanto male che vedo streeelle!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_360..src: Uff... Eso debe de escocer. Si estos rasguños son tan comunes, no os vendría mal tener un dispositivo de curación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_360..ref: Oof, that looks like it stings. If injuries like that are fairly common, then getting some healing devices would go a long way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_360..dst: Uff... Deve pungerlo parecchio. Se questi graffi sono cosi' comuni, non vi farebbe male avere un dispositivo di guarigione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_360..src: Me alegro de estar aquí, porque yo puedo curar heridas superficiales como esta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_360..ref: But I'm here now, and I've got the means to easily cure something this small.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_360..dst: Menomale che sono qui, perche' io posso curare facilmente ferite superficiali come questa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_360..src: Te lo agradecería. Adelante, no te cortes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_360..ref: If you could, that would be much appreciated. By all means, go right ahead.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_360..dst: Lo apprezzerei molto. Avanti, non ti fare problemi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_370..dst: W-wow! Non mi fa piu' male!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_370..src: Lo que necesitáis es un conversor de maná. Su finalidad principal no es la curación, pero os salvará de más de un aprieto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_370..ref: What you guys really need is a mana converter. It's not primarily used for healing, but it works well enough in a pinch.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_370..dst: Quello che vi serve e' un convertitore di mana. Il suo scopo principale non e' la cura, ma vi salvera' da piu' di un impiccio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_380..src: El maná es como... la esencia de la vida, estar cerca de una máquina así debería provocar que la gente se recupere con más rapidez.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_380..ref: Since mana is a kind of life-essence, being around one of these should help people heal faster.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_380..dst: Il mana e' una specie di... essenza della vita; stare vicino a una macchina del genere dovrebbe far recuperare le persone piu' rapidamente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_380..src: En serio, no sé cómo agradeceros todo lo que habéis hecho. El equipo podrá seguir con sus tareas sin preocuparse por nada más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_380..ref: Honestly, I can't thank you enough for everything. That should help everyone on the team do their jobs without worrying.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_380..dst: Davvero, non so come ringraziarti per tutto. Cosi' tutta la squadra potra' svolgere il proprio lavoro senza preoccupazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_380..src: Llevaos esto, es una orden. O sea, es un regalo, ¡ya me entendéis! Lo encontré en una expedición.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_380..ref: Ah. You ought to take this, as a gift. I found it while I was out in the field.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_380..dst: Prendete questo, e' un ordine. Cioe', e' un regalo, ormai mi capite! L'ho trovato durante una spedizione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_380..ref: No way! Is this Dryad Jade?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_380..dst: Incredibile! Ma questa e' Giada di Driade?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_380..src: Bueno, qué menos. Ojalá le deis un buen uso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_380..ref: Well, I owe you a lot. I was hoping you'd find it useful.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_380..dst: Beh, e' il minimo. Spero che ne farete buon uso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_380..src: ¡Le daremos el mejor uso que haya! Gracias, ¡qué ganas de tener algo así!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_380..ref: Oh, this would totally come in handy! Thanks, I'd be happy to take it off your hands!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_380..dst: Gli daremo il miglior uso possibile! Grazie, che voglia di avere una cosa cosi'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..src: ¡Perdona! ¡Uf! Tú tienes cara de apreciar los manjares más selectos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..ref: Hrm?! You! You have the look of someone who appreciates an eccentric delicacy!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..dst: Ehi! Uff! Tu hai la faccia di chi apprezza le prelibatezze piu' ricercate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..src: ¿Cómo? Eso es tan descortés que no pienso ni caer en la trampa. Te diré que la comida me interesa siempre que sepa bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..ref: ... That's so rude that I don't even feel mad. But the only thing I care about is if something tastes good.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..dst: Come? E' cosi' maleducato che non me la prendo nemmeno. Ti diro': il cibo mi interessa purche' sia buono.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..src: ¿Ese es tu baremo? ¡Qué triste...! ¿Y dónde queda tu ambición? ¿Dónde queda tu pasión?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..ref: That's your only metric?! What a waste ...! Where's the challenge? Where's the thrill?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..dst: E' questo il tuo metro di giudizio? Che tristezza...! E l'ambizione dov'e'? Dov'e' la passione?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..src: Los manjares son mucho más que una comida que sepa bien. Es precisamente el no poder comerlos todos los días lo que nos hace relamernos, ¿me sigues?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..ref: Delicacies are so much more than mere flavor. There's that element of scarcity that drives up their value, you see.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..dst: Le prelibatezze sono molto piu' di un cibo buono. E' proprio il non poterle mangiare tutti i giorni a renderle speciali, mi segui?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..src: Bueno, dicho así... Supongo que sí me interesan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..ref: Well, when you put it that way ... I guess I'm interested in them?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..dst: Beh, detto cosi'... Suppongo che mi interessino, si'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..src: Entonces, ¿qué haces ahí parada que no sales a buscar algunos? Lo digo porque aquí cerca hay más de uno.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..ref: Then, why not also try your hand at tracking some down? I say that because there are a few that aren't too far from here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..dst: Allora, che ci fai li' ferma a non andare a cercarne qualcuna? Lo dico perche' ce n'e' piu' di una qui vicino.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..src: Creo que te vendría muy bien poner a prueba tus dotes de sabueso e ir en busca de ingredientes inusuales.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..ref: I think it would be beneficial for you to try scrounging up some unusual ingredients for yourself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..dst: Penso che ti farebbe molto bene mettere alla prova il tuo fiuto e andare alla ricerca di ingredienti insoliti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..src: Pues... Me has abierto el apetito. Podría intentarlo por si los necesitara en un futuro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..ref: ... I mean, I am curious. I suppose I could give it a shot for future reference.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_390..dst: Beh... Mi hai stuzzicato l'appetito. Potrei provarci, chissa' che non mi servano in futuro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_400..src: ¡Esa es la actitud! ¡Una vez me comí una de estas delicias cruda y estuve sin salir de la cama tres días con sus noches!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_400..ref: Well done! I once ate my fill of this delicacy raw and was waylaid for three whole days and nights!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_400..dst: Questo e' lo spirito! Una volta mangiai una di queste prelibatezze cruda e rimasi a letto tre giorni e tre notti di fila!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_400..ref: Uh, doesn't that mean it's poisonous?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_400..src: No, fue del atracón... No recomendaría comer más de tres puñados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_400..ref: No, I simply overindulged. I wouldn't recommend eating more than a few handfuls.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_400..dst: No, e' stata solo un'abbuffata... Non consiglierei di mangiarne piu' di tre manciate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_400..src: No nos desviemos del tema... ¡Te nombro mi "cazadora gourmet" oficial!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_400..ref: But! This discovery makes you a fellow gourmet researcher!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_400..dst: Non cambiamo argomento... Ti nomino la mia "cacciatrice gourmet" ufficiale!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_400..src: La verdad, no es un título que me quite el sueño, pero ¡lo acepto!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_400..ref: ... Can't say that's a title I've ever wanted, but okay.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq01_400..dst: A dire la verita', non e' un titolo che mi tolga il sonno, ma lo accetto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..src: Oye, tú has hablado antes con una Neru, ¿no? ¿Crees que estarían dispuestas a hacerse amigas de un humano?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..ref: Hey, you've chatted with a Neru before, right? Would you say they'd be up to befriending a human?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..dst: Ehi, tu hai gia' parlato con una Neru, vero? Pensi che sarebbero disposte a fare amicizia con un essere umano?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..src: Tienen conversaciones muy amenas y no creo que quieran hacerle daño a nadie. Por lo menos, no sin motivos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..ref: They keep up a conversation just fine, and I don't think they'd hurt anyone without good reason.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..dst: Tengono conversazioni molto piacevoli e non credo che vogliano fare del male a nessuno. Almeno, non senza motivo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..src: Vale, entonces, primero debería enviarles algo como símbolo de mi amistad. ¿Qué podría funcionar...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..ref: Okay, then I should maybe send something as a symbol of friendship first. Hm, what would do the trick ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..dst: Ok, allora prima dovrei inviare loro qualcosa come simbolo di amicizia. Cosa potrebbe funzionare...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..src: ¿Me harías un favor? ¿Podrías llevarle esto a una Neru?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..ref: Could you do me a favor? Would you mind giving this to a Neru?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..dst: Mi faresti un favore? Potresti portare questo a una Neru?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..src: Me encanta conocer gente a nueva y hacer amigos. Sería genial ser amigo de las Neru.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..ref: I love meeting new people and making connections. It'd be nice to have a Neru friend, too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..dst: Adoro conoscere gente nuova e fare amicizia. Sarebbe fantastico essere amico anche delle Neru.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..src: Es un gesto muy noble, pero no tendrás nada más en mente, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..ref: That's pretty noble and all, but did you have anyone specific in mind?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..dst: E' un gesto molto nobile, ma non avrai nient'altro in mente, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..src: No, la verdad es que no. Nunca he hablado con ellas, pero he pensado que esto podría allanarme el camino.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..ref: Not really? I haven't exactly spoken to any of them before, so ... Well, I was thinking this would help grease some wheels.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..dst: No, a dire il vero no. Non ho mai parlato con loro, ma ho pensato che questo potesse spianarmi la strada.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..src: Así que aquí estamos. No tengo preferencia por ninguna, solo quiero que les digas que soy un humano y que me encantaría ser su amigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..ref: So, yeah. Anyone would be fine! Just let them know that I, a human, would very much like to be friends!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..dst: Ecco perche' siamo qui. Non ho preferenze particolari, voglio solo che tu dica loro che sono un umano e che mi piacerebbe molto diventare loro amico.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..src: Claro, claro... Creo que no va a ser tan sencillo, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..ref: Uh ... Sure. I get the feeling it's not going to be that easy, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_010..dst: Certo, certo... Ho l'impressione che non sara' cosi' semplice, pero'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_020..dst: Cosa? Che cos'e'? Perche' me lo dai?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_020..src: Eh... Es un símbolo de amistad, ya sabes, un regalo que demuestra el deseo de una persona de llevarse bien contigo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_020..ref: Uuuum ... It's a sign of, er, friendship? Like, to show that someone wants to be on good terms with you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_020..dst: Ehm... E' un simbolo di amicizia, vedi, un regalo che dimostra il desiderio di una persona di andare d'accordo con te.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_020..src: ¿De quién? No conozco... a nadie. Miedo, miedo, ¿cuál es el propósito?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_020..ref: Who? I do not. Know them. Scary, scary. What are they thinking?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_020..dst: Di chi? Non conosco... nessuno. Paura, paura. Qual e' lo scopo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_020..src: ¡No es nada del otro mundo! Te lo prometo. Aunque es más fácil decirlo que creerlo, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_020..ref: I-it's nothing nasty, I promise. That's easy enough to believe, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_020..dst: Non e' niente di male! Te lo prometto. Pero' e' piu' facile a dirsi che a crederci, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_020..src: Condición, condición. Acaba... con las Neru malvadas. Entonces, te creeré.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_020..ref: ... Condition, condition. Take down. The bad Neru. Then I will believe you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_020..dst: Condizione, condizione. Sconfiggi... le Neru malvagie. Allora ti credero'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_020..src: Está bien. Supongo que te hemos asustado, me veo obligada a compensarte...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_020..ref: Oh, okay. I mean, we startled you, so it's not like we can refuse ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_020..dst: Va bene. Suppongo che ti abbiamo spaventata, mi tocca compensarti...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_030..src: Te encargaste... de las Neru malvadas. Acepto el regalo... como prometí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_030..ref: ... You took down. The bad Neru. I will take it. As promised.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_030..dst: Ti sei occupata... delle Neru malvagie. Accetto il regalo... come promesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_030..src: ¡Menos mal! Además, creo que te gustará.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_030..ref: Thank goodness. I think you'll genuinely like this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_030..dst: Meno male! Inoltre, credo che ti piacera' davvero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_030..src: Los humanos son... un misterio. No lo entiendo. ¿Por qué tantas molestias? Miedo. Misterio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_030..ref: Humans are. A mystery. I do not understand. Why go so far? Scary. A mystery ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_030..dst: Gli umani sono... un mistero. Non lo capisco. Perche' tante premure? Paura. Mistero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_030..src: Sí, lo siento por la parte que me toca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_040..ref: Oh, wow! You really got someone to accept it! What a relief!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_040..dst: Caspita! Ce l'hai fatta a farglielo accettare! Che sollievo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_040..src: ¿Seguro que ha sido buena idea? Le diste un buen susto.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_040..ref: Are you sure that was a good idea? They were pretty scared by it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_040..dst: Sei sicura che fosse una buona idea? L'hai fatto spaventare parecchio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_040..src: Claro que sí, además, así será un momento memorable. Ahora no olvidará que un desconocido quiere conocerla un poco mejor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_040..ref: Yeah, but that makes the whole thing that much more memorable. They'll remember that someone out there wants to get to know them better.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_040..dst: Certo, e poi cosi' sara' un momento memorabile. Ora non dimentichera' che qualcuno la' fuori vuole conoscerla meglio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_040..src: Y si consigo con eso que al menos una Neru se interese por los humanos, eso que nos llevamos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_040..ref: And if even one more Neru takes an interest in humans, that's a plus in my book.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_040..dst: E se cosi' facendo almeno un'altra Neru si interessasse agli umani, per me e' un guadagno.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_040..src: Ajá... La pregunta es si despertarás su interés de verdad o...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_040..ref: Uh ... huh. I wonder if it will catch their interest ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_040..dst: Ah, ah... La domanda e' se suscitera' davvero il suo interesse o...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_050..src: Tú eres... la humana de antes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_050..ref: You, you are. The human from before.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_050..src: Ah, sí, esto... Me alegro de verte, sí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_050..ref: Oh! U-umm ... G-good to see you again?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_050..src: Toma... esto. Es una solicitud. Acéptala. Un regalo de agradecimiento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_050..ref: Here, here. A request. Please deliver. This return gift.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_050..dst: Tieni... questo. E' una richiesta. Consegnala. Un regalo di ringraziamento.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_050..src: ¡Anda! No parecías muy entusiasmada con la situación, ¿qué ha cambiado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_050..ref: Huh? You didn't seem too happy about things last time, so why?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_050..dst: Oh! Non sembravi molto entusiasta della situazione, cosa e' cambiato?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_050..src: Los regalos... hay que agradecerlos. Las Neru respetamos los buenos modales.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_050..ref: Presents must. Be acknowledged. Neru respect manners.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_050..dst: I regali... vanno ringraziati. Le Neru rispettano le buone maniere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_050..src: Ah... No esperaba una respuesta tan... directa. Claro, lo haré sin demora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_050..ref: ... Huh, I wasn't expecting such a straightforward answer. Sure, I can do that for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_050..dst: Oh... Non mi aspettavo una risposta cosi'... diretta. Certo, lo faro' subito.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_060..src: Si has traído algo para mi compañero, déjalo por ahí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_060..ref: Whatever you've got for him, you can just leave it over there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_060..dst: Se hai portato qualcosa per il mio compagno, lascialo laggiu'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_060..ref: Is he out on an investigation?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_060..src: Sí, le han llamado para que se encargue de unos monstruos, tardará en volver.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_060..ref: Yeah, we got a call to help handle some monsters. I don't think he'll be back for a while.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_060..dst: Si', l'hanno chiamato per occuparsi di alcuni mostri, non credo che torni presto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_060..src: Monstruos, ¿eh? Me gustaría ver su reacción en persona, así que iremos a su encuentro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_060..ref: Monsters, huh? ... But I'd rather see his reaction to this in person, so we'll head out that way ourselves.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_060..dst: Mostri, eh? Preferirei vederne la reazione di persona, quindi andiamo noi a cercarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_070..src: Ah, sois vosotros... Hemos subestimado la fuerza de estos monstruos y nos vimos forzados a retirarnos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_070..ref: Oh, it's you guys again ... We underestimated how strong those monsters were, so we had to retreat.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_070..dst: Ah, siete voi... Abbiamo sottovalutato la forza di quei mostri e ci siamo visti costretti a ritirarci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_070..src: Siguen acechando por la zona. Andaos con ojo al salir de aquí o acabaréis mal parados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_070..ref: They're still lurking in the area, though. You'd better get out of here before you get hurt.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_070..dst: Continuano a ronzare in zona. State attenti quando uscite di qui, o ne uscirete malconci.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_070..src: No podemos ignorar la situación. Nosotros nos encargamos de esos monstruos. Aprovechad para descansad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_070..ref: We can't just ignore this. We'll take care of the monsters, so you all please rest up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_070..dst: Non possiamo ignorare la situazione. Di quei mostri pensiamo noi. Voi, intanto, riposatevi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_080..ref: Aha, there they are. Let's settle this!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_090..src: Listo, ya no queda ninguno. Vale, ¡ahora a entregar ese regalo de agradecimiento!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_090..ref: There, I think that's all of them. Great, now we can deliver that return gift!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_090..dst: Fatto, non ne resta piu' nessuno. Ok, ora tocca consegnare quel regalo di ringraziamento!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_100..src: ¿Habéis acabado con esos monstruos por nosotros? ¡Qué alivio! Ya podemos respirar...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_100..ref: You got rid of those monsters for us?! Thank goodness ... Now we can all breathe easy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_100..dst: Avete eliminato quei mostri per noi? Che sollievo! Ora possiamo stare tranquilli...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_100..src: No hay de qué. Lo más importante ahora es que te he traído algo de tu amiga Neru.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_100..ref: Nothing to worry about. More importantly, I've brought something for you from your Neru friend.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_100..dst: Non e' niente. La cosa importante e' che ti ho portato qualcosa dalla tua amica Neru.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_100..src: ¿Para... para mí? ¿Para darme las gracias por mi detalle?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_100..ref: This is ... for me? As thanks for last time?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_100..dst: Per... per me? Per ringraziarmi per l'altra volta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_100..src: Por lo visto, sí. Nos dijo que no podía dejar pasar un gesto como este. En realidad, no esperaba tanta diligencia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_100..ref: Apparently. They said they couldn't let a nice gesture go unnoticed. Honestly, I wasn't expecting them to be that conscientious.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_100..dst: A quanto pare, si'. Ha detto che non poteva ignorare un gesto simile. Sinceramente, non mi aspettavo tanta scrupolosita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_100..src: En fin, ahora que os habéis intercambiado estos regalos, ¿por qué no le llevas algo en persona?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_100..ref: Anyway, now that you've both exchanged gifts, please try delivering the next one yourself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_100..dst: Insomma, ora che vi siete scambiati questi regali, perche' non le porti tu il prossimo di persona?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_100..src: Sí, no es mala idea. Eso haré.
¡Gracias por tomaros tantas molestias para entregarme esto! ¡Y por acabar con los monstruos, ya de paso!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_100..ref: Thanks for coming all the way out here to give it to me. And for getting rid of all those monsters at the same time!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_100..dst: Grazie per esservi fatti in quattro per consegnarmelo! E per aver eliminato pure i mostri!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..src: ¡Qué alegría verte! ¿Has encontrado más reliquias interesantes últimamente?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..ref: It's good to see you! Have you found any interesting relics lately?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..dst: Che piacere vederti! Hai trovato altre reliquie interessanti ultimamente?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..src: Pues... no sabría decirte. ¿Por eso has venido?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..ref: Hmm ... Maybe? Is that what you came here for?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..dst: Mah... non saprei dirti. Per questo sei venuto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..src: ¡Por supuestísimo! Una nueva región implica más reliquias por desenterrar. Cualquier coleccionista que se precie no se conformaría con menos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..ref: Naturally! A new area means new relics to be discovered. Any collector worth their salt would want for nothing more!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..dst: Ma certo! Una nuova regione significa nuove reliquie da dissotterrare. Qualunque collezionista che si rispetti non desidererebbe altro!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..src: Bueno, aunque... ¿quién sabe si esta región oculta algo? No sé si aquí habrá reliquias o no...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..ref: But, well ... who knows what this region will bring? Will I obtain any relics at all?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..dst: Pero', beh... chi sa cosa riservera' questa regione? Chissa' se trovero' reliquie o no...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..src: ¿No se supone que todo el continente es una reliquia? Deberías encontrar algo de valor mires por donde mires.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..ref: Isn't the whole continent basically one big relic? You're bound to find some, no matter where you look.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..dst: Non si dice che l'intero continente sia una grande reliquia? Troverai qualcosa di sicuro, ovunque guardi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..src: ¿Eh? Pues... ahora que lo dices... tienes razón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..ref: Ooooh?! True, now that you mention it ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..dst: Oh? Ehm... ora che lo dici... e' vero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..src: Entonces, ¿qué me dices? No te importará volver a salir a procurarme algunas, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..ref: Well then, how about it? Would you mind gathering some for me a second time?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..dst: Allora, che ne dici? Non ti dispiacera' uscire di nuovo a procurarmene alcune, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..src: Te volvería a recompensar por el esfuerzo. Y esta vez te prometo que merecerá la pena.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..ref: Again, you'd be rewarded handsomely for your efforts. I promise you, this would be worth it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..dst: Ti ricompenserei di nuovo per lo sforzo. E questa volta ti prometto che ne varra' la pena.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..src: Bueno, no nos cuesta nada prestar un poco de atención cuando salgamos a investigar y explorar el entorno. ¡Te traeremos lo que encontremos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..ref: Well, it wouldn't be too hard to keep an eye out for them while we're out investigating and pioneering. I'll bring you whatever we find!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_110..dst: Beh, non ci costa nulla fare un po' di attenzione quando usciremo a investigare ed esplorare la zona. Ti porteremo cio' che troveremo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_120..src: ¡Ooooooh! ¡Son espléndidas! ¡Me habéis traído un montón de reliquias!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_120..ref: Ooooooh! These are simply splendid! You've found so many new relics for me!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_120..dst: Oooooooh! Sono splendide! Me ne avete portato un sacco, di reliquie!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_120..src: En serio, es como si os cayeran del cielo, quizás debería unirme a vuestro equipo y acompañaros en vuestras aventuras...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_120..ref: I swear, they seem to just fall into your lap. Maybe I should join your party and tag along on your journeys ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_120..dst: Davvero, e' come se vi piovessero dal cielo, forse dovrei unirmi alla vostra squadra e accompagnarvi nelle vostre avventure...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_120..src: Eh... No creo que sea buena idea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_120..ref: Um, that might not be the best idea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_120..dst: Ehm... Non credo sia una buona idea.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_120..src: ¡Ja, ja, ja! Era una bromita. Sois unos aventureros impresionantes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_120..ref: Haha! I kid, I kid. Still, you're an impressive bunch of adventurers.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_120..dst: Ah, ah, ah! Era solo una battuta. Siete un gruppo di avventurieri impressionanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_120..src: Tomad, esto debería compensaros por todo el trabajo que habéis hecho por mí. ¡Vamos, cógelo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_120..ref: Here, this ought to be enough to cover all the trouble you went through. Go on, take it!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_120..dst: Prendete, questo dovrebbe compensarvi per tutto il lavoro che avete fatto per me. Dai, prendilo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_130..src: Unos monstruos desconocidos han cortado la carretera más adelante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_130..ref: The road up ahead is being blocked by strange monsters.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_130..dst: Alcuni mostri sconosciuti hanno bloccato la strada piu' avanti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_130..src: Por lo visto, están dispuestos a quitarse de ahí a cambio de comida, pero nos va a hacer falta un montón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_130..ref: They seem to be willing to move in exchange for food, but we'd need an awful lot of it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_130..dst: A quanto pare, sono disposti a spostarsi in cambio di cibo, ma ci ne servira' tantissimo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_130..src: Además, su fuerza es imponente, así que hemos descartado echarlos a las malas. En pocas palabras: estamos aquí atrapados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_130..ref: They're also rather strong, so forcing them out of the way is out of the question. In short, we're stuck here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_130..dst: Inoltre, la loro forza e' imponente, quindi abbiamo scartato l'idea di cacciarli con la forza. In poche parole: siamo bloccati qui.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_130..src: Esos monstruos suenan más desagradables de lo normal. No nos costaría nada ir a echar un vistazo, ¿os parece?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_130..ref: Those monsters sound nastier than the usual ones. I guess we could go scope out the situation?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_130..dst: Quei mostri sembrano piu' sgradevoli del solito. Non ci costerebbe nulla andare a dare un'occhiata, vi sembra?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_130..src: ¿No os importa? Si pudierais resolver este entuerto, sería fabuloso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_130..ref: You wouldn't mind? If you could get rid of them, that would be amazing.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_130..dst: Non vi dispiace? Se riusciste a risolvere questo pasticcio, sarebbe fantastico.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_140..src: Ya veo, ocupan todo el camino. Vaya problemón.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_140..ref: Huh, they're really taking up the whole path. Yeah, that is a problem.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_140..dst: Capito, occupano tutta la strada. Che grosso problema.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_140..ref: Oh no, they're looking this way.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_140..src: (Parecen fuertes. Si queremos acabar con ellos, deberíamos prepararnos antes para la batalla.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_140..ref: (They definitely seem strong, too. If we're going to take them down, we should make sure we're ready for a fight.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_140..dst: (Sembrano davvero forti. Se vogliamo eliminarli, dovremmo prepararci prima per la battaglia.)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_150..src: ¿En serio habéis acabado con esas malas bestias? Vaya... Habréis sudado la gota gorda para derrotar a unos monstruos tan fuertes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_150..ref: Y-you actually took down those beasts?! Oh, wow ... Going up against something that strong can't have been easy.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_150..dst: Davvero avete avuto la meglio su quelle brutte bestie? Cavolo... Avete sudato sette camicie per sconfiggere mostri cosi' forti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_150..src: Pero me alegro de oír que podemos movernos con total libertad de nuevo. ¡Tomad! Es mi modo de daros las gracias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_150..ref: But, it's wonderful to hear that we can freely pass through again! Here, take this as thanks!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_150..dst: Ma mi rallegro di sentire che possiamo di nuovo muoverci in totale liberta'. Prendete! E' il mio modo di ringraziarvi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_160..src: Esta arma lleva con nosotros mucho, mucho tiempo, pero está llegando a su límite.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_160..ref: This weapon's been in use for a good, long while, but it might finally be at its limit.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_160..dst: Quest'arma ci accompagna da molto, molto tempo, ma sta raggiungendo il suo limite.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_160..src: ¡Hala! Cuánto cariño profesa a su equipo, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_160..ref: Whoa! That really is a well-loved piece of equipment.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_160..dst: Caspita! Quanto ci tiene al suo equipaggiamento, eh?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_160..src: Estoy a cargo del mantenimiento de las armas de los miembros del equipo, aunque, por desgracia, los recursos son limitados.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_160..ref: I'm in charge of maintaining the team members' weapons, but unfortunately, supplies are limited.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_160..dst: Mi occupo della manutenzione delle armi dei membri della squadra, anche se, purtroppo, le risorse sono limitate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_160..src: Reparo sus armas, mi obligación es que sean útiles el mayor tiempo posible, pero mis habilidades llegan hasta donde llegan.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_160..ref: I've been repairing the weapons we have to keep them usable for as long as possible, but there's only so much I can do.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_160..dst: Riparo le loro armi, il mio compito e' tenerle utilizzabili il piu' a lungo possibile, ma le mie capacita' fanno quello che possono.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_160..src: Ya veo... ¿Quieres que le haga unos apaños? Así retrasaríamos su jubilación, ¿no?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_160..ref: ... I see. But what if I patched it up for you? That would reset the clock, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_160..dst: Capisco... Vuoi che gli faccia qualche ritocco? Cosi' rimanderemmo il suo pensionamento, no?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_160..src: ¿Harías eso? ¡Me encantaría que esta pequeñina viviera unos cuantos combates más!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_160..ref: You'd do that? It would be amazing if this one could see a few more rounds of combat.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_160..dst: Lo faresti? Mi piacerebbe che questa piccola vedesse ancora qualche combattimento!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_160..ref: Of course! Please leave it to us!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_170..src: ¡Hualaaa! Pero ¡si está como nueva! ¿Cómo has hecho que quede tan perfecta?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_170..ref: Whoa! It's practically brand new! How did you get it so perfect?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_170..dst: Wow! Ma e' come nuova! Come sei riuscito a renderla cosi' perfetta?
Ah! Quello e' un segreto professionale.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_170..src: Está bien, lo respeto. Lo bueno es que los miembros del equipo seguirán luchando bien pertrechados. Gracias, os debemos una.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_170..ref: Fair enough. But, this is going to help the team members keep on fighting. Thanks, I owe you one.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_170..dst: Va bene, lo rispetto. La cosa bella e' che i membri della squadra continueranno a combattere ben equipaggiati. Grazie, ve ne dobbiamo una.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..src: Oye, tú sabías arreglar armas rotas en un pis pas, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..ref: Say, you've got an easy fix for broken weapons, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..dst: Ehi, tu sai riparare le armi rotte in un attimo, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..src: Bueno, yo no diría tanto, pero se me da bien reparar cosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..ref: It's a bit more complicated than that, but I'm good at repairing things.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..dst: Beh, non lo direi proprio cosi', ma sono brava a riparare le cose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..src: Verás, es que quería proponerte un trato.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..ref: In that case ... What would you say to making a deal?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..dst: Vedi, e' che volevo proporti un affare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..src: Yo me hago con las armas rotas de los miembros del equipo y tú las reparas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..ref: I collect the team members' broken weapons, and you patch them up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..dst: Io raccolgo le armi rotte dei membri della squadra e tu le ripari.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..src: Las reparaciones nos harán ganar un dinerillo y nos repartiremos el pastel. ¿Qué me dices?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..ref: The fixed pieces of equipment earn us a tidy reward, which we split. What do you say?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..dst: Le riparazioni ci faranno guadagnare un po' di soldi e ci divideremo la torta. Che ne dici?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..src: Pues... no buscaba sacarle beneficio a esto, pero...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..ref: Hm ... I'm not really in it to turn a profit, so ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..dst: Beh... non cercavo di trarne profitto, ma...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..src: ¡Espera, espera! Quiero añadirle un incentivo por mi parte, una Pentanita adicional. ¿Y ahora? ¿Eh?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..ref: I'll even sweeten the deal by adding my own incentive. An extra Pentanite. How about it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..dst: Aspetta, aspetta! Voglio aggiungere un incentivo da parte mia, una Pentanite in piu'. E adesso? Eh?
Va bene... Si'! Conta su di me!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..src: ¡Es un placer hacer negocios contigo! Pues manos a la obra, ya tengo unas cuantas romas por aquí, te puedes poner cuando tengas un rato, ¡gracias desde ya!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..ref: Pleasure doing business with you! As it so happens, I already have a bunch of weapons that need fixing, so thanks in advance.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_180..dst: E' un piacere fare affari con te! Quindi, mani all'opera, ho gia' qualche arma rotta da queste parti, puoi metterti al lavoro quando hai un momento, grazie fin d'ora!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_190..src: Aquí tienes. Estas son todas las armas, ¿verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_190..ref: Here you go. These were all the weapons you had, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_190..dst: Ecco a te. Queste sono tutte le armi, giusto?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_190..src: ¡Qué bien! No esperaba nada menos de ti, ¡pero están perfectas!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_190..ref: Nicely done! Not that I was expecting any less, but these really are perfect.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_190..dst: Benissimo! Non mi aspettavo meno da te, ma sono perfette!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_190..src: (De hecho, sería más lucrativo que no lo estuvieran tanto y que necesitaran pasar por nuestras manos más pronto que tarde...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_190..ref: (Actually, it might be kind of lucrative to make it so these weapons need servicing sooner rather than later ... )
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_190..dst: (A dire il vero, sarebbe piu' redditizio che non lo fossero cosi' tanto e che avessero bisogno di passare dalle nostre mani prima o poi...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_190..src: Ah, no, hablaba conmigo mismo. Aquí tienes la recompensa que te prometí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_190..ref: Nothing, just talking to myself. But, here's the reward I promised.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_190..dst: Ah, no, parlavo da solo. Ecco a te la ricompensa che ti avevo promesso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_190..src: ¡Espero que no te importe si vuelvo a pedirte ayuda en el futuro!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_190..ref: I hope you won't mind if I ask for more help in the future!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_190..dst: Spero non ti dispiaccia se ti chiedero' di nuovo aiuto in futuro!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_190..src: (¿Acabo de firmar mi sentencia de pasar la eternidad reparando armas?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_190..ref: ( ... Did I just doom myself to an eternity of repair work?)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_190..dst: (Ho appena firmato la condanna a passare l'eternita' a riparare armi?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..src: ¡Hola, qué bien verte de nuevo! Me han llegado más armas que necesitan unos mimos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..ref: Hey, good to see you again! So, I've got some more weapons in need of repairs ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..dst: Ehi, che bello rivederti! Mi sono arrivate altre armi che hanno bisogno di un po' di cure.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..src: ¡Un segundo! ¿Esa no la reparé la última vez?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..ref: Hold on a second! Didn't I fix that one last time?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..dst: Un secondo! Non e' quella che ho riparato l'ultima volta?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..src: ¡S-sí...! Estas cosas son así, ya sabes. Quería pedirte que le dieras unos retoques más, aunque...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..ref: Y-you did, but that's just what happens out in the field. I was hoping you'd be able to patch it up again, but ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..dst: S-si'...! Ma queste cose succedono sul campo, sai. Speravo che potessi sistemarla di nuovo, pero'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..src: El uso normal no la desgastaría tan pronto. Y no es solo esta, ¡mira las demás! Qué extraño.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..ref: Normal wear and tear wouldn't run it down this quickly. And it's not just the one, it's ALL of them. That's pretty suspicious.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..dst: L'usura normale non la rovinerebbe cosi' presto. E non e' solo questa, guarda le altre! Che strano.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..src: Bu-bueno, claro, con tantas hordas de monstruos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..ref: W-well, when you're going up against hordes of monsters ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..dst: B-beh, certo, con tutte quelle orde di mostri addosso...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..src: No, no es eso. La calidad de estas armas no es tan deficiente como para que se rompan con facilidad. Este daño es deliberado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..ref: Nope, I'm not buying it. These aren't so poorly made that they'd break that easily. This was deliberate.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..dst: No, non ci sto. Queste armi non sono fatte cosi' male da rompersi con tanta facilita'. Questo danno e' deliberato.
