eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..src: Estás ocultando algo, ¿verdad? Habla con sinceridad, por favor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..ref: You're hiding something, aren't you? Please be honest.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..dst: Stai nascondendo qualcosa, vero? Parlami con sincerita', ti prego.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..src: Está bien, vale. Supongo que te debo una explicación como socia que eres.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..ref: ... All right, fine. I suppose I owe you an explanation, since you're in on this too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..dst: Va bene, dai. Suppongo di doverti una spiegazione, visto che anche tu ci sei coinvolta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..src: Te gustan las bien merecidas recompensas, ¿verdad? Reconozco que estábamos ganando dinero a espuertas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..ref: You're in it for those sweet, sweet rewards, aren't you? I mean, I was making money hand over fist.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..dst: Ti piacciono le ricompense ben meritate, eh? Ammetto che stavamo guadagnando soldi a palate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..src: Entonces se me ocurrió que, si animaba a los miembros del equipo de investigación a adentrarse en zonas con un poco más de acción, acudirían con las armas rotas a nosotros algo antes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..ref: So, I figured that if I gently nudged the Research Team members into areas with more action, I'd see those weapons come back my way that much sooner.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..dst: Cosi' ho pensato che, se incoraggiavo i membri della Squadra di Ricerca ad addentrarsi in zone un po' piu' movimentate, sarebbero tornati da noi con le armi rotte un po' prima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..src: Más reparaciones significa más ingresos, es sencillo. Son negocios, ¿sabes?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..ref: More repairs means more profit, after all. It's just business, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..dst: Piu' riparazioni significa piu' guadagni, semplice. Sono affari, sai?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..src: ¡Qué mal! ¿Es que no te preocupa la seguridad de los pobres miembros del equipo?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..ref: That's awful! Don't you care about the safety of the team members at all?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..dst: Che orribile! Non ti importa proprio della sicurezza dei poveri membri della squadra?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..src: ¡Han venido a investigar! Tampoco es que no conozcan los peligros de primera mano. Solo los más novatos se quejarían de estas incursiones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..ref: They came out here to investigate, it's not like they don't know the dangers! Only amateurs would complain!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..dst: Sono venuti qui per fare ricerche! Non e' che non conoscano i pericoli. Solo i piu' inesperti si lamenterebbero di queste spedizioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..src: Eres... una persona horrible. Se acabó.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..ref: ... You're a horrible person. We're done here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..dst: Sei... una persona orribile. Qui e' finita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..src: Venga ya, no seas así. He recogido un montón de armas rotas. Los miembros del equipo no pueden usarlas para luchar en este estado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..ref: C'mon, don't be like that. I've collected a bunch of broken weapons. The team members can't fight with them like that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..dst: Dai, non fare cosi'. Ho raccolto un sacco di armi rotte. I membri della squadra non possono combattere in questo stato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..src: Y, si no pueden luchar, no van a estar preparados para cualquier incursión repentina. Eso tampoco te vendría bien a ti, ¿no crees?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..ref: And if they can't fight, they wouldn't be prepared for a sudden raid. That would be bad news for you guys as well, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..dst: E se non possono combattere, non saranno pronti per un attacco improvviso. E questo non farebbe comodo nemmeno a voi, non credi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..src: Si concluimos el trabajo como es debido, ayudaremos a que todo el mundo esté a salvo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..ref: Seeing the job through to the end will help everyone stay safe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..dst: Se concludiamo il lavoro come si deve, aiuteremo tutti a stare al sicuro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..src: Está bien, pero esta es la última vez. Haré que esas armas sean indestructibles.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..ref: ... Fine, but after that, we're through. I'll make those weapons indestructible!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_200..dst: Va bene, ma questa e' l'ultima volta. Rendero' quelle armi indistruttibili!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_210..src: Toma, ya he terminado. Nunca han sido más resistentes, no se romperán tan fácilmente esta vez.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_210..ref: Here, they're done. I made them even sturdier than before, so they won't break at all now.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_210..dst: Ecco, ho finito. Non sono mai state cosi' resistenti, stavolta non si romperanno piu' cosi' facilmente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_210..src: Bueno, no me voy a quejar. He sacado tantos beneficios que podría casi cerrar mi taller.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_210..ref: Hmph. Guess I can't complain about that. I made enough of a profit that I can close up shop, in a sense.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_210..dst: Beh, non posso lamentarmi. Ho fatto cosi' tanti profitti che potrei quasi chiudere bottega.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_210..src: Estás tramando algo más, ¿a que sí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_210..ref: ... You've got something else up your sleeve, don't you?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_210..src: ¿Por quién me tomas? Ya te dije que me había resignado a parar. Dejemos el tema, ¿vale?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_210..ref: Weren't you listening? I said I was done. Just drop it, would you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_210..dst: Ma per chi mi prendi? Ti ho gia' detto che mi sono rassegnato a smettere. Lasciamo perdere, va?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_210..src: ¡Vaya, qué humos! Si llega el día en que tienes que dar explicaciones de tus actos, no digas que no te avisé.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_210..ref: Well, aren't you a ray of sunshine! When this catches up with you, don't say I didn't tell you so!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_210..dst: Mah, che solarita'! Quando dovrai rendere conto dei tuoi atti, non dire che non te l'avevo detto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..src: Oye, tú debes de ser la chica de tanto talento con las reparaciones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..ref: Oh! You must be that talented repair lady.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..dst: Ehi, tu devi essere quella ragazza cosi' talentuosa nelle riparazioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..src: Una de las armas que reparaste era mía. En serio, menudo alivio saber que tenía entre mis manos algo tan resistente y fiable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..ref: I own one of the weapons you fixed up. Honestly, it was a relief to have used something that reliably solid.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..dst: Una delle armi che hai riparato era mia. Davvero, che sollievo sapere di avere tra le mani qualcosa di cosi' solido e affidabile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..src: ¿Por qué hablas de ella en pasado...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..ref: And that was in the past tense because ...?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..dst: Perche' parli di lei al passato...?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..src: Hace unos cuantos días, el líder de unos monstruos a los que nos enfrentamos decidió plantarnos cara.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..ref: Not too long ago, the leader of some monsters we'd dealt with decided to show up.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..dst: Qualche giorno fa, il capo di alcuni mostri che avevamo affrontato ha deciso di darci battaglia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..src: ¿Y te acuerdas del hombre que llevaba el taller de armas? Pues cogió la mía y salió corriendo para encargarse de él en persona.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..ref: And, you know that man who's in charge of weapon maintenance? Well, he grabbed mine and ran off to go take care of it himself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..dst: E ti ricordi dell'uomo che gestiva il laboratorio delle armi? Ebbene, ha preso la mia ed e' corso via per occuparsene in persona.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..src: ¿Que hizo quééé? Dime que no iba solo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..ref: He what?! He didn't go all on his own, did he?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..dst: Ha fatto cosaaaa? Dimmi che non e' andato da solo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..src: Me temo que eso fue exactamente lo que hizo. Me sabe fatal, pero yo estaba echándome un sueñecito mientras tanto, así que no pude hacer nada por detenerlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..ref: That's exactly what happened. I hate to admit it, but I was taking a nap at the time, so I couldn't stop him.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..dst: Temo che sia esattamente quello che ha fatto. Mi dispiace ammetterlo, ma in quel momento stavo facendo un pisolino, quindi non ho potuto fermarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..src: Me han contado que salió corriendo al grito de "¡Ha sido mi culpa!".
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..ref: I was told that he sped away, yelling, "It's all my faaaaaault!"
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..dst: Mi hanno raccontato che e' scappato via urlando "E' tutta colpa miaaa!".

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..src: Pero ¿en qué estaría pensando...? Uf, iremos tras él. Por muy poco que me apetezca, me sentiría mal ignorando este tema.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..ref: What was he thinking ...? Ugh, we'll go track him down. As much as I'd rather not, I'd regret ignoring this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_220..dst: Ma cosa si sara' messo in testa...? Uff, andremo a cercarlo. Per quanto non ne ho voglia, mi sentirei in colpa a ignorare questa faccenda.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_230..ref: There you are! What's going on?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_230..src: ¡El monstruo me ha atacado! ¡Por favor, haz algo!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_230..ref: That monster's attacking me! Please, you've got to do something!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_230..dst: Il mostro mi ha attaccato! Ti prego, fai qualcosa!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_230..src: En fin... Mira, quédate ahí, ¿vale? ¡Nosotros le pondremos fin a esto!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_230..ref: *Sigh* ... Look, just go stand over there, okay? We'll settle this!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_230..dst: Mah... Senti, mettiti li', va bene? A questo pensiamo noi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..src: E... ¡estoy vivo! Vaya, eras la última persona a la que esperaba ver.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..ref: I-I'm alive ...! Still, you were the last person I was expecting to come to my rescue.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..dst: S-sono vivo...! Vabbe', eri l'ultima persona che mi aspettavo di vedere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..src: ¿Cómo se te ocurre ponerte en peligro de esta manera?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..ref: What were you thinking, putting yourself in danger like that?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..dst: Come ti viene in mente di metterti in pericolo in questo modo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..src: No se lo diré a nadie.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..dst: Non lo diro' a nessun altro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..src: Ese matón apareció por mi culpa... Prácticamente lo animé a atacarnos de tanto enviar caballeros para acabar con sus vasallos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..ref: ... Their leader only showed up because of me. I basically goaded it into attacking by repeatedly sending the knights to go pick on its underlings.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..dst: Quel capo si e' fatto vivo per colpa mia... In pratica l'ho spinto ad attaccarci mandando piu' e piu' volte i cavalieri a infastidire i suoi scagnozzi.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..src: Nunca imaginé que las cosas se fueran a torcer tanto. Me refiero también a las reparaciones. Fue una idea tan lucrativa que me dejé llevar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..ref: I honestly didn't think that things would get this bad. Same with the repairs, too. It was such a lucrative set-up, that I just got sucked right in.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..dst: Non credevo davvero che le cose sarebbero peggiorate a tal punto. Mi riferisco anche alle riparazioni. Era un affare cosi' redditizio che mi sono lasciato trascinare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..src: Y por eso te viste obligado a compensarlo de alguna manera... A pesar de casi no tener experiencia en combate. No tenías ninguna posibilidad de ganar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..ref: So, you felt compelled to make it right ... despite having barely any combat experience. There's no way you were going to win.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..dst: E cosi' ti sei sentito in dovere di rimediare in qualche modo... Nonostante avessi quasi nessuna esperienza di combattimento. Non avevi alcuna possibilita' di vincere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..src: Ya, no lo niego. Me uní a esto de la investigación para ganar dinero y lo único que me he llevado ha sido una lección de vida, ¡y por las malas!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..ref: Yeah, I can't argue with that. I only joined this investigation to earn money, but I've learned my lesson the hard way.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..dst: Gia', non posso negarlo. Mi sono unito a questa indagine solo per guadagnare, e l'unica cosa che mi sono portato a casa e' una lezione di vita, imparata alla dura!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..src: Solo os he causado problemas a ti y a los demás miembros del equipo. Lo siento mucho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..ref: I've done nothing but cause problems for you and the other team members. I really am sorry about that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..dst: Non ho fatto altro che causare problemi a te e agli altri membri della squadra. Mi dispiace davvero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..src: Disculpas aceptadas. Sigues siendo un cretino, pero ahora al menos vas por el buen camino.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..ref: ... Apology accepted. You're still a jerk, but at least you're trying to do better.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..dst: Scuse accettate. Sei sempre un cretino, ma almeno ora stai cercando di migliorare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..src: ¿No se te olvida decir algo más?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..ref: Are you sure there's nothing else that you're forgetting to say, though?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..dst: Sicuro di non aver dimenticato di dire qualcos'altro?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..src: Ah... Sí, claro. Gracias por salvarme la vida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..ref: O-oh, right. Thank you very much for saving me.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_240..dst: Ah... Si', certo. Grazie mille per avermi salvato la vita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..src: ¡Qué alegría volver a verte, cazadora gourmet! Apuesto a que has venido a ver a tu compi y a buscar más manjares.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..ref: How good to see you, my fellow gourmet researcher! I take it you've come out here in search of more delicacies?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..dst: Che gioia rivederti, cacciatrice gourmet! Scommetto che sei venuta a trovare il tuo compare e a cercare altre prelibatezze.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..src: Esto... no. Pero, ¿me buscabas tú a mí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..ref: Uh ... no. But, I'm guessing you are?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..dst: Ehm... no. Ma tu mi stavi cercando, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..src: ¡Pues claro! He salido a cazar ingredientes raros y comestibles que solo se dan en esta zona y eso me ha llevado a hablar con los Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..ref: Of course! I'm on the hunt for rare and edible ingredients that can only be found in this area, so I've been talking to the Welleks.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..dst: Ma certo! Sono a caccia di ingredienti rari e commestibili che si trovano solo in questa zona, e cosi' ho parlato con i Welleks.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..src: No entiendo por qué alguien se tomaría tantas molestias para comer algo tan horrible. Cualquiera de nuestras recetas sabría mucho mejor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..ref: ... I just don't get why anyone would go out of their way to eat something so awful. We've got plenty of great dishes here.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..dst: Non capisco perche' qualcuno dovrebbe impegnarsi cosi' tanto per mangiare una cosa cosi' orribile. Una qualsiasi delle nostre ricette sarebbe molto piu' gustosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..src: No lo entiendes, verás: los platos clásicos son algo tan cotidiano que no apreciamos todo su valor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..ref: No, see, taking conventional dishes for granted is the surest way to gloss over their value.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..dst: Non capisci, vedi: i piatti classici sono qualcosa di cosi' quotidiano che non ne apprezziamo tutto il valore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..src: Ah, por cierto, ¿te importaría salir a buscar un ingrediente por mí? Si te apetece, claro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..ref: Ah, I know. If you're feeling up for it, would you mind gathering me some of this particular ingredient?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..dst: Ah, a proposito, ti dispiacerebbe andare a cercare un ingrediente per me? Se hai voglia, certo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..src: Me preocupan tanto los monstruos de la zona que solo pensaría en salir airoso de la incursión y no prestaría la atención que se merece a mi ingrediente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..ref: The monsters here are rather formidable, so I would be hard-pressed to focus on finding it on my own.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..dst: I mostri di questa zona mi preoccupano cosi' tanto che penserei solo a uscirne incolume, senza prestare la dovuta attenzione al mio ingrediente.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..src: Respeto tu devoción por la cacería de ingredientes. Está bien, iremos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..ref: Well, I respect your devotion to your hunt. All right, we'll keep an eye out for it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_250..dst: Rispetto la tua devozione alla caccia agli ingredienti. Va bene, staremo d'occhio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_260..src: ¡Genial! ¡Has encontrado un montón! ¡Eres una cazadora gourmet brillante!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_260..ref: Amazing! You found so much! I've never met a more brilliant gourmet researcher!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_260..dst: Fantastico! Ne hai trovato una marea! Sei una cacciatrice gourmet brillante!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_260..src: Vas en serio, ¿eh? Una pregunta, ¿qué soléis comer los humanos?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_260..ref: ... You sure are into this stuff, huh? What DO humans eat on a regular basis, anyway?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_260..dst: La prendi sul serio, eh? Una domanda: che cosa mangiate di solito voi umani?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_260..src: La mayoría prepara sus recetas pensando en si estarán ricas o no. Él es una excepción.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_260..ref: Most people pick things based on whether or not they're delicious. He's the exception, not the rule.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_260..dst: La maggior parte della gente prepara i suoi piatti in base a se saranno buoni o no. Lui e' un'eccezione.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_260..src: Los manjares son una cosa aparte. Toma, te lo mereces por todo lo que has trabajado hasta ahora.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_260..ref: Delicacies are in their own class. But, I still have to reward you for this round.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_260..dst: Le prelibatezze sono un capitolo a parte. Tieni, te lo meriti per tutto il lavoro che hai fatto finora.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_260..src: Algún día, en un lugar remoto y teniendo en cuenta tus habilidades, seguro que nos volvemos a ver y compartiremos nuevos manjares.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_260..ref: I'm certain we'll see each other again, given your skills. Someday, somewhere, with new delicacies to sample.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_260..dst: Un giorno, in qualche luogo remoto, vista la tua abilita', di sicuro ci rivedremo e condivideremo nuove prelibatezze.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_260..ref: ... I'm really not sure what to say to that.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..src: ¿Te pasa algo? Tienes una cara muy larga.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..ref: Is something wrong? You look kind of sad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..dst: Ti succede qualcosa? Hai una faccia cosi' lunga.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..src: Horrible. Horrible. Atacaron a mis amigas. Eran muchas... Neru fuertes. Peligrosas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..ref: Awful, awful. My friends were attacked. A bad group. Of us. Dangerous.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..dst: Orribile. Orribile. Hanno attaccato le mie amiche. Erano tante... Neru forti. Pericolose.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..src: Un grupo hostil de Neru... ¿Qué les pasó a tus amigas?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..ref: A hostile group of Neru ... What happened to the folks who got attacked?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..dst: Un gruppo ostile di Neru... Che cosa e' successo alle tue amiche?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..src: Todas... están bien. Aun así. No podemos... ignorarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..ref: None of them. Died. But, we cannot. Ignore this.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..dst: Tutte... stanno bene. Eppure. Non possiamo... ignorarlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..src: No quiero... enfrentarme a otras Neru. Triste. Aunque sean enemigas... Quiero proteger... a mis amigas. Importante. Importante... para mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..ref: I don't want to. Fight other Neru. It is sad. Even if they are enemies. But, I will protect. My friends. That is. An important duty.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..dst: Non voglio... affrontare altre Neru. Triste. Anche se sono nemiche... Voglio proteggere... le mie amiche. Importante. Importante... per me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..src: En ese caso, ¿por qué no dejas que vayamos nosotros a por las Neru enemigas? Así podrías dedicarte a defender la aldea.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..ref: In that case, we'll take care of them for you. You please focus on defending the settlement.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..dst: In tal caso, perche' non ci lasci occuparci noi delle Neru nemiche? Cosi' potresti dedicarti a difendere il villaggio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..src: Las cosas se podrían más tensas todavía si atacaran este lugar mientras estás ausente, ¿no crees?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..ref: Things would get a lot worse if this place got attacked again while you were out, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..dst: La situazione si farebbe ancora piu' tesa se attaccassero questo posto mentre sei via, non credi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..ref: You're sure, you're sure? That would be. Appreciated.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..src: Estoy segura. Entiendo cómo te sientes. Y no te preocupes por nosotros, sabemos luchar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..ref: It's fine, I get how you must be feeling. Don't worry, we'll handle it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_270..dst: Sono sicura. Capisco come ti senti. E non preoccuparti per noi, sappiamo combattere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_280..ref: Human, human. How did it? Turn out?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_280..src: Nos enfrentamos a las Neru que estaban rondando por la aldea. Espero que eso sirva para mantener las cosas a raya.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_280..ref: We took out the ones who were hanging around the settlement. That should hopefully reduce the threat a bit.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_280..dst: Abbiamo affrontato le Neru che giravano intorno al villaggio. Spero che serva a tenere la situazione sotto controllo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_280..src: Gracias... Muchas gracias... Con eso... bastará. Menos peligros. De lo contrario... tristeza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_280..ref: Thank you, thank you. That is. Enough. It will surely. Be less dangerous. If not, I will be sad ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_280..dst: Grazie... Molte grazie... Con questo... bastera'. Meno pericoli. Altrimenti... tristezza.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_280..src: Sí, a mí me daría pena también. Ojalá que tu aldea siga siendo un lugar seguro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_280..ref: Yes, that would be sad. We'll be hoping that your settlement stays safe.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_280..dst: Si', anche a me dispiacerebbe. Speriamo che il tuo villaggio continui a essere un luogo sicuro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_280..src: Gracias. Gracias. Estaremos... bien. Toma una recompensa... Lo siento. No es mucho.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_280..ref: Thank you, thank you. It will surely. Be fine. Here is your. Reward. I am sorry. It is not much.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_280..dst: Grazie. Grazie. Staremo... bene. Tieni, una ricompensa... Mi dispiace. Non e' molto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_280..src: No te preocupes. Si necesitas más ayuda, acude a nosotros sin dudarlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_280..ref: Please don't worry about it. If you need any more help, just let us know.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_280..dst: Non ti preoccupare. Se hai bisogno di altro aiuto, vieni da noi senza esitare.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_290..src: ¿Cómo están las cosas? ¿Se ha reducido el número de ataques?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_290..ref: How have things been? Has the number of attacks gone down?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_290..dst: Come vanno le cose? Il numero degli attacchi e' diminuito?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_290..src: Sí. Sí. Ha... bajado. Pero no es cero.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_290..ref: Yes, yes. It has. But, it is not zero.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_290..dst: Si'. Si'. E'... diminuito. Ma non e' zero.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_290..src: Tal vez deberíamos probar con un método más radical si queremos que los ataques sean cosa del pasado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_290..ref: Hmm ... We might have to take a more active approach if we want to get rid of the attacks altogether.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_290..dst: Forse dovremmo provare un metodo piu' radicale se vogliamo che gli attacchi diventino solo un ricordo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_290..src: No. No. No... podemos pedir ayuda siempre. Lucharemos. Protegeremos a... nuestras compañeras.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_290..ref: No, no. We cannot always. Rely on others. We will fight. To protect our friends.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_290..dst: No. No. Non... possiamo chiedere aiuto sempre. Lutteremo. Proteggeremo le... nostre compagne.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_290..src: En ese caso, deja que te ayudemos. ¿Hay algo que podamos hacer?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_290..ref: In that case, please let us help you. Is there anything that we can do?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_290..dst: In tal caso, lascia che ti aiutiamo. C'e' qualcosa che possiamo fare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_290..src: Armas. Armaduras. Necesitamos para luchar... y que sean poderosas y resistentes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_290..ref: ... Weapons. Armor. We need them to fight. Many strong. And sturdy ones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_290..dst: Armi. Armature. Ci servono per lottare... e devono essere potenti e resistenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_290..src: Vaya, pues has dado con la humana perfecta. Espera, que te las forjo en un instante.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_290..ref: Well, that kind of work's perfect for me. Understood, I'll make them for you right away, so please wait!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_290..dst: Oh, allora hai trovato l'umana perfetta. Aspetta, che te le forgio in un attimo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_300..src: Esto es lo que he logrado hasta ahora, ¿qué te parece?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_300..ref: This is what I've got for you so far. How does it look?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_300..dst: Ecco cos'ho realizzato finora. Che te ne pare?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_300..src: ¡Muy bien! Son... geniales. ¡Podemos luchar... con ellas!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_300..ref: Amazing, amazing! These are all. Great! We can fight. With this!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_300..dst: Benissimo! Sono... fantastiche. Possiamo combattere... con queste!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_300..src: ¿Te parece bien... que me las quede? Son una artesanía... de calidad. De buena calidad.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_300..ref: Is it okay? For me to take them? These are all. Well-made. Very well-made.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_300..dst: Ti dispiace... se le tengo io? Sono... oggetti di qualita'. Di ottima qualita'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_300..src: Sé que no es el típico asunto que se resuelve en dos asaltos, por eso intenté que quedaran lo más resistentes posible.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_300..ref: I know this isn't the kind of thing that'll get resolved in one or two skirmishes, so I built them to last.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_300..dst: So che non e' una cosa che si risolve in uno o due scontri, percio' ho cercato di renderle il piu' resistenti possibile.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_300..src: Sí. Sí. Con esto... podremos luchar. Protegeremos... a nuestras amigas. Gracias, humana. Agradecida. Agradecida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_300..ref: Yes, yes. With this, we can fight. We will protect. Our friends. Thank you, human. I am truly. Grateful.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_300..dst: Si', si'. Con queste... potremo combattere. Proteggeremo... le nostre amiche. Grazie, umana. Ti sono... grata. Davvero grata.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_310..src: ¿Te encuentras bien? Esa herida es bastante fea...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_310..ref: Are you all right? That's a nasty-looking wound ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_310..dst: Stai bene? E' una ferita proprio brutta...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_310..src: ¡Ha... ha sido un monstruo! ¡Ag... uf, uf!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_310..ref: I-it was a monster! I-I ... Ngh!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_310..dst: E'... e' stato un mostro! I-io... Ngh!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_310..src: Vale, no te esfuerces en hablar. Haré lo que pueda para curarte.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_310..ref: It's okay, don't talk anymore. I'll do what I can for your injury.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_310..dst: Va tutto bene, non parlare piu'. Faro' il possibile per curarti la ferita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..ref: ... Thanks, that feels a lot better.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..dst: Grazie... Mi sento gia' molto meglio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..src: Me alegro. Ese monstruo sería tremendo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..ref: That's good to hear. That monster must've been really strong.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..dst: Mi fa piacere. Quel mostro dev'essere stato davvero forte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..src: Pues... Dije que fue un monstruo, pero no estoy seguro de qué era.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..ref: Oh, right. I called it a monster, but ... I'm not too sure what it was.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..dst: Ah, gia'. L'ho chiamato mostro, ma... non sono sicuro di cosa fosse.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..src: Era más bien como una roca rara. Me acerqué a inspeccionarla, saltó y me atacó.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..ref: It looked more like a weird rock. When I went to inspect it, it jumped up and attacked.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..dst: Sembrava piu' una strana roccia. Quando mi sono avvicinato per esaminarla, e' saltata su e mi ha attaccato.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..src: Y no era un aviso, desde luego. No sé qué habría sido de mí si no me hubieras encontrado.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..ref: And yeah, it wasn't messing around. I don't know what would've happened if you hadn't found me when you did ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..dst: E si', faceva sul serio. Non so cosa mi sarebbe successo se non mi avessi trovato in tempo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..src: Rocas agresivas, ¿eh? No puedo ignorar este incidente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..ref: Aggressive rocks, huh? We'll definitely have to do something about that.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..dst: Rocce aggressive, eh? Dovremo assolutamente fare qualcosa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..src: Sería buena idea despejar la zona antes de que alguien más salga herido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..ref: Probably a good idea to clear the area before anyone else gets hurt.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..dst: Sarebbe meglio sgomberare la zona prima che qualcun altro si faccia male.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..src: ¡A-adónde vas! ¡Es muy peligroso! ¡Es más duro que cualquier otro monstruo que hayas visto por aquí!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..ref: H-hang on, they're really dangerous! They're way stronger than any of the other monsters around here!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..dst: A-aspetta, dove vai! E' molto pericoloso! E' piu' forte di qualsiasi altro mostro che hai visto da queste parti!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..src: Antes de salir, asegúrate de estar bien preparada para lo inesperado. Y, si te topas con mi monstruo, no hagas locuras.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..ref: If you're going out there, make sure you're ready for anything. And if you do run into them, don't push yourself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..dst: Prima di uscire, assicurati di essere pronta a ogni evenienza. E se dovessi incontrare quei mostri, non fare pazzie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..src: Te lo pido por favor, si ves que estás en peligro, huye lo más rápido que puedas. Las leyendas vivas molan más.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..ref: Seriously, if you think you're in trouble, make a run for it. Don't be a hero.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..dst: Te lo chiedo per favore: se ti trovi in pericolo, scappa piu' in fretta che puoi. Meglio una leggenda viva.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..src: Vale, te prometo que no cometeremos ninguna estupidez.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..ref: ... I promise, we won't do anything stupid.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_320..dst: Va bene, ti prometto che non faremo sciocchezze.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_330..src: Tenía razón... Nunca he visto nada igual por aquí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_330..ref: Yep ... We haven't seen anything like that around here before.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_330..dst: Avevi ragione... Non ho mai visto niente del genere da queste parti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_330..src: Sé que acepté la misión sin pensarlo dos veces, pero, ahora que lo pienso, habría que prepararse bien antes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_330..ref: I know I signed us up for this without a second thought, but it does look like something we should prepare for first.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_330..dst: So che ho accettato la missione senza pensarci due volte, ma ora che ci penso, dovremmo prepararci bene prima.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_330..src: Será mejor que esperemos un poco y volvamos más adelante, aunque no me gusta la idea de dejar esta cosa a sus anchas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_330..ref: It might be better to fall back for now and return here later. But, I don't like the idea of letting this thing stay out on the loose either ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_330..dst: Forse per ora e' meglio ritirarci e tornare piu' avanti. Pero' non mi piace nemmeno l'idea di lasciare in giro quella creatura...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_340..src: Ya puedes respirar tranquilo; hemos acabado con el monstruo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_340..ref: You can breathe easy now—we took care of that monster.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_340..dst: Ora puoi tirare un sospiro di sollievo: abbiamo sconfitto quel mostro.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_340..src: No exagerabas ni un poco cuando me avisaste de la gravedad de la situación. Me pregunto de dónde habrá venido.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_340..ref: You weren't kidding. It was a force to be reckoned with. I wonder where it even came from.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_340..dst: Non esageravi quando mi hai avvertito. Era davvero un avversario temibile. Chissa' da dove veniva.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_340..ref: Thank goodness. That's a huge relief.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_340..src: Bueno, ahora que hemos solucionado esa parte, ya no tienes de qué preocuparte. Dedícate a recuperarte de tus heridas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_340..ref: Anyways, since that's settled, you've got nothing to worry about. Please just focus on recovering from your injury.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_340..dst: Comunque, ora che abbiamo risolto la faccenda, non hai piu' nulla di cui preoccuparti. Pensa solo a riprenderti dalle ferite.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_340..src: Claro. Muchas gracias por tu ayuda.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_340..ref: Sure, will do. Thank you again for all your help.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_340..dst: Certo, lo faro'. Grazie ancora per tutto il tuo aiuto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_350..src: Vaya, no esperaba veros a todos hoy. ¿Qué ha pasado?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_350..ref: Huh? I wasn't expecting to see so many of you today. What happened?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_350..dst: Oh? Non mi aspettavo di vedervi tutti qui oggi. Che e' successo?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_350..ref: Oh, Tall Ones! We're running away!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_350..src: ¡Te explico! Hay unos monstruos enormes merodeando por nuestras casas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_350..ref: Um, so, you see! There are some scary big monsters near our homes!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_350..dst: Ehm, ecco! Ci sono dei mostri enormi che si aggirano vicino alle nostre case!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_350..src: Y no queremos estar cerca por si les entra hambre. ¡Por eso nos fuimos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_350..ref: We don't want to be anywhere near them! So, we left!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_350..dst: Non vogliamo stare loro troppo vicino! Cosi' ce ne siamo andati!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_350..ref: ... Are you planning on going back?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_350..src: Bueeeno, este lugar no está nada mal, pero sí, nos gustan nuestras casas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_350..ref: Weeell, I guess this spot's not so bad? But yeah, we'd rather be in our own homes!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_350..dst: Be', questo posto non e' poi cosi' male, ma si', preferiamo le nostre case!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_350..src: No te preocupes, las recuperaremos por vosotros. ¿Qué clase de abusón se mete con los más pequeños?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_350..ref: Don't worry, we'll get them back for you. Anyone who steals from someone smaller than them is just a bully!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_350..dst: Non preoccuparti, le recupereremo per voi. Chi ruba a qualcuno piu' piccolo di lui e' solo un prepotente!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_350..src: ¡Qué bien! ¡Qué ilusión! Os aguardaremos con muchas esperanzas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_350..ref: Oh, wow! Yay! I'm so super excited to hear that! We'll be waiting for you!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_350..dst: Oh, wow! Che bello! Non vedo l'ora! Vi aspetteremo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_360..src: Esos son los monstruos que mencionaron las gentes Alber... La verdad es que yo también huiría de algo así.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_360..ref: Those are the monsters they were talking about ... Yeah, I'd run away from them, too.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_360..dst: Quelli sono i mostri di cui parlavano gli abitanti dell'Alber... Si', anch'io scapperei da qualcosa del genere.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_360..src: Cuanto antes los saquemos de aquí, antes podremos llevar buenas noticias de vuelta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_360..ref: Well, the quicker we take them out, the sooner we can give them the good news.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_360..dst: Be', prima li eliminiamo, prima potremo portare loro la buona notizia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_370..src: Todavía no habéis terminado de deshacer las maletas, ¿no? ¡Porque esos monstruos son cosa del pasado!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_370..ref: You haven't finished unpacking yet, right? Because the monsters are no more!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_370..dst: Non avete ancora finito di disfare i bagagli, vero? Perche' quei mostri non ci sono piu'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_370..src: ¡Haaaaalaaaaa! ¿En seeerio? ¿Podemos volver a casa y no estarán allí?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_370..ref: Wowee! You really mean it?! We can go home and they won't be there?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_370..dst: Uaaaa! Dici sul serio?! Possiamo tornare a casa e loro non ci saranno?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_370..src: ¡Pues claro que no! No os preocupéis, es totalmente seguro.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_370..ref: You bet! You don't have to worry, it's totally safe!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_370..dst: Puoi scommetterci! Non preoccupatevi, e' tutto sicuro!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_370..src: ¡Bieeen! ¡Qué alegría! ¡Como en casa, en ningún lado!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_370..ref: Yaaaaay! I'm so happy! There's no place like home!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_370..dst: Si'i'i'! Sono cosi' felice! Non c'e' posto come casa!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_370..src: Qué amables sois los altus. ¡Muchas gracias por acabar con esos bichos nauseabundos!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_370..ref: Thank you, Tall Ones! Thanks for getting rid of those nasty monsters!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_370..dst: Grazie, Gente Alta! Grazie per aver eliminato quei mostri disgustosi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..src: ¡Ay! Me has asustado. ¿A qué viene ese grito?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..ref: Yeesh, you scared me. Why'd you scream like that, anyway?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..dst: Accidenti, mi hai spaventato. Perche' hai urlato cosi', poi?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..src: Pe-perdón. Pensaba que eras el monstruo que me venía detrás...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..ref: S-sorry about that. I thought you were the monster that's been chasing me, so ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..dst: S-scusa. Pensavo fossi il mostro che mi stava inseguendo, cosi'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..src: Ah, verás, trabajo investigando la zona y me han puesto al mando de recopilar datos e informar de nuestros descubrimientos.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..ref: Oh, I'm running the investigation in this area. I'm in charge of compiling the data and reporting on our findings.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..dst: Ah, sto conducendo le indagini in questa zona. Mi occupo di raccogliere i dati e riferire i risultati.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..src: Pero nunca había visto a un monstruo como este. Salió de la nada y... obviamente, corrí sin mirar atrás.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..ref: But, I've never seen a monster like this before. It came out of nowhere, too ... Obviously, I ran for my life.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..dst: Pero' non avevo mai visto un mostro del genere. E' spuntato dal nulla e... ovviamente, sono scappato a gambe levate.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..src: Era enorme, con colmillos afilados, me pareció ver que era un cocodrilo bestial. No lo ha-habrás visto por aquí, ¿ve-verdad?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..ref: It was massive, ferocious, and looked like a beastly crocodile. Y-you haven't seen it around, h-have you?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..dst: Era enorme, con zanne affilate, mi e' sembrato un coccodrillo bestiale. N-non l'avrai visto da queste parti, ve-vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..src: No, puedes estar tranquilo. Y me alegro de que estés bien.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..ref: Nope, can't say that I have. I'm glad you're all right, though.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..dst: No, puoi stare tranquillo. E mi fa piacere che tu stia bene.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..src: Ja, ja... Ya... Pero ¿a qué precio? Al huir, dejé atrás todas las notas de mi investigación.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..ref: Haha ... Sure, but at what cost? When I bolted, I left all my research notes behind.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..dst: Eh, eh... Gia'... Ma a che prezzo? Scappando, ho lasciato indietro tutti i miei appunti di ricerca.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..src: No puedo abandonarlas sin más... Debo volver para recogerlas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..ref: I can't leave them there ... I need to go back and get them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..dst: Non posso abbandonarle cosi'... Devo tornare a riprenderle.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..src: Podríamos ir nosotros, si lo prefieres.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..ref: You know, we could do it for you.
N-no, that would be too much ...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..src: Está bien, iré a ver a qué monstruo nos enfrentaremos en todo caso.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..ref: It's fine. I'd like to get a good look at this monster myself.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..dst: Va bene, vado comunque a vedere che mostro ci aspetta.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..src: S-si insistes... Pero escucha bien lo que te digo: bajo ningún concepto te enfrentes a él.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..ref: I-if you insist. But, let me just say this—absolutely do NOT fight it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..dst: S-se insisti... Ma ascolta bene quello che ti dico: non affrontarlo in nessun caso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..src: Ve con sigilo, agarra esas notas y sal de allí con más prisas que vergüenza.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..ref: Sneak over, grab the documents, then get the heck out of there.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..dst: Avvicinati di soppiatto, prendi quegli appunti e poi sganciati via in fretta e furia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..src: No lo azuces ni lo pinches ni lo ofendas de ningún modo. Solo quiero los papeles.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..ref: Don't poke it, don't prod it, don't even look at it funny. All I need are those papers.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..dst: Non stuzzicarlo, non toccarlo e neanche guardarlo male. Mi servono solo quei documenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..src: Vale, vale... Seré tan silenciosa como una sombra.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..ref: ... Fine, we'll be quiet and careful.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_380..dst: Va bene, va bene... Saro' silenziosa come un'ombra.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_390..src: Sí que es grande ese cocodrilo... No sería divertido que nos atacara...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_390..ref: Wh-whoa, that crocodile monster is huge. We'd be in for a really bad time if that thing attacked us.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_390..dst: Quello e' un coccodrillo enorme... Non sarebbe per niente divertente se ci attaccasse...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_390..src: No me importaría enfrentarme a ese monstruo si no tuviera ese aspecto tan formidable... Pero sí, debemos tomarnos en serio el consejo del investigador.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_390..ref: I wouldn't mind taking it out if it looked a little weaker, but ... Yeah, we should probably take that guy's advice to heart.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_390..dst: Non mi dispiacerebbe affrontare quel mostro se non avesse quell'aspetto cosi' imponente... Pero' si', conviene prendere sul serio il consiglio del ricercatore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_390..src: Nos acercaremos de puntillas a recuperar los documentos y hasta luego.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_390..ref: Let's just stay out of sight, grab those documents, and go.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_390..dst: Ci avvicineremo in punta di piedi a recuperare i documenti e poi a tutto la'.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_400..ref: Y-you really did it?! You got my research notes back?!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_400..dst: Ce-ce l'avete fatta?! Avete i miei appunti?!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_400..src: Tal y como prometimos. Y no exagerabas ni un poco, ese monstruo tenía una pinta espantosa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_400..ref: Just like we promised. But you weren't kidding. That monster looked really dangerous.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_400..dst: Proprio come promesso. E non esageravi per niente, quel mostro aveva un aspetto terrificante.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_400..src: Y-ya, solo de pensarlo me entran escalofríos...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_400..ref: O-oooh, just thinking about it is giving me chills.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_400..dst: G-gia', solo a pensarci mi vengono i brividi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_400..src: No sé cómo daros las gracias por infiltraros en su territorio y recuperar mis valiosos papeles.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_400..ref: But, I can't thank you enough for braving its territory to get my precious papers back.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_400..dst: Non so come ringraziarvi per essere entrati di nascosto nel suo territorio e aver recuperato i miei preziosi documenti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_400..src: Las palabras no bastan, ¡estoy en deuda con vosotros! Lo digo en serio, no sabéis lo importante que son esas notas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_400..ref: Words aren't nearly enough, but I'm seriously grateful! I mean it, you have no idea how important those notes are.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_400..dst: Le parole non bastano, sono in debito con voi! Lo dico sul serio, non avete idea di quanto siano importanti quegli appunti.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_400..src: No pasa nada, todos somos miembros del equipo de investigación. Hoy por ti, mañana por mí.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_400..ref: It's fine, we're all Research Team members here. We've got to have each others' backs.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq02_400..dst: Non c'e' di che, siamo tutti membri della Squadra di Ricerca. Oggi per te, domani per me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_010..src: Humm, el área de investigación ha crecido considerablemente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_010..ref: Hm, the area we're investigating certainly has grown.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_010..dst: Hmm, l'area di ricerca e' cresciuta parecchio.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_010..src: He pensado en enviarles provisiones a mis compañeros para subirles la moral y mostrarles mi agradecimiento por sus incursiones.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_010..ref: To that end, I'd like to send out supplies to the folks in the field, to keep their morale up and show my appreciation.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_010..dst: Ho pensato di inviare delle provviste ai miei compagni per tirare su il loro morale e ringraziarli per le loro spedizioni.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_010..src: Me siento mal por pedirte ayuda, ya que seguramente tú seas la que más aporta al equipo, pero si pudierais, sería genial.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_010..ref: I feel bad asking you to help since you've arguably put in the most work, but if you could, it would be invaluable.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_010..dst: Mi sento in colpa a chiederti aiuto, visto che probabilmente sei tu quella che contribuisce di piu' alla squadra, ma se poteste farlo, sarebbe fantastico.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_010..src: No te preocupes, no nos importa en absoluto. ¡Nosotros lo haremos encantados!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_010..ref: Don't worry, we don't mind. We'll handle it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_010..dst: Non ti preoccupare, non ci pesa affatto. Ce ne occupiamo noi, volentieri!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_010..ref: Thank you in advance for your help!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_010..dst: E grazie mille fin da subito!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_010..src: Todos los puntos de entrega y los paquetes están apuntados aquí. No será coser y cantar, pero confío en que os las apañaréis.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_010..ref: The locations and the items to be delivered are all on this note. It won't be a quick job, but I know you'll manage just fine.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_010..dst: Tutti i punti di consegna e i pacchi sono annotati qui. Non sara' una passeggiata, ma confido che ve la caverete.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_020..src: ¡Vaya, cuántas provisiones! Ya me estaba empezando a preocupar, no podéis llegar en mejor momento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_020..ref: Whoa, look at all these supplies! I was starting to run low, so you came at a great time.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_020..dst: Wow, quante provviste! Stavo iniziando a preoccuparmi, non potete arrivare in un momento migliore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_020..src: Ahora a investigar sin preocuparme por la comida, ¡gracias!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_020..ref: Now I can keep investigating without worrying about food, thanks!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_020..dst: Ora posso investigare senza preoccuparmi del cibo, grazie!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_030..ref: F-foooood! And tons of it, too!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_030..dst: Cibooooooo! E in gran quantita', oltretutto!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_030..src: No sabes lo feliz que estoy. Llevo un tiempo sin poder comer hasta hartarme, ¡gracias por traerme esto!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_030..ref: You have no idea how happy this is making me. It's been forever since I've gotten to eat my fill! Thank you for bringing this!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_030..dst: Non sai quanto sono felice. E' da una vita che non riesco a mangiare a sazieta'! Grazie per avermi portato questo!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_040..src: Últimamente estaba un poco abatido, tanto que llegué a plantearme dejar el equipo de investigación...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_040..ref: ... Lately, I've been feeling so run-down that I was seriously considering quitting the Research Team ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_040..dst: Ultimamente mi sentivo un po' giu', tanto da arrivare a pensare di lasciare la Squadra di Ricerca...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_040..src: Pero esto me da fuerzas para seguir un poco más. Gracias, era justo lo que necesitaba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_040..ref: But this is giving me the strength to go on for at least a little longer. Thank you, these supplies were needed.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_040..dst: Ma questo mi da' la forza di andare avanti ancora un po'. Grazie, queste provviste erano proprio cio' che serviva.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_050..src: ¿Ya habéis vuelto? Pues no era una entrega ligera, desde luego...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_050..ref: Y-you're back already?! That wasn't a small amount of supplies, either ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_050..dst: Siete gia' tornati?! E poi non era una quantita' da poco, davvero...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_050..src: Bueno, te mentiría si dijera que ha sido fácil, pero se me da muy bien recolectar.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_050..ref: Well, I wouldn't say it was easy, but I'm good at gathering stuff.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_050..dst: Beh, mentirei se dicessi che e' stato facile, ma raccogliere cose e' il mio punto forte.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_050..src: Snif, snif... Ay, eres un portento. Si tuviera una compañera como tú con la que compartir mi puesto de logística...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_050..ref: *Sniff* You're such a wonderfully capable person. It would be so reassuring to have you as a fellow logistics manager ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_050..dst: Snif, snif... Sei un portento. Sarebbe cosi' rassicurante averti come collega nel mio ruolo di logistica...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_050..src: Ya... No aceptaría esa misión, no creo que sea lo mío.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_050..ref: Yeaaaaah, I'm going to have to refuse. That sounds like a pain.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_050..dst: Gia'... Devo rifiutare, non credo che faccia per me.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_050..src: ¡Ja, ja, ja! Claro que no. Aun así, gracias por tu ayuda. No es mucho, pero llévate esto como recompensa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_050..ref: Haha! You're not wrong there. Still, thank you for all your help. It's not much, but please take this as a reward.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_050..dst: Eh, eh, eh! Hai ragione, in effetti. Comunque, grazie per tutto il tuo aiuto. Non e' molto, ma prendi questo come ricompensa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..ref: Hello. Are you still out hunting for relics?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..src: No sé hacer otra cosa. Me imagino la de objetos que estarán en este nuevo territorio esperando a que yo los descubra...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..ref: That goes without saying. A new region means more undiscovered objects just waiting to be found.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..dst: Non so fare altro. Mi immagino quanti oggetti ci saranno in questo nuovo territorio, in attesa che li scopra io...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..src: Por cierto, hace tiempo que me ronda una pregunta... ¿Por qué te desvives tanto por coleccionar reliquias?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..ref: So, I've been wondering this for a while now, but ... Why are you so keen on collecting as many relics as you can find?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..dst: A proposito, e' da un po' che mi pongo una domanda... Perche' ti impegni cosi' tanto a collezionare quante piu' reliquie possibili?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..src: ¿Cómo? ¿No te lo he contado? Quiero atesorar los recuerdos de sus propietarios.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..ref: Hm? Didn't I mention? I want to preserve the memories of whoever used to own them.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..dst: Eh? Non te l'ho mai raccontato? Voglio preservare i ricordi di chi un tempo le possedeva.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..src: Estas reliquias eran herramientas comunes que la gente usaba sin darles mayor importancia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..ref: These relics were all commonplace tools that people used without a second thought back in their day.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..dst: Queste reliquie erano strumenti comuni che la gente usava senza pensarci troppo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..src: Y yo me dedico a averiguar quién, dónde, cuándo y cómo las usaba.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..ref: What I do is research the who, where, when, and how.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..dst: E io mi occupo di scoprire chi, dove, quando e come le usava.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..src: Básicamente, estás haciendo un estudio histórico.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..ref: So, you're doing a historical study.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..dst: In pratica, stai facendo uno studio storico.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..src: Algo así, sí. Aunque, comparado con el estudio de las ruinas del Imperio aladissiano, es una investigación a una escala más pequeña.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..ref: Something like that. Compared to the research going into the ruin of the Aladissian Empire, it's on a much, much smaller scale.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..dst: Piu' o meno, si'. Anche se, rispetto allo studio delle rovine dell'Impero Aladissiano, e' una ricerca su scala molto piu' piccola.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..src: Pero si lo miramos con perspectiva, es demasiado fácil pasar por alto estos pedacitos complementarios de historia.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..ref: But, if you're only looking at the bigger picture, it's all too easy to miss these incidental pieces of history.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..dst: Ma se lo guardiamo con prospettiva, e' fin troppo facile tralasciare questi piccoli frammenti di storia.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..src: Tiene sentido. Si te soy sincera, me alegro de que no intentes sacarles un beneficio.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..ref: Makes sense. If I'm being honest, I'm glad that you're not just trying to turn a profit on these.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..dst: Ha senso. A dirtela sincera, mi fa piacere che tu non stia cercando di ricavarci un profitto.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..src: Bueno, ¿cuántas necesitas esta vez? ¡Dinos un número!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..ref: Right, how many are you hoping for this time? We can help out again!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..dst: Insomma, quante te ne servono questa volta? Dai, di' un numero!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..src: Gracias por ser tan profesionales. Supongo que no os importará reunir, no sé... ¿unas seis?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..ref: Thank you for getting straight to business. I don't suppose you'd mind gathering ... six of them for me?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..dst: Grazie per essere cosi' professionali. Suppongo che non vi dispiacera' raccoglierne, mah... circa sei?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..src: Claro que no. Puede que tardemos un poco, así que espéranos, ¿vale?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..ref: Absolutely. That might take us a little while, so just kick back and relax, okay?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_060..dst: Certo che no. Potrebbe richiederci un po' di tempo, quindi aspetta pure, va bene?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..src: Increíble... Habéis vuelto a superar mis expectativas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..ref: My word ... Once again, you've managed to completely exceed my expectations.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..dst: Incredibile... Avete superato di nuovo tutte le mie aspettative.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..ref: So, this was a good haul?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..src: ¿Bueno dices? ¡Buenísimo! Me habéis devuelto las ganas de presentar mi solicitud oficial para formar parte de vuestro grupo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..ref: Without question! It makes me want to seriously petition to join your crew.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..dst: Buon, dici? Ottimo! Mi avete fatto venire voglia di presentare domanda ufficiale per entrare nel vostro gruppo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..src: ¿Y bien? ¿Aceptáis uniros a mi búsqueda de artefactos y el conocimiento que esconden?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..ref: Well? How about it? What would you say to joining me in the pursuit of artifacts and their related knowledge?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..dst: Ebbene? Che ne dite? Vi unireste a me nella ricerca di artefatti e del sapere che nascondono?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..src: Pues no, la verdad, ser cazatesoros está bien como algo puntual, pero no es lo nuestro, lo siento.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..ref: Nah, being part-time relic hunters works best for us. We just like doing this on the side.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..dst: Beh, no, la verita'... Fare i cacciatori di tesori va bene per una volta, ma non fa per noi, mi dispiace.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..src: Ah, vaya... La verdad es que para ser una tarea esporádica, se os da de lujo conseguir grandes botines.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..ref: Ah, alas. ... Still, for casual searchers, you manage to get some truly impressive results.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..dst: Ah, peccato... Pero', a dire il vero, per essere un lavoro saltuario, riuscite a portare a casa bottini davvero notevoli.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..src: Supongo que obligaros a esto sería desperdiciar vuestro talento natural, tal vez esta negativa sea lo mejor.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..ref: I suppose forcing you into it would be a waste of your natural talent, so perhaps this is for the best.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..dst: Immagino che obbligarvi sarebbe uno spreco del vostro talento naturale, forse questo rifiuto e' la cosa migliore.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..src: Hale, no os robo más tiempo. Esta es la recompensa que os corresponde por este lote de reliquias.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..ref: But, I won't keep you any longer. Here's your reward for this batch of relics.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_070..dst: Bene, non vi rubo altro tempo. Questa e' la ricompensa che vi spetta per questo lotto di reliquie.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..src: ¡Ay, ay, ay! Pero ¿qué son estas vías tan enormes?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..ref: My, my, my! Would you look at this massive railroad!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..dst: Mamma mia! Ma guardate che binari enormi!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..ref: Is there something wrong with it?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..src: ¿No lo notas? La fascinación que te transmite su extensión, la emoción de no saber a dónde te llevarán. ¿No te dan ganas de decir "halaaa"?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..ref: Can't you feel it? That wonder brought on by its sheer length? The excitement of not truly knowing where it ends?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..dst: Non lo senti? La meraviglia che ti trasmette la sua lunghezza, l'emozione di non sapere davvero dove finisce. Non ti viene voglia di dire "ohhh"?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..src: A ver, las vías se construyen para transportar cosas muy necesarias en vagonetas, ¿verdad? Pero con estas dimensiones, no sabría qué decir.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..ref: Railroads are made to transport goods using carts, right? But this width and length don't give me that impression.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..dst: Senti, i binari servono a trasportare cose necessarie su vagoni, giusto? Ma con queste dimensioni, non saprei proprio dire.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..src: Me encantaría ver el vehículo ancestral que descansa al final del camino.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..ref: I would love to see the ancient vehicle that lies at the end of these tracks with my own eyes.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..dst: Mi piacerebbe vedere con i miei occhi l'antico veicolo che riposa alla fine di questi binari.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..src: Pero ni chispita ganas tengo de recorrerlas con tanto monstruo. No tengo ni idea de cómo podría hacerlo sin perder la cabeza mientras investigo a mi propio ritmo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..ref: That being said, there are so many monsters lurking about. I have no idea how I could ensure my safety as I did my research, especially at the pace I prefer ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..dst: Pero', con tutti quei mostri in giro, non ne ho proprio voglia. Non ho idea di come potrei proteggermi mentre indago al mio ritmo...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..src: Vale, lo que quieres decir es que te gustaría que nos adelantáramos para ir despejando el camino. ¿Es eso?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..ref: Ah. So, basically, you want us to scout ahead and clear the way. That's what you're getting at, right?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..dst: Va bene, in pratica vorresti che andassimo avanti a sgombrare la strada. E' questo che intendi, vero?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..src: ¡Ay, pero si eres una lumbrera! Y una que siempre cumple con sus promesas, diría yo. Lo harías en una sentada, ¿a que sí? En un chuuum y en un chaaas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..ref: My, my, my! You're so astute! And so capable-looking, too. I'm sure it would be a snap for you! No trouble at all, yes?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..dst: Mamma mia, ma se sei una cima! E poi cosi' affidabile, direi. Lo faresti in una botta, vero? In un "zuuum" e in un "paaam"!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_080..ref: ( ... Would it have killed him to just ask?)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_090..src: Hemos acabado con los monstruos que merodeaban por las vías.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_090..ref: We cleared out all the monsters sitting on the tracks for you.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_090..dst: Abbiamo eliminato i mostri che ronzavano intorno ai binari.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_090..src: ¡Ay, ay, ay! Pero ¡muchísimas gracias! ¿Eso quiere decir que ya puedo ver la maravilla tecnológica que me aguarda al final de las vías y hacer "oooooh"?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_090..ref: My, my, my! Thank you ever so much! Does that mean I can go see the fabulous vehicle that lies at the end?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_090..dst: Mamma mia! Ma grazie mille! Vuol dire che posso andare a vedere la meraviglia tecnologica che mi aspetta alla fine dei binari e fare "oooooh"?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_090..src: ¡Ay, doble ay! ¡Qué maravilla! Iré a prepararme, si oyes "zuuum", ¡seré yo andando a toda prisa!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_090..ref: My, my, my! How wonderful! I shall make my preparations, then depart, posthaste!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_090..dst: Doppio mamma mia! Che meraviglia! Vado a prepararmi: se senti uno "zuum", saro' io che corro a tutta velocita'!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_090..src: Pero antes, ¡tachán! Te mereces esta recompensa.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_090..ref: Right, right. You deserve a reward! Please, take this!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_090..dst: Ma prima, tarata'! Ti meriti questa ricompensa.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_090..src: ¡Ayyyyy! Estoy emocionadísimo. Iré todo el camino pensando qué forma tendrá, con qué motivo lo construyeron, el sonido que hará cuando...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_090..ref: My, my, my! I can barely contain my excitement! I can't help but consider its potential shape, and purpose, and ...!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_090..dst: Ohhhhh! Sono entusiasta come non mai. Mi passera' tutto il viaggio a pensare a che forma avra', per quale scopo e' stato costruito, e il suono che fara' quando...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_090..src: (Será mejor que me vaya antes de que suelte más soniditos...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_090..ref: ( ... I'd better go before he starts lecturing.)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_090..dst: (Meglio che me ne vada prima che tiri fuori altri suonini...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..src: ¡Ay, ay y ay! ¡Qué es esto! ¿Qué es esto? ¡Qué es esto! Seguro que transportaba personas.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..ref: My, my, my! Now this is something else! Surely, this was for transporting people!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..dst: Mamma mia! Ma cos'e'! Che cos'e'! Che cos'e'! Di sicuro serviva a trasportare persone.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..src: Pero ¡qué diseño tan elegante! Me lo imagino haciendo "trac, trac" día tras día y el corazón me hace "pum, pum, pum" a toda velocidad...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..ref: Such an elegant design! Ah, just imagining it running during its heyday makes my heart soar ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..dst: Ma che design elegante! Me lo immagino fare "trac, trac" giorno dopo giorno e il cuore mi fa "bum, bum, bum" a tutta velocita'...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..src: Ja, ja, ja... Claro, claro... Bueno, tengo mucho lío, si me disculpas...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..ref: Ahaha, sure ... Uh, I have things that I have to do, sooo ...
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..dst: Ah, ah, ah... Certo, certo... Vabbe', ho un sacco di cose da fare, quindi se mi scusi...

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..src: ¡Ay, un momentín! ¿No crees que cuando dos personas observan la misma obra de arte se forma un vínculo muy especial?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..ref: Wait just one moment! Wouldn't you say that gazing at the same thing like this forms a special connection?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..dst: Oh, un attimino! Non credi che quando due persone contemplano la stessa opera d'arte nasca un legame davvero speciale?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..src: (Eso digo yo, "ay". Estamos perdiendo el tiempo...)
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..dst: (Anche per me, "oh". Stiamo solo perdendo tempo...)

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..src: Podría pasarme la vida entera contemplando esta belleza de la tecnología. Aunque nunca se me ocurriría llevármela, me encantaría tener un recuerdo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..ref: I could spend an eternity staring at this gorgeousness. While I wouldn't dare dream about absconding with it, it would be nice to keep it on hand.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..dst: Potrei passare una vita intera a contemplare questa meraviglia della tecnologia. Non mi passerebbe mai per la testa di portarmela via, ma mi piacerebbe averne un ricordo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..src: Vaya, que me encantaría hacer "chas, chas" y construir una maqueta.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..ref: In short, I wish to construct a model.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..dst: Insomma, che vorrei fare "ciac, ciac" e costruire un modellino.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..ref: Oh, yeah? How would you do that?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..src: ¡Ay, ay, ay! Pero ¡si ya tengo un plan y todo! Verás, he escrito hasta una lista de los materiales que necesitaría para darle vida.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..ref: My, my, my! I already have a plan, you see. Plus a list of the materials that would be required to build it.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..dst: Mamma mia! Ma se ho gia' un piano e tutto! Ho persino scritto la lista dei materiali che mi servirebbero per dargli vita.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..src: La cosa es que el ingrediente principal no quiere dejarse atrapar, pero la piedra damasquina sería un sustituto bastante decente.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..ref: While the key ingredient is proving to be elusive, Damascal Stone would be an acceptable substitute.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..dst: Il punto e' che l'ingrediente principale non si lascia trovare, ma la pietra damaschina sarebbe un sostituto piu' che dignitoso.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..src: Aunque debo darte la mala noticia de que solo se obtiene al derrotar monstruos, así que "nanay" de conseguirlo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..ref: Regrettably, it is only obtainable from monsters, making collecting it quite the conundrum.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..dst: Purtroppo devo darti la mala notizia: si ottiene solo sconfiggendo mostri, quindi niente da fare per ottenerlo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..src: O sea, si te he entendido bien, quieres que derrotemos a algunos monstruos para obtenerlo por ti.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..ref: Ah. In other words, you want us to take down some monsters so you can get your hands on it?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..dst: Quindi, se ho capito bene, vuoi che sconfiggiamo qualche mostro per ottenerlo al posto tuo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..ref: My, my, my! Yes, indeed! You're so sharp!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..dst: Oh, ah, oh! Proprio cosi'! Che prontezza!

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..src: Eso sí, os prometo que habrá una recompensa si os tomáis tantas molestias. ¿"Yey" o "naaah"?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..ref: Of course, you would be rewarded for your troubles. Pleeease?
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..dst: Certo, vi prometto una ricompensa per tutte le vostre fatiche. Che dite, "si'i'i'" o "nooo"?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..src: Bueno, no te impacientes si tardamos un poco, nos llevará un tiempo.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..ref: Well, as long as you don't mind that it'll probably take a while.
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_100..dst: Beh, non impazientirti se tardiamo un po', ci vorra' del tempo.

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_110..ref: This was what you were looking for, right?

eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_110..src: ¡Ay, ay, ay! ¡Justo eso! ¡Espléndido! ¡Ya puedo terminar la maqueta!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_110..ref: My, my, my! That's the very thing! How splendid! Now I can complete my model!
eventmessagedata/event_message_xq03_110..dst: Oh, oh, oh! Proprio quello! Splendido! Ora posso finire il modellino!
